title: Width, Memory, and Delay: A Resource Accounting for the Limits of Flat Multi-Agent Systems
summary: A recurring question in the design of scalable multi-agent systems -- from robot swarms to collectives of large-language-model (LLM) agents -- is whether adding more agents can, on its own, overcome performance limits, or whether a qualitatively \emph{deeper} organization is required. A recent preprint argues that flat, homogeneous multi-agent systems face an irreducible, population-independent ``causal floor'' on achievable error, removable only by hierarchical (nested-loop) organization. Using a controlled disturbance-rejection testbed with an exactly computable optimum, we show this conclusion is too strong and replace it with a quantitative resource model built on three resources: population \emph{width} $N$, per-agent internal-model \emph{memory} $d$, and prediction across the observation \emph{delay} $τ$. We establish three claims. (i) The achievable floor is governed not by architectural hierarchy but by per-agent internal-model content: a flat, homogeneous swarm whose agents carry a matched internal model of the disturbance matches or beats a designed two-loop hierarchy at equal per-agent memory -- so temporal depth can be dynamical (recurrent memory), not architectural (nesting). (ii) The three resources are \emph{not mutually interchangeable}; we chart the exchange rates and the hard non-exchange boundaries on an explicit width$\times$memory map, including a strict equal-total-state-budget comparison. (iii) A residual floor is set by the observation delay and the environment's unpredictability over that horizon, which we verify against the optimal controller. We quantify the price of replacing oracle knowledge of the disturbance spectrum with online learning, provide a preliminary robustness check against a mild bounded nonlinearity and a spatially-extended plant, and distill four design rules for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控扰动抑制测试平台，反驳了"扁平同质多智能体系统存在不可消除的因果性能地板，只能靠层级组织突破"的观点。作者提出基于三种资源（群体宽度N、智能体内部模型记忆d、观测延迟τ上的预测）的定量资源模型，证明平坦同质群体若携带匹配的扰动内部模型，可媲美或超越两级层级结构；三种资源不可互换；剩余性能地板由观测延迟和环境不可预测性决定。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统设计中的核心问题：增加智能体数量本身能否突破性能极限，还是需要更深层次的组织结构？近期一篇预印本声称扁平同质多智能体系统存在与群体规模无关的"因果地板"，只能通过层级（嵌套循环）组织消除。作者认为该结论过于绝对，需要通过精确可计算的受控实验进行量化检验和修正。
AI.method: 采用扰动抑制测试平台作为受控实验系统，该平台具有精确可计算的最优解。构建了以三种资源为核心的定量模型：群体宽度N（智能体数量）、每智能体内部模型记忆d、跨观测延迟τ的预测能力。通过严格对比平坦同质群体（携带匹配扰动内部模型）与两级嵌套层级结构的性能，并绘制宽度×记忆资源映射图，分析资源的交换率和不可交换边界，包括等总状态预算的严格比较。
AI.result: （i）性能地板由智能体内部模型内容决定而非架构层级：携带匹配内部模型的平坦同质群体在相同每智能体记忆下可匹配或超越两级层级结构——时间深度可以是动态的（循环记忆）而非架构性的（嵌套）。（ii）三种资源不可互换：绘制了宽度×记忆映射图，确定了交换率和硬性不可交换边界。（iii）残余地板由观测延迟和环境在该时域内的不可预测性决定，并通过最优控制器验证。还量化了在线学习替代扰动频谱先知知识的代价。
AI.conclusion: 为实践者总结了四条设计规则：提升智能体内部模型质量比堆叠更多智能体或增加架构层级更有效；不同资源间存在不可互换的边界，需要根据任务选择资源组合；观测延迟和环境不可预测性是最终瓶颈；在线学习替代先知知识有可量化的代价。初步验证了方法对温和有界非线性和空间扩展对象的鲁棒性。

title: MAPLE-Guard: Memory-Aware Link Enforcement Against Memory-Link Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Includes examples that may be misleading or harmful. Code: https://github.com/xiong-wenjun/MAPLE-Guard
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly rely on persistent private and shared memories for long-horizon coordination. This memory layer improves continuity, but it also gives attackers a durable channel: a poisoned memory can be written once, continuously retrieved in later tasks, promoted into shared memory, and reused by other agents. A single poisoned write can therefore steer many later decisions and contaminate agents that never saw the original attack, all while no malicious message crosses a visible communication edge at the moment of harm. Further, because existing safeguards mainly inspect prompts, actions, or communication edges, they can miss attacks whose content appears benign at write time but becomes harmful after retrieval. We introduce Memory-Aware Propagation and Link Enforcement Guard, MAPLE-Guard, a memory-link guard for memory-enabled MAS. MAPLE-Guard monitors the memory lifecycle and places gates at write, retrieval, promotion, and cross-agent reuse, so risky memories can be quarantined, unsafe retrievals filtered, and poisoned private memories blocked before they enter shared memory. In the main evaluation, MAPLE-Guard lowers attack success rate (ASR) from 38.2% to 0.9% on LongMemEval and from 34.7% to 0.2% on AppWorld; it also raises multi-agent defense success rate (MDSR) from 54.0% to 74.3% and from 42.5% to 99.8% on the same benchmarks. These results suggest that memory-aware link enforcement covers a gap left by prompt-level and topology-level defenses. Code is available at the link: https://github.com/xiong-wenjun/MAPLE-Guard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAPLE-Guard，一种针对基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）中持久记忆层的安全防护机制。它监控记忆生命周期，在写入、检索、提升和跨智能体复用四个环节设置防护门，防止投毒记忆被传播和复用，从而阻断攻击者在记忆层建立的持久攻击通道。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统越来越多地依赖持久化的私有和共享记忆进行长时程协调。这种记忆层虽然提升了连续性，但也为攻击者提供了持久化攻击通道：一次投毒的记忆写入可以被后续任务反复检索、提升到共享记忆并被其他智能体复用。单个投毒写入就能影响大量后续决策，并污染从未见过原始攻击的智能体。更关键的是，现有防护手段主要检查提示、动作或通信边，容易漏掉那些写入时看起来良性、但检索后才产生危害的攻击。
AI.method: MAPLE-Guard在记忆生命周期中设置四道防护门：1) 写入门（write）：对有风险的记忆进行隔离；2) 检索门（retrieval）：过滤不安全的检索结果；3) 提升门（promotion）：在私有记忆进入共享记忆前进行拦截；4) 复用门（cross-agent reuse）：监控跨智能体记忆复用。通过这四道关卡形成记忆感知的链路防护。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval上，攻击成功率从38.2%降至0.9%；在AppWorld上，从34.7%降至0.2%。多智能体防御成功率（MDSR）在LongMemEval上从54.0%提升至74.3%，在AppWorld上从42.5%提升至99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，记忆感知的链路防护（memory-aware link enforcement）填补了提示级和拓扑级防御所遗漏的空白。代码已开源。

title: BANDMAS: Causality-Inspired Semantic Packet Scheduling for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems make decisions based on the aggregated information via exchanging messages across specialized agents. Forwarding every generated message among agents increases application-layer traffic. Yet, it introduces tremendous input tokens for agent processing, potentially raising inference latency and computational overhead. Existing approaches attempt to address the above issues by pruning agents or discarding redundant messages. Nevertheless, such agent-level or message-level optimization results in insufficient evidence supporting for final decisions or still containing redundant message transmissions. To address these challenges, we propose BANDMAS, a multi-agent collaboration framework that models inter-agent communications as task-oriented traffic, which enables efficient transmission via causality-inspired replay valuation. Specifically, we decompose messages into several data packets by analyzing their semantic features such as evidence and requests. The system only transmits these packets if their predicted replay-derived contribution exceeds their resource cost. Consequently, BANDMAS is able to adaptively schedule communication packets while adhering to bandwidth, latency, deadline, and receiver context constraints. On frozen Qwen3-4B traffic across SciFact, HotpotQA, and FanOutQA, our framework reduces application-layer bytes by 53.2\% to 77.3\% at selected caps and attains the highest mean task metric among constrained methods on all three workloads.

AI.tldr: BANDMAS是一个多智能体协作框架，通过将智能体间通信建模为任务导向流量，利用因果启发的回放估值机制，将消息分解为数据包并有选择性地传输，在保持任务性能的同时大幅减少应用层通信字节数（降低53.2%-77.3%）。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体系统中，所有智能体生成的消息都会被转发，导致大量输入token和推理延迟及计算开销。已有的优化方法（如剪枝智能体或丢弃冗余消息）要么导致决策证据不足，要么仍存在冗余消息传输，无法在效率和效果之间取得良好平衡。
AI.method: BANDMAS将智能体间通信建模为任务导向流量，通过因果启发的回放估值进行高效传输。具体而言，系统将消息根据语义特征（如证据和请求）分解为多个数据包，仅当预测的回放贡献超过资源成本时才传输这些数据包，并能在带宽、延迟、截止时间和接收者上下文约束下自适应调度通信数据包。
AI.result: 在SciFact、HotpotQA和FanOutQA三个数据集上使用Qwen3-4B模型，BANDMAS在选定上限下将应用层字节数减少53.2%至77.3%，并且在所有三个工作负载上均取得了受限方法中最高的平均任务指标。
AI.conclusion: BANDMAS通过任务导向的通信建模和数据包级别的选择性传输，实现了多智能体通信的高效性和有效性兼顾，证明了通过语义分解和因果回放估值可以在大幅降低通信开销的同时维持甚至提升任务表现。

title: MDGAM-Based Cooperative Task Scheduling for Communication-Constrained Distributed Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Cooperative task scheduling in communication-constrained distributed multi-agent systems is challenging because each agent must make decisions from partial and dynamic observations while satisfying complex practical constraints. Existing heuristics rely on handcrafted bidding rules and repeated consensus, whereas many learning-based methods assume global observations and lack explicit communication-based coordination. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a neural scheduling framework for distributed multi-robot task allocation (MRTA), consisting of a multi-decoder graph attention model (MDGAM) policy model and a critic-free group relative multi-agent policy gradient (GRMAPG) training algorithm. MDGAM uses an extended graph attention mechanism to jointly update node and edge features, and employs multiple decoders to generate task-selection decisions and communication messages. GRMAPG constructs group-relative advantages from equivalent task-planning instances to replace the critic network used in conventional MARL algorithms, thereby reducing training difficulty and improving convergence performance. Experiments under different problem scales and communication ranges show that the proposed method improves task-completion performance over existing heuristic and learning-based methods, while ablation, complexity, and generalization tests further validate the proposed innovations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向通信受限分布式多智能体系统的神经调度框架，包含多解码器图注意力模型（MDGAM）策略网络和无评论家组相对多智能体策略梯度（GRMAPG）训练算法，在多种问题规模和通信范围下均优于现有启发式和学习方法。
AI.motivation: 通信受限的分布式多智能体任务调度极具挑战性，因为每个智能体需基于部分动态观测做决策并满足复杂约束。现有启发式方法依赖手工设计的竞标规则和重复共识过程，而许多学习方法假设全局观测，缺乏基于显式通信的协调机制。
AI.method: 提出由两个核心组件构成的神经调度框架：(1) MDGAM策略模型，采用扩展的图注意力机制联合更新节点和边特征，利用多个解码器生成任务选择决策和通信消息；(2) GRMAPG训练算法，从等价任务规划实例构造组相对优势来替代传统MARL中的评论家网络，降低训练难度并提升收敛性能。
AI.result: 在不同问题规模和通信范围下的实验表明，所提方法在任务完成性能上优于现有启发式和学习方法。消融实验、复杂度分析和泛化测试进一步验证了所提出创新点的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了通信受限分布式多机器人任务分配问题中全局观测假设与显式通信协调缺失的局限性，通过去评论家的组相对策略梯度训练方法有效提升了训练效率和性能。

title: ELECTRIC: Evidential Learning-Enhanced CT Reconstruction via Iterative Correction
summary: Here we introduce ELECTRIC (Evidential Learning-Enhanced CT Reconstruction via Iterative Correction), a physics-guided Bayesian formulation. An evidential neural network provides an image proposal and an error-predictive epistemic-uncertainty surrogate. The latter is converted into an adaptive precision field and inserted into a Poisson-weighted MAP update. The resulting image-evidence-precision-reconstruction loop treats prior confidence as a learned state variable of iterative reconstruction. In addition to the formulation and theoretical analysis, we report two simulation studies on image slices from the AAPM Mayo Clinic Low-Dose CT dataset: a mechanism-validation pilot using transparent surrogate estimators, and a feasibility study in which a trained Normal-Inverse-Gamma evidential network drives the full closed loop. On held-out patients, the learned prior mean reduces reconstruction error by roughly 70 percent relative to filtered back-projection, the learned epistemic uncertainty is error-predictive and supports selective trust, and the physics-guided update restores measurement consistency while the adaptive-precision reconstruction matches or exceeds a validation-tuned fixed prior and remains markedly more robust to prior-strength misspecification. Together these results demonstrate the complete ELECTRIC closed-loop pipeline, while identifying formal uncertainty calibration and joint training as the principal directions for future work.

AI.tldr: ELECTRIC是一种物理引导的贝叶斯低剂量CT重建框架，通过证据神经网络提供图像建议和误差预测性的认知不确定性代理，将其转化为自适应精度场并融入泊松加权MAP更新，形成图像-证据-精度-重建的闭环迭代。在梅奥诊所低剂量CT数据集上，该方法将重建误差较滤波反投影降低约70%，且对先验强度误设具有显著鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 低剂量CT重建面临噪声大、先验信息难以精确设定等挑战，传统固定先验方法对先验强度敏感且无法表达不确定性。作者旨在引入一种能够自适应调节先验置信度并预测重建误差的物理引导贝叶斯框架。
AI.method: 提出ELECTRIC框架：1）证据神经网络（Normal-Inverse-Gamma）生成图像建议及认知不确定性代理；2）不确定性被转换为自适应精度场；3）插入泊松加权MAP更新中，形成图像-证据-精度-重建闭环迭代；4）包含机制验证和可行性研究两项仿真实验。
AI.result: 在梅奥诊所低剂量CT数据集上：学习到的先验均值相对滤波反投影降低约70%重建误差；认知不确定性具备误差预测能力并支持选择性信任；物理引导更新恢复测量一致性；自适应精度重建匹配或超越调参固定先验，且对先验强度误设显著更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: ELECTRIC完整闭环流水线被验证有效，但正式的不确定性校准和联合训练被识别为未来工作的主要方向。

title: Cost-Effective Automated Judging of Natural-Language Mathematical Proofs
summary: Grading natural-language mathematical proofs is a recurring cost in evaluating math-reasoning systems, and frontier LLM judges are expensive. We ask whether cheap open-weight models can serve as reliable judges given a candidate proof, a ground-truth proof, and a human-grading rubric. On a 200-instance validation sample of IMO-GradingBench, three cheap judges (GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek-V4 Flash, Gemma-4 31B) agree with human pass/fail decisions at rates statistically indistinguishable from Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, at up to $100\times$ lower cost. We had expected a majority vote of the three to be the best budget option; it matched the frontier but did not improve on its strongest member. Extending to the full 1000-instance benchmark and exploring consensus rules, we found that requiring unanimous agreement (all-three-pass) reaches the highest pass-agreement and precision and, on four replicate runs, the smallest run-to-run spread. The headline finding is that cheap judges are competitive with the frontier at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost; as a deployable default we recommend all-three-pass, with the caveat that this rule was identified post-hoc and warrants independent replication.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用廉价开源权重模型作为数学证明自动评分器的可行性。在IMO-GradingBench基准上，三个廉价模型（GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B）与人类评分的一致性可与前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro）相媲美，但成本降低高达100倍。研究发现要求三者一致通过（all-three-pass）的共识规则达到最高的一致性、精度和稳定性，推荐作为默认部署方案。
AI.motivation: 对自然语言数学证明进行人工评分是评估数学推理系统的经常性成本，而前沿LLM评判模型价格昂贵。作者希望探索能否用廉价的开放权重模型替代前沿模型作为可靠评判者，以降低成本。
AI.method: 在200个实例的验证样本上，将三个廉价评判模型与人类通过/失败决策进行一致性比较，并与Claude Opus 4.7和Gemini 3.1 Pro对比。随后扩展到1000个实例的完整基准，探索多种共识规则（包括全部通过的多数投票变体），并在四次重复运行中评估稳定性。
AI.result: 三个廉价评判模型与人类评判的一致性在统计上与前沿模型无显著差异，成本最多降低100倍。多数投票虽与前沿持平但未优于最强成员。全票通过（all-three-pass）规则达到最高的通过一致性和精确度，且四次重复运行中具有最小的运行间波动。
AI.conclusion: 廉价评判模型在成本降低一至两个数量级的情况下可与前沿模型竞争。作者推荐all-three-pass共识规则作为默认部署方案，但提醒该规则是基于后验分析确定的，需要独立重复验证。

title: Revisiting Classic Thought Experiments to Measure Consciousness for Artificial Intelligence Safety
summary: This research note revisits Leibniz's mill, Turing's imitation game, and Searle's Chinese Room through the Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) framework. It formalises a toy symbolic setting in which successful behaviour is measured by task performance ($W_{causal,T}$), while the efficiency with which preserved internal structure supports that behaviour is measured by operational consciousness ($κ_T$). Within this setup, an uncompressed lookup system and a compact generative system can in principle achieve comparable behavioural success, yet diverge sharply in $κ_T$: the former relies on an expanding standing store of unreused mappings, whereas the latter reuses compact internal structure. The note therefore reframes classic disputes about understanding by separating outward performance from the organisation that sustains it, and motivates why this distinction may matter for later AI-safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"守恒-一致性编码"(CCE)框架重新审视莱布尼茨的磨坊、图灵测试和塞尔的中文房间论证，提出用任务表现(W_causal,T)衡量行为成功、用操作意识(κ_T)衡量内部结构支持行为的效率，从而将外在表现与内在组织分离，为后续AI安全分析提供理论基础。
AI.motivation: 经典心智哲学和AI领域的争论（如中文房间、图灵测试）长期围绕"理解"的本质展开，但缺乏一个形式化的框架来明确区分"行为表现"与"内在结构效率"。作者希望通过CCE框架为这些争论提供新的分析工具，并服务于AI安全研究。
AI.method: 提出CCE框架，构建一个玩具符号设定：用W_causal,T衡量任务层面的因果成功表现，用κ_T衡量操作意识（即保留的内部结构支持该行为的效率）。在此设定中比较无压缩查找系统与紧凑生成系统在行为表现和κ_T上的差异。
AI.result: 无压缩查找系统和紧凑生成系统在原则上可以达到相当的行为成功（W_causal,T），但在操作意识（κ_T）上存在显著分歧：前者依赖不断扩张的未复用映射存量，后者则复用紧凑的内部结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将"理解"的经典争论重新定义为"外在表现"与"支撑其的内在组织"的分离问题，并指出这一区分对后续AI安全分析具有重要启发意义。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Simulation-Based Inference for Operations Research with Large Language Models
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for operations research (OR) tasks remains challenging because correctness depends on a coherent modeling process, not merely a correct final answer. Standard autoregressive generation operates on a myopic policy, which sometimes fails to anticipate whether a partial formulation can be validly extended into a globally consistent optimization model. Consequently, locally plausible steps may propagate into catastrophic downstream formulation or solver code errors. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-aware, training-free inference framework for OR mathematical modeling. Without updating model parameters, our method evaluates intermediate candidate steps using short lookahead simulations to quantify downstream predictive uncertainty or probability concentration. Candidates that demonstrate a higher likelihood of yielding coherent mathematical formulations are then dynamically selected via importance resampling. Empirical evaluations across multiple OR benchmarks (including NL4OPT, MAMO, and IndustryOR) demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both standard and low-temperature baselines, establishing an efficient, training-free paradigm for reliable OR formulation generation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的不确定性感知推理框架，通过短前瞻模拟量化下游预测不确定性，并利用重要性重采样动态选择候选步骤，以提升LLM在运筹学数学建模任务中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM处理运筹学（OR）任务时，标准自回归生成采用短视策略，无法预判部分公式能否有效扩展为全局一致的优化模型，导致局部看似合理的步骤可能传播为下游灾难性的建模或求解代码错误。
AI.method: 采用无需更新模型参数的不确定性感知推理框架：通过短前瞻模拟评估中间候选步骤，量化下游预测不确定性或概率集中程度；利用重要性重采样动态选择更可能产生一致数学公式的候选步骤。
AI.result: 在多个OR基准（NL4OPT、MAMO、IndustryOR）上，该框架一致优于标准和低温采样基线，建立了高效、免训练的可靠OR公式生成范式。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的推理时策略能够有效提升LLM在运筹学数学建模中的可靠性，且无需任何参数训练，具有高效性和普适性。

title: HIERA: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Relevance Assessment for Content Discovery Systems
summary: Content discovery systems depend on relevance judgment for search quality evaluation, but human annotation faces inter-annotator disagreement and scaling costs. While Large Language Models show promise as automated assessors, current approaches rely on flat aggregation strategies: single-step prompting, voting ensembles, or uncoordinated multi-agent pipelines that aggregate independent outputs without integration. We propose HIERA, a hierarchical multi-agent relevance assessment framework with four specialized agents: a Relevance Judge, Query Analyzer, Item Analyzer, and Relation Analyzer. The Judge determines when specialist analysis is needed; the Relation Analyzer then coordinates query and item analyses with external knowledge to establish relevance relationships for final judgment. Ablation studies show that the same agents and external knowledge without hierarchical coordination degrade performance, confirming that the coordination structure itself accounts for the improvement. Evaluation across five datasets (EVS, MSRD, ESCI, WANDS, Home Depot) shows improvements over 11 baselines: 10.2\% on Home Depot, 4.8\% on ESCI, and up to 38\% on EVS ($p < 0.05$). Hierarchical coordination yields 12.7\% improvement over uncoordinated collaboration using identical agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HIERA，一个层级式多智能体相关性评估框架，包含Relevance Judge、Query Analyzer、Item Analyzer和Relation Analyzer四个专业智能体。Judge决定何时需要专家分析，Relation Analyzer协调查询和条目分析并结合外部知识建立相关性判断。在五个数据集上显著优于11个基线，层级协调相比无协调协作提升12.7%。
AI.motivation: 内容发现系统依赖人工相关性标注进行搜索质量评估，但人工标注存在标注者间分歧大和规模化成本高的问题。虽然LLM作为自动评估器展现出潜力，但现有方法采用扁平化聚合策略（单步提示、投票集成或非协调多智能体流水线），缺乏智能体间的整合与协调，限制了评估质量。
AI.method: 提出HIERA层级式多智能体框架：1）Relevance Judge作为顶层裁决者，判断是否需要更深层的专家分析；2）Query Analyzer分析查询意图；3）Item Analyzer分析条目内容；4）Relation Analyzer协调前两者的分析并结合外部知识建立查询与条目之间的相关性关系，最终做出综合判断。通过层级协调结构而非简单的输出聚合来实现智能体间的有效集成。
AI.result: 在EVS、MSRD、ESCI、WANDS和Home Depot五个数据集上超越11个基线方法：Home Depot提升10.2%，ESCI提升4.8%，EVS最高提升38%（p<0.05）。消融实验证明层级协调结构本身是性能提升的关键，使用相同智能体和外部知识但无层级协调时性能下降。层级协调相比无协调协作（使用相同智能体）提升12.7%。
AI.conclusion: 层级化协调结构是多智能体相关性评估的关键成功因素，而非仅仅依赖智能体数量和外部知识。HIERA证明了通过明确的角色分工和协调机制，可以有效利用LLM进行高质量、可扩展的自动相关性判断，为搜索质量评估提供了一条实用的自动化路径。

title: Noise-Robust Conditional Flow Matching: Generating Clean Samples from Noisy Datasets
summary: Generative models learn the statistical properties of their training data, so high-quality generation depends on clean and representative datasets. In scientific imaging, acquisition often yields noisy measurements, while collecting clean references can be costly, impractical or even unattainable. Training directly on these measurements results in a model that reproduces the corrupted data. This can be circumvented by learning the clean population distribution directly from the noisy data. Conditional flow matching (CFM) combines a simple regression objective with stable training, efficient sampling, and strong image-generation performance, making it a natural framework for this setting. We introduce Noise-Robust Conditional Flow Matching (NR-CFM), an unconditional generator that learns from one corrupted observation per image. NR-CFM provides a closed-form clean endpoint correction for additive white Gaussian noise and learns a data-driven correction for general Gaussian corruptions with more complex covariance structure. Across the evaluated corruption settings, NR-CFM outperforms NR-GAN in most cases and remains competitive with Ambient Diffusion in the high-noise regime. We further evaluate NR-CFM on scientific data at signal-to-noise ratios as low as $0.001$, where it generates plausible particle images from severely corrupted measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出噪声鲁棒条件流匹配（NR-CFM），一种无监督生成模型，能够仅从每张图像的一个带噪观测中学习干净数据的分布。它针对加性高斯白噪声提供闭式干净端点校正，对更复杂的协方差结构则学习数据驱动的校正。在科学成像数据（信噪比低至0.001）上表现优于NR-GAN，且在高噪声下与Ambient Diffusion竞争。
AI.motivation: 科学成像中获取的测量数据通常含有噪声，而收集干净参考图像成本高昂、不切实际甚至不可行。直接在噪声测量上训练生成模型会复制数据中的损坏，因此需要一种能够直接从带噪数据中学习干净群体分布的方法。
AI.method: 将条件流匹配（CFM）框架扩展到噪声鲁棒设置，提出NR-CFM。对于加性高斯白噪声，推导出闭式形式的干净端点校正；对于具有更复杂协方差结构的通用高斯损坏，则学习数据驱动的校正方法。
AI.result: 在评估的所有损坏设置中，NR-CFM在大多数情况下优于NR-GAN，并在高噪声区域与Ambient Diffusion保持竞争力。在信噪比低至0.001的科学数据上，能从严重损坏的测量中生成合理的粒子图像。
AI.conclusion: NR-CFM提供了一种从单个带噪观测学习干净分布的可行性方案，结合了CFM的简单回归目标、稳定训练和高效采样优势，在极低信噪比的科学成像场景中展现出良好的生成能力。

title: RubricReviewer: From Direct Critique to Objective and Comprehensive Rubric-Driven Peer Review
summary: Peer review at major venues is under unprecedented submission pressure, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) as review assistants. Existing LLM-based reviewers, however, face two structural limitations. First, they map manuscripts directly to reviews, leaving the underlying rubric implicit and entangling its derivation with the judgement. Second, the prevailing paradigms each capture only half of a good review: training-free agents gather broad evidence but produce undirected critiques, while training-based reviewers inherit human discriminative judgement together with its noise and uneven coverage. We introduce RubricReviewer, a fully rubric-driven framework that addresses both limitations. It makes rubric generation an explicit intermediate step, so that both review generation and the final assessment are conditioned on paper-adaptive rubrics. It further combines a training-free agent (Scout) that gathers external evidence with a human-aligned trained model (Aligner) that consumes this evidence, fusing the strengths of both supervision sources. Experiments on real-world submissions show that RubricReviewer produces reviews that are markedly more comprehensive and more discriminative than prior systems, and exhibits the strongest robustness against adversarial prompt-injection attacks. Ablation studies further confirm the necessity of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RubricReviewer，一个完全基于rubric驱动的LLM审稿框架，通过将rubric生成作为显式中间步骤，并将无训练agent（Scout）与训练模型（Aligner）结合，解决现有LLM审稿系统在隐式rubric和证据收集不完整方面的问题，实验证明其评审更全面、更具区分度，且对对抗性提示注入攻击鲁棒性最强。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM审稿系统存在两个结构性局限：(1) 将稿件直接映射到评审，隐含的rubric未被显式化，rubric推导与判断纠缠在一起；(2) 现有范式各只有一半优点——无训练agent能广泛收集证据但缺乏针对性评判，训练型审稿员继承了人类判别性判断但带有噪声和覆盖不均的问题。
AI.method: RubricReviewer将rubric生成作为显式中间步骤，使评审生成和最终评估都基于论文自适应的rubric。框架结合两个组件：Scout（无训练的agent，收集外部证据）和Aligner（与人类对齐的训练模型，消费这些证据），融合两种监督来源的优势。
AI.result: 在真实世界投稿上的实验表明，RubricReviewer生成的评审比先前系统明显更全面、更具区分度，并且对对抗性提示注入攻击表现出最强的鲁棒性。消融实验进一步确认了每个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RubricReviewer通过显式化rubric和融合无训练/训练两种范式，成功解决了LLM审稿的结构性局限，验证了该框架的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) plays an important role in modern engineering, but using open-source solvers such as OpenFOAM requires considerable knowledge and skills, as well as time-consuming configuration file setup. To reduce this burden, we propose AutoFOAM - a self-evolving large language model (LLM) agent that creates, evaluates, runs, and evolves its own OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural-language instructions. Our model is pre-trained on the Qwen-coder 2.5-14B, which is then fine-tuned on 252 text prompts targeting 7 OpenFOAM solvers, 13 parametrized mesh templates, and a y plus-aware numerical policy. The crucial element of the algorithm is a sophisticated evolution loop composed of 7 stages. To prevent model degeneration under repeated self-training, the agent employs three complementary anti-collapse streams: RAG-augmented retry context, surgical dictionary-level patching, and prompt-diversity paraphrasing. By bridging generative artificial intelligence with rigorous fluid simulations, AutoFOAM accelerates rapid prototyping and democratizes advanced CFD workflows.

AI.tldr: AutoFOAM是一个自进化的大语言模型智能体，能够仅根据自然语言指令自动创建、评估、运行和进化OpenFOAM仿真，降低CFD使用门槛，加速原型设计并实现高级CFD工作流的民主化。
AI.motivation: OpenFOAM等开源CFD求解器需要大量的专业知识和手工配置文件设置，耗时而繁琐，阻碍了CFD在工程中的广泛应用。作者希望通过大语言模型智能体来自动化这一过程，让用户仅用自然语言即可完成CFD仿真。
AI.method: 基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B进行微调，训练数据包含252个文本提示，覆盖7个OpenFOAM求解器、13个参数化网格模板和y plus感知数值策略。核心是7阶段的自进化循环，并采用三种防退化机制：RAG增强重试上下文、词典级外科修补和提示多样性改写。
AI.result: 模型能够自主生成和运行OpenFOAM仿真，通过自进化循环持续改进，同时防退化机制有效避免模型在重复自训练中性能下降。
AI.conclusion: AutoFOAM通过将生成式AI与流体仿真相结合，显著加速了快速原型设计，并使高级CFD工作流对更广泛的用户群体开放，实现了CFD的民主化。

title: Learning Compositional Meta-Routing for Agentic Workflows: An Executable Benchmark
summary: Agentic systems must decide not only what answer to produce, but which reasoning and execution operations should precede it. A controller may answer directly, decompose a request, retrieve evidence, execute code, delegate to a specialist, or verify an intermediate result. Existing routing work largely selects model endpoints, retrieval depth, or tools in isolation. We introduce an executable benchmark and a budget-aware meta-router that composes heterogeneous operations from raw task text. The benchmark contains 216 training, 72 development, 108 held-out test, and 108 locked lexical-shift challenge tasks across data analysis, frozen-corpus research, and document processing. Outcomes are machine checked after operations execute. Independent regularized logistic heads predict operation probabilities from word and character features, are temperature-scaled on development data, and are greedily composed under route-cost and action-count budgets. On the held-out test, the learned policy achieves 100% success versus 93.5% for strong static and fixed workflows, with 43% lower cost than the static policy; a matched learned one-shot router reaches 56.5%. On the untouched challenge split, learned success falls to 75.9% and trails static routing at 93.5%, while remaining 49% cheaper and exceeding one-shot routing by 34.3 points. The gap identifies lexical generalization, rather than route execution, as the principal limitation. These results establish a reproducible testbed and a bounded proof of concept, not evidence of live-LLM performance.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个可执行的基准测试和一个预算感知的元路由器，用于在智能体系统中组合异构操作（如直接回答、分解请求、检索证据、执行代码、委托专家、验证中间结果）。基于216个训练、72个开发、108个测试和108个词汇转移挑战任务的实验表明，学习到的策略在测试集上达到100%成功率（静态策略为93.5%）且成本降低43%，但在词汇挑战分割上表现下降至75.9%，落后于静态路由的93.5%，揭示了词汇泛化是主要限制而非路由执行。
AI.motivation: 现有的路由工作大多孤立地选择模型端点、检索深度或工具，而智能体系统需要从原始任务文本中组合异构操作序列（推理和执行操作）。需要一个可复现的基准来评估这种组合路由能力。
AI.method: 提出了一个可执行基准测试和一个预算感知的元路由器。路由器使用独立的规则化逻辑回归头部从词和字符特征预测操作概率，在开发数据上进行温度缩放，并在路线成本和行动次数预算下进行贪心组合。基准涵盖数据分析、冻结语料库研究和文档处理三类任务，结果通过机器检查验证。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，学习策略达到100%成功率（对比静态和固定工作流的93.5%），成本比静态策略低43%；匹配的学习一次性路由器仅达56.5%。在未触及的挑战分割上，学习成功率降至75.9%，落后于静态路由的93.5%，但仍便宜49%，且超过一次性路由34.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 词汇泛化而非路由执行是当前方法的主要限制。该结果确立了可复现的测试平台和有界的概念验证，但不代表实时LLM性能的证据。

title: Stress-Relief Annealing: Polynomial-Time Simulation-Free Layout Optimization for Automated Warehouses
summary:
We study the problem of optimizing physical layouts for automated warehouses, where hundreds to thousands of robots are coordinated to transport packages. Previous works have shown that optimizing the warehouse layout (e.g., the physical location of the storage shelves) significantly improves throughput. However, state-of-the-art layout optimization approaches are based on evolutionary optimization methods, which treat the entire warehouse as a black box and rely on random mutation to search for high-quality layouts. While the optimization outcomes are promising, these methods require a massive number of simulations to evaluate candidate solutions, making them sample-inefficient. In this paper, we present Stress-Relief Annealing (SRA), a polynomial-time simulation-free layout optimization algorithm. SRA turns the task demand into a per-vertex \emph{stress field} that predicts where traffic will concentrate in the warehouse; the field's peak provably caps the throughput.
  Our experimental results show that (1) SRA improves both the throughput and the scalability of a human-designed warehouse, roughly doubling the number of robots it can sustain, (2) it matches or exceeds the throughput of the evolutionary baselines while taking only $19$ minutes on one CPU core, against their $25{,}000$ simulations and $25$ hours on a $64$-core machine, and (3) the gain generalizes across different Multi-Agent Path Finding algorithms, non-uniform task demands, and a warehouse with doubled dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Stress-Relief Annealing (SRA)，一种多项式时间、无需仿真的仓库布局优化算法。SRA将任务需求转化为每个顶点的"应力场"来预测交通拥堵位置，并通过消除应力峰值来优化布局，大幅提升吞吐量和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库布局优化方法（如进化算法）虽然效果不错，但将整个仓库视为黑盒，依赖随机变异搜索高质量布局，需要大量仿真评估候选方案，样本效率极低。本文旨在提出一种更高效、无需仿真的布局优化方法。
AI.method: SRA将任务需求转化为一个逐顶点的"应力场"，该场能够预测仓库中交通集中的位置，且应力场的峰值理论上限定了吞吐量。通过退火式地消除应力峰值，SRA在多项式时间内完成布局优化，无需进行任何仿真。
AI.result: (1) SRA同时提升了人类设计仓库的吞吐量和可扩展性，使可支持的机器人数量约翻倍；(2) 吞吐量达到或超过进化基线，但只需单CPU核19分钟，而基线需要25,000次仿真和64核机器25小时；(3) 增益可泛化到不同的多智能体路径规划算法、非均匀任务需求以及尺寸翻倍的仓库。
AI.conclusion: SRA是一种高效且可扩展的仓库布局优化方法，在吞吐量上不逊于甚至超越进化算法，同时将计算成本从数万次仿真降低到单核CPU上的分钟级，具有显著的实际应用价值。

title: PhysAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Remote Heart Rate Estimation
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart-rate estimation from facial videos, but its weak physiological signal is easily corrupted by motion, illumination changes, occlusion, skin-appearance variation, and device noise. Existing rPPG methods typically rely on a single model to directly predict heart rate or recover pulse waveforms, while different strong estimators may produce conflicting yet individually plausible candidates for the same video. To resolve these conflicts, we propose PhysAgent, an inference-time multi-agent candidate-verification framework. Unlike direct prediction approaches, PhysAgent neither trains a new base rPPG model nor asks Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to output heart rate directly. In contrast, it treats outputs from multiple base estimators as physiological hypotheses to be verified and uses a lightweight 4B MLLM, Qwen3-VL-4B, to drive multi-agent reasoning over video conditions, signal reliability, and candidate disagreement. A deterministic physiological verifier checks the fusion proposal, and a reproducible numerical fusion process produces the final heart rate. Experimental results on multiple public rPPG benchmarks show that PhysAgent improves fusion stability and reliability across different datasets and source-domain settings, while avoiding the irreproducibility and physiological inconsistency of direct MLLM prediction or unconstrained ensemble fusion. The code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: PhysAgent是一个推理时多智能体候选验证框架，用于遥感光电容积描记法（rPPG）心率估计。它不训练新的基础模型，而是将多个基础估计器的输出视为生理假设，通过轻量级4B多模态大语言模型（Qwen3-VL-4B）驱动多智能体推理，结合确定性生理验证器和可复现的数值融合过程，最终产生可靠的心率估计结果，在多个公开基准上提升了融合稳定性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有rPPG方法通常依赖单一模型直接预测心率或恢复脉搏波形，但不同强估计器对同一视频可能产生相互冲突但各自合理的候选结果。直接使用MLLM预测心率存在不可复现性和生理不一致性问题，因此需要一个能解决候选冲突、保证结果可靠且可复现的验证框架。
AI.method: PhysAgent采用推理时的多智能体候选验证框架：(1)将多个基础估计器的输出视为待验证的生理假设；(2)使用轻量级4B多模态大语言模型Qwen3-VL-4B驱动多智能体推理，分析视频条件、信号可靠性和候选分歧；(3)通过确定性生理验证器检查融合提案；(4)使用可复现的数值融合过程产生最终心率。
AI.result: 在多个公开rPPG基准上的实验表明，PhysAgent在不同数据集和源域设置下提升了融合稳定性和可靠性，避免了直接MLLM预测或非约束集成融合带来的不可复现性和生理不一致问题。
AI.conclusion: PhysAgent通过多智能体候选验证框架有效解决了rPPG中心率估计的候选冲突问题，在不训练新基础模型的前提下提升了估计的稳定性和可靠性，代码即将开源。

title: MemoryForge: Synthesize Lifelong Memory for Human-Like LLM Agents
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with human-like personas is crucial for agentic applications, such as role-play and user simulation. Traditional prompt-based methods rely on descriptive conditioning by injecting static textual profiles, which often makes agents show generic behaviors due to a lack of realistic life memory. To fill this gap, we introduce memory-based conditioning, a paradigm inspired by the cognitive psychology, which replaces abstract profiles with an autobiographical memory base, enabling frozen LLMs to dynamically retrieve situation-relevant memory to guide their behaviors. We formalize its enabling task as customized lifelong memory synthesis and propose MemoryForge, a novel framework to synthesize such lifelong memory from brief target personas. MemoryForge has three key components: a context generator for socio-historical grounding, a life organizer for developmental coherence toward the target identity, and a multi-resolution simulator that balances broad temporal summaries with high-fidelity episodic experiences. Experiments on PersonaGym for role-play and SimulatorArena for user-simulation, show that the synthesized memory base by MemoryForge enables frozen LLMs to exhibit more human-like behaviors than strong descriptive conditioning baselines across multiple metrics and LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemoryForge框架，通过基于记忆的条件化（memory-based conditioning）代替传统的描述性条件化，为冻结的大语言模型合成自传体终身记忆，使其能够动态检索情境相关记忆来引导行为，在角色扮演和用户模拟任务中展现出更类人的行为。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于提示的方法通过注入静态文本描述来赋予LLM人格，但缺乏真实的生活记忆，导致智能体表现出的行为过于通用化，不够拟人。作者借鉴认知心理学，提出以自传体记忆库替代抽象人格描述的新范式。
AI.method: MemoryForge框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 上下文生成器，用于社会历史背景锚定；(2) 生活组织器，确保发展连贯性以趋近目标身份；(3) 多分辨率模拟器，平衡宽泛的时间摘要与高保真的情景体验。这些组件协同工作，从简短的目标人格描述中合成定制化的终身记忆。
AI.result: 在PersonaGym（角色扮演）和SimulatorArena（用户模拟）基准上的实验表明，MemoryForge合成的记忆库使冻结的LLM比强描述性条件化基线在多个指标和多个LLM主干上表现出更类人的行为。
AI.conclusion: 基于记忆的条件化范式比传统的描述性条件化更能让LLM展现出类人行为，为构建更真实的智能体应用（如角色扮演和用户模拟）提供了新的思路。

title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), a part of artificial intelligence (AI), are increasingly being adopted by Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to enhance question-answering capabilities and support business decision-making processes. However, hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs can serve as a source of misinformation, reducing user confidence in their reliability and trustworthiness within SMEs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising approach to address this challenge by incorporating external knowledge sources into the modeling process. In this paper, we present VectorRAG and GraphRAG modeling approaches to mitigate hallucinations and misinformation risks and evaluate their effectiveness in SME environments. Our experimental evaluation is conducted on multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen, to assess performance in terms of useful response generation, risk of hallucination, contextual relevance, as well as human-interpretation. The results demonstrate that RAG-enhanced LLMs can significantly improve response quality by reducing hallucinations and misinformation, thereby supporting more reliable, trustworthy, and context-aware decision-making in SME environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种检索增强生成（RAG）方法，用于减轻大型语言模型（LLM）在中小企业（SME）环境中产生的幻觉和错误信息问题，并在LLaMA、Mistral和Qwen等多个LLM上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM在中小企业中被广泛用于问答和决策支持，但其输出中的幻觉现象会传播错误信息，降低用户对模型可靠性和可信度的信心，因此需要有效的方法来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 提出VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种RAG建模方法，通过将外部知识源融入建模过程来减轻幻觉。在多个先进LLM（LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）上进行实验评估，从有用响应生成、幻觉风险、上下文相关性和人类可解释性等多个维度衡量性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RAG增强的LLM能够显著提高响应质量，有效减少幻觉和错误信息，从而支持中小企业在决策过程中获得更可靠、可信且具有上下文感知能力的信息支持。
AI.conclusion: RAG方法（尤其是VectorRAG和GraphRAG）是缓解LLM幻觉问题的有效手段，能够提升中小企业在实际业务决策中的信任度和可靠性。

title: MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing
summary: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a shared execution model. The initial benchmark contains 180 synthetic task profiles spanning data analysis, research, and document processing, eight routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds. Across 43,200 traces, a task-aware compositional policy achieves 79.4% success compared with 76.7% for a strong workload-specific static policy, 67.4% for one-shot task routing, and 52.9% for direct answering. Relative to the static policy, this is a 2.7 percentage-point improvement with paired 95% CI of plus or minus 2.0 points, at 4.7% higher mean cost and 6.4% higher latency. Ablations show the largest losses when route composition is restricted to one operation and when verification is removed. These results are generated by a seeded offline execution model rather than a live deployment; accordingly, the primary contribution is a reproducible evaluation method and an analysis of routing-policy tradeoffs, not evidence of production effectiveness. We release task generation, policies, traces, tests, and analysis artifacts to support live-system validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MetaRoute-Bench，一个开源、可检查的框架，用于在共享执行模型下比较智能体的元决策策略（直接回答、分解任务、调用工具、执行代码、委派、验证、恢复等）。基准包含180个合成任务、8种路由策略和30对随机种子，共43,200条执行轨迹。任务感知组合策略达到79.4%成功率，优于静态策略（76.7%）、一次性路由（67.4%）和直接回答（52.9%），但代价是更高的成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统需要在每个步骤做出元决策，这些决策影响任务成功率、成本和延迟，但现有评估通常只通过整体任务准确率衡量，把元决策嵌入编排框架中难以检查。需要一个可复现、可检查的框架来系统比较元决策策略。
AI.method: 构建MetaRoute-Bench框架，包含：180个合成任务（覆盖数据分析、研究和文档处理）、8种路由策略（包括任务感知组合策略、静态策略、一次性任务路由和直接回答）、30对配对随机种子，以及49,200条可检查的执行轨迹。通过离线执行模型进行配对比较，辅以消融实验。
AI.result: 任务感知组合策略达到79.4%成功率，比最佳静态策略高2.7个百分点（95% CI为±2.0），但代价是4.7%更高的成本和6.4%更高的延迟。消融实验显示，限制组合为单一操作和移除验证环节时性能损失最大。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是可复现的评估方法和路由策略权衡分析，而非生产环境有效性的证据。所有工件均开源以支持真实系统验证。

title: When Collaboration Becomes a Trigger: Collective Evidence-Threshold Backdoors in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) extend LLM capabilities through iterative communication and shared contexts. However, this collaboration introduces a vulnerability: backdoor behavior can be activated when peer evidence reaches a hidden threshold, rather than being determined by any single message. We introduce a collective evidence-threshold backdoor paradigm for MAS and Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection (BCBI), which constructs counterfactual boundary pairs to separate benign behavior before the threshold from the adversarial objective after it, and learns latent progression aligned with evidence. To mitigate this threat, we propose LAtent Transition Test-time Evaluation (LATTE), a clean-only latent-transition defense that learns benign communication dynamics and quarantines anomalous agent updates before their responses propagate. Across several benchmarks, BCBI yields selective activation with little premature activation; without knowing the attack target or trigger, LATTE limits propagation with minimal disruption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对LLM多智能体系统的一种新型后门攻击范式——集体证据阈值后门（BCBI），以及相应的防御方法LATTE。攻击通过在隐空间中累积证据越过隐藏阈值时触发恶意行为，防御则通过学习良性通信动力学并在响应传播前隔离异常智能体更新来缓解威胁。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统通过迭代通信和共享上下文扩展了LLM能力，但这种协作引入了一种新漏洞：后门行为可在对等证据达到隐藏阈值时被激活，而非由任何单一消息决定。现有方法未针对这种集体证据驱动的后门攻击范式提供防护。
AI.method: 提出了两种方法：（1）BCBI（边界条件后门注入）——构建反事实边界对，将阈值前良性行为与阈值后对抗目标分离，并学习与证据对齐的隐进展；（2）LATTE（潜在转移测试时评估）——一种仅需干净数据的潜在转移防御，学习良性通信动力学，在响应传播前隔离异常智能体更新。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，BCBI实现了选择性激活且几乎没有过早激活；在不了解攻击目标和触发器的条件下，LATTE能以最小干扰限制恶意行为传播。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明多智能体系统中的集体证据阈值后门是一种现实且隐蔽的威胁，同时提出了有效的干净数据防御方法，为多智能体系统的安全性研究提供了新方向。

title: SafeBuild-Bench: A Temporal-Robust Construction Safety Benchmark with Graph-Enhanced Data Mining
summary: Construction-safety models must handle concrete deployment risks, such as a worker standing near a scaffold edge without guardrails, rather than only recognize common objects in curated images. Yet real inspection archives are redundant, long-tailed, and collected across changing sites and months. We introduce SafeBuild-Bench, a metadata-driven benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on construction safety under realistic temporal and site variation. It is mined from 100K+ industrial image-text records and contains 3,314 task instances from over 3,000 expert-verified images, covering multiple-choice hazard identification and free-form hazard description. To make expert verification scalable, we develop GEMS, a graph-enhanced multimodal selection pipeline that combines a proxy-model confusion signal with graph-based diversity to identify informative candidates from redundant streams. On public instruction-tuning data, GEMS-selected subsets preserve robustness-oriented performance under small data budgets. On SafeBuild-Bench, current MLLMs remain far from reliable construction-safety understanding, with the best overall score near 60. We release the benchmark, evaluation scripts, and GEMS codebase at https://github.com/safebuild/gems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeBuild-Bench，一个基于元数据驱动的建筑安全多模态大语言模型评测基准，从10万+工业图像文本记录中挖掘出3,314个任务实例（覆盖3,000+专家验证图像），包含多选危害识别和自由文本危害描述任务。同时提出GEMS图增强多模态选择流程，利用代理模型混淆信号与图多样性从冗余数据流中筛选信息丰富的候选样本，实现可扩展的专家验证。实验表明当前多模态大模型在建筑安全理解上仍远不可靠（最佳得分约60%）。
AI.motivation: 建筑安全模型必须处理具体部署风险（如工人站在无护栏的脚手架边缘），而非仅识别策展图像中的常见物体。然而真实检查档案存在冗余、长尾分布，且随站点和时间变化，现有基准无法反映这一现实复杂性。
AI.method: 首先构建SafeBuild-Bench，从10万+工业图像文本记录中挖掘评测数据，包含3,314个任务实例；其次开发GEMS（图增强多模态选择流程），结合代理模型混淆信号与图多样性筛选信息量最大的候选样本，使专家验证可扩展。
AI.result: GEMS选出的子集在公开指令微调数据上以小数据预算保持鲁棒性性能；在SafeBuild-Bench上，当前多模态大模型最佳总体得分仅接近60%，表明其建筑安全理解能力仍远不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了现有多模态大模型在真实建筑安全场景中的显著不足，并提供了可复用的基准（SafeBuild-Bench）与高效数据筛选工具（GEMS），为建筑安全智能检测的未来发展奠定基础。代码已开源。

title: AgentMemBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Management Strategies in Conversational AI Agents
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures submitted on Neural Computing and Applications
summary: Long-term memory remains a critical bottleneck for conversational AI agents, whose finite context windows cannot support coherent recall across thousands of turns. We present AgentMemBench, a unified, reproducible benchmark evaluating five memory management strategies under identical conditions: in-context windowing (ICW), external key-value store (EKV), graph-based episodic memory (GEM), compression-based summarisation (CBS), and web-augmented memory (WAM). All are assessed across three public datasets covering long-term multi-session dialogue (LoCoMo), task-oriented document grounding (MultiDoc2Dial), and persona-grounded multi-session chat (MSC), using Recall@k, MRR, nDCG@k, Answer F1, an LLM-judge Faithfulness score, Memory Footprint, and Latency over 491 annotated question turns. Generation and judging both use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (4-bit), with greedy decoding for determinism. Our results show that (1) EKV dominates on every quality axis (macro Recall@5 0.792, MRR 0.677, F1 0.156, Faithfulness 0.354); (2) long-range recall is decisive: on LoCoMo, where the gold turn lies many sessions back, ICW, WAM, GEM, and CBS retrieve almost nothing (Recall@5 <= 0.005) while EKV alone reaches 0.573, showing that recency windows, summaries, and entity graphs collapse at long horizons and only dense retrieval scales; (3) CBS is the runner-up on retrieval (0.556); (4) WAM equals ICW on in-corpus recall by construction, since external results carry no in-corpus provenance; and (5) EKV's recall advantage carries a footprint cost (~5,100 vs ~300 tokens for ICW/WAM), an explicit accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We additionally evaluate two published memory systems (MemGPT/Letta, HippoRAG) against the same harness, and release all code, environment, and result artefacts for full reproducibility.

AI.tldr: AgentMemBench是一个统一的、可复现的基准测试框架，在相同条件下评估五种记忆管理策略（上下文窗口、外部键值存储、图基情景记忆、压缩摘要和网络增强记忆），在三个公共数据集上使用491个标注问题回合进行测评。结果显示外部键值存储（EKV）在所有质量指标上占优，尤其在长距离回忆任务中表现突出（Recall@5达0.573，远超其他方法），但代价是更高的内存占用。
AI.motivation: 对话AI的长期记忆是关键瓶颈，有限上下文窗口无法支持跨数千轮对话的连贯回忆。缺乏统一的、可复现的基准来公平比较不同记忆管理策略，这是该论文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 构建了统一的基准测试框架，在完全相同条件下测试五种记忆策略：上下文窗口化（ICW）、外部键值存储（EKV）、图基情景记忆（GEM）、压缩摘要（CBS）和网络增强记忆（WAM）。使用三个公共数据集（LoCoMo、MultiDoc2Dial、MSC），采用Recall@k、MRR、nDCG@k、Answer F1、Faithfulness、Memory Footprint和Latency等多维指标，基于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（4-bit）进行生成和评判。
AI.result: （1）EKV在所有质量指标上占优，宏平均Recall@5达0.792，MRR为0.677；（2）在长距离回忆的LoCoMo数据集上，EKV的Recall@5达0.573，而其他四种方法几乎为零（≤0.005）；（3）CBS在检索方面排名第二（0.556）；（4）WAM与ICW在语料内回忆上等价；（5）EKV的回忆优势带来约5100 vs 300 token的内存占用代价。
AI.conclusion: 密集检索（EKV）是唯一能在长时域扩展的记忆策略，但存在明确的精度-效率权衡。论文同时评估了MemGPT/Letta和HippoRAG两个已发布的记忆系统，并发布了全部代码、环境和结果工件以确保完全可复现性。

title: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
summary: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of nine open-source LLMs (1B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060Ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2Hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate mean/peak power, total energy per prompt (J/prompt), energy per output token (J/token), and throughput (tok/s). Our findings suggest that factors beyond raw parameter count, including model architecture and quantization strategy, drive energy efficiency. Specifically, gemma3:1b and llama3.2:1b achieve the lowest energy cost (0.56 J/token and 0.65 J/token) and the highest throughput (>170 tok/s). In contrast, the 7B-Mistral model consumes up to 4.4x more energy per token than the most efficient model. Notably, qwen3.5:2b exhibits anomalously high per-prompt energy due to extended internal reasoning, highlighting the need to distinguish between token generation modes in efficiency metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可复现的硬件级能耗基准测试，对9个开源LLM（1B到7B参数）在单张消费级GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上使用Ollama推理引擎进行能耗评估，发现模型架构和量化策略比参数量更能影响能源效率，gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b能耗最低（0.56和0.65 J/token），而7B-Mistral能耗是最优模型的4.4倍。
AI.motivation: 由于隐私担忧和本地推理需求，LLM在消费级硬件上的本地部署日益流行，但现有基准测试仅关注准确性，忽略了消费硬件上的能耗成本，该领域缺乏系统的、可复现的能耗基准研究。
AI.method: 在单张RTX 4060Ti 16GB GPU上，使用Ollama推理引擎运行9个开源LLM（1B至7B参数），通过nvidia-smi以2Hz采样频率记录GPU功耗，评估平均/峰值功耗、每提示能耗（J/prompt）、每输出token能耗（J/token）和吞吐量（tok/s）。
AI.result: gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b实现最低能耗（0.56和0.65 J/token）和最高吞吐量（>170 tok/s）；7B-Mistral模型每token能耗比最优模型高4.4倍；qwen3.5:2b因扩展内部推理导致异常的每提示高能耗，凸显了在效率指标中区分token生成模式的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 能源效率的决定因素是模型架构和量化策略，而非单纯的参数量；能耗指标需要考虑推理模式差异（如内部推理token与输出token），这对消费级硬件上的模型选型和经济性评估具有重要意义。

title: Progressive$^2$: A Teacher-Student Progressive Co-Evolving Knowledge Distillation Method for Substantial Model Compression
comment: Manuscript under review at IEEE Transactions on Services Computing
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely utilized technique for transferring knowledge from a large model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student). Owing to its flexibility and broad applicability, KD has been extensively applied in the compression of server-side models to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of client users. Despite significant advancements, the performance of distillation is substantially compromised when a large disparity exists between the capabilities of the server and the requirements of the client. To alleviate this problem, we propose a novel distillation approach, named Progressive$^2$, which operates through the combination of a progressively stronger teacher and a progressively smaller student. On the side of the teacher, rather than involving all layers simultaneously, we progressively select additional layers for distillation following a raw-to-rich semantic progression, establishing a systematic learning curriculum. Furthermore, we design a teacher-side multi-feature fusion adapter for the teacher to improve training stability, which is theoretically supported by the framework of Lipschitz continuity. On the side of the student, rather than directly training a tiny model, we gradually reduce the size of the network to facilitate an iterative co-evolution with the teacher. Progressive$^2$ serves as a flexible framework; the progressive strategy of the teacher can be deployed independently to achieve an optimal balance between accuracy and training efficiency, while the joint integration of the teacher and the student yields further improvements in overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Progressive²的新型知识蒸馏方法，通过渐进式增强的教师模型与渐进式缩小的学生模型协同进化，解决了教师与学生能力差距过大时蒸馏性能严重下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏（KD）是广泛使用的模型压缩技术，但在服务器端模型与客户端需求之间能力差距过大时，蒸馏性能会显著受损，这是现有KD方法面临的关键挑战。
AI.method: Progressive²包含两个核心设计：(1) 教师侧：按照由粗略到精细（raw-to-rich）的语义进程，渐进式地选择更多层参与蒸馏，形成系统化学习课程，并设计多特征融合适配器以提高训练稳定性（有Lipschitz连续性理论支撑）；(2) 学生侧：逐步减小网络规模，与教师进行迭代式协同进化。
AI.result: Progressive²是一个灵活框架：教师侧的渐进策略可独立部署，在精度与训练效率之间取得最优平衡；教师和学生联合集成的完整方案能进一步提升整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过教师与学生两侧的双向渐进策略，有效缓解了大能力差距下的蒸馏性能退化问题，为大规模模型压缩提供了系统化的学习课程解决方案。

title: Asking Questions the Right Way: A Multi-Agent Conversational System for Prompt Formulation in Complex Task Resolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are integral to complex intellectual tasks, yet output quality remains constrained by user-provided prompts. Iterative multi-turn prompting often leads to context degradation and diminishing cognitive returns. We present PAWNI (Prompt Architecture Wizard using Neural Intelligence), an agentic conversational interface of eight agents that transforms unstructured queries into structured prompts through guided question-and-answer dialogue informed by a self-evolving knowledge base. Rather than optimizing the models response, PAWNI optimizes the question itself by front-loading intent clarification. We also propose a three-tier framework of 18 prompt elements across Essential, Enhancement, and Elevation categories.To evaluate system behavior and validate a measurement protocol, we conducted an exploratory within-subjects study (N=4) across four complex tasks, integrating 32-channel EEG, NASA-TLX workload, and behavioral metrics. Participants produced more structurally complete prompts with PAWNI (42% to 91% of assessed elements), rated LLM outputs higher across all quality dimensions, and reported lower workload (39.6 vs. 21.7 NASA-TLX). Every participant reached satisfactory output in a single turn, compared to 1-12 turns unaided. While effect sizes are unstable due to sample size, direction consistency supports the hypothesis that optimizing prompt formulation front-end is a critical lever for human-AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAWNI（Prompt Architecture Wizard using Neural Intelligence），一个由八个智能体组成的对话式系统，通过引导式问答将非结构化查询转化为结构化提示词，并提出了包含18个提示元素的三个层级框架（Essential, Enhancement, Elevation）。初步探索性研究（N=4）表明，PAWNI能显著提升提示词的完整性（从42%提高到91%）、LLM输出质量评分，同时降低认知负荷（NASA-TLX从39.6降至21.7），且所有参与者单轮即达到满意输出。
AI.motivation: LLM的输出质量受限于用户提供的提示词，而迭代式多轮对话提示常导致上下文退化与认知收益递减。现有研究多聚焦于优化模型响应，而非优化问题本身，缺乏系统化的提示词构造方法和前端意图澄清机制。
AI.method: 提出PAWNI，一个由八个智能体组成的代理式对话界面，通过引导式问答对话并结合自进化知识库，将非结构化查询转化为结构化提示词。同时提出三层级18个提示元素的框架，并设计了一个整合32通道EEG、NASA-TLX工作负荷和行为指标的探索性组内实验（N=4）来验证系统行为和测量协议。
AI.result: 使用PAWNI时参与者产生的提示词结构更完整（从实现42%到91%的评估元素），在所有质量维度上对LLM输出的评分更高，且报告的工作负荷更低（NASA-TLX从39.6降至21.7）。所有参与者单轮即达到满意的输出，而未经辅助时需1-12轮。尽管受样本量限制效应量不稳定，但方向一致性支持了假设。
AI.conclusion: 在提示词构造的前端进行优化（而非在后端优化模型响应）是人机协作中的关键杠杆。PAWNI通过前端意图澄清和结构化提示词生成，有效改善LLM输出质量并降低认知负荷，为提示工程提供了新的系统化方法论与测量框架。

title: Empirical investigation of 3D CT Foundation Models and Unsupervised Adaptation for Head and Neck Cancer Recurrence Prediction
summary: The rapid emergence of 3D CT foundation models has opened new avenues for predictive modeling from CT imaging, offering a compelling alternative to traditional radiomics which is known to suffer from reproducibility issues and sensitivity to acquisition protocol variations. Yet, as these models grow in availability, a critical need arises to evaluate how well their learned representations generalize across diverse clinical settings and whether adaptation to specific downstream tasks is necessary to unlock their full potential. To address these questions, we benchmarked several 3D CT foundation models for predicting recurrence-free survival in head and neck cancer across two public datasets totaling 3,644 patients, evaluating various adaptation strategies and modality fusion mechanisms. Our findings reveal persistent difficulty in identifying features that generalize consistently across different imaging distributions, as evidenced by significant performance drops on external validation cohorts. Ultimately, the integration of imaging features with clinical data remains the most accurate approach for prognostic prediction, though achieving universal generalization across varied clinical contexts continues to represent a substantial challenge for the current generation of models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多种3D CT基础模型在头颈癌无复发生存预测中的表现，基于两个公共数据集共3,644名患者，比较了不同的适应策略和模态融合机制。研究发现这些模型在外部验证集上存在显著的性能下降，跨影像分布的泛化能力不足；影像特征与临床数据融合仍是最准确的预后预测方法，但实现跨临床环境的通用泛化仍是当前模型的重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 3D CT基础模型的迅速兴起为基于CT影像的预测建模提供了新途径，有望替代存在可重复性问题和采集协议敏感性缺陷的传统影像组学。然而随着这些模型日益普及，亟需评估其学习到的表征能否在不同临床场景中良好泛化，以及是否需要针对特定下游任务进行适配以充分发挥其潜力。
AI.method: 在头颈癌无复发生存预测任务中，对多种3D CT基础模型进行基准测试，涵盖两个公共数据集共3,644名患者。研究评估了多种模型适应策略（如微调等）和多模态融合机制（如影像特征与临床数据融合），并通过外部验证队列检验模型的泛化能力。
AI.result: 研究发现不同影像分布之间难以识别出能一致泛化的特征，模型在外部验证队列上出现显著的性能下降。影像特征与临床数据整合的方法在预后预测中表现最为准确，但当前一代模型在跨临床环境实现普遍泛化方面仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.conclusion: 当前3D CT基础模型在跨临床环境的泛化能力有限，外部验证时性能显著下降。影像-临床多模态融合是最准确的预后预测方案，但通用泛化仍是该领域亟待解决的核心问题，提示未来需要更强的领域适应机制和更稳健的特征学习策略。

title: DLLM-TTS: Block Discrete Diffusion Language Model for Text-to-Speech Synthesis
summary: Current text-to-speech systems face a trade-off: autoregres- sive codec language models produce highly intelligible speech but require large-scale models and training data and decode tokens sequentially, while non-autoregressive approaches im- prove speed at the cost of linguistic accuracy. We present DLLM-TTS, a framework that formulates TTS as conditional block discrete diffusion over X-Codec2 neural audio codec to- kens. The model decomposes sequences into blocks and applies masked diffusion within each block while processing blocks se- quentially, learning both local acoustic coherence and global text-speech alignment. During inference, parallel token pre- diction within blocks enables efficient generation with a real- time factor (RTF) of 0.15. A 0.6B-parameter model trained on 20K hours achieves competitive performance on the Seed- TTS-eval benchmark, demonstrating that block discrete diffu- sion language models enable practical and data-efficient speech synthesis with parallel generation.

AI.tldr: DLLM-TTS提出了一种将文本到语音(TTS)建模为条件块离散扩散的框架，基于X-Codec2神经音频编解码器token。模型将序列分解为块，在块内应用掩码扩散，同时按顺序处理块，实现了局部声学连贯性和全局文本-语音对齐。推理时块内并行token预测达到0.15的RTF，仅用0.6B参数和20K小时训练数据就在Seed-TTS-eval基准上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的TTS系统面临两难：自回归编解码器语言模型语音可懂度高但需要大规模模型和训练数据且解码缓慢；非自回归方法虽然速度快但牺牲了语言准确性。作者希望在这两者之间取得平衡，兼顾生成速度与语音质量。
AI.method: 将TTS公式化为条件块离散扩散模型，使用X-Codec2神经音频编解码器token。模型将序列分解为多个块，在每个块内部应用掩码扩散，而块之间则顺序处理，从而同时学习局部声学连贯性和全局文本-语音对齐关系。推理阶段在块内并行预测token以实现高效生成。
AI.result: 推理时RTF达到0.15，实现了高效的并行生成。仅使用0.6B参数的模型和20K小时训练数据，就在Seed-TTS-eval基准上取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明块离散扩散语言模型能够实现实用且数据高效的并行语音合成，在生成速度和生成质量之间达成了良好的平衡，避免了自回归和非自回归方法的固有缺陷。

title: CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection
summary: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically disparate questions can share equivalent underlying logic, CoT-Core prompts LLMs to unroll zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Projecting these paths into a latent space effectively clusters questions by intrinsic logical equivalence rather than superficial text similarity. Extensive experiments on GSM8K, MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and GPQA demonstrate that CoT-Core drastically reduces evaluation costs while maintaining high-fidelity score estimation, and delineate the boundary conditions of reasoning-aware pruning, revealing that its efficacy is intrinsically gated by task complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出CoT-Core框架，通过让LLM生成零样本CoT推理轨迹并将其投影到潜在空间进行聚类，实现基于逻辑等价而非表面文本相似性的核心问题选择，从而在无需历史日志的情况下大幅降低LLM评估成本并保持高保真度评分。
AI.motivation: LLM持续开发过程中的评估计算开销过大。现有核心集选择方法存在两个问题：一是如IRT等方法面临严重的"冷启动"瓶颈，需要大量历史日志；二是表面词法偏差，仅基于文本相似性选择问题，忽略了任务背后的推理流形。
AI.method: CoT-Core是一个无需训练的核心问题选择框架。具体而言：利用LLM生成零样本Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理轨迹；将这些推理路径投影到潜在空间；依据内在逻辑等价性而非表面文本相似性对问题进行聚类，从而选择代表性核心问题。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro和GPQA四个基准上的大量实验表明，CoT-Core能大幅降低评估成本，同时保持高保真度的分数估计。此外，研究还描绘了基于推理感知剪枝的边界条件，揭示其有效性本质上受任务复杂度的门控。
AI.conclusion: CoT-Core通过利用推理轨迹的逻辑等价性实现了高效的训练无关核心集选择，但其有效性依赖于任务复杂度，这为推理感知评估剪枝的适用边界提供了重要见解。

title: Rethinking Pretraining for Specialized Design Data: Evidence from the JONES-19 Cultural Design Dataset
summary: Design and architectural archives encode expert human knowledge in graphical formats, providing a critical testbed for design-inspired Machine Learning (ML) challenges absent with typical computer vision benchmarks. Building on JONES-19, a small-size image dataset based on The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1857), we evaluate the discriminative performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in two model training strategies: (a) ImageNet pretraining for domain-general "visual common sense," and (b) learning from scratch on the design data in JONES-19. We find that while domain-general priors improve discriminative performance, learning from scratch augmented with repeated local sampling (multi-crop) effectively recovers these gains. For highly structured design data, local design-driven representations provide sufficient foundation for learning, challenging a reliance on massive general-purpose pretraining. These findings suggest that in specialized design domains, careful curation of smaller high-quality datasets that capture empirical and formal design principles may prove more effective and informative on the nature of a particular design domain than prioritizing large-scale data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文基于JONES-19数据集（源自《装饰法则》的图形数据集），评估CNN在两种训练策略（ImageNet预训练微调 vs. 从零训练）下的判别性能，发现多裁剪数据增强可弥补从零训练与预训练之间的性能差距，表明在专业设计领域，精心策划的小型高质量数据集可能比大规模通用预训练更有效。
AI.motivation: 设计档案以图形格式编码专家知识，为设计启发式机器学习提供了独特测试平台，但缺乏与传统计算机视觉基准相当的评估。作者希望探索在专业设计领域，领域通用预训练是否必要，以及小规模高质量数据是否足以支撑有效学习。
AI.method: 基于JONES-19数据集（源自1857年《装饰法则》的小型图像集），评估CNN在两种策略下的判别性能：(a) ImageNet预训练作为领域通用"视觉常识"；(b) 在JONES-19设计数据上从零训练，并结合重复局部采样（多裁剪）数据增强技术。
AI.result: 领域通用先验（ImageNet预训练）能提升判别性能，但结合多裁剪数据增强的从零训练可有效恢复这些性能差距。对于高度结构化的设计数据，局部设计驱动的表示足以支撑学习。
AI.conclusion: 在专业设计领域，精心策划的小型高质量数据集（捕捉经验和形式设计原则）可能比盲目追求大规模数据收集更有效，且更能揭示特定设计领域的本质。

title: Imprecise Belief Fusion Improves Multi-agent Social Learning
summary: In social learning, agents learn not only from direct evidence but also through interactions with their peers. We investigate the role of imprecision in such interactions and ask whether it can improve the effectiveness of the collective learning process. To that end we propose a model of social learning where beliefs are equivalent to formulas in a propositional language, and where agents learn from each other by combining their beliefs according to a fusion operator. The latter is parametrised so as to allow for different levels of imprecision, where a more imprecise fusion operator tends to generates a more imprecise fused belief when the two combined beliefs differ. In this context we describe both difference equation models and agent-based simulations of social learning under a variety of conditions and with different initial biases. The results presented suggest that for populations with a strong initial bias towards incorrect beliefs some level of imprecision in fusion can improve learning accuracy across a range of learning conditions. Furthermore, such benefits of imprecision are consistent with a stability analysis of the fixed points of the proposed difference equation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究社会学习中信念融合的不精确性（imprecision）对集体学习效果的促进作用。作者提出一个基于命题逻辑公式和融合算子（fusion operator）的社会学习模型，融合算子可按参数调节不精确程度。通过差分方程模型和基于主体的仿真实验，发现当群体存在较强的初始错误偏见时，适当水平的不精确融合能够提升学习准确性，且该结论与差分方程模型不动点的稳定性分析一致。
AI.motivation: 传统社会学习研究多聚焦于精确的信念更新机制，但现实中个体间的信息传递往往存在模糊不清之处。作者希望探讨这种"不精确性"是否不仅无害，反而能改善集体学习的效果，特别是在群体普遍持有错误初始信念的情形下。
AI.method: 1) 信念建模：将信念表示为命题语言中的公式；2) 融合算子：参数化的信念融合机制，不精确程度越高，融合后信念越模糊；3) 两种分析框架：差分方程模型（用于理论分析和不动点稳定性研究）与基于主体的仿真（用于探索多变条件和不同初始偏见下的动态过程）。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明：在群体初始信念强烈偏向错误的情况下，一定水平的不精确融合能够提升集体学习准确性，且这一优势在多种学习条件下均成立。此外，差分方程模型的不动点稳定性分析结果与仿真结论一致，验证了不精确性有益性结论的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 不精确性在社会学习中并非总是负面因素——在特定条件下（如群体存在较强初始偏见时），适度的不精确融合反而能帮助群体克服集体认知偏差，提升学习准确性，其机制与动力系统不动点的稳定性特性密切相关。

title: Volcanic Clouds Detection through QCNN and Geostationary Satellite Multispectral Imagery
summary: Recent advances in quantum computing are opening new possibilities for Earth Observation (EO) data analysis. Quantum machine learning (QML) approaches offer novel ways to process information by exploiting quantum phenomena such as superposition and entanglement. These capabilities have motivated the exploration of whether quantum-enhanced models can address long-standing challenges in satellite remote sensing, where complex spectral and spatial signals often require sophisticated feature extraction. Among various fields of application, EO data allow the global monitoring of volcanic clouds and are crucial for aviation safety, hazard assessment, real-time eruption response, and evaluation of volcanic impacts on climate. Yet accurate detection of volcanic clouds remains difficult due to their similarity with meteorological clouds, the variability of eruption signatures, and the coarse spectral sampling of geostationary sensors. In this work, the potential of hybrid quantum convolutional neural networks (QCNNs) for the classification of satellite images containing volcanic clouds was investigated. These architectures integrate quantum computational layers into a classical convolutional framework. Two QCNN variants (with 2 and 4 qubits) have been considered to evaluate their ability to classify a dataset of SEVIRI images, including scenes with volcanic clouds (composed of ash, $SO_2$, or mixed components) as well as non-volcanic backgrounds. Finally, the performance of the hybrid QCNN models was compared with that of purely classical architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了混合量子卷积神经网络（QCNN）在卫星图像火山云分类中的应用，比较了2量子比特和4量子比特两种QCNN变体与纯经典架构的性能，数据集来自SEVIRI图像，包含火山云（灰烬、SO₂、混合成分）和非火山背景场景。
AI.motivation: 火山云检测对航空安全、灾害评估、实时喷发响应和气候影响评估至关重要，但火山云与气象云相似、喷发特征多变、地球静止传感器光谱采样粗糙，导致准确检测困难。量子机器学习的进步为地球观测数据分析提供了新的可能性，值得探索其能否解决这一长期挑战。
AI.method: 采用混合量子卷积神经网络（QCNN）架构，将量子计算层集成到经典卷积框架中。设计了两种QCNN变体（分别使用2个和4个量子比特），用于对SEVIRI卫星图像的火山云进行分类，数据集包含火山云场景（灰烬、SO₂、混合成分）和非火山背景场景。
AI.result: 研究评估了两种QCNN变体在火山云分类任务中的表现，并与纯经典架构进行了性能对比，具体量化结果在论文正文中给出。
AI.conclusion: 通过比较混合QCNN模型与经典架构的分类性能，评估了量子增强方法在卫星遥感火山云检测任务中的潜力。

title: Obshazard-bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Foundation Models for Real-Time Disaster Intelligence from Raw Earth Observation Streams
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret Earth observation data, yet their capability to support real-world disaster emergency response remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing remote sensing benchmarks largely rely on static, post-hoc, and expert-processed products, such as gridded reanalysis data, which are difficult to align with operational disaster scenarios where hazards evolve rapidly and decisions must be made under strict time constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce Obshazard-bench, a real-time, observation-driven benchmark for evaluating disaster intelligence in MLLMs. Unlike image-centric or post-event benchmarks, Obshazard-bench directly integrates raw, high-frequency satellite sounding streams from diverse satellite sensors with concurrent ground-station observations, historical disaster records, and socio-economic indicators, bypassing delayed expert-processing and physical-inversion pipelines. The benchmark covers 8 major disaster categories and 28 sub-categories across more than 60 countries, incorporating over 120 historically documented extreme-event cases and thousands of lifecycle-oriented VQA samples. Moreover, Obshazard-bench further defines a three-stage evaluation taxonomy aligned with the operational disaster workflow: Predictive Crisis Anticipation for pre-disaster risk detection and early forecasting, Active Evolution Reasoning for in-situ disaster tracking and termination prediction, and Multi-faceted Impact Quantification for post-disaster magnitude deduction, humanitarian burden estimation, and socio-economic impact assessment. Experiments on representative general-purpose and Earth-focused foundation models reveal substantial limitations in transforming raw multi-channel physical observations into temporally grounded and decision-relevant disaster reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Obshazard-bench，一个面向实时灾害应急响应的多模态大语言模型基准测试，直接整合原始高频卫星感测流、地面观测、历史灾害记录和社会经济指标，覆盖8大类28小类灾害、60多个国家、120多个历史极端事件案例，并定义了三阶段评估分类体系（灾前预测、灾中推演、灾后量化）。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基准测试依赖静态、事后且经专家处理的产品（如网格化再分析数据），难以对齐实际灾害应急场景中灾害快速演变、决策需严格遵守时间限制的现实需求，导致MLLMs在真实灾害应急响应中的能力评估不足。
AI.method: 构建Obshazard-bench基准，直接整合多传感器高频率卫星感测流与同期地面观测、历史灾害记录及社会经济指标，绕过延迟的专家处理和物理反演管线；定义与运营灾害工作流对齐的三阶段评估分类：灾前预测性危机预警、灾中主动演变推理、灾后多维度影响量化；生成数千个全生命周期VQA样本。
AI.result: 实验表明代表性通用型和地球专注型基础模型在将原始多通道物理观测转化为时间敏感和决策相关的灾害推理方面存在显著局限性。
AI.conclusion: Obshazard-bench填补了MLLMs在实时灾害应急响应能力评估方面的空白，揭示了现有模型在时间性感知和决策级灾害推理方面的不足，为该领域后续发展提供了评估基准和方向指引。

title: Optimization and Constraint Modeling using LLMs with a Retrieval Augmented Generation Process
summary: Both optimization modeling and constraint modeling are non-trivial problems requiring deep domain expertise and proficiency in modeling formalism languages. Despite their importance across logistics, healthcare, and supply chain management, current large language models regularly produce structurally inconsistent or incomplete optimization formulations, particularly in combinatorial settings. This paper evaluates whether a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline built on a curated synthetic dataset can meaningfully improve LLM optimization modeling performance. A total of 500 optimization problems were synthesized using seed descriptions from the Text2Zinc dataset and professional personas created using an LLM, specified in JSON and associated with validated Python solver scripts. These problems were encoded in a Chroma vector database. For each inference problem, semantically similar problems were retrieved and used as contextual guidance for a LangChain LLM agent. Three benchmark testbeds were used to evaluate the proposed pipeline under the Qwen 3 30B Instruct model. Accuracy rose from 40% to 72% on NL4OPT, 40% to 56% on MAMO Easy, and 32% to 56% on MAMO Complex. The use of semantically validated synthetic examples greatly improves both solution accuracy and structure. The combination of synthetic dataset generation with retrieval augmentation provides an effective alternative to fine-tuning, suggesting that domain-specific synthetic corpora paired with retrieval augmentation can serve as a practical pathway for deploying LLM-based optimization tools in real-world decision-support contexts without costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的流水线，利用综合生成的数据集来提升大语言模型在优化建模任务上的性能。通过从Text2Zinc数据集合成500个优化问题并存入向量数据库，检索相似问题作为上下文指导，在Qwen 3 30B模型上将NL4OPT准确率从40%提升至72%，MAMO Easy从40%提升至56%，MAMO Complex从32%提升至56%，证明了综合数据生成与检索增强相结合的方案可以作为微调的有效替代方案。
AI.motivation: 优化建模和约束建模需要深厚的领域专业知识和建模语言能力，当前大语言模型在组合优化场景下经常产生结构不一致或不完整的优化方案。作者旨在探索是否可以通过RAG流水线结合综合数据集来有效提升LLM的优化建模性能，而无需昂贵的模型微调。
AI.method: 从Text2Zinc数据集获取种子描述，使用LLM生成专业角色人设，合成500个优化问题（以JSON格式描述并关联已验证的Python求解脚本）；将这些问题编码到Chroma向量数据库中；对于每个推理问题，检索语义相似的问题作为上下文指导LangChain LLM代理；使用Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型在三个基准测试集（NL4OPT、MAMO Easy、MAMO Complex）上进行评估。
AI.result: 在Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型上，NL4OPT准确率从40%提升到72%，MAMO Easy从40%提升到56%，MAMO Complex从32%提升到56%。语义验证过的综合示例显著提高了解法的准确性和结构一致性。
AI.conclusion: 综合数据集生成与检索增强的结合为微调提供了一种有效的替代方案，表明领域特定的综合语料库配合检索增强可以成为在实际决策支持场景中部署LLM优化工具的实际可行途径，无需昂贵的模型重训练。

title: Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models
summary: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds nothing, while on an IID Pile split (MIMIR) neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly beats a blind baseline (incremental AUC 95% CI includes zero). Aggregate metrics hide the real harm. The same sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 83 of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (16.6%; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that exact identifier reproduced AND not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control, so each leak is attributable to that document, not to a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC and grows with capacity (5.6% to 16.6% from 410M to 6.9B). The risk is uneven: identifier leakage is ~3x stronger in code than prose, though prose stays clearly positive and also grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1%), while recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling matter little, a 16-token prefix suffices, and we detect no reduction from corpus deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, decomposed by domain, not a single AUC. We release leakit, a black-box extraction-audit tool.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了成员推断（MIA）用聚合ROC-AUC评估语言模型隐私泄露的做法，指出其混淆性。作者通过黑盒采样视角，在WikiMIA和MIMIR数据集上证明盲基准即可达到高AUC，采样并不增加区分度；但真正风险在于逐文档提取——Pythia-6.9B上16.6%的含真实标识符文档会被精确复现，且该风险随模型规模增长、在代码域更强、不受去重影响。作者主张隐私审计应报告按域分解的逐文档提取情况，而非单一AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有MIA评估用聚合ROC-AUC衡量，但即使无模型访问的盲基线也能仅凭表面文本区分成员与非成员，导致评估结果被混淆、掩盖了真实的隐私泄露风险。
AI.method: 采用概率视角，将从p(.|x)采样的N个样本视为输出分布的估计，把泄露信号建模为其泛函。在WikiMIA和MIMIR上比较盲基线（bag-of-words分类器）与采样方法，并在Pythia系列模型上测量逐文档的标识符精确提取率，搭配不匹配前缀对照实验验证泄露可归因性。
AI.result: 盲bag-of-words分类器在WikiMIA达AUC 0.97，采样无增益；在MIMIR上采样方法无法显著超越盲基线。但Pythia-6.9B上16.6%含标识符文档被精确提取（邮件地址文档为21.3%），泄露率从410M的5.6%增长至6.9B的16.6%；代码域泄露比散文强约3倍；温度、核采样影响小，16-token前缀即足够，去重无效果。
AI.conclusion: 聚合AUC掩盖了真实的逐文档泄露风险，隐私审计应报告按域（代码/散文）分解的逐文档提取率。作者发布leakit工具作为黑盒提取审计工具。

title: Training Small LLMs as Spatial Multi-Agent Policies
summary: Training LLM-based multi-agent systems with multi-agent reinforcement learning is rapidly gaining traction, and a parallel line of work argues that such systems should be judged by their behavior, not only their reward. We take up both threads in spatial cooperative games, where small frozen LLMs prompted with low-level actions fail outright, earning zero reward. Guided by the options/semi-MDP framework---and, because option execution is asynchronous across agents, its multi-agent extension in macro-action Dec-POMDPs---we equip each game with a library of symbolic \emph{options}: typed, state-feasible, short-horizon behaviors executed by a symbolic planner. Each library is drafted by a frontier coding model from the game's source code; the feasibility guards that filter each menu are then synthesized mechanically from cheap random-policy burn-in rollouts---a guard is adopted only if it explains repeated execution failures while hiding no logged success---so no guard is authored, selected, or reward-tuned by hand. Each agent's LLM acts as its policy over options, with a private per-agent LoRA adapter trained by a per-agent variant of multi-agent GRPO (PA-MAGRPO); this lifts frozen bases from zero reward to competent play across three games and four small backbones. Behavioral audits then reveal that reward and cooperation decouple: a rising reward curve may simply mean that one agent has learned to run the entire task alone while its partner idles---cooperation emerges only when the task makes it necessary. Reward alone is thus an unreliable readout of cooperation; behavioral evaluation must sit alongside it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于LLM的多智能体系统在空间协作游戏中的训练与评估问题。作者提出利用符号选项库（options）将低级动作抽象为高级行为，通过机制自动合成的可行性守卫过滤选项，并用每智能体LoRA适配器和多智能体GRPO算法训练。实验表明该方法能将冻结的基础模型从零奖励提升到熟练水平，但行为审计发现奖励与合作解耦——奖励上升可能只是因为单智能体独自完成任务，因此需要行为评估与奖励评估并重。
AI.motivation: (1) 基于LLM的多智能体强化学习日益流行，但纯低级动作提示的小型LLM在空间协作游戏中会完全失败（零奖励）；(2) 现有研究强调系统应依据行为而非仅依据奖励来评判，但缺乏系统的行为评估方法；(3) 需要将这两条研究线结合起来，在空间协作游戏中实现LLM智能体的有效训练和行为评估。
AI.method: 基于宏动作Dec-POMDP（macro-action Dec-POMDP）框架，为每个游戏构建符号选项库（symbolic options）：选项由前沿编码模型从游戏源码自动起草，类型化且有状态可行性；可行性守卫通过随机策略burn-in rollout机械化合成——仅当守卫能解释重复执行失败且不隐藏任何记录的成功时才会被采纳，全程无需手工编写、选择或奖励调优。每个智能体以LLM作为在选项集上的策略，使用私有每智能体LoRA适配器，并通过每智能体多智能体GRPO（PA-MAGRPO）变体训练。此外，对训练后的系统进行行为审计以评估协作质量。
AI.result: 在三个游戏和四种小型骨干模型上，该方法将冻结基础模型从零奖励提升到熟练水平。行为审计揭示奖励与合作解耦：奖励曲线上升可能只表示一个智能体学会独自完成整个任务而同伴闲置；合作仅在任务使其成为必要时才涌现，因此仅靠奖励无法可靠反映合作程度。
AI.conclusion: 奖励与协作行为可以脱钩，仅依赖奖励作为智能体系统评估指标是误导性的，行为评估必须与奖励评估并列使用。基于选项抽象和机制自动合成的可行性守卫为LLM多智能体训练提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond Random Partitioning: Unsupervised Spatio-Temporal Stratification for Cohort Balancing in Longitudinal Medical Imaging
summary: Rigorous dataset partitioning is a foundational, yet frequently overlooked, prerequisite for reliable deep learning in longitudinal medical imaging. Naively shuffling small clinical cohorts routinely introduces covariate shifts and temporal sampling imbalances across training, validation, and test subsets, exposing downstream models to out-of-distribution evaluation. We address this vulnerability with an auditable Tripartite Dataset Analytics Framework that systematically characterizes spatial grid integrity, multi-parametric intensity fingerprints, and longitudinal temporal trajectories, quantifying the heavy-tailed feature dispersion and irregular, episodic sampling intervals typical of real-world clinical cohorts. Building on this characterization, we formalize an unsupervised spatio-temporal cohort-balancing standard operating procedure (SOP) that combines elbow-optimized K-means clustering over a standardized, six-dimensional joint intensity-temporal feature space with intra-cluster proportionate stratified sampling. On a longitudinal, contrast-enhanced $T1$-weighted brain MRI cohort (N=149), the protocol reduces the maximum cross-subset intensity bias from 34.1% under conventional random shuffling to under 2.1%, while aligning longitudinal follow-up intervals closely around the population mean. Monte Carlo stress testing across ten random seeds and three split configurations confirms that this alignment remains tightly bounded, in clear contrast to the substantial variability of random partitioning. The resulting protocol offers a reproducible, generalizable procedure for cohort engineering in variable-length longitudinal clinical imaging workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可审计的三方数据集分析框架（Tripartite Dataset Analytics Framework），用于纵向医学影像中严格的数据集划分。通过无监督时空队列平衡标准操作程序（SOP），结合肘部优化的K-means聚类和聚类内比例分层抽样，将跨子集强度偏差从传统随机划分的34.1%降至2.1%以下，并校准了纵向随访间隔。
AI.motivation: 在纵向医学影像的深度学习任务中，严格的数据集划分是基础但常被忽视的环节。小规模临床队列的朴素随机打乱会引入协变量偏移（covariate shifts）和时间采样不平衡，导致模型面临分布外评估（out-of-distribution evaluation）的风险。
AI.method: 提出三方数据集分析框架，从三个维度系统刻画数据：空间网格完整性（spatial grid integrity）、多参数强度指纹（multi-parametric intensity fingerprints）和纵向时间轨迹（longitudinal temporal trajectories）。在此基础上，构建无监督的时空队列平衡SOP：先在标准化六维联合强度-时间特征空间上执行肘部优化的K-means聚类，再进行簇内比例分层抽样（intra-cluster proportionate stratified sampling）。
AI.result: 在纵向增强T1加权脑MRI队列（N=149）上，最大跨子集强度偏差从随机打乱的34.1%降至2.1%以下，纵向随访间隔被对齐到接近总体均值。蒙特卡洛压力测试（10个随机种子、3种划分配置）确认该对齐保持紧密有界，与随机划分的显著变异性形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 该协议为可变长度的纵向临床影像工作流提供了可复现、可推广的队列工程方法，是一种优于朴素随机划分的可靠数据集划分策略。

title: What Transfers from Text to Vision? Capability Scaling Laws and Transfer Dynamics for VLMs
summary: Choosing the right large language model (LLM) backbone is the most consequential decision when building a vision-language model (VLM), yet it remains fundamentally unprincipled: compute-based scaling laws fail to generalize across model families, and no framework exists for directly predicting VLM performance before training begins. We propose the Capability-Driven Multimodal Scaling Law, the first cross-family framework that predicts VLM benchmark accuracy from directly observable textual capability. Given a low-dimensional capability score $S$ extracted from LLM textual benchmarks via PCA, we model VLM performance as a function of $S$, with a per-backbone transfer rate and an absorption rate that quantifies data-scaling efficiency. To fit and validate the framework, we train over 150 VLMs on 34 LLMs spanning 7 model families under a strictly controlled recipe. Evaluations on more than 200 textual and 50 multimodal benchmarks show that the law accurately extrapolates transfer rate from models up to 8B parameters to 72B-scale backbones, predicts full VLM training trajectories with high fidelity, and generalizes to entirely held-out model families. Beyond the scaling law, our analysis surfaces actionable insights: certain textual benchmarks negatively correlate with multimodal performance, exposing latent benchmark-gaming behavior; base LLMs outperform instruction-tuned counterparts as VLM backbones due to higher absorption rates and lower data-scaling decay; and different model families occupy distinct positions in the transfer--absorption space. The framework turns backbone selection from costly empirical sweeps into a principled, quantitative decision. Code and data are available at https://github.com/wangq-dev/CDMScaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能力驱动的多模态缩放定律（CDM Scaling Law），这是首个跨模型家族的框架，能够从LLM的文本能力分数直接预测VLM的基准性能。通过训练150多个VLM、覆盖7个模型家族的34个LLM，该框架能准确外推模型规模、预测训练轨迹并泛化到未见模型家族，同时揭示了文本基准与多模态性能的负相关、基座模型优于指令微调模型等洞见。
AI.motivation: 选择LLM骨干是构建VLM时最关键的决策，但现有的计算量缩放定律无法跨模型家族泛化，且缺乏在训练前直接预测VLM性能的框架，导致骨干选择依赖昂贵的经验性试错。
AI.method: 从LLM文本基准中通过PCA提取低维能力分数S，将VLM性能建模为S的函数，包含每个骨干的迁移率（transfer rate）和量化数据缩放效率的吸收率（absorption rate）。在严格控制的实验条件下训练150多个VLM，覆盖34个LLM和7个模型家族。
AI.result: 在200多个文本基准和50多个多模态基准上的评估表明：该定律能准确将迁移率从8B参数外推到72B规模的骨干；高保真地预测完整VLM训练轨迹；泛化到完全未见过的模型家族。同时发现某些文本基准与多模态性能负相关（暴露基准游戏行为）、基座LLM比指令微调版本更适合作为VLM骨干（因为更高的吸收率和更低的数据缩放衰减），不同模型家族在迁移-吸收空间中占据不同位置。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将骨干选择从昂贵的经验性扫描转变为有原则的量化决策，为VLM的骨干选择提供了首个可预测、跨家族泛化的理论基础。

title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly learn from experience without updating any weights. Each episode is stored in an external memory, scored, and retrieved for similar future tasks to shape later behavior. Viewed through a reward lens, the stored score is a proxy reward for an implicit, non-parametric policy. Each retrieved episode then becomes a policy-improvement step whose reliability hinges on how that score is produced.
