In deployment, ground-truth labels are unavailable, so the stored reward is at best an LLM assessment. This substitution creates a failure mode, the *Echo Gap*, across the memory-based self-improving agents and model families studied. Incorrect episodes receive inflated rewards; thus, the agent preferentially reuses the very mistakes it has most confident in. Because the error compounds through memory rather than averaging out and the confirming judge's errors remain correlated with the original self-grading bias, so it cannot identify which memories are overvalued. The missing property is formalized as the *Error-Independence Assumption* (EIA), which we prove is a *necessary* condition for correcting the inflation, not merely a description of a good verifier: a usable signal must track truth *and* decorrelate its error from the memory bias, and the recoverable payoff is a closed-form function of exactly those two quantities. We further show the inflation compounds not only when retrieval ranks by the stored score but also under plain similarity retrieval which is the regime the deployed agent uses. Finally, the answer-free de-inflation algorithm LUCID delivers a consistent end-to-end gain on the BIRD text-to-SQL benchmark. It raises execution accuracy to $56.9\%$, above both a Memento-style self-graded agent ($54.0\%$, a $+2.9$-point mean gain across seeds) and a memory-less agent of identical architecture ($52.4\%$).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于外部记忆的LLM智能体自我改进中，由于用LLM评估替代真实标签而产生的"Echo Gap"失败模式——错误的记忆被高估并被反复重用，误差在记忆中复合而非平均化。作者形式化了"Error-Independence Assumption"(EIA)作为修正这一偏差的必要条件，并提出了无答案的去膨胀算法LUCID，在BIRD text-to-SQL基准上将执行准确率提升至56.9%。
AI.motivation: 在无权重更新的记忆式LLM智能体自我改进中，部署时缺少真实标签，存储的奖励分数只能来自LLM自身评估。这种替代会产生系统性的打分膨胀问题，导致智能体优先重用自己最自信的错误记忆。需要理解这一失败模式的机制并找到修正方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出Echo Gap失败模式并形式化描述；2) 证明Error-Independence Assumption(EIA)——信号需跟踪真理且其误差需与记忆偏差去相关——是修正奖励膨胀的必要条件；3) 推导可恢复收益为这两个量的闭式函数；4) 分析膨胀在按分数检索和纯相似性检索两种模式下都会复合；5) 提出LUCID去膨胀算法。
AI.result: LUCID算法在BIRD text-to-SQL基准上取得56.9%的执行准确率，超过Memento式自评分智能体(54.0%，平均+2.9点提升)和无记忆同架构智能体(52.4%)。
AI.conclusion: Echo Gap是记忆式LLM自我改进中的系统性失败模式，EIA是修正奖励膨胀的必要条件，LUCID通过去膨胀算法实现了一致且端到端的性能提升。

title: Response Magnitude as a Dominant Signal for Held-Out CRISPRi Perturbation Effect Prediction
summary: Predicting the magnitude of a CRISPRi perturbation's transcriptomic effect on held-out target genes is an important open problem in single-cell biology. Recent work has documented that simple baselines often match or exceed deep perturbation predictors on related protocols. We study this phenomenon on the Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC) benchmark under a strict held-out target-gene split, identify the specific low-dimensional signal that drives the gap, and characterize how it transfers across cell types. The target is the log Anderson-Darling distance from non-targeting controls, which is strongly predictable from four deterministic scalar functions of the 2,000-dimensional input. A deep MLP encoder with direct access to the full input collapses toward the marginal training mean, and standard remedies do not close the gap. A linear regression on the four magnitude scalars alone exceeds the strongest x-only classical model, while a Random Forest on the input plus the four scalars substantially outperforms our deep proof-of-concept encoder. Two pre-specified controls attribute the magnitude gain to per-row alignment rather than added dimensionality. Under zero-shot transfer to two external CRISPRi screens evaluated against a target-gene endpoint rebuilt from single-cell data, magnitude-only predictors transfer positively whereas expression-only predictors are negative or unresolved. Exposing magnitude to the deep encoder improves transfer over its expression-only counterpart, yet the encoder does not outperform a four-scalar linear regression on the same features. We also find that the Anderson-Darling column distributed with these screens measures transcriptome-wide response breadth rather than target-gene effect strength, so evaluating transfer against it scores a different outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了CRISPRi扰动对基因表达影响的预测问题，发现一个简单的低维信号（四个确定性标量函数）就足以高度预测目标基因的扰动效应幅度。深度MLP编码器在严格的held-out目标基因分割下会退化到边际训练均值，而线性回归和随机森林等经典方法表现更好。该幅度信号在跨细胞类型转移到外部CRISPRi筛选时表现正收益，而纯表达预测器则表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 预测CRISPRi扰动对基因表达的转录组效应是单细胞生物学中的一个重要开放问题。已有研究表明简单基线方法往往能达到或超过深度扰动预测器，但具体原因尚不清楚。作者希望理解这种差距背后的机理，找出驱动预测性能差距的低维信号。
AI.method: 在Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC)基准上采用严格的held-out目标基因分割，分析目标变量（对数Anderson-Darling距离）的可预测性。通过识别四个确定性标量函数作为关键特征，对比深度MLP编码器与线性回归、随机森林等经典方法，并通过两个预设对照实验将幅度增益归因于按行对齐而非维度增加。还进行了到两个外部CRISPRi筛选的零样本迁移实验。
AI.result: 四个幅度标量的线性回归就超过最强的x-only经典模型；在输入加四个标量上的随机森林显著优于深度MLP编码器。标准优化策略无法让深度编码器缩小差距。幅度预测器在零样本迁移中表现正收益，而纯表达预测器为负或不明确。将幅度暴露给深度编码器可改善迁移，但仍不如四标量线性回归。此外，Anderson-Darling列度量的是转录组响应广度而非靶基因效应强度。
AI.conclusion: CRISPRi扰动预测中的深度方法优势可能被高估——简单的低维标量特征就能捕捉大多数可预测信号，深度编码器在held-out基因设置下无法有效利用高维输入。评估迁移时应区分"幅度预测"和"表达预测"两个不同任务，且Anderson-Darling度量本身的语义需要重新审视。

title: Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
summary: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Bazaar，一个动态密封投标基准，用于测试LLM代理在真实市场条件下的多属性拍卖定价能力。实验发现11个前沿LLM中，客户获取最优的代理（如Gemini 3.1 Pro）并非利润最优（如Opus 4.6），需求冲击下排名再次变化，且最强代理的利润也不到事后最优的三分之一。
AI.motivation: 代理商务正从概念走向实际部署，但LLM代理能否在真实市场（客户偏好隐藏、竞争对手实时调整、需求突变）中胜任定价，尚未被系统测试。
AI.method: 提出Bazaar——一个动态密封投标基准，用于多属性拍卖场景，通过闭式客户效用函数实现精确评估，并对11个来自4家提供商的前沿LLM进行系统性测试。
AI.result: 客户获取领先的代理（Gemini 3.1 Pro）与利润领先的代理（Opus 4.6）并非同一；需求冲击下排名再次变化，冲击前学习最快的代理冲击后修正最慢，而Gemini 3.1 Pro恢复最快但非利润领先；最强代理利润不足事后最优的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在代理商务中已有进展，但距离最优定价仍有显著差距，存在大量改进空间。

title: Explainable Multimodal AI for Adaptive Calibration of Archaeological Sensing Workflows
summary: This paper presents a multimodal machine-learning framework for calibration monitoring, quality assessment, and adaptive acquisition support in archaeological digitisation workflows. The proposed approach operates across photogrammetric 3D reconstruction, hyperspectral imaging, X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy, and Raman spectroscopy through a unified pipeline combining deterministic quality indicators, statistical feature representations, machine-learning classification, anomaly detection, and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI). Rather than replacing instrument-level calibration, the framework introduces an additional algorithmic layer that evaluates whether acquisitions are statistically consistent, physically plausible, and suitable for downstream multimodal integration. For each sensing modality, acquisitions are represented through structured feature spaces encoding geometric, spectral, spatial, and statistical properties. These representations are used to identify degradation patterns such as reconstruction artefacts, illumination inconsistencies, spectral distortions, detector instability, baseline fluctuations, and low signal-to-noise conditions. Supervised and unsupervised learning methods are combined with XAI techniques to support both automatic discrimination between acceptable and problematic acquisitions and interpretation of the underlying causes of degradation. The framework additionally supports adaptive feedback and resource-aware acquisition strategies by linking feature-space deviations to acquisition-level corrective actions. Experimental results obtained on multimodal archaeological datasets demonstrate that the proposed methodology captures meaningful acquisition variability and enables robust quality assessment across heterogeneous sensing modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多模态机器学习框架，用于考古数字化工作流中的校准监控、质量评估和自适应采集支持。框架通过统一管道整合确定性质量指标、统计特征表示、机器学习分类、异常检测和可解释AI，覆盖摄影测量3D重建、高光谱成像、XRF光谱和拉曼光谱等多种传感模态。
AI.motivation: 考古数字化涉及多种异构传感模态，各模态的采集质量问题（如重建伪影、光照不均、光谱失真、探测器不稳定等）难以统一评估和监控。现有方法主要依赖仪器级校准，缺乏一个能够评估采集数据是否统计一致、物理合理且适合下游多模态集成的算法层。
AI.method: 框架由多部分组成：1) 每个传感模态通过结构化特征空间表示，编码几何、光谱、空间和统计属性；2) 结合监督和无监督学习方法进行自动判别与异常检测；3) 引入可解释AI（XAI）技术解释退化的根本原因；4) 通过特征空间偏差与采集级纠正措施的关联，支持自适应反馈和资源感知采集策略。
AI.result: 在多模态考古数据集上的实验表明，该框架能够捕捉有意义的采集变异性，并在异构传感模态之间实现稳健的质量评估。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不会取代仪器级校准，而是增加一个额外的算法层来评估采集数据的统计一致性和物理合理性，从而提升考古数字化工作流的整体质量和可靠性。

title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
summary: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. Role-specific directions receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. They also preserve high lexical diversity, while the control drops sharply at larger coefficients. The role-level screen is the main practical output: most roles improve as steering increases, but 38 roles decline across all six measured dimensions, showing why simulation builders should choose coefficients per role rather than deploy a uniform high-strength setting. We make our code and evaluation artifacts available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/anonymous-research-code-5F03/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于激活引导（activation-steering）筛选工作流，用于在将角色条件化智能体放入模拟人群之前，验证其角色条件化行为是否合格。工作流包含五个步骤：定义角色档案、提取角色特定方向、扫描四个引导系数、评估角色档案对齐度、通过或标记每个候选配置。在OLMo-3-7B-Instruct上对275个角色进行测试，角色特定方向比先前的persona-vector方向控制获得更高的角色档案对齐评分（63.2 vs 41.1），同时保持更高的词汇多样性。关键发现是大多数角色随引导增强而改善，但有38个角色在所有六个维度上均下降，说明应逐角色选择系数而非统一采用高强度设置。
AI.motivation: 社会模拟系统使用语言模型智能体构建时，需要确保智能体具备角色条件化行为，并且这种行为需要在智能体被放入模拟人群之前就可验证。现有方法缺乏系统的筛选流程来保证角色条件化行为的质量，需要一种可以在部署前评估和筛选角色智能体配置的机制。
AI.method: 提出激活引导筛选工作流，具体包括：(1) 定义角色档案（role profile）；(2) 提取角色特定方向（role-specific direction）；(3) 扫描四个引导系数（steering coefficients）；(4) 评估角色档案对齐度（role-profile alignment）；(5) 对每个候选配置进行通过或标记（pass/flag）。实验使用OLMo-3-7B-Instruct，275个角色与228个角色无关问题，GPT-4.1-mini生成角色参考并作为评判者，与prior persona-vector的方向控制进行对比。
AI.result: 角色特定方向在角色档案对齐度上显著优于assistant-axis方向控制（平均总分63.2 vs 41.1）。角色特定方向在高引导系数下仍保持高词汇多样性，而控制组词汇多样性急剧下降。角色级筛选是主要实用产出：大多数角色随引导增强而改善，但38个角色在所有六个测量维度上均下降，证明了逐角色选择系数的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导筛选工作流为角色条件化智能体提供了部署前的系统验证方法。研究结果表明应避免统一使用高强度的引导设置，而应基于每个角色的表现单独选择引导系数。该方法可作为社会模拟中角色智能体质量保障的标准流程。

title: Request-Level Energy Attribution for Batched LLM Serving
summary: Batched LLM serving improves throughput but complicates energy accounting. GPU power telemetry is aggregate, whereas sustainability reporting, chargeback, and workload analysis often require request-level energy charges. Existing inference-energy benchmarks report model-, phase-, or token-level energy, and recent carbon-accounting work motivates Shapley fairness conceptually. Neither provides measured request-level ground truth, so how far the accounting rules used in practice deviate from a fair allocation has remained unknown. We present JouleShare, an attribution framework with two components. An offline harness establishes this ground truth by replaying request subsets under vLLM with a reproducible protocol, integrating GPU power telemetry, and computing exact Shapley energy for each request. A lightweight calibration model, JCalib, then learns to predict Shapley shares from cheap request features for use at serving time. Across 16 model/workload runs, token-proportional attribution differs from exact Shapley by 0.440 normalized L1 on average under static batching and by 0.458 under continuous batching, a gap that reproduces across three data-center GPUs. JCalib reduces this error to 0.116 under static batching and 0.177 under continuous batching, below even a standalone-measurement baseline that is unavailable online, while preserving exact batch-energy efficiency. Sampled Shapley extends the measured reference to larger group sizes, where the gap persists and a single offline calibration remains the most accurate deployable rule. The results show that token attribution is not a reliable proxy for marginal energy under batched execution, and that measured Shapley ground truth can calibrate low-cost request features toward fairer attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JouleShare框架，解决批量LLM推理服务中请求级能量归因问题。通过离线回放建立Shapley能量真值基准，并训练轻量级校准模型JCalib在服务时预测Shapley份额，显著优于传统的token比例归因方法。
AI.motivation: 批量LLM服务虽然提高了吞吐量，但使能量核算复杂化——GPU功率遥测是聚合的，而可持续性报告、费用回收和工作负载分析需要请求级能量分摊。现有基准只报告模型级、阶段级或token级能量，缺乏可测量的请求级真值，导致实践中使用的核算规则与公平分配之间的偏差一直未知。
AI.method: JouleShare包含两个组件：(1) 离线测试平台，通过vLLM回放请求子集、整合GPU功率遥测、计算每个请求的精确Shapley能量，建立真值；(2) 轻量级校准模型JCalib，从廉价请求特征学习预测Shapley份额，用于服务时推理。
AI.result: 在16个模型/工作负载运行中，token比例归因与精确Shapley的平均归一化L1误差在静态批处理下为0.440，连续批处理下为0.458，且跨三种数据中心GPU可复现。JCalib将误差降至静态0.116、连续0.177，甚至优于在线不可用的独立测量基线，同时保持精确的批处理能量效率。
AI.conclusion: token归因不能作为批量执行下边际能量的可靠代理；通过测量的Shapley真值校准低成本请求特征，可以实现更公平的能量归因。

title: Inference-Time Policy Alignment for Fair Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026. 13 pages main + appendix, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents achieve strong performance by optimizing scalar reward functions. However, once deployed, the policies of these RL agents are often rigid and costly to adapt to new performance criteria. For instance, an agent trained to maximize expected cumulative reward may not accommodate previously unknown stakeholder preferences. Existing approaches to achieve fairness, a type of preference, in RL typically assume that such preferences are known a priori and require complete retraining of the policy under a fairness-oriented metric. Inspired by inference-time alignment in large language models, we investigate the problem of steering a pretrained RL policy toward welfare-based fairness objectives at inference time without updating the base policy's parameters. We formalize inference-time fairness alignment as a policy shaping problem and propose a multiplicative policy shaping framework that adjusts action probabilities using action-dependent welfare scores, thus requiring no modification to the base policy. Our framework is general and compatible with any deep RL agent. Through extensive experiments across multiple domains, we demonstrate that inference-time policy shaping substantially improves welfare-based fairness objectives while preserving core task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种推理时公平性对齐框架，通过乘法策略塑形调整动作概率，无需更新预训练强化学习智能体的参数即可实现基于福利的公平目标，并在多个领域验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习智能体在部署后难以适应新的性能标准（如公平性偏好），传统方法假设偏好预先已知且需要完全重新训练策略，成本高昂且不灵活。
AI.method: 将推理时公平性对齐形式化为策略塑形问题，提出乘法策略塑形框架，利用与动作相关的福利分数调整动作概率，不修改基础策略参数，且与任何深度RL智能体兼容。
AI.result: 在多个领域的广泛实验中，推理时策略塑形显著改善了基于福利的公平性目标，同时保持了核心任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理时策略塑形是一种通用且有效的方案，能够在无需重新训练的情况下将公平性偏好融入预训练RL策略，为LLM推理时对齐思想在RL领域的迁移提供了成功范例。

title: Cross-Task Dissociation in Frontier Vision-Language Model Theory of Mind
summary: Do frontier vision-language models present a coherent Theory-of-Mind (ToM) profile across tasks, matching the same human reference group, or does that profile fragment from one paradigm to the next? We evaluate a shared panel of nine frontier VLMs on two psychology-derived benchmarks: the Keysar Director Task (visual perspective-taking under egocentric interference) and the Frith-Happé animated triangles scored with the Castelli rubric (intention attribution from pure motion). On the Director Task, without chain-of-thought, the panel makes the egocentric error on 78\% of trials like children rather than adults; variation is substantial across models, and reasoning rescues several models. On the triangles, the panel under-attributes intention: its ToM profile sits more than three times closer to the high-functioning-autistic-adult (HF-ASD) mean than to the typical-development-adult (TD) mean, while Goal-Directed and Random stay near TD. No model is nearest TD on both tasks; the model that looks adult-like on the Director Task falls on the HF-ASD side on the triangles, and the most TD-like model on the triangles is child-like on the Director Task. We report group-level descriptions, not diagnostic labels for any model.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了九个前沿视觉语言模型（VLMs）在两个心理学范式任务（Keysar导演任务和Frith-Happé动画三角任务）中的心智理论（ToM）表现。结果显示，这些模型的表现是碎片化的：没有一个模型能在两个任务上都接近典型发育成人（TD）的参照标准，模型在导演任务上表现出儿童式的自我中心错误，在三角任务上则更接近高功能自闭症成人的意图归因模式。
AI.motivation: 探究前沿视觉语言模型是否在跨任务中呈现一致的、与同一人类参照组匹配的心智理论（ToM）画像，还是说这种画像会因任务范式不同而碎片化。这一问题是评估多模态模型社会认知能力的核心。
AI.method: 选取九个前沿VLM构成共享模型面板，在两个心理学基准任务上评估：（1）Keysar导演任务，测试视觉视角采择能力（在自我中心干扰下的表现）；（2）Frith-Happé动画三角任务，使用Castelli评分量表评估从纯运动信息中的意图归因。比较模型表现与儿童、典型发育成人（TD）、高功能自闭症成人（HF-ASD）三类人类参照组。
AI.result: 在导演任务中，无思维链（CoT）提示时，模型面板在78%的试验中犯自我中心错误，类似儿童而非成人；不同模型间差异显著，推理能挽救多个模型。在三角任务中，模型整体对意图归属不足，其ToM画像距HF-ASD均值比TD均值近三倍以上，而目标导向和随机运动归因接近TD。没有任何模型在两个任务上都最接近TD；在导演任务上表现成人化的模型在三角任务上落在HF-ASD一侧，而三角任务上最像TD的模型在导演任务上表现如儿童。
AI.conclusion: 前沿VLM的心智理论能力在任务间呈碎片化而非一致性表现，没有任何单一模型能跨两个范式维持一致的成人式ToM画像。研究仅提供群体层面的描述性发现，而非对任何模型给出诊断标签。

title: K-space Gaussian Representation for Parallel MRI
summary: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) aims to recover the k-space signal from acquired measurements, where accurate estimation of missing samples is essential for high-fidelity reconstruction. Existing k-space reconstruction methods estimate missing samples through interpolation operators or structure priors defined on discrete sampling grids. Although these formulations effectively exploit local interpolation relationships and global k-space redundancy, they reconstruct only discrete frequency coefficients and therefore do not explicitly model the underlying continuous signal. To overcome this limitation, we propose K-space Gaussian Representation (KGR), the first explicit continuous representation formulated directly in the native k-space domain. Rather than estimating unknown samples on discrete grids, KGR parameterizes the continuous signal using Gabor-Gaussian primitives with shared spatial geometry, yielding a compact representation that naturally preserves inter-coil correlations. Because unconstrained continuous fitting does not necessarily satisfy the intrinsic structural properties of multi-coil signal, the estimated representation is projected onto a low-rank manifold to enforce the algebraic constraints arising from smoothly varying phase and coil redundancy. A frequency-adaptive fitting strategy accommodates the heterogeneous characteristics of different k-space regions. Comprehensive validation across multiple datasets and sampling schemes shows consistent improvements over representative reconstruction baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. These results suggest that explicit continuous parameterization of native k-space provides a principled framework for integrating continuous signal modeling with structured low-rank reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KGR（K空间高斯表示），这是首个直接在原生k空间域构建的显式连续表示方法，用于加速MRI重建。KGR使用Gabor-Gaussian原语参数化连续信号，并通过低秩流形投影保持多线圈间结构约束，配合频率自适应拟合策略，在多个数据集和采样方案上取得了优于现有方法的定量和定性结果。
AI.motivation: 现有k空间重建方法主要在离散采样网格上估计缺失样本，仅重建离散频率系数，无法显式建模底层连续信号。尽管这些方法利用了局部插值关系和全局冗余性，但缺乏对连续信号结构的显式建模，限制了重建精度的进一步提升。
AI.method: 1) 提出KGR，使用Gabor-Gaussian原语在原生k空间域参数化连续信号，并利用共享空间几何保持线圈间相关性；2) 将无约束的连续拟合结果投影到低秩流形上，以强制执行平滑相位和线圈冗余带来的代数约束；3) 采用频率自适应拟合策略以适配k空间不同区域（如低频和高频）的异质特性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种采样方案下的综合验证表明，KGR在定量指标和视觉质量上均优于代表性的重建基线方法，显示出显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式的原生k空间连续参数化为结合连续信号建模与结构化低秩重建提供了原则性框架，验证了从离散估计转向连续表示的可行性和优越性。

title: Exploring More to Solve More: Boosting Diversity in Text Diffusion Models via Entropy-Based Guidance
summary: Although diffusion models have revolutionized continuous domains like image synthesis through high quality generations and controllable guidance mechanisms, bringing this controllability to the discrete, sequential nature of text remains an open challenge. Meanwhile, current sampling strategies and guidance methods adjust token likelihoods without capturing the broader semantic landscape, leading to a suboptimal balance between fidelity and diversity. In this work, we introduce a novel training-free Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy (SAKE) guidance method. Our method computes the order-2 Rényi entropy over a kernel Gram matrix that captures both cross-token semantic interactions and relative token positions. By linearizing this objective in the embedding space, we derive a tractable guidance signal that dynamically adjusts the sampling distribution, flattening it to encourage exploration during redundancy and sharpening it for fidelity when diverse. Empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a superior Pareto frontier between fidelity and diversity, and improves multi-sample performance on reasoning-intensive tasks, such as code and mathematics generation, compared to temperature scaling and discrete guidance baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为SAKE（语义感知核熵）的训练无关引导方法，通过核Gram矩阵计算二阶Rényi熵，在嵌入空间中捕捉跨token语义交互和相对位置信息，从而动态调整采样分布，实现文本生成中保真度与多样性的更优平衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在连续域（如图像生成）已通过可控引导机制取得突破，但将这种可控性迁移到离散序列的文本生成仍是开放挑战。现有采样策略和引导方法仅调整token似然，未能捕捉更广泛的语义景观，导致保真度与多样性之间难以达到最优平衡。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的SAKE引导方法：1) 构造核Gram矩阵以捕获跨token语义交互和相对位置信息；2) 在该矩阵上计算order-2 Rényi熵作为目标；3) 在嵌入空间中对目标进行线性化处理，推导出可解的引导信号；4) 利用该信号动态调整采样分布——在冗余时展平分布以鼓励探索，在多样时锐化分布以保证保真度。
AI.result: 实验表明，SAKE在保真度与多样性之间实现了更优的Pareto前沿，并在推理密集型任务（如代码和数学生成）的多样本性能上优于温度缩放和离散引导基线。
AI.conclusion: SAKE通过语义感知的熵引导，为文本生成提供了一种无需训练的、可动态调节采样分布的引导机制，有效改善了保真度与多样性的权衡，特别在推理密集型生成任务中展现出显著优势。

title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
comment: 9 pages of main text, 8 pages of appendix, 6 figures. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: Motif-Mamba是一种结构化状态空间模型，通过在Mamba中引入受三节点网络基序启发的低秩循环通路，增强状态维度间的显式交互，同时保持线性时间复杂度，在长序列外推、语言建模和脑机接口解码任务上均优于Mamba基线。
AI.motivation: Mamba虽然通过选择性状态空间递归实现了线性时间复杂度的长序列建模，但其状态转移矩阵主要是对角形式的，限制了状态维度之间的显式交互，这可能是其表达能力的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Motif-Mamba，在Mamba中增加一个受三节点网络基序动力学启发的低秩循环通路：先将隐状态投影到低维动力学子空间，施加基序引导的交互，再将动力学结果映射回原始状态空间，从而增强跨维度通信并保持线性递归结构。
AI.result: 在长序列外推、语言建模基准和脑机接口解码等实验上，Motif-Mamba相比Mamba骨干网络均展现出一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基序引导的低秩动力学为长序列建模提供了一种有效的结构先验，验证了在状态空间模型中引入显式跨维度交互的价值。

title: AutoCause: A Python framework that automates expert decisions in environmental time-series causal discovery
comment: 33 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software
summary: Environmental time-series causal discovery requires expert decisions about method choice, conditional-independence tests, lag horizons, sample-size adequacy, multiple-testing control, and evidence interpretation. Applied inconsistently across datasets, these choices yield graphs that cannot be compared, reproduced, or audited. We present AutoCause, an open-source Python workflow that records each decision, derives defaults from an extended causal-audit module, and admits domain-informed overrides. The workflow wraps four established causal-discovery methods from three families, adds non-causal reference models, and grades links by method-count support. On 145 datasets from DGP-Atlas, TimeGraph, and a topology-derived CausalRivers reference, the methods recover complementary parts of the reference graphs. Majority-supported links are more precise than single-method links on the synthetic benchmarks but not against river topology. AutoCause converts inconsistent expert practice into an auditable, repeatable analysis; causal interpretation remains with the analyst. Available at https://github.com/marcoruizrueda/autocause.

AI.tldr: AutoCause是一个开源Python工作流，通过记录每个专家决策、从扩展的因果审计模块推导默认值并允许领域知识覆盖，将环境时序因果发现中不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可复现的分析流程。它封装了三个家族的四种成熟因果发现方法，添加非因果参考模型，并根据方法计数支持对链接进行分级。在145个数据集上的评估显示，多数方法支持的链接在合成基准上比单方法链接更精确，但在河流拓扑上并非如此。
AI.motivation: 环境时序因果发现依赖于专家对方法选择、条件独立性检验、滞后范围、样本量充足性、多重检验控制和证据解释的决策，这些决策在不同数据集间应用不一致，导致生成图无法比较、复现或审计。
AI.method: AutoCause工作流：1) 记录每个决策步骤；2) 从扩展的因果审计模块推导默认参数；3) 允许领域知识覆盖；4) 封装四个来自三个家族的成熟因果发现方法；5) 添加非因果参考模型作为对照；6) 根据方法计数支持对因果链接进行分级（多数支持 vs 单方法支持）。
AI.result: 在来自DGP-Atlas、TimeGraph和拓扑推导的CausalRivers参考的145个数据集上评估，各方法恢复参考图的不同互补部分。多数方法支持的链接在合成基准上比单方法链接更精确，但在河流拓扑数据上并未显示这一优势。
AI.conclusion: AutoCause将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可复现的分析流程，但不能替代因果解释——因果解释仍由分析师负责。

title: Neural operator learning for collision-aware trajectory planning of spacecraft swarms
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Nature Machine Intelligence. Video abstract included as ancillary file
summary: Autonomous spacecraft swarms must plan fuel-efficient, collision-free maneuvers in increasingly congested orbits, yet classical trajectory optimization scales poorly as pairwise safety constraints multiply with swarm size, and learning-based planners rarely transfer across swarm sizes or debris densities. Here we introduce a permutation-equivariant neural operator that maps distributions of spacecraft, targets and debris to collision-aware trajectories for an entire swarm in a single forward pass, paired with a batched Gauss-Newton finish that enforces exact orbital dynamics. The operator is trained without optimal-trajectory labels, combining self-supervised physics objectives with adversarial threats generated against its own rollouts. Trained on ten spacecraft, it generalizes zero-shot to swarms of 1,000 amid more than 11,000 catalogued objects, matching a per-agent optimal-control solver's accuracy, evading worst-case threats that a debris-blind baseline cannot, and reducing proximity within the swarm several-fold. Physics-grounded operator learning thus offers a fast, scalable alternative to optimal control for crowded orbits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种置换等变的神经算子，可在单次前向传播中为整个航天器星群生成碰撞感知的轨迹规划，并通过批量高斯-牛顿精化强制执行精确轨道动力学。该算子无需最优轨迹标签，结合自监督物理目标与对抗威胁训练，从10个航天器零样本泛化到1000个航天器和11000多个编目物体的场景，达到最优控制求解器的精度并显著降低星群内部邻近度。
AI.motivation: 自主航天器星群在日益拥挤的轨道上需要规划燃料高效且无碰撞的机动，但经典轨迹优化因成对安全约束随星群规模成倍增长而扩展性差，学习式规划器又难以跨星群规模或碎片密度迁移。
AI.method: 提出一种置换等变神经算子，将航天器、目标和碎片的分布映射为整个星群的碰撞感知轨迹（单次前向传播）；配合批量高斯-牛顿精化来强制满足精确轨道动力学。训练无需最优轨迹标签，采用自监督物理目标与针对自身rollout生成的对抗威胁相结合。
AI.result: 在10个航天器上训练后，零样本泛化到1000个航天器和11000余个编目物体；匹配逐智能体最优控制求解器的精度，能躲避碎屑盲基线无法躲避的最坏情况威胁，并将星群内部邻近度降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: 物理驱动的算子学习为拥挤轨道中的最优控制提供了一种快速、可扩展的替代方案。

title: Which Modality Decides? Counterfactual Modality Attribution for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly support high-stakes decision making by combining complementary information from images and text. While existing explainability methods identify influential image regions or text tokens, they cannot answer a fundamental question: which modality drives a prediction? Consequently, a model may produce the correct output while relying on the wrong source of evidence, masking shortcut learning and unsafe reasoning. We formulate modality attribution as a complementary explainability objective for multimodal foundation models and propose Counterfactual Modality Attribution (CMA), the first framework for quantifying modality-level contributions in MLLMs. CMA generates image-only, text-only, and joint multimodal counterfactuals using coupled diffusion priors and converts them into principled modality attribution scores through a cooperative game-theoretic formulation based on Shapley values. We evaluate CMA on controlled synthetic benchmarks with known ground-truth modality reliance and on a real-world multimodal clinical dataset. CMA correctly identifies the decision-driving modality in 98% of controlled cases and consistently outperforms baselines, revealing failures of cross-modal reasoning that remain invisible to predictive accuracy alone. Our results establish modality attribution as a complementary dimension of explainability beyond feature attribution, providing a principled framework for auditing multimodal foundation models in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实模态归因（CMA）框架，首次量化多模态大语言模型中模态级别的贡献，通过耦合扩散先验生成反事实样本并结合Shapley值进行博弈论归因，在98%的受控案例中正确识别决策驱动模态。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法只能识别有影响力的图像区域或文本token，无法回答"哪个模态驱动了预测"这一根本性问题。模型可能在输出正确结果时依赖错误的证据来源，掩盖捷径学习和不安全推理，这在高风险决策场景中尤为危险。
AI.method: 提出Counterfactual Modality Attribution (CMA)框架：(1) 使用耦合扩散先验生成图像独有、文本独有和联合多模态三类反事实样本；(2) 基于Shapley值的合作博弈论公式将其转化为原则性的模态归因分数；(3) 在受控合成基准和真实临床多模态数据集上评估。
AI.result: CMA在98%的受控案例中正确识别决策驱动模态，持续优于基线方法，并揭示了仅靠预测准确率无法发现的跨模态推理失败。
AI.conclusion: 模态归因可作为超越特征归因的可解释性补充维度，为安全关键应用中审计多模态基础模型提供原则性框架。

title: SLMs as Multi-Agent Routers: A Progressive SFT and Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Specialised retrieval agents typically surface higher quality results than general-purpose search, but selecting the optimal agent for a given query remains an open problem. Current approaches route queries based on inferred topic or intent, however intent-based selection is fundamentally limited: it does not incorporate signal from retrieved content, and cannot detect when a topically aligned agent produces low-relevance results. We address this by training a small language model via supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning to jointly perform agent selection and structured parameter generation for downstream tool calls, using a hierarchical reward function grounded in retrieval relevance along with query-agent topic alignment. This enables the model to learn task-dependent agent suitability from retrieval performance: which agents reliably yield high-relevance results for which query distributions, and when to redirect queries away from specialised agents despite surface-level topical overlap. On a targeted subset of such agent-query mismatches, the trained model achieves an NDCG@10 of 0.918 compared to 0.539 and 0.490 for two LLM baselines (Amazon Nova Lite and Claude Haiku 4.5) that route on intent alone. Overall, it achieves a mean NDCG@10 of 0.771 (+0.177 over Nova Lite, +0.219 over Haiku) with a mean selection latency of 120.1ms, an 82.4% reduction over Nova Lite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过监督微调加强化学习训练一个小语言模型，联合执行检索智能体选择与工具调用参数生成，利用基于检索相关性和查询-智能体主题对齐的分层奖励函数，使模型能从检索性能中学习任务相关的智能体适用性。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于意图的检索智能体路由方法存在根本性局限：无法利用检索内容的信号，也无法检测主题匹配但检索结果低相关性的情况。需要一种能够从检索反馈中学习智能体选择的方法。
AI.method: 使用小语言模型，通过监督微调后再进行强化学习训练，联合完成智能体选择与下游工具调用的结构化参数生成。采用分层奖励函数，结合检索相关性与查询-智能体主题对齐信号。
AI.result: 在智能体-查询不匹配子集上NDCG@10达0.918（对比Nova Lite的0.539和Haiku 4.5的0.490）；整体平均NDCG@10为0.771（比Nova Lite高0.177，比Haiku高0.219），平均选择延迟120.1ms（比Nova Lite降低82.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效克服意图导向路由的局限性，通过学习检索性能信号来判断智能体适用性，在相关性和效率上均显著优于基于意图的LLM基线。

title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
summary: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: Nova 是一个自动化端到端JIT编译器，通过融合操作、优化内存层次和寄存器级调优来最大化硬件利用率。它利用Analytic Configurator（基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度，搜索时间为零）和结构哈希运行时，在12GB消费级GPU上实现了比PyTorch高10.6%的吞吐量，比XLA高4.4%，并将内存占用降低高达29%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型性能受限于高层张量框架（如PyTorch）与底层硬件之间的映射效率。现有框架的eager执行模式缺乏全局图可见性和对硬件/内存的细粒度控制，无法原生地最大化物理硬件利用率，需要一种能够弥合这一鸿沟的编译方案。
AI.method: Nova采用三层核心设计：(1) 捕获eager执行并将前向/反向传播统一到单一值语义方言中，实现全面的whole-graph优化；(2) Analytic Configurator基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度，消除搜索开销；(3) 结构哈希运行时直接从计算结构合成细粒度内核。
AI.result: 在RTX 3060上：TF32 matmul方面匹配或略超cuBLAS和XLA（误差<5e-4）；42M参数模型上吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%、比XLA高4.4%；内存占用比PyTorch降低达29%，成功在12GB GPU上以17,900 tokens/s训练144M参数模型（PyTorch在此场景OOM）。
AI.conclusion: Nova证明了通过确定性调度推导（而非搜索）和结构驱动内核合成，可以在不牺牲数值精度的前提下显著提升深度学习训练的性能和内存效率，使更大规模模型能在消费级GPU上训练。

title: A Physics-Chemistry-Informed Neural Network (PCINN) for Real-Time Spatial-ALD Coverage Prediction and Reliable Kinetics Inversion
summary:
Spatial atomic layer deposition (SALD) is a leading atmospheric-pressure, high-throughput route to industrial ALD, but design and control are limited by the cost of predicting surface coverage: high-fidelity CFD is far too slow for operating-window scans, while analytic models miss transport modulation such as the gas curtain. We present a physics-chemistry-informed neural network (PCINN), a hybrid surrogate with CFD-level accuracy at real-time speed: a query returns coverage in about 7 ms, roughly 5x10^4 times faster than a CFD solve, reaching a test R^2_log = 0.998 (leave-one-out R^2_raw = 0.974) from only 30 training cases spanning four orders of magnitude in coverage.
  The architecture is not a black box: a small network learns only the operating-condition to near-wall concentration closure, while the known surface kinetics is a hard-coded, trainable chemistry layer integrated along the substrate trajectory. This single-scalar bottleneck keeps it accurate under sparse data, interpretable and invertible.
  We add a full identifiability analysis (Fisher information, profile likelihood). The adsorption energy E_ads and desorption rate k_des are robustly identifiable; k_ads is not separately identifiable at a single temperature (only k_ads*c_wall is). Across four temperatures the prefactor nu and E_ads bind along a weakly identifiable degeneracy valley of slope 0.065 eV/decade, derived analytically as k_B T_eff ln(10) and turned into a reliability diagnostic: a seven-chemistry mismatch matrix shows it is invariant under any single-Arrhenius mismatch and shifts only when a second thermally activated process appears, so a slope departure flags unmodelled site heterogeneity.
  Data come from simulation with known ground truth inverted by the same kinetic form, so the study verifies pipeline self-consistency and the identifiability boundary, not real parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种物理化学信息神经网络（PCINN），作为空间原子层沉积（SALD）的混合代理模型，以约7毫秒的实时速度实现CFD级别精度（R²=0.998），比传统CFD快约5×10⁴倍，仅需30个训练案例。架构中神经网络只学习操作条件到近壁浓度的闭包，表面动力学则通过硬编码的化学层实现，保证可解释性和可逆性。论文还进行了完整的可辨识性分析（Fisher信息、剖面似然），发现吸附能E_ads和解吸速率k_des可靠可辨识，而k_ads在单温度下不可独立辨识，并推导出跨温度下指前因子nu与E_ads之间的弱可辨识退化谷（斜率0.065 eV/decade），作为未建模位点异质性的可靠性诊断工具。
AI.motivation: SALD是大气压、高通量的工业ALD主要路线，但其设计和控制受限于表面覆盖度的预测成本：高保真CFD过于缓慢无法用于操作窗口扫描，而解析模型无法捕捉气体帘幕等输运调制效应。需要一种兼具CFD精度和实时速度的代理模型。
AI.method: 采用物理化学信息神经网络（PCINN）混合代理架构：小规模神经网络仅学习操作条件到近壁浓度的映射闭包，已知的表面动力学作为硬编码的可训练化学层沿基板轨迹积分。通过单标量瓶颈保证稀疏数据下的准确性、可解释性和可逆性。同时进行完整的可辨识性分析，包括Fisher信息矩阵和剖面似然方法，并推导出热力学退化谷的理论斜率。
AI.result: 查询耗时约7毫秒，比CFD求解快约5×10⁴倍；测试R²_log=0.998（留一法R²_raw=0.974），仅需30个训练案例即可覆盖四个数量级的覆盖度范围。辨识性分析表明E_ads和k_des可稳健辨识，k_ads仅在组合k_ads*c_wall水平上可辨识。七化学失配矩阵证明退化谷斜率对任何单一Arrhenius失配不变，仅当第二个热激活过程出现时才偏移。
AI.conclusion: PCINN提供了一个兼具精度、速度、可解释性和可逆性的SALD表面覆盖度预测框架，并建立了一个基于参数退化谷斜率的可靠性诊断指标，可检测未建模的位点异质性。需注意数据来自已知真值的仿真，验证的是管道自洽性和可辨识性边界，而非真实工业参数。

title: HetGPS: Scalable Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Physics-Anchored Adaptive Safety for EV Charging
summary: Safety interventions for large populations of network-coupled agents must protect shared constraints without unnecessarily overriding task-oriented policy decisions. We present HetGPS, a hybrid graph-control framework synergizing learned graph risk with physics-anchored correction by separating intervention magnitude from corrective direction. An action-conditioned graph residual model schedules state-dependent intervention authority, while a physics model determines its direction. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, we couple this filter with a parameter-shared heterogeneous graph soft actor-critic policy, enabling topology-aware coordination with a learned model size independent of fleet size. Across five nested distribution networks with 200--3,218 EVs and 100 evaluation days, Adaptive Authority reduces bus--step voltage violations from 3.93--7.74\% without filtering to 0.52--3.44\%, while maintaining 99.06--100\% departure success. Relative to the same physics-directed projection with fixed authority, it improves mean reward on all five networks and lowers the mean safety score on four. The deployed policy-and-risk model contains 383,702 learned parameters at every scale; at 3,218 EVs, a matched centralized SAC actor is about $170\times$ larger. A policy trained on the eight-transformer system transfers zero-shot to the 16- and 32-transformer systems, attaining 0.57--0.75\% violation rates and at least 99.99\% departure success. These results show that learned graph risk can allocate intervention authority at scale while feeder physics anchors corrective action.

AI.tldr: HetGPS是一个混合图控制框架，用于大规模网络耦合智能体的安全干预，通过解耦干预幅度与修正方向，结合学习图风险与物理锚定校正，在电动汽车充电场景中显著降低电压违规率，同时保持高出发成功率，且模型规模与车队规模无关。
AI.motivation: 大规模网络耦合智能体的安全干预需要在保护共享约束的同时，不过度覆盖任务导向的策略决策。现有方法难以在规模可扩展性与安全性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出HetGPS混合图控制框架，核心思想是将干预幅度与修正方向解耦：动作条件图残差模型负责调度状态相关的干预权限（幅度），物理模型决定修正方向。在电动汽车充电场景中，结合参数共享的异构图soft actor-critic策略，实现拓扑感知协调，且学习模型大小不随车队规模增长。
AI.result: 在5个嵌套配电网（200-3,218辆EV）和100天评估中，Adaptive Authority将母线-步电压违规率从3.93-7.74%降至0.52-3.44%，出发成功率保持99.06-100%。相比固定权限的物理定向投影，在所有5个网络上平均奖励提升，4个网络上安全评分降低。模型仅383,702个参数，而3,218辆EV的集中式SAC actor约为其170倍。训练于8变压器系统可直接零样本迁移到16和32变压器系统。
AI.conclusion: 学习图风险可以在大规模上有效分配干预权限，而馈线物理模型锚定修正动作。HetGPS证明了将安全干预的"何时干预"（学习）与"如何干预"（物理）解耦是一种高效的范式。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Auditing Spatial Provenance in Visual Token Pruning for OCR-Critical MLLM Inference
comment: 21 pages, including supplementary material. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/SouthWinter/spatial-provenance-audit
summary: Visual-token pruning is usually judged by answer quality at a fixed retention budget. For text-rich multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this protocol can miss a distinct failure: an answer remains correct even when no retained token is locally traceable to the small OCR region that supports it. We turn this blind spot into an evidence-risk audit that couples answer behavior with geometric token-origin provenance, interventions, and realized cost; transparent training-free selectors isolate controlled operating points. On locked image-disjoint confirmation, Qwen Target at 30% retention has observed accuracy 0.786 versus 0.783 for Full (paired image-cluster difference +0.003, 95% CI [-0.014, +0.020]), yet same-budget Target, Random, and Grid retain sharply different positive-support coverage: 0.620, 0.270, and 0.318. Across Qwen3-VL-8B, LLaVA-1.5-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B, matched controls, interventions, detector tests, and external methods reveal model-specific quality-risk-traceability frontiers that accuracy alone does not expose. Materialized prefixes yield up to 4.32x batch-prefill speedup and 76.4% lower incremental peak memory; full-validation TextVQA and DocVQA further show that favorable target-verification points do not imply task-general compression. Visual-token pruning should therefore report surviving spatial provenance and realized cost alongside quality and compression.

AI.tldr: 本文针对文本密集型多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中视觉token剪枝的评估盲点，提出"证据风险审计"框架，将答案行为与几何token来源溯源、干预手段和实际成本相结合，揭示仅靠准确率无法暴露的质量-风险-可追溯性权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉token剪枝评估只看固定保留预算下的答案质量，但忽略了关键失败模式：即使所有保留的token都无法局部追溯到支撑答案的小型OCR区域，答案仍然可以正确。这种"依赖盲点"会导致剪枝方法看似有效实则不可靠，需要更全面的审计框架。
AI.method: 提出证据风险审计方法，将答案行为与几何token来源溯源（provenance）、干预测试和实际成本相结合；使用无训练的透明选择器隔离受控操作点；在锁定且图像不相交的确认集上评估，并在多个模型（Qwen3-VL-8B、LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL3.5-8B）上对比匹配控制组、干预组、检测器测试和外部方法。
AI.result: 在Qwen Target模型30%保留率下，观测准确率0.786与Full模型0.783相当（配对图像簇差异+0.003，95% CI [-0.014,+0.020]），但同预算下Target、Random和Grid策略的正支持覆盖率差异显著（0.620 vs 0.270 vs 0.318）。物化前缀最高实现4.32倍批预填充加速和76.4%更低的增量峰值内存；TextVQA和DocVQA全验证显示有利的target验证点并不意味任务通用压缩。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token剪枝评估应同时报告存活的视觉token空间来源溯源和实际成本，而不仅是质量和压缩率。准确率本身无法揭示模型特有的质量-风险-可追溯性前沿面，需要更全面的评估协议。

title: XL-DocBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Extra-Long Document Understanding
summary: Real-world document tasks often ask professionals to answer questions from annual reports, regulations, clinical guidelines, and technical manuals that span hundreds or thousands of pages. Some questions also require comparing related reports. Reliable long-document understanding is therefore a prerequisite for using LLMs in compliance, clinical, financial, and engineering workflows, where decisions must be traceable to specific evidence pages and the cost of an unsupported answer is high -- yet most existing benchmarks still measure short-context or single-page QA. We introduce XL-DocBench, a fully human-verified benchmark for extra-long document understanding, with 1,519 retained questions from six professional domains and contexts up to 2,303 pages. XL-DocBench goes beyond page-level lookup. 1,103 examples (72.6\%) use multiple evidence pages. The final set also includes 556 questions (36.6\%) that use tables, charts, or figures, and 165 questions (10.9\%) that require evidence from multiple documents. Each question has one of twelve reasoning labels, expert-annotated evidence pages, a typed verification rule, and an answer format, including 218 None-answer cases. We build the benchmark with a tree-guided synthesis pipeline followed by artifact filters and full verification by 194 human experts. By coupling extra-long professional contexts with page-level evidence and typed rules, XL-DocBench fills a gap left by prior single-page, short multi-page, or text-only long-context benchmarks, and lets future work attribute system failures to retrieval, evidence use, or rule following rather than to a single leaderboard score. The results show that current systems still struggle with long contexts, multi-page evidence, and structured reasoning over professional documents.

AI.tldr: XL-DocBench是一个全新的、完全人工验证的超长文档理解基准测试，包含1,519个来自六个专业领域的问题，上下文长度可达2,303页。它超越了单页查找，72.6%的问题需要多页证据，36.6%涉及表格/图表/图形，10.9%需要跨文档证据，并包含12种推理标签、专家标注的证据页和类型化验证规则（含218个无答案案例）。当前系统在此基准上仍表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的专业文档任务（合规、临床、金融、工程）涉及数百至数千页的文档，需要可追溯到具体证据页的可靠理解。然而现有大多数基准仍局限于短上下文或单页QA，无法反映真实场景中长文档、多页证据和结构化推理的需求，因此需要一个填补这一空白的基准来推动长文档理解研究。
AI.method: 作者构建了XL-DocBench，采用树引导的合成流水线（tree-guided synthesis pipeline)生成问题，随后通过人工制品过滤器（artifact filters）和194名人类专家的全面验证来确保质量。每个问题包含12种推理标签之一、专家标注的证据页、类型化验证规则和答案格式，专门设计了多页证据、多文档证据和包含表格/图表/图形的问题类型。
AI.result: 实验结果显示当前系统在长上下文、多页证据以及专业文档的结构化推理方面仍然存在显著困难，尤其在需要多文档比较和涉及图表结构化推理的任务上表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: XL-DocBench通过将超长专业上下文与页面级证据和类型化规则相结合，填补了先前单页、短多页或纯文本长上下文基准留下的空白。它允许未来研究将系统故障归因于检索、证据使用或规则遵循，而不是单一的总分指标，为长文档理解领域的系统诊断和改进提供了更精细的评估工具。

title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
summary:
SIRIN (Semantic Inconsistency Recognition and Inspection Nexus) is a unified toolkit and interactive web UI for detecting contextual hallucinations (fluent, plausible responses unsupported by the provided evidence) in retrieval-augmented, agentic, and memory-grounded LLM systems. SIRIN unifies three detector paradigms (representation probing, uncertainty estimation, and judge-style verification) and the complementary task of pre-generation query answerability under one interface, configuration system, and evaluation pipeline, supporting response- and span-level inspection in both white-box and black-box settings. The web UI enables live analysis of user-supplied context-query-answer triples through hallucination scores, unsupported-span highlighting, and side-by-side detector comparison, with a lightweight plug-in design for adding new detectors. We demonstrate SIRIN on hallucination detection, query answerability, and as a faithfulness gate within long-term memory systems.
  The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sb-ai-lab/SIRIN.

AI.tldr: SIRIN是一个统一的工具包和交互式Web界面，用于检测检索增强生成（RAG）、智能体和基于记忆的LLM系统中的上下文幻觉（即流畅但缺乏证据支持的响应）。它统一了三种检测器范式（表示探测、不确定性估计和评判式验证），并集成了生成前查询可回答性任务，支持白盒和黑盒设置下的响应级和跨度级检查。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在检索增强、智能体和记忆接地系统中经常产生上下文幻觉——即流畅、看似合理但缺乏证据支持的响应。现有的检测方法分散在不同范式（表示探测、不确定性估计、评判式验证）中，缺乏统一的接口、配置系统和评估流水线，难以在实际系统中进行综合比较和部署。
AI.method: SIRIN通过统一接口将三种检测器范式（表示探测、不确定性估计和评判式验证）整合在一起，同时支持生成前查询可回答性任务。它提供响应级和跨度级检查，支持白盒和黑盒两种设置，并配有交互式Web UI，可实时分析用户提供的上下文-查询-答案三元组，包括幻觉评分、不支持跨度高亮和并排检测器比较。设计采用轻量级插件架构，便于添加新检测器。
AI.result: 作者在幻觉检测、查询可回答性以及作为长期记忆系统中的忠实度门控三个任务上展示了SIRIN的应用。源代码已在GitHub上公开。
AI.conclusion: SIRIN提供了一个统一且可扩展的工具包和交互式界面，能够有效检测和检查LLM系统中的上下文幻觉，并在多种系统场景下验证了其实用性。

title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
summary: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability. The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于可验证奖励的在线强化学习（RLVR）在提升当前任务目标的同时，会重塑策略的支撑分布（支持集），导致后续任务的成功轨迹变得过于稀有而无法采样和强化。作者称之为"验证器诱导的支撑重塑"（verifier-induced support reshaping），并通过数学推理和指令跟随的交叉训练实验验证了这一现象。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLVR研究主要关注单任务终点指标的提升，但忽视了其在优化当前目标时对策略分布造成的副作用——即"杀鸡取卵"式的支持集坍塌，使得后续学习或联合能力受损。理解这一机制对可扩展的智能体对齐与持续训练至关重要。
AI.method: 定义"有效可奖励支撑"（effective rewardable support）为在固定rollout预算内可达的成功轨迹集合。采用双向训练设计：Math-RLVR后接IFEval验证器，IF-RLVR后接数学验证器，并在两个模型家族上反复进行验证器打分采样，结合token分布分析和受控的答案开头（opening）干预实验来定位变化来源。
AI.result: Math-RLVR提高平均指令跟随成功率但降低重复采样下存在任何成功响应的提示数量。Qwen3-8B-Base上pass@1提升6.5个百分点而best@32下降9.8个百分点。IF-RLVR使数学响应从逐步解答转向直接答案，降低各采样预算下的best@k。变化集中在开头几个token，RLVR主要对基础策略已有的开头进行重排序。参考策略约束、路由先验和在线蒸馏仅部分保留跨任务支撑。
AI.conclusion: 终点指标的提升并不能保证未来的可训练性或联合能力。RLVR所带来的支撑重塑是一种需要警惕的系统性风险，仅靠部分缓解策略（如参考策略约束、路由先验、蒸馏）不能完全维持跨任务支持，设计RLVR算法时需要同时考虑对策略分布支撑空间的长期影响。

title: Co-evolution of social reward and punishment under institutional interventions
summary: We investigate how peer and institutional incentives jointly shape the evolution of cooperation, social welfare, and enforcement efficiency in social dilemmas. In a Prisoners Dilemma with four strategies, unconditional cooperators (C), defectors (D), social punishers (SP), and social rewarders (SR), we allow decentralised peer incentives and centralised institutional incentives to act simultaneously, with the institution able to reward or punish any subset of strategies. In infinite well-mixed populations, we analyse the resulting four-strategy replicator dynamics, and in structured populations we use agent-based simulations on square lattices to study spatial effects and network reciprocity. Intervention schemes are evaluated by equilibrium states and evolutionary flow for infinite well-mixed populations, by cooperation levels and social welfare for structured populations, defined as aggregate population payoff net of institutional cost. We find that peer punishment most strongly promotes cooperation, whereas peer reward is more beneficial for social welfare. Institutionally rewarding peer incentive strategies substantially improves both cooperation and welfare, while subsidising unconditional cooperators has little impact. Under institutional punishment, directly penalising defectors is the only consistently effective policy; punishing peer incentive strategies dismantles decentralised incentives, reduces cooperation, and harms social welfare, showing that maximising cooperation does not necessarily optimise overall societal benefit. Our findings provide design principles for institutions seeking to balance cooperation promotion with welfare maximisation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究同伴激励与制度激励如何共同影响社会困境中的合作演化、社会福利和执法效率。在包含四种策略（C、D、SP、SR）的囚徒困境中，允许分散同伴激励与集中制度激励同时作用。研究发现同伴惩罚最能促进合作，同伴奖励更有利于社会福利；制度性奖励同伴激励策略能显著提升合作与福利，而制度性惩罚直接针对背叛者才有效，惩罚同伴激励策略反而破坏合作并损害社会福利。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多单独考察同伴激励或制度激励，缺乏对两者共同作用如何影响合作演化与福利的系统性分析。理解不同激励组合对合作水平和整体社会效益的影响，对于现实制度设计具有重要指导意义。
AI.method: 在无限混合均匀种群中分析四策略复制者动力学，在结构化种群中使用方格晶格上的基于智能体的模拟来研究空间效应和网络互惠。通过均衡状态和演化流评估无限种群，通过合作水平和社会福利（总种群收益扣除制度成本）评估结构化种群。
AI.result: 同伴惩罚最能促进合作，同伴奖励对福利更有利；制度性奖励同伴激励策略（SP/SR）显著提升合作与福利，而补贴无条件合作者效果甚微；制度惩罚下，直接惩罚背叛者是最有效且唯一持续有效的政策，惩罚同伴激励策略会破坏分散激励、降低合作并损害社会福利。
AI.conclusion: 最大化合作不必然等同于优化整体社会效益；为制度设计者提供了关于制度激励与同伴激励如何协调配合的设计原则，以实现合作促进与福利最大化的平衡。

title: Device-First Feedback: Toward Mobile-Native LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
summary: Deploying convolutional neural networks generated by large language models (LLMs) on real mobile hardware requires more than GPU validation accuracy: INT8 TensorFlow Lite export, delegate selection, and on-device latency jointly determine whether a model is usable. We present an automated mobile deployment pipeline that closes the loop from QLoRA fine-tuning of an architecture-generating LLM through GPU evaluation, INT8 export, and physical-device benchmarking to gated augmentation of the training corpus. The pipeline is fully scripted and runs cycle-by-cycle without manual intervention, with resume support after interruptions. We evaluate the same frozen protocol on two benchmarks, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, on a Samsung SM-P613 tablet (seed 42, 20 models per cycle, cycles 0-6). On CIFAR-10, cycle 1 is gate-accepted and improves the mobile deployment score approximately 25.6x over the baseline with a mean quantized accuracy of 46.9%; later cycles raise GPU accuracy but fail the non-decreasing mobile gate. On CIFAR-100, the pre-QLoRA baseline retains the best mobile score; iterative rounds improve GPU accuracy (up to 26.2%) yet cannot surpass cycle 0 on-device, and the training pool stalls at 19 examples after the first accepted round. Together, the two studies show that closed-loop GPU fine-tuning does not guarantee monotonic mobile gains, especially on harder classification tasks, and that multi-dataset, on-device measurement is needed to stress-test deployment objectives. We release per-cycle metrics with 95% confidence intervals, all figures, and complete reproduction commands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一条从LLM生成CNN架构到真实移动设备部署的全自动化流水线，涵盖QLoRA微调、GPU评估、INT8导出和物理设备基准测试的闭环迭代。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验表明，闭环GPU微调并不能保证移动端指标的单调提升，尤其在更难的任务上，需要多数据集、真机上的测量来检验部署目标。
AI.motivation: 将LLM生成的CNN部署到真实移动硬件上，仅验证GPU精度是不够的——INT8 TensorFlow Lite导出、代理选择和在设备上的延迟共同决定模型是否可用。现有方法缺乏从模型生成到真机部署的闭环自动化验证，导致生成架构在移动端的实用性无法得到保证。
AI.method: 构建全自动化的移动部署流水线，实现从QLoRA微调架构生成LLM、GPU评估、INT8导出、物理设备基准测试到对训练语料进行门控增强的完整闭环。流水线完全脚本化，支持逐周期运行和中断恢复，在三星SM-P613平板上按固定协议（seed 42，每周期20个模型，周期0-6）进行评测。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上，周期1的门控通过，移动部署分数较基线提升约25.6倍，平均量化精度46.9%；后续周期提升GPU精度但未通过非递减移动端门控。CIFAR-100上，QLoRA前基线保留最佳移动分数，迭代轮次提升GPU精度最多26.2%但无法超越周期0的真机表现，训练池在首次接受后停滞于19个样本。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明闭环GPU微调并不保证移动端增益的单调性，尤其在更难的任务上。需要结合多数据集和真实设备测量来验证部署目标。作者发布了每个周期的指标（含95%置信区间）、全部图表和完整复现命令。

title: Trustworthiness Costs of Domain Adaptation in Small Language Models:A Cross-Architecture Empirical Study
comment: 13 pages, 7 tables, 2 appendices (Reproducibility Checklist; Software and Data Availability). Code, model checkpoints, and datasets publicly available at https://github.com/rbpdlf/slm-trw
summary: Domain adaptation of small language models (SLMs) has emerged as a practical strategy for deploying capable NLP systems in resource-constrained, high-stakes environments including healthcare, legal services, and financial analysis. While performance gains from parameter-efficient fine-tuning are well characterised, the corresponding impact on trustworthiness (factual calibration and adversarial robustness) remains poorly understood. This paper presents the first systematic cross-domain, cross-architecture empirical study quantifying the trustworthiness cost of domain adaptation across three SLM architectures (TinyLlama 1B, Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), three domains (healthcare, legal, finance), two training-data conditions (benign and adversarially perturbed), and four fine-tuning strategies (baseline LoRA, Safety-DPO, Dark Experience Replay, and Task Arithmetic LoRA, TA-LoRA). Trustworthiness is evaluated through TruthfulQA MC2 (factual calibration) and HarmBench ASR (adversarial robustness) across all 216 experimental configurations with three random seeds. Three principal findings emerge. First, baseline QLoRA domain adaptation produces minimal TruthfulQA MC2 change across all model-domain combinations (mean |Delta TQA| < 0.02). Second, adversarially perturbed training data consistently improves domain adaptation quality (Delta loss approximately -0.040) without worsening trustworthiness benchmarks. Third, none of the three safety-preserving strategies reduced adversarial harm susceptibility: Safety-DPO was effectively neutral (mean Delta ASR < 0.001), while Dark ER and TA-LoRA increased mean HarmBench ASR by +0.171 and +0.155 respectively in safety-aligned models (Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), with individual configurations exceeding +0.45. These results challenge the assumption that replay-based and arithmetic-merge strategies transfer alignment to domain-adapted SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对小型语言模型（SLMs）领域自适应中的可信度代价进行了系统性跨领域、跨架构实证研究，覆盖3种架构、3个领域、2种训练数据条件和4种微调策略共216种实验配置，发现基线QLoRA对事实校准影响极小、对抗扰动数据反而提升适配质量且不损害可信度，但安全保持策略（Safety-DPO、Dark ER、TA-LoRA）均未能有效降低对抗危害敏感性。
AI.motivation: 虽然参数高效微调（PEFT）在SLM领域自适应中能带来性能提升，但其对可信度（事实校准和对抗鲁棒性）的影响尚不明确。在高风险场景（医疗、法律、金融）中部署SLM时，理解领域自适应的可信度代价至关重要。
AI.method: 在3种SLM架构（TinyLlama 1B、Gemma-2 2B、Llama 3.2 1B）× 3个领域（医疗、法律、金融）× 2种训练数据条件（良性、对抗扰动）× 4种微调策略（基线LoRA、Safety-DPO、Dark Experience Replay、Task Arithmetic LoRA）共216种配置下，使用TruthfulQA MC2评估事实校准、HarmBench ASR评估对抗鲁棒性，每种配置使用3个随机种子。
AI.result: 三大发现：(1) 基线QLoRA领域自适应仅产生极小的TruthfulQA MC2变化（平均|Delta TQA| < 0.02）；(2) 对抗扰动训练数据一致提升领域适配质量（Delta loss ≈ -0.040）且不恶化可信度基准；(3) Safety-DPO近乎中立（平均Delta ASR < 0.001），但Dark ER和TA-LoRA分别使安全对齐模型的HarmBench ASR平均增加+0.171和+0.155，个别配置超过+0.45。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了"基于重放和算术合并的策略能将对齐能力迁移到领域自适应SLM"这一假设，表明现有安全保持策略在领域自适应场景下效果有限，需要重新设计更可靠的可信度保持方法。

title: Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）中语言提示会引发视觉表征的动态重编码，表现为两种具体机制：抽象参考表征（通过对比转向向量识别目标相关对象，且可跨对象、跨任务、跨域泛化）和属性调制（后期层选择性放大视觉表征中的目标相关属性），并通过因果干预验证了属性调制在模型响应分布中的中介作用。
AI.motivation: 以往研究大多将VLM中的视觉表征视为静态的信息存储库，由语言表征直接操作。本文质疑这一静态观点，希望探究语言目标如何主动重塑视觉表征，从而更准确地理解跨模态处理机制。
AI.method: 1) 识别抽象参考表征：提取对应于自然语言提示下目标相关对象的对比转向向量（contrastive steering vectors）；2) 验证这些参考表征的抽象性（跨对象、跨任务上下文、从合成到自然图像泛化）；3) 展示语言诱导的属性调制：后期层选择性放大视觉表征中的目标相关属性；4) 通过因果干预证明属性调制中介了VLM的响应分布。
AI.result: 1) 对比转向向量在模型预测中具有因果关系；2) 参考表征具有跨对象、跨任务和从合成到自然图像的强泛化能力；3) 后期层确实选择性地放大目标相关属性；4) 因果干预表明属性调制中介了VLM的响应分布。
AI.conclusion: VLM中的视觉表征并非静态信息库，而是被动态调制以支持语言查询。这一发现支持了跨模态处理中更动态的认知视角，即视觉token会根据语言目标被主动重编码。

title: Similarity-Aware Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning removes the influence of user-specified training examples from a trained model, avoiding the need to retrain it from scratch. Localization-based methods improve unlearning efficiency by identifying a subset of influential model parameters. However, existing approaches select parameters based solely on forget-set importance, neglecting their role in retained dataset and often causing collateral damage to semantically similar retained examples. We address this limitation with a retain-aware localization method that considers parameter importance to both forgotten and retained data. We also introduce a retain-similar evaluation set, constructed using cosine similarity in the model embedding space, to directly measure collateral damage. Across eleven experimental settings on CIFAR-10 dataset and ResNet18 model, our method consistently reduces collateral damage while improving standard unlearning metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of retain-aware localization for similarity-aware machine unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种保留感知的参数定位方法用于机器遗忘，在识别需要修改的参数时同时考虑遗忘集和保留集的重要性，以减少对语义相似保留样本的附带损害。作者还构建了基于嵌入空间余弦相似度的保留相似评估集来直接衡量附带损害，在CIFAR-10和ResNet18上的11种实验设置中验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于定位的机器遗忘方法仅根据遗忘集的重要性选择参数，忽略了这些参数在保留数据集中的作用，往往会对语义上与遗忘样本相似的保留样本造成附带损害（collateral damage）。
AI.method: 提出保留感知定位方法（retain-aware localization），同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性来共同选择需要修改的参数子集；同时引入基于模型嵌入空间余弦相似度构建的保留相似评估集（retain-similar evaluation set），用于直接量化附带损害程度。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集和ResNet18模型上的11种实验设置中，该方法一致地减少了附带损害，同时提升了标准机器遗忘指标的性能。
AI.conclusion: 保留感知的定位方法能够有效实现相似性感知的机器遗忘，在保证遗忘效果的同时更好地保护语义相似的保留样本，减少模型的附带损害。

title: Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races
summary: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation. We first verify the game engine, then test rule recall, state tracking, payoff calculation, and stability under different but equivalent task descriptions. We then compare LLM action sequences with an evolutionary game-theory benchmark and published human data, and explore differences across models, risk conditions, personas, and two- to five-player races. The audit shows that strong rule recall can coexist with weak state tracking and expected-payoff calculation. Providing verified arithmetic and changing the response representation can also change later actions, even when the game rules stay fixed. Across seven tested model endpoints, aggregate rates hide large differences in action sequences, responses to opponents, and responses to race position. Patterns across the tested three- to five-player races are also model-specific rather than a single effect of adding competitors. These results show why multi-agent AI-race simulations need validity checks and trajectory-level analysis before their outputs are described as strategic, human-like, or safety-aware. Our findings are exploratory and apply only to the tested models, prompts, and decoding settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI开发竞赛中的多智能体安全困境，通过在2-5人竞赛中测试LLM代理的战略安全行为。作者在行为解释前设置了审计门槛，验证游戏引擎、规则记忆、状态追踪、收益计算和任务描述的稳定性，并比较LLM动作序列与进化博弈论基准及人类数据。结果显示强规则记忆可能与弱状态追踪和收益计算共存，提供验证算术和改变响应表示会改变后续行动，7个模型端点的聚合率掩盖了动作序列、对手反应和竞赛位置反应上的巨大差异。
AI.motivation: 多智能体AI竞赛模拟常被用来研究战略安全行为，但LLM代理的有效行动并不能证明其真正理解游戏。现有研究缺乏严格的验证步骤，可能将模型输出误读为战略性、类人或安全意识行为。
AI.method: 在行为解释前设置审计门槛：首先验证游戏引擎，然后测试规则回忆、状态追踪、收益计算，以及在不同但等价的任�务描述下的稳定性。随后将LLM动作序列与进化博弈论基准和已发表的人类数据进行比较，并探索不同模型、风险条件、人物角色和2-5人竞赛中的差异。
AI.result: 审计显示强规则回忆可与弱状态追踪和预期收益计算共存。提供验证算术和改变响应表示会改变后续行动，即使游戏规则固定不变。7个测试模型端点的聚合率掩盖了动作序列、对手反应和竞赛位置反应上的巨大个体差异。3-5人竞赛中的模式也是模型特定的，而非增加竞争者带来的单一效应。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体AI竞赛模拟在输出被描述为战略性、类人或安全意识之前，需要有效性检查和轨迹级分析。研究结果是探索性的，仅适用于测试的模型、提示和解码设置。

title: LeapTalk: Breaking the Latency-Quality Trade-off in Talking Head Generation
summary: Long-form and real-time talking-head generation remains challenging due to a latency-quality trade-off: inefficient multi-step diffusion prohibits streaming generation, whereas real-time autoregressive approaches suffer from error accumulation and identity drift. To address this drawback, we propose LeapTalk, a novel framework that achieves stable and real-time talking-head generation with a single forward step, scaling to arbitrarily long videos. At the heart of our approach lies a single-step bridge distillation scheme. On the one hand, departing from the conventional noise-to-data paradigm, we introduce a data-to-data transport formulation based on a Brownian bridge. Anchored by a persistent reference, this strategy effectively mitigates identity drift and enhances long-term temporal stability. On the other hand, to enable smooth knowledge transfer from a pre-trained diffusion teacher to the student bridge model, we explore a heterogeneous distillation framework with an SNR-aligned time transformation $Φ(τ)$, which bridges the functional discrepancy between the two models. Moreover, we propose an audio-driven classifier-free guidance mechanism to maintain fine-grained lip synchronization under extreme step reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity and temporally consistent video generation with only 1 step at up to 200 FPS, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both efficiency and stability. Project Page: https://zhangrongxiang.github.io/leaptalk-page/

AI.tldr: LeapTalk是一个用于长时实时说话人视频生成的框架，通过单步桥式蒸馏在单个前向步骤中实现稳定、实时的说话头像生成，可扩展到任意长度的视频，并以最高200 FPS的速度生成只有1步的高保真且时间一致的视频。
AI.motivation: 长时和实时说话人头生成面临延迟-质量权衡：低效的多步扩散模型无法实现流式生成，而实时自回归方法则遭受误差累积和身份漂移问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出单步桥式蒸馏方案，采用基于布朗桥的数据到数据输运公式（而非传统噪声到数据范式），以持久参考锚定，缓解身份漂移并增强长期时间稳定性；2) 提出异构蒸馏框架，使用SNR对齐的时间变换Φ(τ)实现从预训练扩散教师到学生桥模型的平滑知识迁移；3) 提出音频驱动的分类器自由引导机制，在极端步数减少下保持精细的唇部同步。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法仅需1步即可实现高保真和时间一致的视频生成，速度达到200 FPS，在效率和稳定性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LeapTalk成功解决了实时说话人头生成中延迟与质量之间的权衡，通过创新的桥式蒸馏架构实现了单步生成、实时运行并能处理任意长视频的目标。

title: Predicting Startup Exit from Textual Descriptors - A Computational Linguistics Framework
summary: This study shows that textual descriptors alone can predict early-stage startup success, defined as Exit, without relying on contextual, financial, or human capital variables. Using venture capital-curated datasets covering 7,419 startups over 20 years, the research isolates text-based framing variables and engineers 850 features through startup narrative mapping. Data subsets and vector embeddings are evaluated for statistical significance, followed by supervised machine learning experiments across six models. LightGBM achieved the highest predictive performance (F1 = 0.48), while textual descriptors alone achieved F1 = 0.30, confirming the standalone predictive value of founder narratives. Feature analysis shows that optimized densities of hyping markers, including adjectives, jargon, and buzzwords, are associated with higher Exit probability, whereas excessive statement or name length reduces it. The study also introduces a quantifiable Hyping Score for venture capital applications, demonstrating that startup framing provides measurable signals for predicting Exit under conditions of high information asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，仅凭文本描述符即可预测早期初创企业成功（退出），无需背景、财务或人力资本变量。基于风投策划的7419家初创企业20年数据集，通过叙事映射构建850个特征，使用六种监督学习模型进行实验，LightGBM取得最佳性能（F1=0.48），纯文本描述符F1=0.30，证实创始叙事具有独立预测价值。
AI.motivation: 早期初创企业成功预测面临高信息不对称问题，传统方法依赖财务或人力资本变量，但此类数据往往稀缺或不可靠。本文旨在探索是否仅凭文本描述符就能预测初创企业退出（Exit），为风投决策提供无需额外背景信息的预测信号。
AI.method: 使用风投策划的数据集（7419家初创企业、20年），隔离文本框架变量，通过初创企业叙事映射工程化850个特征。评估数据子集和向量嵌入的统计显著性，随后在六种监督学习模型上进行实验（其中LightGBM表现最佳）。通过特征分析识别影响退出概率的关键文本特征，并引入量化"炒作分数"（Hyping Score）用于风投应用。
AI.result: LightGBM取得最高预测性能（F1=0.48），纯文本描述符单独使用达到F1=0.30，证实文本的独立预测价值。特征分析发现，优化密度的宣传标记（形容词、行话、流行词）与更高退出概率相关，而过度的陈述或名称长度则会降低退出概率。研究同时提出了可量化的炒作分数。
AI.conclusion: 初创企业叙事框架提供了在高信息不对称条件下预测退出的可测信号，文本描述符是预测早期初创企业成功的有效独立特征。引入的炒作分数可为风投应用提供实用工具，表明创始人叙事中的"宣传"密度可作为成功预测信号。

title: RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to use external and domain-specific knowledge, but its reliability depends on the interaction between the generative model, embedding model, retrieval mechanism, and prompt construction strategy. We present RagTester, an automated end-to-end testing approach for RAG systems. RagTester generates retrieval documents, test inputs, and expected outputs; executes the tests; and evaluates the resulting answers using an LLM as a judge. Its test-generation strategy targets complex passages, unsupported queries, and document-coverage criteria. We evaluate RagTester using eight LLMs and six embedding models, yielding 24 compatible configurations, and compare it with a baseline test-input generator. Across 72,000 test executions, RagTester detected 21,633 failures, 6.6% more than the baseline, and outperformed it in 20 of the 24 configurations. The detected failures include inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, incomplete use of retrieved context, and difficulties interpreting complex passages. These results show that coverage-oriented test generation can effectively expose failures caused by the interaction between retrieval and generation components and support the assessment of RAG configurations before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RagTester，一个针对RAG系统的自动化端到端测试方法。它通过生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，并使用LLM作为裁判来评估答案。在8个LLM和6个嵌入模型的24种配置、72,000次测试执行中，RagTester检测到21,633个失败，比基线多6.6%，在24个配置中的20个表现更优。
AI.motivation: RAG系统的可靠性依赖于生成模型、嵌入模型、检索机制和提示构建策略之间的复杂交互，但目前缺乏系统化的自动化端到端测试方法来评估这些组件之间的协同效果，尤其是在部署前评估RAG配置的有效性。
AI.method: RagTester的核心方法包括：(1) 生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出；(2) 自动执行测试；(3) 使用LLM作为裁判评估生成答案。其测试生成策略针对复杂段落、不支持查询和文档覆盖率三种标准，以暴露检索与生成组件交互中的缺陷。
AI.result: 在8个LLM和6个嵌入模型组成的24种兼容配置、总计72,000次测试执行中，RagTester检测到21,633个失败，比基线方法多6.6%，并在24个配置中的20个上优于基线。检出的失败类型包括检索不准确、生成无依据答案、未充分利用检索上下文以及难以理解复杂段落。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖导向的测试生成方法能有效暴露RAG系统中检索与生成组件交互导致的失败，支持在部署前评估不同RAG配置的可靠性，为RAG系统的质量保障提供了系统化的自动化测试方案。

title: Stabilized Best-of-$K$ Training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Leader Reward modifies POMO training to emphasize the best trajectory produced by repeated inference. We test a narrow extension: replace its binary leader/non-leader distinction with a stabilized rank signal indexed by a sampling budget $K$. With the POMO architecture, 3,050-epoch schedule, and TSP-100 test set held fixed, the Leader Reward reimplementation obtains $7.7662$ under 100-start, 8-augmentation greedy decoding, matching the reported $7.766$ at its displayed precision. Under independent sampling, the stabilized $K=8$ recipe lowers realized Best-of-8 cost in all three paired training seeds: $7.7944$ versus $7.8136$. This observation is estimation-only and decoder-specific: three seeds are below the six-seed testing floor, Leader Reward is better at sampled $K=1$, and it remains slightly better under its original augmented-greedy protocol. We make no unbiased-estimator, universal superiority, or state-of-the-art claim.

AI.tldr: 本文在POMO架构上对比了Leader Reward与一种基于采样预算K的稳定秩信号方法。在TSP-100测试集上，Leader Reward复现结果为7.7662，与论文报告的7.766一致。在独立采样下，K=8的稳定秩方法在三个训练种子上均降低了Best-of-8成本（7.7944 vs 7.8136），但作者强调这是估计性、解码器特定的观察，仅基于三个种子（低于六个种子的测试下限），不声称普遍优越性或SOTA。
AI.motivation: 测试Leader Reward训练的窄扩展——用稳定化秩信号替代二元的leader/non-leader区分，以探索是否能在POMO架构下进一步提升采样解码性能。
AI.method: 在固定POMO架构、3,050轮训练计划及TSP-100测试集条件下，将Leader Reward的二元区分替换为基于采样预算K的稳定秩信号，并通过配对训练种子比较在独立采样与增强贪婪解码下的Best-of-K成本。
AI.result: Leader Reward复现得到7.7662（与报告7.766一致）；在独立采样下，稳定K=8配方在全部三个配对种子中降低Best-of-8成本（7.7944 vs 7.8136）。但Leader Reward在K=1采样下更优，且在其原始增强贪婪协议下仍略优。
AI.conclusion: 稳定秩信号在特定条件（独立采样、K=8）下优于Leader Reward，但该发现为估计性且解码器特定，样本量不足，不构成一般性结论，也不做SOTA或无偏估计声明。

title: CRAFTS: Collaborative Role-Adaptive Fine-Tuning of LLM Agents for Chemical Process Simulation
summary: Constructing an executable chemical-process model remains manually intensive. Chemical engineers translate underspecified requests into coupled decisions about unit operations, thermodynamics, streams, specifications, degrees of freedom (DoF), initialization, solver repair, and optimization; one error can invalidate the model. CRAFTS mirrors the staged workflow of chemical engineers by decomposing simulation building into bounded subtasks assigned to seven bounded roles, with deterministic IDAES/Pyomo gates between stages. Given a natural-language request, process flowsheet diagram (PFD) evidence, and curated chemical-engineering knowledge, Input Understanding and Intent recover requirements, constraints, and process semantics; visual, topology, and specification specialists translate them into typed simulator contracts; and Debug and Optimization support bounded repair and eligible optimization. Fine-tuning is applied to the three schema-critical visual, topology, and specification roles, while the remaining roles use untuned Qwen. The resulting VisualGraphIR, TopologyIR, SpecIR, BuildPlan, and SolveReport expose unit, port, thermodynamic, numerical, and execution decisions. Compatible constructors, property packages, and runners are attached only after semantic artifacts pass engineering gates. We introduce OpenIDAES-450, a 450-case IDAES process- simulation dataset, and evaluate the complete seven-role LangChain/LangGraph workflow through solve and eligible optimization on its frozen 82-case held-out split. CRAFTS completes the prescribed validation and execution contract for for 91.5% of cases and achieves unit, stream, and directed-connection F1 scores of 0.815, 0.791, and 0.782. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of role specialization, typed intermediate representations, and deterministic engineering gates for reliable automated process-model construction.

AI.tldr: CRAFTS是一个自动化化工过程建模系统，通过将建模分解为七个有界角色（对应化工工程师的分阶段工作流），并使用确定性IDAES/Pyomo工程门控，实现从自然语言请求到可执行过程模型的自动构建。在450例OpenIDAES-450数据集上，91.5%的案例能完成规定的验证和执行合同。
AI.motivation: 构建可执行的化工过程模型目前仍是高度手动密集型工作。化工工程师需要将模糊的请求转化为一系列耦合决策（单元操作、热力学、流股、规格、自由度、初始化、求解器修复和优化），任何一个错误都可能导致整个模型失效。现有方法缺乏系统性的自动化手段来可靠地完成这一复杂流程。
AI.method: CRAFTS将仿真构建分解为七个有界角色（Bound Roles），包括：输入理解与意图恢复、视觉专家、拓扑专家、规格专家、调试与优化支持等。各阶段之间设有确定性IDAES/Pyomo工程门控，确保语义工件通过后才附加兼容的构造函数、物性包和求解器。对三个模式关键的视觉、拓扑和规格角色应用微调，其余角色使用未调优的Qwen模型。系统输出VisualGraphIR、TopologyIR、SpecIR、BuildPlan和SolveReport等中间表示，暴露单元、端口、热力学、数值和执行决策。
AI.result: 引入OpenIDAES-450数据集（450例IDAES过程仿真案例），在冻结的82例预留测试集上评估完整七角色LangChain/LangGraph工作流。CRAFTS在91.5%的案例中完成规定的验证和执行合同，单元、流股和有向连接F1分数分别达到0.815、0.791和0.782。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了角色专业化、类型化中间表示和确定性工程门控在可靠的自动化过程模型构建中的有效性。CRAFTS成功地镜像了化工工程师的工作流程，展示了通过结构化分解和工程门控实现自动化建模的可行性。

title: Beyond Edge Maps: Wavelet-Domain Conditioning for Multi-Adapter Map-to-Satellite Diffusion
summary: Commercial mapping partnerships are often unavailable in low-resource regions, leaving satellite basemaps stale and motivating synthesis of satellite imagery from independently maintained cartographic data. Existing ControlNet-based diffusion methods typically condition on structural signals like edges or segmentation extracted from the target image itself, assuming the imagery already exists and limiting their use exactly where synthesis matters most. Map-conditioned alternatives add cues like edge detection but omit frequency-domain structure. We propose a ControlNet-based diffusion framework conditioned only on cartographic sources obtainable independently of the target imagery: OpenStreetMap (OSM) raster maps and their stationary wavelet transform (SWT) subbands, a conditioning signal previously unexplored for map-to-satellite diffusion. Two ControlNet adapters, trained separately on the map and wavelet representations atop a frozen Stable Diffusion backbone, are fused via MultiControlNet, jointly drawing on spatial structure and frequency detail without retraining a multi-input model. We evaluate on a new paired map-satellite dataset curated for Nepal, a data-scarce, topographically diverse region, alongside the Pix2Pix maps-satellite benchmark. Combined conditioning wins six of eight metric-dataset comparisons -- SSIM and PSNR on both datasets, plus LPIPS (both Alex and VGG backbones) on ours and ties map-only on both Pix2Pix LPIPS backbones while still edging past wavelet-only there. Wavelet-only takes the lowest FID on both datasets, matching the tradeoff between per-image fidelity and distributional realism. We treat this gap cautiously given our modest test-set sizes and FID's known small-sample bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖独立可获取的制图数据（OSM栅格地图及其平稳小波变换子带）作为条件的ControlNet扩散框架，用于在低资源地区合成卫星图像。两个分别训练的ControlNet适配器通过MultiControlNet融合，在尼泊尔数据集上实现优于单一条件的方法。
AI.motivation: 商业地图合作伙伴在低资源地区往往不可用，导致卫星底图过时。现有ControlNet方法通常从目标图像本身提取条件信号（如边缘、分割），假设图像已存在，这恰恰限制了在最需要合成的地方的使用。已有的地图条件方法仅添加边缘检测等线索，忽略了频域结构信息。
AI.method: 提出基于ControlNet的扩散框架，仅以独立于目标影像的制图数据为条件：OSM栅格地图及其平稳小波变换（SWT）子带。两个ControlNet适配器分别在冻结的Stable Diffusion主干上单独训练（一个处理地图表示，一个处理小波表示），通过MultiControlNet融合，同时利用空间结构和频率细节，无需重新训练多输入模型。
AI.result: 在尼泊尔（数据稀缺、地形多样的区域）新构建的配对地图-卫星数据集及Pix2Pix基准上评估。组合条件在八个指标-数据集比较中赢得六项（两个数据集的SSIM和PSNR，以及自己数据集的LPIPS），在两数据集的Pix2Pix LPIPS上追平地图单独条件。小波单独条件在两个数据集上取得最低FID，体现逐图像保真度与分布真实感之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 组合地图与小波条件的方法在大多数保真度指标上优于单一条件方法，但FID结果存在小幅偏差，需谨慎对待。小波条件在分布真实性上表现更优，揭示了不同条件在保真度与真实感间的权衡。

title: Neural Circuit Function Inference with LLMs
summary: The success of connectome mapping now shifts the challenge of understanding the nervous system to the interpretation of neural circuits. Here, we devise a new automated method, LLantia (LLM automated neural circuit inference and analysis), to systematically infer neural circuit function and the role of its component neural cell types. Our approach distills descriptions of cell type function from the literature and, in combination with the connectome, then infers the function for all other cell types, which serves as a basis for subsequent neural circuit function inference. Results are structured hierarchically, with different possible circuit functions organised under multiple possible behavioural and physiological contexts, and each circuit function composed of subcircuit descriptions alongside relevant cell types to facilitate both backtracking to known, published information and support further experimental research. We illustrate our method by inferring cell type function for all cell types of the adult fruit fly brain and for select broader circuits within, and validate our findings, including by cross-checking with literature published after the release date of our analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为LLantia的自动化方法，结合文献知识和连接组数据，系统地推断神经回路功能及组成细胞类型的作用，并以果蝇大脑为例进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 连接组图谱的成功绘制使得理解神经系统的挑战转向了对神经回路的解析和功能性解释，而目前缺乏系统化、自动化的方法来推断神经回路功能及其细胞类型的作用。
AI.method: LLantia方法首先从文献中提取细胞类型功能的描述，然后结合连接组数据，推断所有其他细胞类型的功能，并以此为基础进一步推断神经回路功能。结果以层级结构组织，按行为和生理学上下文分类，每个回路功能由子回路描述和相关细胞类型组成，便于回溯已有文献信息。
AI.result: 该方法被应用于成年果蝇大脑所有细胞类型的功能推断以及特定更广泛回路的功能推断，并通过与分析发布日期之后发表的新文献进行交叉验证，验证了推断结果的准确性。
AI.conclusion: LLantia提供了一种利用大型语言模型+连接组数据自动推断神经回路功能的可行框架，支持回溯验证和未来实验研究，为神经回路功能解析提供了新工具。

title: H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases
summary: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost.
