Empirical evaluations across four benchmark tabular datasets (COMPAS, German Credit, IEEE-CIS, and Communities & Crime) confirm that our method systematically crushes target feature attribution to near-zero (<0.02), maintains >90% Attack Success Rates, and fundamentally bypasses Conditional Anomaly Detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的白盒、梯度正则化的对抗性解释攻击框架，通过连续嵌入双惩罚机制直接在模型参数中嵌入规避逻辑，在不依赖OOD检测器包装的情况下生成平滑的分布内预测，从而绕过现有的异常检测防御。在四个基准表格数据集上验证了该方法的高攻击成功率（>90%）和低特征归因（<0.02）。
AI.motivation: 现有的对抗性解释攻击依赖OOD检测器包装来切换预测，但这类黑盒攻击会被基于异常扰动足迹的防御方法检测并中和。作者旨在展示一种更隐蔽的漏洞：通过白盒方式直接在模型参数中嵌入规避逻辑，使攻击不留任何异常足迹，从而突破现有防御。
AI.method: 提出白盒梯度正则化规避攻击框架，包括：(1) 连续嵌入双惩罚框架，在训练过程中直接惩罚触发特征梯度；(2) 在分布内数据上训练，将规避逻辑原生嵌入模型参数；(3) 不依赖OOD检测器脚手架包装，生成平滑的分布内预测。
AI.result: 在四个基准表格数据集（COMPAS、German Credit、IEEE-CIS、Communities & Crime）上的实验验证表明：目标特征归因被压制至接近零（<0.02），攻击成功率维持在90%以上，并且从根本上绕过条件异常检测（Conditional Anomaly Detection）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了一个关键的安全漏洞：即使模型发布者或审查者使用解释器和异常检测防御，白盒攻击者仍可通过梯度正则化将规避逻辑嵌入模型参数，生成无异常足迹的对抗性解释攻击。这表明现有的可解释性安全防线存在根本性不足，需要开发更强大的防御机制。

title: RadPRISM: Schema-stratified radiology-report supervision for concept-disentangled image representations and visual grounding
summary: Vision-language pretraining learns rich medical image representations from radiology reports, but previous model variants commonly operate within a single shared embedding space, so concept-level structure and interpretability must be recovered post hoc, limiting model transparency and, hence, clinical utility. We introduce RadPRISM, which makes a clinician-defined radiology schema a designated stratification axis: an on-premise large language model extracts per-concept text spans from free-text reports, and each clinical concept is aligned in its own dedicated visual subspace, turning concept stratification into direct, top-level alignment supervision. Instantiated on chest radiographs with a 19-concept schema over $203{,}602$ examinations from an internal multi-year archive, RadPRISM improved internal dataset zero-shot classification from $0.717$ (95% CI, $0.710-0.723$) to $0.868$ (95% CI, $0.863-0.872$) macro AUROC over a matched global-alignment baseline, performed on par with the purpose-built CARZero reference in external zero-shot classification while substantially outperforming it (up to 4.3-fold) in pointing-game visual grounding. In addition, a radiologist reader study demonstrated concept-stratified retrieval ability ($0.78$ macro retrieval correctness rate within rank 3), surfacing disentangled descriptive findings that report-level retrieval and fixed-label vocabularies cannot express. RadPRISM yields discriminative, spatially faithful, natively concept-stratified representations shaped by and transparently inspectable by clinicians.

AI.tldr: RadPRISM 提出了一种全新的医学影像-语言预训练范式，通过将临床医生定义的放射学概念模式作为显式的分层轴，将每个临床概念在独立的视觉子空间中对齐，从而实现了原生概念分层、可解释且空间保真的医学图像表征，在胸部X光片的零样本分类、视觉定位和概念分层检索等任务上均显著优于或持平于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言预训练模型通常在单一共享嵌入空间中操作，概念级结构和可解释性需要事后恢复，限制了模型透明度和临床实用性。作者希望将临床概念分层从隐式后处理转变为直接的顶层对齐监督，使模型表征天然具有概念结构且可被临床医生透明检查。
AI.method: RadPRISM 利用本地部署的大语言模型从自由文本报告中提取每个临床概念对应的文本片段，并在每个临床概念专属的视觉子空间中进行对齐。该方法在胸部X光片上使用19概念模式，基于内部多年存档的203,602次检查进行实例化。
AI.result: 内部数据集零样本分类宏AUROC从0.717提升至0.868（匹配全局对齐基线）；外部零样本分类与专用CARZero参考方法表现相当；视觉定位任务中最多超出CARZero 4.3倍；放射科医生阅读研究显示概念分层检索正确率达0.78（rank 3内），能呈现报告级检索和固定标签词汇无法表达的解耦描述性发现。
AI.conclusion: RadPRISM 能够生成判别性强、空间保真、原生概念分层的医学图像表征，其结构由临床医生定义并可直接透明检查，显著提升了模型的临床适用性和可解释性。

title: SeDeM: Selective Decompression of Hidden-State Memories for Long-Context Question Answering
summary: Long-context inference with large language models (LLMs) is costly: self-attention during prefill scales quadratically with sequence length, and the key-value (KV) cache grows with the number of processed tokens. Larger context windows also do not ensure reliable evidence use. Context compression reduces this cost, but many soft-compression methods use LLMs as compressors and rely on compact memory tokens both to preserve information and to condition the decoder. We propose SeDeM, a selective decompression framework that decouples compact memory storage from decoder conditioning. An LLM extracts hidden states from a chosen intermediate Transformer layer, a lightweight compressor stores them as memory blocks, a query-conditioned selector selects relevant blocks, and a decompressor expands only the selected blocks into hidden states compatible with an intermediate decoder layer. Thus, the decoder avoids both full-context processing and direct generation from highly compressed memory slots. On four long-context QA benchmarks, SeDeM achieves higher QA scores than the evaluated compression baselines in both 1B and 3B same-backbone settings, and with the 3B backbone exceeds full-context fine-tuning on three datasets. The learned selector uses block-level evidence supervision during training. SeDeM also reduces online time-to-first-token and improves autoregressive decoding throughput relative to ICAE.

AI.tldr: SeDeM是一个选择性解压缩框架，将紧凑记忆存储与解码器条件生成解耦。通过中间层隐藏状态提取、轻量压缩器存储、查询条件选择器和解压缩器扩展选中的块，在四个长上下文QA基准上优于压缩基线，并减少TTFT、提高解码吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理成本高昂：自注意力在预填充阶段随序列长度二次增长，KV缓存随处理token数增长。现有软压缩方法用LLM作为压缩器，依赖紧凑记忆token同时承担信息保存和解码器条件生成两个任务，效果受限。
AI.method: SeDeM框架包含四个组件：(1) LLM从选定的中间Transformer层提取隐藏状态；(2) 轻量压缩器将这些状态存储为记忆块；(3) 查询条件选择器选择相关块；(4) 解压缩器仅将选中的块扩展为与中间解码器层兼容的隐藏状态。训练时使用块级证据监督来训练选择器。
AI.result: 在四个长上下文QA基准上，SeDeM在1B和3B同骨干设置下均优于评估的压缩基线；3B骨干在三个数据集上超过全上下文微调。相比ICAE，SeDeM减少在线TTFT并提高自回归解码吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦记忆存储与解码器条件生成，并利用选择性解压缩机制，SeDeM在保持压缩收益的同时提升了QA性能和推理效率，证明了该框架在长上下文场景中的有效性。

title: WM-Cov: Test Adequacy for Interactive World-Model-Style Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: World models and generative simulators are emerging as interactive testing infrastructure for autonomous driving because they can react to the ego planner and produce counterfactual, rare, and safety-critical rollouts. This changes a test scenario from a fixed replayed trajectory into an interactive scenario family whose realized evolution depends on the planner under test. The unresolved question is therefore not only whether dangerous rollouts can be generated, but what valid closed-loop evidence is enough to support a specified testing intent and stopping decision. This paper formulates interactive world-model-style testing adequacy and introduces WM-Cov, a provider-agnostic evaluation layer that converts raw provider outputs into requested, realized, and valid evidence. WM-Cov reports adequacy through coverage growth, valid-failure discovery, failure-mode diversity, realism, artifact suppression, duplicate accounting, and valid-evidence precision. Studies on executed TeraSim/SUMO events, WM-like mixed trace pools, and a real DriveArena TrafficManager--WorldDreamer matrix show that dangerous-looking events can include valid ADS failures, duplicates, partial realizations, and artifacts. The DriveArena matrix evaluates two planners, two horizons, six prompt conditions, and 360 ego-route requests; 304 attempts become fully realized evidence and 56 remain partial. A disjoint 80-request route-slice check yields 74 fully realized and 6 partial attempts. The results support evaluating world-model-style testing by convergence of valid interactive evidence under budget, rather than by raw generated failures or prompt coverage alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式世界模型测试充分性概念，并引入WM-Cov——一个提供者无关的评估层，将原始生成器输出转化为可请求、可实现、有效的证据，通过覆盖率增长、有效故障发现、故障模式多样性等指标评估闭环测试充分性，而非仅依赖原始生成故障或提示覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 世界模型和生成模拟器作为自动驾驶交互式测试基础设施正在兴起，因为它们能响应自我规划器并产生反事实、稀有和安全关键的展开（rollouts）。但测试场景从固定回放轨迹变成了交互式场景族，其实际演化取决于被测规划器。因此未解决的问题不仅是能否生成危险展开，而是什么样的有效闭环证据足以支持特定的测试意图和停止决策。
AI.method: 论文形式化了交互式世界模型风格的测试充分性，并引入WM-Cov作为提供者无关的评估层。WM-Cov将原始提供者输出转换为请求的（requested）、已实现的（realized）和有效的（valid）证据，并通过以下指标报告充分性：覆盖率增长、有效故障发现、故障模式多样性、真实性、伪影抑制、重复计数和有效证据精度。在TeraSim/SUMO事件、类WM混合轨迹池和真实DriveArena TrafficManager-WorldDreamer矩阵上进行了研究。
AI.result: 危险外观的事件可能包含有效ADS故障、重复项、部分实现和伪影。DriveArena矩阵评估了2个规划器、2个时间范围、6个提示条件和360个自我路线请求；304个尝试成为完全实现的证据，56个保持部分实现。一个不重叠的80请求路线切片检查得到74个完全实现和6个部分实现的尝试。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持以预算下有效交互证据的收敛性来评估世界模型风格测试，而非仅凭原始生成故障或提示覆盖率。

title: Fairness Auditing: Lower Bounds on Company Manipulation
summary: Fairness audits are increasingly mandated in high-stakes applications such as hiring, lending, and automated decision-making. Recent work has established fundamental impossibility results for black-box fairness auditing, showing that sufficiently expressive models can evade any auditing strategy. We complement these results by quantifying the extent of unavoidable post-audit manipulation under finite audit resources. We formulate fairness auditing as a min-max optimization between a computationally unbounded company and a budget-constrained auditor. We study two auditing regimes: (i) a budgeted auditor that certifies fairness using a fixed-size audit set, and (ii) a budgeted α-tolerant auditor that additionally requires the audit set to estimate the fairness of the certified model within an α approximation. For both settings, we derive explicit lower bounds on the worst-case post-audit demographic parity deviation as functions of the audit budget, group imbalance, and fairness tolerance. Finally, we empirically illustrate these theoretical limits using simple audit-set construction heuristics with linear and neural network classifiers. Our results demonstrate that increasing audit resources reduces, but does not eliminate, the scope for post-audit manipulation, highlighting fundamental limitations of finite-budget fairness certification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限预算下的公平性审计问题，通过最小最大优化框架量化了审计后无法避免的操纵程度，证明增加审计资源只能减少但不能消除事后操纵的空间。
AI.motivation: 公平性审计在高风险应用（如招聘、贷款、自动决策）中日益被强制要求，但已有研究证明了黑盒公平性审计的基本不可能性结果。作者希望进一步量化在有限审计资源下，审计后不可避免的操纵程度，以理解公平性认证的根本局限。
AI.method: 将公平性审计建模为计算能力无限的公司与预算受限的审计者之间的最小最大优化博弈。研究两种审计机制：(i) 有限预算审计者使用固定规模审计集认证公平性；(ii) 有限预算的α容忍审计者，额外要求审计集能在α近似范围内估计被认证模型的公平性。对两种设置均推导出最坏情况下审计后人口统计平价偏差的下界，作为审计预算、群体不平衡和公平性容差的函数，并通过线性分类器和神经网络分类器的审计集构建启发式方法进行实证验证。
AI.result: 推导了两种审计设置下审计后人口统计平价偏差的显式下界，并通过实证实验说明了这些理论极限。结果表明增加审计资源可以减小但无法消除审计后操纵的空间。
AI.conclusion: 有限预算的公平性认证存在根本性局限：即使增加审计资源，也无法完全消除被审计模型的事后操纵，这凸显了有限预算公平性认证的内在限制。

title: SCALP: Semi-Supervised Statistical Shape Modeling from Imperfect 3D Photogrammetry via Landmark-Anchored Spectral Warp
summary: Correspondence-based statistical shape modeling (SSM) is vital for population-level morphometric analysis, but conventional pipelines assume clean, fully registered surfaces. Real-world clinical photogrammetry scans are often noisy, partial, and cluttered, hindering the adoption of radiation-free surface imaging as a safe alternative to computed tomography (CT) for infant craniosynostosis. We present SCALP (Semi-supervised Correspondence via lAndmark Localization and sPectral warping), a two-stage framework that constructs consistent shape models directly from raw, imperfect surface scans. First, a semi-supervised Point Transformer leverages a small expert-annotated dataset alongside a large unlabeled cohort to accurately localize craniofacial landmarks with minimal annotation overhead. Second, these landmarks anchor a Laplace--Beltrami spectral deformation of an anatomical template, generating dense correspondences while naturally isolating the cranium from peripheral scanning clutter without manual preprocessing. Experiments on infant photogrammetry scans demonstrate that SCALP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised point-cloud approaches, offering a clinically practical pathway toward objective, radiation-free head shape analysis.

AI.tldr: SCALP是一个两阶段框架，用于从原始、不完美的临床光摄影扫描中构建一致的形状统计模型，无需手动预处理。它结合半监督Point Transformer进行颅面标志点定位，以及Laplace-Beltrami谱变形进行模板配准和密集对应生成，为婴儿颅缝早闭提供无辐射的头型分析方案。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于对应的统计形状建模（SSM）假设输入是干净且完全配准的表面，但真实临床光摄影扫描通常包含噪声、部分缺失和背景杂波。这阻碍了无辐射表面成像作为CT安全替代方案在婴儿颅缝早闭诊断中的应用，因此需要一种能够直接从原始不完美扫描构建形状模型的方法。
AI.method: SCALP采用两阶段框架：(1) 半监督Point Transformer利用少量专家标注数据集和大量未标注数据，以最小标注开销准确定位颅面标志点；(2) 以标志点为锚定，通过Laplace-Beltrami谱变形将解剖模板变形到目标表面，生成密集对应关系，同时自然地将颅骨与周围扫描杂波分离，无需手动预处理。
AI.result: 在婴儿摄影测量扫描上的实验表明，SCALP在两个阶段均一致优于最先进的无监督点云方法，展示了其在临床实际应用中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SCALP为客观、无辐射的头型分析提供了一条临床实用的路径，克服了传统SSM对干净输入数据的依赖，推动了无辐射表面成像在婴儿颅缝早闭诊断中的实际应用。

title: CurveShift: Is Agent Progress Scalar? Separating Level from Shape
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/harvenstar/CurveShift
summary: Progress in large language models is often summarized using a single scalar measure, such as a time horizon, a latent ability estimate, or an aggregate benchmark score. These summaries capture the overall performance, but they do not test whether progress is distributed differently across task difficulty. We find that most of the apparent shift in gains toward harder tasks does not reflect a change in the shape of the difficulty-response curve. On METR time-horizon data, a single Rasch model with rising ability reproduces this pattern, so it is largely explained by ceiling effects rather than a qualitative change in capability. This echoes how the choice of metric can make claimed emergent abilities look like a property of the models themselves. We then identify a smaller hard-task effect that survives this control. Isolating it is difficult on agentic benchmarks, because newer models are usually run with newer agentic harnesses, so a gain on hard tasks cannot be assigned to the model or its scaffold. We break the confound with LiveCodeBench, a public competitive programming benchmark that runs no agentic scaffold while pairing dated models with an exogenous difficulty ordering. After accounting for the rise in overall ability, models released after September 2024 still gain on the hardest problems beyond what their easy and medium performance predicts, by about +0.40 logits under our most conservative assumption, raising the hard-problem solve rate from roughly 18% to 25%. The effect is led by the strongest reasoning models and holds for hard tasks that need only short reasoning, not autonomy over long horizons. We present this as a result specific to competitive programming, since our clean identification rests on a single coding benchmark. We release the LiveCodeBench Difficulty Panel (66 dated models x 1,055 problems) and our analysis code.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型进步向更难任务转移的表象大多是天花板效应而非能力分布的质性变化，但在竞争性编程基准（LiveCodeBench）上控制了混杂因素后，识别出2024年9月后发布的模型在最难问题上确实存在约+0.40 logits的真实进步（解决率从18%升至25%），该效应主要由最强推理模型驱动，且只需要短推理而非长时程自主性。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM进展的总结通常使用单一标量指标（时间跨度、潜在能力估计或总体基准分数），这些指标捕捉了整体性能但无法检验进步是否在不同任务难度上分布不均。作者希望验证"进步向更难任务转移"这一现象是否真实反映模型能力的质性变化，还是由测量工具（如天花板效应）造成的假象。
AI.method: 1. 在METR时间跨度数据上使用单一Rasch模型（单参数逻辑斯蒂模型）检验"进步向困难任务转移"是否可由能力上升+天花板效应解释。2. 在LiveCodeBench基准上，通过将dated models与外部难度排序配对、无agentic scaffold运行的设置来打破模型与脚手架混杂。3. 控制总体能力上升后，比较模型在困难问题上的实际表现与基于易/中难度预测的差距（logits差异）。
AI.result: 在METR数据上，大部分"向困难任务转移"的表象可由Rasch模型的上升能力解释（天花板效应），仅存在较小的真实困难任务效应。在LiveCodeBench上，2024年9月后发布的模型在最难问题上仍有约+0.40 logits的额外进步（保守估计），将困难问题解决率从约18%提升到25%。该效应由最强推理模型驱动，且仅需短推理即可实现，不依赖长时程自主性。
AI.conclusion: LLM"进步向困难任务转移"的广泛说法大部分是测量假象（天花板效应/度量选择），但在竞争性编程这一特定领域存在真实的小幅困难任务进步效应。该发现需限定于单一编码基准，因为agentic基准中模型与脚手架混杂难以分离。作者发布了LiveCodeBench困难度面板数据集（66个dated模型×1055道题）与分析代码供进一步研究。

title: CrystalMem: Elastic Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Knowledge Crystallization
summary: Memory for self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents is often provisioned as if its byte budget only grows. Cloud platforms, however, adjust quotas with load and cost, and we show that capability does not follow the budget back up: after a squeeze-and-recover cycle, the agent settles below its pre-squeeze level, a gap we call memory hysteresis. The cause is structural. Deletion and one-way compression discard the material needed for later rebuilding, and we prove that any policy that only keeps or drops entries carries a residual-deficit floor. We propose CrystalMem (Crystallized Memory), an elastic memory sidecar that demotes entries across four fidelity states under a crystallization-energy schedule, orders demotions by advantage-weighted influence with dependency coupling, and recovers capability through verified recrystallization under explicit compute and byte caps. Across seven environments, seventeen methods, and six backbones, with multi-tenant serving and a physical edge-cloud deployment, CrystalMem achieves the highest restored capability in every setting and closes the loop left open by every baseline. From a 50% byte budget, CrystalMem matches the strongest budgeted baseline at full provision on every environment; at equal budgets, it leads by +4.6 pp on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrystalMem（Crystallized Memory），一种弹性记忆sidecar机制，解决LLM Agent在内存预算被压缩再恢复后能力无法完全回弹的"记忆迟滞"（memory hysteresis）问题。通过四保真状态降级、结晶能量调度、优势加权影响力排序与依赖耦合，以及显式计算和字节上限下的验证性重结晶，在7个环境、17种方法、6个主干的广泛评测中全面超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent的记忆系统通常假设字节预算只会单调增长，但云平台会根据负载和成本动态调整配额。研究发现经历"挤压-恢复"周期后，Agent能力会回落到压缩前水平以下，形成"记忆迟滞"缺口。根本原因是结构性的：删除和单向压缩会丢弃后续重建所需的材料，且任何只保留或丢弃条目的策略都存在残余赤字下限。
AI.method: 提出CrystalMem弹性记忆sidecar，核心包含三个部分：(1) 在结晶能量调度下，将条目跨四个保真状态降级（demote）；(2) 通过优势加权影响力（advantage-weighted influence）与依赖耦合对降级顺序进行排序；(3) 在显式计算和字节上限内，通过验证性重结晶（verified recrystallization）恢复能力。
AI.result: 在7个环境、17种方法、6个主干的评测中（含多租户服务和物理边缘-云部署），CrystalMem在所有场景中实现了最高的恢复能力。在50%字节预算下，CrystalMem在每个环境中都能匹配最强基线在完整配额下的表现；在相同预算下，平均领先+4.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CrystalMem通过"结晶化"的多保真度记忆管理策略，成功打破了记忆迟滞的理论下限，在降低的内存预算下仍能保持甚至超越全预算基线的能力水平，为弹性记忆系统提供了新的设计范式。

title: CoSynFlow: Conformal Symplectic Neural Flows for Cross-System Prediction of Dissipative Hamiltonian Dynamics
summary: Learning solution operators for differential equations is a central problem in scientific machine learning. However, many neural operator methods optimize prediction accuracy without explicitly enforcing the geometric structure of the dynamics. Structure-preserving models such as SympNets and Symplectic Neural Flows address this issue for conservative Hamiltonian systems by preserving the symplectic form. In dissipative Hamiltonian systems with conformal symplectic structure, however, the symplectic form evolves according to a conformal factor determined by the dissipation. We propose CoSynFlow, a conformal symplectic neural flow for learning continuous-time solution maps of dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics. CoSynFlow composes symplectic shear maps with explicit conformal scaling, preserving the conformal symplectic structure by construction. By conditioning it on a finite-dimensional Hamiltonian descriptor and the dissipation parameter, a single trained model predicts solution maps for unseen systems without retraining. CoSynFlow keeps the structure error at machine precision, attains the lowest long-horizon error, and admits physics-informed training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoSynFlow，一种共形辛神经流，用于学习耗散哈密顿动力学的连续时间解算子。通过将辛剪切映射与显式共形缩放相结合，CoSynFlow在构造上保持共形辛结构，并能通过有限维哈密顿描述符和耗散参数的条件化，实现跨系统的泛化预测。
AI.motivation: 许多神经算子方法仅优化预测精度，未显式强制动力学的几何结构。现有的结构保持模型（如SympNets和Symplectic Neural Flows）针对保守哈密顿系统保持辛形式，但对于具有共形辛结构的耗散哈密顿系统，辛形式会随耗散因子演化，目前缺乏相应的结构保持求解器。
AI.method: CoSynFlow由两个核心组件构成：(1) 辛剪切映射的复合，用于保持哈密顿部分的辛结构；(2) 显式共形缩放，用于模拟耗散带来的收缩效应。模型以有限维哈密顿描述符和耗散系数为条件，使单个训练模型可预测未见系统的解映射，且支持基于物理信息的训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CoSynFlow将结构误差保持在机器精度水平，获得最低的长时程误差，展现出优越的数值稳定性与预测精度。
AI.conclusion: CoSynFlow为耗散哈密顿系统提供了一种严格保持几何结构的神经算子方法，兼顾结构保真度与泛化能力，为具有耗散的物理系统建模提供了新的思路。

title: Manifold-GS: Certified Hybrid Assets via Varifold-Conservative Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) gives high-quality novel-view synthesis, but its adaptive radiance primitives are not directly usable as structured assets: opacity is not an additive area measure, refinement can change the induced geometry, and watertight mesh extraction can hallucinate collision surfaces in unobserved regions. We introduce Manifold-GS, a certified hybrid asset layer for Gaussian scenes. The method separates appearance opacity from geometric quadrature mass, represents surface-like Gaussians as a discrete unoriented varifold, and exports only confidence-certified open surface patches while retaining uncertified content as residual splats. It provides refinement-conservative mass transport, local realizability diagnostics, source-preserving patch bindings, and conservative collision candidates. On three DTU scenes, a frozen asset benchmark shows zero patch-defined edit leakage, texture round-trip PSNR of 30.1/35.3/33.7 dB, and lower collision floater area than official 2DGS meshes on all scenes, with large gaps on two scenes. The result is a precision-coverage tradeoff rather than a universal reconstruction claim. External-region annotations, phantom-collision probes, and 5k-face simplification further support the certified asset interpretation, while RGB-only experiments show that local realizability is not sufficient for sparse-view surface identifiability.

AI.tldr: Manifold-GS 是一种面向 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景的认证混合资产层，将外观不透明度与几何积分质量分离，将类表面高斯表示为离散无向变分形（varifold），并仅导出经置信度认证的开放表面补丁，未认证内容保留为残差泼溅。实验表明其在冻结资产基准上实现零补丁编辑泄漏、优于官方 2DGS 网格的碰撞浮动区域表现，并提供精度-覆盖率的权衡而非普适重建保证。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 虽然能生成高质量的新视角合成，但其自适应辐射基元不能直接用作结构化资产：不透明度不是可加性的面积度量，精炼（refinement）可能改变诱导几何，且水密网格提取可能在未观测区域产生幻觉碰撞表面。这限制了高斯场景作为可编辑、可认证 3D 资产的可用性。
AI.method: Manifold-GS 提出分离外观不透明度与几何积分质量；将表面类高斯建模为离散无向变分形；仅导出置信度认证的开放表面补丁，将未认证内容保留为残差泼溅。同时提供精炼保守的质量输运、局部可实现性诊断、源保持的补丁绑定以及保守碰撞候选检测。
AI.result: 在三个 DTU 场景上，冻结资产基准实现了零补丁定义的编辑泄漏；纹理循环 PSNR 分别为 30.1/35.3/33.7 dB；在所有场景上碰撞浮动面积均低于官方 2DGS 网格，其中两个场景差距显著。此外，外部区域标注、幻影碰撞探针和 5k 面简化均支持认证资产解释，而仅 RGB 实验表明局部可实现性不足以保证稀疏视图下的表面可辨识性。
AI.conclusion: Manifold-GS 提供的是精度-覆盖率之间的权衡而非普适重建声明，引入了认证资产的概念，使 3DGS 场景能够输出经过认证的开放表面补丁与残差泼溅的混合表示，适合需要可编辑、可溯源和碰撞可控的资产应用场景。

title: Deep Research Pretraining via Predictive Navigation
comment: working in progress; correspondence to {ucaswu,maxwellyu}@tencent.com or wuxing@iie.ac.cn
summary: Deep research agents are often trained on expensive, environment-grounded tool-use trajectories that require repeated retrieval, document inspection, and report evaluation. We introduce Deep Research Pretraining (DRP), an offline framework that derives predictive navigation supervision from naturally occurring evidence structures. Given a citation-bearing or hyperlinked passage, DRP constructs a proxy research objective, recovers linked evidence and graph-related alternatives, and converts them into search-open-write trajectories. This teaches models what to search for, which documents to inspect, and how to synthesize evidence, without a live retrieval environment or executed policy rollout. We instantiate DRP on scholarly citation graphs (DRP-Paper) and Wikipedia hyperlinks (DRP-Web), continually pretrain separate Qwen3-14B-Base models on 1B tokens, and fine-tune them on controlled fractions of 13K agent trajectories. Across five independently sampled subsets at each low-data budget, both variants consistently outperform matched no-DRP models on DeepResearch Bench. With one quarter of the SFT data, DRP-Web even surpasses a fixed no-DRP full-data checkpoint, with gains transferring to ResearchQA, WebWalkerQA, and SimpleQA. Starting from matched low-data SFT checkpoints, the DRP-Web advantage also persists through subsequent agentic RL. Source-matched and evidence-mismatch controls indicate that these improvements arise from evidence-conditioned navigation rather than domain exposure or agent-format imitation. DRP thus provides a promising complementary approach to trajectory-based agent training.

AI.tldr: 提出Deep Research Pretraining (DRP)框架，利用自然存在的引用/超链接结构构造离线预训练目标，在没有实时检索环境的情况下训练深度研究智能体，教授模型搜索、文档检查和证据综合能力。在学术引用图和维基百科超链接上实例化，仅用1B token持续预训练和少量SFT数据即显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体的训练通常依赖昂贵的、环境交互式的工具使用轨迹（需要反复检索、文档检查和报告评估），成本高且难以扩展。作者希望利用自然存在的证据结构（引用、超链接）构造离线训练信号，降低对实时环境依赖和数据成本。
AI.method: 提出DRP框架，核心流程：(1) 从带有引用或超链接的段落构造代理研究目标；(2) 恢复关联证据及其图相关替代项；(3) 转换为搜索-打开-写作轨迹。在两个场景实例化：DRP-Paper（学术引用图）和DRP-Web（维基百科超链接），在Qwen3-14B-Base上以1B tokens持续预训练，然后在13K智能体轨迹的子集上微调。
AI.result: 在五个独立抽样的低数据预算子集上，两种DRP变体在DeepResearch Bench上均一致优于无DRP基线。仅用四分之一SFT数据，DRP-Web就能超过固定无DRP全量数据检查点，且收益可迁移到ResearchQA、WebWalkerQA和SimpleQA。从匹配的低数据SFT检查点出发，DRP-Web的优势在后续智能体RL阶段仍然保持。
AI.conclusion: 通过源匹配和证据不匹配的对照实验，证明DRP的改进源自证据条件导航能力，而非单纯的领域暴露或智能体格式模仿。DRP提供了一种与传统轨迹训练互补的、有前景的深度研究智能体训练方法。

title: Trust and Its Betrayal under Three Representational Strategies
summary: Trust is a propositional attitude of a distinctive kind: to trust is to rely on another under conditions where reliance could be disappointed, and the disappointment of trust---betrayal---differs qualitatively from the disappointment of a prediction. We treat trust as a \emph{subjunctive} epistemic state: $A$ trusts $B$'s competence when $A$ believes that \emph{were $P$ true, $B$ would know it}, and $B$'s integrity when $A$ believes that \emph{were $B$ to know $P$, he would disclose it to $A$}. We develop three representations of this state---as lexicographic \emph{assumption} as \emph{ordinal closeness} in a Lewis--Stalnaker sphere system , and as \emph{strong belief} in a conditional probability system and for each we ask whether the Brandenburger--Keisler impossibility on common belief survives when the assumption of rationality is replaced by an assumption of trustworthiness. The three representations agree that every \emph{finite} depth of common trust is realizable while the \emph{completed} common-trust fixed point is the locus of difficulty, but they differ sharply in \emph{how} the difficulty manifests, and---our organizing finding---in how each survives a concrete betrayal. W show that the same betrayal refutes an agent's \emph{level ordering} under the lexicographic representation, contaminates her \emph{closeness ordering} in proportion to the betrayer's deliberateness under the ordinal representation, and merely \emph{shifts her operative conditioning hypothesis} while leaving her belief structure coherent under the strong-belief representation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了信任作为一种虚拟（subjunctive）认知状态的形式化表征，提出了三种不同的表示框架——词典序假设、Lewis-Stalnaker球系统中的序数接近性、以及条件概率系统中的强信念——并考察了将Brandenburger-Keisler不可能性定理中的"理性假设"替换为"可信赖假设"后的结果。三种表示一致表明有限深度的共同信任可实现，而完整的共同信任不动点存在困难，但在背叛情境下三种表示的表现截然不同。
AI.motivation: 信任是与预测截然不同的命题态度，其核心特征在于"被背叛"与"预测失灵"在质性上的区别。作者希望超越简单地把信任当作概率信念来处理，而是将其刻画为一种虚拟条件句式的认知状态，并系统比较不同形式化框架在信任推理中的表现差异。
AI.method: 作者将信任分解为两个条件：A信任B的能力（若P为真，B会知道）和A信任B的诚实（若B知道P，会向A披露）。在此基础上构建三种表示：词典序假设（lexicographic assumption）、Lewis-Stalnaker球系统中的序数接近性（ordinal closeness）、条件概率系统中的强信念（strong belief）。然后将Brandenburger-Keisler的共同理性信念不可能性推广到共同信任的情形，考察三种表示下共同信任固定点的可实现性以及背叛对认知结构的具体影响。
AI.result: 三种表示均证明：任意有限深度的共同信任都可以实现，但完整的共同信任不动点存在困难。然而在具体背叛情境下三者表现分化：词典序表示中背叛会驳倒主体的层次排序；序数表示中背叛会以与背叛者故意程度成比例的方式污染其接近性排序；强信念表示中背叛仅会转移主体的条件化假设，但保持其信念结构的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 共同信任的可实现性问题（有限深度可实现、完整不动点困难）对表示框架具有鲁棒性，但背叛如何影响认知结构的机制则高度依赖于形式化选择。强信念表示在处理背叛时最为稳健，能够在不破坏信念一致性的前提下吸收背叛信息。

title: From field-scale to large-scale spectral libraries: Tabular foundation models in soil spectroscopy
summary: Visible and near-infrared (vis-NIR) and mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy enable rapid, cost-effective prediction of soil properties. Yet, translating high-dimensional, highly collinear spectra into accurate soil property predictions remains challenging, particularly when employing machine learning. We systematically investigated regression models and dimensionality reduction approaches for spectroscopic modeling across 85 regression tasks from open benchmark datasets in pedometrics spanning field-scale digital soil mapping and a global soil spectral library. We compared an in-context learning tabular foundation model (TabPFN), a convolutional neural network (CNN), rule-based regression (Cubist), Random Forest, and partial least squares regression (PLSR) using full spectra as well as features derived from principal component analysis (PCA) and partial least squares (PLS) latent variables. TabPFN consistently delivered the best overall performance across scales, including large spectral library tasks with tens of thousands of soil samples. Notably, TabPFN applied directly to full spectra already surpassed all classical baselines, showing that explicit dimensionality reduction is not strictly required for strong performance. Further improvements were achieved through PLS, which proved to be an effective dimensionality reduction strategy for all models. Combining PLS latent variables with TabPFN yielded the best predictions overall. Our findings provide evidence-based guidance for spectroscopic calibration model selection across operational scales, demonstrating that the long-standing advantages of PLSR and modern tabular foundation models complement each other in chemometrics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了多种回归模型和降维方法在85个土壤光谱回归任务中的表现，发现TabPFN（上下文学习表格基础模型）直接用于全光谱即可超越经典基线，而将PLS潜变量与TabPFN结合则取得最佳预测效果。
AI.motivation: 可见-近红外和中红外光谱技术能够快速廉价地预测土壤属性，但如何将高维、高度共线的光谱数据转化为准确的土壤属性预测仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在使用机器学习方法时。缺乏系统性的、基于循证证据的模型选择和降维策略指导。
AI.method: 在85个回归任务（涵盖田间尺度数字土壤制图和全球土壤光谱库）上，系统比较了五种方法：TabPFN（上下文学习表格基础模型）、卷积神经网络（CNN）、Cubist规则回归、随机森林和偏最小二乘回归（PLSR）。评估了使用全光谱以及PCA和PLS潜变量特征降维两种策略。
AI.result: TabPFN在包括包含数万土壤样本的大规模光谱库任务中，均表现出最佳的整体性能。TabPFN直接应用于全光谱已超越所有经典基线，说明显式降维并非获得强性能的必要条件。通过PLS降维可进一步提升所有模型的性能，其中将PLS潜变量与TabPFN结合获得了整体最优的预测结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究为不同操作尺度下的光谱校准模型选择提供了循证指导，证明长期占据优势的PLSR与现代表格基础模型在化学计量学中具有互补性。

title: Learning How Much, Not Just What: Cross-Patient Burden Order for CT Vision-Language Pretraining
summary: Volumetric CT vision-language pretraining learns 3D representations from scan-report pairs, but global and anatomy-aware objectives supervise only correspondence: they establish what is present and leave how much unconstrained. Nothing separates a mild from an extensive case of the same finding along a consistent direction, so the graded burden language in reports collapses into a present/absent signal. Longitudinal supervision would supply this order, but patient-matched CT pairs are scarce at scale; cross-sectional cohorts already encode weak burden cues across different patients. We introduce Spectrum, an anatomy-conditioned framework that represents each study at whole-study and organ scopes. For each organ-mapped pathology, a rule-based scorer mines confidence-filtered lower-to-higher pairs of different patients, and Burden-Direction Alignment (BDA) aligns the pathology-conditioned image delta with the report delta at each scope, separating that direction from its reverse. Because the endpoints are different people, a target-conditioned aligner first makes them comparable, so the delta reflects burden rather than between-patient variation. BDA further separates the selected direction from its reverse, anchors it to the observed higher-burden endpoint, and enforces consistency across ordered triplets. Since every pair is drawn within a single pathology, BDA is designed to constrain intra-class structure that image-report contrast alone never touches. Spectrum attains 85.6 zero-shot AUROC on CT-RATE and 72.7 on external RAD-ChestCT, with consistent gains in linear probing and retrieval. Weak cross-patient order is thus a scalable complement to anatomy-aware correspondence, yielding burden-aware CT representations without longitudinal data.

AI.tldr: 提出了Spectrum框架，通过跨患者弱监督的负担方向对齐（BDA），在不使用纵向数据的情况下学习负担感知的3D CT表征，在CT-RATE和RAD-ChestCT上分别达到85.6和72.7的零样本AUROC。
AI.motivation: 现有CT视觉-语言预训练只学习"是否存在"的对应关系，无法区分轻度与重度病例，导致报告中的分级负担语言被压缩为有/无的信号。纵向数据稀缺，但横断面数据中蕴含着不同患者之间的弱负担线索，需要被挖掘利用。
AI.method: Spectrum框架包含：(1) 以解剖条件（whole-study和organ两个范围）表示每个研究；(2) 基于规则的评分器为每个器官映射的病理挖掘置信度过滤的低到高负担患者对；(3) Burden-Direction Alignment (BDA) 通过目标条件对齐器消除患者间差异，使图像差异反映负担而非个体差异，同时将选定方向与反向分离，锚定到高负担端点，并在有序三元组上强制一致性；每次配对均在单一病理内进行，约束了图像-报告对比未触及的类内结构。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE上达到85.6零样本AUROC，在外部RAD-ChestCT上达到72.7，线性探测和检索任务均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 弱跨患者顺序是解剖感知对应的可扩展补充，无需纵向数据即可获得负担感知的CT表征，为分级负担语言的学习提供了新范式。

title: AdaMTP: An Adaptive Training Paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has emerged as an effective paradigm that augments a shared Large Language Model backbone with auxiliary heads, training the model to predict several future tokens in parallel to enrich its supervision signal and accelerate inference. However, existing training frameworks adopt a rigid, fixed-length prediction horizon, disregarding the highly non-uniform information density of natural language and code. Forcing the auxiliary heads to predict across high-entropy semantic boundaries injects noisy, conflicting training signals; because these heads share the backbone's latent representations, the resulting gradients backpropagate and interfere with the model's core capabilities. We propose AdaMTP, an adaptive training paradigm that dynamically aligns the prediction horizon with the intrinsic predictability of the sequence. At its core, an entropy-based segmentation algorithm leverages the base model to detect sudden surges in uncertainty as semantic boundaries, partitioning sequences into variable-length groups. Each token is assigned an adaptive prediction depth, and a dynamically masked MTP objective suppresses the loss for predictions that cross these boundaries, attenuating the noisy gradients that degrade the backbone. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and general benchmarks on three backbones (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-12B), AdaMTP consistently outperforms standard MTP in both task performance and inference speedup.

AI.tldr: AdaMTP提出了一种自适应多令牌预测训练范式，通过基于熵的语义边界检测动态调整预测深度，避免梯度噪声干扰骨干模型，在多个基准上优于标准MTP。
AI.motivation: 现有MTP训练框架采用固定长度的预测窗口，忽视了自然语言和代码中信息密度的不均匀性。强制辅助头跨越高熵语义边界进行预测会注入噪声和冲突的训练信号，这些梯度会反向传播并干扰模型核心能力。
AI.method: AdaMTP包含三个关键组件：1) 基于熵的序列分割算法，利用基础模型检测不确定性突增作为语义边界，将序列划分为可变长度组；2) 为每个令牌分配自适应预测深度；3) 动态掩码的MTP目标函数，抑制跨边界预测的损失，衰减干扰骨干模型的噪声梯度。
AI.result: 在三个骨干模型（Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-12B）上，跨越数学推理、代码生成和通用基准测试，AdaMTP在任务性能和推理加速方面均一致优于标准MTP。
AI.conclusion: 通过将预测视野与序列的内在可预测性对齐，AdaMTP有效地解决了固定窗口MTP的固有限制，证明了自适应预测深度能显著提升MTP范式在多个任务和模型架构上的表现。

title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
summary: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transformations. We develop an agent that combines algebraic task training, symbolic tools, and verifier-grounded optimization for this task. Rather than training only on the composite SOS task, we construct 1.35 million synthetic examples covering eight supporting polynomial tasks together with weighted-SOS decomposition. We first apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to direct algebra problems and simulated symbolic traces, and then use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-specific symbolic rewards. The SFT corpus contains no native tool-calling messages; at evaluation, the agent uses native SymPy calls for expansion, collection, reordering, and factorization. Every final SOS answer is checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. On held-out, same-generator synthetic problems, the full SFT+GRPO+tools system is the strongest of four evaluated configurations, reaching 78.96% verified success on weighted SOS, compared with 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks. Within this controlled setting, our work provides a case study of combining domain-specific skill training, executable tools, and verifier feedback, and may inform the design of tool-calling agents in other domains with exactly checkable outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在数学领域中的工具调用能力，具体针对加权平方和（weighted SOS）分解任务，开发了一个结合代数任务训练、符号工具和验证器反馈的智能体系统。
AI.motivation: 工具调用使LLM能够在问题求解过程中调用外部计算，在AI数学领域有重要应用。加权SOS分解是证明多项式非负性的可机器验证路径，但找到分解需要在不唯一的重组方案间做选择，并协调多种符号变换，这对LLM而言是一项具有挑战性的任务。
AI.method: 构建了135万个合成样本（覆盖八个支持的代数任务及加权SOS分解），先通过监督微调（SFT）训练直接代数问题和模拟符号轨迹，再使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）结合任务特定符号奖励进行强化学习。SFT语料不含原生工具调用消息，但在评估时智能体使用SymPy原生调用进行展开、收集、重排序和因式分解，最终答案通过精确展开和系数比较进行验证。
AI.result: 在保留的同生成器合成问题上，SFT+GRPO+tools系统在四种配置中表现最强，加权SOS验证成功率达78.96%（基座模型同样使用工具时为44.73%），九个多项式任务的平均准确率达91.75%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为结合领域技能训练、可执行工具和验证器反馈提供了一个受控条件下的案例研究，对具有精确可验证输出的其他领域中工具调用智能体的设计具有参考意义。

title: RHEA: Reliability-Harmonized Reconstruction and Assignment for Robust Multimodal-Attributed Graph Clustering
summary: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), whose nodes carry heterogeneous attributes such as text and images over a relational structure, have become a fundamental substrate for label-free entity grouping tasks, including community discovery and product segmentation. Existing MAG clustering methods effectively integrate complementary modalities when attributes are clean and complete, but degrade substantially under noisy or missing attributes because they implicitly assume equal modality reliability across all nodes. In practice, modality reliability is inherently node-specific: images may be corrupted or absent, while textual descriptions are incomplete or noisy. We argue that, under attribute homophily, graph neighborhoods naturally provide supervision-free evidence for estimating node-specific modality reliability. Based on this insight, we propose RHEA, a reliability-aware framework for MAG clustering that estimates node-specific modality reliability from neighborhood consensus and propagates this signal throughout the clustering pipeline. RHEA reconstructs unreliable or missing modalities from graph neighborhoods, adaptively weights modalities during reliability-aware fusion, and performs topology-aware optimal transport clustering with reliability-aware transport assignment and neighbor-consensus assignment distillation. Furthermore, the confidence of reconstructed representations is incorporated into the clustering objective, allowing uncertain reconstructions to contribute proportionally during optimization. Experiments on four MAG benchmarks under five attribute conditions show that RHEA consistently outperforms the strongest baseline, with NMI gains increasing as attribute quality deteriorates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RHEA框架，用于多模态属性图（MAG）聚类。针对节点属性噪声或缺失导致现有方法性能退化的问题，RHEA利用图邻域一致性估计节点级模态可靠性，并通过重建不可靠模态、自适应模态加权融合、拓扑感知最优传输聚类三个环节将可靠性信号贯穿聚类流程，在四种基准和五种属性条件下稳定超越最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MAG聚类方法假设所有节点的模态可靠性相同，在属性干净完整时表现良好，但在属性存在噪声或缺失时性能大幅下降。然而实际场景中模态可靠性本质上是节点特异的（如图像可能损坏或缺失，文本描述不完整或含噪），因此需要一种能够感知节点级模态可靠性的聚类方法。
AI.method: RHEA框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 利用图邻域一致性估计节点特异模态可靠性，并据此重建不可靠或缺失的模态；(2) 在可靠性感知融合过程中自适应地对各模态加权；(3) 执行拓扑感知最优传输聚类，包含可靠性感知的传输分配和邻居一致性分配蒸馏。此外，重建表征的置信度被纳入聚类目标函数，使不确定性重建按比例贡献优化。
AI.result: 在四个MAG基准数据集和五种属性条件下的实验表明，RHEA一致优于最强基线，且NMI提升幅度随属性质量恶化而增加，验证了其鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用属性同质性（attribute homophily）下图邻域提供的监督自由证据，RHEA成功解决了节点级模态可靠性差异问题，使MAG聚类在属性噪声和缺失场景下依然保持稳健性能。

title: Real-Time Visual Obstruction Detection in Surgical Augmented Reality
summary: Surgical augmented reality (AR) can provide contextual guidance by overlaying virtual annotations, tool cues, and procedural information onto the surgical workspace. However, the virtual content may obstruct task-relevant real-world information, such as surgical instruments, and interfere with users' perception during time-sensitive surgical tasks. In this paper, we investigate visual obstruction detection for surgical AR and present a latency-aware pipeline that combines vision-language model (VLM)-based surgical-object recognition with segmentation-based obstruction reasoning. To reduce inference overhead, the system adopts a cascaded small-to-large VLM architecture with segmentation-guided early exiting and attention-based visual token pruning. The small VLM handles easy frames when its key-object prediction is supported by segmentation consistency, while difficult frames are forwarded to a large VLM with pruned visual tokens. We construct a pseudo-AR surgical obstruction detection benchmark by overlaying virtual content onto surgical-tool images and labeling whether the virtual content obstructs task-relevant instruments. Evaluation results show that the proposed system achieves 87.43% obstruction detection accuracy with an average end-to-end latency of 479 ms, reducing latency by 62.90% compared with a cloud large-model baseline. These results demonstrate the feasibility of latency-aware obstruction detection for surgical AR and motivate future work on dynamic surgical videos, multi-object scenes, and clinically grounded AR guidance content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向手术增强现实（AR）的视觉遮挡检测系统，采用级联小-大视觉语言模型（VLM）架构，结合分割引导的提前退出和注意力视觉令牌剪枝技术，在保证87.43%遮挡检测准确率的同时，将端到端延迟降至479ms，相比云端大型模型基线降低了62.90%的延迟。
AI.motivation: 手术AR中的虚拟内容可能遮挡任务相关的真实世界信息（如手术器械），干扰医生在时间敏感手术中的感知。现有方法缺乏对虚拟内容遮挡真实器械的检测能力，因此需要一种低延迟的遮挡检测方案。
AI.method: 提出延迟感知的遮挡检测流水线：(1) 结合VLM手术器械识别与分割的遮挡推理；(2) 级联小-到-大VLM架构，小VLM处理简单帧（通过分割一致性验证关键物体预测），困难帧交由大VLM处理；(3) 采用分割引导的提前退出和基于注意力的视觉令牌剪枝来降低推理开销；(4) 构建了伪AR手术遮挡检测基准数据集。
AI.result: 系统达到87.43%的遮挡检测准确率，平均端到端延迟479ms，相比云端大型模型基线延迟降低62.90%，验证了延迟感知遮挡检测在手术AR中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明级联VLM架构配合分割引导的推理优化可有效实现手术AR中的实时遮挡检测，未来工作将扩展至动态手术视频、多物体场景及临床落地AR指导内容。

title: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Agentic Learning
summary: Recent Text-to-SQL systems increasingly rely on multi-turn interaction, execution feedback, and reinforcement learning. However, most existing methods use execution correctness only as a trajectory-level reward, which provides limited guidance for identifying the SQL decisions responsible for success or failure. We propose SERL-SQL, a selective execution-grounded reinforcement learning framework for multi-turn Text-to-SQL agents. SERL-SQL samples on-policy SQL interaction trajectories and uses a training-only teacher to re-score student actions with execution feedback. The resulting teacher--student likelihood gap is converted into bounded, masked weights that reweight GRPO advantages only on SQL and tool-action tokens. In this way, task rewards preserve the optimization direction, while execution hindsight provides localized credit assignment. Experiments on BIRD, Spider, and cross-domain benchmarks show that SERL-SQL achieves competitive performance, reaching 76.56% execution accuracy on BIRD-Dev and 89.92% on Spider-Test. Moreover, our reward-based selection strategy closely approaches the oracle Best-of-N upper bound and consistently outperforms consistency-based selection, showing that SERL-SQL produces high-quality candidates that can be reliably identified by lightweight execution-grounded rewards. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Ffunkytao/SERL-SQL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SERL-SQL，一个选择性的执行接地强化学习框架，用于多轮Text-to-SQL智能体。它通过训练专用的教师模型对学生动作进行执行反馈重评分，并将师生似然差距转化为有界掩码权重，仅对SQL和工具动作token重新加权GRPO优势，实现局部信用分配。在BIRD和Spider基准上达到76.56%和89.92%的执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统虽然越来越多地依赖多轮交互、执行反馈和强化学习，但大多数方法仅将执行正确性作为轨迹级奖励，无法为识别导致成功或失败的SQL决策提供细粒度指导，缺乏局部信用分配能力。
AI.method: SERL-SQL采样策略上的SQL交互轨迹，使用仅在训练阶段可用的教师模型对学生动作进行执行反馈重评分，将师生似然差距转化为有界、掩码的权重，仅对SQL和工具动作token上的GRPO优势进行重新加权，从而在保留任务奖励优化方向的同时，通过执行后见之明实现局部信用分配。
AI.result: 在BIRD、Spider和跨域基准上取得有竞争力的性能，BIRD-Dev上达到76.56%执行准确率，Spider-Test上达到89.92%。奖励驱动的选择策略接近oracle Best-of-N上限，并持续优于基于一致性的选择策略，证明SERL-SQL能产生高质量候选，且可被轻量级执行接地奖励可靠识别。
AI.conclusion: SERL-SQL通过选择性执行接地强化学习实现了细粒度的局部信用分配，有效提升多轮Text-to-SQL智能体的性能，其奖励驱动的候选选择策略展现出接近oracle上限的效果，代码已开源。

title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, and 6 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.

AI.tldr: RMSWeb是一个针对紧凑型Web智能体的三部分训练配方，包含反思条件重试（提高数据收集产量并缩短成功轨迹）、失败模式挖掘（将离线RL集中在关键状态）和Salvage-DS（结合动作语义极化奖励、对比能力门控动态采样和仅动作锚点）。在8B和32B的Qwen3-VL-Instruct上，RMSWeb相比SFT在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和WebTailBench上提升了1.2-7.7个点，同时减少了最多19.7%的动作步数。
AI.motivation: 紧凑型Web智能体可以降低部署成本，但训练面临两大挑战：成功轨迹收集成本高昂且包含低效绕路；SFT后的强化学习阶段，全轨迹语料库被常规状态主导，动作级奖励设计不当会导致弱化或误导的相对更新，且被拒绝的组别缺乏回退学习信号。
AI.method: RMSWeb包含三个部分：(1) 反思条件重试（Reflection-conditioned retries）：通过反思机制提高收集产量并缩短成功轨迹；(2) 失败模式挖掘（Failure-mode mining）：将离线RL集中在SFT策略暴露的关键失败状态上；(3) Salvage-DS：结合动作语义极化奖励（action-semantic polarized reward）、对比与能力门控动态采样（contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling），以及针对被拒绝组别的仅动作锚点（action-only anchor）。
AI.result: 使用反思收集数据训练的策略在已解决任务上减少了最多19.7%的动作步数。在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和WebTailBench上，RMSWeb相比SFT在8B模型上提升2.4-7.0个点，在32B模型上提升1.2-7.7个点。8B模型在Online-Mind2Web上达到同规模开源模型中最强结果，并在WebVoyager和WebTailBench上实现领先的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: RMSWeb通过三部分配方有效解决了紧凑Web智能体训练中的数据收集和RL信号设计问题，在性能和效率上均取得显著改进，展示了在较小模型上实现优异性价比的潜力。不过需要注意外部评估协议差异可能影响结果对比。

title: Towards Effective Federated Multimodal Graph Learning via Navigating Multifaceted Heterogeneity
summary: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), where nodes carry heterogeneous semantic content across multiple modalities while edges encode relational dependencies, have been widely adopted across diverse domains. Federated multimodal graph learning (FMGL) extends federated graph learning (FGL) to MAGs, enabling collaborative optimization across decentralized MAGs without exposing raw data. However, naively applying existing FGL methods to FMGL is insufficient, as they fail to navigate the multifaceted heterogeneity inherent in decentralized MAGs, including task heterogeneity across diverse client objectives, modality heterogeneity from discrepant modality quality and semantic domains, and topology heterogeneity arising from divergent topological patterns with low cross-modality correlation. To address these challenges, we propose Federated multimodal graph learning with Topology-aware Cross-modal Routing (FedTCR), the first systematic algorithm designed for FMGL. To handle task heterogeneity, FedTCR employs a two-stage paradigm that comprises federated task-agnostic pre-training followed by isolated task-oriented fine-tuning. To jointly address modality and topology heterogeneity, FedTCR introduces a topology-aware cross-modal routing mechanism. Concretely, each client distills modality-specific knowledge into compact prototypes via topology-aware importance-weighted aggregation informed by graph structure; the server then evaluates cross-client cross-modal relationships among these structure-informed prototypes and routes informative ones as contrastive references, driving a tri-level cross-modal contrastive learning scheme that jointly aligns cross-client modalities while preserving discrimination. Experiments across 7 domains demonstrate that FedTCR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both graph-centric and modality-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedTCR，首个面向联邦多模态图学习的系统性算法，通过两阶段范式（任务无关预训练+任务定向微调）应对任务异质性，并通过拓扑感知跨模态路由机制联合解决模态与拓扑异质性，在7个领域上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 联邦多模态图学习(FMGL)面临三重异质性挑战：任务异质性（不同客户端目标多样）、模态异质性（模态质量与语义域不一致）、拓扑异质性（拓扑模式差异大且跨模态相关性低）。现有联邦图学习方法无法有效应对这些挑战，需要新的系统化方法。
AI.method: FedTCR包含两大核心设计：(1)两阶段范式——联邦任务无关预训练加隔离的任务定向微调，解决任务异质性；(2)拓扑感知跨模态路由机制——客户端通过图结构感知的重要性加权聚合，将模态特定知识蒸馏为紧凑原型；服务器评估跨客户端跨模态关系并路由信息性原型作为对比参考，驱动三级跨模态对比学习，联合对齐跨客户端模态同时保持判别性。
AI.result: 在7个领域的实验中，FedTCR在图中心任务和模态中心任务上均优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedTCR是首个为FMGL设计的系统性算法，通过两阶段范式和拓扑感知跨模态路由机制有效应对任务、模态和拓扑三重异质性，展示了在跨领域联邦多模态图学习中的优越性能。

title: Attention-Steered Vision-Language Models for Sign Language Translation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful framework for multimodal video understanding. However, they remain limited in the sign language translation task, where we identify a key failure mode of existing VLMbased translators: poor spatial-temporal visual grounding. In particular, we find that standard next-token cross-entropy does not directly provide signal for where and when the model should attend, causing models to overlook sign-relevant regions and frames. To address this challenge, we propose AttnSign, a VLM-based spatial-temporal attention steering framework for sign language translation. AttnSign first introduces spatial attention supervision for sign-relevant regions, such as face and hands, in each frame; then develops an RL-based motion-cadence steering method that encourages the model to explore and focus on sign-level keyframes. Experimental results on How2Sign and OpenASL benchmarks show that our proposed AttnSign consistently outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: AttnSign 是一个面向手语翻译的 VLM 时空注意力引导框架，通过空间注意力监督（聚焦面部和手部区域）和基于强化学习的运动节奏引导（探索关键帧）来解决现有 VLM 在手语翻译中时空视觉接地不足的问题，在 How2Sign 和 OpenASL 基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在手语翻译任务中表现受限，关键失败模式是空间-时间视觉接地能力差。标准的 next-token 交叉熵损失无法直接为模型提供"应关注何处、何时关注"的信号，导致模型忽略与手语相关的区域和帧。
AI.method: 提出 AttnSign 框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 空间注意力监督，引导模型关注每帧中手语相关的关键区域（如脸部和手部）；(2) 基于强化学习的运动节奏引导方法，鼓励模型探索并聚焦手语级别的关键帧。
AI.result: 在 How2Sign 和 OpenASL 两个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，AttnSign 持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式地对模型的注意力进行空间和时间两个维度的引导，可以有效提升 VLM 在手语翻译任务中的表现，验证了注意力引导方法在解决多模态视频理解中视觉接地问题上的有效性。

title: The methodology of Constructing the Large-Scale Dataset for Detecting Presuicidal and Anti-Suicidal Signals in Social Media Texts in Russian
summary: The suicide is a terrifying act of a person who is misled by his own mental state. This problem arises across many countries. Sadly, Russia also has quite high number of persons who committed suicide. Luckily, a subset of these people writes their struggles in social media, allowing a way to find them and help. However, these valuable texts disappearing in many irrelevant texts which is considerably slowing down the decision process about person's suicidal risk. To tackle this problem, in this work we have presented a detailed methodology of building the dataset for detecting texts that describe presuicidal and anti-suicidal signals. This methodology describes the process of instruction and class table creation, the process of annotation, verification and post-annotation correction. Guiding by this methodology, we collect and annotate a large-scale Russian dataset with more than 50 thousand texts from social media. We provide a count statistic of the dataset as well as common problems in annotation. We also conduct basic experiments of building the classification models to show the on go performance on different levels of annotation. Furthermore, we make the dataset, code and all materials publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于检测社交媒体文本中自杀前和反自杀信号的详细数据集构建方法论，并据此构建了包含超过5万条俄语社交媒体文本的大规模数据集，同时进行了基础分类实验验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 自杀问题在许多国家都很严重，俄罗斯的自杀率也较高。部分有自杀倾向的人会在社交媒体上写下自己的挣扎，但这些有价值的文本被大量无关文本淹没，严重减慢了判断个人自杀风险的决策过程。因此需要构建高质量的数据集来帮助检测此类文本。
AI.method: 提出了一套完整的数据集构建方法论，包括：1) 指令和类别表的创建过程；2) 标注流程；3) 验证过程；4) 标注后修正。据此收集并标注了超过5万个俄语社交媒体文本，并进行了基础分类模型的实验。
AI.result: 构建了包含超过5万条俄语社交媒体文本的大规模数据集，提供了数据集的计数统计和标注中的常见问题，并通过基础实验展示了不同标注级别下的分类模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为检测自杀前和反自杀信号的文本分类提供了公开可用的数据集、代码及相关材料，有助于加速该领域的研究和实际应用。

title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.

AI.tldr: 本文通过十二组agent-领域对照实验（涵盖医学、选举取证和地缘政治预测），证明AI代理在固定数值证据但改变情境框架时，会得出不同结论，其决策显著受到先验信念的影响。
AI.motivation: AI代理越来越多地执行开放式任务，其结论可能指导关键决策。然而，代理的决策是否受到任务之外的因素（如先验信念）影响尚不清楚，这可能构成委派决策给AI代理的风险。
AI.method: 作者在医学、选举取证和地缘政治预测三个高风险领域设计实验：保持数值证据不变，仅改变证据所出现的情境框架（如命题是否与代理先验信念一致），在十四个代理-领域组合中比较其结论是否变化，同时分析代理的搜索行为、分析规范和证据评估方式。
AI.result: 代理的结论受先验信念强烈影响：当情境框架与其已认为可能的主张一致时，更倾向于得出肯定结论；反之则相反。框架还改变了代理的工作方式——搜索范围更广、选择不同分析规范、对相同证据评估不同。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了一个委派决策给AI代理的特定风险：代理的决策可能依赖于任务中未明确说明、且在决策记录中不可见的先验信念，从而影响决策的可靠性和可解释性。

title: Relative Parameter Importance in Task-Agnostic Replay-Free Continual Learning
comment: Accepted for publication at the SCL Workshop, ECML-PKDD 2026
summary: Achieving continual learning (CL) with deep neural networks requires balancing stability and plasticity while enabling knowledge transfer. In this work, we focus on offline learning algorithms under the constraints: (I) no access to training data from prior tasks (II) no access to task-id at inference time. We introduce a novel measure, the relative parameter-importance, which measures the relative importance of each parameter with respect to both the current and past tasks. Parameters with high relative importance are interpreted as more important for maintaining past-task stability and thus heavily regularised, whereas parameters with low relative-importance are allowed to be more freely updated. Unlike existing methods, our approach allows the update of parameters with high past-task importance when they have low relative-importance, thus enabling backward knowledge transfer in addition to tackling the stability-plasticity trade-off. We demonstrate improvements against state-of-the-art CL methods on both class-incremental and domain-incremental learning text classification problems and provide insights for extending our method to text generation problems. Code available at: https://github.com/itsmemala/LACL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的持续学习方法（LACL），引入"相对参数重要性"度量，在无旧任务数据和任务ID的条件下，通过区分参数对当前与过去任务的重要性来平衡稳定性与可塑性，同时支持反向知识迁移。在类增量和域增量的文本分类任务上超越了现有的持续学习方法。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中需要平衡稳定性（保持过去任务性能）与可塑性（学习新任务），同时实现知识迁移。现有方法大多只关注正向迁移，且在处理无任务ID和无旧数据约束下的离线学习时效果有限。作者希望提出一种能同时处理稳定性-可塑性权衡并支持反向知识迁移的方法。
AI.method: 引入"相对参数重要性"（relative parameter-importance）度量，衡量每个参数相对于当前任务和过去任务的重要性。高相对重要性的参数被重度正则化以维持过去任务的稳定性，低相对重要性的参数可自由更新。与现有方法不同，即使参数对过去任务高度重要，只要其相对重要性低，也允许更新，从而在解决稳定性-可塑性权衡的同时实现反向知识迁移。
AI.result: 在类增量学习和域增量学习的文本分类问题上，该方法相对于现有的持续学习方法（SOTA）展现了性能提升。此外，文章还提供了将该方法扩展到文本生成问题的见解。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入相对参数重要性概念，该方法在无旧数据和无任务ID的约束下有效地解决了持续学习的稳定性-可塑性权衡，并额外实现了反向知识迁移，在文本分类任务上取得了优于现有方法的表现。

title: Latent-Centroid Steering: Single-Pass Classifier-Free Guidance for Command-Aligned Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving, enabling agents to map multimodal inputs and high-level navigation instructions directly to executable trajectories. However, in practice, these models exhibit a persistent command-following gap: predicted trajectories often show weak sensitivity to navigation commands, resulting in incorrect behavior at critical decision points. We identify this issue as a form of conditional policy collapse, where regression-based training under multimodal trajectory distributions encourages the model to rely on dominant visual priors while marginalizing the language-conditioned signal. To address this issue, we introduce a principled formulation of classifier-free guidance (CFG) for regression-based vision-language driving. We show that CFG can be interpreted as isolating the instruction-induced residual in the action space by contrasting conditional and unconditional predictions, thereby explicitly amplifying the effect of the navigation command at inference time. However, a standard two-pass CFG introduces prohibitive latency for real-time control and produces noisy instance-level guidance directions. Building on a mean-shift interpretation of CFG, we propose Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS), a single-pass guidance mechanism that replaces instance-level residuals with class-level latent shifts. By projecting conditional representations toward precomputed command-specific centroids, LCS performs class-level latent steering based on cluster geometry that is both more stable and computationally efficient. We demonstrate that LCS reduces inference latency by approximately 50% while achieving stronger command adherence and improved driving performance on both closed-loop (Bench2Drive) and open-loop (nuScenes) benchmarks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶中存在的命令跟随缺陷问题，提出了一种基于无分类器引导（CFG）原理的潜质心引导（LCS）机制，通过将条件表征投影到预计算的命令特定质心上，实现单遍推理的高效引导，在降低约50%推理延迟的同时提升命令遵循度和驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: VLM在端到端自动驾驶中虽然前景广阔，但存在持久的命令跟随差距：预测轨迹对导航命令的敏感度弱，在关键决策点行为失误。作者将其识别为一种条件策略崩溃——在多模态轨迹分布下基于回归的训练使模型依赖主导的视觉先验，而边缘化了语言条件信号。
AI.method: 1) 将CFG重新表述为在动作空间中隔离指令诱导残差的方法（对比条件与非条件预测）；2) 基于CFG的均值偏移（mean-shift）解释，提出Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS)，将实例级残差替换为类级潜在位移；3) 通过将条件表征向预计算的命令特定质心投影，实现基于簇几何的类级潜在引导，实现单遍推理。
AI.result: LCS将推理延迟减少约50%，同时在闭环（Bench2Drive）和开环（nuScenes）基准上实现了更强的命令遵循度和更好的驾驶性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过理论化CFG在回归式视觉语言驾驶中的作用，并提出计算高效的LCS机制，有效解决了VLM驾驶中的条件策略崩溃问题，在效率和性能之间取得了良好平衡。

title: The Learning Objective Governs Perceptual Narrowing: A Cross-Lingual, Layer-Wise, Ten-Seed Study of Self-Supervised Speech Encoders
summary: Perceptual narrowing---the developmental loss of non-native phoneme discrimination in the first year of life \citep{werker1984}---is a canonical developmental finding, yet \emph{what learning objective produces it} remains open. We train a \(\sim\)7\,M-parameter Transformer encoder on child-directed and read speech and evaluate phoneme ABX in English, French, and Mandarin over ten seeds, the seed as the unit of replication. Six results. \textbf{(1)}~The objective sets the direction of cross-lingual transfer: reconstruction (masked mel-prediction) degrades non-native discrimination, prediction (frame-contrastive) improves it---a same-encoder, same-data gap of \(+0.051\) in first-layer Mandarin ABX (\(p=3\times10^{-8}\)), unanimous in sign across twenty runs. \textbf{(2)}~That decline combines a large arm-intrinsic difficulty gradient with a smaller language-specialization effect (matched vs.\ mismatched \(+0.022\), \(p=10^{-4}\), all four layers). \textbf{(3)}~Against a language-symmetric raw-mel floor, reconstruction pushes the first layer \emph{below} the discriminability of its input; prediction pushes it \emph{above}. \textbf{(4)}~Read speech gives a \(3.6\times\) steeper non-native decline than child-directed speech. \textbf{(5)}~The customary three-seed budget cannot see this reliably: an effect unambiguous at ten seeds is called significant by as few as 70\% of three-seed subsets. \textbf{(6)}~Six objective configurations---sharpening, compression, consolidation, their composition, and word-level semantic grounding in two forms---fail to produce the full developmental signature (native improves \emph{and} non-native declines): a single objective moves both languages the same way because it acts on a shared representation. We conclude that the objective, not the architecture, is the first-order determinant of narrowing-shaped representational change.

AI.tldr: 本研究训练约700万参数的Transformer编码器，在儿童导向语音和朗读语音上评估英语、法语和普通话的语音音素ABX辨别能力（10个随机种子作为复制单元）。核心发现：（1）预训练目标决定跨语言迁移方向——重建目标（掩码梅尔预测）损害非母语辨别，而预测目标（帧对比）改善之，同编码器、同数据下第一层普通话ABX差异达+0.051（p=3×10⁻⁸）；（2）该下降由较大的内在难度梯度和较小的语言专门化效应共同构成；（3）重建使第一层低于输入的原始梅尔可辨性下限，预测则使其高于上限；（4）朗读语音比儿童导向语音产生3.6倍更陡峭的非母语下降；（5）常规三种子预算不可靠，十种子明确的效应仅70%的三种子子集能达到显著；（6）六种目标配置（锐化、压缩、巩固、组合及两种词级语义锚定）均无法产生完整的发展特征（母语改善且非母语下降）。结论：预训练目标而非架构是塑造窄化型表征变化的一阶决定因素。
AI.motivation: 感知窄化（perceptual narrowing）是发展心理学中的经典发现——婴儿在生命第一年中丧失对非母语音素的辨别能力。尽管这一现象已被广泛证实，但其背后的学习目标（learning objective）究竟是什么仍然悬而未决。本文旨在探究何种学习目标能够产生这种发展性窄化现象。
AI.method: 使用约700万参数的Transformer编码器，在儿童导向语音（child-directed speech）和朗读语音（read speech）上进行训练，并在英语、法语和普通话三种语言上评估音素ABX辨别任务。采用10个随机种子作为复制单位。核心对比实验设置：同一编码器、同一数据条件下，对比重建目标（masked mel-prediction）与预测目标（frame-contrastive）的效果。此外测试了六种目标配置：锐化、压缩、巩固、组合，以及两种词级语义锚定形式。
AI.result: 六个主要结果：（1）目标设定决定跨语言迁移方向：重建损害而非预测改善非母语辨别（第一层普通话ABX差异+0.051，p=3×10⁻⁸，20次运行符号一致）；（2）下降由大的内在难度梯度加较小的语言专门化效应组成（+0.022，p=10⁻⁴）；（3）重建将第一层推至输入原始梅尔可辨性之下，预测推至之上；（4）朗读语音的非母语下降斜率是儿童导向语音的3.6倍；（5）三种子预算不可靠，仅70%的三种子子集能检测到显著效应；（6）六种目标配置均无法产生完整的"母语改善且非母语下降"发展特征，因为单一目标作用于共享表征会同时推动两种语言向同一方向变化。
AI.conclusion: 预训练目标（objective）而非架构是塑造窄化型表征变化的一阶决定因素。研究还强调了种子数量对统计效力至关重要——惯常的三种子预算不足以可靠检测此类效应，至少需要更多种子才能获得稳定的统计结论。

title: Gene Ontology-Guided Hierarchical Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology Images
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Code: https://github.com/NozomiMizore/MSGR
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histopathology images enables large-scale transcriptomic profiling without the cost of direct measurement. Existing methods decode the target gene set as a flat, unstructured vector, ignoring the inter-gene dependencies arising from shared biological pathways and regulatory programs. Without explicit structural guidance, models must infer these dependencies entirely from limited paired data, constraining prediction quality. We propose MSGR (Multi-Scale Gene Refiner), which bridges this gap by incorporating the Gene Ontology (GO), a curated functional hierarchy of genes, as an explicit structural prior. MSGR organizes target genes into a four-level GO tree. Its GO-guided decoder then progressively refines predictions from coarse functional domains to fine individual genes via residual corrections under scale-weighted supervision. Operating solely on the gene side, the GO-guided decoder serves as a seamless plug-in replacement that consistently improves existing architectures without requiring any image-side modifications. Extensive experiments on nine datasets from the HEST-1k benchmark provide empirical evidence for two central claims: GO-structured decoding consistently outperforms flat decoding, even against a state-of-the-art generative baseline, and the gain is attributable to biological ontology structure rather than hierarchical decomposition per se, as confirmed by a +0.027 margin over a structurally equivalent random hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSGR（多尺度基因细化器），通过引入基因本体论（GO）作为显式结构先验，将目标基因组织成语义树结构并渐进细化预测，从而在组织病理图像中预测空间基因表达，在HEST-1k基准的九个数据集上持续超越平面解码方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将目标基因集编码为扁平、无结构的向量，忽略了基因间因共享生物通路和调控程序而产生的依赖关系。由于缺乏显式结构指导，模型只能从有限的配对数据中推断这些依赖，限制了预测质量。
AI.method: MSGR将基因组织为四层GO树，采用GO引导的解码器从粗粒度的功能域到细粒度的单个基因通过残差校正逐步细化预测，并在不同尺度下应用加权监督。该解码器仅作用于基因侧，可作为即插即用的替代模块，无需修改图像侧架构。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k基准的九个数据集上，GO结构化解码一致性地优于平面解码，包括胜过最先进的生成式基线；相比结构等价的随机层级，性能提升+0.027，证实增益来自生物本体论结构本身而非层级分解本身。
AI.conclusion: 将基因本体论作为显式结构先验可以有效提升从病理图像预测空间基因表达的准确率，该结构增益源于生物语义组织而非单纯的分层分解，验证了先验知识在基因表达预测任务中的价值。

title: Learning the Pareto Frontier of Predictive Models under Distribution Shift
summary:
Modern machine learning pipelines increasingly rely on reusing pretrained and foundation models across downstream tasks. These pretrained models can differ not only in performance but also in how they can be used: some only provide black-box predictions, while others may permit white-box access to internal representations that can be probed or fine-tuned. When deployed to the target domain in the presence of distribution shift, no single strategy, including zero-shot application, fine-tuning, or directly training a target-specific model, is uniformly the best.
  In this work, we propose Frontier Learning, a framework that treats a library of candidate models spanning different training histories and access regimes as complementary sources of information rather than mutually exclusive alternatives. Frontier Learning constructs a unified target-domain feature by concatenating internal representations from white-box candidates as well as prediction outputs from black-box candidates, then fits a lightweight, regularized supervised learner on this concatenated representation using labeled target data. Because the resulting hypothesis class contains predictors obtained by zero-shot reuse, fine-tuning, and direct training as special cases, empirical risk minimization over the frontier learner is guaranteed to be no worse, on the training sample, than any individual baseline.
  We evaluate the framework in simulations spanning varying degrees of source-target compatibility and in two real-world distribution-shift settings: visual domain adaptation on DomainNet/VisDA and clinical mortality prediction across intensive care unit domains using MIMIC-IV-Notes. Across all settings, Frontier Learning matches or outperforms the strongest individual reuse strategy, with the largest gains arising precisely when no single baseline is reliable across the range of shift considered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Frontier Learning框架，将来自不同训练历程和访问模式（白盒/黑盒）的预训练模型视为互补信息源，通过拼接内部表征和预测输出构建统一目标域特征，再训练轻量级正则化监督学习器。理论上保证其在训练样本上不差于任何单一基线（零样本、微调、直接训练），实验在模拟和真实分布漂移场景中一致优于或持平最强单一策略。
AI.motivation: 现代ML管线依赖预训练/基础模型，但不同模型在性能和使用方式（黑盒预测vs白盒内部表征）上有差异；在分布漂移下，没有任何单一策略（零样本、微调、直接训练）普遍最优。现有方法将候选模型视为互斥选项，忽略了它们可以互补利用的可能性。
AI.method: Frontier Learning框架：1）将白盒候选模型的内部表征和黑盒候选模型的预测输出进行拼接，形成统一的目标域特征；2）在此拼接特征上拟合一个轻量级正则化监督学习器；3）由于该假设类包含零样本复用、微调和直接训练作为特例，经验风险最小化在训练样本上保证不差于任何单一基线。
AI.result: 在模拟实验（变化源-目标兼容性程度）和两个真实分布漂移场景（DomainNet/VisDA视觉域适应、MIMIC-IV-Notes临床死亡预测）中，Frontier Learning匹配或超越了最强单一复用策略；当没有任何单一基线在整个漂移范围内可靠时，其增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Frontier Learning提供了一种统一且理论上可保证的框架，将来自不同访问模式和训练历史的模型作为互补信息源综合利用，在分布漂移下稳健地优于或持平最优单一策略，尤其在最困难的场景中增益最大。

title: Semantically Calibrated Evidence Composition for CT Vision-Language Learning
summary: Learning transferable representations from CT-report pairs requires combining whole-volume context with anatomy-specific evidence. Existing methods typically emphasize either global CT-report alignment or fine-grained anatomy-level correspondence. Global alignment preserves broad study context but leaves the contribution of localized evidence implicit, whereas anatomy-level alignment explicitly grounds local findings but does not specify how independently represented evidence should interact, acquire study-level meaning, and contribute to a global CT representation. To address this gap, we propose SCOPE (Semantic Calibration Of comPosed Evidence), a framework for semantically calibrated evidence composition in CT vision-language learning. Under organ-specific report supervision, mask-guided queries with fixed anatomical identities extract context-aware organ evidence from shared, uncropped volumetric features, while an unrestricted global query retains access to whole-volume context. The global query then drives Local-Global Coupling to compose the organ evidence into a unified evidence representation. The composed evidence is subsequently calibrated using the diagnostic summary, providing study-level semantic supervision beyond local organ descriptions, and is finally integrated as a controlled residual into a context-preserving whole-volume representation aligned with the complete report. This progressive pathway connects localized evidence with study-level semantics without reducing the CT representation to a predefined set of organs. On CT-RATE and RadChestCT, SCOPE achieves macro AUCs of 85.0 and 72.2, respectively, outperforming the previous SOTA by 7.2 and 4.2, while also yielding substantial gains in linear probing and cross-modal retrieval. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of semantically calibrated evidence composition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE框架，用于CT视觉-语言学习中的语义校准证据组合。通过掩码引导查询提取器官级证据，由全局查询进行局部-全局耦合组合，再利用诊断摘要进行语义校准，最终以受控残差方式整合到保留上下文的整体卷表示中。在CT-RATE和RadChestCT上分别达到85.0和72.2的宏观AUC，超过先前SOTA 7.2和4.2。
AI.motivation: 现有CT视觉-语言学习方法存在两难：全局对齐保留了整体上下文但局部证据贡献不明确；解剖级对齐显式锚定局部发现但未说明独立证据如何交互、获得研究级语义并贡献于全局CT表示。需要弥合局部证据与整体语义之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: SCOPE框架包含三个关键组件：(1)在器官特定报告监督下，具有固定解剖身份的掩码引导查询从未裁剪的共享体积特征中提取上下文感知的器官证据，同时一个不受限制的全局查询保留整体卷上下文；(2)局部-全局耦合机制由全局查询驱动，将器官证据组合为统一的证据表示；(3)使用诊断摘要对组合证据进行语义校准，提供超出局部器官描述的研级语义监督，最终作为受控残差整合到与完整报告对齐的上下文保留整体卷表示中。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE和RadChestCT基准上，SCOPE分别取得85.0和72.2的宏观AUC，较之前SOTA提升7.2和4.2；在线性探测和跨模态检索任务上也有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE通过渐进式通路将局部证据与研级语义连接起来，同时不将CT表示简化为预定义器官集合，证明了语义校准证据组合的有效性。

title: Rethinking and formalising the state across languages: a unified computational learning theory account
summary: The linguistic notion of state has traditionally been restricted to the construct (annexation) state of Afroasiatic languages and treated as a language-specific morphosyntactic phenomenon. This article argues instead that the state is a systemic, context-dependent morphosyntactic mechanism that selects grammatical templates across synthetic languages. Within the Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework, taking Riffian as its primary empirical basis, the proposed theory provides a unified explanation for diverse nominal marking patterns traditionally analysed independently and is formalised as a symbolic computational model in which the state is represented by a set-valued function over grammatical templates. A learning algorithm based on finite-set operations acquires and predicts state-dependent grammatical configurations. Beyond nominal morphology, the framework has broader implications for theories of nominal structure and lexical cognition, in particular offering a unified analysis of determiner-noun structure. These results suggest that the state constitutes one instance of a broader class of syntactically conditioned dependencies that also includes agreement and grammatical case.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战传统将"状态"(state)限制于亚非语系建构格的观点，提出状态是一种跨综合语言的、系统性的、依赖上下文形态句法机制。基于模板模块化认知框架，以里夫语为实证基础，将状态形式化为符号计算模型中的集值函数，并用有限集运算的学习算法获取和预测状态依赖的语法配置。
AI.motivation: 传统语言学将"状态"概念仅限于亚非语系语言的建构(annexation)格，被视为特定语言的形态句法现象。作者认为这种看法过于狭隘，主张状态应该被重新理解为一种跨语言的系统性机制，从而为多样化的名词标记模式提供统一解释。
AI.method: 基于模板模块化认知框架(Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework)，以里夫语(Riffian)为主要实证基础，将状态形式化为一个集值函数(set-valued function)，该函数作用于语法模板。提出基于有限集运算的学习算法来获取和预测状态依赖的语法配置。
AI.result: 该框架为传统上独立分析的各种名词标记模式提供了统一解释，并对名词结构和词汇认知理论产生更广泛影响，特别是在限定词-名词结构的统一分析方面。结果表明状态构成了一类更广泛的句法条件依赖关系（还包括一致关系和语法格）中的一个实例。
AI.conclusion: 状态不应被视为语言特定的边缘现象，而是综合语言中一种普遍存在的、上下文依赖的形态句法机制。该研究不仅统一了名词标记分析，还将状态置于更广泛的句法依赖类型学背景中，暗示其与一致标记和语法格共享相似的系统性特征。

title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
summary: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多义词（polysemy）在文本和图像两种模态中的表达差异。通过对17个文本到图像模型和15个文本生成模型进行实验，发现模型在图像生成时产生的词义多样性远低于文本生成（归一化熵0.10 vs 0.25），两者都远低于人类想象中的语义多样性（0.47）。此外，当让模型预测自己输出各词义的概率分布时，其预测比实际的输出分布更多样化，揭示了基础模型中跨模态的"多模态鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 人类语言具有高度多义性，许多常见词汇携带多种不同含义。虽然已有研究表明大语言模型（LLMs）能够理解词义的多样性，但关于多义词在其他模态（如图像）中如何呈现的研究很少。作者希望探究基础模型在图像和文本两种模态之间对多义词意义表达的一致性。
AI.method: 研究选取多义词作为刺激材料，不给任何上下文以固定词义，分别向17个文本到图像模型和15个文本生成模型提供多义词，通过多次采样测量每种词义被生成的概率（即词义的分布多样性），并用归一化熵（normalized entropy）作为多样性指标进行比较。此外，还让模型直接预测其输出各词义的概率分布，与实际采样结果进行对比。
AI.result: 发现存在明显的多模态鸿沟：同一模型家族中，生成的图像比生成的句子涵盖的词义更少（归一化熵0.10 vs 0.25），而两者都比人们想象中同一词语的词义分布更不多样（人类为0.47）。同时，模型对自身输出分布的预测比实际输出分布更加多样化。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一种多模态差距：基础模型对词义的理解在不同模态间并未忠实地、平等地转移。模型对自身语义理解（自我预测）与实际输出之间存在系统性偏差，提示基础模型在跨模态表达词义方面存在局限性。

title: Mitigating Backdoors via Decoy Shortcuts and Knowledge Decoupling
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to deep neural networks, especially when training relies on third-party data, allowing adversaries to inject malicious behaviors through data poisoning. In this work, we reveal that backdoor behaviors tend to be absorbed by a simpler parallel branch when jointly trained with the main network. Motivated by this insight, we propose Trapping and Removing (TR), a simple yet effective training-time defense that introduces a lightweight shortcut branch as a "honeypot" to trap backdoor knowledge. After training, backdoors can be removed by discarding the shortcut, without requiring any additional data. To further enhance backdoor isolation while maintaining benign performance, we design a knowledge decoupling strategy with entropy-based weight assignment, encouraging poisoned samples to flow through the honeypot while guiding the main network to focus on benign learning. In addition, we introduce an automatic shortcut generation strategy to improve generalization across model architectures. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets and five model architectures demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates a wide range of backdoor attacks while preserving performance on benign data. Code: https://github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR}{github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TR（Trapping and Removing）的训练时后门防御方法。该方法利用后门行为在联合训练时倾向于被简单并行分支吸收的特性，引入一个轻量级"蜜罐"分支来诱捕后门知识，训练后通过丢弃该分支即可移除后门，无需额外数据。TR结合基于熵的权重分配的知識解耦策略，以及自动捷径生成策略，在四个基准数据集和五种模型架构上有效缓解了多种后门攻击，同时保持了良性数据性能。
AI.motivation: 后门攻击对深度神经网络构成严重威胁，尤其是在依赖第三方数据训练时。现有防御方法往往需要额外数据或修改模型结构，缺乏一种简单有效且无需额外数据的训练时防御方案。
AI.method: 1) 轻量级捷径分支作为"蜜罐"诱捕后门知识；2) 基于熵的权重分配的知識解耦策略，促使毒化样本流向蜜罐分支，引导主网络专注良性学习；3) 自动捷径生成策略以提升跨模型架构的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集和五种模型架构上的大量实验表明，该方法有效缓解了多种后门攻击，同时保持了良性数据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: TR是一种简单有效的训练时后门防御方法，通过"诱捕-丢弃"机制实现无需额外数据的后门防御，具有良好的泛化性。

title: MDWD: A Street-Level Dataset for Municipal Solid Waste Detection in Dense Urban Environments
comment: Accepted for publication at the 14th IEEE European Conference on Visual Information Processing (EUVIP 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Automated visual monitoring of urban environments is a growing Computer Vision research area, but municipal solid waste detection remains under-represented in dedicated benchmark resources. Existing waste-related datasets predominantly address individual litter detection, aerial imagery, or image-level classification, and none simultaneously provide street-level imagery, instance-level localization, and categorization of domestic waste streams within a structured municipal collection context. This paper introduces the Maltese Domestic Waste Dataset (MDWD), a street-level benchmark comprising 3,697 high-resolution images and 11,461 manually annotated instances across five domestic waste categories representative of Malta's municipal collection system. The dataset captures substantial variation in location, illumination, object scale, occlusion, and urban context. To establish reproducible baselines, a cross-architecture benchmark is conducted across multiple generations of the YOLO family and a transformer-based detector. On the test set, RF-DETR-M achieves the strongest overall performance with an mAP50 of 94.49% and an F1-score of 93.56%, whilst smaller-capacity variants maintain competitive accuracy at substantially reduced parameter counts. These results indicate that MDWD supports effective training across both compact real-time detectors and transformer-based models, establishing a benchmark for future research in vision-based municipal waste monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了马耳他城市生活垃圾数据集（MDWD），包含3,697张街道级高分辨率图像和11,461个手工标注实例，覆盖5个生活垃圾类别。通过跨架构基准测试（YOLO系列和基于Transformer的检测器），RF-DETR-M取得最佳性能（mAP50为94.49%，F1分数为93.56%），证明该数据集可有效支持紧凑型实时检测器和Transformer模型训练。
AI.motivation: 城市自动视觉监控是日益增长的计算机视觉研究领域，但城市固体废弃物检测在基准资源中代表性不足。现有废弃物相关数据集要么专注于单件垃圾检测、航拍图像或图像级分类，没有同时提供街道级图像、实例级定位和垃圾分类的数据集。因此需要一个在结构化市政收集背景下同时满足这三个条件的数据集。
AI.method: 构建MDWD数据集，包含3,697张街道级高分辨率图像和11,461个手工标注实例，覆盖5类生活垃圾类别，捕捉位置、光照、物体尺度、遮挡和城市背景的显著变化。为建立可复现基线，对YOLO家族多代模型和基于Transformer的检测器进行跨架构基准测试。
AI.result: 在测试集上，RF-DETR-M取得最佳整体性能，mAP50为94.49%，F1分数为93.56%；较小容量的模型在显著减少参数量的同时保持有竞争力的准确率。
AI.conclusion: MDWD能够有效支持紧凑型实时检测器和Transformer模型的训练，为未来基于视觉的城市废弃物监测研究建立了基准。

title: S$^4$R: Selective Sampling, Subspaces, and Sparse Reconstruction for Compressed Long-Context KV Caching
summary: The growth of context window lengths in Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly enhances their long-context capabilities but incurs prohibitive memory costs due to the Key-Value (KV) cache. Although low-rank compression of KV cache is a promising remedy, existing methods face a dilemma: offline approaches depend on external calibration data, whereas online approaches incur substantial compute for full-prompt decomposition and reconstruction. In this paper, we propose S$^4$R, which builds low-rank subspaces from selectively sampled tokens and computes attention over a sparsely reconstructed KV representation. S$^4$R uses prompt-aware initialization to build initial key/value bases from a representative prompt subset, trading off calibration-data dependence against prefilling cost. Because fully reconstructing the cache at every decoding step is prohibitively expensive and hurts throughput, we further adopt sparse reconstruction to retain only informative positions during decoding. Extensive experiments on LongBench and RULER with Llama and Qwen model families show that S$^4$R achieves up to 5$\times$ KV compression with near full-cache accuracy, combining the efficiency of fixed compression with the adaptability of prompt-dependent methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S⁴R方法，通过选择性采样tokens构建低秩子空间，并在稀疏重构的KV表示上计算注意力，实现高达5倍的KV压缩，同时保持接近完整缓存的准确性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型中上下文窗口的增大显著增强长上下文能力，但KV缓存带来高昂的内存成本。现有低秩压缩方法面临两难困境：离线方法依赖外部校准数据，在线方法则因全提示分解和重构而产生巨大计算开销。
AI.method: S⁴R通过两个关键设计解决上述问题：(1) 提示感知初始化(prompt-aware initialization)，从代表性提示子集构建初始键/值基，在缓解校准数据依赖与预填充成本之间取得权衡；(2) 稀疏重构(sparse reconstruction)，在解码阶段仅保留信息丰富的位置，避免每一步完全重构缓存带来的吞吐量损失。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER基准上，使用Llama和Qwen模型家族进行大量实验，S⁴R实现了高达5倍的KV压缩，同时保持接近完整缓存准确性的性能。
AI.conclusion: S⁴R成功结合了固定压缩方法的高效性与提示依赖方法的适应性，为KV缓存压缩提供了一种兼顾内存效率与计算效率的实用方案。

title: SymboUQ: Symbolic Uncertainty Quantification for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) can produce fluent spatial reasoning traces, their intermediate relations may fail to support the final conclusion, making token-level confidence insufficient for final-answer reliability estimation. Existing formal verifiers provide stronger semantic evidence, but their applicability is partial: a parsed claim need not yield a definite semantic verdict.
