To address this issue, we introduce SymboUQ, a symbolic uncertainty quantification framework that estimates final-answer reliability from reasoning traces by distinguishing symbolizability, whether a claim can be represented in the verifier's formal language, from semantic determinacy, whether its execution yields an entailed or contradicted verdict rather than an unknown or not-evaluable outcome. SymboUQ comprises (i) a Layout Auditor that executes ordered spatial claims and extracts feasibility, conflict, and repair evidence; (ii) a label-free Determinacy Profile that characterizes effective executable coverage; and (iii) a Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer that integrates constraint-based, representation-based, and decoding-based scores according to verifier applicability. Extensive experiments on five spatial reasoning benchmarks with four frozen LLM backbones show that SymboUQ achieves approximately an 8% relative improvement in AUROC and a 7% relative reduction in class-balanced Brier loss over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: SymboUQ是一个符号化不确定性量化框架，通过区分"可符号化性"（claim能否被形式验证器表达）和"语义确定性"（执行结果是否产生确定裁决），从推理轨迹中估计大语言模型最终答案的可靠性。在五个空间推理基准上，相比最强基线，AUROC相对提升约8%，类平衡Brier损失相对降低约7%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然能生成流畅的空间推理轨迹，但中间关系可能无法支撑最终结论，导致token级置信度不足以可靠地估计最终答案的可信度。现有形式验证器虽能提供更强的语义证据，但适用性有限：解析出的claim不一定能得到确定的语义裁决。因此需要一种能区分不同验证器适用性的不确定性量化方法。
AI.method: SymboUQ包含三个核心组件：（1）Layout Auditor：执行有序空间claim，提取可行性、冲突和修复证据；（2）无标签Determinacy Profile：刻画有效的可执行覆盖率；（3）Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer：根据验证器适用性，集成基于约束、基于表示和基于解码的分数来估计最终答案可靠性。
AI.result: 在五个空间推理基准和四个冻结LLM骨干上的大量实验表明，SymboUQ相比最强基线在AUROC上实现了约8%的相对提升，在类平衡Brier损失上实现了约7%的相对降低。
AI.conclusion: SymboUQ通过区分符号化和语义确定性两个维度，有效解决了形式验证器在LLM不确定性量化中适用性有限的问题，为空间推理任务的可靠性估计提供了更鲁棒的框架。

title: An Embedded RISC-V Evaluation of Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Hard-Constrained Recurrent Physics-Informed Models
comment: 6 pages, submitted to SBESC 2026 as an extension to the ICLR Workshop Paper https://openreview.net/forum?id=iHpbQn99RB
summary: Hard-constrained recurrent physics-informed networks (HRPINNs) embed known dynamics inside a recurrent numerical integrator and restrict a neural branch to learning only the residual dynamics that the first-principles model does not capture. Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have been proposed as parameter-efficient replacements for multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in such residual branches, but their learnable B-spline activations follow a markedly different execution profile. Building on prior work that characterized when a vanilla B-spline KAN matches or underperforms an MLP as an HRPINN residual branch in discovery accuracy, this paper asks whether that parameter efficiency survives deployment. Using identical trained weights, we measured execution latency, energy per integration step, and dependability under post-training quantization in the closed recurrent loop on a RISC-V RV64GC platform without vector extensions (StarFive VisionFive~2, SiFive U74). For the two accuracy-comparable pairs, the KAN residual branch executed $13.5\times$ and $8.0\times$ slower and consumed $11.3\times$ and $5.6\times$ more energy per integration step (3.7\,$μ$J against 0.33\,$μ$J for the smallest pair); across all four parameter-matched size tiers the ranges are $4.7\times$--$14.5\times$ and $4.7\times$--$18.7\times$. Under INT8 quantization, KAN trajectories diverged up to $43\times$ earlier than matched MLPs; the damage traces to weight quantization, not to input-side knot-interval misassignment. These results indicate that the parameter efficiency reported for KANs does not transfer to deployment cost on scalar embedded cores, and that an MLP residual branch is the more dependable default for embedded HRPINN deployment unless specific quantization co-design is used.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在嵌入式RISC-V平台上，KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold网络）作为HRPINN残差分支时，其参数效率能否转化为部署优势。结果显示KAN在延迟上慢4.7-14.5倍，能耗高4.7-18.7倍，且在INT8量化下轨迹发散时间提前多达43倍，表明MLP仍是嵌入式HRPINN部署更可靠的默认选择。
AI.motivation: KANs被提议作为MLP的替代品用于HRPINN残差分支，声称具有参数效率优势。然而KAN的可学习B样条激活函数与MLP执行特性差异很大，在嵌入式标量核上的实际部署成本（延迟、能耗、可靠性）尚未被量化研究。
AI.method: 在无向量扩展的RISC-V RV64GC平台（StarFive VisionFive 2，SiFive U74）上，使用相同训练权重，对KAN和MLP残差分支进行对比实验，测量执行延迟、每积分步能耗、以及后训练量化（INT8）下的可靠性。比较了精度可比的配对和四个参数匹配的尺寸层。
AI.result: 两个精度可比配对中，KAN分别慢13.5倍和8.0倍，能耗高11.3倍和5.6倍（最小配对3.7μJ vs 0.33μJ）。所有四个尺寸层上，延迟差异为4.7-14.5倍，能耗差异为4.7-18.7倍。INT8量化下KAN轨迹发散比MLP早多达43倍，损伤归因于权重量化而非输入侧节点区间错配。
AI.conclusion: KAN报告的参数效率无法转化为嵌入式标量核上的部署成本优势，MLP残差分支是嵌入式HRPINN部署更可靠的默认选择，除非进行专门的量化协同设计。

title: Interpretability-Guided Soft Pruning of Attention Heads in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision foundation models, such as DINOv2, learn highly expressive representations but rely on massive, opaque architectures that demand substantial computational power and memory. To provide an interpretable-guided and efficient solution to this issue, we first propose a spectral analysis and new visualization technique for individual attention heads based on the Laplacian eigenvectors of their attention maps. Building upon recent observations regarding the block structure of Vision Transformers, we perform semantic clustering of attention heads and identify functional redundancies. Leveraging these insights, we introduce SAPER (Soft Attention PrunER), an end-to-end differentiable pruning framework based on the LapSum Soft Top-K approach. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that SAPER achieves a highly favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, outperforming the competitive RAPTOR baseline in FLOPs reduction while preserving strong classification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAPER框架，通过对视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）的注意力头进行谱分析和语义聚类，识别功能冗余并利用LapSum Soft Top-K实现端到端可微剪枝，在ImageNet-1K上实现了优于RAPTOR的FLOPs降低与精度保持。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）虽然能学习到高度表达性的表征，但其大规模、不透明的架构存在计算开销和内存需求过大的问题，亟需一种可解释引导且高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 基于注意力图拉普拉斯特征向量，对单个注意力头进行谱分析和新的可视化；2) 利用ViT的块结构特性，对注意力头进行语义聚类并识别功能冗余；3) 提出SAPER（Soft Attention PrunER），一种基于LapSum Soft Top-K的端到端可微剪枝框架。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上的大量实验表明，SAPER在精度-效率权衡上表现优异，在FLOPs削减方面优于强基线方法RAPTOR，同时保持了良好的分类性能。
AI.conclusion: SAPER验证了通过谱分析和语义聚类理解并剪枝视觉基础模型注意力头的可行性，为高效且可解释的模型压缩提供了新思路。

title: Native Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
summary: Large Language Models have achieved substantial progress in reasoning capabilities. Yet in low-resource native settings, many suffer from cross-lingual collapse, reverting to English during intermediate steps that require complex logical reasoning. This presents a cold-start bottleneck for policy optimization, whereas standard fine-tuning risks catastrophic forgetting due to cross-lingual representation drift. To address these challenges, we introduce the Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation (OSCD), a post-training algorithm that projects high-resource reasoning trajectories into low-resource vocabulary subspaces during generative training rollouts via an integrated translator agentic loop, ensuring the stable and efficient translation of dynamically generated reference samples for fine-tuning. This is coupled with joint-embedding semantic alignment of both reference and target-language reasoning traces, thereby bridging the pairwise cross-lingual representational gaps. Comprehensive evaluations using the AIME25 and HMMT25 benchmarks demonstrate that OSCD yields up to 3.2 times overall improvements in native Southeast Asian languages for mathematical reasoning, of which the joint-embedding semantic alignment component contributes up to 6.4% improvements in linguistic debiasing over translation-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSCD（Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation）后训练算法，解决大规模语言模型在低资源语言环境下进行数学推理时出现的跨语言坍缩和冷启动问题。该方法通过集成翻译智能体循环将高资源推理轨迹投影到低资源词汇子空间，并结合联合嵌入语义对齐来弥合跨语言表征差距，在AIME25和HMMT25基准上实现最高3.2倍的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型在低资源语言环境中进行复杂逻辑推理时会出现跨语言坍缩现象（即中间推理步骤回退到英语），这造成了策略优化的冷启动瓶颈。同时，标准微调方法因跨语言表征漂移而面临灾难性遗忘的风险，亟需一种能够在低资源语言环境下稳定、高效地进行推理能力迁移的后训练方法。
AI.method: OSCD包含两个核心组件：(1) Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation：通过集成翻译智能体循环，在生成式训练rollout中将高资源语言的推理轨迹投影到低资源语言的词汇子空间中，实现动态生成参考样本的稳定高效翻译用于微调；(2) 联合嵌入语义对齐：对参考语言和目标语言的推理轨迹进行联合嵌入级别的语义对齐，弥合成对的跨语言表征差距。
AI.result: 在AIME25和HMMT25基准上，OSCD在东南亚低资源语言的数学推理任务上取得了最高3.2倍的整体性能提升。其中，联合嵌入语义对齐组件相较于仅翻译的基线方法，在语言去偏方面贡献了最高6.4%的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: OSCD通过将跨语言蒸馏与语义对齐相结合，有效解决了低资源语言环境下LLM推理的跨语言坍缩问题，为低资源语言的推理能力后训练提供了可行的技术路径，并验证了联合嵌入语义对齐在语言去偏方面的独立价值。

title: Mask-Based Priors Are More Persistent than Query-Key Initializations
summary: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer在布尔外推任务上不仅缺乏数据，还会以系统性的错误方式泛化（倾向于学习最低阶插值器而非真实目标函数）。作者提出一种简单替代方案：直接在注意力层初始化可学习的加性掩码（attention-logit bias），从任务级交互结构中提取先验。与QK初始化方法不同，这种掩码初始化不会被训练覆盖，在布尔推理任务上实现近乎完美的外推，同时提升低数据算术性能，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有QK-based结构化初始化方法在布尔外推任务中，其先验会被训练快速覆盖，无法改变学习到的外推规则；而Transformer默认的归纳偏置（偏向简单最低阶插值器）会导致系统性的错误外推。因此需要一种能持久保留结构先验的初始化方法。
AI.method: 提出用可学习的加性注意力掩码（additive attention mask）替代QK投影初始化。该掩码是一个有限、可学习的注意力logit偏置，从任务级交互结构初始化，将结构先验与内容相关注意力分数分离，使其在整个优化过程中得以保留。这一步将掩码从传统硬掩码（如因果掩码、局部注意力）的角色扩展为编码持久归纳偏置的通用机制。
AI.result: 在布尔推理任务上，掩码初始化方法实现了近乎完美的外推，而普通Transformer和QK初始化方法仍被困于默认归纳偏置。该方法同时提升了低数据算术性能，并在视觉和语言基准上与现有方法保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 注意力掩码不仅能作为架构约束，更可以作为编码Transformer中持久归纳偏置的简单基础载体。这种方法为纠正Transformer系统性错误外推提供了有效且简单的解决方案。

title: Generic Vision and Cross-Attention for Reaction Yield Prediction
summary: Traditional reaction yield prediction is constrained by 1D quantum descriptors that lack explicit spatial information. To address this gap, a dual-modal Vision Cross-Attention architecture is proposed, fusing tabular physical-organic data with 2D molecular topologies. Notably, it is demonstrated that a generic computer vision backbone processing simple 2D skeletal structures independently outperforms purely quantum-based baselines. By synergizing both modalities, superior predictive accuracy compared to traditional methodologies is achieved by the optimal cross-attention framework (Test RMSE = 5.27%). Through mechanistic probing, active, descriptor-guided spatial querying is observed, effectively offloading macroscopic steric identification to the visual pathway. Furthermore, a dynamic chemical hierarchy is learned by the network to heavily prioritize critical steric bottlenecks, such as the aryl halide. Concurrently, residual skip connections are utilized to protect non-spatial electronic parameters from destructive attenuation during fusion. Collectively, a scalable and highly interpretable blueprint is provided for augmenting physical chemistry with deep visual learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双模态视觉交叉注意力架构（Vision Cross-Attention），融合表格物理有机数据与2D分子拓扑结构用于反应产率预测。研究表明，仅用通用计算机视觉骨干网络处理简单2D骨架结构就能超越纯量子描述符基线；融合双模态后达到最优预测精度（Test RMSE = 5.27%）。机制探测发现网络学习动态化学层级、优先关注空间位阻关键点（如芳基卤化物），并通过残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数。该工作为物理化学与深度视觉学习结合提供了可扩展且可解释的蓝图。
AI.motivation: 传统反应产率预测依赖1D量子描述符，缺乏显式空间信息，限制了模型的预测能力和可解释性。作者希望引入2D分子拓扑结构补充空间信息，从而突破传统方法的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出双模态Vision Cross-Attention架构：将表格化物理有机数据（1D量子描述符）与2D分子骨架结构图像分别编码，通过交叉注意力机制进行模态融合；视觉分支采用通用计算机视觉骨干网络（如CNN/ViT），并通过残差跳跃连接保护电子描述符信息。
AI.result: 最优交叉注意力框架在测试集上取得RMSE=5.27%，优于传统量子基方法。机制分析表明：网络进行主动的、描述符引导的空间特征查询，将宏观位阻识别任务交给视觉通路；学习到动态化学层级结构，优先关注关键位阻瓶颈（如芳基卤化物）；残差连接有效防止非空间电子参数的衰减。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了视觉信息对化学性质预测的重要价值，提供了一种可扩展、可解释的框架，为物理化学预测任务引入深度视觉学习提供了新的范式。

title: ORCA: ORgan-Centroid Aggregation for Training-Free 3D CT Visual Token Compression
summary: A 3D CT scan entering a vision-language model produces a long sequence of visual tokens, often thousands to tens of thousands per volume, and this sequence must be compressed before a language model can consume it. Token compression is well studied in general vision, but little of it targets 3D CT specifically. A common baseline is grid average, which pools regular grid cells and can blend distinct anatomy, lesion, and air into one token. We present \textbf{ORCA} (ORgan-Centroid Aggregation), a token compressor for 3D CT. It merges adjacent tokens with organ guidance and adds a sinusoidal encoding of each region's centroid to preserve spatial layout. This preserves the anatomical information a downstream model needs. ORCA is training-free and plug-and-play, producing an adjustable token set without any model change or text query. We evaluate it across two datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin) and five encoders. The evaluation spans two task types: attribute prediction over five families (size, density, location, texture, and disease) and text generation (visual question answering and report generation). At matched token budgets, ORCA improves consistently over existing compression methods. It shrinks the visual context $64\times$ and its KV-cache $50\times$, and is $31\times$ faster to process each volume. Code released at https://github.com/renjie-liang/ORCA-3DCT.

AI.tldr: ORCA是一个针对3D CT影像的token压缩方法，通过器官质心聚合相邻token并加入正弦空间编码，在无需训练的情况下实现64倍视觉上下文压缩和50倍KV缓存缩减，性能优于现有压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 3D CT扫描进入视觉语言模型时会产生数千到数万个视觉token的长序列，必须压缩后才能被语言模型消费。现有token压缩方法主要面向通用视觉领域，很少有专门针对3D CT的研究。常用的网格平均基准池化方法会将不同的解剖结构、病灶和空气混入同一个token，损失关键解剖信息。
AI.method: ORCA通过器官引导合并相邻token，并对每个区域质心添加正弦编码以保留空间布局信息。该方法无需训练、即插即用，可调节token数量，无需修改模型或使用文本查询。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE和Merlin两个数据集、五个编码器上评估，覆盖属性预测（大小、密度、位置、纹理、疾病）和文本生成（VQA和报告生成）两类任务。在相同token预算下，ORCA一致优于现有压缩方法，实现64倍视觉上下文压缩、50倍KV缓存缩减，处理每个体数据速度快31倍。
AI.conclusion: ORCA通过器官感知的token聚合策略有效保留了3D CT解剖信息，证明了在相同token预算下优于通用压缩方法，为3D医学影像的视觉语言模型提供了高效的即插即用压缩方案。

title: DE-NER : Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition via Dialogue Elicitation of Large Language Models
summary: Recent advancements of zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) establish strong baselines by formulating sequence labeling into question answering where Large Language Models (LLMs) can be naturally adopted. However, existing LLM-based zero-shot NER methods suffer from the limitations of prompt and demonstration engineering. To address these issues with minimal human interventions, we introduce DE-NER, a dialogue elicitation framework which elicits the chatting ability of LLMs to fully extract the knowledge encoded in LLMs. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperform the competitive baselines in zero-shot settings across multiple benchmarks, with an average improvement of 3.75\% F1 points. Codes are released in https://github.com/kkkenshi/DE-NER.

AI.tldr: DE-NER是一个对话式引导框架，通过利用LLM的对话能力来执行零样本命名实体识别，无需复杂的提示词和示例工程，在多个基准上平均提升3.75%的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的零样本NER方法将序列标注转化为问答任务，但受限于提示词和示例（demonstration）工程的设计成本与局限性，需要人工干预较多。
AI.method: 提出DE-NER（Dialogue Elicitation framework for NER），一种对话引导框架，通过激发LLM的对话交流能力，充分挖掘LLM中编码的知识来完成零样本NER任务，减少对人类提示词工程的依赖。
AI.result: 在多个基准上优于竞争基线，零样本设置下平均提升3.75%的F1分数，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: DE-NER验证了利用对话引导方式可以更有效地激发LLM内在知识进行零样本NER，为减少提示工程依赖提供了新思路。

title: TrAC: Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent reasoning traces that nevertheless lead to incorrect answers, making response-level uncertainty estimation important for abstention, human review, and adaptive compute allocation. Existing approaches generally fall into three categories: passive single-trace methods use token-level confidence signals, sampling-based methods compare multiple complete traces at higher generation cost, and active prefix-based methods probe partial traces to study answer stabilization or preference transitions. However, none actively re-elicits an answer from a completed reasoning trace to measure its consistency with and support for the original answer. To address this gap, we introduce Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency (TrAC), a correctness-supervised uncertainty quantification framework that combines active and passive signals anchored to one completed reasoning trace. Its active component, Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE), re-elicits a short answer conditioned on the completed trace and represents both its consistency with the original answer and its token-level probabilistic support. Its passive component, Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP), summarizes how token-level uncertainty evolves throughout the original generation without additional decoding. A lightweight head then integrates the two representations into a response-correctness score. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three LLM families, TrAC improves macro AUROC by 1.8% and reduces AURC by 3.4% relative to eight-sample self-consistency, while using one complete reasoning trace and a short cached answer probe. When eight samples are already available, augmenting sample consensus with re-elicitation further improves macro AUROC by 4.3% and reduces AURC by 8.3%, without additional full-trace generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrAC框架，通过结合主动（Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation）和被动（Trace Uncertainty Profile）信号，基于单一完整推理轨迹进行响应级不确定性估计，在数学推理基准上优于八样本自一致性方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可以生成流畅但错误的推理轨迹，现有不确定性估计方法分为三类：被动单轨迹方法（使用token级置信度）、采样方法（比较多条完整轨迹但成本高）、主动前缀方法（探测部分轨迹）。然而，没有方法能在完整推理轨迹生成后主动重新引出答案来测量其与原始答案的一致性。这一空白促使作者提出TrAC框架。
AI.method: TrAC包含三个组成部分：(1) 主动组件PCE（Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation）在已完成推理轨迹条件下重新引出简短答案，同时捕捉其与原始答案的一致性及token级概率支持；(2) 被动组件TUP（Trace Uncertainty Profile）汇总原始生成过程中token级不确定性的演变，无需额外解码；(3) 轻量级头模块整合两个表示，输出响应正确性评分。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准和三个LLM家族上，TrAC相比八样本自一致性方法，将宏AUROC提升1.8%并将AURC降低3.4%，但仅使用一个完整推理轨迹和一个短缓存答案探针。当已有八个样本时，将重引出信号与样本共识结合，可额外提升宏AUROC 4.3%并降低AURC 8.3%，无需额外生成完整轨迹。
AI.conclusion: TrAC证明了主动重引出与被动不确定性信号结合的有效性，以更低的生成成本实现更优的不确定性估计性能，并能在已有多个样本时作为正交的增强信号进一步提升校准质量。

title: Paris as a 15-Minute City: An Explainable AI Perspective
comment: 17 pages, 16 figures. Extended report of a poster presented at the NetMob 2025 conference on 8 October 2025
summary:
The 15-minute city promotes access to everyday services within a short walk or bicycle ride, but its relationship with observed mobility remains difficult to quantify. We investigate this relationship in the Paris metropolitan area using mobility trajectories from the NetMob 2025 Data Challenge, enriched with INSEE sociodemographic data and OpenStreetMap points of interest (POIs), yielding approximately 70,000 trip segments after stop-based segmentation and data cleaning.
  We construct walking- and cycling-based indicators of local service availability and examine their associations with trip duration, transport mode, and short-trip car use. Higher POI availability is associated with less private motorized travel and more active mobility, although this relationship is substantially weaker in the outer agglomeration. Gradient-boosted tree models interpreted with explainable machine-learning methods consistently identify trip purpose, home--work distance, local service availability, vehicle ownership, public-transport subscription, and sociodemographic context as important predictors. For short trips, high POI density is associated with lower car use, while car ownership and driving-licence availability are associated with higher predicted car use; where services are sparse, public-transport subscription is associated with lower predicted car dependence. Finally, explainable AI (XAI) methods are used to examine how feature attributions change under alternative assumed variable orderings.
  The results are consistent with central assumptions of the 15-minute city while revealing substantial spatial and demographic heterogeneity. They also demonstrate how explainable machine-learning methods can complement accessibility indicators and identify locally relevant hypotheses for urban-mobility policy.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用巴黎大都市区约7万条出行轨迹数据，结合INSEE人口统计和OpenStreetMap兴趣点数据，构建步行和骑行可达性指标，探讨15分钟城市理念与实际出行行为之间的关系。研究发现POI可用性与减少私家车出行、增加主动出行相关，但这一关系在外围地区显著减弱。通过可解释机器学习方法识别出出行目的、家-工作距离、本地服务可用性、车辆保有量、公共交通订阅等关键预测因子，结果支持15分钟城市的核心假设，同时揭示了显著的空间和人口异质性。
AI.motivation: 15分钟城市理念主张在短距离步行或骑行范围内获取日常服务，但其与实际出行行为之间的量化关系难以衡量。作者旨在通过大规模真实的移动轨迹数据来实证检验这一核心假设，从而为城市交通政策提供基于证据的洞见。
AI.method: 使用NetMob 2025数据挑战提供的移动轨迹数据，通过停止点分割和数据清洗得到约7万条出行段。构建步行和骑行可达性指标，结合POI密度、INSEE社会人口数据，采用梯度提升树模型并用可解释机器学习（XAI）方法解释模型，分析服务可用性与出行时长、交通方式和短途汽车使用之间的关系。
AI.result: 更高POI可用性与更少的私人机动车出行和更多的主动出行相关，但这一关系在外围集聚区明显减弱。梯度提升树模型中的关键预测因子包括出行目的、家-工作距离、本地服务可用性、车辆保有量、公共交通订阅和社会人口背景。短途出行中高POI密度与低汽车使用相关，车辆保有量和驾照与高汽车使用相关，而在服务稀疏地区公共交通订阅与低汽车依赖相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持15分钟城市的核心假设，同时揭示了实质性空间和人口异质性。可解释机器学习方法能够补充可达性指标，为城市出行政策识别出地方相关的假设，展示了XAI在城市流动研究中的价值。

title: The 1st AI Children Challenge
summary: The First AI Children Challenge aims to advance real-world applications of computer vision and AI in child healthcare, child education, and pediatrics. The 2026 CV4CHL edition featured the first track in this domain: Children Gait Visual Analysis. The main goal of Children Gait Visual Analysis is the fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors from keypoint sequences. This is still a big challenge for human action recognition. Experienced medical doctors can distinguish these subtle nuances, but none of the people test AI models in this domain. To bridge this gap, we introduce thousands of 2D children keypoint sequences walking around videos across various age groups of children (3-16 years old). There is a significant opportunity for batch analysis of these videos to provide clinically relevant insights into medical diagnosis. The Challenge will be launched with two problem tracks: Edinburgh Visual Gait Score (EVGS) Scoring and Classification of Gait Patterns in Bilateral Spastic Cerebral Palsy. Each track is chosen in consultation with board-certified pediatricians based on the value of potential solutions. With the first available dataset for such tasks and ground truth for each track, the challenge enabled participants to evaluate their solutions. Final rankings will be revealed after the competition concludes, fostering reproducibility and mitigating overfitting.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首届AI儿童挑战赛（CV4CHL 2026）中的"儿童步态视觉分析"赛道。该赛道旨在通过从2D关键点序列中对3-16岁儿童步态进行细粒度分析，缩小AI模型与经验丰富的儿科医生在步态细微差异识别上的差距。挑战赛包含两个子任务：爱丁堡视觉步态评分（EVGS）和双侧痉挛性脑瘫步态模式分类，并提供了该领域首个大规模标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 儿童步态的细粒度分析对人类动作识别仍是重大挑战。尽管经验丰富的医生能区分这些细微差别，但尚未有AI模型在该领域得到评测。为了弥合这一差距，需要引入大量带标注的儿童步态关键点数据，并举办挑战赛以推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 本文构建了覆盖3-16岁不同年龄组儿童的数千条2D关键点序列数据集，并设计两个子任务：1) 爱丁堡视觉步态评分（EVGS）评分；2) 双侧痉挛性脑瘫步态模式分类。两个任务均由认证儿科医生参与设计以确保临床价值，并提供真实标注供参赛者评估。
AI.result: 该挑战赛提供了该领域首个可用数据集和对应的真值标注，使参赛者能够评估其解决方案。最终排名将在比赛结束后公布，以保证可复现性并减少过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 通过举办CV4CHL 2026儿童步态视觉分析挑战赛，该工作为AI在儿童医疗健康领域的实际应用（如临床诊断辅助）提供了基准数据集和评测平台，推动了步态分析在儿科临床场景中的落地。

title: Loanword or Switch? The Annotation Boundary, Not the Model, Drives Kazakh-Russian Code-Switching Identification
comment: 5 pages. Preprint. Submitted to W-NUT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/naadgob/KazNLP
summary: Off-the-shelf LID and letter heuristics over-label Kazakh-Russian social text as mixed: Russian loanwords inside Kazakh look like code-switching under a shared Cyrillic script. We release a document-level gold LID set whose guideline keeps integrated borrowings as Kazakh and reserves mixed for clause-level switches, plus a mixed-only sentiment pool used after LID in a filter-first cascade. On a shared LID test, FastText, Lingua, raw and windowed HeLI, character-trigram NB, and XLM-R range from weak to strong performance. The gap shows the bottleneck is the loanword-vs-switch annotation boundary, not model class alone.

AI.tldr: 本文针对哈萨克语-俄语社交媒体文本的语言识别（LID）问题，指出现有工具容易将哈萨克语中的俄语借词误标为语码转换。作者发布了文档级金标准LID数据集，将整合性借词归为哈萨克语，仅将从句级转换标记为混合；同时构建了混合情感语料库，用于"先过滤后分析"的级联流程。实验对比了FastText、Lingua、HeLI、NB和XLM-R等模型，发现性能差异的核心瓶颈在于借词与语码转换的标注边界，而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 哈萨克语与俄语共享西里尔字母，导致现成的LID工具和字母启发式方法在哈萨克-俄语社交媒体文本上过度标注为混合语言。俄语借词在哈萨克语中被误判为语码转换，影响下游自然语言处理任务（如情感分析）的准确性。
AI.method: （1）构建文档级金标准LID数据集，标注规则将整合性借词视为哈萨克语，仅将从句级语码转换标为混合；（2）构建仅含混合文本的情感分析语料库；（3）在LID测试集上比较FastText、Lingua、原始及窗口化HeLI、字符三元组朴素贝叶斯和XLM-R等模型的性能；（4）采用"LID过滤优先、情感分析其次"的级联流程。
AI.result: 不同模型（从FastText到XLM-R）在共享LID测试集上表现出从弱到强的性能差异。模型之间的性能差距表明，主要瓶颈在于借词与语码转换之间的注释边界问题，而非模型类别本身。
AI.conclusion: LID在哈萨克-俄语社会文本上的关键挑战是准确区分整合性借词与真正的语码转换。仅改进模型架构不足以解决此问题，需要更精细的标注准则和数据资源来推动该方向的研究。

title: Diagnose Before You Compress: Prediction-Independent Bottleneck Witness Refinement for LLM Serving Traces
summary: Production LLM serving generates millions of diverse requests, making full-trace replay across serving configurations increasingly expensive. Existing trace reduction methods mainly preserve workload distributions or representative requests, but bottleneck-revealing workloads may be rare and non-representative. Moreover, evidence for one component cannot compensate for missing evidence in another, while using predicted bottlenecks as target truth creates circular evaluation. These limitations make it necessary to preserve evidence for every bottleneck component rather than rely on workload representativeness alone. We propose Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW), a quality-constrained framework for compact and diagnostically reliable LLM serving replay suites. BPW first performs Workload Candidate Nomination using response-blind workload features and closed source-side measurements. This stage identifies workloads that may expose scheduler, prefill, decode, or KV-cache bottlenecks. Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction then organizes multi-component proposals as reusable hyperedges and prioritizes weak and uncovered dimensions. Finally, Bottleneck Truth Verification derives prediction-independent labels solely from direct target-system measurements. The verified results determine the earliest prefix satisfying the direct two-witness requirement for every component. Experiments on BurstGPT, ServeGen, and Mooncake show that BPW reaches the verified gate with a compact workload set and outperforms 16 policies, achieving relative improvements of 2.3% and 16.3% in Mean prefix Macro-F1 and WBRC-AUC, respectively. Stage-resolved and sensitivity analyses confirm the distinct contributions and local stability of its three stages. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llmllmllm/BPW

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPW（Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing），一个质量约束框架，用于生成紧凑且诊断可靠的LLM服务回放测试套件。BPW通过三个阶段的流水线——工作负载候选提名、覆盖优先级序列构建、瓶颈真值验证——确保每个瓶颈组件都有直接证据支持，而不是依赖工作负载的代表性。实验表明BPW在紧凑工作负载集下达到验证门槛，并在16个策略上取得相对2.3%和16.3%的提升。
AI.motivation: 生产级LLM服务生成海量多样化请求，导致全迹回放在不同服务配置下越来越昂贵。现有迹缩减方法主要保留工作负载分布或代表性请求，但揭示瓶颈的工作负载可能罕见且非代表性。此外，一个组件的证据无法弥补另一个组件的证据缺失，而使用预测瓶颈作为目标真值会产生循环评估。因此需要为每个瓶颈组件保留证据，而非仅依赖工作负载代表性。
AI.method: BPW包含三个阶段：(1) 工作负载候选提名（Workload Candidate Nomination）：使用响应盲工作负载特征和封闭源侧测量，识别可能暴露调度器、预填充、解码或KV缓存瓶颈的工作负载；(2) 覆盖优先级序列构建（Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction）：将多组件方案组织为可复用超边，优先覆盖薄弱和未覆盖的维度；(3) 瓶颈真值验证（Bottleneck Truth Verification）：直接从目标系统测量中推导预测无关的标签，验证结果决定满足每个组件的直接双见证要求的最早前缀。
AI.result: 在BurstGPT、ServeGen和Mooncake上的实验表明，BPW以紧凑的工作负载集达到验证门槛，在16个策略中表现最优，Mean prefix Macro-F1相对提升2.3%，WBRC-AUC相对提升16.3%。阶段消融和敏感性分析确认了三个阶段的独立贡献和局部稳定性。
AI.conclusion: BPW通过为每个瓶颈组件保留直接证据（而非依赖工作负载代表性），有效解决了大型语言模型服务回放测试中迹缩减的关键问题，实现了紧凑且诊断可靠的测试套件。代码已公开。

title: AdvPlan-Bench: Adversarial Evaluation of Structured Plan-Generation Agents
summary: Structured plan-generation agents are often evaluated as if a plan has quality in isolation, yet many realistic planning tasks require asking how a candidate behaves when another agent can search for responses. We introduce AdvPlan-Bench, an offline benchmark for adversarial evaluation of structured plan-generation agents. The contribution is a general evaluation object: a typed plan, an adversarial response set, selector diagnostics, and traceable candidate-frontier metrics. AdvPlan-Bench represents plans as typed action chains with optional branches, assigns synthetic quality scores, compares opposing plans with BLUE-vs-RED advantage and Nash-gap diagnostics, and evaluates qualitative constraint coherence with a transparent heuristic rubric. In 150 synthetic scenarios spanning five planning templates, a sampled best-response policy that draws eight response candidates reduces BLUE advantage from .518 to .486 and BLUE win rate from .900 to .820 relative to a single-sample response. An offline LLM-policy contract baseline reaches .496 BLUE advantage and .700 BLUE win rate, while a two-stage multi-agent council obtains .509 BLUE advantage and .813 BLUE win rate. A three-rater rubric-sensitivity study over 600 rating records yields .978 inter-rater agreement. AdvPlan-Bench is not an operational planner and provides no evidence about real-world decision quality; it is a reproducible benchmark artifact for studying adversarial plan evaluation, response-budget sensitivity, candidate frontiers, and multi-agent critique-and-revision traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdvPlan-Bench，一个用于对抗性评估结构化计划生成智能体的离线基准。它通过类型化计划、对抗响应集、选择器诊断和可追踪的候选前沿指标，评估计划在面对可搜索响应的对抗者时的质量。在150个合成场景中，采样最佳响应策略相比单样本响应降低了BLUE优势（.518→.486）和胜率（.900→.820），同时展示了多阶段多智能体委员会和离线LLM策略合约基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有计划生成智能体通常孤立地评估计划质量，但现实规划任务往往需要考虑候选计划在面对能够搜索响应的其他智能体时的表现。缺乏一个通用的对抗性评估基准来衡量计划在竞争/对抗情境下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: AdvPlan-Bench将计划表示为带分支的类型化动作链，分配合成质量分数，使用BLUE-vs-RED优势和Nash-gap诊断对比对立计划，并通过透明启发式规则评估定性约束一致性。基准包含150个覆盖五个规划模板的合成场景，提供采样最佳响应策略和离线LLM策略合约基线。
AI.result: 采样8个响应候选的最佳响应策略将BLUE优势从.518降至.486，BLUE胜率从.900降至.820。离线LLM策略合约基线达到.496 BLUE优势和.700胜率，两阶段多智能体委员会达到.509 BLUE优势和.813胜率。三评分者规则敏感性研究在600条评分记录上达到.978的评分者间一致性。
AI.conclusion: AdvPlan-Bench是一个可复现的基准工件，用于研究对抗性计划评估、响应预算敏感性、候选前沿和多智能体批评-修订轨迹。它不是操作性规划器，不提供关于真实世界决策质量的证据，但其价值在于提供一个标准化框架来研究计划在对抗环境中的表现。

title: Artificial Intelligence for the Characterization of Particles and Fibers by Optical Microscopy
summary: Optical microscopy of particle and fiber dispersions involves interpreting subtle visual cues influenced by specimen morphology, chemical composition, magnification, and illumination conditions. We introduce an artificial intelligence (AI) distillation framework that extracts semantically rich image embeddings from microscopy images using semantic anchors. A multimodal teacher combines each image's visual embedding with three text embeddings representing illumination modality, magnification, and specimen identity and morphology. Generated by LongCLIP's extended-context text encoder, this yields a 2304-dimensional block-structured teacher vector whose component blocks remain physically interpretable throughout training and inference. A student vision transformer (ViT) with a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) decoder is trained to reconstruct this teacher vector from the image alone, minimizing a mean absolute error (L1) loss that enforces coordinate-level fidelity to the teacher's block structure. A cross-entropy term over pseudo-classes derived from HDBSCAN clustering of the teacher embedding space acts as a collapse-prevention regularizer, enforcing inter-cluster separation without requiring contrastive negative mining. At inference, the student operates on image input alone, producing compact embeddings that recover the full semantic content of the teacher vector. The framework achieves approximately 80% pseudo-class validation accuracy and 75% Recall@1 on fine-grained specimen description labels under leave-one-out nearest-neighbor retrieval. These results demonstrate that semantic anchoring enables a vision-only student to acquire richer and more interpretable representations than image-only training, with direct applicability to retrieval, classification, and exploratory analysis of heterogeneous particle and fiber dispersions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI蒸馏框架，利用多模态教师模型（结合视觉嵌入与光照、放大倍数、样本身份等文本嵌入）生成语义丰富的块结构教师向量，再训练一个仅依赖图像的ViT学生模型重建该向量，从而获得比纯图像训练更丰富且可解释的表征，适用于颗粒和纤维分散体的检索、分类与探索性分析。
AI.motivation: 光学显微镜下颗粒和纤维分散体的成像受形态、化学成分、放大倍数和光照条件等多种因素影响，仅依靠视觉线索难以充分捕捉细微语义。现有方法缺乏一种能够同时整合多模态信息（如光照、放大倍数等元数据）并获得紧凑、可解释、可检索的图像表征的方式。
AI.method: 1) 构建多模态教师：将视觉嵌入与三种文本嵌入（光照模态、放大倍数、样本身份与形态）通过LongCLIP的长上下文文本编码器融合，生成2304维块结构教师向量，各块在训练和推理中保持物理解释性。2) 训练学生ViT：学生网络仅以图像为输入，通过MLP解码器重建教师向量，使用L1损失保证坐标级块结构保真。3) 防坍缩正则化：基于HDBSCAN对教师嵌入空间聚类得到伪类，通过交叉熵损失强制类间分离，无需对比学习的负样本挖掘。
AI.result: 该框架在伪类验证准确率上达到约80%，在细粒度样本描述标签的留一法最近邻检索中Recall@1达75%，证明了语义锚定使仅视觉的学生模型获得比纯图像训练更丰富和可解释的表征。
AI.conclusion: 语义锚定蒸馏框架成功将多模态知识压缩到纯视觉学生模型中，在保持紧凑高效推理的同时获取了丰富的可解释语义表征，对异质颗粒和纤维分散体的检索、分类和探索性分析具有直接应用价值。

title: Writing-System-Level Tokenizer Adaptation for Byte-Level BPE
comment: 15 pages. Accepted for poster presentation at the Second Tokenization Workshop (TokShop) at COLM 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Pretrained byte-level BPE tokenizers can segment underrepresented languages inefficiently. Replacing a tokenizer changes the meaning of nearly every token ID, while vocabulary expansion enlarges the model's embedding and output matrices. We study post-hoc adaptation that keeps the model-vocabulary size fixed and preserves most existing token-to-ID assignments as a construction-time compatibility property. Directly transferring tokens from a language-specific tokenizer does not guarantee derivability through the target BPE merge graph: an inserted entry can conflict with the target's greedy merge ranks. We formalize this failure as the merge ordering problem and introduce BPE-guided insertion, which builds each transferred token through a target-reachable decomposition. Our pipeline uses script-aware row selection to limit collateral fragmentation, reconstructs target-script byte-level prerequisites, and applies guided insertion to maintain merge-graph reachability. On Ukrainian adaptations of Nemotron and GPT-OSS, it reduces token counts by 33.5% and 36.6%, keeps changes on English and the evaluated four-language European aggregate within 0.05%, and retains 78.5%/77.3% of original model-vocabulary rows at the same IDs. Constraint-matched global and frequency-based removal achieve similar Ukrainian compression but increase English/European token counts by 0.7-2.2%; fresh same-size retraining compresses Ukrainian slightly more but retains effectively no same-ID rows and increases English token counts by 7.6-8.6%. The reallocation increases token counts on the evaluated three-language Cyrillic micro-aggregate by 6.7%/10.1%. Structural audits find all 28,134/45,398 inserted BPE nodes reachable under ordinary rank-ordered merging and no retained same-ID model-vocabulary entry newly broken. We release all tokenizers and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPE引导插入（BPE-guided insertion）方法，在保持模型词汇表大小固定且保留大部分token-ID映射的前提下，通过目标BPE合并图可达性约束，实现对低资源语言tokenizer的后验适配。在乌克兰语Nemotron和GPT-OSS适配中，token数减少33.5%和36.6%，英语及四语欧洲聚合变化保持在0.05%以内，并保留了78.5%/77.3%的原始词汇表行。
AI.motivation: 预训练字节级BPE tokenizer对低资源语言切分效率低下，而替换tokenizer会改变几乎所有token ID的语义，词汇表扩大会增加嵌入和输出矩阵的规模。因此需要一种在保持模型词汇表大小固定且保留现有token-ID分配的后验适配方法。
AI.method: 提出了合并排序问题（merge ordering problem）的概念，并引入BPE引导插入方法：每个转移token通过目标可达的分解来构建。具体流程包括：1）脚本感知的行选择以减少连带碎片化；2）重建目标脚本的字节级前置条件；3）应用引导插入以维持合并图可达性。此外还进行了与约束匹配的全局/频率删除、同规模重新训练等基线实验对比。
AI.result: 在乌克兰语Nemotron和GPT-OSS适配中，token数分别减少33.5%和36.6%，英语和四语欧洲聚合指标变化在0.05%以内，保留78.5%/77.3%的原始模型词汇表行并保持相同ID。同规模重新训练虽乌克兰语压缩略高但几乎不保留同ID行且英语token数增加7.6-8.6%。结构审计确认所有28,134/45,398个插入BPE节点在普通rank排序合并下可达，且无不保留的损坏条目。
AI.conclusion: BPE引导插入方法能够在固定词汇表大小和保留大部分token-ID映射的前提下，有效改善低资源语言的tokenizer切分效率，同时将对其他语言的影响控制在极低水平。该方法优于全局/频率删除基线，并在与重新训练的比较中展现出保留连续性的优势。相关工作已开源。

title: Ekova: A Personality-Support Agent for Self-Discovery Dialogue
comment: Accepted to the COLM 2026 Lifelong Agents Workshop
summary: Emotional Support (ES) systems have long optimized a single objective: alleviating the user's emotional distress in the moment. We argue that a complementary need, helping users see themselves more clearly, defines a distinct paradigm we call Personality Support (PS). PS is not counseling or clinical intervention: it targets cognitive clarity and self-articulation, not symptom relief or diagnosis. We instantiate this paradigm in three layers. First, we present DSD, a Chinese self-discovery PS Dataset of 8,590 samples collected through real longitudinal interaction across five minimal units, Coach, Warm, Tsukkomi, Real, and Gonzo. Second, we build DeepSupport, a multi-persona PS system trained with OrthoTune, a PS-tailored framework with style-specific adapters and a style-consistency regularizer. Third, we unify the five DeepSupport personas into Ekova, a persistent personality-support agent with a unified cross-session memory layer, supporting both adaptive routing and user-customized persona selection. Experiments show that OrthoTune-trained models outperform all baselines with an average relative gain of 16.3% across all metrics over the strongest prompt-based baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/Ekova.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人格支持"(PS)这一全新范式，区别于传统情绪支持(ES)，旨在帮助用户更清晰地认识自我。作者构建了包含8,590个真实纵向交互样本的中文自我发现数据集DSD，训练了多人格PS系统DeepSupport（采用OrthoTune框架），并整合为具有跨会话记忆的持久型人格支持智能体Ekova。实验表明OrthoTune训练的模型在全部指标上平均相对提升16.3%。
AI.motivation: 传统情绪支持系统只追求单一目标——即时缓解用户情绪困扰，忽略了帮助用户更清晰地认识自我这一互补需求。作者认为这是一个人格支持(PS)的独立范式，并非心理辅导或临床干预，而是聚焦于认知清晰度与自我表达。
AI.method: 论文以三层结构实现PS范式：(1) 构建DSD数据集，通过五种最小交互单元（Coach、Warm、Tsukkomi、Real、Gonzo）采集8,590条真实纵向交互样本；(2) 开发DeepSupport多人格PS系统，采用OrthoTune框架，包含风格特定适配器和风格一致性正则化器；(3) 将五种人格统一为Ekova持久型人格支持智能体，具备跨会话统一记忆层，支持自适应路由和用户自定义人格选择。
AI.result: 实验显示，OrthoTune训练的模型在所有指标上超越所有基线，相对于最强的基于提示的基线，平均相对增益达16.3%。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: 人格支持(PS)是一个区别于情绪支持(ES)的独立且重要的对话AI范式，通过多人格、跨会话记忆和自我发现数据集的构建，有望在认知层面为用户提供更深层次的帮助。

title: Deep Learning CNN and Recurrence Analysis for Alpha Gamma EEG Biomarkers in Fragile X Syndrome
summary: Fragile X Syndrome (FXS) is a neurodevelopmental disorder caused by reduced expression of fragile X mental retardation protein (FMRP), leading to disrupted synaptic plasticity, cortical hyperexcitability, and impaired network synchronization. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a noninvasive window into these mechanisms and consistently reveals abnormalities in alpha (8 to 12 Hz) and gamma (30 to 100 Hz) oscillations that relate to inhibitory control, sensory processing, and cognition. This paper proposes a multi representation deep learning framework for automated characterization of FXS EEG phenotypes by integrating convolutional neural networks (CNNs), long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, and recurrence plot (RP) analysis. Band limited EEG signals are decomposed into alpha and gamma components and transformed into complementary representations, including temporal feature sequences, time frequency maps, and RP images encoding the nonlinear recurrence structure. CNN modules learn discriminative spatial-spectral and dynamical textures from image based representations, while LSTM modules model temporal modulation of oscillatory activity; a hybrid CNN LSTM architecture jointly captures spatial, temporal, and nonlinear dependencies. Subject-independent evaluation demonstrates that the hybrid model outperforms single modality baselines, with gamma features providing strong discriminative power and alpha gamma integration yielding the best overall performance. These findings support deep learning with nonlinear representations as a scalable approach for EEG biomarker development in FXS, with potential utility for diagnosis, stratification, and treatment monitoring in translational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多表征深度学习框架，通过整合CNN、LSTM和递归图分析，利用EEG的alpha和gamma频段信号自动表征脆性X综合征（FXS）的脑电表型。实验表明混合CNN-LSTM架构优于单模态基线，alpha-gamma整合获得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: FXS是一种由FMRP蛋白表达减少引起的神经发育障碍，导致突触可塑性受损、皮层过度兴奋和网络同步障碍。EEG能无创反映这些机制，但需要自动化的方法来表征FXS的异常脑电特征（特别是alpha和gamma振荡异常），以支持诊断、分层和治疗监测。
AI.method: 将带限EEG信号分解为alpha和gamma成分，转换为三种互补表征：时序特征序列、时频图和递归图（编码非线性递归结构）。CNN模块从图像表征中学习判别性的空间-频谱和动态纹理特征，LSTM模块建模振荡活动的时间调制，混合CNN-LSTM架构联合捕捉空间、时间和非线性依赖关系。
AI.result: 在受试者独立评估中，混合模型优于单模态基线；gamma特征提供强判别力，而alpha-gamma整合获得最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持将深度学习与非线性表征相结合作为FXS EEG生物标志物开发的可扩展方法，在诊断、分层和治疗监测等转化场景中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Decoding Children's Gait Behavior
summary: We introduce a new problem domain for human action recognition: the fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors from standard RGB video. We specifically target the ambulatory patterns of children aged 3-17 years. Such behaviors arise naturally in the diagnosis and treatment of several critical developmental and neuromuscular disorders, such as cerebral palsy and hemiplegia. Despite their clinical value, current 3D sensor-based gait analysis systems are expensive, intrusive, and often impractical for young subjects. To address this, we introduce a new dataset comprising over 1,100 high-frame-rate (60 FPS) video sequences from 110 subjects, accompanied by synchronized, anonymized pose sequences. In each session, the child performs a 5-second "walk-around" task, capturing the gait cycle from multiple viewpoints. Crucially, we demonstrate that current state-of-the-art approaches, including gait foundation models and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), fail to effectively resolve these clinical nuances. We identify the key technical challenges in analyzing these erratic and subtle motor patterns and describe a unified end-to-end framework for decoding fundamental components of pediatric gait. Through comprehensive experimental results, we demonstrate the potential of this dataset to drive novel research questions and establish a rigorous baseline for automated child gait assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个全新的问题领域：从标准RGB视频中细粒度分析儿童步态行为（3-17岁），用于辅助脑瘫、偏瘫等发育性和神经肌肉疾病的诊断与治疗。作者引入了一个包含1100多个高帧率（60FPS）视频序列、涵盖110个受试者的新数据集，并证明了现有最先进方法（包括步态基础模型和多模态大语言模型）难以有效解决这些临床细节问题，同时提出了一个统一的端到端框架来解码儿童步态的基本组成部分。
AI.motivation: 现有3D传感器步态分析系统成本高昂、侵入性强，且对年幼受试者不实用；而儿童步态分析对脑瘫、偏瘫等关键发育和神经肌肉疾病的诊断治疗具有重要临床价值。同时，目前最先进的步态识别方法和多模态大语言模型在面对这些细微、不规则的儿童运动模式时表现不佳。
AI.method: 本文构建了一个新的大型儿科步态数据集（1100+个60FPS视频序列，110个受试者），每个受试者执行5秒"来回走动"任务，从多视角捕捉步态周期，并同步提供匿名化姿态序列。同时提出了一个统一的端到端框架，用于解码儿科步态的基本组成部分，并进行了全面的实验验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，现有最先进方法（包括步态基础模型和MLLM）无法有效解决这些临床级别的细粒度步态分析问题，而提出的数据集和端到端框架展示了自动化儿童步态评估的可行性，为未来研究建立了严格的基准。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集有潜力推动新的研究问题，为自动化儿童步态评估建立严格基线，填补了从RGB视频进行细粒度儿科步态临床分析这一空白领域。

title: Verification Without Sufficiency: Per-Chunk Filtering Fails on Multi-Hop RAG, and Decomposition Repairs It
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables, 1 algorithm. Code, per-question traces and analysis scripts: https://github.com/iamhero2709/verification-without-sufficiency
summary: Verification for retrieval-augmented generation usually scores each retrieved chunk and drops the ones that fail. We show this cannot work for multi-hop questions, and show what does. Per-chunk scoring assumes one chunk is a sufficient premise for the answer. Multi-hop questions are built so that none is, and the paragraph carrying the answer is the one the question does not name. Entailment scoring reaches 0.643, 0.523 and 0.560 AUC on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA and MuSiQue, against 0.951 on single-hop SQuAD. Seven controls rule out model capacity, premise length, hypothesis template, decision threshold, retriever, answer-matching criterion and prompt. End to end across three datasets, three generator sizes and two prompts, per-chunk gating is significantly worse than not filtering at all in every cell, and its penalty grows with generator capability. The repair is to condition verification on the decomposed sub-question rather than the original query. Using MuSiQue's gold decomposition, entailment on a later hop rises from 0.546, which is chance, to 0.840, a paired lift of +0.355 with a bootstrap interval of [0.331, 0.382]. An off-the-shelf Qwen2.5-7B decomposer, given the question and the top retrieved paragraph, reaches 0.637 and captures 31% of that ceiling; decomposing without retrieval reaches 0.533, below the original question. Iterative retrieval systems already produce such decompositions and discard them before verifying.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了对检索增强生成（RAG）中检索到的每个块进行独立评分验证的方法在多跳问答中根本不可行，因为多跳问题没有任何一个单独的块足以支撑答案。作者通过七个控制实验排除了各种替代解释，证明逐块验证在多跳任务上性能远低于单跳，甚至不如完全不过滤。修复方法是基于分解后的子问题（而非原始问题）进行验证，使用黄金分解可将后续跳的验证AUC从随机水平0.546提升至0.840。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG验证方法通常对每个检索块独立评分并丢弃不合格的块。这种方法隐含假设每个块是答案的充分前提，但这仅适用于单跳问答。多跳问题的本质是没有任何单个块足以回答问题，而包含最终答案的段落恰恰是原始问题未直接提到的那个。因此需要研究为什么逐块评分在多跳问题上失败，以及应该如何设计正确的验证策略。
AI.method: 作者首先系统地评估了标准逐块蕴涵评分在多个数据集上的表现（HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue对比单跳SQuAD）。然后设计了七个控制实验，分别排除模型容量、前提长度、假设模板、决策阈值、检索器、答案匹配标准和提示的影响。接着提出修复方案：将验证条件从原始查询改为分解后的子问题。最后评估了使用黄金分解、现成的Qwen2.5-7B分解器（在有无检索条件下）的表现，并指出迭代检索系统本已产生这些分解但在验证前将其丢弃。
AI.result: 逐块蕴涵评分在单跳SQuAD上达到0.951 AUC，但在多跳的HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA和MuSiQue上仅分别达到0.643、0.523和0.560。七个控制实验证实问题并非模型能力、长度、模板、阈值、检索器或其他因素的干扰。端到端实验跨三个数据集、三种生成器规模和两种提示，逐块门控在每个单元中都显著差于完全不过滤，且惩罚随生成器能力增强而增大。基于子问题的验证可将后续跳的AUC从0.546提升至0.840（配对提升+0.355，bootstrap区间[0.331, 0.382]）。离线的Qwen2.5-7B分解器在检索条件下达到0.637的AUC，捕获了31%的黄金分解上限；无检索分解仅达0.533，低于原始问题。
AI.conclusion: 逐块评分验证在多跳RAG问题上是结构性失败的，因为它与多跳问题的语义结构根本矛盾。正确的做法是将验证条件从原始查询改为分解后的子问题，因为证据链在子问题的粒度上才是对齐的。这一发现对迭代检索系统的设计有直接启示：这些系统在检索过程中已生成子问题分解，但目前在验证阶段将其丢弃，如果保留并利用这些分解，可以显著提升验证质量。

title: F-WANDA: Fisher-Reweighted Post-Training Pruning for Sustainable Deployment of Large Language Models
summary: One-shot post-training pruning is the most energy-frugal compression strategy for largelanguage models (LLMs), yet existing approaches trade either quality (WANDA) or compute cost (SPARSEGPT). We introduce F-WANDA, a drop-in modification of WANDA that reallocates the per-row keep budget across output neurons in proportion to the empirical Fisher information of the pre-activation. The Fisher signal is collected in a single additional backward pass over the same calibration corpus WANDA already uses; no weights are updated. On LLAMA-2-7B at 50 % unstructured sparsity, F-WANDA attains WikiText-2 perplexity of 6.85, matches WANDA fluency, and improves 5-shot MMLU by +1.6 pp over WANDA and +1.1 pp over SPARSEGPT, while incurring only one-third of SPARSEGPT pruning wall-clock and energy. The headline trade-off is achieved without extra calibration data or fine-tuning, placing F-WANDA on the Pareto frontier of quality versus pruning cost for sustainable LLM compression.

AI.tldr: F-WANDA是一种对WANDA的即插即用改进，在单次后向传播中利用经验Fisher信息重新分配每行保留预算，在保持单次剪枝极低计算成本的同时显著提升LLM压缩质量，实现了质量与成本间的更优Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 一次性后训练剪枝是LLM压缩中最节能的策略，但现有方法存在质量与计算成本的权衡：WANDA质量不佳，而SPARSEGPT计算代价过高。作者希望在不引入额外校准数据或微调的前提下，同时获得高质量和低成本。
AI.method: F-WANDA作为WANDA的即插即用改进，核心创新是将逐行的保留预算按预激活的经验Fisher信息比例重新分配到输出神经元之间。Fisher信号通过一次额外的反向传播获取，使用与WANDA相同的校准语料库，且不更新任何权重。
AI.result: 在LLAMA-2-7B上以50%非结构化稀疏度测试：WikiText-2困惑度达6.85，流畅度与WANDA相当，5-shot MMLU比WANDA提升+1.6个百分点、比SPARSEGPT提升+1.1个百分点，而剪枝墙钟时间和能耗仅为SPARSEGPT的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: F-WANDA在不增加额外校准数据或微调的情况下实现了核心质量-成本权衡的突破，位于可持续LLM压缩的质量与剪枝成本Pareto前沿。

title: Nonlinear Laplacians Improve Signed-Directed Graph Learning
summary: While signed-directed graphs have been studied using linear Laplacians in the design of graph neural networks, relatively little research has focused on developing non-linear Laplacian operators for such networks. We introduce a non-linear Laplacian operator specific to signed and directed networks (NLSD). This non-linear operator extends the concepts of the signed Laplacian for signed graphs and the Laplacian for directed graphs. The NLSD calculates node-specific potentials based on features More precisely, if the potential discrepancy is not aligned with the edge direction, we ignore it (and vice versa) leveraging message-passing techniques only across edges where potential discrepancies align with the edge's direction. Utilizing this novel operator, we propose an efficient spectral GNN framework (NLSD-GNN). We conducted comprehensive evaluations focusing on node classification and link prediction, examining scenarios involving signed, directional, or both types of information. Our findings reveal that this spectral GNN framework not only integrates signed and directional data effectively but also achieves superior performance across diverse datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对带符号有向图的非线性拉普拉斯算子（NLSD），并将其应用于谱图神经网络框架（NLSD-GNN），在节点分类和链接预测任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多使用线性拉普拉斯算子设计面向带符号有向图的图神经网络，但针对此类网络的非线性拉普拉斯算子研究相对匮乏，因此需要探索新的非线性算子来更好地处理符号和有向信息。
AI.method: 作者引入了一种专门针对带符号有向网络的非线性拉普拉斯算子NLSD，它扩展了带符号图的符号拉普拉斯算子和有向图的拉普拉斯算子概念。该算子基于节点特征计算节点特定势能，仅当势能差异与边的方向一致时才进行消息传递（即忽略方向不一致的势能差异）。基于此算子构建了高效的谱GNN框架（NLSD-GNN）。
AI.result: 在节点分类和链接预测任务上进行了全面评估，涵盖了仅带符号、仅带方向以及两者兼有的多种场景。实验表明该谱GNN框架能够有效整合符号和有向信息，并在多个数据集上取得了优越性能。
AI.conclusion: NLSD-GNN不仅能够有效融合带符号和有向图数据，还在多样化数据集上展现出优于现有方法的性能，验证了非线性拉普拉斯算子在处理此类复杂图结构中的有效性。

title: Boosting Generalizable Depth Estimation in Endoscopy by Mixture of Lightweight Experts and Intrinsic Image Alignment
comment: Accepted by MICCAI 2026 @ The Efficient Medical AI (EMA4MICCAI) Workshop (Oral Presentation)
summary: Depth estimation is a significant task for 3D perception in endoscopic surgeries. However, illumination interference and feature diversity in various endoscopic scenes are still challenges for generalizable depth estimation and ego-motion estimation. Based on this, a novel self-supervised framework, EndoMINI, is proposed for depth estimation in endoscopic scenes. Specifically, mixture of low-rank experts (MiLoRE) is proposed to perform parameter-efficient fine-tuning, which can also boost the model adaptation to scenes with different characteristics. Meanwhile, an intrinsic image alignment (IIA) is introduced into the training loss to alleviate the influence of light reflectance in endoscopy with a novel intrinsic image decomposition network. The proposed method is evaluated on SCARED datasets for supervised depth estimation, and two endoscopic datasets, Hamlyn and SERV-CT, for zero-shot depth estimation, compared with state-of-the-art works as well. The experimental results demonstrate outstanding performance of the proposed model and the effects of the main contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EndoMINI，一个用于内窥镜场景深度估计的自监督框架，通过混合低秩专家(MiLoRE)实现参数高效微调以增强场景适应性，并引入内在图像对齐(IIA)损失来缓解光照反射干扰，在SCARED、Hamlyn和SERV-CT数据集上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜手术中的3D感知深度估计面临两大挑战：光照干扰（如镜面反射）和不同内窥镜场景下的特征多样性，导致现有方法难以实现泛化的深度估计和自运动估计。
AI.method: 提出EndoMINI自监督框架：1）混合低秩专家(MiLoRE)进行参数高效微调，提升模型对不同特征场景的适应能力；2）引入内在图像对齐(IIA)训练损失，结合新颖的内在图像分解网络来缓解内窥镜中光照反射的影响。
AI.result: 在SCARED数据集上进行监督深度估计，以及在Hamlyn和SERV-CT数据集上进行零样本深度估计，与最先进方法对比，实验结果表明所提模型性能优异，验证了各主要贡献的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EndoMINI通过MiLoRE和IIA两个创新组件，有效解决了内窥镜场景中光照干扰和特征多样性的问题，在深度估计任务上取得了超越现有方法的性能。

title: A Heuristic Perspective on Debiasing Language Models
summary: Language models (LMs) often acquire various biases during pre-training and may express them in interactions, potentially causing social harm. Existing methods often rely on counterfactual augmentation or representation projection. These strategies remain limited in practice due to their high computational costs and difficulty in scaling to larger models. Additionally, many of these strategies require manual data annotation, narrowing their scope to specific cultures and bias categories. To overcome these limitations, we propose HEIMAT, a HEurIstic-style autoMATic debiasing framework for LMs. HEIMAT consists of two main steps: bias disclosure and debiasing fine-tuning. In the first step, it uses simple templates to construct heuristic prompts, which are applied to reveal model biases and generate corresponding context prompts. In the second step, it fine-tunes the model by minimizing the Jensen-Shannon divergence of predictions on these context prompts to reduce bias. Extensive experiments show that HEIMAT effectively mitigates bias in different cultures while maintaining the model's natural language understanding (NLU) performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HEIMAT，一个启发式自动去偏框架，通过模板构建提示词披露模型偏见，再用Jensen-Shannon散度对上下文提示进行微调，在不损失自然语言理解性能的前提下有效缓解跨文化模型偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型去偏方法依赖反事实增强或表示投影，存在计算成本高、难以扩展到大规模模型、需要人工标注数据等局限，且适用文化范围和偏见类别有限。
AI.method: HEIMAT包含两步：1）偏见披露——用简单模板构建启发式提示词，揭示模型偏见并生成对应的上下文提示；2）去偏微调——通过最小化这些上下文提示上预测结果的Jensen-Shannon散度来减少模型偏见。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HEIMAT能在不同文化背景下有效缓解模型偏见，同时保持模型的自然语言理解性能。
AI.conclusion: HEIMAT提供了一种无需人工标注、可扩展的自动去偏方案，在跨文化场景中有效降低偏见且不影响模型核心能力。

title: The Bayesian Reflex: A Predictive Coding Engine for Artificial Intelligence
comment: From the Bayesian Brain to Artificial Intelligence
summary: Predictive coding offers a powerful theory of cortical computation, but corresponding scalable algorithmic implementations for artificial intelligence have remained elusive. This paper introduces the Bayesian reflex, a computational framework that directly instantiates predictive coding through three pillars: belief maintenance via hierarchical generative models, sequential Bayesian updating via prediction-error minimization, and uncertainty-driven action via active inference. We show that recent breakthroughs---ellipsoidal decomposition for exact $i.i.d.$ sampling, recursive Gaussian processes for deep hierarchical inference, and derivative-aware Bayesian optimization---provide the missing algorithmic ingredients. The resulting framework enables mathematically principled, scalable, and brain-inspired continual learning, perception, and decision-making. We illustrate its versatility through applications ranging from climate model evaluation to prime number discovery, offering a blueprint for truly adaptive artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"贝叶斯反射"（Bayesian reflex）计算框架，通过三个支柱直接实例化预测编码理论：基于分层生成模型的信念维护、通过预测误差最小化实现的序贯贝叶斯更新、以及基于不确定性驱动的主动推理行为。该框架结合椭球分解、递归高斯过程和导数感知贝叶斯优化等最新算法突破，实现了数学上严格、可扩展且受大脑启发的持续学习、感知与决策系统，并在气候模型评估和素数发现等任务上展示了其通用性。
AI.motivation: 预测编码是皮层计算的有力理论，但一直缺乏可扩展的人工智能算法实现。现有工作未能将这一神经科学理论转化为实用的、可扩展的AI框架，本文旨在弥合这一理论与算法之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 通过三大支柱构建计算框架：(1) 信念维护——采用分层生成模型；(2) 序贯贝叶斯更新——通过预测误差最小化实现；(3) 不确定性驱动行为——采用主动推理。利用椭球分解实现精确i.i.d.采样、递归高斯过程支持深度分层推理、导数感知贝叶斯优化进行决策优化。
AI.result: 该框架在多种应用中展示了其能力，包括气候模型评估和素数发现等领域的成功应用，验证了其在持续学习、感知和决策方面的数学严谨性、可扩展性与通用适应性。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯反射框架为预测编码理论提供了首个可扩展的算法实现，为构建真正自适应的、受大脑启发的通用人工智能提供了蓝图。

title: Adaptive Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differential Equations with Applications to Fluid Dynamics
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a versatile approach for solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs), yet achieving high accuracy efficiently using these techniques remains challenging for high-dimensional or multiscale systems. Here, we present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that enhances Quantum PINNs (QPINNs) through adaptive collocation point sampling and loss-aware attention mechanisms. By dynamically prioritizing points in regions with large PDE residuals or steep solution gradients, our method mitigates the spectral bias inherent in conventional PINNs. Current Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks are commonly assumed to be limited by the expressive power of quantum circuits. In our work, we observed that, across diverse differential equations, optimization - not only expressivity - can be an important bottleneck. Furthermore, a trainable loss-weighting scheme balances contributions from physics residuals, boundary conditions, and data fidelity during training. Integrating these strategies with quantum computing techniques (including variational quantum circuits and quantum gradient estimation) can yield at least a 60% improvement in solution accuracy under specific regimes for benchmark fluid flows and reaction-diffusion systems. Finally, we argue that merely increasing model expressivity is insufficient for resolving complex PDEs via QPINNs, as they remain constrained by the structural optimization limitations of classical PINNs. This framework provides a scalable pathway for quantum-enhanced scientific machine learning, bridging physics-based modeling with emerging quantum computational capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合量子-经典框架，通过自适应配点采样和损失感知注意力机制增强量子物理信息神经网络（QPINNs），在基准流体流动和反应扩散系统中实现了至少60%的精度提升。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN在高维或多尺度系统中难以高效获得高精度，且量子PINN的瓶颈常被归因于量子电路的表达能力，但实际优化问题同样重要。作者希望解决这些局限性。
AI.method: 采用混合量子-经典框架，结合自适应配点采样（动态优先考虑PDE残差大或梯度陡峭的区域）、损失感知注意力机制、可训练损失权重方案，并集成变分量子电路和量子梯度估计等技术。
AI.result: 在基准流体流动和反应扩散系统中，该框架实现了至少60%的求解精度提升，并发现优化而非仅表达能力是QPINNs的重要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 仅增加模型表达能力不足以解决复杂PDE的QPINN求解问题，结构优化限制仍然存在；该框架为量子增强的科学机器学习提供了可扩展路径。

title: Poplar: A Scalable Pipeline for Human-Centric Image Dataset Synthesis
summary: Recent image generators can synthesize convincing human-centric images, yet producing a useful collection remains different from producing a single successful image. A human-centric dataset must cover varied people and contexts, avoid implausible attribute combinations, preserve an everyday photographic character, and expose quality-control decisions at scale. We present Poplar, a reproducible Specify--Render--Inspect pipeline for human-centric image dataset synthesis. Specify samples structured attributes under commonsense constraints and verbalizes them as photography-oriented prompts. Render uses a realism-adapted image generator across composition-aware aspect ratios and retries obvious technical failures. Inspect applies a single structured vision--language review to each candidate, preserving the original prompt while rejecting intrinsic image defects or material prompt mismatches. Using Poplar, we construct Poplar-9K: 9,401 curated human-centric image--text pairs retained from 11,765 reviewed candidates (79.9\% acceptance). We release the dataset together with the pipeline, configurations, immutable generation prompts, and auditable inspection records as a compact resource for building customizable human-centric collections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Poplar，一个可复现的"指定-渲染-检查"（Specify-Render-Inspect）流水线，用于合成以人为中心的图像数据集。该流水线通过结构化属性采样、现实感适配的图像生成和结构化视觉-语言审查，构建了Poplar-9K数据集（9,401对经过筛选的图像-文本对，接受率79.9%）。数据集连同流水线、配置、不可变的生成提示和可审计的检查记录一并发布。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像生成器可以合成逼真的人像图像，但生成一个有用的数据集与生成单个成功图像是不同的任务。以人为中心的数据集需要覆盖多样化的人物和场景、避免不合理的属性组合、保持日常摄影风格，并且需要在规模上暴露质量控制决策，而现有方法缺乏对此的系统性解决方案。
AI.method: Poplar采用三阶段流水线：(1) Specify阶段在常识约束下采样结构化属性，并将其转化为摄影导向的提示词；(2) Render阶段使用经过现实感适配的图像生成器，在考虑构图的长宽比下生成图像，并重试明显技术失败的情况；(3) Inspect阶段对每个候选图像应用单一的结构化视觉-语言审查，保留原始提示词的同时拒绝内在图像缺陷或提示词不匹配的样本。
AI.result: 使用Poplar构建了Poplar-9K数据集：从11,765个审核候选图像中保留9,401个精心筛选的人像图像-文本对（79.9%接受率），并发布了数据集、流水线、配置、不可变生成提示和可审计的检查记录。
AI.conclusion: Poplar提供了一个紧凑且可复现的资源，使研究者能够构建可定制的人像数据集，同时确保质量控制的透明性和可审计性。

title: TreeProbe : A Tibetan Medicine Benchmark for Cultural Bias in LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly viewed as a potential means of mitigating global health inequities, yet their outputs often reflect dominant high-resource medical traditions and provide limited coverage of traditional medical knowledge systems. Tibetan medicine, one of the world's four major traditional medical systems, has an independent and highly structured theoretical framework. When models lack grounded understanding of Tibetan medicine, they may fall back on dominant epistemic systems and distort the native knowledge structure during reasoning. However, quantitative tools for evaluating cultural bias in Tibetan medicine remain largely absent. To address this gap, we introduce TreeProbe, the first cultural-bias benchmark organized around the native Tree of Medicine framework in Tibetan medicine. It contains 4,719 expert-adjudicated items covering 467 diseases and 10 subtasks along the three roots. Experiments on representative LLMs show that current models remain limited in native Tibetan medical contexts and exhibit systematic external ontology drift. Further analysis reveals that models diverge in whether they drift toward biomedical or TCM reasoning, shaped by pretraining data composition and surface resemblance between TCM and Tibetan medicine. TreeProbe provides a diagnostic benchmark for developing medical AI systems that are both linguistically inclusive and epistemically fair. Code and data are available in an anonymous repository at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TreeProbe/.

AI.tldr: TreeProbe是首个围绕藏医学"医学树"本土框架构建的文化偏见评估基准，包含4,719个专家审定的条目，覆盖467种疾病和10个沿三个根组织的子任务。实验表明当前大语言模型在藏医语境中能力有限，并表现出系统性的外部本体漂移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常被视作缓解全球健康不平等的潜在工具，但其输出往往反映主流高资源医学传统，对传统医学知识体系的覆盖有限。藏医是世界四大传统医学体系之一，具有独立且高度结构化的理论框架。当模型缺乏对藏医的扎根理解时，可能退回到主导性认知体系并在推理中扭曲本土知识结构，但目前缺乏量化评估藏医文化偏见的工具。
AI.method: 构建TreeProbe基准：以藏医原生"医学树"框架为核心，收集4,719个专家审定的评测条目，覆盖467种疾病和10个子任务，沿三个根（病理根、诊断根、治疗根）组织。对代表性大语言模型进行系统评测，并分析模型在生物医学与中医推理之间漂移的方向，结合预训练数据组成和中医与藏医的表面相似性进行归因。
AI.result: 当前大语言模型在藏医本土语境中的表现有限，存在系统性的外部本体漂移。模型在漂移方向（朝向生物医学还是中医推理）上存在分歧，这一分歧受预训练数据构成以及中医与藏医之间表面相似性的影响。
AI.conclusion: TreeProbe为开发兼具语言包容性和认知公平性的医学AI系统提供了诊断基准。该工作填补了藏医文化偏见量化评估工具的空白，为医疗AI的公平性研究做出了贡献。

title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Aofan Liu and Jingxiang Meng contributed equally; Fangxin Liu and Yongbiao Chen are corresponding authors
summary: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a framework that transforms execution feedback into a dense per-turn test-pass-ratio reward under a consistent multi-turn interaction protocol. Across six models on 219 code-generation problems from LiveCodeBench, TaPR improves the pooled three-turn success rate (Pass@3) by 2.44 percentage points. In the predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy increases from 30.25% to 33.56% (+3.31 pp), with 42 improvements and 13 regressions in paired trials. On a matched Qwen3-8B ablation, the dense reward supplies nonzero feedback in all of the first ten steps and reaches a higher Hard-subset peak than outcome-only GRPO within the tested budget, although GRPO nearly matches pooled Pass@3 by step 300. Our primary contribution is a reward-decomposition framework and a turn-aware evaluation protocol that decouple first-shot generation quality from multi-turn repair competence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TaPR（Test-aware Policy Refinement）框架，将执行反馈转化为密集的每轮测试通过率奖励，在多轮代码智能体的强化学习训练中解耦首轮生成质量与多轮修复能力。在219个代码生成问题上将三轮成功率提升2.44个百分点，并提出了轮次感知的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 多轮代码智能体依赖执行反馈来修复错误程序，但标准强化学习主要用单轮结果奖励来优化和评估策略。这种错位将初始代码生成与反馈驱动的修复混为一谈，丢弃了中间轮的粒度执行信号，且无法评估策略是否真正获得了自我修复能力。
AI.method: 提出Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR)框架，在一致的多轮交互协议下，将执行反馈转化为密集的每轮测试通过率（per-turn test-pass-ratio）奖励。该方法将奖励分解，在每一轮都提供基于测试执行的密集反馈信号，使策略能够在整个多轮轨迹中持续学习修复能力。
AI.result: 在6个模型、219个来自LiveCodeBench的代码生成问题上，TaPR将池化的三轮成功率（Pass@3）提升2.44个百分点。在预定义的7B/8B高余量子集中，池化准确率从30.25%提升至33.56%（+3.31个百分点），配对试验中有42个改进和13个回退。在Qwen3-8B的消融实验中，密集奖励在前十步中全程提供非零反馈，并在测试预算内达到比仅用结果奖励的GRPO更高的Hard子集峰值，尽管GRPO在第300步时几乎追平池化Pass@3。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是一个奖励分解框架和轮次感知的评估协议，能够解耦首轮生成质量与多轮修复能力，从而更准确地评估和优化代码智能体的自我修复能力。

title: HyperODE: Zero-Shot Surrogate for Simulation and Inference of Dynamical Systems
summary: Understanding and controlling complex dynamical systems often requires executing thousands of numerical simulations across vast parametric landscapes, which is time-consuming. Machine learning surrogates significantly accelerate simulation by predicting state trajectories across different initializations and parameter values. However, surrogate models are specialized to one simulation model. Modifying the underlying differential equations - e.g., adding a physiological state or altering an epidemiological contact network - renders trained models obsolete and forces computationally expensive retraining from scratch. We introduce HyperODE, a surrogate capable of operating across an entire class of approximately mass-conserving compartmental models without retraining. By mapping the structure of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) into directed hypergraphs, HyperODE decouples the functional form of system interactions from the neural network architecture. HyperODE takes a compartmental model in the form of an ODE with an arbitrary parameter distribution defined through quantiles and transforms it into a hypergraph. It outputs the distribution of the trajectories for all the states in the original ODE in the form of quantiles. We then use this surrogate to build an encoder that takes a noisy trajectory and outputs a distribution over the parameters of the original ODE, thus calibrating the model in a single pass. On families and system sizes never seen in training, HyperODE produces calibrated quantile bands in a single forward pass, with weighted-interval score and coverage on par with specialized surrogates for each structure. For inverse inference, HyperODE produces calibration from noisy state trajectories in a few milliseconds with a single shared encoder, competitive with existing methods. HyperODE extends zero-shot to ODEs that break mass conservation and to external forcing.

AI.tldr: HyperODE是一种新型神经网络代理模型，通过将ODE结构映射为有向超图，能够在不重新训练的情况下，适用于整类近似质量守恒的房室模型，支持零样本泛化到未见过的系统结构和大小，并可进行单次前向传播的参数校准。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习代理模型针对单一仿真模型训练，一旦底层微分方程修改（如添加生理状态或改变接触网络），模型即失效，必须从头重新训练，计算开销巨大。需要一种能够跨模型族泛化的通用代理模型。
AI.method: HyperODE将ODEs的结构映射为有向超图，解耦系统交互的函数形式与神经网络架构。它将任意参数分布（以分位数定义）的房室模型转换为超图，输出所有状态轨迹的分位数分布。此外构建编码器，从含噪轨迹输出原始ODE参数的分布，实现单次前向校准。
AI.result: 在训练中未见过的模型族和系统规模上，HyperODE单次前向传播即产生校准的分位数带，其加权区间分数和覆盖率与每个结构的专用代理模型相当。逆推断方面，HyperODE在几毫秒内用单个共享编码器完成含噪轨迹的校准，与现有方法竞争。
AI.conclusion: HyperODE展示了跨模型族的零样本泛化能力，可扩展到打破质量守恒的ODE及外部强迫场景，显著降低复杂系统仿真和参数校准的计算成本。

title: Beyond Static Anchors: Bounded Prototype Conditioning for Language-Free Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: Medical anomaly detection identifies abnormal images and localizes lesions under scarce supervision while generalizing across organs and modalities. Existing CLIP-based methods reduce annotation requirements through vision--language alignment, but their normal and abnormal references, whether text prompts or learned visual tokens, remain fixed across test images. Such static references may not transfer reliably to unseen targets in a cross-domain medical imaging scenario. To address this, we propose ReCAP, a language-free framework that replaces static anchors with input-conditioned visual prototypes. ReCAP re-centers separated normal and abnormal prototypes for each image through a bounded gated modulation, enabling query-adaptive anomaly scoring while constraining context-induced prototype drift. For the few-shot setting, we introduce a non-parametric normal-reference memory to preserve instance-level target-domain variation and complement the conditional prototype branch. Across six medical benchmarks, ReCAP achieves the best image-level AUROC on all zero-shot and 23 of 24 few-shot settings, and the best zero-shot pixel-level AUROC on all three segmentation datasets. Particularly, it reduces inference latency by over 70% compared to the fastest baseline, without text prompts or test-time gradient updates.

AI.tldr: ReCAP是一个无语言（language-free）的医学异常检测框架，用输入条件化的视觉原型替代CLIP方法中静态的文本提示或学习到的视觉标记，通过有界门控调制为每个图像动态重新居中正常和异常原型，并在少样本场景中引入非参数化正常参考记忆来保留目标域的实例级变异。在六个医学基准上取得了最佳的零样本和23/24少样本图像级AUROC，所有三个分割数据集的零样本像素级AUROC，且推理延迟比最快基线降低超过70%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的医学异常检测方法依赖于固定的正常/异常参考（无论是文本提示还是学习到的视觉标记），这些静态参考在跨域医学影像场景中可能无法可靠地迁移到未见过的目标域，导致性能下降。作者旨在解决静态参考在跨域泛化中的局限性。
AI.method: ReCAP包含两个核心组件：(1) 条件原型分支：通过有界门控调制（bounded gated modulation）为每个输入图像动态重新居中分离的正常和异常视觉原型，实现查询自适应的异常评分，同时约束上下文引起的原型漂移；(2) 少样本分支：引入非参数化正常参考记忆（non-parametric normal-reference memory）保存实例级目标域变异，与条件原型分支互补，支持few-shot设置。
AI.result: 在六个医学基准上，ReCAP在所有零样本设置和23/24少样本设置中获得最佳图像级AUROC，在所有三个分割数据集上获得最佳零样本像素级AUROC。推理延迟比最快基线降低超过70%，且无需文本提示或测试时梯度更新。
AI.conclusion: ReCAP通过输入条件化的动态视觉原型替代静态参考，显著提升了医学异常检测的跨域泛化能力，同时大幅降低了推理开销，验证了无语言框架在该任务上的有效性和高效性。

title: Select-And-Extract: A Lightweight Plugin for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for language model (LM) systems fundamentally has two failure modes: retrieval failure and reading failure. The former fails to recall the right pieces of information from the external corpus, and the latter fails to produce the correct answer although the right information is retrieved. Some methods perform structured indexing for retrieval failure, but may suffer from limited generalization of the fixed structures. Some methods perform query-time structuring for reading failure, but typically require a lot of LM calls and rely heavily on the LM's capability. To this end, we propose Select-ANd-Extract (SANE), a simple yet effective plugin for RAG. For the retrieval failure, we retrieve a wide set of candidates with a semantic retriever, and leverage the LM to select the top candidates based on their synopses, which yields better recall than the original retriever. For the reading failure, we perform blueprint-guided query-time evidence extraction, which allows the generator LM to use only compact and structured key information so that it can perform better reasoning. Empirical results confirm that SANE brings solid improvements, while only introducing modest extra overhead. As a lightweight plugin for RAG, SANE offers a simple alternative to heavier approaches, and suggests a high-performance RAG framework need not be overly complex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SANE（Select-ANd-Extract），一个轻量级的RAG插件，通过语义检索器获取广泛候选并使用LM基于概要筛选，解决检索失败问题；同时通过蓝图引导的查询时证据提取，解决阅读失败问题，在提升性能的同时仅引入适度额外开销。
AI.motivation: RAG系统存在两个根本性失败模式：检索失败（无法从外部语料库中召回正确信息）和阅读失败（即使检索到正确信息也无法生成正确答案）。现有方法要么采用结构化索引解决检索失败但泛化能力受限，要么采用查询时结构化处理阅读失败但需要大量LM调用且依赖LM能力。作者希望提出一个简单而高效的方法同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: SANE包含两个核心组件：1）针对检索失败，使用语义检索器召回广泛的候选文档，然后利用LM基于文档概要选择最相关的候选，从而提高召回率；2）针对阅读失败，采用蓝图引导（blueprint-guided）的查询时证据提取，将检索到的信息压缩为紧凑、结构化的关键信息，使生成LM能够进行更好的推理。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，SANE在性能上带来显著改善，同时仅引入适度的额外开销。作为一个轻量级RAG插件，SANE相比更重的方法提供了简单有效的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: SANE证明了高性能的RAG框架不需要过于复杂，一个简单轻量的插件即可有效解决RAG中的检索失败和阅读失败两大问题。

title: BayesSeg: A Bayesian Optimization Framework for State Segmentation of Electricity Consumption Time Series
summary: In Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM), adaptive segmentation of electricity consumption time series is critical for appliance recognition. However, prevailing methods face challenges including heuristic parameter tuning, boundary sensitivity, and metric saturation. This paper proposes BayesSeg, a unified framework integrating time-series segmentation, multidimensional evaluation, and automatic parameter optimization. The segmentation layer employs a dual steady-state criterion based on the tail value and mean of preceding subsequences, combined with a sequential extraction and complement-set parsing strategy, to achieve precise unsupervised partitioning of steady-state and transition-state segments. The evaluation layer maps segmentation results to binary state sequences and formulates a composite metric integrating an event-level F1 score (event_F1) with Normalized Mutual Information (NMI). The event_F1 quantifies switching-event precision and recall via tolerance matching, while NMI captures global structural consistency, jointly overcoming the boundary sensitivity and limited discriminability of point-wise metrics. In the optimization layer, the composite score serves as the objective function for Bayesian optimization, which constructs a TPE surrogate model for efficient global parameter-space exploration. Experiments on the SustDataED2 dataset demonstrate that Bayesian optimization requires only ~100 objective evaluations to locate a parameter region within 0.35% deviation of the exhaustive grid-search optimum. The framework achieves a weighted composite score of 0.7149 and an event_F1 of 0.9340 while reducing optimization latency from ~5300 seconds to under 1 second, a speedup exceeding 5700x. BayesSeg automates segmentation configuration and provides a scalable, efficient solution for time-series analysis in NILM and related domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BayesSeg，一个统一框架，将时间序列分割、多维评估和自动参数优化集成于NILM领域。通过双重稳态准则、贝叶斯优化和复合评估指标，在SustDataED2数据集上实现了0.7149的加权复合得分和0.9340的event_F1，优化延迟从5300秒降至1秒以下（加速超5700倍）。
AI.motivation: NILM中自适应分割电力消耗时间序列对于电器识别至关重要，但现有方法面临启发式参数调优、边界敏感性和指标饱和三大挑战，需要更统一和高效的解决方案。
AI.method: BayesSeg包含三层：1) 分割层采用基于前驱子序列尾部值和均值的双重稳态准则，结合顺序提取和补集解析策略实现无监督分割；2) 评估层将分割结果映射为二元状态序列，提出融合event_F1（容错匹配量化开关事件精度/召回率）和NMI（捕获全局结构一致性）的复合指标；3) 优化层以复合得分为目标函数，使用TPE代理模型的贝叶斯优化进行全局参数搜索。
AI.result: 在SustDataED2数据集上，贝叶斯优化仅需约100次目标函数评估即可达到穷举网格搜索最优值0.35%偏差内的参数区域。框架实现加权复合得分0.7149，event_F1达0.9340，优化延迟从约5300秒降至1秒以下，加速超5700倍。
AI.conclusion: BayesSeg实现了分割配置的自动化，克服了边界敏感性和指标饱和问题，为NILM及相关领域的时间序列分析提供了可扩展、高效的解决方案。

title: SparseKAN: Compressing Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks Across Basis Functions, Neurons, and Bits
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace scalar edge weights with learnable univariate functions parameterized by multiple basis coefficients. This introduces a source of redundancy that conventional neural-network compression does not directly expose. We present \textbf{SparseKAN}, a unified approach that compresses KANs along three complementary axes: basis functions, neurons/channels, and numerical precision. SparseKAN equips the base branch, nonlinear basis branch, and individual basis terms with hierarchical learnable gates trained under a differentiable active-cost objective. The learned importance structure is subsequently hardened under explicit basis and width budgets, recovered in full or low precision, and physically compacted into smaller dense tensors rather than retained as sparse masks. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 across spline, polynomial, RBF, wavelet, and convolutional KAN variants show that the structural axes compose predictably in cost. We also find strong basis-dependent differences in term importance: coefficient-based selection outperforms matched low-order truncation by up to 15.25 accuracy points in the evaluated Gram-polynomial settings. Eight-bit quantization is broadly robust, whereas 4-bit convolutional KANs require quantization-aware adaptation. Physical compaction removes up to 73.0\% of parameters without accuracy loss on MNIST and reduces large-batch CUDA latency to as little as $0.51\times$ dense execution. On a ZCU104 FPGA, the resulting sparse low-bit models achieve up to $23.63\times$ lower inference latency, demonstrating that SparseKAN converts functional redundancy into measurable software and hardware efficiency. The SparseKAN implementation is available at https://github.com/OSU-STARLAB/SparseKAN.

AI.tldr: SparseKAN是一个统一的KAN压缩框架，沿着基函数、神经元/通道和数值精度三个互补维度进行压缩。通过可学习的层级门控和可微活动成本目标，学习重要性结构后在显式预算下硬化，并物理压缩为更小的稠密张量。在多种KAN变体上验证，实现了最高73%的参数减少和23.63倍的FPGA推理加速。
AI.motivation: KAN用可学习的单变量函数（由多个基系数参数化）替代标量边权重，引入了传统神经网络压缩方法无法直接处理的冗余来源，需要一种专门针对KAN结构的统一压缩方法。
AI.method: SparseKAN沿三个轴压缩KAN：基函数、神经元/通道和数值精度。为基础分支、非线性基分支和单个基项配备分层可学习门控，在可微活动成本目标下训练。学习到的结构随后在显式基和宽度预算下硬化，以全精度或低精度恢复，并物理压缩为更小的稠密张量而非保留稀疏掩码。
AI.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上对样条、多项式、RBF、小波和卷积KAN变体进行实验。系数选择比低阶截断最多高15.25个准确率点；8位量化鲁棒，4位卷积KAN需量化感知适应；物理压缩在MNIST上无精度损失移除73.0%参数，CUDA延迟降至稠密执行的0.51倍；ZCU104 FPGA上推理延迟降低达23.63倍。
AI.conclusion: SparseKAN成功将KAN的功能冗余转化为可衡量的软硬件效率，结构轴在成本上可预测地组合，基相关的项重要性差异显著，实现了从算法到硬件端到端的有效压缩。

title: Reconstruction-Shift Discrimination via Mask-Guided Latent Diffusion for Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: Unsupervised medical anomaly detection learns normal anatomical patterns from healthy training images and identifies deviations at test time. Reconstruction-based and diffusion-based methods commonly use the difference between an input image and its reconstruction as anomaly evidence. However, this residual can be ambiguous. Expressive models may preserve pathological structures, while benign anatomical variation, imaging noise, and acquisition differences may also produce large reconstruction errors. We propose discriminative mask-guided diffusion (DMD), a medical anomaly detection framework that complements residual-based localization with reconstruction-shift discrimination. DMD first learns a compact quantized latent representation of normal images. Localized masks then perturb selected latent regions, and a latent diffusion model reconstructs the perturbed representations. The resulting reconstructions are paired with their original normal images to define a self-supervised classification task. At inference, the classifier provides a learned image-level anomaly score, while the residual between the input and its diffusion-based reconstruction yields a pixel-level anomaly map. Experiments on five datasets spanning brain MRI, breast ultrasound, and chest radiography show that DMD achieves the best overall performance among the state-of-the-art baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DMD（判别式掩码引导扩散）框架，用于无监督医学异常检测。该方法结合残差定位与重建位移判别，通过量化潜在表示、掩码扰动和潜在扩散重建，构建自监督分类任务来提供图像级异常分数，同时利用残差提供像素级定位。
AI.motivation: 传统的重建和扩散方法依靠输入图像与重建图像之间的残差作为异常证据，但这种残差具有模糊性：表达能力强的模型可能保留病理结构，而良性解剖变异、成像噪声和采集差异也会产生大的重建误差，导致误检。
AI.method: DMD首先学习正常图像的紧凑量化潜在表示，然后用局部化掩码扰动选定的潜在区域，再通过潜在扩散模型重建扰动后的表示。重建结果与原始正常图像配对，定义自监督分类任务。推理时分类器提供图像级异常分数，输入与扩散重建之间的残差提供像素级异常图。
AI.result: 在涵盖脑MRI、乳腺超声和胸部X光影像的五个数据集上，DMD在总体上优于现有的最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将残差定位与重建位移判别相结合，DMD有效解决了传统残差方法的模糊性问题，在多种医学影像模态上取得了最佳的综合性能。

title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
summary: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future. Unlike conventional language-model interactions, agent behavior is mediated through a shared state that is repeatedly modified and reused across long-horizon workflows. Current safety benchmarks often fail to capture these cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce OpenART, an open-ended arena for scalable agent red teaming through environment evolution. OpenART provides over 10,000 validated stateful scenarios across 50 domains, drawing from a pool of more than 500,000 tools and skills. These tasks require a median of 97 tool calls and enable unified evaluation across 75 different agent-model configurations. To systematically explore these evolving attack surfaces, we propose the Evolutionary Markov Hypergraph Attack (EMHA). EMHA is a black-box policy that performs feedback-driven environment evolution by coordinating authorized state transitions without requiring parameter updates. Throughout the evaluation, task objectives remain fixed while only the environment state changes. Across all configurations, EMHA achieves a pooled Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 85.0%. Its advantage over instruction-only evolution increases from approximately 2% on simple environments to over 17% on the most complex ones, demonstrating that environment evolution increasingly exposes safety failures as task complexity grows. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the specific runtime implementation of an agent explains a significant portion of safety variation beyond the underlying model's capabilities. These results establish OpenART as a scalable foundation for studying agent safety in complex, evolving environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenART，一个通过环境演化进行可扩展智能体红队测试的开放性竞技场，包含超过10,000个有状态场景、50个领域和500,000多个工具/技能，并提出了EMHA（演化马尔可夫超图攻击）黑盒策略，在75种智能体模型配置上实现了85.0%的聚合攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型交互不同，智能体行为通过共享状态在多步骤工作流中被反复修改和重用，而现有安全基准集中于短期静态任务，未能捕捉这些累积性风险。需要一个能反映智能体在持久、演化的环境中长期决策的评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建OpenART：超过10,000个经过验证的有状态场景，覆盖50个领域，来源于超过500,000个工具和技能，任务中位数需要97次工具调用，支持75种不同的智能体模型配置的统一评估。2) 提出EMHA（Evolutionary Markov Hypergraph Attack）：一种黑盒攻击策略，通过反馈驱动的环境演化来协调授权的状态转换，无需参数更新，在固定任务目标的前提下仅改变环境状态来系统性探索攻击面。
