Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and WideSearch show that immediate compaction often hurts performance, whereas delaying compaction to use the agent's future queries recovers much of the gap. Moreover, TE is often more robust than AM under imperfect proxies. Across models at different scales, TE preserves most of the accuracy while reducing KV cache by 80%, and can improve throughput over the no compaction baseline. These results position proxy-query selection as a core design choice for practical online KV compaction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体场景下的在线KV缓存压缩问题，提出在智能体未来查询不可知的情况下，使用廉价代理查询（如边界查询、重复预填充、延迟未来生成查询）进行token驱逐和注意力匹配压缩。实验表明即时压缩往往损害性能，而延迟压缩以利用未来查询可以恢复大部分差距，且token驱逐在代理不完美时比注意力匹配更鲁棒，能在减少80% KV缓存的同时保持大部分准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体产生长轨迹（推理步骤、工具调用、环境反馈），导致KV缓存成为主要推理瓶颈。现有KV缓存压缩方法大多假设静态上下文（未来查询已知或可离线近似），而智能体场景需要在线压缩——新信息必须在其未来相关性未知之前被压缩，且代理查询必须足够廉价以适配推理路径。作者希望填补在线KV缓存压缩这一空白。
AI.method: 将KV压缩方法（token驱逐TE和注意力匹配AM）适配到智能体回合压缩场景，比较三种廉价代理查询来源：边界查询（boundary）、重复预填充（repeat-prefill）和延迟未来生成查询（delayed future-generation），并在BrowseComp-Plus和WideSearch基准上进行实验。
AI.result: 1) 即时压缩往往损害性能，延迟压缩以使用智能体未来查询可恢复大部分差距；2) 在代理查询不完美时，token驱逐比注意力匹配更鲁棒；3) 跨不同规模模型，token驱逐在减少80% KV缓存的同时保持大部分准确性，并能提升吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 代理查询的选择是实用在线KV压缩的核心设计决策，延迟压缩策略和token驱逐方法在实践中表现更优，为LLM智能体推理优化提供了新方向。

title: Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化课程学习（ECL），利用同源序列的进化距离作为归纳偏置，渐进式地按幂律扩展训练数据，在蛋白质变体效应预测（EVE）和RNA家族序列生成（RfamGen）两个任务上均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 标准生物VAE训练将所有序列视为可交换的，忽略了同源序列从进化近到进化远的丰富结构信息。进化距离这一自然层级尚未被利用来优化训练过程。
AI.method: ECL策略：从锚点序列出发，按幂律扩展调度逐步暴露模型于进化距离递增的序列，从进化近到进化远渐进式训练课程。
AI.result: p53的ClinVar AUROC从0.981提升至0.989；PTEN在所有随机种子下达到1.000（基线不稳定，均值0.905）；RNA三个家族的平均协方差模型位分数均提升，12/15训练运行优于种子匹配基线。消融实验表明渐进扩展优于固定邻域采样和均匀随机采样。
AI.conclusion: 进化距离是生物序列建模中用于排序训练课程的有用归纳偏置，ECL在两个不同架构的VAE模型和两个生物域上均带来下游任务性能提升。

title: Beyond Gene Reconstruction: Learning Cell Representations through Complementary Transcriptomic Views
summary: The rapid growth of single-cell transcriptomic data has enabled the development of foundation models pretrained primarily by reconstructing masked expression values. This objective encourages these models to learn gene dependencies but does not directly optimize whole-cell representations, which are essential for many downstream tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose a contrastive pretraining framework that learns cell representations through complementary transcriptomic views. Since standard contrastive learning is not readily applicable to single-cell pretraining, we introduce specific adaptations along three dimensions --- co-expression-guided gene partitioning, expression-aware contrast-set construction, and competence-gated contrastive onset. Specifically, we first construct two complementary views of each cell by partitioning its genes according to their co-expression structure. Then, to prevent the model from using gene-set identity as a shortcut, we construct hard negatives by permuting expression values while keeping gene identities unchanged. Finally, we introduce a competence-aware controller to determine how the contrastive objective is applied. Experiments on cell-type annotation and gene regulatory network inference demonstrate competitive transfer under the evaluated protocols. In the six-network GRN evaluation, our method records the highest mean AUROC and AUPRC point estimates among the compared variants, while the highest-scoring variant differs across individual networks. These results establish complementary-view contrastive learning as an effective direction for single-cell pretraining beyond gene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向单细胞转录组数据的对比预训练框架，通过互补转录组视图学习细胞表示，克服了传统掩码重建预训练不直接优化全细胞表示的局限。方法包括共表达引导的基因划分、表达感知的对比集构建和胜任力门控的对比学习启动三个核心适应策略，实验表明其在细胞类型注释和基因调控网络推断任务上具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞基础模型主要采用掩码表达值重建的预训练目标，虽然能学习基因依赖关系，但未能直接优化全细胞表示，而全细胞表示对许多下游任务至关重要。标准对比学习无法直接应用于单细胞预训练场景，亟需特定适配。
AI.method: 提出对比预训练框架，包含三个关键维度：(1) 共表达引导的基因划分——根据基因共表达结构将基因分为两组互补视图；(2) 表达感知的对比集构建——通过置换表达值同时保持基因身份不变来构造硬负样本，防止模型利用基因集身份作为捷径；(3) 胜任力门控的对比启动——引入胜任力感知控制器决定对比目标的施加方式。
AI.result: 在细胞类型注释和基因调控网络推断任务中表现出有竞争力的迁移性能。在六个网络的GRN评估中，该方法取得了最高的平均AUROC和AUPRC点估计值，但不同网络上最高得分的变体各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 互补视图对比学习是单细胞预训练中超越基因重建的有效方向，为该领域的预训练策略提供了新范式。

title: Test-time Adaptation of Pelvic Bone Segmentation Models via Dynamic Reliability-Guided
comment: Provisionally accepted for presentation at MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable pelvic bone segmentation (PBS) from CT is essential for robot-assisted pelvic trauma surgery, yet deploying a source-trained model to a new hospital suffers from severe performance degradation due to cross-center domain shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) enables online model adaptation without accessing source data, existing methods show limited effectiveness for PBS, facing challenges including boundary degradation, anatomical inconsistency under domain shifts, and voxel-level class imbalance. To address these challenges, we propose a novel closed-loop dynamic Reliability-Guided TTA framework (ReGA) for PBS. Specifically, we introduce a pseudo-label reliability criterion termed Segmentation Inference Consistency Evaluation (SICE), which jointly measures region overlap and boundary deviation via dropout-based ensemble predictions. Based on SICE, a trust-weighted refinement module adaptively updates features to mitigate boundary errors in pseudo-labels. Furthermore, a confidence-weighted region-level contrastive learning strategy is proposed to enforce anatomical consistency. Finally, ReGA follows the teacher-student (TS) scheme to alleviate voxel-level class imbalance. Experiments on three heterogeneous 3D pelvic CT datasets demonstrate that ReGA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA methods, enabling effective adaptation of the source-trained PBS model to unseen clinical domains. The code is available at https://github.com/Ren-ling/ReGA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ReGA的闭环动态可靠性引导测试时自适应（TTA）框架，用于骨盆CT图像分割。该方法通过提出分割推断一致性评估（SICE）标准来联合度量区域重叠与边界偏差，并结合信任加权细化模块、置信度加权的区域级对比学习以及教师-学生机制，有效解决了跨中心域迁移中边界退化、解剖不一致和体素级类别不平衡等挑战。
AI.motivation: 可靠的骨盆骨分割对机器人辅助盆腔创伤手术至关重要，但源域训练模型部署到新医院时因跨中心域偏移而严重性能下降。现有TTA方法在骨盆分割中效果有限，面临边界退化、域偏移下的解剖不一致以及体素级类别不平衡等挑战。
AI.method: 提出ReGA框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) SICE伪标签可靠性判据，通过Dropout集成预测联合度量区域重叠和边界偏差；(2) 信任加权细化模块，自适应更新特征以缓解伪标签边界误差；(3) 置信度加权区域级对比学习策略，强制解剖一致性。整体遵循教师-学生方案以缓解体素级类别不平衡。
AI.result: 在三个异构3D盆腔CT数据集上的实验表明，ReGA在TTA方法中持续表现最优，能够有效将源训练的PBS模型适应到未见过的临床域。
AI.conclusion: ReGA框架通过闭环动态可靠性引导机制，成功实现了骨盆分割模型在跨中心临床域的在线自适应，显著提升了模型的泛化能力，代码已开源。

title: FinHardBench: Can LLMs Generate Latency-Aware Hardware for Financial Computing?
comment: 16 pages (10 pages main text). Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/owenfucell/FinHardBench
summary: Can large language models generate not just correct, but fast hardware? This paper investigates the question in financial FPGA design, where 5-10 nanoseconds of latency determines competitive advantage and designs iterate continuously as protocols, strategies, and regulations evolve. FinHardBench, a benchmark of 33 financial computing tasks, is presented together with three experiments that mirror the real-world FPGA iteration cycle: generating new modules from specifications, tuning system-level configurations across a 6-stage trading pipeline, and adapting existing modules to specification changes. Evaluation of six LLMs on 1530+ experiment rounds yields three findings: (1) models achieve 19-61% functional correctness with timing degradation up to 13.7$\times$ on specific tasks; (2) in system-level design space exploration, top LLMs converge to the optimal configuration with higher reliability than random search, simulated annealing, and Bayesian optimization baselines (5/5 seeds vs. 0-4/5 at the same 24-round budget); (3) strategy-level specification changes remain unsolved for most models. Across the six models, generation and DSE rankings overlap moderately: the strongest code generator is not the fastest architecture optimizer, and the weakest code generator (MiniMax M2.7) still reaches the system optimum on 4 of 5 seeds. On the tasks in FinHardBench, difficulty tracks training data pattern availability more closely than abstraction level. FinHardBench is released as an open-source benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinHardBench基准，包含33个金融计算任务，用于评估大语言模型在FPGA硬件设计中的能力。通过对6个LLM进行1530+轮实验，发现模型在功能正确性上达到19-61%，但在时序优化上可能退化高达13.7倍；在系统级设计空间探索中，顶尖LLM比随机搜索、模拟退火和贝叶斯优化更可靠地收敛到最优配置；策略级规范变更对多数模型仍是未解难题。
AI.motivation: 金融FPGA设计中5-10纳秒的延迟决定竞争优势，且设计需要随协议、策略和法规变化不断迭代。作者希望探究大语言模型能否不仅生成正确的硬件，还能生成快速的硬件，以加速金融FPGA设计的迭代周期。
AI.method: 构建包含33个金融计算任务的FinHardBench基准，设计三个模拟真实世界FPGA迭代周期的实验：(1)从规范生成新模块；(2)在6阶段交易流水线中调优系统级配置；(3)将现有模块适配到规范变更。评估6个LLM在1530+轮实验中的表现。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1)模型功能正确率19-61%，特定任务时序退化高达13.7倍；(2)系统级DSE中，顶尖LLM在24轮预算下5/5种子收敛到最优，优于基线方法的0-4/5；(3)策略级规范变更对多数模型未解决。代码生成与DSE排名仅中等重叠，最强的代码生成器并非最快的架构优化器，最弱的代码生成器MiniMax M2.7仍在5个种子中4次达到系统最优。
AI.conclusion: LLM在金融FPGA设计中展现出部分能力，尤其在系统级设计空间探索方面表现突出，但功能正确性和时序优化仍有显著不足。任务难度与训练数据模式可用性相关度高于抽象层级。FinHardBench已开源，可作为该领域的基准测试平台。

title: DGA$_2$D: Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design with Large Language Models
summary: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened new avenues for Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). However, existing LLM-driven AHD methods are largely confined to rigid solver templates, relegating the search process to isolated module tuning. Transitioning to fully autonomous, system-level algorithm design is essential but fraught with low reliability of generated operators, extremely large search spaces, and ineffective credit assignment. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design framework, termed DGA$_2$D. It structures the open-ended program space as a directed graph, where each node represents a functional operator that can be instantiated using one of multiple candidate code implementations, while directed walks constitute complete algorithmic pipelines. A first-order path-dependent credit assignment mechanism is introduced to evaluate code variations strictly based on their topological context. Extensive experiments across 12 distinct COPs, ranging from complex scheduling to routing, demonstrate the consistent empirical advantages of DGA$_2$D. It reduces the average normalized gap by up to 10.96 percentage points compared to state-of-the-art LLM baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DGA₂D框架，将有向图结构引入LLM驱动的自动算法设计（AHD），将程序搜索空间组织为有向图，每个节点代表可实例化的功能算子，有向路径构成完整算法流水线，并引入一阶路径依赖的信用分配机制来评估代码变体。在12个NP-hard组合优化问题上相比SOTA LLM基线平均归一化差距降低最高10.96个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的自动启发式设计（AHD）方法受限于固定的求解器模板，只能进行孤立的模块调优，无法实现全自主的系统级算法设计。其面临的三大挑战是：生成算子的可靠性低、搜索空间极大、以及信用分配机制无效。因此需要一种能够突破刚性模板约束、实现端到端算法自动设计的新框架。
AI.method: DGA₂D框架的核心方法包括：(1) 将开端的程序搜索空间结构化为有向图，每个节点代表一个功能算子，每个算子可通过多个候选代码实现之一进行实例化；(2) 有向路径（directed walks）构成完整的算法流水线；(3) 引入一阶路径依赖的信用分配机制，基于拓扑上下文严格评估代码变体的贡献。
AI.result: 在12个不同的NP-hard组合优化问题（覆盖复杂调度到路径规划）上的大量实验表明，DGA₂D相比SOTA LLM基线，平均归一化差距最多降低10.96个百分点，展现出持续一致的实证优势。
AI.conclusion: DGA₂D通过有向图引导的搜索空间结构化和路径依赖的信用分配，有效解决了LLM驱动AHD中算子可靠性低、搜索空间过大和信用分配无效的问题，实现了更接近全自主的系统级算法自动设计，在广泛的COP基准上取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。

title: Who Belongs in the Eval Set? A Capability-Taxonomy-Driven Pipeline for Curating Regression Eval Sets in Agent-Extensibility Platforms
comment: Extended abstract accepted at the SERI 2026 Industry Track
summary: Platform teams hosting agent-extensibility surfaces face a regression-economics paradox: every onboarding customer ships an evaluation set tuned to their domain, but the platform's regression set must live under a hard query-count ceiling bounded by release cadence. To our knowledge, no published industrial pipeline addresses this platform-side curation problem: existing evaluation frameworks are customer-side, and benchmark-compression work treats benchmarks as fixed pools rather than streams of incoming sets. We describe a capability-taxonomy-driven curation pipeline applied to declarative agents with custom actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot. It takes an agent specification and a customer's eval set as input, projects each query into a platform-owned capability taxonomy, and outputs per-query decisions (admit, drop, swap, or human review), under the philosophy that a healthy regression set is the minimal set of queries capturing the maximal spread of capability signatures -- distinct combinations of capabilities a query exercises together. Three components instantiate this: a classifier producing per-(query, capability) verdicts via a hybrid of deterministic specification-based extraction and large-language-model (LLM) semantic inference; an Invocation Quality (IQ) rater scoring how thoroughly a query exercises each capability, so a new query sharing a signature with an existing entry can still be recognized as a better test and displace it; and a consolidator comparing incoming queries against the regression set on coverage and quality through a rule-based decision cascade, backed by a conservative curator that only suggests evictions. The mechanism is taxonomy-agnostic and applies to any regression eval-set curation problem with a typed capability taxonomy, including taxonomies that evolve in response to the very evidence the pipeline surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于能力分类学的回归测试集策管管道，用于解决平台方在托管代理可扩展性表面时面临的回归经济悖论：客户持续提交领域相关的评估集，但平台的回归集受限于硬性查询数上限。该管道以代理规格和客户评估集为输入，将每个查询投影到平台拥有的能力分类学中，输出每查询决策（接受、丢弃、替换或人工审查），核心理念是健康回归集=以最少数量的查询覆盖最大范围的能力签名。
AI.motivation: 平台团队在托管代理可扩展性表面时，每个客户都提交针对其领域的评估集，但平台回归集受硬性查询数上限约束。现有评估框架都是客户侧的，基准压缩工作将基准视为固定池而非流式输入，尚无已发表的工业管道解决这一平台侧策管问题。
AI.method: 管道由三个组件构成：(1) 分类器——通过确定性规格提取和LLM语义推断的混合方法，为每对(查询,能力)生成判定；(2) 调用质量(IQ)评分器——评估查询对每项能力的覆盖深度，使共享同一能力签名的新查询可被识别为更优测试并取代旧条目；(3) 合并器——通过基于规则的决策级联，对传入查询与回归集进行覆盖率和质量的比较，由保守策管器仅建议驱逐。该方法与分类学无关，适用于任何具有类型化能力分类学的回归评估集策管问题。
AI.result: 该管道已应用于Microsoft 365 Copilot中具有自定义操作的声明式代理。论文主张该机制是与分类学无关的，并适用于分类学随时间演化的场景。具体实验数据在完整论文中呈现。
AI.conclusion: 该管道解决了平台侧回归集策管问题，健康回归集的定义是最大限度覆盖能力签名的最小查询集。策管器采取保守驱逐策略，仅建议而非强制驱逐，并且系统能够适应分类学随证据演化的需求。

title: GuideGround: VLM-guided Semantic Understanding and Viewpoint-aware Reasoning for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding aims to localize the target object in a 3D scene from a natural language query, requiring both fine-grained semantic understanding and viewpoint-dependent spatial reasoning. Existing methods typically formulate semantic understanding as an auxiliary closed-set object classification task and rely on multi-view feature aggregation for viewpoint reasoning, limiting semantic generalization and weakening viewpoint-specific evidence. We observe that vision-language models naturally provide complementary capabilities through open-vocabulary semantic understanding and global scene perception. Based on this insight, we propose GuideGround, a VLM-guided framework that complements rather than replaces task-specific grounding models by leveraging VLMs for semantic enhancement and viewpoint-specific hypothesis verification. Specifically, we replace auxiliary closed-set object classification with VLM-generated object semantic descriptions to enhance semantic understanding. Meanwhile, instead of directly aggregating multi-view representations, we preserve viewpoint-specific grounding hypotheses through per-view grounding and explicitly verify them using VLMs across candidate viewpoints. Extensive experiments on the ReferIt3D benchmark demonstrate that GuideGround consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of both the proposed semantic understanding and viewpoint reasoning strategies.

AI.tldr: GuideGround是一个VLM引导的3D视觉定位框架，通过利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的开放词汇语义理解和全局场景感知能力，增强任务特定的定位模型。它用VLM生成的语义描述替代封闭集分类，并通过逐视角定位和候选视角验证来保留视角特定证据，在ReferIt3D基准上超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉定位方法存在两个核心问题：(1)将语义理解建模为辅助的封闭集物体分类任务，限制了语义泛化能力；(2)依赖多视角特征聚合进行视角推理，削弱了视角特定的证据信息。作者观察到VLM天然具备开放词汇语义理解和全局场景感知的互补能力，因此希望加以利用。
AI.method: 提出GuideGround框架，核心思想是"互补而非替代"：(1)语义增强：用VLM生成的物体语义描述替代传统的辅助封闭集物体分类，提升语义理解能力；(2)视角特定假设验证：不直接聚合多视角表示，而是通过逐视角定位保留视角特定的定位假设，再利用VLM在候选视角间进行显式验证。
AI.result: 在ReferIt3D基准上的大量实验表明，GuideGround一致性地超越了先前的最先进方法。全面的消融研究进一步验证了所提出的语义理解和视角推理策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GuideGround证明了VLM可以作为一种互补的增强组件，而非替代品，有效地提升3D视觉定位模型的语义理解和视角推理能力，为结合VLM与任务特定模型提供了新的思路。

title: Gaokerena: A Small Persian Medical Language Model Family
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence into medical question-answering systems has advanced rapidly; however, research remains predominantly focused on English, leaving low resource languages like Persian significantly underserved. To address this gap, this paper introduces Gaokerena, a novel family of compact Persian medical language models optimized for deployment on consumer grade hardware. As a foundational step toward localized digital healthcare, we first present Gaokerena-V, developed by training a baseline model on a newly curated 90-million-token Persian medical corpus and 20,000 expert-vetted physician Q&A pairs, which improved performance on a translated medical MMLU benchmark from 46.28% to 49.31%. Second, recognizing the critical demands of clinical reasoning, we developed Gaokerena-R by integrating a Chain-of-Thought approach with two novel Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback (RLAIF) frameworks to optimize preference-based reasoning. Despite utilizing the same baseline architecture and a smaller dataset than Gaokerena-V, Gaokerena-R achieved a superior benchmark score of 52.98%. Furthermore, both models are equipped with custom-developed uncertainty heads that predict the model's confidence in its responses based solely on internal hidden states. While these results demonstrate significant progress in Persian medical language modeling and proactive safety estimation, current performance levels remain insufficient for direct clinical application, highlighting the necessity for further research into robust knowledge acquisition and rigorous safety verification prior to real world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Gaokerena，一个面向波斯语医学问答的紧凑型语言模型家族，可在消费级硬件上部署。包括基于90M token波斯语医学语料训练的Gaokerena-V（MMLU从46.28%提升至49.31%），以及通过CoT与两种新型RLAIF框架优化的Gaokerena-R（达到52.98%）。两个模型均配备基于内部隐藏状态预测置信度的不确定性头部，但当前性能仍不足以直接应用于临床。
AI.motivation: 现有医学AI问答系统研究过度集中于英语，低资源语言（如波斯语）严重缺乏相应的大语言模型支持，阻碍了本地化数字医疗的发展。
AI.method: 1）构建90M token的波斯语医学语料库和2万条专家审核的医患问答对；2）训练Gaokerena-V基线模型；3）在Gaokerena-R中引入CoT推理及两种新的基于AI反馈的强化学习（RLAIF）框架来优化偏好推理；4）为两个模型设计基于内部隐藏状态自定义不确定性头部来预测模型置信度。
AI.result: Gaokerena-V在翻译后的医学MMLU基准上从46.28%提升至49.31%；Gaokerena-R在更少数据下取得52.98%的更优成绩；两个模型均实现基于内部状态的置信度预测。
AI.conclusion: 虽然波斯语医学语言建模和安全评估方面取得了显著进展，但当前模型性能仍不足以直接用于临床，需要在知识获取鲁棒性和安全验证方面开展进一步研究才能实现实际部署。

title: Tracing the Cascade: A Topology-Aware Evaluation Framework for Scientific Agent Hallucinations
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in scientific research, where reliability is critical and the underlying knowledge is densely interconnected. In such settings, hallucinations are particularly damaging: a single erroneous claim on a foundational concept can propagate through multi-step reasoning and corrupt entire trajectories. Existing hallucination benchmarks largely operate at the surface level, treating facts in isolation and relying on uniform accuracy metrics that ignore this topological structure. We address this gap with SCHEMA, the first evidence-grounded, topology-aware evaluation framework for hallucinations in scientific agents. SCHEMA automatically constructs scientific concept graphs from benchmark seeds and literature evidence, synthesizes graph-grounded tasks spanning claim verification, multi-hop reasoning, open-ended explanation, and experimental code generation, and evaluates agents with two complementary diagnostics. A trajectory hallucination pipeline audits intermediate reasoning at scale via a topology-weighted severity score, while a multi-agent counterfactual attribution module pinpoints the causal mechanism behind selected failures. SCHEMA reveals that hallucinations concentrate at a small set of highly connected knowledge hubs, and that final-answer accuracy decouples from trajectory honesty; models often reach correct conclusions through structurally flawed reasoning. These results indicate that for high-stakes scientific applications, terminal accuracy alone is an insufficient signal of agent reliability, motivating mechanism-level evaluation grounded in knowledge topology. Code is available at https://github.com/circles-post/SCHEMA.

AI.tldr: SCHEMA是一个首个基于证据、感知拓扑结构的大语言模型智能体幻觉评估框架，专为科研场景设计。它自动构建科学概念图谱，合成多种图谱锚定任务，并通过轨迹幻觉管线（拓扑加权严重度评分）和多智能体反事实归因模块两种诊断方式评估智能体，揭示幻觉集中于知识枢纽节点，且最终回答准确性与轨迹诚实度脱钩。
AI.motivation: 在科研应用中，LLM智能体的可靠性至关重要，知识高度互联，幻觉的危害会通过多步推理级联放大。现有幻觉基准多在表面层面运作，将事实视为孤立个体，采用统一的准确率指标，忽视了知识的拓扑结构，无法捕捉幻觉在推理链中的传播效应。
AI.method: SCHEMA框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 从基准种子和文献证据自动构建科学概念图谱；(2) 合成图谱锚定任务，涵盖声明验证、多跳推理、开放式解释和实验代码生成；(3) 双重诊断机制：轨迹幻觉管线通过拓扑加权严重度评分审计中间推理，多智能体反事实归因模块定位选定失败背后的因果机制。
AI.result: SCHEMA揭示两个关键发现：幻觉集中在少数高连接度的知识枢纽节点上；最终答案准确性与轨迹诚实度相互解耦——模型常通过结构有缺陷的推理得出正确结论。
AI.conclusion: 对于高风险科研应用，仅靠终端准确性不足以衡量智能体可靠性，需要基于知识拓扑结构的机制层面评估。

title: Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction: An Unbounded Machine Learning Model
summary:
Solomonoff Induction, or SolInd, provides an ideal unbounded model of a priori sequence prediction but cannot naturally describe extrapolation from a given training dataset, as performed by Large Language Models. We apply de Finetti's theorem on exchangeable distributions to SolInd to produce what we call Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction, or HSI, which maintains a hyperprior over all Solomonoff priors that can be conditioned on previously observed sequences.
  We extend Wood et al.'s proof that universal mixtures of semimeasures are equivalent to SolInd to show that universal mixtures of these mixtures are also equivalent, proving that HSI=SolInd. We also prove that HSI's excess error on any distribution, compared to its true generator, is bounded by that generator's complexity in the hyperprior. This result is directly comparable to SolInd's prediction error being bounded by the Kolmogorov complexity of the sequence being predicted, and forces HSI's average excess error to converge to 0 as a dataset grows, leading to optimal prediction in the limit. We claim that HSI is an ideal unbounded model of sequence prediction given a dataset in the same way that SolInd is ideal over individual sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次化 Solomonoff 归纳（HSI），通过对 Solomonoff 归纳应用 de Finetti 定理，构造了一个可在给定数据集条件下进行序列预测的理想无界模型，并证明了 HSI 与原始 SolInd 等价，且其预测误差收敛于最优。
AI.motivation: Solomonoff Induction (SolInd) 是一个理想的无界先验序列预测模型，但它无法自然地描述从给定训练数据集中进行外推的任务，而这正是大语言模型（LLM）所做的。需要一个能够基于已有数据集进行条件化预测的理想模型。
AI.method: 将 de Finetti 关于可交换分布的定理应用于 SolInd，构造一个对所有 Solomonoff 先验的超先验（hyperprior），使其可以基于先前观测到的序列进行条件化。并扩展 Wood 等人的证明，论证通用半测度混合的混合仍然等价于 SolInd，从而证明 HSI = SolInd。
AI.result: 证明了 HSI 与 SolInd 等价；证明了 HSI 在任何分布上的超额误差受限于该分布在超先验中的复杂度；HSI 的平均超额误差随数据集增长收敛到 0，实现极限意义上的最优预测。
AI.conclusion: HSI 是给定数据集条件下的理想无界序列预测模型，正如 SolInd 是单个序列上的理想模型一样，为从有限数据外推到无限序列提供了理论上的最优基准。

title: Unleashing the Power of Text: Text-Guided Flow Matching for Image Fusion under Complex Degradations
summary: Infrared-visible image fusion under realistic degradation scenarios is a challenging task, as degradations not only cause a loss of reliable modality-specific information in observed images but also hinder the fusion process. Recent studies indicate that text can provide prior information about degradation characteristics, complementing the limited evidence available from corrupted input images and facilitating fusion. However, existing methods typically inject fixed global text representations into visual features, making it difficult for textual guidance to adapt to spatially varying degradations, local structures, and thermal saliency. To this end, we propose TGFusion, a text-guided latent-space flow matching framework that unifies degradation suppression and cross-modal fusion. TGFusion encodes task, degradation, and generation cues into structured prompts. To fully exploit these priors, we design a Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer that represents text as an independent semantic stream alongside fusion, visible, and infrared streams. Joint attention enables token-level bidirectional interaction and layer-wise updating among semantic and visual representations, allowing degradation semantics to dynamically guide reliable information selection and fusion latent generation. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and complex degradation scenarios demonstrate that TGFusion achieves superior or competitive performance in perceptual quality, image naturalness, structural-detail preservation, and infrared-saliency retention, while remaining robust across diverse single and compound degradations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TGFusion，一个文本引导的潜空间流匹配框架，统一处理退化抑制和跨模态融合，通过结构化提示和Prompt条件多流联合流Transformer实现退化语义对融合过程的动态引导。
AI.motivation: 红外-可见光图像融合在真实退化场景下极具挑战性，退化不仅导致模态特定信息丢失，还阻碍融合过程。现有方法使用固定的全局文本表示注入视觉特征，难以适应空间变化的退化、局部结构和热显著性。
AI.method: 提出TGFusion框架：(1) 将任务、退化和生成线索编码为结构化提示；(2) 设计Prompt条件多流联合流Transformer，将文本表示为独立语义流，与融合、可见光、红外流并行；(3) 通过联合注意力实现token级双向交互和逐层更新，使退化语义动态引导信息选择和融合潜空间生成。
AI.result: 在公开基准和复杂退化场景上的大量实验表明，TGFusion在感知质量、图像自然度、结构细节保持和红外显著性保留方面达到优越或竞争性性能，并在多种单一和复合退化下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TGFusion通过文本语义与视觉表征的token级动态交互，有效解决了固定全局文本引导无法适应空间变化退化的问题，实现了退化抑制与跨模态融合的统一。

title: Mind the Gap: Zero-Query Jailbreaks via Filter-Generator Discrepancy in Text-to-Image Systems
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems typically have prompt-level safety filters before the generator to block unsafe requests, yet such systems remain vulnerable to malicious jailbreak prompts. Transfer-based attacks construct adversarial prompts offline without querying the target, but they tend to overfit to a single surrogate. Moreover, they explore a large search space in which semantic or perceptual similarity alone cannot guarantee both filter evasion and preservation of the unsafe generation intent, wasting effort on low-potential candidates. We observe that the filter and the generator process the same prompt under different objectives and representations, and term this gap the Filter-Generator Discrepancy (FGD), which allows a perturbation to reduce a prompt's perceived risk to the filter while preserving the visual concept needed by the generator. Building on FGD, we propose a zero-query jailbreak framework that screens perturbations into a high-potential candidate set via observable discrepancy rules at the tokenization and semantic stages, and then performs a surrogate-ensemble evolutionary search that requires no access to the target. Experiments on six black-box pipelines and a commercial online service show that our method consistently outperforms representative baselines, raising the average attack success rate to 29.2\% (MHSC) and 33.3\% (Q16) across the six pipelines and improving over the strongest baseline by about 8 and 12 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于"过滤器-生成器差异"(FGD)的零查询越狱框架，通过筛选高潜力扰动候选集并利用代理集成进化搜索，实现对文本到图像系统的黑盒越狱攻击，在六个黑盒流水线和商业在线服务上显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像(T2I)系统虽有提示级别的安全过滤器，但仍易受越狱提示攻击。基于迁移的攻击方法存在两个问题：一是过度拟合单一代理模型；二是搜索空间巨大，仅靠语义或感知相似性无法同时保证过滤器规避和保留不安全生成意图，浪费大量算力在低潜力候选上。作者观察到过滤器与生成器在处理相同提示时使用不同目标和表示，这一差异(FGD)可以被利用。
AI.method: 作者提出零查询越狱框架：(1) 基于FGD概念，在分词(tokenization)和语义两个阶段通过可观察的差异规则筛选扰动，构成高潜力候选集；(2) 采用代理集成(ensemble)进化搜索，不需要访问目标系统。该方法利用扰动降低提示对过滤器的感知风险，同时保留生成器所需的视觉概念。
AI.result: 在六个黑盒流水线和商业在线服务上，该方法一致优于代表性基线，平均攻击成功率在MHSC指标上达到29.2%，Q16指标上达到33.3%，比最强基线分别提高了约8和12个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用过滤器与生成器之间的表示和训练目标差异(FGD)，可以构建高效的零查询越狱攻击，无需访问目标系统即可实现高成功率，为理解T2I系统的安全漏洞提供了新视角。

title: AI-Based Thesis Assessment: An Empirical Study of Human Evaluation Priorities and Their Impact on Automated Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education Technology (AIET 2026), Zagreb, Croatia
summary: Rubric-based AI systems for thesis assessment use criterion weights to assign different levels of importance to evaluation criteria. These weights are typically defined through expert judgment, although little empirical evidence exists regarding how thesis supervisors actually prioritize evaluation criteria. Consequently, this study investigates supervisor-derived criterion weights in thesis assessment and evaluates their impact on AI-based assessment. We surveyed 84 thesis supervisors across four academic disciplines and collected weighting data for 35 thesis assessment criteria. Comparison with the default criterion weights of the AI assessment system RubiSCoT [1] revealed substantial divergences between supervisor-derived and default criterion weights. To evaluate the practical implications of these differences, the supervisor-derived weights were integrated into multiple calibration configurations and evaluated on a corpus of 80 German-language theses. The best-performing configuration reduced the mean relative deviation between AI-generated and supervisor-assigned evaluations from 11.18% to 10.85%, although the improvement was not statistically significant. Human supervisors showed substantially stronger agreement with each other, exhibiting a mean inter-supervisor relative deviation of 4.44%. The findings indicate that criterion-weight calibration alone does not substantially improve alignment between AI-generated and human assessments.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了84位来自四个学科的论文导师对35个评估标准的权重分配，并与AI评估系统RubiSCoT的默认权重进行比较。结果显示导师权重与默认权重存在显著差异，但将导师权重整合到AI系统中仅将平均相对偏差从11.18%微降至10.85%（不显著），而人类导师之间的偏差仅为4.44%。结论是仅靠标准权重校准无法显著改善AI与人类评估的一致性。
AI.motivation: 基于规范（Rubric）的AI论文评估系统使用标准权重来区分评估标准的重要性，但这些权重通常由专家判断确定，缺乏关于论文导师实际如何优先评估标准的实证证据。研究者希望填补这一空白，探究导师真实的权重偏好及其对AI评估效果的影响。
AI.method: 调查了84位来自四个学术学科的论文导师，收集了35个论文评估标准的权重数据；将导师推导的权重与RubiSCoT系统的默认权重进行对比；将导师权重整合到多种校准配置中，在80篇德语论文语料库上评估；比较AI生成评估与导师评估之间的偏差。
AI.result: 导师权重与系统默认权重存在显著分歧；最佳校准配置将平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%，但改进不具统计显著性；人类导师之间的平均相对偏差仅为4.44%，远低于AI与人类之间的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过校准标准权重无法显著改善AI评估与人类评估之间的一致性。AI与人类评估之间的差距可能源于更深层次的因素，而非单纯的权重分配问题，未来需要探索其他改进方向。

title: Fused Bayesian Flow Networks for Dual-Target Molecular Design
summary: Dual-target drug design aims to generate 3D molecules that can simultaneously interact with two target proteins, offering a promising route for discovering polypharmacological compounds against complex diseases. While recent generative models have shown encouraging performance in single-target drug design, existing dual-target approaches either focus on sequence generation or introduce an additional predictive drift term into the diffusion-based generative trajectory, which limits their ability to fully integrate feature information from both targets. We propose FusedBFN, a fused Bayesian flow network (BFN) for dual-target molecular design. FusedBFN formulates dual-target generation as distribution fusion in a unified continuous parameter space and employs a product-of-experts formulation to incorporate dual-target information throughout the generative process. To address the scarcity of dual-target structural data, we leverage a pretrained target-aware BFN model as the shared backbone. We further introduce a chemically aware prior-based alignment method and a prior-free pocket alignment strategy to construct aligned dual-target contexts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FusedBFN generates molecules with strong binding affinity toward dual targets while maintaining favorable molecular properties.

AI.tldr: 提出FusedBFN，一种基于贝叶斯流网络（BFN）的双靶点分子设计方法，通过产品专家（product-of-experts）融合双靶点信息，实现高质量双靶点结合分子的生成。
AI.motivation: 双靶点药物设计旨在生成能同时与两个靶点蛋白相互作用的3D分子，对复杂疾病的多药理学化合物发现具有重要意义。然而现有方法要么仅聚焦于序列生成，要么通过引入额外的预测漂移项到扩散式生成轨迹中，无法充分整合两个靶点的特征信息。
AI.method: FusedBFN将双靶点生成形式化为统一连续参数空间中的分布融合，采用产品专家（product-of-experts）公式在整个生成过程中整合双靶点信息；利用预训练的靶点感知BFN模型作为共享骨干网络以缓解双靶点结构数据稀缺问题；引入基于化学感知先验的配对方法和无先验口袋配对策略来构建对齐的双靶点上下文。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FusedBFN生成的分子对双靶点具有强结合亲和力，同时保持良好的分子性质。
AI.conclusion: FusedBFN通过贝叶斯流网络框架和产品专家融合策略，有效解决了双靶点分子设计的靶点特征整合问题，为多药理学化合物发现提供了新方法。

title: DocPO: Advancing Document Policy Optimization via Tailored Step-Aware Rewards
comment: 14 pages. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026). Yunhao Wang and Binghong Wu contributed equally
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for document parsing often relies on reference-based rewards rooted in edit distance (e.g., tree edit distance), yet it remains hard to optimize in the high-accuracy regime because such rewards become weakly discriminative: near-correct outputs receive very similar scores, providing limited learning signal for hard cases. We propose Step-Aware Annealing (SAA), a plug-and-play reward sharpening mechanism that progressively increases reward curvature during training, amplifying subtle quality differences among high-scoring samples while preserving stability in early learning. Built on SAA, we introduce DocPO, a document policy optimization framework with element-specific, reference-based rewards anchored by edit-distance signals: normalized string edit distance (NED) for text, tree edit distance similarity (TEDS) for tables, and a hybrid Rubric+edit reward for formulas. Experiments on OmniDocBench and DocElemHard show that SAA consistently improves GRPO-style RL across document elements over non-annealed rewards, without requiring additional human supervision for reward construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Step-Aware Annealing (SAA)奖励锐化机制，解决文档解析中基于编辑距离的奖励在高准确率区域缺乏区分度的问题，并基于此构建DocPO文档策略优化框架，在OmniDocBench和DocElemHard数据集上显著提升GRPO-style RL的性能。
AI.motivation: 文档解析的强化学习中，基于编辑距离的参考奖励（如树编辑距离）在高精度区域变得弱区分——接近正确的输出得分非常相似，难以对困难样本提供有效学习信号，限制了模型在精确解析上的进一步优化。
AI.method: 提出Step-Aware Annealing (SAA)，一种即插即用的奖励锐化机制，在训练过程中逐步增加奖励曲率，放大高分数样本间的细微质量差异，同时保持早期学习的稳定性。基于SAA构建DocPO框架，采用元素特定的参考奖励：归一化字符串编辑距离(NED)用于文本、树编辑距离相似度(TEDS)用于表格、混合Rubric+编辑奖励用于公式。
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench和DocElemHard基准上的实验表明，SAA在文档各元素上持续优于非退火奖励的GRPO-style强化学习，且无需额外人工监督来构建奖励。
AI.conclusion: SAA作为一种即插即用的奖励锐化机制，有效解决了高精度文档解析中奖励区分度不足的核心问题，DocPO框架展示了元素特定奖励结合退火策略在文档解析强化学习中的潜力。

title: Unsupervised Multidomain Approaches to Named Entity Recognition with Small Datasets
summary: This paper explores the challenges and the methodologies associated with learning quality representations in scenarios with unlabelled small or limited datasets for downstream information extraction task (Multidomain Named Entity Recognition (NER). The study adopts a Transfer Learning on small datasets. Traditional NER systems often rely on large, labelled data, which is impractical for many domains. This study, therefore, applies an unsupervised pre-training approach to precondition and identify entities without annotated datasets, then applies transfer learning models to different simulated limited datasets for a named entity recognition task. Entity Recognition (NER) is essential in natural language processing (NLP), it identifies and classifies related entities within the text. This study addresses the complexities of domain variability, data sparsity, and overfitting and investigates innovative approaches such as data augmentation, few-shot learning, and domain adversarial training. Integrating these techniques promises to enhance the performance and generalizability of NER systems across diverse and resource-constrained domains, paving the way for more efficient and adaptable NLP applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在无标注小数据集场景下，通过迁移学习和无监督预训练方法来解决多领域命名实体识别（NER）任务中数据稀缺的问题，并探讨了数据增强、少样本学习和领域对抗训练等创新技术。
AI.motivation: 传统的NER系统依赖大量标注数据，但在许多实际领域中获取标注数据不切实际。本文旨在解决小数据集和未标注场景下学习高质量表示所面临的挑战，包括领域差异性、数据稀疏性和过拟合问题。
AI.method: 采用无监督预训练方式在无标注数据集上进行条件预训练以识别实体，随后将迁移学习模型应用于不同模拟的有限数据集上进行NER任务，并整合数据增强、少样本学习和领域对抗训练等多种技术。
AI.result: 研究表明，通过结合这些创新技术（数据增强、少样本学习、领域对抗训练），可以增强NER系统在多样化且资源受限领域中的性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在数据稀缺条件下构建更高效和适应性更强的NLP应用铺平了道路，展示了迁移学习结合其他先进技术在解决低资源NER问题上的潜力。

title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
summary: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its grammar with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). Each system event is discretized into an 8-token representation spanning event type, process, argument skeleton, path category, parent process, user, destination, and inter-event timing. The model learns the conditional distribution of normal behavior in a purely self-supervised manner, and anomaly scores are derived from per-slot negative log-likelihood (NLL) statistics, yielding a mathematically bounded false-positive rate. We augment this prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution, second-order temporal analysis for cadence-based detection, self-learning pattern extraction, and a five-network fusion pipeline. Against an Adaptive Adversarial Agent (AAA)--a threat that learns survival strategies under defensive pressure, performs behavioral mimicry, and matches host event rates--our system achieves 93% detection at 3.84% onboarding false-positive rate. The strongest discriminative signal arises not from any single event but from the coefficient of variation of inter-event intervals: the AAA stepping cadence exhibits CV=0.310 versus 9.786 for benign sleep intervals, a 30x separation reflecting a fundamental stealth-functionality trade-off. We frame these findings within a coevolutionary economics model, arguing that behavior-grammar detection shifts the evasion cost from rule circumvention (cheap) to distribution matching (expensive), establishing a structural asymmetry favoring the defender.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"行为语法"(Behavioral Grammar)检测架构，将主机运行时行为视为结构化语言，用仅0.88M参数的因果Transformer（TinyGPT）自监督学习正常行为的条件分布。每个系统事件被离散为8-token表示，通过逐槽位负对数似然(NLL)统计派生异常分数，保证数学上有界的误报率。系统结合原型学习、二阶时间分析、自学习模式提取和五网络融合流水线，在对自适应对抗代理(AAA)的检测中实现93%检出率与3.84%预置误报率。核心发现是事件间间隔的变异系数(CV)是最强判别信号：AAA步进节奏CV=0.310 vs 良性睡眠间隔9.786，相差30倍，反映潜行的根本权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统端点检测面临根本性矛盾：基于签名的方案易被多态或自适应威胁绕过，而深度学习方法体量大、难以审计且难以规模化部署。作者旨在构建一个既轻量又可审计、同时能对抗自适应威胁的检测架构。
AI.method: 提出Behavioral Grammar架构：1) 将系统事件离散为8-token表示（事件类型、进程、参数骨架、路径类别、父进程、用户、目标、事件间时序）；2) 使用0.88M参数的TinyGPT学习正常行为条件分布；3) 用逐槽位NLL统计生成异常分数；4) 融合原型学习（已知攻击归因）、二阶时间分析（节奏检测）、自学习模式提取和五网络融合流水线。
AI.result: 对自适应对抗代理(AAA)测试：93%检出率，3.84%误报率。最强判别信号是事件间间隔的变异系数，AAA步进节奏CV=0.310与良性睡眠间隔9.786形成30倍差距，表明"潜行-功能"之间存在根本性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 行为语法检测将规避成本从规则绕过（廉价）转移至分布匹配（昂贵），建立有利于防御方的结构性不对称。作者用共同演化经济学模型框架解释这一发现，论证防御方在对抗演化中占据结构性优势。

title: Caliber: Cross-Architecture Extraction-Cost Control for Score-Returning APIs
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ProvSec 2026
summary: We present Caliber, an output-perturbation defense against model extraction that formulates noise selection as a calibration problem: how much the defense degrades the supervision signal used to train a surrogate, and the provable per-input query cost of recovering the clean logits. To defend against an attacker that uses returned scores for knowledge distillation, Caliber adds independent and identically distributed Gaussian noise to the internal logits. We establish two properties of the resulting perturbed predictions. Monotone agreement degradation: When the clean logits have a unique maximizer, agreement with the clean prediction decreases strictly with the noise scale, so every target in $(1/K,1)$ corresponds to a unique positive scale; task accuracy is bounded by computable lower and upper envelopes. Per-input recovery cost: We derive a closed-form minimax lower bound on the repeated queries needed to recover the clean logits for a fixed input. Caliber normalizes noise variance by the squared median top-two logit margin and fits the resulting noise-utility relationship with a logistic curve, either per model or shared within a task. Across more than thirty model-dataset combinations, per-model calibration achieves mean absolute relative errors of 0.6-1.4%. End-to-end experiments show that surrogate performance generally tracks the configured degradation, while fixed-input averaging follows the expected variance reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Caliber，一种针对模型抽取攻击的输出扰动防御方法，将噪声选择形式化为校准问题：通过向内部logits添加独立同分布的高斯噪声来防御基于知识蒸馏的攻击，并建立两个关键性质（单调一致性退化和每次输入的恢复成本），实现可预测的防御效果。
AI.motivation: 模型抽取攻击通过查询目标模型的输出来训练替代模型，严重威胁模型知识产权。现有输出扰动防御方法缺乏对噪声尺度与防御效果之间关系的精确控制，难以在实践中配置合适的噪声水平。
AI.method: 1) 向内部logits添加独立同分布高斯噪声进行输出扰动；2) 建立单调一致性退化性质：当干净logits有唯一最大元素时，预测一致性随噪声尺度严格递减；3) 推导固定输入的每次查询恢复干净logits的闭式minimax下界；4) 通过中位top-2 logit间隔的平方归一化噪声方差，并用逻辑曲线拟合噪声-效用关系。
AI.result: 在超过三十种模型-数据集组合上，per-model校准实现了0.6-1.4%的平均绝对相对误差；端到端实验表明替代模型性能通常与配置的退化程度一致，固定输入平均行为符合预期的方差缩减。
AI.conclusion: Caliber提供了一种可验证、可精确校准的模型抽取防御框架，使得防御者能够精确控制代理模型的质量退化程度，同时明确每次查询的恢复代价，为输出扰动防御提供了理论基础和实用工具。

title: Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems via Latent Flow Matching
summary: Latent Flow Models have revolutionized compressed-space image synthesis, yet their application to high-fidelity inverse problems remains bottlenecked. In this paper, we trace this dilemma to a fundamental geometric limitation of pre-trained autoencoders, which we term \emph{First-Order Manifold Blindness}. Severe decoder compression (e.g., retaining only $\sim\!2\%$ of the original degrees of freedom) produces a rank-deficient Jacobian, rendering high-frequency measurement residuals in its orthogonal complement invisible to latent gradients even when the decoder can represent the target image. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling (HDPS), a decoupled inference framework that disentangles physical measurement consistency from semantic prior modeling. HDPS diverges into the pixel space, leveraging Langevin dynamics to absorb precise orthogonal measurement gradients, and subsequently projects these structural corrections back onto the generative manifold. An optimization-based latent alignment is introduced to filter pixel-space artifacts while avoiding the semantic drift of direct encoding. Extensive experiments on diverse inverse problems demonstrate that HDPS establishes a new state-of-the-art, successfully recovering the high-frequency structural precision that latent-only solvers inherently discard. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合域后验采样（HDPS）框架，解决潜在流模型在高保真逆问题中的瓶颈。该瓶颈源于预训练自编码器的"一阶流形盲区"（First-Order Manifold Blindness）——由于解码器压缩严重导致雅可比矩阵秩亏，高频测量残差在正交补空间中无法被潜在梯度感知。HDPS通过解耦推理，先在像素空间利用Langevin动力学吸收精确的正交测量梯度，再通过优化驱动的潜在对齐将结构修正投影回流形空间，避免直接编码带来的语义漂移，从而恢复潜在域方法无法捕捉的高频结构精度。
AI.motivation: 潜在流模型虽已革新压缩空间图像合成，但在高保真逆问题中的应用受限于预训练自编码器的几何缺陷——解码器高度压缩导致雅可比矩阵秩亏，使得高频测量残差对潜在梯度不可见，即使解码器本身能表示目标图像也无法优化到位。
AI.method: 提出HDPS（Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling），一种解耦推理框架：1) 在像素空间使用Langevin动力学吸收精确的正交测量梯度；2) 将这些结构修正投影回生成流形；3) 引入基于优化的潜在对齐以过滤像素空间伪影，同时避免直接编码造成的语义漂移。
AI.result: 在多种逆问题上的大量实验表明，HDPS达到了新的最先进水平，成功恢复了仅用潜在域求解器必然丢失的高频结构精度。
AI.conclusion: HDPS通过混合域后验采样有效克服了潜在流模型的流形盲区问题，解耦物理测量一致性与语义先验建模，实现了高保真逆问题求解的新突破。

title: MedUPS: Towards Diagnostic Assistance in Uncommon Medical Cases with Large Language Models
summary: Uncommon and off-guideline cases are difficult for clinical decision support, because physicians must make a series of management decisions under diagnostic uncertainty and rarely see the full case at once. Most large language model (LLM) benchmarks for medicine score only the final diagnosis, yet much of clinical care turns on the next appropriate action: the next test to order, the imaging study to obtain, the specialist to involve, or the differential to pursue. We introduce MedUPSQA, a dataset of 21,874 mid-stream clinical decision points built from 5,535 real case reports, and MedUPS, an alignment framework that supervises models on these intermediate decisions as they unfold along a patient's trajectory. We segment free-text case presentations into chronologically ordered, accumulating clinical chunks and align models to predict the next step with reinforcement learning (GRPO), using an external LLM-as-a-Judge reward. This objective mirrors how clinicians actually meet patients, reasoning forward from accumulating evidence toward the next decision, rather than committing to a final label. Across three backbones, mid-stream alignment raises next-step accuracy from 55.2 to 66.7 for Qwen3.6-27B, from 47.2 to 57.8 for Qwen3.5-9B, and from 37.8 to 44.4 for HuatuoGPT-3-8B, with 95% CI. In several model scales we test the objective improves accuracy more than scale, with smaller models surpassing larger, frontier models we evaluate. We further train supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on the mid-stream task, SFT improves all backbones above base, indicating the target framwork carries signal independently of the optimizer. We release the dataset, code, and aligned checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedUPSQA数据集（包含21,874个临床中途决策点，源自5,535个真实病例报告）和MedUPS对齐框架，通过将病例分割为按时间顺序累积的临床片段，并使用GRPO强化学习和LLM-as-a-Judge奖励来监督模型预测下一步临床决策，而非仅评估最终诊断。在三个骨干模型上，中途流对齐将下一步准确率提升10-11个百分点，且在小模型上提升效果超过增大模型规模。
AI.motivation: 临床决策支持系统中存在大量罕见且不符合指南的病例，医生需要在诊断不确定的情况下做出一系列管理决策。现有医学LLM基准只评分最终诊断，忽略了临床护理中更关键的中间决策（下一步检查、影像、专科会诊、鉴别诊断等），这偏离了医生实际面对患者的推理方式。
AI.method: 1) 构建MedUPSQA数据集：将5,535个真实病例报告分割为按时间顺序排列、逐步累积的临床片段，生成21,874个中途临床决策点。2) 提出MedUPS对齐框架：使用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）强化学习，通过外部LLM-as-a-Judge奖励函数，监督模型在患者轨迹展开过程中预测每一步的下一步行动。3) 训练SFT基线作为对照，验证目标框架本身携带的信号。
AI.result: 在三个骨干模型上，中途流对齐使下一步准确率显著提升：Qwen3.6-27B从55.2提升至66.7，Qwen3.5-9B从47.2提升至57.8，HuatuoGPT-3-8B从37.8提升至44.4（95%置信区间）。在多个模型规模上，目标函数带来的提升超过模型规模扩大带来的提升，较小模型甚至超越更大的前沿模型。SFT基线也能提升所有骨干模型性能，表明目标框架本身携带独立于优化器的信号。
AI.conclusion: 医学LLM评估应转向中途临床决策点而非仅最终诊断。MedUPS对齐框架通过模拟医生在患者轨迹中逐步推理、预测下一步决策的方式，显著提升了模型在临床决策支持中的实用性。途中决策目标带来的收益超过规模效应，为模型规模受限场景提供了有效路径。

title: FinDeepIndicator: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in End-to-End Financial Indicator Construction
summary: Financial indicators are essential tools for transforming raw financial data into interpretable measures for various downstream tasks, such as valuation, risk assessment, and economic analysis. However, existing financial benchmarks largely focus on answer-level accuracy and often assume that relevant data are already provided, leaving the assessment of the intermediate process of indicator construction underexplored. In this work, we propose FinDeepIndicator, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating Deep Research (DR) agents in end-to-end financial indicator construction. Specifically, FinDeepIndicator evaluates DR agents across four stages in indicator construction: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation, and covers fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic indicators organized into 21 fine-grained sub-categories. It contains 3,350 curated question-answer (QA) pairs derived from both U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical financial data, and 800 listed companies. Extensive experiments on search-equipped Large Language Models (LLMs) and DR agents show that, while LLMs generally perform well in formula specification, their accuracy drops substantially during data retrieval and numerical execution. DR agents consistently outperform search-equipped LLMs, yet remain unreliable in realistic financial analysis settings. These findings provide insights for developing more capable and trustworthy DR agents in finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinDeepIndicator，这是首个专门用于评估深度研究（DR）智能体在端到端金融指标构建中表现的基准，涵盖公式规范、数据收集、指标计算和答案生成四个阶段，包含3,350个QA对、10年历史数据及800家上市公司。实验表明LLM在公式规范上表现良好但在数据检索和数值执行上大幅下降，DR智能体虽整体优于搜索增强LLM，但在现实金融分析场景中仍不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准大多聚焦于答案层面的准确率，并假设相关数据已预先提供，忽略了金融指标构建这一中间过程的评估。金融指标是将原始金融数据转化为可解释度量（如估值、风险评估、经济分析）的重要工具，因此需要专门的基准来评估这一关键环节。
AI.method: 构建FinDeepIndicator基准，从四个阶段（公式规范、数据收集、指标计算、答案生成）评估DR智能体，覆盖基本面、技术面和宏观经济三大类指标（21个细分类别），数据集来自美国和中国市场，包含3,350个精心策划的QA对、10年历史金融数据和800家上市公司数据。
AI.result: 实验发现：LLM在公式规范阶段表现良好，但在数据检索和数值执行阶段准确率大幅下降；DR智能体在整体表现上优于搜索增强的LLM，但在现实金融分析场景中仍不够可靠。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为开发更强大、更可信的金融领域DR智能体提供了重要见解，指出了当前模型在数据检索和数值计算环节的瓶颈所在。

title: The Fourth Quadrant: A Stylized View of Benign Misfitting
comment: 82 pages, 6 figures, full version of paper accepted at ITW2026
summary:
Training error is what we can observe on a training set; test error is the quantity we actually care about. We study linear regression with squared-error in a deterministic $(d+1)$-dimensional single-spike model. Each stylized training vector has the same informative spike coordinate, of amplitude $\sqrtγ$ with $γ>1$. The remaining directions are nuisance, and the nuisance components of distinct training vectors all have equal norm and are mutually orthogonal. The training labels are all $1$. Fresh test points are drawn from $\vec{x}_{\rm test} \sim \mathcal{N}(\vec{0},\operatorname{diag}(γ,1,\ldots,1))$, with the noise-free test labels being the normalized spike coordinate $x_{\rm test}[1]/\sqrtγ$. We focus on linear predictors in the span of the training vectors, the class naturally reached by zero-initialized linear gradient methods.
  We exhibit a range of training-set sizes $n$ in which every span predictor that generalizes well must fit the training data \emph{worse} than the zero predictor. We call this regime \emph{benign misfitting}, or the fourth quadrant. The best span predictor begins to generalize when $n\gg d/γ^2$, while interpolation does not generalize until the later threshold $n\gg d/γ$. In the window $d/γ^2 \ll n \ll d/γ$, useful prediction within the linear span lies beyond interpolation: predictions on the training points overshoot the labels. We show that one-pass stochastic gradient descent (SGD), with a large constant learning rate, reaches small test error throughout this window---matching the best span predictor up to a logarithmic factor. We also verify directly that it indeed has \emph{large} empirical training error (despite the descent premise in its name). Finally, we show that the unavoidable nuisance component responsible for the training misfit also controls the predictor's adversarial sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究确定性单尖峰模型下的线性回归问题，发现了一个称为"良性错配"（第四象限）的新机制：在训练集大小n位于d/γ²和d/γ之间的窗口内，所有能良好泛化的span预测器必须在训练数据上比零预测器拟合得更差。单遍随机梯度下降（SGD）配合大常数学习率可以在整个窗口内达到接近最优的测试误差，同时保持较大的训练误差。
AI.motivation: 经典学习理论认为训练误差小是泛化好的前提，但实际中观察到"过拟合"模型仍能泛化良好。本文旨在探索训练误差与测试误差之间的反直觉关系，特别是在高维线性回归中是否存在必须牺牲训练拟合才能获得良好泛化的机制。
AI.method: 使用确定性(d+1)维单尖峰模型：训练向量共享一个信息尖峰坐标（幅度√γ,γ>1），其余方向为等范数且相互正交的 nuisance 分量。测试点服从带尖峰结构的高斯分布。分析span预测器（零初始化线性梯度方法自然到达的类别），推导泛化与插值的阈值，并用单遍SGD配合大常数学习率求解。
AI.result: 发现关键阈值分离：span预测器开始泛化的阈值为n≫d/γ²，而插值泛化的阈值为更晚的n≫d/γ。在窗口d/γ²≪n≪d/γ内，最佳span预测器的训练预测超出标签（过冲）。单遍SGD在整个窗口内达到小测试误差（匹配最佳span预测器，最多差对数因子），同时确实保持较大的经验训练误差。不可避的nuisance分量同时控制训练错配和对抗敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统地揭示了"良性错配"或"第四象限"现象：在特定数据机制下，好的泛化反而要求较大的训练误差。这一结果挑战了传统"训练误差小→泛化好"的直觉，并为理解SGD在大学习率下的隐式正则化行为提供了新的理论框架。

title: DiffuseAgent-MI: Distributionally-Grounded,Tool-Integrated Self-Evolving Agents for Faithful Visual Reasoning
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ICML 2026 manitrack
summary: Tool-integrated vision-language agents have made remarkable progress on compositional and multi-step visual reasoning. Yet their outputs frequently exhibit unfaithfulness: the stated reasoning path diverges from the computation that actually produced the answer, undermining reliability in safety-critical applications. We present DiffuseAgent-MI, a self-evolving agent whose perceptual grounding is governed by a KL-minimal energy model over feature units, providing a distributional view of visual mechanistic interpretability. The agent learns an energy landscape that softly constrains generated samples to lie near the native prior conditioned on the chosen interpretable unit, closing the gap between the explanation and the internal representation. A verifier then supplies trajectory-level faithfulness rewards, and a repair branch re-conditions the energy when the verifier flags an unfaithful step. On GeoQA, SciVis, VQA-v2 and an in-house multimodal reasoning set, DiffuseAgent-MI improves accuracy by up to 5.1 points over prior self-evolving agents while more than doubling mutual-information faithfulness and human-interpretability agreement. Our analysis shows the energy term and the verifier are complementary: the former guarantees distributional faithfulness, the latter trajectory-level faithfulness, and only their combination closes both gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffuseAgent-MI，一种自进化视觉语言推理智能体，通过KL最小化能量模型约束感知接地过程，结合验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励和修复机制，在多个多模态推理基准上显著提升准确性和推理忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有工具集成的视觉语言智能体虽然在组合性和多步视觉推理上取得进展，但其输出经常存在不忠实问题——陈述的推理路径与实际产生答案的计算过程相背离，这在安全关键应用中不可靠。需要一种机制来弥合解释与内部表示之间的差距。
AI.method: DiffuseAgent-MI引入KL最小能量模型，在特征单元上构建能量景观，软性约束生成样本靠近以选定可解释单元为条件的原生先验。训练过程中，验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励，当验证器标记不忠实步骤时，修复分支重新调整能量条件。能量项保证分布级忠实度，验证器保证轨迹级忠实度，二者互补。
AI.result: 在GeoQA、SciVis、VQA-v2及自建多模态推理集上，相比先前的自进化智能体准确率最高提升5.1个点，互信息忠实度和人类可解释性一致性均提升一倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 能量项与验证器具有互补性：前者保障分布级忠实度，后者保障轨迹级忠实度，只有二者结合才能同时弥合两种差距，为可解释、可信赖的视觉语言智能体提供了新的设计范式。

title: Cloud-ScPO: Hidden-State Geometry for Semi-Supervised Preference Optimization in LLM Reasoning
summary: Preference optimization improves mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but reliable chosen-rejected pairs usually require verified answers, human annotations, or external reward models. We investigate whether preference supervision can instead be derived from the model's internal representation geometry in a semi-supervised setting. Our analysis shows that reasoning trajectories generated across different mathematical problems form structured global point clouds in which correct and incorrect trajectories exhibit different geometric organization. Based on this observation, we propose Cloud--ScPO, a topology-guided preference-mining framework that uses a small labeled set to construct multiple correct and incorrect reference Clouds. Each trajectory is represented by a mean-pooled hidden state and scored against connectivity-induced components using a component-level soft $k$-nearest-neighbor measure averaged across reference banks. We combine this cross-problem Cloud signal with prompt-level self-consistency: self-consistency determines the answer-level preference direction, while Cloud scoring selects concrete trajectories and filters pairs by their score margin. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH-Numeric across four model settings show that Cloud--ScPO consistently improves over ScPO, with gains of up to 4.49\% on GSM8K and 4.19\% on MATH-Numeric. Pair-level analyses further show that Cloud--ScPO maintains comparable correctness reliability while more effectively separating informative chosen trajectories from incomplete, repetitive, or otherwise low-quality rejected responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cloud--ScPO，一种基于拓扑引导的偏好挖掘框架。它利用模型内部表示的几何结构（点云），通过少量标注样本构建正确/错误参考点云，结合跨问题云评分与提示级自一致性来筛选偏好对，无需外部奖励模型或人工标注。
AI.motivation: 偏好优化能提升LLM的数学推理能力，但构建可靠的chosen-rejected偏好对通常依赖验证答案、人工标注或外部奖励模型，成本高昂。作者希望探索能否从模型内部表示几何中半监督地推导出偏好监督信号，降低对昂贵标注的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 观察发现不同数学问题的推理轨迹形成结构化全局点云，正确与错误轨迹具有不同的几何组织。2) 提出Cloud--ScPO框架：利用小规模标注集构建多个正确/错误参考点云；每条轨迹用mean-pooled隐状态表示，并通过连通性诱导分量的软k近邻度量（跨参考库平均）进行评分。3) 结合跨问题云信号与prompt级自一致性：自一致性决定答案级偏好方向，云评分选择具体轨迹并按分数差距过滤偏好对。
AI.result: 在GSM8K和MATH-Numeric上、四种模型设置下，Cloud--ScPO相比ScPO持续提升，GSM8K最高提升4.49%，MATH-Numeric最高提升4.19%。Pair-level分析表明其保持相当的正确性可靠性，同时更有效地将信息丰富的chosen轨迹与不完整、重复或低质量的rejected响应区分开。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部表示几何可作为偏好监督的可靠来源，拓扑引导的偏好挖掘能有效提升数学推理性能，为半监督偏好优化提供了新思路。

title: Measurement Without Validity: The Compounding Reliability Problem in Agentic AI Evaluation
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to a peer-reviewed journal
summary:
Agentic AI systems are evaluated using automated benchmarks whose scores justify deployment decisions, safety certifications, and regulatory compliance claims. We present an empirical analysis demonstrating that these scores are systematically less trustworthy than current practice acknowledges.
  The problem operates at three compounding layers. First, tasks are increasingly generated by language models: audits of ten popular benchmarks found validity flaws in seven and reporting gaps in all ten. Second, human users are replaced by LLM simulators, but calibration studies document inter-simulator variance up to 9 percentage points and systematic directional miscalibration, particularly for non-Standard American English speakers. Third, our structured survey of 55 papers finds that approximately 82% apply structurally mismatched, incomplete, or absent inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics.
  These failures compound multiplicatively rather than additively. Under independence, a pipeline retaining 70% of valid signal at task generation, 80% at simulation, and 65% at judgment is at most 36% valid against the intended construct; the bound spans 0.22--0.54 across the empirical estimate range. We formalize this as $V_{\text{total}} \leq V_1 \times V_2 \times V_3$ and show it tightens further under correlated failures when the same model family operates across all three layers.
  We derive eight prescriptions grounded in psychometric science: a simulation calibration floor of $\text{ICC}(A,1) \geq 0.70$; domain-stratified reliability thresholds ($α\geq 0.67$ / $0.70$ / $0.80$ by consequence level); structured IRR metric selection rules based on pipeline design; and IRR as a mandatory reporting field. The measurement tools exist; the field's task is to apply them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析表明，智能体AI系统的自动化基准测试得分系统性不可靠。问题源于三个叠加层面：LLM生成任务存在效度缺陷、LLM模拟器校准偏差、以及约82%的论文使用了不适当的评估者间信度（IRR）指标。这些失败以乘法方式复合累积，使整体效度大幅下降。作者提出了八项基于心理测量学的处方建议。
AI.motivation: 自动化基准测试得分被广泛用于部署决策、安全认证和法规合规声明，但这些分数的可信度缺乏系统评估。现有实践对其可信度的认知远高于实际情况，亟需揭示这一问题并建立可靠评估框架。
AI.method: 采用三层实证分析方法：(1) 审计十个流行基准测试中的任务生成效度问题；(2) 分析LLM模拟器校准研究中的方差与方向性偏差；(3) 对55篇论文进行结构化调查，评估IRR指标的使用情况。并将三者形式化为效度乘法复合模型 V_total ≤ V1 × V2 × V3。
AI.result: 发现十个基准中有七个存在效度缺陷、全部十个存在报告缺口；模拟器间方差高达9个百分点且存在系统性方向性误校准；约82%的论文IRR指标结构不匹配、不完整或缺失。在三层独立条件下整体效度至多36%，相关失败下进一步收紧至0.22-0.54区间。
AI.conclusion: 测量工具已存在，关键在于应用。作者提出八大处方：模拟校准下限ICC(A,1)≥0.70、按后果等级分层的信度阈值、基于管道设计的结构化IRR指标选择规则、以及将IRR设为强制性报告字段等，旨在提升智能体评估的整体可信度。

title: Characterizing Bias in Post-Bandit Inference under Index Algorithms
summary: Bandit algorithms generate data for downstream inference, but adaptive sampling biases post-bandit sample means. We analyze this bias for stable index algorithms, including UCB1 and its generalizations, and derive sharp leading-order expressions for the sample-mean bias and expected $Z$-statistic. Our characterization reveals the algorithmic origin of bias through a key index-function-dependent quantity, which we term effective exploration rate. For example, under UCB1, the effective exploration rate is of order $\sqrt{\log T}$, and the standardized bias of any arm (that is not uniquely optimal) decays at the extremely slow rate $1/\sqrt{\log T}$. We also show how the choice of the index function affects both regret and bias, which reveals a regret-bias trade-off: more exploratory algorithm reduces bias but increases regret. Our sharp characterization for bias uses a novel empirical fluid approximation of the algorithm's sampling dynamics, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了稳定索引算法（如UCB1及其推广）在自适应采样后对样本均值产生的偏差，推导出样本均值偏差和期望Z统计量的精确首阶表达式，提出了"有效探索率"这一关键量，并揭示了遗憾-偏差权衡。
AI.motivation: Bandit算法生成的数据通常被用于下游推断，但自适应采样会使后bandit样本均值产生偏差。理解这种偏差的来源和大小对于保证基于bandit数据进行的统计推断的可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 针对稳定索引算法（包括UCB1及其推广），推导样本均值偏差和期望Z统计量的首阶精确表达式。提出"有效探索率"这一由索引函数决定的关键量来表征偏差的算法来源，并利用一种新颖的经验流体近似方法来刻画算法的采样动力学。
AI.result: 在UCB1下，有效探索率量级为√logT，任何非唯一最优臂的标准化偏差以极慢的速率1/√logT衰减。索引函数的选择同时影响遗憾和偏差，存在遗憾-偏差权衡：更具探索性的算法降低偏差但增加遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次对bandit算法的后采样偏差进行了精确的首阶刻画，揭示了偏差的算法起源和遗憾-偏差之间的内在权衡，所提出的经验流体近似方法可能具有独立的学术价值。

title: Zero-Cost Virtual RNA: Approximating Immunotherapy Signatures via Cross-Modal WSI Retrieval
comment: Accepted to MIDL 2026 Short Paper track
summary: Identifying the ``Inflamed'' immunophenotype in Gastric Adenocarcinoma predicts immunotherapy response but requires an expensive 10-gene RNA signature. While deep learning on standard H\&E slides offers a scalable alternative, conventional binary classifiers oversimplify continuous RNA data and introduce label noise. To resolve this, we propose VITA (VIrtual Transcriptomic Approximation). By aligning H\&E and RNA into a joint latent space during training, VITA requires only standard H\&E at inference to retrieve morphologically similar historical cases and approximate the continuous RNA signature. Achieving 0.72 classification accuracy and a 0.66 Spearman correlation, VITA provides a cost-effective ``virtual transcriptomics'' pre-screening tool that preserves the continuous phenotypic spectrum without requiring genomic sequencing.

AI.tldr: VITA是一种基于H&E切片的虚拟转录组近似方法，通过将H&E图像与RNA数据对齐到联合潜在空间，在推理时仅需标准H&E切片即可近似连续的RNA签名，实现0.72的分类准确率和0.66的Spearman相关性，为胃癌免疫治疗反应预测提供了经济高效的预筛选工具。
AI.motivation: 传统的"发炎"免疫表型识别依赖昂贵的10基因RNA签名检测，而基于H&E切片的深度学习方法通常使用二元分类器，过度简化了连续的RNA数据，引入标签噪声。需要一种既能保持连续表型信息又能利用低成本H&E切片的方法。
AI.method: VITA通过在训练时将H&E图像和RNA数据对齐到联合潜在空间，推理时仅需标准H&E切片，通过检索形态相似的历史病例来近似连续的RNA签名，从而提供成本有效的"虚拟转录组学"预筛查。
AI.result: VITA实现了0.72的分类准确率和0.66的Spearman相关性，在保持连续表型谱的同时提供了可扩展的低成本解决方案。
AI.conclusion: VITA为胃癌免疫治疗反应预测提供了一种经济高效的工具，无需基因组测序即可保留连续的表型光谱，可作为免疫治疗的预筛查工具。

title: Why LLMs Give In: Conversational Factors and Reasoning Behind Medical Sycophancy
summary: A language model that abandons a correct medical answer under user pushback is more dangerous than one that was simply wrong, because it lends the credibility of a correct answer to the user's misinformation. Such model behavior, described as medical sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, but we find it is a property of the conversation, not the model. We study medical sycophancy in language models with a fully crossed factorial design over four conversational factors, user role, the evidence behind a false claim, whether the challenge precedes or follows the model's answer, and whether the correct answer is grounded in the prompt, across five open-weight models and 500 MedQuAD questions (1.2M trials). The factors interact sharply: fabricated sources raise sycophancy 2.0x when they accompany the question but halve it once the model has answered, so the same evidence helps or hurts depending only on timing. Sycophancy varies far more across questions than across models (67x vs. 3x), so a single rate reflects the conversation and the questions sampled as much as the model. Chain-of-thought traces explain why. Models that re-examine their own prior answer concede, while those that reason about the medical facts hold, and only a model that has already answered can spend a round auditing the fabricated source.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型在医疗对话中的"谄媚"行为（即用户施压后放弃正确医学答案）。通过对4个对话因素进行全因子交叉设计，在5个开源模型和500个MedQuAD问题上进行了120万次试验，发现医疗谄媚是对话的属性而非模型的属性。因素间存在显著交互：伪造来源在提问时伴随会使谄媚率翻倍，但在模型回答后则会减半。谄媚变化在问题间的差异远超模型间差异（67倍 vs 3倍）。思维链轨迹揭示了模型重新审视自己的先前答案时会让步，而基于医学事实推理的模型会坚持。
AI.motivation: 放弃正确医疗答案的模型比一开始就答错的模型更危险，因为它将正确答案的可信度赋予了用户的错误信息。然而这类"医疗谄媚"行为通常被简单地报告为每个模型的单一比率，忽略了对话上下文的影响，因此需要更细致的分析。
AI.method: 采用全因子交叉设计，操控4个对话因素：用户角色、假声明背后的证据、挑战发生在模型回答之前还是之后、正确答案是否扎根于提示中。在5个开源模型和500个MedQuAD问题上进行120万次试验，并通过思维链轨迹分析模型行为机制。
AI.result: 因素之间存在强烈交互效应：伪造来源在伴随提问时使谄媚率提高2.0倍，但在模型已回答后则使谄媚率减半。谄媚变化在问题间的差异（67倍）远大于模型间差异（3倍）。思维链分析显示，重新审视自己先前答案的模型会妥协让步，而推理医学事实的模型会坚持立场，只有已回答的模型才能花费一轮来审计伪造来源。
AI.conclusion: 医疗谄媚不是模型的固定属性，而是对话的属性，且很大程度上取决于所涉及的具体问题和对话时序。单一谄媚率不能充分反映模型行为，评估应考虑到对话因素和问题采样的影响。思维链机制揭示了防止谄媚的潜在途径：促使模型基于医学事实而非自身先前答案进行推理。

title: AgentSLABench: Evaluating and Benchmarking Agentic Systems Under Resource Constraints
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code, sealed test sets, and profiling artifacts available at: https://github.com/MeherBhaskar/agentslabench
summary: We present AgentSLABench, a resource-aware evaluation framework for autonomous AI agents that measures correctness alongside latency, cost, compute, memory, and network usage under declared resource budgets. Unlike standard benchmarks that report only accuracy, AgentSLABench produces a multi-dimensional profile per agent per task - the same way systems profilers (perf, pprof, cProfile) measure resource consumption of code, but extended with task correctness as a first-class dimension. AgentSLABench provides 16 task environments across 6 categories (5 core: multi-hop QA, retail substitution, code generation, web shopping, travel planning; 11 extended) with isolated Docker containers, declared CPU/memory/time/network budgets, sealed test sets with SHA256 hashes, and a standardized profiling protocol. We profile 5 general-purpose baseline agents (ReAct, PlanAndSolve, Reflexion, CoT, Random) plus 4 task-specialized agents, finding that specialized agents achieve 100% success on 3/5 core tasks (fact_qa, web_shopping, travel_planning) and 66.7-83.3% on retail and code_gen, while general baselines fail entirely on 4/5 domain tasks. Crucially, we report the Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate (EASR) - success weighted by resource consumption relative to declared budgets - revealing that high accuracy at unbounded cost is not production-viable. We release the full infrastructure, sealed test sets, and profiling results to enable reproducible, resource-aware agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: AgentSLABench是一个面向自主AI智能体的资源感知评估框架，在声明的资源预算下同时衡量任务正确性以及延迟、成本、计算、内存和网络使用情况，提供16个任务环境和标准化剖析协议，并提出Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate（EASR）指标来揭示高精度但无边界成本的方案在生产中不可行。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅报告准确率，忽视了AI智能体在生产环境中的资源消耗（延迟、成本、计算、内存、网络）。高精度但资源消耗无上限的智能体在生产环境中不可行，需要一种类似系统分析器（如perf、pprof）但扩展了任务正确性维度的资源感知评估框架。
AI.method: 构建AgentSLABench框架，包含16个任务环境（6大类：多跳问答、零售替换、代码生成、网络购物、旅行规划等），使用隔离Docker容器，声明CPU/内存/时间/网络预算，采用SHA256哈希封印测试集，提供标准化剖析协议。对5个通用基线智能体（ReAct、PlanAndSolve、Reflexion、CoT、Random）和4个任务特化智能体进行剖析，并提出EASR（效率调整成功率）指标，即成功率按相对于声明预算的资源消耗加权。
AI.result: 任务特化智能体在5个核心任务中的3个（fact_qa、web_shopping、travel_planning）达到100%成功率，在retail和code_gen上达到66.7-83.3%；而通用基线在4/5领域任务上完全失败。EASR指标揭示高精度但无界成本方案在生产中不可行。
AI.conclusion: AgentSLABench提供了首个将正确性与资源消耗多维结合评估的框架，揭示了任务特化智能体在资源约束下的优势，并释放完整基础设施、封印测试集和剖析结果以支持可复现的资源感知智能体评估。

title: Logit-Origin Centering for Singleton Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Tabular data is used extensively in many real-world use cases. Deep learning models have been developed to deal with tabular data, but generally perform poorly when the test data distribution differs from that of the training data. Researchers have proposed test-time adaptation approaches to deal with this problem. The fully test-time adaptation (FTTA) setting involves adapting deployed classifiers to shifted target distributions using only unlabeled test data. Leading FTTA methods inherit a batch-dependent approach from computer vision literature. This paper demonstrates for the first time that such approaches degrade sharply in strict streaming regimes where examples arrive and must be classified one at a time. This occurs because at a batch size of one, batch-level statistics become unavailable or poorly estimated. We argue that singleton tabular FTTA is not merely a small-batch variant of ordinary FTTA, but a distinct identifiability problem where only the location of the model's score stream remains directly observable. To address this, we propose Prequential Logit-Origin Centering (PLOC), a lightweight approach that keeps the source model frozen and shifts the logit space at each step. PLOC stores only a single running number (the mean of past logits), requires no labels, estimates no priors, and bypasses weight updates entirely. A deferred variant applies a static shift that preserves the source ranking, and thus the AUROC, exactly. Evaluated across five tabular benchmarks, three architectures (MLP, FT-Transformer, and TabTransformer), and five independent source checkpoints, PLOC significantly outperforms strong tabular and entropy-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明，在严格流式场景下（样本逐个到达并需立即分类），现有的批量依赖式全测试时适应（FTTA）方法会严重退化。作者提出了一种轻量级方法——Prequential Logit-Origin Centering (PLOC)，通过仅存储一个运行均值来平移logit空间，无需标签、无需权重更新，在五个表格基准和多种架构上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 表格数据在现实场景中广泛使用，但深度学习模型在测试分布与训练分布不同时表现不佳。现有的FTTA方法继承自计算机视觉领域，依赖批处理统计量，在流式场景（样本逐个到达）中这些统计量不可用或估计不佳，导致性能严重退化。作者认为单个样本的表格FTTA不仅是小批量变体，而是一个独特的可识别性问题。
AI.method: PLOC方法保持源模型冻结，在每一步对logit空间进行平移。具体做法是仅存储一个运行数字（过去logit的均值），无需标签、不估计先验、完全绕过权重更新。此外还提出一个延迟变体，应用静态平移以保持源模型排序，从而精确保留AUROC。
AI.result: 在五个表格基准、三种架构（MLP、FT-Transformer、TabTransformer）和五个独立源检查点上，PLOC显著优于强大的表格基线和基于熵的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了流式表格FTTA的独特挑战，并提出了一个极其轻量且有效的解决方案。PLOC仅需存储一个数字即可实现有效的测试时适应，且延迟变体可以精确保持AUROC，兼顾适应性与评估指标保持的双重需求。

title: DrawAI: Agentic Benchmark and Workflow for Making Raster Images Editable
summary: Recent image-generation models and multimodal agents can produce high-quality visuals for increasingly complex visual communication tasks. Yet their raster outputs remain difficult to use directly because meaningful content and relationships are flattened into pixels, preventing users from inspecting, modifying, rearranging, or reusing individual components. We formulate image-to-editable reconstruction, which recovers a structured, directly manipulable artifact from a raster image while preserving its visual and semantic content. The central challenge is to jointly satisfy Fidelity and Editability, which often trade off in practice. To study this task, we introduce DrawAI, comprising an agentic benchmark, DrawAI-Bench, and a reconstruction workflow, DrawAI-Flow. DrawAI-Bench spans scientific figures, presentation slides, posters, and diagrams, combining real and AI-generated images to reflect practical visual-creation scenarios. It evaluates Fidelity and Editability through a hybrid protocol of 39 criteria: deterministic rule-based metrics measure properties with direct correspondences, while asset-specific vision-language rubrics capture semantic and perceptual qualities for which exact matching is misleading. Besides, we propose DrawAI-Flow, a two-stage agentic workflow in which a Parser Agent turns extracted elements evidence into an explicit reconstruction plan, and a Reconstruction Agent realizes the plan as executable graphics code through an iterative code-render-validate-revise loop. On DrawAI-Bench, we systematically evaluate thirteen models across five agent harnesses to study the effects of model capability, harness choice, and workflow design. The results show that reconstruction quality and costs vary substantially across model-harness configurations, while DrawAI-Flow consistently improves editable structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图像到可编辑重建任务，将栅格图像恢复为结构化的、可直接操作的可编辑工件。作者引入DrawAI框架，包含基准DrawAI-Bench（涵盖科学图表、演示文稿、海报和图表，39个评估标准）和两阶段智能体工作流DrawAI-Flow（解析代理+重建代理）。系统评估13个模型在5个智能体框架下的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像生成模型和多模态智能体可以生成高质量视觉内容，但输出是栅格像素形式，用户无法直接检查、修改、重排或重用其中的各个组件。有意义的内容和关系被扁平化为像素，导致生成结果难以实际应用。需要一个将栅格图像恢复为结构化可编辑工件的方法。
AI.method: 提出DrawAI框架，包含两部分：1) DrawAI-Bench基准：涵盖科学图表、演示文稿、海报和图表，包含真实和AI生成图像，通过39个标准的混合评估协议（确定性规则指标+资产特定的视觉-语言评分标准）评估保真度和可编辑性；2) DrawAI-Flow工作流：两阶段智能体流程，解析代理将提取的元素证据转化为显式重建计划，重建代理通过迭代的代码-渲染-验证-修订循环实现为可执行图形代码。
AI.result: 在DrawAI-Bench上系统评估了13个模型在5个智能体框架下的表现。结果显示不同模型-框架配置下的重建质量和成本差异显著，而DrawAI-Flow持续改善了可编辑结构。
AI.conclusion: 图像到可编辑重建是一个重要且具有挑战性的任务，保真度和可编辑性往往需要权衡。智能体工作流设计（如DrawAI-Flow）能有效改善可编辑结构，但模型和框架的选择对重建质量和成本有显著影响。

title: Opt.Gear Technical Report
summary: We introduce Opt.Gear, a foundation model designed for efficient on-device deployment, real-tim inference, and strong task capability. It includes a dense model (1M, 270M, and 1B) with a context length of 64K. We designed a new hybrid architecture that combines a convolutional key-value gated mixer with local-global attention to reduce the KV-cache memory that tends to increase exponentially with long context. This architecture delivers up to X4.9 faster prefill and decoding speeds on the NPUs compared to models of a similar scale models. From a 2T tokens candidate corpus, Opt.Gear is trained on a curated 0.5T tokens subset without knowledge distillation. This is the most data-efficient of the existing foundation models. All models are released with open weights and deployment binaries for ONNX, Qualcomm NPU, and Apple ANE making Opt.Gear a practical base for edge applications that need fast, memory-efficient inference and strong task capabilities. Furthermore, to expand the ecosystem of on-device generative language models, we are introducing the Opt.Gear-1M that can be deployed on Micro-Controller Units (MCUs), a Tiny Language Model (TLM). Opt.Gear-1M is the first generative language model to achieve 20 TPS with W4A32 quantization on the ARM Cortex-M7 CPU of the STM32H747I-DISCO.

AI.tldr: Opt.Gear是一个面向端侧部署的基础模型系列，包含1M、270M和1B三种规模的dense模型，支持64K上下文长度。通过混合架构（卷积键值门控混合器+局部-全局注意力）减少KV-cache内存，在NPU上实现比同规模模型快4.9倍的预填充和解码速度，并且是现有基础模型中最具数据效率的（仅用0.5T tokens子集训练）。所有模型开源权重和部署二进制文件，支持ONNX、高通NPU和Apple ANE。此外推出的Opt.Gear-1M是首个能在MCU上运行的生成式语言模型，在ARM Cortex-M7上以W4A32量化达到20 TPS。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型向端侧设备（如手机、IoT设备、MCU）迁移的需求日益增长，现有模型面临KV-cache内存随长上下文指数增长、NPU等端侧硬件推理速度慢、数据利用效率低等问题。研究者希望打造一个兼顾端侧部署效率、实时推理能力和任务能力的开源基础模型，填补边缘生成式AI生态的空白。
AI.method: 设计了混合架构，将卷积键值门控混合器（convolutional key-value gated mixer）与局部-全局注意力（local-global attention）相结合，以缓解长上下文场景下KV-cache内存的指数增长问题。训练数据方面，从2T tokens的候选语料库中精心挑选0.5T tokens子集进行训练，不采用知识蒸馏方法。模型还提供了面向ONNX、高通NPU和Apple ANE的部署二进制文件，并针对MCU场景推出了Opt.Gear-1M微型语言模型。
AI.result: 该架构在NPU上相比同规模模型实现了最高4.9倍的预填充和解码速度提升；训练数据效率在现有基础模型中最高（仅用0.5T tokens训练）。Opt.Gear-1M成为首个在ARM Cortex-M7 MCU上以W4A32量化达到20 TPS的生成式语言模型。
AI.conclusion: Opt.Gear系列模型通过创新的混合架构和数据高效训练策略，在端侧推理速度、内存效率和任务能力之间取得了良好平衡，并开源全部权重和部署工具链，为端侧生成式AI应用提供了实用的基础模型选择，特别是Opt.Gear-1M将生成式语言模型的能力扩展到了微控制器这一极端受限的硬件平台。

title: Large language models improve physician accuracy but lead to false reliance
summary: Retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) promise source-linked clinical support, but their value depends on whether displayed evidence guides rather than distorts physician reliance. We developed CORA, an agentic retrieval-augmented LLM, to investigate how source-linked assistance affects physician decision-making. CORA maintained benchmark performance and achieved larger gains on cases published after the models' training-data cutoffs. In a study of 46 physicians, accuracy increased from 70.8% unaided to 82.6% with CORA. Supporting citations predicted correct answers (87.7% vs 65.5%), but citations created an important asymmetry: perceived support increased adoption of correct advice from 34% to 76.9% but when an incorrect LLM answer appeared citation-supported, physician resistance to it fell from 92% to 34.8%. These findings show that source-linked LLM assistance can improve physician accuracy while introducing a grounding-dependent safety risk.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CORA，一个代理式检索增强大语言模型系统，旨在为临床决策提供带来源链接的支持。研究涉及46名医生，发现CORA将诊断准确率从70.8%提升至82.6%，但同时也揭示了重要安全隐患：当不正确的LLM答案附带引用支持时，医生的拒绝率从92%骤降至34.8%，表明来源链接虽能提升正确建议的采纳率，却也增加了对错误建议的盲目信任风险。
AI.motivation: 检索增强的LLM有望提供来源链接的临床支持，但其价值取决于这些展示的证据是否能正确引导而非扭曲医生的决策依赖。需要系统性研究源链接辅助如何影响医生的决策过程，特别是在准确性和安全性两个维度。
AI.method: 开发CORA（代理式检索增强LLM），在保持基准性能的同时，在训练数据截止日期后发布的病例上取得更大增益。设计了一项包含46名医生的研究，比较无辅助与CORA辅助下的诊断准确率，并分析引用支持对正确/错误建议采纳率的影响。
AI.result: CORA辅助下准确率从70.8%提升至82.6%。支持性引用能预测正确答案（87.7% vs 65.5%），但产生关键不对称性：引用支持将正确建议采纳率从34%提升至76.9%，同时也使错误建议的拒绝率从92%降至34.8%。
AI.conclusion: 来源链接的LLM辅助能提高医生诊断准确性，但引入了依赖地面证据的安全性风险——引用支持可能使医生对错误建议过度信任，这需要在部署临床AI系统时引起重视。

title: Breaking Diversity Collapse in Spiking Pseudo-Ensembles for Efficient OOD Detection in Remote Sensing
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are attractive for resource-constrained remote-sensing systems, but reliable out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging. Deep ensembles provide strong predictive uncertainty, yet require multiple complete models and backbone evaluations. We propose an efficient spiking pseudo-ensemble that attaches multiple lightweight classification heads to a frozen SNN backbone. Naively training these heads with cross-entropy can lead to diversity collapse, where independently parameterized heads may produce correlated predictions. To address this, we introduce an agree--disagree objective that preserves correct predictions on clean in-distribution samples while encouraging diversity on structured, uncertainty-inducing transformations of the same inputs. This provides a diversity-promoting training signal without requiring external OOD data. Experiments with Spikformer and ResNet19-SNN on EuroSAT demonstrate consistent improvements over conventionally trained pseudo-ensembles. Using three backbones with five heads each matches or improves upon a five-model deep ensemble on UCM and AID, while requiring approximately 38% fewer parameters and 40% fewer backbone evaluations. These results show that explicit diversity promotion can recover useful ensemble-style uncertainty at substantially lower deployment cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的脉冲伪集成方法，通过在冻结的SNN骨干网络上附加多个轻量级分类头，并引入"一致-分歧"训练目标来促进预测多样性，从而在不使用外部OOD数据的情况下实现可靠的分布外检测，显著降低了部署成本。
AI.motivation: SNN在资源受限的遥感系统中具有吸引力，但可靠的OOD检测仍具挑战性。深度集成虽能提供强预测不确定性，但需要多个完整模型和骨干网络评估，计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出脉冲伪集成方法：1) 在冻结的SNN骨干上附加多个轻量级分类头；2) 引入"一致-分歧"目标函数，在保持干净分布内样本正确预测的同时，鼓励对结构化不确定性变换样本产生多样化预测；3) 该目标无需外部OOD数据即可提供促进多样性的训练信号。
AI.result: 在Spikformer和ResNet19-SNN上使用EuroSAT实验，一致优于传统训练的伪集成。使用三个骨干五个头配置可匹配或超越五模型深度集成（UCM和AID），同时节省约38%参数和40%骨干评估。
AI.conclusion: 显式促进多样性可以在显著降低部署成本的情况下恢复集成风格的不确定性估计能力。

title: Test-Time Curriculum for Open-Set AIGC Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors deployed in open-world environments inevitably face distribution shifts as new and stronger generative models continue to emerge. Although existing methods improve cross-generator generalization through better representations or training data construction, they typically follow a static train-once-and-deploy paradigm and cannot adapt after deployment. In this work, we study open-set AIGC image detection from a test-time adaptation perspective. We propose Test-Time Curriculum (TTC), a simple and model-agnostic framework that adapts a detector on unlabeled test data through curriculum-based self-training. TTC starts from highly reliable pseudo-labeled samples and progressively incorporates harder yet informative cases, while enforcing class-balanced selection to reduce biased updates under generator shift. To further improve pseudo-label quality, we introduce Cross-Scale Pseudo-Label Refinement, which aggregates complementary evidence across multiple resolutions for more reliable adaptation, and applies noisy-or fusion at inference to strengthen final predictions. In addition, we construct AIGCGuard, a new benchmark containing 3,100 representative real images and 124,000 generated images from 40 of the most advanced open-source and proprietary text-to-image models.
