Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TTC substantially improves overall detection performance under diverse unseen-generator shifts, establishing a practical and effective test-time adaptation framework for open-set generated image detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Test-Time Curriculum (TTC)框架，从测试时适应的角度解决开放世界中AI生成图像检测器的分布偏移问题。TTC通过课程式自训练让检测器在未标注测试数据上自适应，并引入跨尺度伪标签精炼和多分辨率证据融合，同时构建包含40种先进文生图模型的AIGCGuard基准。实验表明TTC在五个基准上显著提升了面对未知生成器时的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI生成图像检测器大多遵循"训练一次便部署"的静态范式，无法适应部署后不断涌现的新生成模型带来的分布偏移。尽管已有方法通过更好的表示或训练数据构建来改善跨生成器的泛化能力，但这些方法在部署后无法进一步自我调整，限制了开放世界场景下的实用性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出Test-Time Curriculum (TTC)框架：(1)采用课程式自训练策略，从高置信度伪标签样本开始，逐步纳入更难但有信息量的样本，并执行类别平衡选择以减少生成器偏移下的偏差更新；(2)引入跨尺度伪标签精炼（Cross-Scale Pseudo-Label Refinement），聚合多分辨率下的互补证据以提升伪标签质量；(3)在推理阶段使用noisy-or融合增强最终预测；(4)构建AIGCGuard基准，包含3,100张真实图像和124,000张来自40种先进开源与专有文生图模型的生成图像。
AI.result: 在五个基准上的大量实验表明，TTC在面对多样化的未知生成器分布偏移时显著提升了整体检测性能，验证了测试时适应框架在开放集生成图像检测中的有效性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: TTC为开放集AI生成图像检测提供了一种简单且模型无关的测试时适应框架，通过课程式自训练和跨尺度伪标签精炼，让检测器能够部署后持续适应新出现的生成模型，为该领域建立了一种实用有效的自适应检测范式。

title: DeBERTa-Sentinel: Toward Transparent and Trustworthy Detection of AI-Generated Text
summary: The rapid spread of large language models (LLMs) across the web raises concerns about misinformation, academic integrity, automated content manipulation, and risks to vulnerable online communities. Existing transformer-based detectors, such as GPT-Sentinel, show promise but struggle to generalize to diverse model outputs and paraphrasing attacks, limiting their role in building trustworthy web ecosystems. This work introduces DeBERTa-Sentinel, a responsible AI-generated text detection framework leveraging DeBERTa-v3's disentangled attention to capture subtle structural irregularities in synthetic content. A central design principle is transparency: unlike black-box commercial detectors, DeBERTa-Sentinel exposes token-level explanations of its decisions, enabling affected stakeholders journalists, educators, and platform trust and safety teams to audit, challenge, and contextualize detection outcomes. Using the GLC-AIText dataset of 28,057 human and LLM-generated samples (GPT, LLaMA, and Claude) with a 60-20-20 split, DeBERTa-Sentinel achieves 98.21\% validation accuracy and surpasses the RoBERTa-Sentinel baseline from NeurIPS 2025, achieving 97.53\% test accuracy, 95.89\% precision, 99.33\% recall, and 99.53\% ROC-AUC, and maintaining a 0.665\% false negative rate. The model's interpretability reveals linguistic markers such as academic phrasing and formal transitions associated with synthetic text, directly supporting stakeholder needs for verifiable, auditable content-authenticity decisions. By advancing responsible detection methods that reduce bias and enhance explainability, DeBERTa-Sentinel promotes trustworthy, ethical, and human-centric AI systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeBERTa-Sentinel，一个基于DeBERTa-v3的AI生成文本检测框架，在GLC-AIText数据集上达到98.21%验证准确率和97.53%测试准确率，并具备token级可解释性，超越了NeurIPS 2025的RoBERTa-Sentinel基线。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在网上的快速传播引发了虚假信息、学术诚信、自动化内容操控等担忧。现有基于Transformer的检测器（如GPT-Sentinel）虽然在检测方面有前景，但难以泛化到多样化的模型输出和释义攻击，且作为黑盒系统缺乏透明性，无法让利益相关者（记者、教育者、平台信任与安全团队）审计和验证检测结果。
AI.method: 利用DeBERTa-v3的解纠缠注意力机制捕捉合成内容中细微的结构异常。核心设计原则是透明性，提供token级别的决策解释，使利益相关者能够审计、质疑和情境化检测结果。使用GLC-AIText数据集（28,057个样本，涵盖GPT、LLaMA和Claude），采用60-20-20的训练-验证-测试划分。
AI.result: 验证准确率达到98.21%，测试准确率97.53%，精确率95.89%，召回率99.33%，ROC-AUC 99.53%，假阴性率仅0.665%，全面超越RoBERTa-Sentinel基线（NeurIPS 2025）。
AI.conclusion: DeBERTa-Sentinel通过结合高性能检测与token级可解释性，推进了负责任AI检测方法，减少偏差、增强可解释性，支持可信、道德和以人为本的AI系统建设。模型的可解释性揭示了学术措辞和正式过渡语等与合成文本相关的语言标记，直接支持利益相关者做出可验证、可审计的内容真实性决策。

title: The Scaling Paradox in Human-AI Collaboration
summary: The discovery of scaling laws has highlighted the extraordinary potential of AI systems with a striking empirical pattern: as AI systems scale, their capabilities tend to improve predictably. Yet, in real-world applications, AI rarely operates in isolation; instead, it often works alongside humans, raising the question of whether these gains persist in human-AI collaboration. In this work, we develop an analytical model to examine when the empirical scaling benefits of AI translate into improved human-AI joint system performance. We demonstrate that the performance of a human-AI system can scale positively as the AI scales up-provided that humans have an accurate perception of the AI's capabilities. Human misperception, however, can fundamentally alter this relationship: i) when humans over-perceive the AI's capabilities, a scaling paradox may arise, in which greater AI scale reduces overall system performance and amplifies firm-level profit losses, and (ii) when humans under-perceive the AI's capabilities, performance still improves with scale but at a substantially slower rate. We further show that firms can actively manage these distortions through operational policies such as cost internalization and perception alignment, whose effectiveness depends on the economics of AI deployment and the direction of human misperception. These findings suggest that organizations may benefit more from managing the human-AI interface than from simply investing in larger, more expensive AI systems. More broadly, our results suggest that AI scaling should be viewed not only as a technological challenge, but also as a behavioral and operational one, and caution against the view that larger AI systems will automatically lead to better operational outcomes. Whether AI scaling creates value ultimately depends on how increased AI capabilities shape human beliefs and collaborative efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析模型研究AI扩展能力如何转化为人机联合系统性能的提升，发现人类的AI能力感知准确性是关键决定因素：过度感知会导致"扩展悖论"（AI规模增大反而降低系统性能和利润），感知不足则使性能提升大幅减缓。企业可通过成本内化和感知对齐等运营策略管理这些偏差。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中AI很少单独运作，而是与人类协作。尽管AI扩展能力已被证明会提升其自身性能，但尚不清楚这种增益能否在人机协作系统中持续体现，因此需要研究AI扩展如何影响人机联合系统的实际表现。
AI.method: 开发了一个分析模型（analytical model），用于考察AI扩展效益何时能转化为人机联合系统性能的提升，并分析了人类对AI能力的感知准确性（过度感知或感知不足）如何改变这一关系，同时探讨了企业可采取的运营策略（如成本内部化和感知对齐）的有效性。
AI.result: 发现当人类准确感知AI能力时，人机系统性能随AI扩展正向提升；当人类过度感知AI能力时会产生"扩展悖论"——AI规模增大反而降低整体性能并扩大企业利润损失；当人类低估AI能力时，性能虽提升但速度显著放缓。运营策略的有效性取决于AI部署的经济性和人类感知偏差的方向。
AI.conclusion: 企业从管理人机界面中获得的收益可能超过单纯投资更大更昂贵的AI系统。AI扩展不仅是技术挑战，更是行为与运营挑战；扩展能否创造价值取决于AI能力如何塑造人类的信念和协作努力。

title: Factorized AdaBoost.MH Achieves the Same Convergence Rate as AdaBoost.MH
summary: AdaBoost.MH reduces multi-class classification to a collection of binary subproblems and enjoys the classical boosting-type convergence guarantee under a weak learning condition. A more structured variant, Factorized AdaBoost.MH, uses base classifiers of the form $\mathbf{h}(x)=α\mathbf{v} \bm{\varphi}(x)$, where a single binary classifier $\bm{\varphi}$ is shared across all classes and the label dependence is carried by a vote vector $\mathbf{v} \in\{\pm1\}^K$. This factorization is algorithmically attractive and achieves better performance in practice, but its convergence depends on whether one can always choose a vote vector with sufficiently large induced binary weight mass. Previous work resolved this question with a lower bound $\max\{1/n,1/\sqrt{2K}\}$, which still leaves a dimension-dependent slowdown relative to the original AdaBoost.MH analysis. In this paper, we sharpen this combinatorial step. For the minimax quantity $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ governing the factorized edge, we prove $\max\{1/n,C_K\}\le\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}\le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$, where $C_q=1$ for $q=1$, $C_q=q/(3q-4)$ for even $q\ge2$, and $C_q=(q+1)/(3q-1)$ for odd $q\ge2$. Since $C_q\downarrow 1/3$, our bounds show that $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=Θ(1)$ uniformly over $n$ and $K$. Consequently, Factorized AdaBoost.MH achieves the same boosting-type convergence rate as AdaBoost.MH up to a universal constant factor, removing the previously suggested additional dependence on $n$ or $K$ in the number of boosting rounds.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了Factorized AdaBoost.MH的收敛性分析。通过证明最小最大量$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$满足$\max\{1/n,C_K\}\le\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}\le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$，其中$C_q\downarrow 1/3$，表明$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$对$n$和$K$均匀一致。这使得Factorized AdaBoost.MH能够达到与AdaBoost.MH相同的提升型收敛率（仅差一个普适常数因子），消除了之前分析中存在的对$n$或$K$的额外依赖。
AI.motivation: Factorized AdaBoost.MH通过共享二进制分类器$\boldsymbol{\varphi}$和投票向量$\mathbf{v}$来分解多类分类问题，在算法上更具吸引力且实践效果更好，但其收敛性依赖于能否始终选择具有足够诱导二进制权重质量的投票向量。此前的工作给出了下界$\max\{1/n,1/\sqrt{2K}\}$，这导致相对于原始AdaBoost.MH分析存在维度相关的减速。本文旨在消除这一维度依赖，证明因子化算法可以达到与原算法相同的收敛率。
AI.method: 本文对控制因子化边距的最小最大量$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$进行了更精细的组合分析。作者证明了$\max\{1/n,C_K\}\le\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}\le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$，其中$C_q$是一个分段定义的常数序列：$q=1$时为1，偶数$q\ge2$时为$q/(3q-4)$，奇数$q\ge2$时为$(q+1)/(3q-1)$。该序列单调递减收敛至$1/3$，从而证明$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$对所有$n$和$K$一致成立。
AI.result: 证明了$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$均匀成立，上下界均为普适常数。由此得出Factorized AdaBoost.MH在提升轮数上达到与AdaBoost.MH相同的提升型收敛率，仅差一个普适常数因子，移除了先前建议的额外依赖$n$或$K$的项。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过对组合步骤的精细化，证明了Factorized AdaBoost.MH的收敛速度与原版AdaBoost.MH一致（至多差一个常数因子），解决了先前分析中维度依赖的减速问题，为该结构化变体的理论保证提供了更坚实的支撑。

title: Beyond Token-Level Cross-Entropy: Fréchet Distributional Post-Training for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive image generators are commonly pretrained with token-level cross-entropy under teacher forcing, yet evaluated by the distributional quality of decoded images. This creates an objective mismatch, because categorical errors have unequal image-level consequences, and a context mismatch, because inference conditions on model-generated histories. We introduce FD-loss post-training, which adapts a pretrained discrete generator using representation-space Fréchet distance as the sole objective. A dual-pass scheme first constructs detached rollout contexts through gradient-free generation under the model's native inference configuration, then performs differentiable replay with a probability-level straight-through estimator (STE) that preserves hard argmax decoding in the forward pass while propagating image-level gradients through temperature-scaled probabilities. Only the generator is updated, while the tokenizer and feature extractors remain frozen. Across eight completed configurations from four generator families on class-conditional ImageNet at $256\times256$, FD-loss post-training reduces FID and $\mathrm{FD}_{r6}$ by 41.4% and 52.0% on average. The strongest FID result improves from 2.42 to 1.43 without adding parameters or inference steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FD-loss后训练方法，通过将预训练离散图像生成器的训练目标从token级交叉熵改为表示空间中的Fréchet距离，解决了目标不匹配和上下文不匹配问题。通过双通道方案（无梯度生成构建上下文 + 可微重放配合概率级straight-through估计器），在八个配置上将FID平均降低41.4%，最佳FID从2.42改善至1.43，且不增加参数或推理步骤。
AI.motivation: 自回归图像生成器通常以token级交叉熵在教师强制下预训练，但评估时却关注解码图像的分布质量。这导致两个问题：(1) 目标不匹配——分类错误对图像级质量的影响不均匀；(2) 上下文不匹配——推理时模型需要基于自身生成的历史进行条件生成，而非真实token序列。现有方法未直接针对这两个不匹配进行优化。
AI.method: 提出FD-loss后训练框架：(1) 使用表示空间的Fréchet距离作为唯一优化目标；(2) 采用双通道方案：第一通道通过梯度无关的生成过程在当前模型原生推理配置下构建detached rollout上下文；第二通道执行可微重放，使用概率级straight-through估计器(STE)，前向保持硬argmax解码，反向通过温度缩放概率传播图像级梯度；(3) 只更新生成器，冻结tokenizer和特征提取器。
AI.result: 在四个生成器家族、八个完成的配置上，对256×256分辨率类条件ImageNet进行实验：FD-loss后训练平均降低FID 41.4%、FD_r6 52.0%。最强FID结果从2.42提升至1.43，且不增加参数或推理步骤。
AI.conclusion: FD-loss后训练作为一种轻量级、通用的后训练方法，能够有效弥合离散图像生成器预训练目标与评估指标之间的差距，在不牺牲效率的前提下显著提升生成质量。

title: Attend to Your Own Thoughts: Breaking the Barrier for Post-Training Quantization of Reasoning LLMs through the Lens of 1.58-Bit Quantization
comment: This research work was completed and submitted for publication in early May 2026. The project page: https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern
summary: We propose ScaleQ-1.58, a scalable ternary post-training quantization (PTQ) framework for reasoning LLMs. Its core insight stems from an empirical finding: although modern LLMs are typically trained to exhibit chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities, in the PTQ regime, even the latest CAT-Q method based on learning-based differentiable ternarization still leads to performance collapse on challenging mathematics and coding tasks when using conventional calibration schemes that ignore the model's reasoning process. Driven by this finding, we introduce a simple calibration approach, Attend to Your Own Thoughts (AYOT), where reasoning traces and final answers generated by the pre-trained high-precision target LLM on a proper set of calibration samples are used as the context input during the ternarization process, along with the corresponding questions. ScaleQ-1.58 is formed by simply integrating AYOT with CAT-Q, which demonstrates several scaling properties: (1) with only 4M calibration tokens, Qwen3-1.7B ternarized by ScaleQ-1.58 reaches over 90.52% of the performance of the prior best BitNet b1.58 2B4T averaged over 4 mathematics and coding tasks, and our ternary Qwen3-4B shows an absolute gain of 8.97%, while requiring 1,000,000x fewer calibration tokens for quantization; (2) ScaleQ-1.58 generalizes well to both dense and MoE architectures, with performance improving as model scale increases (up to 235B parameters); (3) ScaleQ-1.58 demonstrates strong generalization across tasks of varying difficulty levels, including mathematics, coding and scientific logic reasoning, as well as commonsense reasoning and basic language generation; (4) its performance continues to improve as the number of calibration tokens increases. Notably, AYOT also exhibits strong generalization ability across other quantization bit-widths. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScaleQ-1.58，一个可扩展的推理LLM三元后训练量化（PTQ）框架。其核心发现是：即便使用最新的基于学习的可微三元量化方法CAT-Q，在忽略模型推理过程的传统校准方案下，推理LLM在数学和编码任务上仍会出现性能崩溃。据此提出AYOT校准方法，将预训练高精度模型生成的推理轨迹和最终答案作为量化过程的上下文输入。ScaleQ-1.58仅用4M校准token即可使Qwen3-1.7B达到BitNet b1.58 2B4T性能的90.52%，且校准token量减少100万倍，并展现良好的跨架构、跨任务扩展性。
AI.motivation: 推理型LLM（如具有链式思维能力的模型）在传统PTQ量化方案下性能严重崩溃，即便采用最新的CAT-Q方法在数学和编码等挑战性任务上仍会失效。现有校准方案忽略了模型的推理过程，无法有效量化推理模型。作者希望通过利用模型自身的推理痕迹来解决这一量化难题，使三元量化在推理LLM上变得可行且可扩展。
AI.method: 首先通过实证研究发现，忽略推理过程的传统校准方案会导致推理LLM量化后性能崩溃。基于此发现，提出AYOT（Attend to Your Own Thoughts）校准方法：在校准阶段，使用预训练的高精度目标LLM在适当校准样本上生成的推理轨迹和最终答案，连同原始问题一起作为上下文输入参与三元量化过程。将AYOT与CAT-Q（基于学习的可微三元量化方法）简单集成形成ScaleQ-1.58框架。
AI.result: (1) 仅用4M校准token，Qwen3-1.7B经ScaleQ-1.58量化后在4个数学和编码任务上平均达到BitNet b1.58 2B4T性能的90.52%，Qwen3-4B获得8.97%的绝对提升，校准token量减少100万倍；(2) 在稠密和MoE架构上均表现良好，性能随模型规模增大而提升（最高至235B参数）；(3) 在数学、编码、科学逻辑推理、常识推理和基础语言生成等不同难度任务上均展现强大泛化能力；(4) 性能随校准token数量增加而持续提升。AYOT还可泛化至其他量化位宽。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种简单而有效的解决推理LLM三元量化难题的方案：通过让量化过程关注模型自身的推理轨迹（AYOT校准），可以显著提升三元量化推理模型的性能。ScaleQ-1.58在极少的校准数据下即实现SOTA性能，并展现出色的可扩展性和跨架构、跨任务的泛化能力，为大规模推理LLM的高效部署提供了实用路径。

title: Isotropy Cliffs: The Geometric Signature of Decision-Making in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate the geometry of decision-making in Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) through the lens of isotropy. Analyzing five open-weight models across diverse datasets, we identify decision-critical transition layers characterized by a shift in isotropy, coinciding with a major representational change and the emergence of task-relevant clusters. We demonstrate that this synchronized geometric behavior is strongly correlated with downstream accuracy ($r\approx0.84$), displaying its relevance for successful decision-making. Furthermore, we show that this transition is robust to prompt variations, suggesting that it reflects a general mechanism of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过各向同性（isotropy）的视角研究多项选择问答（MCQA）中的决策几何。分析了五个开源模型在多个数据集上的表现，发现了决策关键转换层，其特征是各向同性发生变化，同时伴随主要表征变化和任务相关聚类的出现。这种同步的几何行为与下游准确率高度相关（r≈0.84），并且对提示变化具有鲁棒性，表明它反映了模型行为的普遍机制。
AI.motivation: 理解MCQA任务中模型如何做出决策，特别是寻找决策过程中关键的表示转换层，以及这些几何特征与模型性能之间的关系。作者希望揭示模型决策的普遍机制，而不仅仅是特定数据集或提示下的偶然现象。
AI.method: 使用各向同性（isotropy）作为几何度量工具，对五个开源权重模型在多个MCQA数据集上进行系统性分析。通过追踪各层表示的各向同性变化，识别决策关键转换层，并检查该转换与表征变化、聚类出现以及下游准确率之间的相关性。同时通过提示扰动实验检验该现象的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 发现了决策关键转换层，其各向同性变化与任务准确率高度相关（r≈0.84）；该转换伴随着表示的主要变化和任务相关聚类的出现；该现象对提示变化具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MCQA模型的决策过程存在一个几何上可识别的关键转换层，各向同性变化是任务相关表示形成的有力指标，且该机制在不同模型和提示设置下普遍存在，为理解大型语言模型的内部决策机制提供了新视角。

title: FL-OA: A Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning Framework with Outsourced Auditing for Intelligent Devices
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple intelligent devices to collaboratively train a high-accuracy model without sharing raw data. However, due to its distributed nature, FL is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks. Existing defense methods rely on strong assumptions, such as the proportion of malicious devices not exceeding 50\%, or the server having an additional root dataset that matches the training task. Moreover, they show limited efficacy as they overlook $(i)$ the divergence among benign updates and $(ii)$ the curse of dimensionality involved in comparing two high-dimensional updates. To solve these concerns, we propose FL-OA, a Byzantine-robust federated learning framework utilizing outsourced auditing. In FL-OA, the server collaborates with third-party organization that holds an additional root dataset to perform outsourced auditing, thereby enabling the server to achieve robust aggregation without strong assumptions. Additionally, FL-OA introduces a gradient ascent step and a correction term during local training to mitigate the divergence among benign updates, and designs a parameter importance indicator to extract critical parameters for auditing, alleviating the curse of dimensionality. We further provide a detailed theoretical analysis of FL-OA. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FL-OA outperforms existing defense methods against Byzantine attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FL-OA，一种利用外包审计的拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习框架。服务器与持有根数据集的第三方组织协作执行外包审计，无需强假设即可实现鲁棒聚合；同时引入梯度上升步骤和修正项缓解良性更新间的发散，并设计参数重要性指标提取关键参数以缓解维度灾难问题。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习拜占庭防御方法存在两个核心问题：(1) 依赖强假设（如恶意设备比例不超过50%、服务器需持有与训练任务匹配的根数据集）；(2) 忽视了良性更新之间的发散性以及比较高维更新时面临的维度灾难问题，导致防御效果有限。
AI.method: FL-OA框架包含三个关键设计：(1) 服务器与持有附加根数据集的第三方组织协作进行外包审计，实现无强假设的鲁棒聚合；(2) 在本地训练中引入梯度上升步骤和修正项，以缓解良性更新间的发散；(3) 设计参数重要性指标来提取关键参数进行审计，从而缓解维度灾难问题。作者还提供了详细的理论分析。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FL-OA在抵御拜占庭攻击方面优于现有防御方法。
AI.conclusion: FL-OA通过外包审计机制，成功克服了现有拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习方法对强假设的依赖，并有效解决了良性更新发散和高维比较两个被忽视的问题，在对抗拜占庭攻击上展现了更优的性能。

title: Relax Within, Balance Across: Geometry-Guided Load Balancing for Vision-Language Mixture-of-Experts
comment: 22 pages, including appendices. Code available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA
summary: Vision-language MoE batches contain different numbers of image and text tokens. Image resolution, image count, tiling, and prompt length all change this token mix. We call the standard token-level Switch auxiliary loss Std-Aux. Std-Aux balances only the mixed load, so large image and text load errors can cancel at one mix. On our main model, the same trained router shows more than a fivefold change in load imbalance across image resolutions. We hold the image and text load profiles fixed and derive the exact load curve as the token mix varies. The image-text load gap controls sensitivity to the token mix. Physical preprocessing can also change the conditional profiles. The fixed-profile law excludes such changes. To design a remedy, we examine the router input structure. Image and text occupy distinct regions, while visual tokens group strongly by source image. The modality boundary motivates separate image and text terms. The image boundary motivates one equal-weight routing instance per image. ReBA, or Relax Within, Balance Across, implements both choices. Across four split backbones, ReBA lowers load on every reported benchmark input while keeping mean task accuracy comparable to Std-Aux. ReBA also lowers average load over the tested range and worst physical load under resolution and tiling shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReBA（Relax Within, Balance Across）方法，用于解决视觉-语言MoE模型中标准辅助损失（Std-Aux）在混合token负载下无法有效平衡图像和文本负载的问题。ReBA通过为每个图像建立独立的均衡路由实例、并分别处理图像与文本负载，显著降低了所有基准输入上的负载，同时保持任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言MoE批处理中图像token与文本token数量随图像分辨率、数量、切分方式和提示长度变化而变化。标准的token级Switch辅助损失（Std-Aux）仅平衡混合负载，导致图像和文本负载误差可能相互抵消。实验表明，同一路由器在不同图像分辨率下负载不均衡度变化超过5倍。因此需要一种对token混合比例不敏感的负载均衡方法。
AI.method: 1. 通过固化图像和文本负载分布，推导出负载曲线随token混合变化的精确关系，并指出图像-文本负载差距是敏感性的关键。2. 分析路由器输入结构，发现图像和文本token占据不同区域，且视觉token按源图像强分组。3. 基于此提出ReBA：利用模态边界分别处理图像和文本项（Balance Across modalities），利用图像边界为每个图像创建等权重的路由实例（Relax Within image）。
AI.result: 在四个拆分主干网络上，ReBA在所有报告基准输入上均降低了负载，同时平均任务准确率与Std-Aux相当。ReBA还降低了测试范围内的平均负载以及分辨率和切分变化下的最差物理负载。
AI.conclusion: ReBA通过在图像内部放宽负载均衡约束、在图像间与模态间进行平衡，有效解决了视觉-语言MoE中token混合变化导致的负载不均衡问题，且不牺牲任务性能。代码已开源。

title: Morphology Aware Reversible Semantic Tokenization and Hierarchical Word Composition for Tamil Language Models
summary:
Statistical subword tokenizers can process arbitrary text, but their units need not align with lexical or grammatical structure. This is especially important for Tamil, where a written word may encode stem changes, case, number, tense, agreement, voice, clitics, and linked verbs. We present a Tamil morphology system extending the open-source ThamizhiMorph analyzer and generator, together with a byte-exact semantic tokenizer and a learned hierarchical word composer. Twelve finite-state transducers analyze words into lemmas and grammatical features, while character and byte fallbacks preserve exact reconstruction.
  We compare a flat morphology tokenizer, a signal-preserving word composer, and tokenizers based on Sarvam-1, AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2, and BrahmicTokenizer-131K. All systems use the same 69,591 Tamil-English training pairs, 18.97-million-parameter encoder-decoder, 40,000 updates, target tokenizer, optimizer, positional method, and generation settings.
  On a protected 3,539-row IN22 and FLORES+ evaluation, morphology-flat achieves the best pooled scores: 10.63 BLEU, 35.26 chrF++, and 0.6276 COMETKiwi. Relative to AI4Bharat, the strongest external-tokenizer baseline, these are improvements of 7.2%, 3.2%, and 2.6%. The word composer scores 10.30, 34.88, and 0.6241, improving on AI4Bharat by 3.8%, 2.1%, and 2.0%.
  The composer reduces mean global source states from 71.48 to 29.08, a 59.3% reduction, and is estimated to require 9-21% fewer inference FLOPs depending on decoder caching. Its remaining quality gap is concentrated in longer FLORES+ sentences. These results show that explicit Tamil morphology improves translation under a fixed small-model budget, while hierarchical composition substantially reduces sequence length and estimated inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套针对泰米尔语的形态学系统，包含12个有限状态转导器用于词法分析、字节精确的语义分词器以及学习式的分层词组合器，并在机器翻译任务中验证了显式形态学建模在固定小模型预算下的优势。
AI.motivation: 统计子词分词器可以处理任意文本，但其切分单元未必与词汇或语法结构对齐。这在泰米尔语中尤为严重，因为一个书面词可能编码词干变化、格、数、时态、一致、语态、附着词和连动动词等多种语法信息。作者希望通过显式形态学分析提升翻译质量。
AI.method: 扩展了开源的ThamizhiMorph分析器和生成器，构建了12个有限状态转导器将词分析为词元和语法特征，并提供字符和字节回退以保证精确重建。同时提出字节精确的语义分词器和学习式分层词组合器。实验对比了扁平形态分词器、信号保持的词组合器以及基于Sarvam-1、AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2和BrahmicTokenizer-131K的分词器，所有系统使用相同的训练数据、模型架构和训练设置。
AI.result: 在3,539行的IN22和FLORES+评估集上，扁平形态分词器取得最佳综合得分：BLEU 10.63、chrF++ 35.26、COMETKiwi 0.6276，相较于最强的外部分词器基线AI4Bharat分别提升7.2%、3.2%和2.6%。词组合器得分10.30/34.88/0.6241，将平均全局源状态从71.48降至29.08（减少59.3%），推理FLOPs估计减少9-21%。其质量差距主要集中在较长的FLORES+句子上。
AI.conclusion: 显式泰米尔语形态学在固定小模型预算下能显著提升机器翻译质量，而分层词组合能大幅降低序列长度和推理成本，尽管在长句上仍存在一定质量差距。

title: Similarity Weighted Aggregation with Global Differential Privacy for Federated Brain Lesion Segmentation
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across multiple institutions without sharing sensitive data, making it particularly suitable for medical imaging applications. However, heterogeneous data distributions across institutions and potential information leakage through model updates remain important challenges. In this work, we propose DP-SimAgg, a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that integrates similarity-weighted aggregation with a server-side differential privacy mechanism. The proposed method applies L2 clipping to bound collaborator updates, computes similarity-based aggregation weights to mitigate the effects of non-IID data distributions, and injects calibrated Gaussian noise at the central server, providing per-round privacy guarantees under the assumed sensitivity bound. The framework is implemented using Intel's OpenFL platform and evaluated on the FeTS 2022 dataset consisting of 1251 multi-modal MRI scans for brain tumor segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that DP-SimAgg maintains competitive segmentation performance while providing privacy protection. Under a strict per-round privacy budget (epsilon = 1, cumulative epsilon_total = 20 over 20 rounds), the method achieves Dice scores of 0.6357, 0.5305, and 0.5274 for the enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT) regions, respectively. With a more relaxed per-round budget (epsilon = 10, cumulative epsilon_total = 200), performance approaches that of the non-private baseline while incorporating a central Gaussian mechanism with per-round (epsilon, delta)-DP accounting under the assumed sensitivity bound. These results highlight the potential of DP-SimAgg for enabling privacy-preserving collaborative learning in medical imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-SimAgg，一个结合相似性加权聚合与服务端差分隐私的联邦学习框架，用于医学影像中的隐私保护协作学习。在FeTS 2022脑肿瘤分割数据集上验证，该方法在提供隐私保障的同时保持有竞争力的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在医学影像中应用广泛，但面临两大挑战：1) 各机构间的异质数据分布（non-IID）影响模型性能；2) 模型更新可能泄露敏感信息。现有方法难以同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: DP-SimAgg框架包含三个核心组件：1) 应用L2裁剪约束各参与方的更新；2) 基于相似性的加权聚合策略以缓解non-IID数据分布的影响；3) 在中心服务器注入校准的高斯噪声，提供每轮(epsilon, delta)-DP隐私保证。框架基于Intel OpenFL平台实现。
AI.result: 在FeTS 2022数据集（1251例多模态MRI脑肿瘤分割）上，严格隐私预算下（每轮epsilon=1，20轮累计20）Dice分数分别为ET 0.6357、TC 0.5305、WT 0.5274；宽松预算下（每轮epsilon=10，累计200）接近非私有基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: DP-SimAgg展示了隐私保护联邦学习在医学影像中的可行性，在隐私保护与分割性能之间取得了良好折中，为跨机构的协作医学影像分析提供了有效方案。

title: When Do Surrogate Updates Improve Decisions? A Local Theory of Trajectory-Wise Transfer
comment: 22 pages in total, including references and appendices; 3 composite figures (9 panels) and 4 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/Ethan-Shen-Individual-Lab/surrogate-to-decision-transfer
summary: A broad range of models face the mismatch where they are updated through trajectory losses but are evaluated by downstream task reward. Here, a trajectory is a training instance that induces a surrogate loss whose reduction might not track the model's decision utility update. Theoretically, we ask when one step of trajectory training reduces both population surrogate loss and decision risk, and how transfer accumulates along repeated updates. To formalize this, we first fix a checkpoint and a restricted update space, and define the reductions in population surrogate risk and decision risk induced by a trajectory as its learnability and decision utility, respectively. On this basis, our theory yields four main results. First, a one-step transfer bound separates their discrepancy into first-order gradient misalignment after nonnegative calibration and second-order curvature; and a pathwise extension accumulates the same terms over repeated updates. Second, when the accessible surrogate gradient is nonzero, universal first-order transfer over every accessible direction holds exactly when the accessible surrogate and decision gradients are positively collinear. Third, the calibration gap bounds the decision regret of learnability-based trajectory selection, while a candidate-difference refinement tightens this guarantee by retaining only directions that affect pairwise rankings. Finally, we establish an approximation--calibration trade-off across nested update spaces. Controlled gridworld and LLM post-training experiments yield results consistent with our predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究轨迹损失优化与下游任务奖励评估之间的不匹配问题，通过理论分析提出"可学习性"与"决策效用"概念，建立了从单步到多步更新的迁移界限，并证实一阶梯度对齐、校准差距等关键因素对迁移效果的决定性作用。
AI.motivation: 许多模型在训练时使用轨迹损失（如RLHF中的序列级损失）进行更新，但在评估时却依据下游任务奖励。这两者之间的不匹配可能导致训练目标优化了代理损失却未真正提升决策效用。作者希望从理论上回答：何时轨迹训练的一步更新能同时降低代理损失和决策风险，以及这种迁移如何在多次更新中累积。
AI.method: 作者首先固定检查点和受限更新空间，定义了轨迹的"可学习性"（代理风险的减少）和"决策效用"（决策风险的减少）。在此基础上，推导了四个主要理论结果：（1）单步迁移界限，将偏差分解为一阶梯度错位（经非负校准后）和二阶曲率；（2）路径扩展，将相同项累积到多次更新；（3）校准差距界定了基于可学习性的轨迹选择的决策遗憾；（4）嵌套更新空间上的近似-校准权衡。并通过网格世界和LLM后训练实验验证。
AI.result: 四个主要理论结果：第一，单步迁移界限分解了代理损失与决策风险间的误差为一阶梯度错位和二阶曲率；第二，当代理梯度非零时，universal first-order transfer成立的充要条件是可访问的代理梯度与决策梯度正共线；第三，校准差距为轨迹选择的决策遗憾提供了上界，并通过候选差异细化得到更紧的界；第四，在嵌套更新空间上存在近似-校准权衡。实验验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统性地刻画了轨迹训练与决策评估之间不匹配的理论性质，揭示了梯度对齐和校准差距在迁移学习中的核心作用，为理解轨迹损失优化的局限性及设计更有效的训练策略提供了理论基础。

title: Element-Aware Group Learning for E-Commerce Image Generation
summary: Recent advances in image generation and editing have made prompt quality a key bottleneck for e-commerce creatives. Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate image-editing prompts from product images and metadata, but further improving their prompt-writing capabilities requires post-training with feedback from the generated images. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a natural framework for such outcome-level reward optimization. However, it assigns credit only at the full-prompt level, even though image quality often depends on specific design elements such as composition, background, and the presentation of selling points. Existing fine-grained credit assignment methods typically require step-level supervision or learned critics. To address this, we propose EAGLE-GRPO (Element-Aware Group Learning for E-Commerce Image Generation), which decomposes the group-centered reward over predefined elements. We cast element-level credit assignment as a kernel ridge regression problem and derive a closed-form solution, without additional rollouts or separate credit-assignment models. This yields interpretable per-element advantages and more precise policy updates. Experiments show that EAGLE-GRPO sustains performance gains over more training steps before plateauing and generates prompts that produce higher-quality e-commerce images than competitive VLM prompt-writing baselines.

AI.tldr: EAGLE-GRPO提出了一种元素感知的组相对策略优化方法，用于电商图像生成中的提示词优化。该方法将组级奖励分解到预定义的设计元素上，通过核岭回归的闭式解实现元素级信用分配，无需额外的rollout或实体模型。
AI.motivation: 在电商图像生成中，视觉语言模型（VLM）的提示词质量成为关键瓶颈。虽然GRPO可用于结果级奖励优化，但它仅在完整提示层级分配信用，而图像质量往往取决于构图、背景和卖点呈现等具体设计元素。现有细粒度信用分配方法需要步骤级监督或学习型评论器，成本高且复杂。
AI.method: EAGLE-GRPO将组中心奖励分解到预定义元素上，将元素级信用分配建模为核岭回归（Kernel Ridge Regression）问题，并推导出闭式解。该方法无需额外rollout或独立的信用分配模型，即可获得可解释的逐元素优势值，从而实现更精确的策略更新。
AI.result: 实验表明，EAGLE-GRPO在更多训练步骤中持续保持性能提升后才趋于平稳，生成的提示词能够产生比竞争性VLM提示词写作基线更高质量的电商图像。
AI.conclusion: EAGLE-GRPO通过元素感知的信用分配有效解决了GRPO在电商图像提示词优化中的信用分配粒度问题，提供了更精确的策略更新和更优的最终图像质量，且计算开销低。

title: PlainMedScale: A Corpus of Multi-Level Simplified Medical Texts in German and English
summary: We introduce PlainMedScale, a topic-aligned medical corpus spanning four levels of comprehensibility in German and English, drawn from MSD (professional and consumer), Gesund.Bund, Apotheken Umschau Einfache Sprache, and the NHS. The four tiers correspond to distinct communicative functions --- reference, explanation, decision support, and access --- and move beyond the binary expert--lay contrast of prior corpora. In two pilot studies enabled by the alignments, we show that many readability metrics established on two registers fail to generalize across the full gradient, and that a SOTA open-weight LLM prompted for Plain Language still partially preserves the difficulty of its input. Code (https://github.com/GS-Uni-Heidelberg/PlainMedScale) and data (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21728290) are made available.

AI.tldr: 本文引入PlainMedScale，一个涵盖德语和英语四层可理解性等级的主题对齐医学语料库，突破以往专家-非专家的二元划分，并在两个初步研究中证明现有可读性指标和SOTA开源大语言模型在完整梯度上泛化能力有限。
AI.motivation: 现有医学语料库通常仅区分专家与普通消费者两个层面，难以反映医学沟通中真实存在的多级可理解性梯度。作者希望提供更精细的主题对齐资源，以更好地研究可读性度量和纯语言生成模型在医学文本简化中的表现。
AI.method: 从MSD（专业版和消费者版）、Gesund.Bund、Apotheken Umschau Einfache Sprache及NHS四个来源构建语料库，按四种交际功能（参考、解释、决策支持、获取）划分为四个可理解性层级。德语和英语双语主题对齐，并开展两个试点研究：一是评估既有可读性指标在四层梯度上的泛化能力；二是测试SOTA开源权重LLM在纯语言提示下的简化效果。
AI.result: 试点研究表明，许多基于双寄存器（专家vs.非专家）建立的可读性指标在完整四层梯度上无法良好泛化；SOTA开源LLM在纯语言提示下仍部分保留输入文本的难度水平。语料库代码和数据均已公开。
AI.conclusion: PlainMedScale提供了一个更精细、主题对齐的多级医学语料资源，揭示了现有可读性指标和大模型简化的局限性，为未来医学文本可理解性研究与简化方法发展奠定基础。

title: Assuming You Knew: Fixing an Epistemic Semantics for Flow Policies Using Agentic AI
summary: Many high-level security requirements are about the allowed flow of information in programs and are difficult to make precise because they involve selective downgrading. Notions from epistemic logic have emerged as a good approach to policy semantics but a robust general framework remains elusive. A paper appearing in CSF 2018, entitled ``Assuming You Know: Epistemic Semantics of Relational Annotations for Expressive Flow Policies'', attempted to provide a unifying framework---but the formalization was sketchy and a correction was announced during the conference presentation. With aid from an agentic AI coding assistant, a corrected formalization has been machine checked in the Rocq proof assistant. The simplicity and generality of the framework may help compare different policy specification styles and enforce them by leveraging existing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了对CSF 2018一篇论文的修正工作。该论文尝试用认知逻辑为信息流策略提供统一的形式化框架，但原始形式化存在缺陷。本文借助智能体AI编码助手，在Rocq证明助手中完成了修正后形式化的机器验证。
AI.motivation: 许多高级安全需求涉及程序中允许的信息流，但由于涉及选择性降级而难以精确化。认知逻辑的概念为策略语义提供了良好方法，但缺乏稳健的通用框架。CSF 2018的论文试图提供统一框架，但形式化不够严谨，会议上还宣布了修正，因此需要一个正确的、经过验证的形式化。
AI.method: 利用智能体AI编码助手（agentic AI coding assistant）协助完成修正后的形式化，并在Rocq证明助手中进行机器检查（machine checked）验证其正确性。
AI.result: 修正后的形式化已在Rocq证明助手中通过机器检查，证实了框架的正确性。该框架的简洁性和通用性有助于比较不同的策略规范风格，并可利用现有技术加以实施。
AI.conclusion: 通过机器验证的修正形式化使该统一框架更加可靠，其简洁通用性使其在信息流策略规范比较与实施方面具有实用价值。

title: Policy Optimality Measurement for Multi-Vehicle Decision-Making: From Extrinsic Indicators to Intrinsic Quality
summary: Evaluating Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policies in autonomous driving fundamentally relies on extrinsic statistical indicators (e.g., reward curves and success rates), which often mask intrinsic policy degradation and algorithmic blind spots. To break this black-box evaluation, this letter proposes a novel information-theoretic diagnostic framework. By leveraging a fully converged Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) as an asymptotic oracle, we establish a theoretical ground-truth baseline distribution. We formulate a bounded policy optimality score ($\mathcal{M}_{opt}$) using the forward KL divergence to rigorously penalize fatal collaborative omissions. Crucially, we semantically decouple this metric into lateral and longitudinal dimensions, creating a granular "semantic microscope". Extensive spatial and temporal diagnostics on state-of-the-art MARL architectures and exploration mechanisms demonstrate that our framework conclusively exposes hidden directional biases, identifies temporal average-policy traps, and transforms heuristic hyperparameter tuning into a visually trackable trajectory optimization. This framework establishes a rigorous, model-agnostic standard for benchmarking intrinsic multi-agent policy quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信息论的诊断框架，用于评估自动驾驶中多智能体强化学习（MARL）策略的内在质量。通过将完全收敛的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）作为渐近最优基准，利用前向KL散度构建有界策略最优性分数（M_opt），并从横向和纵向维度对策略进行语义解耦分析，从而揭示传统统计指标无法捕捉的隐藏策略偏差和算法盲区。
AI.motivation: 传统MARL评估过度依赖外部统计指标（如奖励曲线和成功率），但这些指标往往掩盖了策略的内在退化过程和算法盲区，缺乏对策略质量的深入、可解释的诊断手段。
AI.method: 1) 利用完全收敛的MCTS作为渐近oracle，建立理论上的ground-truth基准分布；2) 基于前向KL散度设计有界策略最优性分数M_opt，严格惩罚致命性协同遗漏；3) 将评估指标语义解耦为横向和纵向两个维度，构建细粒度的"语义显微镜"；4) 对SOTA MARL架构和探索机制进行时空诊断分析。
AI.result: 实验证明该框架能够：1) 揭示隐藏的方向性偏差；2) 识别时间上的平均策略陷阱；3) 将启发式超参数调优转化为可视化可追踪的轨迹优化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架建立了一个严谨、模型无关的标准，用于基准测试多智能体策略的内在质量，突破了传统黑箱评估的局限性，为自动驾驶MARL策略诊断提供了新的范式。

title: Representation Transfer of Foundation Models for Ultra-Widefield Retinal Imaging
summary: Despite the widespread adoption of foundation models as feature extractors for medical imaging, relatively little is understood about how different pretraining strategies influence the transferability of learned representations to weakly supervised ophthalmic imaging tasks. We investigate this question in ultra-widefield (UWF) retinal imaging by evaluating foundation model representations within a patch-based multiple instance learning (MIL) framework for disease classification on UWF images. We compare Vision Transformer encoders pretrained with supervised, Masked Autoencoder (MAE), and self-distillation objectives, while keeping the downstream aggregation architecture unchanged. Within a controlled comparison of ViT-B encoders pretrained on ImageNet-1k, the choice of pretraining objective substantially influenced frozen representation transfer, with supervised and self-distillation-based models outperforming MAE. A contemporary DINOv3 model pretrained at a larger scale achieved the strongest overall performance, with a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.863 for five-class diabetic retinopathy grading, comparable with DINOv1. Attention analysis further revealed distinct patch-aggregation behaviours associated with the different pretrained representations, while partial fine-tuning substantially reduced the performance gap for MAE. These findings suggest that pretraining strategy influences both representation transferability and the subsequent aggregation of patch-level evidence within MIL, resulting in differences in downstream classification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在超广角眼底成像中，不同预训练策略（监督学习、MAE、自蒸馏）对基础模型表征在弱监督多实例学习中迁移能力的影响。研究发现预训练目标显著影响冻结表征的迁移性能，DINOv3和DINOv1表现最佳，部分微调可缩小MAE的差距。
AI.motivation: 虽然基础模型已广泛用于医学图像特征提取，但不同预训练策略对弱监督眼科任务中表征迁移性的影响仍缺乏系统理解。理解这一影响对于合理选择和应用预训练模型至关重要。
AI.method: 在UWF视网膜图像上，采用基于patch的多实例学习（MIL）框架进行疾病分类。在保持下游聚合架构不变的前提下，比较了使用监督学习、Masked Autoencoder (MAE) 和自蒸馏（self-distillation）目标预训练的Vision Transformer编码器。同时进行了注意力分析和部分微调实验。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1k预训练的ViT-B编码器对比中，监督学习和自蒸馏模型优于MAE。更大规模训练的DINOv3模型表现最佳，五类糖尿病视网膜病变分级中二次加权kappa达到0.863，与DINOv1相当。注意力分析显示不同预训练表征产生不同的patch聚合行为，部分微调显著缩小了MAE的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 预训练策略不仅影响表征的可迁移性，还影响MIL中patch级证据的聚合方式，最终导致下游分类性能的差异。这一发现对医学影像基础模型的选型和应用具有指导意义。

title: Does Machine "know" interpersonal pragmatics? Evidence from MARBERT's learning of emoji pragmatics in Arabic digital discourse
summary: This study examines Transformer-based models' ability to learn emoji pragmatics in Arabic digital discourse (ADD), providing evidence from MARBERT's behavior with interpersonal pragmatic functions (IPFs). A corpus of 8,504 unique emoji-posts collected from Facebook via Python was used in the study. These posts were manually annotated, developed, and labeled for five IPFs: Politeness, Respect, Solidarity, Empathy, and Encouragement. A mixed-method approach was employed comprising statistical methods and interpretative analyses involving speech act theory, politeness theory, and rapport management theory. MARBERT was fine-tuned to model these context-dependent pragmatic functions. Findings demonstrate MARBERT's ability to learn these IPFs, achieving strong performance on unseen data, with an accuracy of 93%, a micro F1-score of 0.61, and a macro F1-score of 0.56, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing interpersonal functions beyond conventional sentiment analysis. Function-level evaluation showed that Politeness and Respect were identified more accurately than Solidarity, reflecting differences in the explicitness and contextual dependence of IPFs. The study concludes that Transformer-based models learn patterns of face management and relational communication but remain challenged by highly implicit social meanings. It contributes a novel computational approach to modeling emoji pragmatics and advances the integration of interpersonal pragmatics with NLP for digital communication research.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨Transformer模型（MARBERT）在阿拉伯语数字话语中学习表情符号语用功能的能力，基于8,504条手动标注的表情符号帖子，涵盖五种人际语用功能（礼貌、尊重、团结、共情、鼓励），模型在未见数据上达到93%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有NLP研究多聚焦于情感分析，忽略了表情符号在数字话语中承载的人际语用功能（如礼貌、尊重等）。本研究旨在弥合人际语用学与NLP之间的鸿沟，探索Transformer模型能否学习这些情境依赖的语用功能。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：构建包含8,504条独特表情符号帖子的语料库（来自Facebook），进行手工标注五种IPFs；使用MARBERT（面向阿拉伯语的Transformer模型）进行微调建模；结合统计方法和质性分析（言语行为理论、礼貌理论、关系管理理论）进行解读。
AI.result: MARBERT在未见数据上表现出色，准确率达93%，微观F1分数为0.61，宏观F1分数为0.56。功能级评估显示"礼貌"和"尊重"比"团结"识别更准确，反映了IPFs在显性程度和情境依赖性上的差异。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型能够学习面子管理和关系性沟通的模式，但对高度隐性的社会意义仍具挑战。本研究为表情符号语用学建模提供了新的计算方法，推进了人际语用学与NLP在数字传播研究中的整合。

title: Neuro-Evolved Heuristics for Variable Gapped Common Subsequence Identification
summary:
This study addresses the Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence Problem (VGLCSP), a variant of the classical longest common subsequence problem with additional gap constraints and applications in sequence alignment and time-series analysis. While the two-sequence version has been widely studied using dynamic programming, the generalized multi-sequence form is usually solved with beam search-based heuristics, whose hand-crafted designs often lack robustness.
  To overcome this limitation, we propose a learning-based approach for automatically designing more effective data-driven heuristics. The heuristics are represented by a neural network with predefined architecture, whose weights are optimized by a genetic algorithm within a neuro-evolutionary framework. The learning process alternates between weight optimization and evaluation within an iterative multi-source beam search procedure, a state-of-the-art method for the problem. Rather than constructing solutions directly, the neural network learns to guide the search process, producing a neuro-evolved heuristic. We further introduce an ensemble heuristic that combines the scores of learned and the best-performing hand-crafted heuristic. Integrated into the iterative multi-source beam search framework, the resulting hybrid approach outperforms existing methods on both synthetic benchmark instances and newly introduced real-world instances with data-driven gap constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文针对变间隔最长公共子序列问题（VGLCSP）提出了一种基于学习的启发式方法，通过神经进化框架用遗传算法优化神经网络权重，使其学习引导迭代多源束搜索过程，并引入集成启发式结合学习与人工设计启发式的优势，在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: VGLCSP的多序列版本通常使用基于束搜索的手工启发式方法，但这些手工设计的启发式缺乏鲁棒性。研究旨在克服这一局限，通过自动设计数据驱动的启发式来替代手工设计，提高方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种神经进化框架：1) 使用预定义架构的神经网络作为启发式表示；2) 通过遗传算法优化网络权重；3) 学习过程在权重优化和评估之间交替进行；4) 网络不直接构造解，而是学习引导迭代多源束搜索过程；5) 进一步引入集成启发式，结合学习到的启发式与最佳手工启发式的评分。
AI.result: 将所提出的混合方法集成到迭代多源束搜索框架中，在合成基准实例和具有数据驱动间隔约束的新引入真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于神经进化的学习方法能够自动设计出比手工启发式更有效的搜索引导启发式，且集成策略能进一步提升性能，为VGLCSP提供了新的解决方案。

title: EulerLoRA: Rank-Driven Jump Dynamics for Calibrated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning, but standard LoRA produces a single deterministic model and does not directly support predictive uncertainty estimation. We introduce EulerLoRA, a stochastic extension of LoRA that generates multiple predictive trajectories by sampling structured variations along the rank-one components of shared low-rank adapters, while preserving the deterministic LoRA transformation in expectation. We evaluate EulerLoRA with vision transformers on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and HAM10000, together with out-of-distribution detection on SVHN. Across these benchmarks, EulerLoRA achieves comparable or improved performance relative to strong LoRA-Ensemble baselines. Using two rank-20 adapters, EulerLoRA requires approximately 3 million trainable adapter parameters, compared with about 10 million for a rank-8, 16-adapter LoRA-Ensemble, corresponding to roughly 69% fewer trainable parameters. These results show that useful predictive diversity can be obtained from a small number of shared adapters.

AI.tldr: EulerLoRA 是一种随机化低秩适配（LoRA）扩展方法，通过沿共享低秩适配器的秩一组件采样结构化变体来生成多个预测轨迹，在保持确定性 LoRA 变换期望不变的同时提供预测不确定性估计。实验表明，在 CIFAR-10/100、HAM10000 和 SVHN 上，EulerLoRA 相比强 LoRA-Ensemble 基线实现了相当或更优的性能，且参数量减少约 69%。
AI.motivation: 标准 LoRA 只能生成单一确定性模型，无法直接支持预测不确定性估计，而这对许多实际应用（如医学影像诊断）至关重要。虽然可以通过 LoRA-Ensemble 获得不确定性，但这种方式需要大量适配器，参数量开销大。因此需要一种既能保持 LoRA 参数高效性、又能提供不确定性估计的方法。
AI.method: EulerLoRA 在共享低秩适配器的秩一组件上采样结构化变体，生成多条预测轨迹。其核心思想是：通过多个随机采样路径实现多样性，同时保证在期望意义上保留确定性 LoRA 的变换行为，从而兼顾确定性与随机性。
AI.result: 在视觉 Transformer 上，EulerLoRA 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 HAM10000 上取得与强 LoRA-Ensemble 基线相当或更优的性能，并在 SVHN 上表现良好的 OOD 检测能力。使用两个秩为 20 的适配器时仅需约 300 万可训练参数，而秩为 8、含 16 个适配器的 LoRA-Ensemble 需要约 1000 万参数，参数量减少约 69%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，仅使用少量共享适配器即可获得具有实用价值的预测多样性，EulerLoRA 在维持性能的同时大幅降低了参数量，为低秩适配在不确定性估计方面的应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: InstancePin: Instance-Addressable Layout-to-Image Diffusion via Coordinate Pinning
summary: Layout-to-image diffusion models have achieved impressive semantic controllability by conditioning generation on category-level segmentation maps. However, such category-aligned control is not necessarily instance-addressable: multiple nearby objects from the same category are often treated as a shared semantic region, leading to ambiguous boundaries, averaged appearances, and feature confusion among instances. This limitation is particularly evident in urban scene synthesis, where small and crowded pedestrians or vehicles require fine-grained instance separation while preserving global scene consistency. In this paper, we propose InstancePin, an instance-addressable layout-to-image diffusion framework that pins each object instance with an explicit coordinate anchor. Instead of directly injecting instance masks into the pretrained backbone, InstancePin introduces an independent instance-aware adapter to preserve the category-level generation prior while learning instance-specific spatial control. For each instance, its center coordinate is encoded with Fourier features and projected into a coordinate token, which serves as a spatial anchor queried by latent image features through coordinate pinning attention. To make these anchors spatially meaningful, we further supervise the coordinate attention maps with instance regions, encouraging each coordinate token to activate its corresponding object area. Finally, an instance-mask guided fusion module routes pretrained backbone features to non-instance regions and adapter features to instance regions, enabling local instance refinement without sacrificing global semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments on Cityscapes demonstrate that InstancePin mitigates instance entanglement in dense layouts and improves both image fidelity and semantic consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InstancePin，一个实例可寻址的布局到图像扩散框架。通过引入独立于预训练骨干的实例感知适配器，利用坐标锚点和"坐标固定注意力"机制对每个实例进行显式空间约束，并通过实例掩码引导的融合模块在保持全局语义一致性的同时实现局部实例细化，有效解决密集城市场景中同类对象实例纠缠的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有布局到图像扩散模型虽然能通过类别级分割图实现语义可控生成，但缺乏实例级可寻址性：同类别的多个邻近对象常被当作共享语义区域处理，导致边界模糊、外观平均化和特征混淆。这一问题在城市场景合成中尤为突出，因为行人和车辆等小而密集的实例需要细粒度分离，同时保持全局场景一致性。
AI.method: InstancePin包含三个核心组件：(1) 实例感知适配器：独立于预训练骨干网络，避免破坏类别级生成先验；对每个实例的中心坐标进行Fourier特征编码并投影为坐标token作为空间锚点；(2) 坐标固定注意力机制：潜在图像特征查询坐标token，并通过监督坐标注意力图与实例区域对齐，使每个token激活对应的对象区域；(3) 实例掩码引导融合模块：将预训练骨干特征路由到非实例区域、适配器特征路由到实例区域，实现局部实例细化而不损失全局语义保真度。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes数据集上的大量实验表明，InstancePin有效缓解了密集布局中的实例纠缠问题，同时提升了图像保真度和语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过坐标锚点和实例感知适配器的设计，InstancePin为布局到图像生成提供了实例级别的可控性，在保持类别级生成能力的同时实现了细粒度实例分离，为密集场景的图像合成提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案。

title: When Words Divide: Diachronic Ideological Polarization in Political Discourse on Social Media
summary: Political polarization has become a defining feature of online discourse, yet its long-term evolution remains poorly understood. We present a longitudinal analysis of ideological polarization in Reddit discussions by measuring semantic differences in the language used by opposing political communities. We construct temporally aligned community-specific word embeddings and quantify ideological polarization as the semantic divergence of political concepts over time. Our analysis shows that ideological polarization has increased substantially during the study period, both at the concept- and topic-level. Unlike prior computational work, which has largely focused on cross-sectional analyses or affective dimensions of polarization at a single point at time, our approach captures the evolution of ideological differences in semantic framing. The proposed framework provides a scalable method for studying the temporal dynamics of ideological polarization in large-scale social media discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文对Reddit讨论进行了纵向分析，通过构建时间对齐的社区特定词嵌入，量化政治概念语义分歧的演变趋势，发现研究期间意识形态极化在概念和主题层面均显著增加。
AI.motivation: 政治极化已成为在线话语的显著特征，但其长期演变机制仍未被充分理解。现有计算研究大多局限于横截面分析或单一时间点上的情感维度极化，无法捕捉意识形态差异如何随时间演化。
AI.method: 构建时间对齐的社区特定词嵌入，将意识形态极化量化为政治概念随时间推移的语义分歧程度，同时从概念层面和主题层面进行分析。
AI.result: 研究期间意识形态极化的语义分歧在概念层面和主题层面均显著增加。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种可扩展的方法，用于研究大规模社交媒体话语中意识形态极化的时间动态，为理解极化的长期演变提供了新的分析框架。

title: CADIR: A Cross-Backend Editable Intermediate Representation for Agentic CAD Generation
summary: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.

AI.tldr: CADIR是一种面向智能体的可执行中间表示，用于CAD生成和跨后端编辑。基于OCCT几何内核，通过显式建模操作和构造图记录建模历史，并利用几何签名匹配实现跨CAD系统（FreeCAD、SolidWorks、Fusion 360）的原生可编辑特征重建。实验证明其在几何保真度、执行可靠性及跨后端编辑方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD生成方法存在两大问题：一是将建模过程表示为后端特定的顺序脚本且含隐式依赖，二是表示为静态几何。这两者都难以同时保留构建历史、稳定的拓扑引用和特征级可编辑性，尤其是在跨CAD系统环境下。
AI.method: 1) CADIR表示：基于OCCT几何内核（通过OCP），提供显式、组合式的建模操作和细粒度执行诊断；2) 构造图：在执行过程中记录建模操作、参数依赖、约束和拓扑选择；3) 几何签名匹配：识别参数变化和后端差异下对应的边和面，使适配器能在FreeCAD、SolidWorks和Fusion 360中重建原生可编辑特征历史；4) 构造图检索：支持文本和图像查询的全图及子图检索，供智能体利用完整模型和建模子结构。
AI.result: 实验表明：CADIR在几何保真度和执行可靠性上优于现有CAD表示方法；构造图检索进一步提升模型生成质量；跨后端编辑能在多个CAD环境中实现可靠的模型重建和重建后编辑。
AI.conclusion: CADIR通过引入可执行中间表示、构造图和几何签名匹配机制，有效解决了CAD生成中构建历史保留与跨系统可编辑性的核心难题，为智能体驱动的CAD设计提供了更可靠的表示基础。

title: Differentiable Lifting for Topological Neural Networks
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026 (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=eC89CbINIw). 20 pages, 4 figures
summary: Topological neural networks (TNNs) enable leveraging high-order structures on graphs (e.g., cycles and cliques) to boost the expressive power of message-passing neural networks. In turn, however, these structures are typically identified a priori through an unsupervised graph lifting operation. Notwithstanding, this choice is crucial and may have a drastic impact on a TNN's performance on downstream tasks. To circumvent this issue, we propose $\partial$lift (DiffLift), a general framework for learning graph liftings to hypergraphs and cellular- and simplicial complexes in an end-to-end fashion. In particular, our approach leverages learned vertex-level latent representations to identify and parameterize distributions over candidate higher-order cells for inclusion. This results in a scalable model which can be readily integrated into any TNN. Our experiments show that $\partial$lift outperforms existing lifting methods on multiple benchmarks for graph and node classification across different TNN architectures. Notably, our approach leads to gains of up to 45% over static liftings, including both connectivity- and feature-based ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffLift（∂lift），一个端到端学习图提升（graph lifting）的通用框架，将图提升到超图、胞腔复形和单纯复形，取代传统预先无监督确定的静态提升方法，提升拓扑神经网络（TNNs）的表达能力与下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 拓扑神经网络利用图上的高阶结构（如环、团）来增强消息传递神经网络的表达能力。然而，这些高阶结构通常是通过无监督的图提升操作预先确定的，这一选择性选择对TNN在下游任务中的性能影响巨大，但目前缺乏可学习、端到端的提升方法。
AI.method: DiffLift利用学习到的顶点级潜在表示来识别和参数化候选高阶胞腔的分布，从而在端到端框架中学习图提升操作。该方法具有可扩展性，可以灵活集成到任何TNN架构中。
AI.result: 在多个人工智能基准测试（图分类和节点分类）上，DiffLift在多种TNN架构中均优于现有提升方法。与静态提升（包括基于连接和基于特征的方法）相比，性能提升最高可达45%。
AI.conclusion: DiffLift验证了学习式端到端图提升的可行性与优越性，为TNN中的高阶结构选择提供了可学习的新范式，显著改善了现有静态提升方法的局限性。

title: Diagnosing Under-Development of Irreversible Processes in Video Generation
summary: Many physical attributes are \emph{irreversible}: ice melts but does not re-freeze, paper chars but does not un-burn. Do video generators respect this? We show the question is hard to measure, and that what can be measured reliably is \emph{development} rather than reversal. Metrics of local reversal are null-degenerate: a per-clip violation rate scores $0.50$ on pure noise, and a variance-normalized reversal residual sits at its noise ceiling. What survives null-testing is a two-part protocol: progress (a directional attribute correlation) and a stasis rate. Under this protocol, generated video separates cleanly from real footage, and the gap is human-validated. Across seven text-to-video models, real reference footage advances ($ρ{=}{+}0.40$, $35\%$ static) while every generator shows near-zero progress and $92$--$100\%$ stasis; nine annotators rate real footage far above generated ($2.75$ vs.\ $0.99$ on a $0$--$4$ scale). The reliable finding is \emph{under-development}: generators barely advance irreversible attributes rather than reversing them. As a complementary mechanism, we show that post-hoc readout guidance is gameable, whereas enforcing monotonicity by construction in a disentangled attribute latent removes the gameable readout, validated in controlled and semi-synthetic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视频生成模型是否尊重物理属性不可逆性（如冰融化后不会重新冻结）。作者发现局部逆转度量存在零退化问题，提出了一种两部分的可靠协议：进展（方向性属性相关性）和稳态率。实验表明视频生成器在不可逆属性上表现出"发展不足"而非"逆转"，并证明了事后读取引导可以被欺骗，而通过在解耦属性潜空间中构造单调性可以消除这种欺骗。
AI.motivation: 物理世界的许多属性是不可逆的（冰融化不重冻、纸燃烧不复原），但视频生成模型是否尊重这一物理规律尚未被系统研究。作者指出直接测量"逆转"在方法论上存在困难（度量零退化和噪声天花板问题），因此需要开发可靠的度量协议来评估生成视频对不可逆属性的遵从程度。
AI.method: 作者提出两部分的可靠评估协议：(1) 进展度量——方向性属性相关性（ρ）；(2) 稳态率度量。排除了局部逆转度量（因为其存在零退化问题）。此外，作者展示了事后读取引导的可欺骗性，并提出在解耦属性潜空间中通过构造强制单调性来解决这一问题，在受控和半合成设置中进行了验证。
AI.result: 在七个文生视频模型上，真实参考视频的进展ρ=+0.40且35%静态，而所有生成器的进展接近零、92%-100%稳态；九名标注者对真实视频评分2.75（0-4量表）远高于生成视频的0.99。核心发现是生成器对不可逆属性表现出"发展不足"而非"逆转"。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成模型在不可逆物理属性上的可靠问题是"发展不足"（几乎不推进这些属性），而非"逆转"（反向演化）。作者提供了一个通过构造强制单调性（在解耦属性潜空间中）来消除可欺骗读取的补充机制，为未来模型改进提供了方向。

title: ShiJianBench: From Dialogue to Decision for Long-Horizon Evaluation of Investment Advisors
summary: Conversational investment advisors influence not only what users know, but also how they make subsequent decisions as market conditions evolve. Existing evaluations primarily assess response quality or observed outcomes, leaving the long-horizon pathway from advisor language to investor behavior difficult to audit. We introduce ShiJianBench, an offline framework for evaluating conversational investment advisors through matched investor trajectories under fixed historical market feedback. At its core is a multi-agent investor simulator with explicit evolving state variables, motive-driven deliberation, long-term memory, and dialogue-grounded updates. The simulator is calibrated against aggregate behavioral patterns from 7,199 real users, and advisor policies are evaluated using separate investor-side, service-side, and content-side metrics under a hard compliance gate. Experiments on Chinese fund-market traces from 2021 to 2026 identify a stable leading group of LLM advisors that combines substantially stronger personalized content with competitive investor-side trajectory outcomes. These results reveal a systematic distinction between producing a high-quality response and delivering an effective long-horizon intervention, motivating trajectory-aware evaluation of conversational advisors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShiJianBench，一个用于评估对话式投资顾问的离线框架，通过匹配投资者轨迹在固定历史市场反馈下评估顾问效果。核心是一个多智能体投资者模拟器，具备显式演化状态变量、动机驱动推理、长期记忆和对话驱动更新，并基于7,199名真实用户的行为模式进行校准。实验使用2021-2026年中国基金市场数据，识别出稳定的领先LLM顾问群体，揭示高质量回复与有效长期干预之间存在系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式投资顾问评估主要关注回复质量或即时观察结果，无法审计从顾问语言到投资者行为的长期影响路径。随着市场条件变化，顾问如何影响用户的后续决策难以被有效评估，缺乏覆盖长期时间跨度的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建ShiJianBench离线评估框架：1) 多智能体投资者模拟器，包含显式演化状态变量、动机驱动的推理过程、长期记忆和对话驱动的状态更新；2) 基于7,199名真实用户的聚合行为模式进行校准；3) 在硬性合规门槛下，使用投资者侧、服务侧和内容侧三类指标评估顾问策略；4) 使用2021-2026年中国基金市场真实数据进行实验。
AI.result: 实验识别出一个稳定的领先LLM顾问群体，这些顾问在个性化内容方面表现显著更强，同时在投资者侧轨迹结果上具有竞争力。研究揭示了高质量回复生成与有效长期干预之间存在系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了轨迹感知的评估方法对对话式顾问的重要性，表明生成高质量内容不等同于在长期时间范围内对投资者行为产生有效影响，呼吁采用考虑长期轨迹的评估框架。

title: Modeling Social Dynamics with an LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) Model
summary: Social dynamics encode the process in which individual network and discourse interactions aggregate into collective influence, narrative dominance and coordinate behavior. This paper uses the the GhostField architecture, a hybrid LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) model as a social simulation framework to build the AuraSight scenario. In the AuraSight scenario, 314,244 heterogeneous cyber social agents and human actors exchange 529,327 messages over 30 days surrounding a fictional international song-writing contest. We methodologically examine emergent social dynamics across four analytical layers: ego-network topology, semantic network evolution, coordination dynamics and influence dynamics. Our results show how generated social simulations do also produce social dynamics, and how the dynamics of coordination and influence emerge not from individual agents but from the recursive interaction between network topology and narrative exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文使用GhostField架构（一种混合LLM增强的智能体网络动力学模型）构建AuraSight模拟场景，在30天内模拟了314,244个异构网络社交智能体与人类参与者之间529,327条消息的交互，围绕一个虚构国际歌曲创作竞赛展开，并从四个分析层面（自我中心网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动力学和影响力动力学）检验涌现的社会动态。
AI.motivation: 理解社会动态如何从个体互动中涌现为集体影响力、叙事主导和协调行为，是一个重要的研究问题。本文旨在证明生成式社会模拟（generated social simulations）能够产生真实的社会动态，并阐明协调与影响力的涌现机制。
AI.method: 采用GhostField架构，这是一个混合LLM增强的智能体基网络动力学（LAND）模型，作为社会模拟框架构建AuraSight场景。场景包含314,244个异构智能体和人类参与者，在30天内交换529,327条消息，围绕虚构国际歌曲创作竞赛展开。分析横跨四个层面：自我中心网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动力学和影响力动力学。
AI.result: 结果显示生成式社会模拟确实能够产生社会动态，且协调与影响力的动态并非源自个体智能体本身，而是源自网络拓扑与叙事交换之间的递归交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 社会模拟中的集体动态是网络结构与叙事内容交互涌现的产物，这为理解复杂社会现象提供了新的模拟方法论框架。

title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Traffic Congestion Prediction: Unveiling the Impact of Different COVID-19 Periods
summary: Traffic congestion prediction is essential for congestion mitigation, but the COVID-19 pandemic and related control measures altered travel behavior and increased prediction complexity. This study predicts congestion in Alameda County, California, during pre-lockdown, lockdown, and post-lockdown periods. Weather, seasonality, and COVID-19 variables are incorporated, and Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation is used to select important features and reduce overfitting. Support vector regression, multiple linear regression, recurrent neural networks, and long short-term memory networks are trained and optimized. Because LSTM is more sensitive to hyperparameter settings, an adaptive parameter selection approach is used, while SVR and RNN are manually tuned. Performance is evaluated using Normalized Root Mean Square Error. Bidirectional LSTM consistently performs best across all periods because it captures temporal dependence in both directions. Integrated Gradients is used to interpret Bi-LSTM predictions, and SHapley Additive exPlanations is applied to SVR. New COVID-19 cases have a mainly negative effect on congestion during lockdown and post-lockdown, likely due to greater risk awareness, voluntary travel reduction, and compliance with mobility restrictions. In the post-pandemic period, higher hospitalization reduces travel and congestion, while higher fuel prices do not prevent a shift toward private vehicles and therefore increase congestion.

AI.tldr: 本研究预测了美国阿拉米达县在封锁前、封锁期间和封锁后的交通拥堵情况，将天气、季节性和COVID-19变量纳入模型。使用递归特征消除与交叉验证（RFECV）进行特征选择，比较了支持向量回归、多元线性回归、循环神经网络和LSTM等模型，其中双向LSTM表现最佳。通过集成梯度和SHAP进行模型解释，发现新增病例对拥堵有负向影响，而油价上涨反而增加拥堵。
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情及其防控措施显著改变了人们的出行行为，使交通拥堵预测变得更加复杂。传统预测模型可能无法适应这种特殊时期的交通模式变化，因此需要开发能够整合疫情相关变量的预测方法。
AI.method: 融合天气、季节性和COVID-19变量；使用递归特征消除与交叉验证（RFECV）进行特征选择以减少过拟合；训练并优化支持向量回归（SVR）、多元线性回归（MLR）、循环神经网络（RNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）四种模型；采用自适应参数选择方法对LSTM调参，手动调优SVR和RNN；使用归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）评估性能；用集成梯度（IG）解释Bi-LSTM，用SHAP解释SVR。
AI.result: 双向LSTM在封锁前、封锁中和封锁后所有时期表现最佳，因其能捕获双向时间依赖性。新COVID-19病例在封锁中和封锁后对拥堵主要产生负面影响，归因于风险意识提高、自愿减少出行和遵守出行限制。疫情后期住院人数增加会降低出行和拥堵，而油价上涨并未阻止私家车出行增加，反而导致拥堵增加。
AI.conclusion: 在疫情背景下，双向LSTM是最有效的拥堵预测模型；疫情相关变量（如新增病例、住院人数）对交通行为有显著影响；研究结果对疫情及后疫情时期的交通管理和政策制定具有参考价值。

title: Where Does Generative Difficulty Reside? An Empirical Study of Target Representations
comment: TL;DR: Across pixels, SD-VAE, DINOv2, and MAE, we find that target representations are not interchangeable: they shift difficulty between contextual modeling, per-token denoising, and guidance, producing distinct optimization and diversity trade-offs
summary: The target representation defines the distribution an image generator must learn, yet it is often treated as an interchangeable interface. This assumption is particularly questionable for continuous masked generators, which combine contextual inference from visible tokens with conditional modeling of each missing token. We study raw pixels, SD-VAE latents and DINOv2 as well as MAE representation-autoencoder features within a unified masked autoregressive rectified-flow model. Under a shared ImageNet training budget, these spaces exhibit distinct optimization and inference regimes. DINOv2 converges fastest in both iterations and computation but benefits strongly from a wider local denoiser and direct context fusion. Pixels optimize substantially more slowly and require a different prediction, masking, and guidance configuration. MAE reconstructs images more faithfully and exhibits clear semantic clustering, yet produces generations substantially worse than DINOv2. The representations also respond differently to classifier-free guidance and occupy distinct precision-recall trade-offs. Together, our results show that compression, reconstruction fidelity, token dimensionality, and visible semantic clustering do not individually predict generative behavior. Instead, target representations redistribute difficulty across contextual modeling, per-token denoising, and inference-time distributional control.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了连续掩码生成器中不同目标表示（原始像素、SD-VAE潜变量、DINOv2与MAE特征）对生成行为的影响，发现这些表示在优化速度、推理配置、重建保真度和生成质量上表现出截然不同的特性，且单一因素无法预测生成性能。
AI.motivation: 生成模型中的目标表示通常被视为可互换的接口，但这一假设在连续掩码生成器中值得质疑——因为这类模型同时涉及可见token的上下文推理和缺失token的条件建模，不同表示可能在这些环节中产生根本性的差异。
AI.method: 在统一的掩码自回归整流流模型中，对原始像素、SD-VAE潜变量、DINOv2和MAE表示自编码器特征进行系统对比实验，在共享的ImageNet训练预算下分析其优化与推理行为差异。
AI.result: DINOv2收敛最快且需要更宽的局部去噪器和直接上下文融合；像素优化最慢且需要不同的预测、掩码和引导配置；MAE重建最忠实且语义聚类清晰但生成质量明显逊于DINOv2。不同表示对分类器自由引导的响应也不同，占据不同的精确率-召回率权衡空间。
AI.conclusion: 压缩率、重建保真度、token维度和可见语义聚类都不是生成行为的独立预测因子。目标表示实际上是在重新分配上下文建模、逐token去噪和推理时分布控制之间的难度。

title: Evaluating VLMs on Multimodal Aristotelian Persuasion Tasks
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance across various tasks. However, they have not yet been thoroughly evaluated on more complex tasks. The Persuasion Model, conceived by Aristotle, resembles a triangle shape, which highlights its inherent challenges related to personal biases. To assess the progress of VLMs on these complex tasks, we use the ImageArg datasets, focusing on the Logos, Ethos, and Pathos detection tasks. Our findings indicate that models from the Qwen family achieve improved F1 scores, with Qwen3 performing exceptionally well on the Logos and Pathos tasks, while Qwen2 exhibits competitive performance on the more complex Ethos detection task. We release the code to foster research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在复杂说服力检测任务（Logos、Ethos、Pathos）上的表现，使用ImageArg数据集。研究发现Qwen系列模型表现优异，其中Qwen3在Logos和Pathos任务上表现突出，Qwen2在更复杂的Ethos任务上具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: VLMs在多种任务上表现出色，但在更复杂的任务（如基于亚里士多德说服三角模型的偏置检测）上尚未被充分评估。作者希望通过ImageArg数据集评估VLMs在Logos、Ethos和Pathos检测上的进展。
AI.method: 使用ImageArg数据集，对VLMs进行Logos（逻辑）、Ethos（伦理/信誉）和Pathos（情感）三种说服力检测任务的评估，重点分析Qwen系列模型的表现。
AI.result: Qwen系列模型在F1分数上表现更优。Qwen3在Logos和Pathos任务上表现卓越，Qwen2在更复杂的Ethos检测任务上表现出竞争力。
AI.conclusion: VLMs在复杂说服力检测任务上取得了一定进展，Qwen系列模型表现突出。作者公开了代码以促进该方向的进一步研究。

title: PMMC: Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation for Long-Term LVLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LVLM agents to maintain consistency and integrate information across extended multimodal interactions. Existing agent memory systems, however, often reduce visual experiences into textual summaries or rely on static retrieve-then-reason pipelines, which are inefficient at query time and brittle when questions require image-text binding, temporal updates, or visual details. We propose Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation, a framework that shifts part of the memory reasoning process from query time to memory consolidation time. Given accumulated multimodal interactions, a Questioner predicts future question candidates, a Planner compiles question-conditioned multimodal memory programs, and a Doubter verifies whether the planned evidence path can support the predicted answer. The verified question-program pairs form a structured question bank for efficient query-time routing and evidence retrieval. Experiments on multimodal long-term memory benchmarks show that our method improves answer quality and visual evidence recall while reducing query-time token and latency costs. Extensive ablations analyze the effects of self-feedback, dynamic planning, raw-image access, and question bank coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出前瞻性多模态记忆编译（Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation）框架，将记忆推理过程从查询时转移到记忆整合时，通过Questioner预测未来问题、Planner编译问题条件化记忆程序、Doubter验证证据路径，构建结构化问题库以实现高效查询路由和证据检索，在提升答案质量和视觉证据召回的同时降低查询时token和延迟成本。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM智能体记忆系统存在两个核心缺陷：一是将视觉经验降级为文本摘要，丢失视觉细节；二是依赖静态的"检索-推理"流水线，在查询时效率低且脆弱，难以处理需要图像-文本绑定、时间更新或视觉细节的问题。
AI.method: 框架包含三个关键组件：Questioner预测未来可能的问题候选；Planner编译问题条件化的多模态记忆程序；Doubter验证规划的证据路径能否支持预测答案。经过验证的问题-程序对形成结构化问题库，用于查询时的高效路由和证据检索。该框架将记忆推理从查询时转移到记忆整合阶段执行。
AI.result: 在多模态长时记忆基准上的实验表明，该方法在提升答案质量和视觉证据召回的同时，显著降低了查询时的token消耗和延迟成本。消融实验分析了自我反馈、动态规划、原始图像访问和问题库覆盖率等因素的影响。
AI.conclusion: 前瞻性记忆编译通过将记忆推理前置到整合阶段，实现了查询时的高效和推理时的鲁棒性之间的良好平衡，为LVLM智能体的长时多模态记忆管理提供了一种新范式。

title: SAFE-Merge: Data-Free Continual Model Merging with General Knowledge Preservation
summary: Data-free continual model merging must incorporate a stream of specialized models while retaining both pretrained general knowledge and previously acquired tasks, without access to task data. Existing methods mainly merge task updates by suppressing interference among downstream tasks; while this protects previously acquired tasks, it overlooks the safety of the pretrained knowledge itself, whose erosion degrades generalization to held-out distributions and weakens the foundation for future task acquisition. We propose SAFE-Merge, a simple data-free continual-merging framework that first decides which parameter updates are safe to retain, and then recovers the task information lost through masking. Specifically, to ensure safety, risk-aware sparse masking selects parameter updates that carry task-specific information while posing low risk to general knowledge. Masked low-rank recovery then compensates for the lost task information using only the same retained parameter updates, while leaving all masked-out parameters strictly unchanged. Finally, the combined update is fused into the backbone, incurring no additional inference cost. Across vision and language benchmarks, SAFE-Merge consistently achieves the best H-score. On longer CLIP task sequences, it substantially improves H-score over NUFILT while also achieving the highest accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFE-Merge，一种无需数据的持续模型合并框架，通过风险感知稀疏掩码选择安全的参数更新来保护预训练知识，并通过掩码低秩恢复补偿丢失的任务信息，在视觉和语言基准上均取得最佳H-score。
AI.motivation: 现有持续模型合并方法主要聚焦于抑制下游任务间的干扰以保护已获取的任务，但忽视了预训练知识本身的安全性问题。预训练知识的侵蚀会降低模型对分布外数据的泛化能力，并削弱未来任务获取的基础。
AI.method: SAFE-Merge由两部分组成：(1) 风险感知稀疏掩码，选择携带任务特定信息但对通用知识低风险的参数更新；(2) 掩码低秩恢复，仅使用保留的参数更新来补偿掩码造成的任务信息损失，同时严格保持被掩码参数不变。最后将合并更新融合到骨干网络中，无额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在视觉和语言基准上，SAFE-Merge一致取得最佳H-score。在更长的CLIP任务序列上，相比NUFILT显著提升H-score，同时达到最高准确率。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-Merge通过显式保护预训练知识安全性的同时恢复任务信息，实现了无需数据、无推理开销的持续模型合并，验证了"安全优先、恢复补偿"策略的有效性。

title: WiFuse: An Attention Mechanism for Human Activity Recognition using Fused CSI Amplitude and Delay-Doppler Channel Features
summary: Recently, Wi-Fi sensing has played a significant role in Human Activity Recognition (HAR), as it enables the detection of various activities using only Wi-Fi signals, ensuring privacy and remaining non-intrusive for the user. However, environmental characteristics such as reflective surfaces, hardware offsets, and other physical impairments affect recognition by the neural network, subsequently causing errors and significantly reducing model accuracy. To overcome this problem we present the WiFuse framework, a dual-stream Channel State Information (CSI) framework for human activity recognition (HAR) that pairs denoised time-domain amplitude variations with 2D-FFT-derived Delay-Doppler motion representations computed from the sanitized channel phase. The fused representation feeds a hybrid ResNet-Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) neural architecture augmented with channel and spatio-temporal attention, where the ResNet extracts spatial-spectral features and the TCN models long-range temporal dependencies; a decoupled two-stage transfer learning strategy is employed to improve optimization stability and feature reuse. We conduct extensive experiments on two public datasets, including comparisons against state-of-the-art methods and alternative hybrid architectures, ablation studies, and cross-dataset and domain-adaptation evaluations. The proposed framework reaches an overall accuracy of up to 95.28% across the four environments of the XRF55 dataset and up to 98.20% on the multi-user Wi-MIR dataset. Overall, the results indicate that combining amplitude and Delay-Doppler representations within a dual-stream strategy, enhanced by transfer learning, improves recognition performance under conditions that typically degrade deep neural networks, such as class overlap, multipath propagation, noise, and interference.

AI.tldr: WiFuse是一个双流CSI框架，结合去噪时域幅度变化和2D-FFT延迟-多普勒运动表示，通过混合ResNet-TCN架构（含通道和时空注意力）及两阶段迁移学习策略，在XRF55和Wi-MIR数据集上分别达到95.28%和98.20%的准确率，有效解决了Wi-Fi感知中环境因素导致的识别精度下降问题。
AI.motivation: Wi-Fi感知在人体活动识别中具有隐私保护和非侵入性优势，但环境因素（如反射表面、硬件偏移等物理损伤）会干扰神经网络识别，导致显著精度下降。作者旨在解决这些环境退化条件下深度神经网络性能降低的问题。
AI.method: 提出WiFuse双流CSI框架：(1) 一对流使用去噪后的时域幅度变化；(2) 另一流使用从净化通道相位计算得到的2D-FFT延迟-多普勒运动表示。融合表征输入混合ResNet-TCN架构，其中ResNet提取空间-频谱特征，TCN建模长时程时间依赖，并加入通道和时空注意力机制；采用解耦的两阶段迁移学习策略以提升优化稳定性和特征复用。
AI.result: 在XRF55数据集的四个环境中达到最高95.28%的整体准确率，在多用户Wi-MIR数据集上达到98.20%。与最先进方法及替代混合架构相比表现更优，并通过消融研究、跨数据集和域适应评估验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双流策略结合幅度和延迟-多普勒表示，辅以迁移学习，在类别重叠、多径传播、噪声和干扰等通常使深度神经网络性能退化的条件下，显著提升了Wi-Fi人体活动识别的性能。

title: DeltaFlow: Noise-Adaptive Bidirectional Gated Delta Networks for Embedded Language Flows
summary: Embedded Language Flows (ELF) rely primarily on full non-causal attention for iterative denoising, repeatedly incurring quadratic sequence-mixing cost at each sampling step. Gated Delta Networks (GDNs) provide an efficient recurrent alternative, but their standard causal formulation cannot directly capture the bidirectional context required by ELF. We introduce DeltaFlow, a noise-adaptive bidirectional GDN backbone for continuous language denoising. We study two variants: DeltaFlow-A, which alternates scan directions across layers, and DeltaFlow-P, which performs parallel forward and backward scans within each layer. We further introduce noise-adaptive memory control and scheduled Temporal State Consistency (TSC) to stabilize hidden representations across nearby noise levels. On OpenWebText, using a 32-step stochastic differential equation sampler, DeltaFlow-P reduces generated perplexity from 24.218 for the full-attention ELF baseline to 21.228 while maintaining comparable unigram entropy, with 36B training-token exposure compared with 45B for the baseline. In a denoiser-only benchmark, DeltaFlow-P achieves a 2.72x throughput speedup over the full-attention baseline at a sequence length of 16k. These results show that DeltaFlow is a promising alternative to dense attention for efficient continuous language denoising.

AI.tldr: DeltaFlow 是一个基于 Gated Delta Networks（GDN）的噪声自适应双向骨干网络，用于连续语言去噪（ELF）任务。它通过交替或并行双向扫描替代全非因果注意力，并结合噪声自适应记忆控制和时序状态一致性（TSC）机制，在降低计算成本的同时提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的Embedded Language Flows（ELF）依赖全非因果注意力进行迭代去噪，每次采样步骤都产生二次方的序列混合计算成本，效率低下。虽然Gated Delta Networks（GDNs）提供了高效的循环替代方案，但其标准因果形式无法捕捉ELF所需的双向上下文信息。
AI.method: 作者提出DeltaFlow，包含两种变体：DeltaFlow-A（跨层交替扫描方向）和DeltaFlow-P（层内并行前向和后向扫描）。此外，引入噪声自适应记忆控制和调度时序状态一致性（TSC）机制来稳定相邻噪声级别下的隐藏表示。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText数据集上，使用32步随机微分方程采样器，DeltaFlow-P将生成困惑度从全注意力ELF基线的24.218降至21.228，同时保持可比的单字熵，且仅需36B训练token（基线为45B）。在去噪器基准测试中，DeltaFlow-P在序列长度16k时实现2.72倍吞吐量加速。
AI.conclusion: DeltaFlow展示了作为稠密注意力在高效连续语言去噪任务中的有力替代方案，在提升生成质量的同时显著降低了计算开销。

title: TrajWiki: Source-Grounded Memory Trajectories for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents
summary: Large language model agents have shown strong capabilities in generating coherent and contextually appropriate responses, yet robust long-horizon dialogue remains limited by the lack of external memory that is traceable, updatable, and diagnostically transparent. Existing memory-augmented agents often store memories as isolated records or overwritable states, making it difficult to preserve how information originates, evolves, conflicts, or becomes obsolete over time. We propose TrajWiki, a trajectory-based memory framework for long-horizon conversational agents. Instead of treating memory as static entries, TrajWiki represents each memory as a source-grounded evolution trajectory, maintained through immutable episodic snapshots and claim-level operations such as ADD, REVISE, and DEPRECATE. To reduce fragmentation and retrieval cost, TrajWiki further introduces Memory Wiki, a persistent intermediate layer that incrementally compiles dialogue history into structured and interlinked wiki pages capturing salient entities, events, quantities, topics, and conflicts. At inference time, queries are routed hierarchically from relevant wiki pages to linked memory trajectories, then to corresponding snapshots and source messages for evidence-grounded answer synthesis. Experiments on LoCoMo and MedMT show that TrajWiki improves long-horizon dialogue performance across both open-source and closed-source LLM backbones, while providing greater interpretability and diagnostic visibility into memory evolution, retrieval failures, and answer generation.

AI.tldr: TrajWiki是一个基于轨迹的记忆框架，用于长对话智能体。它将每条记忆表示为源可追溯的演化轨迹，通过不可变的快照和ADD/REVISE/DEPRECATE操作维护，并引入Memory Wiki中间层将对话历史增量编译为结构化的互链wiki页面。在推理时，查询从wiki页面分层路由到记忆轨迹和源消息，以实现基于证据的答案生成。实验在LoCoMo和MedMT上优于基线，并提供了更好的可解释性和诊断可见性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型智能体在长对话场景中缺乏可追溯、可更新且诊断透明的外部记忆。已有记忆增强智能体通常将记忆存为孤立记录或可覆写状态，难以保留信息的来源、演化、冲突或过时过程，这限制了可靠的长期对话能力。
AI.method: TrajWiki将每个记忆表示为源可追溯的演化轨迹，通过不可变的片段快照和ADD、REVISE、DEPRECATE等声明级操作来维护。此外引入Memory Wiki作为持久中间层，将对话历史增量编译为捕获实体、事件、数量、主题和冲突的结构化互链wiki页面。推理时，查询从相关wiki页面分层路由到链接的记忆轨迹，再路由到快照和源消息，实现基于证据的答案合成。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和MedMT基准上的实验表明，TrajWiki在开源和闭源LLM骨干上均提升了长对话性能，同时提供了更强的可解释性和诊断可见性，包括记忆演化、检索失败和答案生成的洞察。
AI.conclusion: TrajWiki通过将记忆建模为可追溯的演化轨迹并配合结构化wiki中间层，有效解决了长对话中记忆的溯源、更新和诊断问题，在性能和可解释性方面均取得了显著改进。

title: ReBRAC-v2: The Return of the King
summary: Recent offline reinforcement learning methods increasingly rely on expressive generative policies and specialized value-guidance mechanisms. We ask whether comparable progress can instead come from systematically modernizing a conventional behavior-regularized actor-critic while preserving its algorithmic simplicity. We introduce ReBRAC-v2, which directly trains an exact-likelihood normalizing flow as the RL actor, combines likelihood, MSE, and MAE behavior regularization, and integrates a classification-based residual critic, staged optimization, and multi-sample test-time action selection. Rather than tuning this recipe separately for every task, we develop a single shared configuration via roughly 600 Bayesian proposals on six challenging OGBench tasks, freeze all structural and optimization choices, and adapt only two behavior-regularization coefficients over a 16-point grid. Across ten common state-based OGBench categories, ReBRAC-v2 averages 74.8 compared to 52.3 for the next-best aggregate result and ranks first in eight categories. The same recipe, without structural changes, obtains the strongest averages in our comparisons on D4RL AntMaze (90.2) and Adroit (33.6). Fixed-recipe ablations show the largest sensitivity to the selected mixed cloning objective, staged training, sufficient flow capacity, and multi-sample inference, while showing that several smaller choices depend on the values of other hyperparameters. These results show that disciplined, transferable engineering can achieve state-of-the-art aggregate performance without abandoning a minimalist offline RL foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReBRAC-v2，通过系统性地现代化传统行为正则化的actor-critic方法（而非依赖生成式策略或价值引导），在保持算法简洁性的同时实现SOTA聚合性能。该方法直接训练精确似然归一化流作为RL actor，结合似然、MSE和MAE行为正则化，并集成基于分类的残差critic、分阶段优化和多样本测试时动作选择。通过约600个贝叶斯提议在六个OGBench任务上开发单一共享配置，仅调整两个行为正则化系数，在OGBench十类任务中平均74.8（次优52.3），D4RL AntMaze上90.2，Adroit上33.6。
AI.motivation: 近年来离线强化学习方法越来越依赖表达性生成策略和专门的价值引导机制，作者质疑是否可以通过系统性地现代化传统行为正则化的actor-critic方法来实现同等进步，同时保持算法的算法简洁性。
AI.method: ReBRAC-v2包含以下关键组件：(1) 直接训练精确似然归一化流作为RL actor；(2) 组合似然、MSE和MAE三种行为正则化；(3) 集成基于分类的残差critic；(4) 分阶段优化；(5) 多样本测试时动作选择。通过约600个贝叶斯提议在六个OGBench任务上确定单一共享配置，冻结所有结构和优化选择，仅通过16点网格调整两个行为正则化系数。
AI.result: 在OGBench十个常见基于状态的任务类别中，ReBRAC-v2平均得分74.8，远高于次优聚合结果52.3，并在八个类别中排名第一。同一配方无需结构修改即可在D4RL AntMaze达到90.2、Adroit达到33.6的最强平均值。消融实验显示对混合克隆目标、分阶段训练、足够的流容量和多采样推理最敏感。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，纪律严明、可迁移的工程实践可以在不放弃极简离线RL基础的前提下实现SOTA聚合性能。这证明了传统行为正则化actor-critic方法经过系统现代化后仍具有强大的竞争力和实用价值。

title: PixelSR: Efficient Screen Content Super-Resolution via Pixel Classification
summary: Screen content images are generally composed of texts and graphics. Compared to natural images, these man-made images contain a large quantity of sharp but repetitive structures. However, existing works in screen content super-resolution underutilize the special characteristics of screen content, leaving a large room to improve model performance and speed up. In this paper, we propose PixelSR, a simple yet effective method to improve super-resolution performance but with faster inference speed. To improve model performance, we classify pixels via pixel binning to compute content attention in the training phase. Specifically, after binning pixels into content-dependent groups, content attention is aggregated from pixel features within each group to introduce a content-dependent and non-local receptive field for every pixel. In the testing phase, we utilize the properties of self-repetitiveness and redundancy in screen content to speed up inference without the loss of model performance. We divide targeted high-resolution pixels into three types, which are unique pixels, repeated pixels, and background pixels for each test image. We conduct conventional network processing on unique pixels and cache their predictions in the on-the-fly lookup table. For repeated pixels which have appeared in unique pixels, we directly retrieve prediction results from the lookup table without network processing. For background pixels, we use the nearest neighbor algorithm to generate high-resolution pixels. The on-the-fly lookup table is cleaned and repeats the procedure above for the next test image. Experiments show our PixelSR achieves state-of-the-art performance with shorter inference time in screen content super-resolution.
