title: The Role of Disfluencies in Speech Translation
summary: Current speech translation systems, including SpeechLLMs, are trained on cleaned text and tend to strip disfluencies like filled pauses and false starts rather than translate them. We show this comes at a cost: disfluencies carry meaning that gets lost when speech is cleaned up. To study this systematically, we introduce Uh-Mazing, a benchmark of human-translated, disfluency-annotated Switchboard speech covering English into eight target languages. Across these languages and several architectures, we find that false starts and self-repairs, not filled pauses or discourse markers, drive most of the translation-quality loss, and that models which fail to preserve a disfluency tend to omit it rather than mistranslate it. We show inference-time decoding can mitigate this without retraining, and release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 本文发现当前语音翻译系统（包括SpeechLLMs）在训练时使用清洗过的文本，会去除口语不流利现象（如填充词、假开头）而非翻译它们。作者引入Uh-Mazing基准（覆盖英语到8种目标语言的人工翻译、标注不流利现象的Switchboard语音），发现假开头和自我修复（而非填充词或话语标记）是造成翻译质量损失的主因，且模型倾向省略而非误译不流利现象。推理时解码可缓解此问题，无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 口语不流利现象（如"uh"、"um"、假开口和自修复）携带真实语义信息，但当前语音翻译系统因为训练于清洗文本而会剥离这些现象，导致信息丢失。作者希望系统性地研究这一问题及其影响。
AI.method: 1) 构建Uh-Mazing基准：基于Switchboard语料，包含人工翻译并标注不流利现象的英语到8种目标语言数据。2) 使用多种架构进行跨语言实验，分析不同不流利类型对翻译质量的影响。3) 提出推理时解码策略来缓解不流利现象丢失的问题，无需重新训练模型。
AI.result: 发现假开头和自我修复（而非填充词或话语标记）是翻译质量损失的主要驱动因素；模型失败时倾向于省略不流利现象而非误译它们；推理时解码可以在不重新训练的情况下有效缓解该问题。
AI.conclusion: 语音翻译中保留不流利现象对信息保真很重要，可以通过推理时解码策略低成本地改善，作者同时发布了基准和代码供社区使用。

title: LAB-Tab: LLM-Augmented Bayesian Network Adaptation for Few-Shot Tabular Generation
summary: Tabular data generation supports analysis and decision-making when target-domain data are scarce, yet collecting complete target samples is often costly. A practical but underexplored setting provides only a few target records together with richer source data from a related domain. Existing few-shot tabular generators often either fit sparse target statistics directly, which can overfit incidental patterns, or reuse source-domain generators, which may preserve dependencies that no longer hold in the target domain. To address this problem, we propose LAB-Tab, an LLM-augmented Bayesian network (BN) adaptation framework for source-aware few-shot tabular generation. LAB-Tab first fits a BN from source data and then uses an LLM to propose plausible target-domain BN edges that are absent from the source BN graph. This step converts semantic and weak statistical evidence into explicit structural hypotheses, thereby expanding the editable edge space beyond the source-fitted graph. Because the proposed edges may be noisy and interact with existing dependencies, a PPO policy calibrates edges in the augmented BN through edge-level actions, including keep, weaken, strengthen, flip, and deactivate. The PPO policy is trained with a reward that combines distributional alignment, downstream utility, and preservation of target-relevant dependencies. The adapted BN is then sampled to synthesize target-domain tables. Across six source--target distribution-shift scenarios built from three US Census (ACS) prediction tasks, LAB-Tab achieves the best performance at the 10% target-data budget, leads four of the six individual scenarios, and reduces the macro Overall score by 33.8% relative to the strongest baseline. It also obtains the best macro JSD, WAPE, and UtilityGap while maintaining competitive feature--label preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAB-Tab，一种基于LLM增强贝叶斯网络（BN）自适应的少样本表格数据生成框架。它先从源数据拟合BN，再利用LLM提出目标域中源图中缺失的候选边，最后用PPO策略在增强后的BN上进行边级校准（保留、削弱、增强、翻转、停用），生成目标域表格数据。在三个ACS预测任务构建的六个源-目标分布偏移场景中，LAB-Tab在10%目标数据预算下取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 少样本表格数据生成中，目标域数据稀缺而源域数据丰富，现有方法要么直接拟合稀疏目标统计导致过拟合偶然模式，要么直接复用源域生成器但可能保留目标域中已失效的依赖关系，缺乏一种能有效利用源数据同时适配目标域结构的方法。
AI.method: LAB-Tab分三步：(1)从源数据拟合贝叶斯网络(BN)；(2)使用LLM将语义和微弱统计证据转化为显式结构假设，提出源图中缺失的目标域候选边；(3)使用PPO强化学习策略对增强BN中的边进行校准（keep/weaken/strengthen/flip/deactivate），奖励函数结合分布对齐、下游效用和目标相关依赖保留，最终从适配后的BN采样生成目标表格。
AI.result: 在六个源-目标分布偏移场景（基于三个US Census ACS预测任务）中，LAB-Tab在10%目标数据预算下达到最佳性能，在六个单独场景中领先其中四个，相对最强基线将macro Overall分数降低33.8%，同时取得最佳macro JSD、WAPE和UtilityGap，并保持有竞争力的特征-标签保留度。
AI.conclusion: LLM增强的BN自适应结合强化学习边校准，能够有效扩展现有BN的可编辑边空间，将语义知识转化为结构化假设，从而在少样本场景下生成高质量的目标域表格数据，且在各评估指标上优于现有基线方法。

title: QuerySplat: Decoupling Geometry and Appearance Representations in 3DGS Prediction
summary: While feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient 3D reconstruction, achieving high-fidelity rendering remains challenging. Existing pixel-aligned approaches suffer from spatial inflexibility and massive structural redundancy, whereas query-based methods lack 3D priors and entangle geometry with appearance, yielding blurry, pose-dependent results. To overcome these deficiencies, we propose \textbf{QuerySplat}, a feed-forward 3DGS framework driven by geometric priors and explicit appearance decoupling. Specifically, we design a dual-branch query-based decoder: the geometry branch leverages a pretrained Vision Geometric Model for spatial understanding, which intrinsically endows QuerySplat with pose-free modeling capabilities, while the appearance branch recovers high-frequency details through a dedicated pathway separated from geometric attribute regression. Extensive experiments demonstrate that QuerySplat mitigates the blurry rendering issues of early query-based models and consistently outperforms pixel-aligned approaches in rendering fidelity. On the challenging DL3DV benchmark, it achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis performance, with average PSNR gains of 2.30 dB and 1.04 dB over the best pose-free and pose-required baselines, respectively. Project Page: https://inspatio.github.io/querysplat.

AI.tldr: QuerySplat是一个基于几何先验和显式外观解耦的前馈3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）框架，通过双分支查询解码器解决现有方法在渲染保真度上的不足，在DL3DV基准上取得最先进的新视角合成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法存在两类问题：像素对齐方法空间灵活性差且结构冗余严重；基于查询的方法缺乏3D先验，并将几何与外观纠缠在一起，导致渲染结果模糊且依赖姿态。作者旨在克服这些缺陷，实现高保真渲染。
AI.method: 设计了双分支查询解码器：几何分支利用预训练视觉几何模型（VGM）获取空间理解能力，实现无姿态建模；外观分支通过独立于几何属性回归的专用通路恢复高频细节，实现几何与外观的显式解耦。
AI.result: 在DL3DV基准上达到最先进水平，相比最佳无姿态基线和有姿态基线，平均PSNR分别提升2.30 dB和1.04 dB，同时缓解了早期查询模型的模糊渲染问题，并在渲染保真度上持续优于像素对齐方法。
AI.conclusion: QuerySplat通过几何先验引导和外观解耦设计，有效提升了前馈3DGS的渲染质量，验证了查询式框架在结合3D先验后的强大潜力。

title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) capable of self-improvement require not only effective policy optimization, but also a principled mechanism for transforming transient interaction experience into persistent model capabilities. Existing self-improvement paradigms remain fragmented: test-time methods can explicitly extract experience but cannot internalize it into model parameters, whereas training-time optimization methods can update model parameters but lack an explicit mechanism for accumulating transferable experience. Bridging these two paradigms requires a critical intermediate stage that remains underexplored, namely \emph{experience distillation}. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{SPEE} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{E}xperience \textbf{E}volution), a unified post-training framework that sequentially performs explicit experience evolution followed by implicit policy optimization. During explicit experience evolution, SPEE reflects on trajectories collected from multiple interactions to extract, verify, and progressively evolve transferable experience, which is subsequently internalized into the policy through privilege-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). During implicit policy optimization, reward-driven reinforcement learning leverages these internalized priors to explore novel solution strategies. In the experience evolution stage, a continuously evolving global experience pool consolidates knowledge from both successful and failed trajectories, filters out low-utility experience, and mitigates post-hoc rationalization induced by individual trajectories. Experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SPEE consistently outperforms both test-time and training-time self-evolution baselines across three model scales. The source code is available at https://github.com/rrrsj/SPEE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEE（Self-Progressive Experience Evolution），一个统一的自进化后训练框架，通过显式经验演化（extract, verify, progressively evolve可迁移经验）和隐式策略优化（OPSD蒸馏+强化学习）两个阶段，弥合测试时与训练时自进化范式之间的鸿沟，在5个数学推理基准上超越两类基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自改进范式是碎片化的：测试时方法能显式提取经验但无法内化到参数中；训练时方法能更新参数但缺乏显式的可迁移经验积累机制。两者之间需要一个关键的中间阶段——经验蒸馏，但目前尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: SPEE包含两个顺序阶段：(1) 显式经验演化——从多次交互的轨迹中提取、验证并逐步演化可迁移经验，通过全局经验池整合成功与失败轨迹，过滤低效用经验并减轻事后合理化；(2) 隐式策略优化——通过特权引导的On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)将经验内化到策略中，随后用奖励驱动的强化学习利用这些内化先验探索新的解题策略。
AI.result: 在5个数学推理基准上，SPEE在3个不同模型规模下始终优于测试时和训练时的自进化基线。
AI.conclusion: 经验蒸馏是连接测试时与训练时自进化的关键中间环节，SPEE通过显式经验演化+隐式策略优化的统一框架，实现了更有效的持续自改进能力。

title: Does the Competitive Component of Adversarial Self-Play Improve Legal Reasoning? A Controlled Negative Result
summary: Adversarial self-play is an appealing recipe for legal reasoning: have a student model draft an argument, have an adversary attack it, and reward the student when its argument survives the attack. We designed exactly such a training signal -- a verifiable "survival" reward in which both the student's cited authorities and the adversary's counter-authorities are checked by a citation verifier, so that survival is decided on verified grounds rather than rhetoric, and fabricated citations are automatically neutralized. We then asked a narrow but important question: does the competitive component itself -- the adversary and the survival reward -- add anything on top of an otherwise identical non-competitive training run? Across four independent tests -- a bootstrap comparison, a two-seed replication, a paired per-case adversarial-robustness comparison, and a blinded head-to-head judgment of generated arguments, plus a follow-up pilot with a deliberately strengthened self-play adversary -- the competitive component produced no reliable benefit. The blinded judgment gave a 49% win rate (binomial p approx. 1.000); the strengthened-adversary pilot gave a 50% win rate (32:32, p approx. 1.000). An early apparent +29% advantage reversed and proved to be a small-sample artifact. We report this as an honest negative result. The value of the paper is reproducibility and the sharing of concrete pitfalls: an initially promising metric that inverted on more data, and an adversarial-robustness metric that silently collapsed to plain recall once the adversary stopped citing the same authorities as the gold answer. This null is consistent with, and reconfirms in the legal domain, the conclusion of the companion coding-domain study (Kim, 2026, arXiv:2607.08255) that the value of multi-teacher curricula arises from constructing a verifiable environment rather than from competition itself.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四项独立实验（bootstrap比较、两种子复制、逐案例对抗鲁棒性比较、盲审生成论证对比）以及一个强化对抗者的先导实验，系统评估了"对抗性自博弈"（包括对手模型和生存奖励）在法律推理中的训练价值，结果发现竞争组件没有带来任何可靠收益（盲审胜率49%，强化对抗先导实验胜率50%），最终报告为诚实的阴性结果。
AI.motivation: 对抗性自博弈被视为有吸引力的法律推理训练方法（学生起草论点、对手攻击、学生因论点幸存而获得奖励）。作者提出了一个可验证的"生存"奖励机制，可以自动检测和中和伪造引用。但核心问题是：竞争组件本身（对手+生存奖励）相对于完全相同的非竞争训练是否真的增加了价值？这是一个值得严格检验的重要问题。
AI.method: 设计了可验证的"生存"奖励信号：学生的引文权威和对手的反引文权威都由引文验证器检查，使幸存决策基于可验证的事实而非修辞，并自动中和伪造引用。通过四项独立测试进行验证：bootstrap比较、两种子复制、逐案例对抗鲁棒性比较、盲审论证生成逐对判断，另外还有一个强化自博弈对手的先导实验。
AI.result: 竞争组件没有产生可靠收益。盲审胜率为49%（二项检验p≈1.000）；强化对手先导实验胜率50%（32:32，p≈1.000）。早期表面上的+29%优势在更多数据下反转，证明是小样本伪影。还发现对抗鲁棒性指标在对手停止引用与黄金答案相同的权威后静默退化为普通召回率。
AI.conclusion: 本文报告了诚实的阴性结果，其价值在于可复现性和分享具体陷阱：一个最初看似有希望的指标在更多数据上反转，以及一个对抗鲁棒性指标静默崩塌为普通召回率。该空白结果与配套编码领域研究一致，支持了"多教师课程的价值在于构建可验证环境而非竞争本身"的结论。

title: CARE: A Cascaded Framework for Efficient and Reliable Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: While deep learning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in time series anomaly detection, their complex architectures incur substantial inference overhead. Existing methods typically apply a uniform inference strategy across all data points, which is inefficient given that anomalies are inherently scarce and the vast majority of temporal data consists of predictable normal patterns. To mitigate this bottleneck, we propose CARE, a model-agnostic cascaded inference framework that integrates a Lightweight Pre-filter Model (LPM) with an existing high-capacity Complex Detection Model (CDM). The LPM rapidly filters high-confidence normal samples using a Residual MLP AutoEncoder and a Normality-Conditioned Gating mechanism. Crucially, we introduce a Structure Attention module to explicitly capture channel-wise anomaly contributions, and optimize the gating network via a confidence-guided selective routing objective that learns reliable routing decisions to reduce unnecessary CDM invocations. Extensive experiments across eight real-world benchmarks demonstrate that CARE effectively isolates high-confidence normal samples. By routing only uncertain samples to the CDM, our framework achieves $2.7\times$ to $4.8\times$ inference speedup compared to the most accurate SOTA approaches, while still maintaining competitive detection quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE，一个模型无关的级联推理框架，用于加速时间序列异常检测。它通过轻量级预过滤模型（LPM）快速筛选高置信度的正常样本，仅将不确定样本路由到高容量复杂检测模型（CDM），在保持检测质量的同时实现2.7倍到4.8倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习时间序列异常检测模型虽然性能优异，但复杂架构带来了高昂的推理开销。由于异常数据天然稀缺，大部分时间序列数据是可预测的正常模式，对所有数据点采用统一的推理策略是低效的。因此需要一种方法能够减少不必要的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出级联推理框架CARE，包含两个核心组件：1）轻量级预过滤模型（LPM），采用残差MLP自编码器和正态条件门控机制快速过滤高置信度正常样本；2）结构注意力模块（Structure Attention），显式捕获通道级异常贡献；3）置信度引导的选择性路由目标函数，训练门控网络做出可靠的路由决策以减少不必要的CDM调用。
AI.result: 在八个真实世界基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，CARE能有效隔离高置信度正常样本。与最准确的SOTA方法相比，仅将不确定样本路由到CDM，推理速度提升2.7倍至4.8倍，同时保持具有竞争力的检测质量。
AI.conclusion: CARE通过级联推理框架有效解决了时间序列异常检测中的推理效率瓶颈，证明了利用"异常稀缺"这一先验知识可以显著减少计算开销而不牺牲检测性能，为异常检测模型的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Fruit-HSNet: A Machine Learning Approach for Hyperspectral Image-Based Fruit Ripeness Prediction
summary: Fruit ripeness prediction (FRP) is a classification-based agricultural computer vision task that has attracted much attention, thanks to its wide-ranging advantages in agriculture field for both pre-harvest and post-harvest management. Accurate and timely FRP can be achieved using machine/deep learning-based hyperspectral image classification techniques. However, challenges including the limited availability of labeled data and the lack of robust methods generalizable to various hyperspectral cameras and fruit types can compromise the effectiveness of hyperspectral image-based FRP. Addressing these challenges, this paper introduces Fruit-HSNet, a machine learning architecture specifically designed for hyperspectral classification of fruit ripeness. Fruit-HSNet incorporates a spatio-spectral feature extraction module based on Fourier Transform and central pixel spectral signature followed by learnable feature fusion and a classifier optimized for ripeness classification. The proposed architecture was evaluated using the DeepHS Fruit dataset, the largest publicly available labeled real-world hyperspectral dataset for predicting fruit ripeness, which includes five different types of fruits-avocado, kiwi, mango, kaki, and papaya-captured with three distinct hyperspectral cameras at various stages of ripeness. Experimental results highlight that Fruit-HSNet substantially outperforms existing deep learning methods, from baseline to state-of-the-art models, with improvements of 12%, achieving a new state-of-the-art overall accuracy of 70.73%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Fruit-HSNet，一种基于傅里叶变换和中心像素光谱特征的机器学习架构，用于高光谱图像的果实成熟度预测。在最大公开高光谱果实数据集DeepHS Fruit上，该方法以70.73%的总体准确率超越现有方法12%，达到新的最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 果实成熟度预测（FRP）在农业的收获前后管理中具有重要价值，但面临两个主要挑战：标记数据稀缺，以及缺乏能泛化到不同高光谱相机和果实类型的鲁棒方法。现有方法的有效性因此受到限制。
AI.method: Fruit-HSNet包含三个关键组件：1）基于傅里叶变换和中心像素光谱特征的空间-光谱特征提取模块；2）可学习的特征融合机制；3）针对成熟度分类优化的分类器。
AI.result: 在DeepHS Fruit数据集（包含5种果实、3种高光谱相机、多种成熟阶段）上，Fruit-HSNet优于现有深度学习方法（从基线到最先进模型），提升幅度达12%，总体准确率达到70.73%，创下新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: Fruit-HSNet通过结合傅里叶变换和中心像素光谱特征，有效解决了高光谱果实成熟度预测中标记数据有限和跨设备、跨果实泛化能力不足的问题，为农业高光谱图像分类提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Domain-Specific Evaluation of Text-to-Speech Systems: A Multi-Metric Benchmarking Study
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to Computer Speech & Language (Elsevier)
summary: Recent advances in neural text-to-speech (TTS) systems have substantially improved speech naturalness and intelligibility across many languages. However, comprehensive evaluation methodologies that jointly assess perceptual quality, speaker similarity, and acoustic fidelity across diverse speech domains remain limited, particularly for low-resource and underrepresented languages. This paper presents a reproducible, multi-metric benchmarking framework for systematic evaluation of modern TTS systems through domain-specific analysis. The proposed framework integrates complementary subjective and objective evaluation protocols and is demonstrated through a comprehensive case study on a representative low-resource language spanning four speech domains: Formal, Conversational, Literary/Storytelling, and Emotional. Four state-of-the-art TTS systems -- Indic-Parler-TTS, MMS-TTS, Microsoft Edge TTS, and Google Gemini TTS -- are evaluated using MUSHRA listening tests, ABX discrimination tests, speaker similarity scoring with Resemblyzer, and acoustic analyses based on mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) and F0 RMSE over 960 audio pairs. Results reveal substantial variation in TTS performance across speech domains, with emotional speech consistently presenting the greatest synthesis challenge (mean MCD 12.03 dB; mean F0 RMSE 889 cents), while conversational speech achieves the highest overall acoustic fidelity. Beyond the empirical findings, this work provides a reproducible evaluation framework, publicly releasing evaluation scripts, result tables, and executable Colab notebooks to support standardized benchmarking and future research on TTS evaluation for low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可复现的多指标TTS基准评估框架，针对低资源语言（以印度语言为代表）在四种语音域（正式、对话、文学/讲故事、情感）下系统评估四个SOTA TTS系统。通过MUSHRA听力测试、ABX判别测试、说话人相似度打分及声学分析（MCD和F0 RMSE）对960个音频对进行评估，发现情感语音是最大的合成挑战，对话语音的声学保真度最高，并公开了评估脚本和Colab笔记本以支持标准化评测。
AI.motivation: 现有神经TTS系统在多种语言上取得了显著进展，但缺乏跨语音域联合评估感知质量、说话人相似度和声学保真度的全面评估方法，尤其针对低资源和欠表征语言的综合评估仍然不足。
AI.method: 构建一个可复现的多指标基准框架，整合主观评估（MUSHRA听力测试、ABX判别测试）和客观评估（Resemblyzer说话人相似度、MCD和F0 RMSE声学分析），以低资源语言为案例，在四种语音域（正式、对话、文学/讲故事、情感）下评估Indic-Parler-TTS、MMS-TTS、Microsoft Edge TTS和Google Gemini TTS四个系统，共960个音频对。
AI.result: TTS性能在不同语音域间存在显著差异：情感语音是最大的合成挑战（平均MCD 12.03 dB，平均F0 RMSE 889 cents），而对话语音的整体声学保真度最高。四个TTS系统在不同域上表现各异，提供了全面的比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅提供了低资源语言TTS系统在多种语音域下的实证评估结果，还公开了完整的评估脚本、结果表格和可执行的Colab笔记本，为低资源语言的TTS标准化评估和未来研究建立了可复现的基准框架。

title: Is More Privileged Information Better? From Solution Traces to Problem-Solving Structure in Self-Distilled Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by using a privileged view of a model conditioned on reference solutions to supervise a student view that observes only the question. However, the teacher-provided token-level targets may depend on reference-specific information unavailable at inference time. We propose Problem-Space-Guided OPSD (PS-OPSD), which replaces the complete solution with trajectory-grounded guidance describing the initial state, goal conditions, constraints, and a selected state-transition path. The student rollout and OPSD objective remain unchanged. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model scales ranging from 1.7B to 8B, PS-OPSD achieves the highest aggregate question-only accuracy among the compared methods. Controlled experiments further indicate that guidance relevance and path coherence contribute to these gains, highlighting the representation of privileged information as an important design choice in OPSD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出问题空间引导的OPSD（PS-OPSD），用轨迹锚定的问题空间描述（初始状态、目标条件、约束和状态转移路径）替代完整参考解作为特权信息，在不改变学生rollout和OPSD目标的情况下，在三个数学推理基准和1.7B至8B模型规模上取得最优的纯问题准确率。
AI.motivation: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 通过参考解提供特权视角来监督仅观察问题的学生视图，但教师提供的token级目标可能依赖推理时不可用的参考特定信息，导致教学信号与推理时实际可获取的信息不匹配。
AI.method: 提出PS-OPSD，用描述初始状态、目标条件、约束和选定状态转移路径的轨迹锚定引导替换完整参考解作为特权信息，学生rollout和OPSD优化目标保持不变。
AI.result: 在三个数学推理基准和1.7B到8B模型规模上，PS-OPSD在纯问题（question-only）准确率上取得所有对比方法中的最高聚合表现；控制实验表明引导相关性和路径连贯性对增益有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 特权信息的表示方式（而非仅其内容）是OPSD中的重要设计选择，问题空间级别的引导比完整解作为特权信息更有利于推理泛化。

title: Understanding and Correcting Low-Frequency Bias in EEG Foundation Model
summary: Increasing EEG pretraining data scale or model capacity does not consistently improve downstream performance. We identify a persistent low-frequency bias in representations learned by diverse EEG foundation models, which remains across dataset scales, model capacities, and pretraining objectives. Our analysis links this bias to the interaction between EEG's $1/f^α$-like spectral structure and neural networks' tendency to preferentially learn low-frequency components. In masked autoencoders, the $\ell_2$ reconstruction objective further amplifies this imbalance: under comparable relative reconstruction errors, high-power low-frequency components contribute disproportionately to the loss. To address this issue, we introduce FAME, a frequency-balanced masked autoencoding framework that reconstructs time--frequency activity in predefined EEG bands from masked EEG inputs. FAME independently standardizes the reconstruction targets within each band and assigns equal weight to all band-specific losses, thereby balancing supervision across the EEG spectrum. Evaluated on 41 downstream tasks in OmniEEG-Bench, FAME learns more spectrally balanced representations and achieves state-of-the-art performance on 24 of them. These results underscore the importance of balanced spectral supervision for learning transferable EEG representations.

AI.tldr: 本文发现EEG预训练模型存在持续的低频偏置，即使增加数据规模或模型容量也无法解决。作者将这一偏置归因于EEG的1/f^α谱结构与神经网络偏好学习低频成分的相互作用，以及MAE中ℓ2重建损失对低频的放大效应。为此提出FAME框架，在预定义频带内对时间-频率活动进行重建，通过独立标准化和等权损失实现谱平衡监督，在OmniEEG-Bench的41个下游任务中24个达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: EEG基础模型虽在预训练中不断扩大数据规模和模型容量，但下游性能并未一致提升。作者发现根本原因在于EEG表示中存在顽固的低频偏置，这一偏置跨越不同的数据集规模、模型容量和预训练目标持续存在，亟需从谱平衡角度重新设计预训练框架。
AI.method: FAME（频率平衡掩码自编码框架）：从掩码EEG输入重建预定义EEG频带中的时间-频率活动。核心创新在于对每个频带内的重建目标进行独立标准化，并对所有频带损失赋予相等权重，从而在EEG频谱上实现均衡的监督信号。
AI.result: 在OmniEEG-Bench的41个下游任务上评估，FAME学习到更谱平衡的表示，并在24个任务上达到最先进性能，验证了谱平衡监督对学习可迁移EEG表示的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 谱平衡的监督训练对于获得可迁移的EEG表示至关重要。低频偏置是EEG基础模型性能瓶颈的关键因素，FAME通过频带级别平衡重建有效缓解了这一问题，为EEG自监督预训练提供了新的设计原则。

title: It's the Decoding Format, Not the Perturbation: Auditing Consistency-Based Selection for Vision-Language Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling lifts large language model reasoning by sampling many candidate solutions and selecting among them, yet the same recipe transfers poorly to vision-language models (VLMs): recent work shows that simple majority voting beats selection methods built on the model's own self-verification, apparently because at the selection layer an image-grounded answer and a confident guess from the language prior look the same. A natural fix is to make the selection signal one that cannot be computed without the image. We study Perturbation Grounded Selection (Pgs), a label-free, training-free rule that scores each candidate by whether the model re-derives it under label-preserving perturbations of the input (cropping, background masking, mild photometric or geometric jitter); Pgs recovers majority voting when the perturbation set is empty. The decisive question is not whether Pgs beats chain-of-thought only majority voting, but whether the perturbation term adds anything once decoding format and budget are controlled. We therefore introduce a format-matched control (MatchedCtrl): the same short, no-CoT draws spent on the original image. Across TextVQA, MATH-Vision, MMMU, and ViLP, with a Qwen headline (three-seed means) and LLaVA-OneVision coverage in matched-budget selector tables, Pgs appears to beat plain majority voting by up to +31.8 points on TextVQA (Qwen), but MatchedCtrl tracks or exceeds Pgs within noise on every benchmark, including the vision-required ViLP; no Qwen category shows a significant gain over this control. The stability gap is real and image-dependent (up to +0.48), yet does not predict per-instance wins. The result is negative and diagnostic: perturbation consistency is at best a partial diagnostic of visual dependence and, on its own, not a usable selection signal once format is controlled; gains reported against CoT-only majority voting overstate such methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）测试时缩放中的选择信号问题。作者提出扰动接地选择（Pgs）方法，通过图像扰动（裁剪、背景遮蔽等）下的候选答案一致性来评分选择。然而，引入格式匹配对照（MatchedCtrl）后发现，Pgs相对于简单多数投票的显著提升（最高+31.8分）在同格式基线对照下消失，结论为负面：扰动一致性至多是对视觉依赖的部分诊断信号，不能作为格式控制下的可用选择信号。
AI.motivation: 现有工作显示简单多数投票优于基于模型自我验证的选择方法，因为图像接地答案与语言先验的自信猜测在模型自评看来难以区分。作者希望构建一个无法脱离图像计算的选择信号来改善VLM推理的选择阶段。
AI.method: 提出Pgs（扰动接地选择）：对输入进行标签保持扰动（裁剪、背景遮蔽、轻度光度或几何抖动），对每个候选答案检查模型能否在扰动下重新推导出该答案。同时设计格式匹配对照（MatchedCtrl），将同样短的无思维链采样应用于原始图像，以控制解码格式和预算。
AI.result: 在TextVQA、MATH-Vision、MMMU、ViLP四个基准上，用Qwen和LLaVA-OneVision评估。Pgs在TextVQA上比多数投票高+31.8分，但MatchedCtrl在噪声范围内追踪或超过Pgs的每个基准表现。稳定差距是真实存在且与图像相关（最高+0.48），但不能预测单实例胜负。
AI.conclusion: 结论为负面和诊断性：扰动一致性最多只是视觉依赖的部分诊断指标，在控制格式后单独不能作为可用选择信号；此前报告的对比CoT-only多数投票的收益被高估。

title: An Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Transformer Framework for Health Misinformation Verification
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, To appear in the Reimagining knowledge systems for digital transformation and sustainable development in the 21st century conference 2026, faculty of social sciences education. Federal University of Education, Zaria
summary:
The rapid spread of false and misleading health information through digital platforms has become a major public health challenge, particularly during infectious disease outbreaks where delayed verification can influence public behaviour and hinder effective disease control. Although recent advances in automated health misinformation detection have shown encouraging results, most existing approaches rely heavily on global biomedical resources and often fail to capture the local context needed to verify claims in developing countries. This study presents a retrieval-augmented transformer framework designed to verify health-related claims using trusted evidence from the World Health Organization and the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention. The framework combines semantic evidence retrieval with transformer-based classification to determine whether a claim is true, false, or misleading. To evaluate the proposed approach, a manually annotated dataset of 67 verified health claims covering coronavirus disease, Lassa fever, cholera, measles, and monkeypox was compiled from Nigerian fact-checking sources.
  Three transformer models and a retrieval-augmented configuration were evaluated. The Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers model achieved the best performance, with an accuracy of 71% and a weighted F1-score of 0.66. Although retrieval augmentation did not improve classification performance because the current evidence repository was limited in size and coverage, the findings highlight the importance of comprehensive and authoritative knowledge sources for reliable health misinformation verification. The proposed framework provides a practical foundation for developing context-aware and evidence-driven health misinformation verification systems for Nigeria and other resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个检索增强的Transformer框架，利用世界卫生组织和尼日利亚疾病控制中心的权威证据来验证健康相关声明的真伪。基于67条人工标注的尼日利亚健康声明数据集，最佳模型BERT达到71%准确率和0.66的加权F1分数。检索增强并未提升分类性能，但强调了全面权威知识源对健康谣言验证的重要性。
AI.motivation: 数字平台上的虚假健康信息传播已成为重大公共卫生挑战，尤其在传染病暴发期间，延迟验证会影响公众行为并阻碍疾病控制。现有自动化检测方法依赖全球生物医学资源，无法捕捉发展中国家的本地语境，因此需要开发能结合本地权威证据的健康信息验证框架。
AI.method: 提出了一个检索增强的Transformer框架，结合语义证据检索与基于Transformer的分类器。从WHO和尼日利亚CDC检索可信证据，通过语义检索匹配相关证据，再使用Transformer模型判断声明为真、假或误导。数据集包含67条来自尼日利亚事实核查来源的人工标注健康声明，涵盖COVID-19、拉沙热、霍乱、麻疹和猴痘。
AI.result: 评估了三种Transformer模型和一种检索增强配置。BERT模型表现最佳，准确率为71%，加权F1得分为0.66。检索增强未能提升分类性能，原因是当前证据库规模和覆盖范围有限。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为尼日利亚及其他资源受限环境提供了开发上下文感知、证据驱动的健康谣言验证系统的实用基础。研究强调全面权威知识源的重要性，并为未来改进证据库覆盖范围和检索策略指明了方向。

title: Latent Thought Credit: Multi-Answer Credit Assignment for Latent Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning allows language models to carry out intermediate reasoning in continuous latent representations rather than fully externalizing it as discrete chains of thought. However, assigning credit to such latent thoughts from answer-only rewards is difficult: a single final answer mixes thought quality with answer-sampling noise. We propose \textbf{Latent Thought Credit (LTC)}, a hierarchical credit-assignment framework for latent reasoning. For each prompt, LTC samples multiple latent thoughts, fixes the context after each thought, and estimates thought-level expected reward by averaging rewards over multiple answers generated from that fixed context. LTC uses thought-level advantages to optimize the latent-thought phase, answer-level advantages to optimize the answer phase, and an advantage-weighted thought-matching objective that helps the policy reproduce high-credit latent thoughts. We instantiate LTC in a GRPO-style on-policy training framework and evaluate it across mathematical reasoning and STEM multiple-choice tasks. LTC achieves the best average accuracy among the compared methods, while ablations and fixed-context diagnostics show that multi-answer estimation reduces reward-estimation error and mitigates ambiguous or incorrect thought-level credit.

AI.tldr: LTC是一个用于潜在推理的分层信用分配框架，通过采样多个潜在想法、固定上下文后多次生成答案来估计想法级奖励，并使用想法级和答案级优势分别优化相应阶段，在数学推理和STEM多项选择任务上取得了最佳平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 潜在推理在连续潜在表示中进行中间推理，但仅从答案奖励中为潜在想法分配信用很困难，因为单个最终答案混合了想法质量和答案采样噪声，难以准确评估想法的贡献。
AI.method: LTC框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 对每个提示采样多个潜在想法，并在每个想法后固定上下文，通过多次生成答案的平均奖励来估计想法级期望奖励；(2) 使用想法级优势优化潜在想法阶段，答案级优势优化答案阶段；(3) 采用优势加权的想法匹配目标，使策略重现高信用潜在想法。该方法集成在GRPO风格的在策略训练框架中。
AI.result: 在数学推理和STEM多项选择任务中，LTC取得了所比较方法中最佳的平均准确率。消融实验和固定上下文诊断表明，多样本答案估计减少了奖励估计误差，并缓解了模糊或不正确的想法级信用分配问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层信用分配，LTC有效解决了潜在推理中想法级信用的估计难题，多答案估计策略能够更准确地区分想法质量与答案采样噪声，从而提升潜在推理模型的整体性能。

title: Finite-Time Analysis of Discounted Exponential-Utility Reinforcement Learning
summary: Discounted exponential utility provides a principled criterion for risk-sensitive sequential decision-making, but its nonlinear structure complicates reinforcement learning. A recent work \citep{thoppe2026reinforcement} addressed this difficulty by introducing a Bellman-compatible surrogate and two model-free fixed-point algorithms for optimizing it over stationary policies. However, their main convergence results are asymptotic. In this work, we establish finite-time rates of $\tilde{O} (1/\sqrt{n})$ for the aforementioned two algorithms under asynchronous Markovian sampling, where $n$ is the iteration index and $\tilde{O}$ hides logarithmic expressions. Importantly, we employ parameter-free choices for the stepsize parameter to derive these rate results. For the algorithmically simpler one-timescale method, the main challenge is that its update equation is not directly aligned with the contraction geometry of its underlying power-law operator. We overcome this mismatch by exploiting the boundedness, monotonicity, and homogeneity of the operator to obtain a local pseudo-contraction property for the relative-error dynamics. We then use a Moreau-envelope-based Lyapunov function and Polyak--Ruppert averaging to obtain the stated convergence rate with parameter-free stepsizes. For the two-timescale method, the main challenge is to control a tracking error on the faster timescale. These results provide the first finite-time guarantees for model-free discounted exponential-utility reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对折扣指数效用强化学习问题，为两种模型无关的定点算法建立了有限的收敛速率保证（~O(1/√n)），采用参数自由的自适应步长选择，并解决了单时间尺度更新与收缩几何不匹配以及双时间尺度跟踪误差控制等关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 折扣指数效用为风险敏感的序贯决策提供了原理性准则，但其非线性结构使得强化学习变得复杂。此前工作引入了Bellman兼容的代理和两种模型无关的定点算法，但收敛结果是渐近性的，缺乏有限时间保证。
AI.method: 本文在异步马尔可夫采样下，为两种算法建立了~O(1/√n)的有限时间收敛率。对于单时间尺度方法，利用算子的有界性、单调性和齐次性，为相对误差动态建立局部伪收缩性质，结合Moreau包络Lyapunov函数和Polyak-Ruppert平均技术；对于双时间尺度方法，重点控制快时间尺度上的跟踪误差。两种方法均使用参数自由的步长选择。
AI.result: 为折扣指数效用强化学习提供了首个有限时间收敛保证，收敛率为~O(1/√n)，且步长参数无需事先调优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了折扣指数效用强化学习在有限时间收敛分析方面的空白，通过新颖的数学工具（局部伪收缩、Moreau包络Lyapunov函数）解决了特定算法结构带来的挑战。

title: VaRS-Doc: Interpretation-Aware Variant Representations via Latent Self-Probing for Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Visual document retrieval has recently become increasingly important in applications such as enterprise search, scientific literature discovery, and retrieval-augmented generation. These applications depend on efficiently identifying query-relevant pages across large collections of visually rich documents. Existing methods commonly adopt late-interaction architectures that encode and index documents offline to enable scalable and low-latency online retrieval. Despite its efficiency, this paradigm requires each document to be encoded into a fixed representation before the query is known. However, the same content in a visual document may induce different interpretations depending on the query intent, which a fixed representation struggles to capture. Yet postponing document encoding until the query arrives would incur prohibitive online retrieval latency. To address this gap, we propose VaRS-Doc, a visual document retrieval framework that diversifies document representations by enabling the model to actively explore variant latent interpretations during document encoding, while preserving efficient late-interaction retrieval in which each query adaptively selects the best-fit representation. We further introduce a two-stage training strategy that encourages the model to capture complementary semantic interpretations and prevents it from falling back to train a single dominant representation. Experiments on visual document retrieval benchmarks show that VaRS-Doc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance, offering a practical solution to the mismatch between query-agnostic document encoding and query-specific retrieval needs. Code is available at https://github.com/bokufa/VaRS-Doc.

AI.tldr: VaRS-Doc是一个视觉文档检索框架，通过让模型在文档编码阶段主动探索多样化的潜在语义解释来多元化文档表示，同时保持高效的晚期交互（late-interaction）检索范式，查询时自适应选择最佳表示。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉文档检索方法采用晚期交互架构，需要将文档预先编码为固定表示。然而，视觉文档中的相同内容可能因查询意图不同而产生不同解释，固定表示难以捕捉这种多样性。若推迟文档编码直到查询到达，又会带来不可接受的在线检索延迟。
AI.method: 提出VaRS-Doc框架：（1）在文档编码阶段让模型主动探索多个变体潜在解释，生成多样化的文档表示；（2）保持晚期交互检索，每个查询自适应选择最匹配的表示；（3）引入两阶段训练策略，鼓励模型捕捉互补的语义解释，避免退化为训练单一主导表示。
AI.result: 在视觉文档检索基准测试上，VaRS-Doc取得了最先进的检索性能，有效解决了查询无关文档编码与查询特定检索需求之间的不匹配问题。
AI.conclusion: VaRS-Doc提供了一种兼顾效率与效果的实用解决方案，在不牺牲晚期交互检索效率的前提下，通过多元化文档表示更好地满足查询特定的检索需求。

title: Can AI Agents Simulate A/B Test Outcomes? A Validation Framework for Agentic Experimentation
comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at https://www.aiagentbehavior.com/
summary: A/B testing remains the standard for rolling out new features in the technology industry. Each experiment, however, consumes real traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of wall-clock time. Can AI agents---conditioned on behavioral profiles and contextual descriptions of the intervention---simulate outcomes accurately enough to vet candidate treatments before committing live traffic? We formalize this question as a \emph{Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial} (S-RCT) and derive a two-layer error decomposition that separates agent approximation error from subsampling error, enabling targeted improvements to each. The framework is agent-agnostic: any behavioral model---from a fine-tuned specialist to a general-purpose foundation model---can serve as the simulation engine. Validated on 67 historical marketing A/B tests, a baseline S-RCT using an off-the-shelf foundation model captures directional signal (sign overlap 0.70) but systematically overshoots effect magnitudes. A two-phase pre-period calibration protocol reduces the squared prediction error (after removing irreducible measurement noise) by ${\sim}77\times$; a within-subject design---where each agent is exposed to both arms---reduces standard errors by ${\sim}2.4\times$. We discuss limitations of the current approach and identify applications where experimenters stand to benefit from agentic signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模拟随机对照试验"(S-RCT)框架，用AI智能体模拟A/B测试结果，以在投入真实流量前预筛选候选实验方案。在67个历史营销A/B测试上验证，基线模型能捕捉方向性信号但高估效应量；通过两阶段校准协议可将平方预测误差降低约77倍，被试内设计可将标准误降低约2.4倍。
AI.motivation: A/B测试是科技行业的标准做法，但每次实验都消耗真实的流量、工程资源和数周时间。研究者希望用AI智能体模拟实验结果，以便在投入真实流量之前预筛选候选方案，节省成本和加速迭代。
AI.method: 提出S-RCT框架，包含两层误差分解（智能体近似误差与子采样误差），该框架与具体模型无关。采用两阶段前周期校准协议来修正系统性的效应量高估，并采用被试内设计（同一智能体暴露于两个实验臂）来降低标准误。
AI.result: 在67个历史营销A/B测试上验证：使用现成基础模型的基线S-RCT能捕捉方向性信号（符号重叠度0.70），但系统性地高估效应幅度。两阶段校准协议将平方预测误差（扣除不可约测量噪声后）降低约77倍；被试内设计将标准误降低约2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: S-RCT作为实验前的预筛选工具具有潜力，但当前方法存在局限。作者讨论了局限并指出了实验者能从智能体信号中受益的应用场景。

title: Post-Training on Office Work Improves Software Engineering: A Behavioral Account of Cross-Domain Transfer
summary: Long-horizon tasks require agents to maintain coherent state and goals across nested and branching work. We call this capability goal-directed execution (GDE): the repeated application of four behaviors, namely selecting goals, constructing task-relevant state, maintaining fidelity to higher-level objectives, and verifying completion against the environment. We hypothesize that long-horizon post-training strengthens these behaviors across domains. We test this by post-training Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on 363 Long-Horizon Multi-Tool Agent (LHMTA) tasks drawn from office workflows. The collection contained no software-engineering tasks, yet the model's pass@1 improved by 5.8 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Matched trajectory analysis shows gains in all four GDE behaviors in both office workflows and software repositories. Aggregate SWE-Bench Pro statistics showed related changes in information gathering, implementation, and verification. Together, the results support a behavioral interpretation in which long-horizon post-training changed how the model organized and applied knowledge across tasks, with effects extending beyond the training domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"目标导向执行"(GDE)概念，包含四个行为：目标选择、任务相关状态构建、维持高层目标保真度、以及对照环境验证完成情况。作者通过对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B模型在363个办公工作流任务上进行长时域后训练，发现即使在训练集中不含软件工程任务的情况下，模型在SWE-Bench Pro上的pass@1仍提升了5.8个百分点，且四个GDE行为在所有领域均得到增强。
AI.motivation: 长时域任务要求智能体在嵌套和分支的工作中维持连贯的状态与目标，但现有研究缺乏对这种能力（作者称之为"目标导向执行"）的系统性定义与验证。作者希望探究长时域后训练是否能跨领域强化这类行为。
AI.method: 作者定义GDE为四种行为的重复应用（目标选择、状态构建、目标保真度维持、环境验证），在363个长时域多工具智能体(LHMTA)办公工作流任务上对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B进行后训练，并通过匹配轨迹分析和SWE-Bench Pro聚合统计来评估跨域效果。
AI.result: 训练集不含软件工程任务，但模型在SWE-Bench Pro上的pass@1提升了5.8个百分点。匹配轨迹分析显示四个GDE行为在办公工作流和软件仓库中均有增益，SWE-Bench Pro的聚合统计也显示信息收集、实现和验证方面有相关变化。
AI.conclusion: 长时域后训练改变了模型跨任务组织与应用知识的方式，其效果超越了训练领域本身，支持了行为层面的解释框架。

title: HarnessCompass: Guiding Automatic Harness Evolution toward Generalizable and Effective Agent Harnesses
summary: Harness design plays a critical role in agent performance by shaping how large language models (LLMs) perceive, reason over, and act within executable environments. Recent work has proposed automatic harness evolution, which iteratively improves the harness from agent--environment interactions. However, existing methods often overfit to the evolution tasks, rely exclusively on trajectory-derived signals, and optimize harness components jointly, causing interference across components. We propose HarnessCompass, a novel automatic harness evolution framework built around constrained evolution, proactive feedback, and component-wise optimization. HarnessCompass first enforces global constraints on evolution, restricting modifications to task-agnostic harness changes that generalize beyond the evolution tasks. It then augments trajectory-derived evidence with proactive first-person feedback from the agent about harness usage, yielding richer signals for evolution. Finally, it decouples the optimization of different harness components before consolidating them into a unified harness, reducing cross-component interference while preserving component synergy. On SWE-bench Verified with GPT-5.4, HarnessCompass improves Pass@1 from 54\% to 66\% in only 5 evolution iterations, outperforming AHE in both effectiveness and evolution efficiency. In addition, the evolved harness transfers effectively to held-out tasks and other models, demonstrating substantially stronger generalization than prior automatic harness evolution methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了HarnessCompass，一个基于约束进化、主动反馈和组件级优化的自动harness进化框架，在SWE-bench Verified上将Pass@1从54%提升到66%，仅需5轮进化迭代，且具备良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自动harness进化方法存在三个问题：过度拟合进化任务、仅依赖轨迹信号、组件联合优化导致互相干扰，限制了harness的泛化能力和进化效率。
AI.method: HarnessCompass包含三个核心设计：(1) 全局约束进化，限制修改为与任务无关的harness变更；(2) 主动反馈，融合agent关于harness使用的第一人称反馈与轨迹信号；(3) 组件级优化，解耦不同harness组件的优化后再整合，减少跨组件干扰。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上使用GPT-5.4，仅5轮进化迭代将Pass@1从54%提升至66%，在效果和进化效率上均优于AHE；进化后的harness能有效迁移到留出任务和其他模型，展现出更强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: HarnessCompass通过任务无关约束、主动反馈信号和组件解耦优化，实现了更高效、更泛化的自动harness进化，优于现有方法。

title: From Forest to Future Capital: Tracking Land Cover Change in Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) from 2021 to 2026 with PlanetScope Imagery
summary: Indonesia's relocation of its political and administrative capital from Jakarta to Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) has been framed around a ``Forest City'' vision, yet rapid construction within the Core Government Area (KIPP) raises concerns over land conversion, vegetation loss, and carbon stock decline. This study applies remote sensing techniques to systematically assess land use and vegetation cover change in KIPP from 2021 to 2026 using PlanetScope SuperDove satellite imagery. Cloud-free mosaics were prepared and analysed through spectral indices, including the Normalised Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalised Difference Red Edge (NDRE), and Normalised Difference Water Index (NDWI), alongside supervised land use and land cover (LULC) classification using a Support Vector Machine algorithm. Results show substantial environmental transformation, with mean NDVI declined by 17.1\%, total carbon stock decreased by 0.28\%, developed land expanded by 672\%, and total vegetation declined by 18.1\%. Vegetation loss was most extensive between 2023 and 2024, although a temporary recovery in NDVI and carbon stock occurred from 2024 to 2025 as active clearing slowed and development shifted towards already-cleared land. Overall, the findings demonstrate that remote sensing provides an effective approach for monitoring the environmental impacts of large-scale urban development, while highlighting the need for higher-resolution, hyperspectral, and SAR-based methods to improve detection of construction stages and plantation-related land cover changes.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用PlanetScope SuperDove卫星影像，通过遥感技术系统评估了印度尼西亚新首都努桑塔拉（IKN）核心政府区（KIPP）2021-2026年间的土地利用和植被覆盖变化，发现平均NDVI下降17.1%、碳储量下降0.28%、建成区扩张672%、植被总量减少18.1%。
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚将首都从雅加达迁至IKN，以"森林城市"愿景为框架，但核心政府区的快速建设引发了对土地转换、植被损失和碳储量下降的担忧，亟需系统评估这一大规模开发的环境影响。
AI.method: 采用PlanetScope SuperDove卫星影像制备无云镶嵌图，利用NDVI、NDRE、NDWI等光谱指数分析，并结合支持向量机（SVM）算法进行监督分类的土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）分析。
AI.result: 平均NDVI下降17.1%，总碳储量下降0.28%，建成区扩张672%，植被总量下降18.1%。植被损失在2023-2024年间最为严重，但2024-2025年间NDVI和碳储量出现暂时恢复，因为土地清理放缓且开发转向已清理区域。
AI.conclusion: 遥感技术为监测大型城市开发的环境影响提供了有效手段，但需要更高分辨率、高光谱和SAR方法以改进对施工阶段和种植相关土地覆盖变化的检测。

title: Global Optimization and Inference-Time Region Grafting for Agentic Workflows
summary: Recent advances in agentic workflow optimization automate workflow design through task-specific workflow search or input-conditioned architecture selection. However, they determine the workflow before execution and cannot adapt failed workflow regions using execution-time label-free quality signals. Naively enabling such inference-time adaptation through whole-workflow re-optimization would be computationally prohibitive. To tackle this challenge, we introduce GRAFT, which preserves a globally optimized workflow while locally replacing only selected regions for each input. Without parameter training, GRAFT evaluates region-level alternatives using label-free execution-quality signals and accepts only replacements that improve local quality while preserving workflow-level consistency, thereby enabling instance-wise adaptation without whole-workflow re-optimization. GRAFT applies without modification across a range of tasks spanning mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-hop and knowledge-intensive question answering. Under matched optimizer and executor settings, it improves over the strongest prior workflow-optimization method, MaAS, by 3.85 points on average. Replacing only the executor with a stronger model yields further gains without re-optimizing the global workflow. This suggests that an optimized workflow is not merely a static optimization artifact, but an adaptable execution policy that can evolve with inference-time feedback and stronger executors.

AI.tldr: GRAFT是一种无需训练参数的推理时工作流自适应方法，在保持全局优化工作流的同时，仅对每个输入局部替换选定的工作流区域，利用无标签的执行质量信号进行局部优化，避免了整体重新优化的高昂计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体工作流优化方法（如任务特定工作流搜索或输入条件架构选择）在执行前确定工作流，无法利用执行时的无标签质量信号来适应失败的工作流区域。而直接进行推理时全工作流重新优化在计算上不可行，因此需要在推理时实现高效的局部自适应。
AI.method: GRAFT的核心方法包括：(1) 保留全局优化的工作流，仅对每个输入局部替换选定区域；(2) 使用无标签执行质量信号评估区域级替代方案；(3) 仅接受能提升局部质量且保持工作流级一致性的替换；(4) 无需参数训练，实现实例级自适应而不进行全工作流重新优化。
AI.result: GRAFT在数学推理、代码生成、多跳和知识密集型问答等多个任务上均适用。在与最强的先前工作流优化方法MaAS进行匹配的优化器和执行器设置下，平均提升了3.85分。仅将执行器替换为更强的模型即可获得进一步增益，无需重新优化全局工作流。
AI.conclusion: 优化后的工作流不仅仅是静态的优化产物，而是一种可适应的执行策略，能够随着推理时反馈和更强的执行器而演变。GRAFT证明了在保持全局优化工作流的同时，通过局部推理时自适应可以有效提升性能。

title: When Memory Updates but Behavior Does Not: Repairing Implicit Stale Dependencies in Personalized Agent Responses
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Memory-augmented agents can know that a user's stored state is outdated and still plan around the old value. The STALE benchmark calls this the implicit policy adaptation (IPA) gap. We identify one structural contributor: draft-anchored verification checks what a response says, and in an open-ended response the stale dependency is usually unsaid. StateAuditor therefore audits in the opposite direction, from stored state to draft. An LLM proposes candidate old-to-new transitions from timestamped evidence; deterministic code pins each quotation to a single entry, checks that the new evidence really is newer, and lets only these verified transitions trigger repair. What is verified is provenance and chronology - not semantic supersession. On STALE's full protocol (400 scenarios, 50-session histories, one independent response per query), strict single-query VTA scores .736 against .686 for our locked predecessor under the same judge: a +5.0-point paired gain (95% CI [+2.9, +7.2]) coming almost entirely from IPA and premise resistance (PR). The benchmark's own judge, from a third model family, reproduces the gain (.738 vs. .680). On an independent cross-family preference-evolution benchmark (HorizonBench), the full draft-audit-repair pipeline over a gold-derived structured store raises current-preference accuracy (user-clustered p<.01), though a matched control shows most of this external gain is the draft-side audit itself; a harder authored lifecycle set gives no gain, bounding the claim while false invalidation stays controlled. On STALE, by contrast, a matched control (same evidence, adapter, and call budget) scores only .692 (+0.6 over the predecessor, n.s.), attributing the STALE gain to the transition machinery rather than added context or calls. We make no claim about general-purpose agent memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StateAuditor，一种反向审计机制（从存储状态到草稿），通过LLM提议候选转换并用确定性代码验证溯源与时序，修复隐式策略适应（IPA）差距。在STALE基准上取得+5.0点的配对提升，主要来自IPA和前提抵抗（PR），并通过匹配对照实验证明增益来自转换机制而非额外上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体即使知道用户存储状态已过时，仍会围绕旧值进行规划，即隐式策略适应（IPA）差距。传统草稿锚定验证只检查回复内容，而开放式中依赖的过时信息往往未被提及，导致验证失效。
AI.method: StateAuditor采用与草稿锚定验证相反的方向：从存储状态到草稿进行审计。LLM根据带时间戳的证据提出候选的旧→新转换；确定性代码将每个引用固定到单个条目，检查新证据确实比旧证据更新，并只允许这些已验证的转换触发修复。验证的是溯源（provenance）和时序（chronology），而非语义取代（semantic supersession）。
AI.result: 在STALE完整协议（400场景、50会话历史）上，严格单查询VTA得分0.736，对比前身0.686，配对增益+5.0点（95% CI [+2.9, +7.2]），几乎完全来自IPA和前提抵抗。跨模型族的基准评判确认增益（0.738 vs 0.680）。在HorizonBench上全流程提升当前偏好准确性（p<.01），但匹配对照显示外部增益主要来自草稿侧审计；更难的作者生命周期集合无增益。STALE匹配对照仅得0.692（+0.6，n.s.），归因于转换机制。
AI.conclusion: StateAuditor通过从存储状态到草稿的反向验证，有效缩小了IPA差距，STALE上的增益归因于转换机制而非额外上下文。但作者明确不声称对通用智能体记忆有效，且外部基准上的增益有限，需谨慎推广结论。

title: ChaosProbe: A Neurochaotic Lens on Frozen Transformer Input-Embedding Spaces
summary: Transformer models are most often understood through what they do: their benchmark performance, generation quality, or behavior on downstream tasks. Yet frozen transformer input-embedding spaces may also be examined through their responses to a controlled deterministic probe before contextual computation or task-specific adaptation. Guided by this response-based view, we introduce \emph{ChaosProbe}, a deterministic neurochaos-inspired method for constructing response-based fingerprints of frozen transformer input-embedding spaces. For each prompt-level embedding matrix, ChaosProbe applies a chaotic trajectory-based transformation and summarizes its Firing Rate and Entropy channel responses with complementary representation-level measures, producing a fixed-length signature for each model. In a bounded proof-of-concept study of $80$ neutral prompts and four pretrained models---GPT-2, DistilGPT2, BERT-base-uncased, and RoBERTa-base---Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, and cosine similarity each recover all four same-family nearest-neighbor assignments and both expected mutual family pairs. Euclidean distance recovers three of the four assignments and one of the two mutual family pairs. Paired bootstrap resampling supports the stability of the Pearson and Spearman pairings over the observed prompt set, and signature-validity checks show that constant or collapsed responses do not dominate the reported fingerprints. These results provide a cohort-dependent proof of concept that deterministic neurochaotic response signatures can expose broad structure among frozen transformer input-embedding spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChaosProbe方法，利用确定性混沌轨迹变换对冻结Transformer模型的输入嵌入空间构建"响应指纹"。在80个中性提示和4个预训练模型（GPT-2、DistilGPT2、BERT-base、RoBERTa-base）的概念验证研究中，皮尔逊相关、斯皮尔曼相关和余弦相似度均成功恢复了所有同族最近邻分配和预期的互惠家族对，证明了神经混沌响应签名能揭示冻结Transformer输入嵌入空间的宏观结构。
AI.motivation: 传统上对Transformer模型的理解主要基于其下游任务表现或生成质量，但冻结的输入嵌入空间本身可以在上下文计算和任务特定适配之前，通过其对受控确定性探针的响应来考察。作者希望从响应视角探索嵌入空间的内部结构，而非仅关注行为层面的性能指标。
AI.method: ChaosProbe方法包含三个核心步骤：(1)对每个提示级嵌入矩阵应用基于混沌轨迹的确定性变换；(2)通过Firing Rate和Entropy通道响应进行总结，并辅以互补的表示级度量；(3)为每个模型生成固定长度的签名。模型中嵌入空间的相似性通过皮尔逊相关、斯皮尔曼相关、余弦相似度和欧氏距离等度量来评估。
AI.result: 在80个中性提示和4个模型的概念验证研究中，皮尔逊相关、斯皮尔曼相关和余弦相似度均恢复了全部4个同族最近邻分配和2个期望的互惠家族对；欧氏距离恢复了3个分配和1个互惠家族对。配对自助重采样支持皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼配对在提示集上的稳定性，签名有效性检查确认恒定或塌缩响应未主导报告指纹。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个依赖于模型群体的概念验证，表明确定性神经混沌响应签名能够揭示冻结Transformer输入嵌入空间的宏观结构，为理解模型嵌入空间的内部组织提供了一种新的、无需任务特定适配的分析视角。

title: A Benchmark Dataset for MLLM-Generated Image Detection: GPT Image2 & Nano Banana2
summary: The realism of images generated by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as GPT Image2 and Nano Banana2, has improved rapidly in recent years. Compared with early generative models, current models have made clear progress in text rendering. They can produce high-quality images that closely resemble real-world application scenarios. The enhanced generation capabilities of current MLLMs pose increasingly severe challenges to AI-generated image detection. Detection is no longer limited to identifying obvious artifacts left by early generators. Instead, it requires systematic and realistic benchmarks for the new generation of generated content. However, most existing benchmarks are still built around early generative models and cannot fully evaluate the forensic challenges introduced by high-quality and multi-form generated images. To address this gap, this paper constructs a benchmark dataset for detecting images generated by MLLMs. The benchmark covers several realistic application scenarios and adopts three generation protocols to simulate direct generation, reference-based reconstruction, and local editing. Based on this benchmark, we evaluate detector degradation from traditional scenarios to MLLM-generated images and analyze false positive rates and false negative rates across three sample types, revealing the failure modes of existing methods. We further propose a structural-artifact-prior-guided dual-stream prompt framework (SAP-DSP) as a strong baseline. SAP-DSP uses dual-stream prompt learning and structure-aware routing fusion to improve representation learning. Extensive experiments show that the proposed benchmark exposes the performance degradation of existing detectors on high-quality generated images, while SAP-DSP achieves more stable detection results on this benchmark. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/SAP-DSP.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成图像检测的基准数据集，涵盖多种真实应用场景和三种生成协议，并提出了一个结构伪影先验引导的双流提示框架（SAP-DSP）作为强基线，实验表明该基准能暴露现有检测器在高保真生成图像上的性能退化，SAP-DSP在此基准上表现更稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测基准大多基于早期生成模型构建，无法充分评估新一代MLLM（如GPT Image2）生成的高质量、多形态图像所带来的取证挑战。检测需求已从识别明显伪影转向系统性的现实基准评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建覆盖多个现实应用场景的MLLM生成图像检测基准数据集；2) 采用三种生成协议：直接生成、基于参考的重建、局部编辑；3) 提出结构伪影先验引导的双流提示框架（SAP-DSP），包含双流提示学习和结构感知路由融合。
AI.result: 基准实验揭示了现有检测器在高质量MLLM生成图像上的性能退化，并分析了三类样本（直接生成、重建、局部编辑）的假阳性率和假阴性率，暴露了现有方法的失败模式。SAP-DSP在该基准上取得了更稳定的检测结果。
AI.conclusion: 该基准数据集填补了MLLM生成图像检测评估的空白，SAP-DSP框架为高保真生成图像的检测提供了有效的强基线，代码和数据集已公开。

title: ScrambleToolBench: Agents Search Exhaustively Even When Their Own Map Points to the Next Step
summary: To operate robustly in open-world environments, autonomous agents should be able to infer the behavior of unfamiliar systems through interaction alone, even in the absence of documentation. However, existing tool-use benchmarks expose semantic tool schemas in static environments, allowing agents to rely on prior knowledge rather than autonomous discovery. To address this limitation, we introduce ScrambleToolBench, an interactive terminal benchmark designed to isolate behavioral reasoning. By removing semantic cues and enforcing a continuous task curriculum, the benchmark requires agents to uncover hidden tool behaviors entirely through trial-and-error interaction. The benchmark further introduces dynamic challenges, including mapping drift, stochastic action failures, and temporal execution windows, to evaluate whether agents can revise and adapt their hypotheses as the environment changes. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art language models reveals that successful initial discovery does not translate into robust adaptation. When faced with structural changes such as mapping drift, agents fail to use deductive strategies such as cycle tracing, and instead exhibit belief inertia or fall back to exhaustive search. Increasing test-time reasoning only amplifies this expensive brute-force search rather than enabling deductive recovery. While equipping agents with persistent memory reduces compounding errors, they remain unable to efficiently infer structural changes, highlighting a gap in current agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ScrambleToolBench，一个交互式终端基准测试，旨在隔离和评估智能体的行为推理能力。该基准通过去除语义线索、强制连续任务学习，以及引入动态挑战（映射漂移、随机动作失败、时间窗口），发现当前最先进语言模型在初始发现后无法稳健适应环境变化，存在信念惯性、依赖穷举搜索等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用基准测试在静态环境中暴露语义化工具模式，使智能体可依赖先验知识而非自主发现，无法评估其在开放世界中仅通过交互来推断陌生系统行为的能力。
AI.method: 构建ScrambleToolBench交互式终端基准：1) 移除语义线索，强制智能体通过试错交互发现隐藏工具行为；2) 实施连续任务课程；3) 引入动态挑战包括映射漂移、随机动作失败和时间执行窗口，测试智能体在环境变化下的假设修正与适应能力。
AI.result: 评估发现：成功的初始发现并不转化为稳健的适应能力。面对结构变化（如映射漂移），智能体无法使用演绎策略（如循环追踪），反而表现出信念惯性或退化为穷举搜索。增加测试时推理只会放大昂贵的暴力搜索，而非实现演绎恢复。配备持久记忆虽减少累积错误，但仍无法高效推断结构变化。
AI.conclusion: 当前语言模型在自主行为发现与动态适应之间存在显著差距，现有智能体推理能力无法有效处理环境结构变化，需要进一步发展能结合演绎推理与自适应假设修正的智能体机制。

title: Salami Attack: Stealthy Collusive Memory Poisoning against OpenClaw
summary: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to retain useful information across sessions, but also creates an attack surface through which adversaries may poison an agent's persistent memory to steer its behavior. Existing memory poisoning attacks mainly rely on individually malicious records, overlooking a compositional threat: multiple benign-looking memories may jointly induce unsafe behavior. In this paper, we introduce MemCollusion, an automated red-teaming framework for constructing collusive memory poisoning attacks. MemCollusion applies salami tactics---a strategy that slices an adversarial objective into small, individually innocuous pieces---to generate memory fragments that are individually benign looking but collectively harmful. It constructs memory coalitions using four design constraints, five theory-informed strategies, and a fine-tuned generator. To assess collusive memory poisoning in a realistic cross-session setting, we develop MoltLab, a controlled research reproduction of Moltbook, in which crafted platform content must first be observed and distilled into persistent memory before influencing the agent's behavior in a separate session. We evaluate MemCollusion on OpenClaw using two backbone models across 48 scenarios. Under the strongest memory-saving setting, MemCollusion achieves an average Memory Save Rate of 81.3% and an Attack Success Rate of 75.0%, and remains effective under both benign memory dilution and memory-level defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemCollusion，一种利用"沙拉米战术"构造合谋式记忆投毒攻击的自动化红队框架。它将恶意目标拆分为多个看似无害的记忆片段，这些片段单独看起来良性，但组合起来会产生有害行为。作者还开发了MoltLab实验平台，在跨会话场景中验证攻击效果：在最强记忆保留设置下达到81.3%的记忆保留率和75.0%的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆投毒攻击主要依赖单个恶意记录，忽视了组合性威胁——多个看似良性的记忆可能共同诱导不安全行为。这一研究空白使得LLM智能体的长期记忆面临尚未被充分认识的安全漏洞。
AI.method: MemCollusion框架包含三部分：(1) 沙拉米战术将对抗目标切片成小而看似无害的记忆片段；(2) 基于四个设计约束、五个理论驱动的策略以及微调生成器构建记忆联盟；(3) 开发MoltLab实验环境，模拟真实跨会话场景，要求平台内容先被观察并蒸馏为持久记忆，再在另一会话中影响智能体行为。
AI.result: 在OpenClaw上使用两个骨干模型、48个场景进行评估。在最强记忆保留设置下，平均记忆保留率81.3%，攻击成功率75.0%；在良性记忆稀释和记忆级防御下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一种新型组合式记忆投毒威胁，表明仅靠单个记忆验证不足以防御该类攻击，需要针对记忆联盟的联合防御机制。MemCollusion为评估和提升LLM智能体长期记忆的安全性提供了自动化红队工具。

title: AOS: Adaptive Optimizer Switching via Training-State Signals for Faster Convergence and Better Generalization
summary:
Single-optimizer training is a poor fit for the distinct phases of deep network optimization: adaptive methods handle noisy early gradients well but overshoot flat minima, while SGD with momentum generalizes better in the late phase but converges slowly early on.
  We introduce AOS-R (Adaptive Optimizer Switching, Rule-Based), a lightweight controller that monitors six online gradient-space signals -- gradient noise scale (GNS), Hutchinson curvature trace, loss stagnation, update stability ratio, gradient stability index (GSI), and loss improvement ratio (LIR) -- and switches among AdamW, SGD-M, and Lion as the optimization landscape evolves. State-preserving momentum transfer and a 400-step learning-rate bridge prevent accuracy degradation at every transition point.
  On CIFAR-100/WRN-28x10, AOS-R reaches 78% top-1 in 81 epochs -- 26% fewer than AdamW (109), 43% fewer than SGD-M (143), and 16% fewer than Lion (96). Across eight model-dataset benchmarks, AOS-R achieves best accuracy on 6 of 8 combinations with a mean +0.4 pp gain and 0.80x convergence speedup over AdamW under a single shared hyperparameter configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AOS-R (Adaptive Optimizer Switching, Rule-Based)，一种轻量级规则控制器，通过监控六种在线梯度空间信号（梯度噪声尺度、Hutchinson曲率迹、损失停滞、更新稳定性比率、梯度稳定性指数和损失改进比率），在训练过程中动态在AdamW、SGD-M和Lion之间切换优化器。通过状态保留动量转移和400步学习率桥接机制避免切换时的精度损失，在多个基准上实现了更快的收敛速度和更好的精度。
AI.motivation: 单一优化器在深度学习的不同训练阶段表现不佳：自适应方法（如AdamW）在早期能很好处理噪声梯度，但会在平坦最小值处超调；而带动量的SGD在后期泛化更好但在早期收敛缓慢。作者希望设计一个能够根据训练动态自适应切换优化器的方法，兼顾两种优化器的优势。
AI.method: AOS-R是一个基于规则的轻量级控制器，核心包括：(1) 监控六种在线梯度空间信号：梯度噪声尺度(GNS)、Hutchinson曲率迹、损失停滞、更新稳定性比率、梯度稳定性指数(GSI)和损失改进比率(LIR)；(2) 根据这些信号在AdamW、SGD-M和Lion之间切换；(3) 采用状态保留动量转移机制避免优化器切换时的状态丢失；(4) 使用400步学习率桥接来平滑过渡，防止每次切换时的精度下降。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100/WRN-28x10上，AOS-R仅用81个epoch达到78% top-1精度，比AdamW（109 epoch）少26%、比SGD-M（143 epoch）少43%、比Lion（96 epoch）少16%。在8个模型-数据集组合基准上，AOS-R在6/8的组合上取得最佳精度，平均提升+0.4个百分点，且在单一共享超参数配置下相比AdamW实现0.80倍收敛加速（即约20%的训练时间节省）。
AI.conclusion: 通过在不同训练阶段自适应切换最合适的优化器，AOS-R证明了规则驱动的优化器切换策略能够同时实现更快的收敛速度和更好的最终精度，且无需针对不同任务调整超参数，展示了一种实用且高效的优化器管理范式。

title: Rethinking Video Token Compression with a Global Codebook: Learning Once, Compressing Everywhere
summary: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) represent videos as dense sequences of visual tokens, whose length grows with the temporal and spatial extent of the input. These tokens often contain substantial redundancy arising from repeated visual patterns, leading to unnecessary computation in the subsequent language-model processing. Existing token compression methods, including pruning and merging, perform compression online during inference, repeatedly incurring additional computation for each input video and often relying on model-specific designs that limit their generality, we instead rethink this paradigm by shifting the costly compression process offline. We propose \textbf{ONCE}, a plug-in video token compression framework that introduces an offline-to-online paradigm: a frequency-aware global codebook is learned once in the visual feature space and reused for lightweight online compression through codebook lookup and aggregation, reducing repeated per-video computation and the need for model-specific compression designs. Extensive experiments across multiple video understanding benchmarks and against diverse compression baselines demonstrate that our approach achieves a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off, maintaining competitive performance while achieving the lowest inference latency among compared methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ONCE，一个即插即用的视频token压缩框架，通过离线学习频率感知的全局码本并在在线推理时仅通过码本查找和聚合实现轻量压缩，避免了传统在线压缩方法的高计算开销和模型依赖性问题，在保持竞争力的同时实现了最低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型将视频表示为密集的视觉token序列，这些token包含大量因重复视觉模式产生的冗余，导致语言模型处理阶段不必要的计算开销。现有token压缩方法（剪枝或合并）在推理时在线执行，每个输入视频都重复产生额外计算，且常依赖特定模型设计，限制了其通用性。
AI.method: 提出离线到在线的压缩范式：在视觉特征空间中一次性学习一个频率感知的全局码本，在线推理时通过简单的码本查找与聚合实现轻量级压缩，从而减少每个视频反复计算的需求，也摆脱了对特定模型设计的依赖。
AI.result: 在多个视频理解基准和多种压缩基线上的大量实验表明，该方法实现了良好的精度-效率权衡，在保持竞争性性能的同时，在对比方法中实现了最低的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: ONCE验证了将视频token压缩从在线移到离线的可行性，为视频大语言模型的效率优化提供了新的范式，既降低了每视频的计算开销又提高了方法的通用性。

title: Fast and Accurate Quotation Attribution in Literary Texts
summary: Attributing quotations to their speakers in literary texts remains an open challenge. Standard methods, which independently predict a speaker mention for each quotation, are efficient but still limited in accuracy. In contrast, large language model (LLM) approaches achieve strong performance, but their computational cost limits their use in large-scale literary analysis. We propose an encoder-based efficient formulation that resolves multiple quotation attributions within a shared, large context window. Using our new formulation, \textit{joint scoring}, we report state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the Project Dialogism Novel Corpus (PDNC), comprising more than 35,000 manually annotated quotations from 22 English novels. Our best model reaches 94.5\% overall attribution accuracy while processing novels $20\times$ faster than comparable standard methods and more than $1000\times$ faster than LLM-based approaches on an A100 GPU. An analysis of models' representations suggests that joint scoring improves on challenging attribution examples by preserving long-range anaphora resolution signal, an information that we found already present in pretrained encoders. To facilitate adoption, we release ModernBookNLP, a modified fork of BookNLP that replaces its quotation attribution model with our best system available at https://github.com/gasmichel/ModernBookNLP_QA/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于编码器的高效引语归属方法（joint scoring），在共享的大上下文窗口中同时解决多个引语的说话人归属任务。该方法在PDNC数据集上达到94.5%的准确率，速度比传统方法快20倍，比LLM方法快1000倍以上。
AI.motivation: 文学作品中的引语归属（即判断每句引语的说话人）仍是一个开放挑战。传统方法独立预测每个引语的说话人，效率高但准确率有限；而LLM方法虽然表现优异，但计算成本过高，难以应用于大规模文学分析。作者希望在准确率和效率之间找到更好的平衡点。
AI.method: 提出一种基于编码器的高效公式化方法——joint scoring，在共享的大上下文窗口中同时解决多个引语的归属问题。与独立预测每个引语的标准方法不同，该方法利用编码器的预训练表征来保留长距离指代消解信号，在同一个上下文中联合评分多个引语归属。
AI.result: 在PDNC数据集（22部英文小说、35,000+人工标注引语）上取得94.5%的整体归属准确率，达到SOTA性能。推理速度比标准方法快20倍，比LLM方法快1000倍以上（基于A100 GPU）。分析表明，joint scoring通过保留预训练编码器中已存在的长距离指代消解信号来改善困难样本的归属表现。
AI.conclusion: 提出的joint scoring方法在准确性和效率之间实现了优越的平衡，验证了预训练编码器本身已包含足以支撑长距离引语归属的信息。此外，作者发布了ModernBookNLP工具，将最佳系统集成到BookNLP中，便于社区采用。

title: GISAgentBench: A Practitioner-Sourced Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on GIS Tasks
summary: Geographic Information System (GIS) professionals rely on multi-step spatial analysis workflows to support decision-making in urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. The process is tedious, time-consuming, and error-prone. While recent large language model (LLM) agents equipped with external tools have the potential to automate geospatial analysis, their ability to perform realistic GIS workflows remains largely unexplored. Existing GIS agent benchmarking datasets are mostly drawn from textbooks, tutorials, or LLM-generated seeds and remain limited in size and trajectory depth. More importantly, none provides ground truth outputs. They therefore rely on surrogate signals such as code similarity, trajectory matching, or LLM and VLM judges, which can conflate workflow resemblance with task correctness. To address this gap, we introduce GISAgentBench, a benchmark of 349 multi-step GIS tasks curated from GIS Stack Exchange and instantiated on real public data across six selected geographic areas of interest. Each task ships with an executable reference trajectory and an exact ground truth output file, enabling strict, deterministic, tolerance-aware output matching beyond LLM judging. Evaluations of six LLM models reveal that realistic GIS workflows remain challenging: the best agent completes only 32.7% of tasks under strict tolerance-aware scoring, although most models produce outputs that are close to the ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GISAgentBench，一个包含349个多步GIS任务的基准测试集，任务来自GIS Stack Exchange并在真实公共数据上实例化，每个任务附带可执行的参考轨迹和精确的ground truth输出文件，支持严格的确定性容错输出匹配。对六个LLM模型的评估显示，最佳智能体在严格评分下仅能完成32.7%的任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的GIS智能体基准数据集多来自教科书、教程或LLM生成的种子数据，规模有限且缺乏轨迹深度；更重要的是，没有一个提供ground truth输出，只能依赖代码相似度、轨迹匹配或LLM/VLM评判等替代信号，这些信号可能混淆工作流相似性与任务正确性。真实的GIS工作流对LLM智能体的挑战尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 从GIS Stack Exchange策展349个多步GIS任务，在六个选定的地理区域兴趣点上用真实公共数据实例化。每个任务配有可执行的参考轨迹和精确的ground truth输出文件，采用严格、确定性、容错的输出匹配方式（而非LLM评判）进行评估。
AI.result: 对六个LLM模型的评估表明，真实GIS工作流仍然具有挑战性：最佳智能体在严格的容错感知评分下仅完成32.7%的任务，尽管大多数模型产生的输出已接近ground truth。
AI.conclusion: GISAgentBench填补了GIS智能体基准测试缺乏ground truth验证的空白，强调现有LLM智能体在真实GIS工作流上的能力仍有限，需要进一步改进。

title: Scikit-fingerprints: Python library for scikit-learn compatible molecular fingerprints and chemoinformatics
summary: We present scikit-fingerprints, a comprehensive, fully scikit-learn compatible library for molecular machine learning in Python, based on RDKit. Molecular fingerprints and related functionalities are workhorses of chemoinformatics, yet the widely used open-source frameworks are not compatible with the wider Python machine learning ecosystem based on scikit-learn conventions. scikit-fingerprints closes this gap, bringing molecular fingerprints, molecular filters, similarity and distance measures, applicability domain estimation, data splitting strategies, and more under a single, familiar interface. Scikit-learn compatibility means that an entire chemoinformatics workflow, from a raw SMILES string to a deployable model, can be assembled from composable building blocks and can reuse the mature tooling of the surrounding ecosystem. The underlying RDKit code makes it familiar and extensible for custom chemoinformatics use cases. We put a strong focus on unified interfaces, ease of use, computational efficiency, customization, and extensibility. scikit-fingerprints makes molecular machine learning faster to prototype, easier to reproduce, and simpler to deploy.

AI.tldr: scikit-fingerprints是一个基于RDKit的、完全兼容scikit-learn的分子机器学习Python库，将分子指纹、分子过滤、相似性度量、适用域估计、数据拆分策略等化学信息学功能统一到熟悉的scikit-learn接口下，使得从SMILES字符串到可部署模型的整个化学信息学工作流可以被组装和复用。
AI.motivation: 分子指纹是化学信息学的核心工具，但现有的开源框架与基于scikit-learn约定的Python机器学习生态系统不兼容，导致化学信息学工作流难以与更广泛的机器学习工具链无缝集成。
AI.method: 开发一个完全兼容scikit-learn的库，将分子指纹、分子过滤器、相似性和距离度量、适用域估计、数据拆分策略等统一到scikit-learn接口之下，底层基于RDKit实现，强调统一接口、易用性、计算效率、定制化和可扩展性。
AI.result: 提供了scikit-fingerprints库，使分子机器学习原型开发更快、复现更容易、部署更简单，并可直接复用scikit-learn生态中成熟的工具链。
AI.conclusion: 该库弥合了化学信息学与Python机器学习生态之间的鸿沟，为分子机器学习提供了标准化的、可组合的、可扩展的解决方案。

title: Astrolabe: Spherical-Map Guidance Across Diffusion Pipelines for Full-Body Capture from Unconstrained Images
summary: Full-body capture from unconstrained photographs requires global correspondence across arbitrary views, poses, crops, and occlusions. Yet pose, geometry, and foundation features estimated in this setting are too unreliable for dense matching or appearance transfer, while diffusion rectifiers and optimization pipelines expose no common interface for consuming such uncertain correspondence. Our insight is that correspondence need not be locally accurate: its coarse viewpoint and body layout can still organize how a diffusion prior adapts and guides reconstruction. We introduce \emph{Astrolabe}, a host-portable adapter built on frozen viewpoint-guided spherical maps (SPH). A fixed bounded transform converts SPH into a spatial noise shift, which is matched during prior adaptation and reused during downstream denoising or score-distillation guidance in both pipeline categories. When a rectifier exposes a reference router, the same target/reference SPH additionally supplies coarse compatibility scores to select native appearance features; router-free optimization uses only the shared shift path. Astrolabe therefore follows one SPH--shift--adapt--guide process without dense warping or a learned control branch. Across Puzzle-IOI and 4D-Dress, it improves all reported image metrics in both hosts and all paired Puzzle-IOI geometry metrics; image gains extend to rear views, while 4D-Dress geometry remains stable overall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Astrolabe，一种基于冻结视点引导球面映射（SPH）的宿主可移植适配器，通过将SPH转换为空间噪声位移来实现粗略对应关系引导，无需稠密匹配或学习控制分支，同时适用于扩散整流器和免路由优化管线，并在Puzzle-IOI和4D-Dress基准上全面改进图像指标。
AI.motivation: 无约束照片下的全身捕捉需要跨任意视角、姿态、裁剪和遮挡的全局对应关系，但该场景下估计的姿态、几何和基础特征过于不可靠，难以用于稠密匹配或外观迁移；现有的扩散整流器和优化管线缺乏统一接口来消费这种不确定的对应关系。
AI.method: 关键洞察是粗粒度的视点和身体布局对应关系仍足以组织扩散先验的适应与引导，不需要局部精确。Astrolabe构建在冻结的视点引导球面映射（SPH）之上，通过固定的有界变换将SPH转换为空间噪声位移，在适配阶段匹配该位移，并在去噪或分数蒸馏引导阶段复用。当整流器暴露参考路由器时，SPH提供粗粒度兼容分数来选择原生外观特征；免路由优化则仅使用共享位移路径。
AI.result: 在Puzzle-IOI和4D-Dress基准上，Astrolabe在两个宿主中均改善了所有报告的图像指标，并改善了Puzzle-IOI的所有配对几何指标；图像改进扩展到背面视角，而4D-Dress的几何指标整体保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: Astrolabe验证了在不可靠对应关系下，粗粒度空间引导足以有效驱动扩散先验进行全身重建，且单一SPH-位移-适配-引导流程无需稠密扭曲或学习控制分支即可跨两类管线迁移。

title: PredAct-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Augmented Dialogue under Controlled Tool Noise
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in task-oriented dialogue systems that support multi-step decision-making in high-stakes domains such as education, healthcare, and finance. However, existing benchmarks typically assume perfectly accurate tool outputs, overlooking the reality that deployed systems must operate with noisy tools and human decision-makers whose trust in the agent is itself uncertain. Such conditions are common in practice, for example, a clinician using a diagnostic prediction tool or an advisor relying on a model that forecasts student outcomes from historical records. We introduce PREDACTBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating dialogue agents paired with statistically imperfect tools, using education as a measurable testbed where ground truth outcomes and clear intervention decisions are available. First, we build a benchmark for AI-assisted human decision-making, where the AI uses noisy predictors to help guide a user. Second, we introduce episode-level Relative AI-Reliance (RAIR) and Relative self-reliance (RSR) metrics, extending prior trust calibration framework to multi-turn dialogue. Third, we evaluate 13 state-of-the-art closed and open source LLMs on two educational datasets, OULAD (real assessment trajectories from the UK Open University) and PREDACT-CS (60 courses with real final grade outcomes and synthetically generated weekly score trajectories), alongside a human study with instructors and teaching assistants. We find that when tools are noisy, SOTA models are supposed to provide visibility to teachers so that they do not over-rely on wrong suggestions or hallucinations, but current models fail to do that. We offer PREDACTBENCH to help build better LLMs as AI decision support systems to help teachers.

AI.tldr: PREDACTBENCH是一个用于评估对话式AI辅助决策系统在统计不完美（含噪）工具条件下的基准测试平台，以教育领域为测试场景，引入新的信任校准指标（RAIR和RSR），并评估了13个主流LLM在两个教育数据集上的表现，发现当前SOTA模型在工具输出有噪声时无法帮助人类决策者正确校准对AI建议的信任。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式AI基准测试假设工具输出完全准确，忽略了实际部署中工具存在噪声、人类决策者对智能体信任不确定等现实条件（如临床医生使用诊断预测工具、教育顾问依赖预测模型），导致现有评估体系无法反映真实世界AI辅助决策系统的性能。
AI.method: 1) 构建AI辅助人类决策的基准测试平台，AI使用有噪声的预测工具引导用户；2) 提出回合级别的相对AI依赖度（RAIR）和相对自我依赖度（RSR）指标，扩展先前信任校准框架至多轮对话场景；3) 在两个教育数据集（OULAD真实评估轨迹和PREDACT-CS合成周度成绩轨迹）上评估13个闭源和开源LLM，并开展包含教师和助教的人类研究。
AI.result: 发现当工具存在噪声时，SOTA模型本应向教师提供可见性以防止他们对错误建议或幻觉过度依赖，但当前所有评估的模型均未能做到这一点。
AI.conclusion: PREDACTBENCH的提出旨在帮助构建更好的LLM作为AI决策支持系统，以更好地辅助教师等人类决策者。

title: LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
summary: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.

AI.tldr: LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) 是一个硬件-算法协同设计的稀疏注意力框架，通过三种正交策略（流式感知索引、跨层索引、层次化索引）解决 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 中 Lightning Indexer 的 O(L²) 计算开销和不连续内存访问问题，支持从 69B-A3B 到 560B-A27B 规模模型的百万 token 上下文本地训练，并开源了 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse 模型。
AI.motivation: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) 虽然通过 Lightning Indexer 实现了高效的长上下文建模，但在实际部署中面临两大系统级瓶颈：(1) indexer 的 O(L²) 评分开销过高；(2) indexer 输出导致的不连续内存访问模式对硬件不友好，影响 HBM 访问效率。这些瓶颈制约了 DSA 在生产环境中的落地应用。
AI.method: 提出三种互补且正交的策略：(1) Streaming-Aware Indexing：将分散的 KV 条目转换为硬件对齐的连续布局，实现合并的 HBM 访问；(2) Cross-Layer Indexing：通过跨层蒸馏，在单层计算的索引结果在连续层之间复用，摊销索引开销；(3) Hierarchical Indexing：采用从粗到细的评分方案，逐步缩小每个查询的候选集，显著减少索引计算量。
AI.result: 在 69B-A3B 到 560B-A27B 规模的扩展实验中，LSA 在通用和长上下文基准上均达到与全注意力相当的性能。支持多达 100 万 token 的本地训练，并支撑了 LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B) 的开发。开源了集成 LSA 的 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B) 模型。
AI.conclusion: LSA 通过硬件-算法协同设计有效解决了 DSA 的系统级瓶颈，在不损失注意力质量的前提下显著提高了稀疏注意力的计算效率和硬件友好性，为大规模长上下文模型的训练和部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: DART: Decoded Attention over Recurrent States for Efficient Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Modern language models are built primarily from Transformers, recurrent models, and their hybrid architectures. Transformers rely on token-level attention memories, while recurrent models such as state space models (SSMs) and linear attention maintain compact recurrent states. These architectures are typically instantiated separately or interleaved at the layer level, leaving open whether a shared memory representation can support both recurrent compression and attention-style retrieval. We study this question through the state space duality (SSD) view of Mamba-2, where the SSM state can be interpreted as a compressed associative key--value (KV) cache. We observe that Mamba-2 decodes token-conditioned values from this state but does not decode token-conditioned keys. Based on this observation, we propose DART (Decoded Attention over Recurrent sTates), which retains the chunk state contributions produced by the Mamba-2 chunked scan as chunk state memories, decodes token-conditioned keys and values from these memories, and performs state-memory attention (SMA) over the resulting KV pairs. The retrieved output is then combined with the native Mamba-2 output through a gated residual connection. DART supports practical training by reusing the Mamba-2 chunked scan and implementing SMA as a FlashAttention-style computation. Our analysis and experiments show that DART substantially reduces the length-dependent inference cache compared with a matched attention baseline (e.g., $75\%$ savings when the chunk size is $S=256$ and the state size is $N=128$). Compared with Mamba-2, DART substantially improves associative recall and retrieval while preserving general language-modeling quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DART（Decoded Attention over Recurrent sTates），基于Mamba-2的状态空间对偶（SSD）视角，将SSM状态视为压缩的键值（KV）缓存。DART保留Mamba-2块扫描产生的块状态记忆，从中解码出token条件化的键和值，并执行状态记忆注意力（SMA）。该方法相比匹配的注意力基线大幅减少长度相关的推理缓存（块大小S=256、状态大小N=128时节省75%），相比Mamba-2显著提升关联回忆和检索能力，同时保持通用语言建模质量。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型架构（Transformer、循环模型及其混合）通常将注意力记忆和循环压缩状态分开实例化或在层级别交错，尚未探索是否可以用共享的记忆表示同时支持循环压缩和注意力式检索。作者发现Mamba-2从SSM状态中解码token条件化的值，但不解码token条件化的键，这启发了设计一种同时利用两者能力的统一记忆表示。
AI.method: DART方法包括：(1) 保留Mamba-2块扫描产生的块状态贡献作为块状态记忆；(2) 从这些记忆中解码token条件化的键和值；(3) 对生成的KV对执行状态记忆注意力（SMA）；(4) 将检索输出通过门控残差连接与原生Mamba-2输出结合。训练方面，DART复用Mamba-2块扫描并将SMA实现为FlashAttention风格的计算。
AI.result: 实验和分析表明：DART相比匹配的注意力基线显著减少长度相关的推理缓存（块大小S=256、状态大小N=128时节省75%）；相比Mamba-2，DART在关联回忆和检索任务上表现显著提升，同时保持通用的语言建模质量。
AI.conclusion: DART证明了一个共享的记忆表示可以同时支持循环压缩和注意力式检索，填补了Transformer注意力和循环模型之间的架构空白，为设计更高效且检索能力更强的语言模型提供了新方向。

title: TurboClear: One-Step Object-Effect Removal via Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching and Fusion
summary: Recently, diffusion-based removal methods have achieved promising visual quality in removing both target objects and their associated effects. However, they typically rely on multi-step denoising, leading to high inference cost. Directly applying existing one-step distillation methods is also suboptimal, since their global objectives lack explicit region-wise calibration and may weaken the asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior required by object-effect removal. To address these challenges, we propose TurboClear, a one-step SDXL-based object-effect removal model. During training, we design Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching (RDM) for region-aware distillation to preserve the teacher model's asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior. Furthermore, we propose Learnable Spatial Fusion (LSF) for lightweight inference-time fusion. Extensive experiments show that TurboClear significantly improves inference efficiency while maintaining competitive visual quality. TurboClear reduces the computational overhead by up to $40.04\times$ compared to ObjectClear, and by up to $665\times$ against the Flux-based method OmniPaint, all while maintaining comparable or better visual removal quality. Code is available at https://github.com/GuoCalix/TurboClear.

AI.tldr: TurboClear是一个基于SDXL的单步对象-效果移除模型，通过区域校准分布匹配（RDM）和可学习空间融合（LSF）在保持视觉质量的同时实现快速推理，相比ObjectClear最高加速40.04倍，相比OmniPaint最高加速665倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散式去除方法虽能同时移除目标物体及其相关效果，但依赖多步去噪导致推理成本高。现有的单步蒸馏方法由于全局目标缺乏区域级校准，无法保持对象-效果移除任务所需的不对称编辑-保持行为，因此直接应用效果欠佳。
AI.method: 提出TurboClear，一个单步SDXL对象-效果移除模型。训练阶段设计区域校准分布匹配（RDM）用于区域感知蒸馏，保持教师模型的不对称编辑-保持行为；推理阶段提出可学习空间融合（LSF）实现轻量级融合。
AI.result: 实验表明TurboClear在保持可比的视觉移除质量的同时显著提高了推理效率，相比ObjectClear降低计算开销最高40.04倍，相比Flux-based的OmniPaint最高665倍。
AI.conclusion: TurboClear通过区域感知蒸馏和轻量级推断融合策略，成功实现了对象-效果移除任务中高效率与高质量的统一，代码已开源。
