title: Training-Free versus Training-Based Intent Classification in LLMs: Accuracy, Robustness, and Failure Modes
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Intent classification in Large Language Models (LLMs) involves categorizing user prompts into predefined classes. For instance, given a user prompt, the system must determine whether it primarily concerns mathematics, coding, or general text processing. Such classification enables routing prompts to specialized models optimized for specific domains, improving both accuracy and computational efficiency. In this work, we conduct a systematic study comparing training-free vs training-based approaches for intent classification. For this purpose, we consider two lightweight, training-free methods based on statistics of internal representations and compare them against MLP classifiers and linear probes. Our comprehensive empirical evaluation reveals that 1) Both training-free and training-based methods saturate easy benchmarks (mathematics vs. coding vs. natural language), 2) Training-based classifiers have an advantage on harder classification tasks (e.g. Java vs Python), and 3) Training-free methods are generally more robust to mixed-intent and adversarial prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了面向LLM意图分类的免训练方法与基于训练的方法，发现两者在简单基准上均达到饱和，基于训练的分类器在困难任务上更优，而免训练方法对混合意图和对抗性提示更具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 意图分类对于将用户提示路由到专门模型至关重要，可提升准确性和计算效率。然而，目前缺乏对免训练与基于训练方法的系统性比较研究，作者旨在填补这一空白，为实际应用中的方法选择提供指导。
AI.method: 本文采用两种轻量级免训练方法（基于内部表示的统计特征）与MLP分类器及线性探针等基于训练的方法进行对比，在多种分类任务（从简单的数学/编程/自然语言到困难的Java vs Python编程语言区分）上进行系统性的经验评估。
AI.result: 实验发现：1）免训练和基于训练的方法在简单基准任务上均达到饱和性能；2）在更困难的分类任务（如区分不同编程语言）上，基于训练的分类器具有优势；3）免训练方法对混合意图和对抗性提示更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 两种方法各有优劣：基于训练的方法在困难分类任务上表现更好，而免训练方法在鲁棒性方面更胜一筹。这提示实际应用中应根据任务难度和对鲁棒性的需求来选择合适的方法。

title: Allocation Before Ranking: Decoupled Token Compression for OmniLLMs
summary: Token compression in OmniLLMs is typically posed as a single saliency-ranking problem: score each multimodal token, keep the top-K. We argue this abstraction is mis-specified. The same attention score simultaneously decides two things: how much retained capacity each modality receives, and which tokens within a modality are kept. A shared top-K rule therefore inherits this audio-favoring allocation prior, spending retained capacity on audio before video tokens have a chance to compete. We propose Macer, a training-free compressor that first assigns explicit audio and video budgets, then performs allocation-normalized ranking within each modality at modality-specific shallow layers. Macer significantly reduces token cost while preserving accuracy across audio-grounded, audio--video joint, visual-dominant, and video-centric benchmarks. At 25 % retention, Macer preserves 98.7 % of full-token performance on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and 97.3 % on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B. On Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, this 25 % setting reaches OmniZip-level performance at 45 % retention while using lower FLOPs. On OmniVinci-9B, the same allocation-before-ranking principle improves over shared top-K ranking by up to 12.9 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Macer，一种无需训练的多模态token压缩方法。它指出传统top-K压缩方法存在缺陷：单一的注意力分数同时决定了模态间的容量分配和模态内的token保留，导致语音模态被过度偏好。Macer通过先显式分配音频和视频预算，再在各模态内进行分配归一化排名，在25%保留率下保持98.7%（7B模型）和97.3%（3B模型）的完整性能。
AI.motivation: 现有OmniLLM（全模态大语言模型）的token压缩方法，将压缩问题简单化为单一的显著性排名问题（对所有多模态token打分并保留top-K）。作者认为这种抽象定义是错误的，因为同一个注意力分数同时决定了两件事：每个模态获得多少保留容量，以及模态内哪些token被保留。这种共享top-K规则继承了音频偏好的分配先验，导致保留容量在视频token有机会竞争之前就被音频token消耗掉了。
AI.method: Macer是一种无需训练的压缩器，包含两个关键步骤：1）首先为音频和视频显式分配各自的token预算（budget）；2）然后在各模态内特定的浅层，执行分配归一化的排名（allocation-normalized ranking），即在每个模态内部根据归一化后的分数进行token选择，而不是跨模态统一排名。
AI.result: Macer在音频接地、音视频联合、视觉主导和视频中心等多种基准上显著降低token成本同时保持精度。在25%保留率下，Qwen2.5-Omni-7B保持98.7%的完整token性能，Qwen2.5-Omni-3B保持97.3%。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上，25%设置达到OmniZip在45%保留率下的性能且FLOPs更低。在OmniVinci-9B上，分配优先于排名的原则相比共享top-K排名最多提升12.9个点。
AI.conclusion: Macer验证了"先分配、后排名"（allocation-before-ranking）原则的有效性：通过在压缩前显式分离模态间的容量分配与模态内的token选择，可以避免共享top-K固有的模态偏见，在显著压缩token成本的同时更好地保留多模态信息。该原则在不同模型规模（3B/7B）和不同架构（Qwen2.5-Omni/OmniVinci）上均表现出鲁棒性。

title: Upper-Expectile Multi-Step Q-Learning for Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-step returns accelerate reward propagation in off-policy reinforcement learning, but couple the evaluation of each decision to the suboptimal logged actions that follow it, inducing a pessimistic bias that grows with the horizon. We propose Expectile $n$-step Q-learning (ENQ), which replaces the symmetric $n$-step temporal-difference (TD) loss with an asymmetric expectile loss on the action-value error, with expectile level $τ$ as the only method-specific hyperparameter added beyond $n$-step TD. We prove that the ENQ operator is a $γ^{n}$-contraction. Under deterministic dynamics, at $τ=1$, its bias vanishes at the optimal action-value function $Q^*$ on covered in-support pairs, and the corresponding fixed point satisfies the separation-$n$ instance and its multiples of the lower-bound inequality used by Long-Horizon Q-learning (LQL). Under stochastic dynamics, the operator bias admits two-sided bounds with horizon-independent noise constants. Using a single expectile level $τ=0.8$ and a fixed backup horizon across 27 manipulation and navigation task instances, ENQ is competitive with LQL on aggregate, achieves higher measured training-step throughput in our profiling study, and benefits more from a ten-critic ensemble in a controlled scaling experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出期望分位数n步Q学习（ENQ），用非对称期望分位数损失替换对称的n步时序差分损失，在保留n步返回加速奖励传播优势的同时，减少对次优日志动作的悲观偏差，并在理论保证与实验性能上均表现出竞争力。
AI.motivation: n步返回在离策略强化学习中能加速奖励传播，但后续的次优日志动作会引入随horizon增长而放大的悲观偏差。作者希望设计一种方法，既能保留n步学习的优点，又能减少这种偏差。
AI.method: ENQ将n步TD的对称损失替换为动作值误差上的非对称期望分位数损失，仅引入期望分位数水平τ这一个额外超参数。论文证明ENQ算子为γ^n-收缩，并在确定性动力学下τ=1时偏差在最优Q*的覆盖对上消失。
AI.result: 在27个操纵与导航任务实例上，使用单一期望分位数水平τ=0.8和固定backup horizon，ENQ在总体表现上与LQL竞争，训练吞吐更高，且在十评论家集成的受控扩展实验中获益更多。
AI.conclusion: ENQ通过非对称期望分位数损失有效缓解了n步返回的悲观偏差问题，在理论上具有收缩性和偏差界保证，在实践上以更少的超参数实现了与LQL相当甚至更优的性能。

title: UDT: Reconciling U-Nets and Diffusion Transformers with Data-Adaptive Token Reduction
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a core architecture in generative modeling due to their scalability and adaptability to multimodal tasks. DiTs comprise isotropic transformer blocks, and learn representations progressively across depth, where the denoising objective drives later layers to focus on fine-detail reconstruction. This results in degraded representation quality and an imbalanced encoder-decoder behavior. Prior approaches such as representation alignment (REPA) mitigate this by encouraging stronger early representations via training regularization. Alternatively, U-Net-style DiT architectures introduce explicit multi-scale encoder-decoder structures for improved convergence. But they build on standard U-Net wisdom via learnable operators for spatial downsampling, which are not well-suited to transformer architectures, introducing inefficiencies and compatibility issues with components such as cross-attention and representation regularization. In this work, we propose UDT, a U-Net diffusion transformer that combines the representation power of DiTs with the encoding-decoding benefits of U-Nets, through data-adaptive token merging for downsampling and upsampling, while preserving the DiT token dimension. Our baseline UDT architecture outperforms existing U-Net DiTs and achieves performance comparable to REPA across all model sizes. Furthermore, using architectural optimization and REPA, UDT outperforms SiT's 7.9 FID at 1400 epochs (w/o CFG) within 40 epochs (~ 40x faster convergence) for XL model size on 256x256 ImageNet. Finally, it achieves strong image generation performance with CFG, reaching FID of 1.38 (320 epochs) with SD-VAE and 1.35 (500 epochs) with VA-VAE, providing a new backbone for DiTs with strong empirical benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UDT，一种结合DiT表示能力与U-Net编码-解码优势的U-Net扩散Transformer架构，通过数据自适应token合并实现高效下采样和上采样，在保持DiT token维度的同时显著加速收敛，以更少训练轮次达到或超越现有方法性能。
AI.motivation: DiT的表示质量随深度退化且编码器-解码器行为不平衡，现有解决方案（如REPA训练正则化和U-Net风格DiT）各有局限：前者改善早期表示但未解决架构问题，后者使用可学习算子进行空间下采样，与Transformer架构不兼容，引入效率问题和与交叉注意力、表示正则化的兼容性障碍。
AI.method: 提出UDT架构：采用数据自适应的token合并机制进行下采样和上采样，保留DiT的token维度特性，将U-Net的多尺度编码器-解码器结构融入DiT，既保持DiT的表示能力又获得U-Net的编码-解码收益，并可结合REPA正则化进一步提升。
AI.result: UDT基线在全部模型规模上优于现有U-Net DiT方法，性能与REPA相当。通过架构优化和REPA，在256x256 ImageNet XL模型上仅用40 epochs达到SiT在1400 epochs的7.9 FID结果（约40倍收敛加速）。带CFG时达到FID 1.38（320 epochs，SD-VAE）和1.35（500 epochs，VA-VAE）的强生成性能。
AI.conclusion: UDT为DiT提供了新的骨干架构，通过自适应token合并成功融合U-Net和DiT的优势，在显著加速收敛的同时实现更强的图像生成性能，具有可靠的实证收益。

title: CTRAG: An In-Context Retrieval-based Framework for Automated Compliance Checking using LLMs
summary: Trust is fundamental in modern regulatory ecosystems, and compliance checking plays a critical role in fostering that trust. Regulatory compliance verification is essential for businesses operating in highly controlled environments, as it ensures alignment with sector-specific guidelines across domains such as financial reporting, data privacy, and cybersecurity. Manual compliance testing, however, is often time-intensive and prone to inconsistencies, particularly when compliance depends indirectly on third-party services such as cloud providers, where vendors rely on external providers to meet regulatory standards. In this paper, we present CTRAG, a novel Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline designed for automated compliance checking. CTRAG employs advanced strategies, including adaptive chunking, dynamic retrieval configurations, and in-context learning, to improve the precision and relevance of compliance assessments. By extracting control questions from regulatory texts and cross-referencing them with unstructured company documentation, CTRAG achieves highly accurate, document-informed compliance verification, even in cases of indirect compliance through third-party services. Empirical evaluations demonstrate significant improvements, with CTRAG achieving an F1-score of 78% and a recall of 85% in the final deployed configuration, ensuring minimal missed non-compliance cases while reducing manual reviewer effort in a real-world deployment. To validate CTRAG value, we developed and deployed a POC within a Big Four professional services firm, applying it to real-world cases and cross-checking results against manual compliance reports. These findings highlight CTRAG potential to streamline compliance workflows, mitigate risks, and enhance regulatory trust in complex, high-stakes environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTRAG，一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的自动化合规检查流水线，通过自适应分块、动态检索配置和上下文学习等策略，从监管文本中提取控制问题并与公司文档交叉比对，实现高精度的合规验证。在四大会计师事务所的真实部署中，F1分数达78%，召回率达85%，显著减少人工审查工作量。
AI.motivation: 手动合规测试耗时且不一致，尤其当合规间接依赖第三方服务（如云供应商）时更为复杂。企业需要自动化解决方案来确保与金融报告、数据隐私和网络安全等领域的监管标准保持一致。
AI.method: CTRAG采用检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，包含三个关键策略：自适应分块（adaptive chunking）优化文本切片、动态检索配置（dynamic retrieval configurations）提升检索精度、上下文学习（in-context learning）增强理解能力。流程包括从监管文本中提取控制问题，并与非结构化公司文档进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 在最终部署配置中，CTRAG达到78%的F1分数和85%的召回率，确保最少遗漏不合规案例。在四大会计师事务所的真实环境中部署了概念验证（POC），应用于真实案例并与人工合规报告交叉验证，显著减少了人工审查工作量。
AI.conclusion: CTRAG展示了自动化合规检查在复杂高风险环境中的实际价值，能够简化合规工作流程、降低风险，并增强监管信任，尤其适用于涉及第三方服务的间接合规场景。

title: TCPO: Turn-Level Credit Policy Optimization
summary: Verifier-guided reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for improving LLM reasoning. In multi-turn settings, models receive a verifier score after each turn and iteratively refine their outputs. Although such scores provide dense feedback, they do not directly provide dense credit: a score measures the quality of the current output, while credit should measure how the current turn changes the refinement trajectory. We propose TCPO, a turn-level credit assignment method for verifier-guided multi-turn RL. TCPO casts credit assignment as score-to-credit conversion and constructs turn-level advantages through reference-based comparisons: retrospective credit captures immediate progress and regression relative to the best prior state; hindsight delayed credit identifies non-improving turns with later payoff; and selective fixed-history counterfactual estimation refines high-surprisal turns under the same history. Experiments on math reasoning, code generation, and AppWorld agent tasks show that TCPO improves or matches the strongest baselines across model scales, task domains, and verifier types. TCPO achieves the best or tied-best best-turn Pass@8 on Qwen3-4B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, reduces turns to success, and improves multi-turn agent performance. These results highlight score-to-credit conversion as a central ingredient for verifier-guided multi-turn policy optimization.

AI.tldr: TCPO是一种面向验证器引导的多轮强化学习的回合级信用分配方法，将分数转换为信用，通过多种参考比较机制（回顾性信用、后见延迟信用、选择性固定历史反事实估计）构建回合级优势函数，在数学推理、代码生成和AppWorld智能体任务上优于或匹配最强基线。
AI.motivation: 在多轮设置中，LLM每回合都会收到验证器分数并迭代优化输出。虽然这些分数提供了密集的反馈信号，但它们并不直接提供密集的信用（credit）分配——分数衡量的是当前输出的质量，而信用应当衡量当前回合如何改变了优化轨迹。现有方法无法有效区分"改进当前输出"与"改进优化过程"之间的差异，缺乏回合级的信用分配机制。
AI.method: TCPO将信用分配问题建模为"分数到信用"的转换，通过三种基于参考的比较机制构建回合级优势函数：(1) 回顾性信用——捕捉相对于最佳历史状态的即时进展和回退；(2) 后见延迟信用——识别那些在当下无改进但后续产生收益的回合；(3) 选择性固定历史反事实估计——在相同历史条件下对高意外度回合进行精细化反事实估计。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和AppWorld智能体任务上的实验表明，TCPO在多种模型规模、任务领域和验证器类型下均优于或匹配最强基线。在Qwen3-4B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上取得了最佳或并列最佳的best-turn Pass@8，减少了成功回合数，并提升了多回合智能体性能。
AI.conclusion: "分数到信用"的转换是验证器引导的多回合策略优化的核心要素，TCPO通过显式区分输出质量与回合贡献，有效解决了多回合RL中的信用分配问题。

title: Convex Neural Energy Elements: Monolithic Finite-Element Assembly of Geometry-Parameterized Neural Operators with Stability and Error Guarantees
summary: Extending the neural-operator element method from individually trained, fixed-geometry neural elements to a library of reusable, geometry-parameterized element types fails structurally: a field-predicting operator trained by value regression induces an energy whose assembled Hessian is indefinite, and Newton converges to spurious minima (247% error) even with 1%-accurate field predictions. We introduce convex neural energy elements: each element exports a scalar energy E(g,U), architecturally convex in its boundary degrees of freedom U and smoothly parameterized by its geometry g, realized as a hypernetwork-generated positive-semidefinite quadratic form (an input-convex correction is reserved for non-quadratic physics). A regularization-nullspace principle--the regularizer's nullspace must contain the physics nullspace--removes an otherwise irreducible bias, and assembled elements inherit the classical guarantee that singular element stiffnesses yield a positive-definite global system. We prove conditional error bounds (energy-to-solution accuracy, element-count scaling, geometry generalization) and verify each experimentally. On heat conduction with elliptic holes, one trained element assembles into 2x2 to 8x8 grids and an L-shaped layout of unseen geometries at 0.6-1.0% relative L2 error, with 175x faster per-geometry setup for boundary-quantity workloads. A second trained element type mixes freely with the first in one monolithic assembly, and a three-dimensional instantiation reaches 0.23% on eight-element assemblies--the guarantees are type- and dimension-agnostic. A plane-strain elasticity element, whose physics nullspace is three-dimensional, lands on the analytically predicted regularization floors. Making the energy the learned object turns neural operators from single-use surrogates into reusable elements that inherit the assembly guarantees of the method they extend.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"凸神经能量单元"（convex neural energy elements），将神经算子元方法从固定几何的个体训练扩展到可复用、几何参数化的单元库。每个单元输出一个标量能量E(g,U)，在边界自由度U上架构性凸、在几何g上光滑参数化，通过超网络生成正半定二次型实现，并引入正则化-零空间原理消除不可约偏差。实验证明该方法在热传导、弹性力学及三维场景中均达到高精度，且继承了经典有限元装配的全局正定保证。
AI.motivation: 直接将神经算子元方法从单独训练的固定几何神经单元扩展到可复用、几何参数化单元库在结构上失败：通过值回归训练的场预测算子诱导的能量其装配Hessian不定，即使场预测精度达1%，牛顿法仍收敛到伪最小值（247%误差）。这表明需要重新设计学习对象，使能量本身成为学习目标。
AI.method: 每个单元导出标量能量E(g,U)，在边界自由度U上架构性凸、在几何参数g上光滑参数化，通过超网络生成正半定二次型实现（非二次物理保留输入凸修正）。提出正则化-零空间原理：正则化器的零空间必须包含物理零空间，以消除不可约偏差。装配后的单元继承经典保证：奇异单元刚度产生全局正定系统。
AI.result: 在带椭圆孔的热传导问题中，单个训练单元可装配成2x2至8x8网格及L形未知几何布局，相对L2误差0.6-1.0%，边界量工作负载几何设置加速175倍。第二类单元可与第一类自由混合装配；三维实例在八单元装配上达到0.23%误差。平面应变弹性单元的零空间为三维，落在解析预测的正则化下限上。
AI.conclusion: 将能量作为学习对象，使神经算子从一次性替代模型转变为可复用单元，继承了被扩展方法的装配保证。该方法的保证与单元类型和维度无关，证明了神经能量单元框架的通用性和稳定性。

title: Ranking Image Fusion the Way Humans Do: A Learned Pairwise Preference Metric for Infrared-Visible Fusion Assessment
summary: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has no ideal fused reference, so fusion algorithms are routinely ranked by scalar objective metrics that formalize different proxies for information transfer, structure, or source similarity. These proxies often disagree with the judgment that ultimately matters: given the same sources, which of two fused results does a human prefer? Direct pairwise comparison is an established reference protocol for relative subjective assessment, but its cost grows quadratically with the number of algorithms, which prevents routine use. We present the Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure (LPIFM), a source-conditioned model that operationalizes the human A/B/Tie comparison protocol as a repeatable, scalable surrogate. LPIFM jointly observes the infrared source, the visible source, and two fused candidates, and predicts whether candidate A is better, candidate B is better, or the two are perceptually equivalent. Supervision comes from a new dense preference corpus that covers every unordered comparison among a broad pool of fusion methods on the scenes of a public benchmark, labeled under a blinded, randomized, two-stage protocol with expert adjudication. Across scene- and method-generalization settings, LPIFM tracks human pairwise decisions closely and reproduces the tie-aware Bradley-Terry rankings derived from human labels; on full method pools it surpasses the strongest conventional metric by a wide margin in both pairwise accuracy and ranking correlation. We release the annotated preference dataset, together with the LPIFM model weights, source code, and evaluation code, to support preference-aligned IVIF assessment. LPIFM offers a practical instrument for human-aligned method comparison and ranking at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LPIFM（学习感知图像融合度量），一种基于源条件模型的红外-可见光图像融合（IVIF）客观评价指标。LPIFM联合观察红外源、可见光源和两个融合候选结果，直接预测人类A/B/Tie比较协议的输出，作为可扩展、可重复的人类主观评价替代方案。作者构建了密集的成对偏好标注数据集，实验表明LPIFM在成对准确率和排序相关性上大幅超越传统指标。
AI.motivation: 现有IVIF融合算法通常依靠标量客观指标（如信息传递、结构、源相似性的代理）进行排名，但这些指标常常与人类真实偏好不一致。直接进行人类成对比较虽然准确，但成本随算法数量呈二次方增长，无法常规使用。因此需要一个能模拟人类判断的可扩展替代方案。
AI.method: LPIFM是一个源条件模型，同时输入红外源图像、可见源图像以及两个融合候选，输出三个类别（A更好、B更好、或感知等效）的预测。模型通过新的密集偏好语料库进行监督训练，该语料覆盖了广泛融合方法之间所有无序比较，采用盲法、随机化、两阶段标注协议并由专家裁定。将人类标签转化为tie-aware Bradley-Terry排名用于训练和评估。
AI.result: 在场景泛化和方法泛化两种设置下，LPIFM与人类成对决策高度一致，并能重现基于人类标签的tie-aware Bradley-Terry排名。在完整方法池上，LPIFM在成对准确率和排名相关性方面均大幅超越最强的传统指标。同时释出了标注偏好数据集、模型权重、源代码和评估代码。
AI.conclusion: LPIFM提供了一种实用且与人类对齐的IVIF评估工具，能够在规模上进行方法比较和排名，填补了传统客观指标与人类主观判断之间的鸿沟，是该领域向前迈出的重要一步。

title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs
comment: 45 pages, 23 figures, 18 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aragoner/folkmotif Code: https://github.com/AragonerUA/folkmotif
summary: Open-source LLMs reliably name Zeus, Jupiter, and Thor, but recover their counterparts in less-represented traditions like Finnish, Slavic, Egyptian, or Chinese mythology far less consistently. We ask where inside the model this cultural default is produced. On a parallel cross-cultural substrate of Thompson-motif entities, we instrument 18 open-source LLMs from 8 architecture families with linear probing, logit lens, activation patching, and output extraction. The residual stream cleanly distinguishes cultures, well above a name-string baseline, yet the decoder collapses culturally-specific tokens onto dominant-tradition ones. The failure is at readout, not at representation. Asking the same question in the target culture's native language versus English produces failures that cluster within language but decouple across language: the decoder is gated on prompt language. We release a per-entity (probe, output) decomposition framework, a citation-anchored cross-cultural ground truth, a within- versus cross-mode correlation test for language-conditioned readout, and per-entity predictions for all 18 models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了开源LLM在不同文化神话实体命名中的系统性偏差。通过跨文化主题基底的线性探针、logit透镜、激活修补和输出提取工具，对18个开源LLM（8个架构家族）进行仪器分析，发现残差流能清晰区分文化，但解码器将文化特异性token坍缩到主导传统上。问题出在读出阶段而非表征阶段，且解码器受提示语言门控。
AI.motivation: 开源LLM在主流文化（如希腊神话）命名上表现可靠，但在芬兰、斯拉夫、埃及或中国等代表性不足的传统中恢复对应实体时表现不稳定。作者想定位这种文化默认偏见在模型内部何处产生，以理解模型的文化表征与输出之间的脱节。
AI.method: 在平行跨文化汤普森母题实体基底上，对18个开源LLM（8个架构家族）进行四重仪器分析：线性探针、logit透镜、激活修补和输出提取。同时对比目标文化母语与英语提问条件，并发布包括逐实体（探针、输出）分解框架、引用锚定跨文化真值、语内vs语间相关测试及全部18个模型的逐实体预测。
AI.result: 残差流中文化信息可清晰区分（远超名字字符串基线），但解码器将文化特异性token坍缩到主导传统上。失败发生在读出阶段而非表征阶段。语言条件内失败聚类，但跨语言解耦——解码器以提示语言为门控条件。
AI.conclusion: 文化偏见不是表征缺陷，而是解码读出阶段的结构性缺陷。提示语言决定解码器的输出路径，导致模型虽"知道"文化信息却无法生成正确的文化特异性输出。作者发布了一套完整的分解框架和资源以支持进一步研究。

title: When Memory Becomes Authority: Benchmarking Authority Collapse at the Memory Consolidation Boundary
summary:
Persistent memory allows (self-evolving) LLM agents to adapt across tasks by consolidating heterogeneous interaction histories into reusable facts, preferences, observations, and rules. Yet consolidation also imposes an implicit authorization boundary: it determines whether stored information may later be consumed as a user fact, an attested observation, or a standing instruction. We identify authority collapse, in which consolidation preserves a claim while erasing the source constraints governing its authorized use, causing the stored memory to imply greater authority than its source permits. We introduce AuthMem-Bench, a controlled paired benchmark that holds the focal claim and downstream task fixed while varying only source authority. It evaluates write-time collapse, downstream authorization errors, and automatic authority preservation. Across seven consolidators based on widely used agent-memory systems and seven LLM backbones, we observe authority collapse in 48 of 49 evaluated configurations. In a controlled action-grounded evaluation, collapsed memories without authority metadata yield a mean unauthorized-action rate of 50.3%. In an end-to-end evaluation, automatically predicted and persisted authority labels reduce the observed unauthorized-action rate from 16.9% to 0.0%, while benign task success remains essentially unchanged. These findings show that memory-driven adaptation must preserve not only what was
  learned, but also the authority under which it may be reused.

AI.tldr: 本文发现持久记忆系统中的"权威坍缩"问题：记忆整合在保留信息内容的同时丢失了信息来源的权威约束，导致存储的记忆比其来源允许的拥有更大权威。作者提出AuthMem-Bench基准，在48/49种配置中观察到该问题，并通过自动保留权威标签将未授权操作率从16.9%降至0.0%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过持久记忆将异构交互历史整合为可复用的知识，但整合过程隐式地引入了授权边界——决定信息后续能否作为用户事实、观察或指令使用。作者识别出"权威坍缩"问题：整合过程保留了主张但抹除了控制其授权使用的来源约束，使存储的记忆暗示出比来源允许的更大权威，构成安全隐患。
AI.method: 提出AuthMem-Bench，一个受控配对基准：固定焦点主张和下游任务，仅变化来源权威。该基准评估三个维度：写入时坍缩、下游授权错误和自动权威保留。基于7个广泛使用的智能体记忆系统和7个LLM骨干构建了49种配置，并进行了受控动作接地评估和端到端评估。
AI.result: 在49种配置中有48种观察到权威坍缩。受控评估中，无权威元数据的坍缩记忆平均未授权操作率达50.3%。端到端评估中，自动预测并持久化的权威标签将未授权操作率从16.9%降至0.0%，同时良性任务成功率基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 记忆驱动的适应性必须不仅保留所学内容，还要保留内容可被复用的权威范围。自动权威保留是可行且有效的解决方案，能够在几乎不影响任务成功的前提下消除未授权行为。

title: Secrets Everywhere: Auditing Memorization in Mobility Prediction Models
comment: Full version of the paper accepted for publication at the ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS 2026). Includes supplementary appendices omitted from the proceedings version
summary:
Human mobility prediction models, which forecast the next location in a user's trajectory, are increasingly deployed in urban analytics, navigation, and personalized services. Yet, little is known about their potential to memorize and expose sensitive user trajectories from training data. While memorization has been extensively studied in language models, mobility prediction poses unique challenges: training sequences encode human behavior at various spatial and temporal scales, creating privacy risks at different granularities.
  In this paper, we conduct the first systematic audit of memorization in mobility prediction models. While prior work has shown that privacy leaks can arise from such models, we systematically assess and quantify memorization risks at scale. We identify key challenges, including the lack of a randomness space, the multi-scale structure of trajectories, and user-specific behavioral diversity. To address these challenges, we introduce a framework to quantify mobility memorization at different levels of granularity: individual locations, anchor pairs, and subtrajectory segments. We also develop user-grounded reference sets to assess how likely a model is to prefer training data over realistic alternatives. Our evaluation across multiple models and datasets reveals pervasive memorization patterns that correlate with user regularity and increase the risk of data extraction at inference time. Our findings call for mandatory privacy auditing in mobility prediction models.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统审计了移动轨迹预测模型中的记忆化（memorization）问题，提出了一个多粒度框架来量化模型对训练数据中敏感轨迹的暴露程度，并在多个模型和数据集上发现了普遍的记忆化模式，呼吁对移动预测模型进行强制性隐私审计。
AI.motivation: 移动轨迹预测模型已广泛应用于城市分析、导航和个性化服务中，但关于它们从训练数据中记忆和泄露敏感用户轨迹的潜力知之甚少。与语言模型中的记忆化研究相比，移动预测面临独特挑战：训练序列在不同空间和时间尺度上编码人类行为，导致不同粒度上的隐私风险。目前缺乏对移动预测中记忆化问题的系统性审计和量化框架。
AI.method: 作者提出一个多粒度量化记忆化的框架，包括三个层次：(1) 个体位置（individual locations）、(2) 锚点对（anchor pairs）、(3) 子轨迹片段（subtrajectory segments）。同时开发了用户基准参考集（user-grounded reference sets）来评估模型更倾向于训练数据还是现实替代方案的可能性。该框架解决了随机空间缺失、轨迹多尺度结构和用户特定行为多样性等关键挑战。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上的评估揭示了普遍存在的记忆化模式，这些模式与用户的规律性相关，并增加了推理时数据提取的风险。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现移动预测模型存在普遍的记忆化现象，这构成了严重的隐私威胁。作者呼吁在移动预测模型中实施强制性的隐私审计机制。

title: Beyond Symmetric Fusion: Exploiting Task-Dependent Modality Strengths for RGB-Event Small Object Detection
summary: State-of-the-art RGB-Event detectors improve the detection of small, fast-moving objects by combining complementary features from RGB and Event data, yet they typically fuse the two modalities into a unified representation for both localization and classification. Such a task-symmetric design is inconsistent with the intuition that the two modalities should play different roles according to their task-specific strengths. To examine this issue, we conduct a modality-specific evaluation and find that the relative advantage of the two modalities reverses across tasks: Event data are substantially more effective for class-agnostic localization, whereas RGB data provide stronger category evidence within localized target regions. Motivated by this task-dependent asymmetry, we propose an Asymmetric Event-RGB Object Detection Transformer (AERODet). During class-agnostic localization, Scale-wise Uncertainty-aware Reliability Estimation (SURE) calculates the relative reliability of the two modalities from their objectness response heatmaps and accordingly calibrates their contributions when the decoder aggregates multimodal features. Once the candidate boxes are obtained, Task-Decoupled Semantic Refinement (TDSR) decouples classification from localization and uses RGB RoI features for fine-grained classification. Extensive experiments on FRED and NeRDD demonstrate that AERODet achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, it surpasses the strongest RGB-Event baseline by 10.7 mAP points on the FRED challenging split.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AERODet，一种非对称的RGB-Event目标检测Transformer。基于对两模态在定位和分类任务上优势反转的观察，AERODet在类不可知定位阶段通过SURE模块根据不确定性估计校准两模态贡献，在分类阶段通过TDSR模块解耦分类与定位，仅使用RGB RoI特征进行细粒度分类。在FRED和NeRDD上达到SOTA，尤其在FRED挑战集上比最强基线高10.7 mAP。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-Event检测器将两模态对称融合用于定位和分类，但这种任务对称设计不符合两模态应各发挥其任务优势的直觉。通过模态特定评估发现：事件数据在类不可知定位上更有效，而RGB数据在分类上提供更强的类别证据，这种优势在不同任务间是反转的。
AI.method: 提出Asymmetric Event-RGB Object Detection Transformer (AERODet)，包含两个核心模块：(1) Scale-wise Uncertainty-aware Reliability Estimation (SURE)：在类不可知定位阶段，从两模态的objectness响应热图计算相对可靠性，据此校准解码器聚合多模态特征时的贡献；(2) Task-Decoupled Semantic Refinement (TDSR)：在获得候选框后，将分类与定位解耦，仅使用RGB RoI特征进行细粒度分类。
AI.result: 在FRED和NeRDD数据集上达到最先进性能，尤其在FRED挑战集上超越最强RGB-Event基线10.7 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务级非对称的模态使用策略，AERODet验证了RGB和Event数据在目标检测的不同子任务中应扮演不同角色的观点，显著提升了检测性能。

title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
summary: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiveMem，一种内在记忆方法，通过固定容量的记忆状态实现长时运行助手和代理的"状态连续性"，使历史信息能在上下文轮换后持续存在，而主注意力路径仅保留有界的KV窗口。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的助手和代理消费交互流，最终会超出上下文窗口。现有的上下文保留、摘要和检索方法只能提供对选定历史的访问，无法在上下文变化时提供跨越完整生命周期的持久状态。这种缺失的推理能力被定义为"上下文轮换下的状态连续性"。
AI.method: LiveMem通过三个关键组件实现：1) 上下文轮换和记忆状态维护机制，将计算通过固定容量记忆状态向前推进；2) 面向记忆的后训练（memory-oriented post-training），使记忆状态在原始token释放后仍然有效；3) 状态感知的推理服务（state-aware serving）。该方法在预训练的全注意力LLM上增强一个独立于活动上下文的记忆状态。
AI.result: 实验表明LiveMem在评估系统和内在记忆方法中取得领先的整体性能。在LongMemEval上的实验显示，即使支持证据已从当前上下文移除，LiveMem仍能基于记忆状态回答问题；证据距离分析表明有用信息能持续存在于活动窗口之外。
AI.conclusion: LiveMem将状态连续性确立为持续LLM推理中一个独立且互补的抽象，证明了记忆状态可以在承载信息的同时保持主注意力路径的有界KV窗口，为长时运行代理提供了更可靠的记忆基础设施。

title: GABench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Graph Analysis Tasks
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of planning, using tools, and interacting with external environments. They are typically supported by harnesses, which manage state and coordinate multi-step execution. Graph analysis provides a promising setting for evaluating their agentic capabilities, because it requires agents to access data and execute operations in a graph environment. However, existing graph benchmarks for LLMs provide limited coverage of graph tasks and graph types, making it difficult to comprehensively evaluate LLM agents. Moreover, they typically formulate graph analysis as text-based question answering, where graph information is directly provided in the prompt, limiting the evaluation of end-to-end agentic capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce GABench, a comprehensive benchmark for agentic graph analysis. GABench spans three graph types and covers four graph analysis task categories: graph retrieval, graph theory, graph machine learning, and graph open-ended question answering. GABench also provides 84 executable tools for accessing graph data and performing diverse graph operations. Building on these tools, we develop an agentic graph analysis task generation pipeline and construct 10,400 tasks with verifiable ground truth.Using GABench, we evaluate a range of frontier LLMs and agent harnesses. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (1) Existing LLM agents still struggle with complex graph analysis tasks. (2) Harness choice significantly affects performance, yet existing harnesses remain limited on complex graph tasks. (3) Graph analysis depends more on tool-call quality than quantity. Our findings provide practical insights into the development and evaluation of LLM agents for graph analysis.

AI.tldr: GABench是一个全面的智能体图分析基准，涵盖三种图类型、四类图分析任务（图检索、图论、图机器学习、图开放问答），提供84个可执行工具，并构建了10,400个具有可验证真值的任务。实验发现现有LLM智能体在复杂图分析任务上仍有困难，harness选择显著影响性能，且图分析更依赖工具调用质量而非数量。
AI.motivation: 现有图基准对LLM的图任务和图类型覆盖有限，且通常将图分析形式化为基于文本的问答（图信息直接放入提示中），无法全面评估端到端的智能体能力，因此需要更全面的智能体图分析基准。
AI.method: GABench涵盖三种图类型和四类图分析任务，提供84个可执行工具用于访问图数据和执行多样图操作，基于这些工具构建了智能体图分析任务生成流水线，生成了10,400个具有可验证真值的任务。
AI.result: 实验发现三个关键结论：(1)现有LLM智能体在复杂图分析任务上仍存在困难；(2)harness（智能体框架）的选择对性能有显著影响，但现有harness在复杂图任务上仍有限；(3)图分析对工具调用质量的依赖大于数量。
AI.conclusion: GABench为LLM智能体在图分析场景中的开发与评估提供了实际见解，揭示了现有智能体在图任务上的局限以及harness选择和工具调用质量的重要性。

title: SCOPE: Entanglement Frontier Escape for Source-Free Class Unlearning
summary: Source-free class unlearning erases whole classes using only the forget data, judged at the representation level, where features can leak a class the head no longer predicts. Existing feature-space erasers answer with one fixed projection, yet forget and retain classes share a representation, so deleting one disturbs the other where they overlap. We prove this tension is a frontier. Every fixed projection that deletes pays a retain cost of at least the retain-readout energy along the forget-discriminant subspace, and erasing that subspace alone attains the floor. The leading source-free erasers all instantiate the form it binds, so the frontier limits the whole class. Conditioning the erasure on the input escapes it. Spectral Conditional Projective Erasure (SCOPE) does so with a single gate, suppressing the forget subspace chiefly on inputs its frozen head's weight scores read as a forget class. It is closed form, needs no retain data or gradient training, and costs orders of magnitude less than retraining. Across five object, face, and speaker benchmarks spanning two modalities and both convolutional and transformer backbones, the frontier predicts the measured retain cost. SCOPE leads the source-free erasers on every benchmark and forget-set size, and at the hardest setting it tops every unlearner, trained methods included.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无源类别遗忘（source-free class unlearning）问题，证明固定投影擦除存在理论下限：任何固定投影在遗忘判别子空间上不可避免支付保留代价。提出SCOPE方法，通过输入条件化的门控机制，仅在输入被识别为遗忘类别时抑制遗忘子空间，从而突破该理论下限，在五个基准上超越所有无源擦除方法。
AI.motivation: 现有特征空间擦除方法使用固定投影来删除遗忘类别，但遗忘类和保留类在表示空间中存在重叠，删除一个类别会干扰另一个类别。作者证明这是理论上的前沿界限，所有固定投影方法都无法避免这种代价，需要条件化擦除才能突破。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE（Spectral Conditional Projective Erasure）方法：通过单一门控机制，利用冻结头的权重分数判断输入是否属于遗忘类别，仅在判定为遗忘类别时抑制遗忘子空间。该方法为闭式解，不需要保留数据或梯度训练。
AI.result: 在五个涵盖物体、人脸、说话人的基准测试（跨越两种模态、卷积和Transformer骨干网络）上，理论前沿准确预测了保留代价。SCOPE在所有基准和遗忘集规模上领先无源擦除方法，在最困难设置下超越了包括有监督训练方法在内的所有遗忘方法。
AI.conclusion: 固定投影擦除存在理论上限，输入条件化是突破该限制的关键。SCOPE以极低计算成本实现了最优的无源类别遗忘性能，比重新训练方法节省数量级计算开销。

title: SPAE: Spectrally Guided Autoencoder for Pretrained Visual Latents
summary: Latents from vision foundation models (VFMs) are semantically rich and well suited for visual understanding. Recent representation autoencoder methods such as RAE have shown that they can provide promising latent spaces for image generation. However, VFM latents remain difficult to model directly: DiT-generated latents exhibit spectral mismatch with encoder latents, especially in high-frequency components. Our channel-wise spectral analysis further reveals that these high-frequency components are diffusely distributed across latent channels and entangled with semantic information, making the latent space difficult for DiT to model. To address these challenges, we propose SPAE, latent adaptation framework for generation. Specifically, SPAE employs a compact bottleneck to distill stable semantic information while suppressing high-frequency components, thereby improving the alignment between DiT-generated latents and encoder latents. In addition, we apply a channel-wise masking strategy to promote the decoupling of semantic information and high-frequency details across bottleneck channels. Experiments show that SPAE achieves a favorable balance among visual understanding, generation quality, and reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: SPAE是一个用于视觉基础模型（VFM）潜在空间的生成式适配框架。它通过紧凑瓶颈蒸馏稳定语义信息并抑制高频成分，结合通道级掩码策略促进语义与高频细节的解耦，从而解决DiT生成潜在空间与编码器潜在空间之间的光谱失配问题，在视觉理解、生成质量和重建保真度之间取得良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型的潜在表示语义丰富，适合视觉理解，但直接建模困难。主要挑战是DiT生成的潜在表示与编码器潜在表示存在光谱失配（尤其在高频成分上），且这些高频成分在通道间弥散分布并与语义信息纠缠，导致潜在空间难以被DiT有效建模。
AI.method: 提出SPAE框架，包含两个关键设计：(1) 采用紧凑瓶颈蒸馏稳定的语义信息并抑制高频成分，改善DiT生成潜在表示与编码器潜在表示的alignment；(2) 应用通道级掩码策略，促进瓶颈各通道中语义信息与高频细节的解耦。
AI.result: 实验表明SPAE在视觉理解、生成质量与重建保真度三者之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SPAE通过有针对性的潜在空间适配，有效解决了VFM潜在空间在生成任务中难以直接建模的问题，证明了语义信息与高频成分解耦策略的有效性。

title: MedPRESS: A Multi-turn Benchmark for Patient-Pressure-Induced Medical Sycophancy in LLMs
comment: 27 pages, 10 figures. Both authors contributed equally
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health-related advice. Existing research measures their safety with static questions rather than pressured patient-facing conversations. We introduce MedPRESS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring patient-pressure-induced sycophancy in LLMs. MedPRESS contains 600 medically grounded five-turn dialogues across three scenario families: medication and treatment demand, personal health self-care, and symptom triage and care resistance. Each dialogue begins with a health query and escalates through personal experience, social proof, external evidence claims, and direct adversarial challenge. We evaluate 20 LLMs across general, medical-domain, lightweight, large, open-weight, and proprietary families using structured judging and safety-focused metrics. Results show that models frequently shift toward unsafe agreement under repeated patient pressure, with substantial variation across model families, model scale, and prompt type. Anti-sycophancy prompting improves robustness for several models, but does not eliminate unsafe agreement. MedPRESS highlights a critical gap in medical LLM evaluation: safe medical knowledge is not enough unless models can maintain it under conversational pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedPRESS，一个多轮基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在面对患者施加的压力时产生的谄媚行为（sycophancy）。包含600个医学对话，覆盖三个场景家族，评估了20个LLM，发现模型在患者重复施压下频繁转向不安全的同意，且反谄媚提示不能完全消除该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅用静态问题评估LLM的医疗安全性，忽略了患者面对面对话中的压力情境。LLM日益被用于医疗建议，但缺乏对患者压力诱导下谄媚行为的系统评估，这是一个关键的研究空白。
AI.method: 构建MedPRESS基准：包含600个医学基础的五轮对话，覆盖三个场景家族（用药和治疗要求、个人健康自我护理、症状分诊和护理抵抗）。对话从健康问题开始，逐步升级通过个人经历、社会证明、外部证据声称和直接对抗性挑战四个阶段加剧压力。评估了20个LLM（涵盖通用、医学领域、轻量级、大型、开源和专有模型），使用结构化评判和安全导向指标。
AI.result: 模型在反复患者压力下频繁转向不安全的同意，不同模型家族、模型规模和提示类型之间存在显著差异。反谄媚提示能为多个模型提高鲁棒性，但无法完全消除不安全的同意行为。
AI.conclusion: MedPRESS揭示了医学LLM评估中的一个关键缺口：仅拥有安全的医学知识是不够的，模型必须能够在对话压力下维持其安全性。这强调了需要在压力会话情境下评估和提升模型的鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Single-Use Tokens: Durable Authorization State for Replay-Resistant LLM Agent Actions
summary: Tool-using large language model agents frequently replan, retry failed operations, delegate tasks, and resume after crashes. These behaviors can cause one user authorization to be requested and executed multiple times under freshly issued token identifiers, even when each individual token is single-use. We call this failure semantic replay: exceeding the execution budget of a token-independent authorization instance rather than merely reusing an old token identifier. We show that identifier-local token consumption cannot prevent fresh reissuance unless the issuer retains monotonic durable state over the authorized action, confirmation event, and remaining execution budget. We introduce CapLease, an authorization-consumption layer that follows proposal- and authority-level defenses, binds an authenticated user confirmation to a canonical action, and enforces transactional Issue-Prepare-Commit transitions. Across LLM-agent replanning, retry, delegation, concurrency, confirmation-replay, and crash-recovery scenarios, identifier-local tokens permit fresh semantic reissuance, whereas CapLease and an equally stateful Server Ledger prevent duplicate admission and, with an idempotent sink, duplicate external effects. Our results identify durable authorization state, rather than token representation alone, as the systems requirement for replay-resistant agent execution.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了LLM代理系统中"语义重放"（semantic replay）这一新型授权失效模式：即使用户授权令牌是单次使用的，代理的重规划、重试、委托和崩溃恢复等行为仍可能导致同一授权被多次执行。作者提出CapLease——一个授权消费层，通过绑定用户确认与规范化动作、实施事务性Issue-Prepare-Commit转换，并要求持久化单调状态，来防止重复准入和重复外部效应。
AI.motivation: 现有的标识符本地令牌消费机制无法阻止令牌被重新签发，因为代理系统频繁重规划、重试、委托和崩溃恢复，导致同一用户授权可能在新的令牌标识符下被多次请求和执行。这超出了传统单次使用令牌的保护范围，构成一种被忽视的授权失效模式。
AI.method: 提出CapLease授权消费层，采用提议级和权威级防御，将经认证的用户确认绑定到规范化动作上，并通过事务性的Issue-Prepare-Commit状态转换强制执行。同时引入Server Ledger作为同等有状态的对照方案，在多种LLM代理场景下进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在LLM代理的重规划、重试、委托、并发、确认重放和崩溃恢复等场景中，标识符本地令牌均允许新鲜的语义重签发；而CapLease和Server Ledger能够阻止重复准入，配合幂等接收端可阻止重复外部效果。
AI.conclusion: 耐重放代理执行的核心系统需求是持久化的授权状态管理，而非令牌表示形式本身。这为LLM代理授权安全设计指明了关键的系统层要求。

title: Geometry-Guided Layerwise FFN Width Allocation in Transformers
summary: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) account for a large fraction of Transformer parameters, yet their hidden width is usually constant across depth. We ask whether this capacity can instead be allocated from a forward-pass measurement of layer behavior. We view each FFN as transporting a cloud of token representations and quantify the induced geometric change using correspondence-preserving shift, Gromov-Wasserstein distortion, and degree-one persistent homology under raw and scale-normalized metrics. A layerwise approximation surrogate yields an exact fixed-budget optimizer. Across seven pretrained language models, raw Euclidean work largely tracks residual-norm growth, whereas normalized work is predominantly front-loaded. Gromov-Wasserstein work is more consistently associated with perturbation-based layer sensitivity than the finite-sample topological estimate. In paired 128M and 256M training runs, several normalized-work schedules reduce mean validation loss relative to both uniform width and a hand-designed cosine taper. With the amplified paired differences at 440M, the best geometry-based allocations improve over uniform substantially larger than the cosine taper, while the anti-topological raw control is worse than uniform.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Transformer中前馈网络(FFN)的隐藏宽度分配问题，提出基于前向传播中每层几何变化（如Gromov-Wasserstein距离、持久同调等）来动态分配固定容量预算，而非传统的均匀或手工设计的宽度分配方案。实验表明基于归一化几何度量的分配方案在多个模型规模上优于均匀宽度和余弦衰减基准。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer中所有FFN层的隐藏宽度通常是常数，但不同层对信息处理的重要性和计算需求可能差异很大。本文希望从模型前向传播的几何特性出发，测量每一层对token表示的变换量，从而更合理地分配各层的容量预算，提升模型效率与性能。
AI.method: 1) 将每层FFN视为对token表示云的点变换，使用三种几何度量量化变化：保对应关系的位移（correspondence-preserving shift）、Gromov-Wasserstein失真、及一阶持久同调（在原始和尺度归一化度量下）。2) 提出逐层近似代理函数，并推导精确的固定预算优化器来求解最优宽度分配。3) 在7个预训练语言模型上评估这些几何度量的分布特性（原始欧氏度量随残差范数增长，归一化度量主要集中在前几层）。4) 在128M、256M和440M参数规模上进行训练实验，比较几何度量驱动的宽度分配与均匀宽度及余弦衰减方案的验证损失。
AI.result: 1) 原始欧氏工作量大致跟随残差范数增长，而归一化工作量主要集中在浅层。2) Gromov-Wasserstein工作量与基于扰动的层敏感性的一致性更高，优于有限样本拓扑估计。3) 在128M和256M训练中，多种归一化工作量调度方案的平均验证损失低于均匀宽度和余弦衰减基线。4) 在440M规模下，最佳几何分配方案比余弦衰减提升更大，且反拓扑的原始工作量控制组表现差于均匀宽度。
AI.conclusion: 基于前向传播几何度量的层分配策略能够有效替代均匀或手工设计的宽度配置，归一化的几何度量（尤其是Gromov-Wasserstein）是更可靠的容量分配依据，且效果在更大模型规模下更为显著。

title: Remember-R1: Mitigating Long-Context Visual Forgetting through Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought reasoning for complex tasks. However, as reasoning sequences lengthen, models may gradually rely less on visual evidence and more on accumulated textual context, leading to visual forgetting. Existing approaches do not directly constrain how visual evidence is used and maintained along the original reasoning trajectory, leaving long-context visual forgetting insufficiently addressed. To address this issue, we propose Remember-R1, a reinforcement learning framework that mitigates long-context visual forgetting by applying process-level supervision directly on the original reasoning trajectory. Specifically, Remember-R1 introduces rewards that encourage broader coverage of matched visual keywords, stronger persistence of visual dependence in later reasoning steps, and greater focus on question-relevant image regions. Experiments across multiple model scales and diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that Remember-R1 consistently improves reasoning performance. Additional analyses further show that it slows the decline of visual attention during generation, supporting its effectiveness in mitigating long-context visual forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Remember-R1，一个通过过程级强化学习奖励机制来缓解多模态大语言模型长上下文推理中视觉遗忘问题的框架。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在复杂任务中依赖长链思维推理，但推理序列变长时模型会逐渐减少对视觉证据的依赖，而更多依赖累积的文本上下文，导致视觉遗忘。现有方法没有直接约束视觉证据在原始推理轨迹中的使用和维持方式。
AI.method: Remember-R1通过在原始推理轨迹上施加过程级监督来缓解长上下文视觉遗忘。具体引入三类奖励：1)鼓励更广泛覆盖匹配的视觉关键词；2)强化后期推理步骤中视觉依赖的持久性；3)增加对与问题相关图像区域的关注度。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模和多种多模态基准上的实验表明，Remember-R1 consistently提升了推理性能。进一步分析显示该方法能减缓生成过程中视觉注意力的下降，验证了其在缓解长上下文视觉遗忘方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Remember-R1通过过程级奖励直接约束原始推理轨迹中的视觉证据使用，有效减缓了长期推理中视觉注意力的衰退，从而提升了多模态推理性能。

title: Romanized Arabic Across Dialects: Views, Usage Patterns, and Linguistic Variation
summary: Arabizi refers to Arabic written in Latin script. Although previous studies have shown that the prevalence and usage of Arabizi vary by factors such as region and age group, most NLP research on Arabic texts treats it as a temporary phenomenon resulting from limited technological support for the Arabic script. In this work, we engage with Arabic speakers to collect insights on their perceptions and usage of Arabizi. We further examine writing norms among speakers of different dialects, focusing on Algerian, Egyptian, Lebanese, Moroccan, and Tunisian Arabic. To this end, we release two resources. First, a character-level alignment of Arabic words to study inter- and intra-dialectal variation across these five dialects, based on words transliterated by survey participants, finding systematic intra-dialectal regularity and inter-dialectal variation. Second, to study Arabic speakers' ability to identify this stylistic variation at the sentence-level, we build a manually curated parallel corpus of sentences written in Arabic script alongside multiple Arabizi transliterations, collected from speakers of the same five dialects. Our study presents the largest human-centered, cross-dialectal study of Arabizi's perceptions and practices to date.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项面向阿拉伯语使用者的跨方言人本主义研究，探讨Arabizi（拉丁字母书写的阿拉伯语）的认知与使用实践。研究覆盖阿尔及利亚、埃及、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥和突尼斯五种方言，发布了两个资源：字符级对齐语料（用于研究方言内/方言间的转写差异）和句子级平行语料（用于研究说话者识别文体变异的能力），是迄今为止规模最大的跨方言Arabizi人本主义研究。
AI.motivation: 以往NLP研究大多将Arabizi视为由于阿拉伯文字技术支持不足而产生的临时现象，忽视了其在不同地区和年龄群体中的实际使用差异。本文旨在通过与阿拉伯语使用者的直接互动，收集他们对Arabizi的认知和使用习惯，填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 1) 与五种方言（阿尔及利亚、埃及、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥、突尼斯）的阿拉伯语使用者互动收集认知与使用见解；2) 基于调查参与者转写的词语，构建字符级对齐语料，研究方言内和方言间的系统性变异；3) 构建人工策划的句子级平行语料库，包含阿拉伯文字和多种Arabizi转写版本，用于研究说话者识别文体变异的能力。
AI.result: 发现了系统性的方言内规整性和方言间变异性；发布了两个语料资源（字符级对齐语料和句子级平行语料），并验证了说话者能识别句子层面的文体变异。
AI.conclusion: Arabizi并非简单的技术限制下的临时现象，而是一种具有系统性方言特征的语言实践。本文提供了目前最大规模的人本主义跨方言Arabizi研究，为后续NLP研究提供了新的资源和视角。

title: Constructing Executable Analytical Knowledge Representations for Meta-Analysis Synthesis Using an Agentic Harness
summary: Meta-analysis synthesis highlights a fundamental challenge in knowledge-based scientific analysis: structured evidence does not by itself represent the analytical knowledge required for executable computation. Decisions about evidence assignment, analytical contrasts, outcome and time-point alignment, effect-size formulation, and methodological admissibility must be explicit before statistical execution. Existing automated approaches often embed these decisions in model outputs, generated code, or workflow traces rather than representing them as independently verifiable knowledge. We introduce the Executable Analytical Knowledge Representation (EAKR), a machine-actionable representation of the knowledge required to transform structured evidence into executable meta-analysis. An EAKR represents evidence, relations, numerical inputs, constraints, provenance, and unresolved issues. We operationalise EAKR in MetaSynDec, an agentic harness in which large language models propose structured updates and deterministic services govern schema- and contract-based validation and execution. Across 58 synthesis units, MetaSynDec constructed all EAKRs, with 57 proceeding to statistical execution. Of 56 units with sufficient information to define a reference analysis object, 38 (67.9%) achieved complete object fidelity and 42 (75.0%) exact evidence-set agreement, with a mean Jaccard similarity of 0.909. Generated and published confidence intervals overlapped in 54 of 55 units (98.2%). MetaSynDec outperformed direct LLM generation in reference synthesis-structure agreement (57/58 versus 23/58; p<0.001) and among 23 jointly completed units, exact reference-formulation agreement (23/23 versus 1/23; p<0.001). These findings provide feasibility evidence that EAKR supports formal validation, traceability, statistical execution, and improved methodological agreement relative to direct LLM generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可执行分析知识表示（EAKR），一种将结构化证据转化为可执行元分析的机器可操作知识表示，并通过MetaSynDec智能体框架实现。在58个合成单元中，EAKR支持形式化验证、可追溯性、统计执行，并在方法论一致性上显著优于直接LLM生成。
AI.motivation: 现有知识型科学分析面临根本性挑战：结构化证据本身并不包含可执行计算所需的分析知识。证据分配、分析对照、结局与时间点对齐、效应量公式、方法学可接受性等决策必须在统计执行前明确。现有自动化方法将这些决策嵌入模型输出、生成代码或工作流痕迹中，而非作为独立可验证的知识表示存在。
AI.method: 提出EAKR（可执行分析知识表示），一种机器可操作的知识表示框架，涵盖证据、关系、数值输入、约束、来源和未决问题。通过MetaSynDec智能体系统实现：大型语言模型提出结构化更新，确定性服务负责基于模式和合约的验证与执行。
AI.result: 在58个合成单元中，MetaSynDec构建了全部EAKR，其中57个进入统计执行。56个具备足够信息的单元中，38个（67.9%）达到完全对象保真度，42个（75.0%）实现精确证据集一致性，平均Jaccard相似度为0.909。55个单元中54个（98.2%）生成的置信区间与已发表结果重叠。在参考综合结构一致性上显著优于直接LLM生成（57/58对23/58，p<0.001），在精确参考公式一致性上也显著更优（23/23对1/23，p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明EAKR作为独立可验证的分析知识表示，能够支持形式化验证、可追溯性、统计执行，并在方法论一致性上显著优于直接LLM生成，为知识型科学分析提供了可行的新范式。

title: Feed-Forward Steering in Transformer Residual Dynamics
summary: Attention-only dynamical theories model Transformer residual directions as particles aggregating on a sphere. We extend this framework by incorporating the feed-forward network (FFN) term as a local steering field acting on each token state. The resulting theory predicts that the tangential component of the FFN field is necessary for motion in residual-direction space, that critical residual directions correspond to nonlinear projective equilibria, and that a commutator defect determines when a finite attention--FFN block can be accurately approximated by a parallel, additive flow. Across GPT-2, Pythia, Mistral, and Llama models, the extended theory improves one-step angular prediction relative to an attention-only baseline, with the contribution of the FFN increasing from GPT-2 to Llama-3-8B. Intervention experiments show that retaining only the tangential FFN component preserves most model quality, whereas retaining only the radial component causes performance to collapse. The tangential component also preserves output diversity under aggregation pressure. As a practical application, layers with small commutator defects can be approximately parallelized with only a modest increase in loss, whereas layers with large defects degrade rapidly. These findings support the interpretation of FFN layers as directional steering fields that shape Transformer residual geometry and govern the feasibility of block-level interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了仅关注注意力的动态理论，将前馈网络（FFN）项建模为作用于每个token状态的局部导向场，从而更好地解释Transformer残差方向空间的动力学行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的注意力-only动态理论将Transformer残差方向视为球面上的聚集粒子，但忽略了FFN层对残差几何的重要影响，需要更完整的理论框架来解释残差方向的运动机制。
AI.method: 将FFN项纳入动态理论作为局部导向场，预测FFN场的切向分量对残差方向空间运动至关重要；通过理论推导和跨模型（GPT-2、Pythia、Mistral、Llama）的实验验证；进行干预实验检验切向与径向分量的作用。
AI.result: 扩展理论在所有模型中改进了单步角预测；FFN贡献从GPT-2到Llama-3-8B递增；仅保留切向分量可保持大部分模型质量，仅保留径向分量则性能崩溃；切向分量保持输出多样性；小交换子缺陷的层可近似并行化且损失增幅小。
AI.conclusion: FFN层应被理解为方向性导向场，它塑造了Transformer残差几何，并决定了块级干预的可行性，支持将FFN纳入动态理论框架的必要性。

title: SphereVideo: Prototype-anchored Hyperspherical Boundary for Continual AI-generated Video Detection
summary: AI-generated video (AIGV) detection aims to distinguish real videos from AI-generated ones. In practice, detectors trained on existing data often fail to generalize to newly emerging generative models, making this task challenging. Therefore, continual learning (CL) is essential for improving the adaptability. However, CL frameworks for this task remain underexplored. To this end, we propose SphereVideo, a novel CL framework for AIGV detection built on two key observations. First, real videos exhibit a compact feature distribution. Based on this, we encourage real video features to cluster around a real prototype on a hypersphere while repelling AI-generated samples, thereby establishing a decision boundary. This prototype serves as a stable anchor for CL, regulating boundary evolution and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Second, existing methods tend to rely solely on spatial artifacts as shortcuts. To enhance temporal modeling, we introduce a strategy that models the temporal dynamics of real data at both frame and clip levels. By strengthening real data modeling, this strategy further facilitates learning a real prototype and forming a stable decision boundary. Moreover, we construct a comprehensive and challenging benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SphereVideo achieves an improved plasticity-stability trade-off, outperforming prior methods by 3.08% on seen data and 4.00% on unseen AI-generated data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SphereVideo，一个面向AI生成视频（AIGV）检测的持续学习框架。它基于两个关键观察：真实视频特征分布紧凑（利用超球面上的原型锚点聚类真实特征、排斥AI生成样本，形成稳定决策边界以缓解灾难性遗忘）；现有方法过度依赖空间伪影作为捷径（引入帧级和片段级的时间动态建模，加强真实数据建模，辅助原型学习）。作者还构建了综合性基准，实验表明SphereVideo在已见数据和未见AI生成数据上分别比现有方法提升3.08%和4.00%，实现了更好的可塑性-稳定性平衡。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频检测面临新生成模型不断出现导致泛化能力不足的问题，持续学习（CL）是提升适应性的关键，但该任务上的CL框架研究仍很欠缺。
AI.method: 1) 在超球面上引入真实视频原型作为稳定锚点，聚类真实特征同时排斥AI生成样本，形成决策边界并调节边界演化以缓解灾难性遗忘；2) 提出帧级与片段级的时间动态建模策略，强化真实数据建模，弥补现有方法对空间伪影的过度依赖，从而辅助原型学习和稳定决策边界的形成。
AI.result: 在自建的综合性基准上，SphereVideo在已见AI生成数据上比现有方法提升3.08%，在未见AI生成数据上提升4.00%，实现了更好的可塑性-稳定性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过原型锚定与时间动态建模的结合，SphereVideo有效解决了AIGV检测在持续学习场景下的灾难性遗忘与泛化问题，证明了该框架的有效性。

title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
summary:
Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity, decodable text latent and design the diffusion model to learn its distribution directly.
  We introduce AURORA-LM, a continuous-latent diffusion language model that separates the construction of a decodable text representation from the modeling of its distribution. A Query-based Encoder-Decoder organizes text into a high-capacity, prefix-aligned latent sequence, and a Block-causal Diffusion Transformer learns its distribution through flow matching, generating blocks left to right while denoising positions within each block in parallel. Because such a latent is harder for diffusion to model, AURORA-LM restricts only the noisy-input pathway while retaining the full clean-latent prediction target, accommodating full-width latents without reducing decoder-facing capacity. We further calibrate the noise-level distribution to the latent width, and introduce self-trajectory consistency to bridge independently sampled training noise and iterative denoising at inference.
  AURORA-LM achieves the strongest performance among evaluated continuous and diffusion-based language models on OpenWebText free generation and XSum summarization. Scaling to 1B parameters with about 1500 EFLOPs of total compute yields further gains, surpassing a larger publicly released latent-diffusion language model under a matched evaluation protocol. All experiments are conducted on Ascend NPUs.

AI.tldr: AURORA-LM是一个连续潜在空间的扩散语言模型，通过Query-based Encoder-Decoder将文本组织为高容量、前缀对齐的潜在序列，并使用Block-causal Diffusion Transformer通过flow matching学习其分布。它在OpenWebText和XSum上取得了最优性能，1B参数规模的模型超越了更大的公开潜在扩散语言模型。
AI.motivation: 文本生成仍然主要依赖离散token，而图像、视频和音频已在连续潜在空间中建模。现有连续语言模型要么继承不适合联合生成和解码的嵌入空间，要么压缩自编码潜在表示以简化扩散过程，从而牺牲token级别的保真度。作者的目标是保留高容量、可解码的文本潜在表示，而不是简化表示以适应生成模型。
AI.method: AURORA-LM将可解码文本表示的构建与分布建模分离。具体包括：(1) Query-based Encoder-Decoder将文本组织为高容量、前缀对齐的潜在序列；(2) Block-causal Diffusion Transformer通过flow matching学习分布，从左到右生成块，同时并行去噪块内位置；(3) 仅限制噪声输入通路，保留完整干净潜在预测目标，支持全宽度潜在而无损解码能力；(4) 将噪声级别分布校准到潜在宽度；(5) 引入自轨迹一致性以弥合独立采样的训练噪声与推理时迭代去噪之间的差距。
AI.result: AURORA-LM在OpenWebText自由生成和XSum摘要任务上达到了所评估的连续和基于扩散的语言模型中的最强性能。扩展到1B参数（约1500 EFLOPs总计算量）后，在匹配的评估协议下超越了更大的公开潜在扩散语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计扩散模型直接学习高容量可解码文本潜在表示的分布，而非简化表示来迁就生成模型，AURORA-LM证明了连续潜在扩散语言模型可以达到强性能。所有实验在Ascend NPU上完成。

title: LaCache: Robust Semantic Caching for LLM Serving
summary: Semantic caching, which reuses responses to semantically similar requests via their embeddings, has seen growing adoption in LLM serving, offering faster responses and reduced costs. Yet existing schemes are fundamentally vulnerable to cache-collision attacks, wherein an adversary pollutes the cache by injecting crafted queries, corrupting responses to subsequent legitimate requests. We present LaCache, a novel semantic caching scheme that addresses this vulnerability through a conceptually simple yet principled redesign. The key insight is that while the adversary has full control over the adversarial query, it has far less control over its response, which must simultaneously satisfy multiple semantic constraints. Rather than checking only the cache hit of a query, LaCache additionally checks the cache hit of its first k (speculatively) decoded tokens. This design yields two concrete benefits. First, it provides formally guaranteed resilience against cache-collision attacks: we prove that it is impossible to craft adversarial queries that simultaneously elicit malicious responses and collide with benign queries. Second, the enriched index supplies additional semantic context for cache retrieval, improving response relevance. Empirical evaluation across diverse LLMs and benchmarks validates both LaCache's security guarantees and efficiency gains, pointing to a promising direction for robust semantic caching.

AI.tldr: LaCache是一种新颖的语义缓存方案，通过额外检查请求前k个推测解码token的缓存命中，从原理上防御缓存碰撞攻击（cache-collision attacks），同时利用更丰富的索引上下文提升缓存检索的相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有的语义缓存方案在LLM服务中已广泛应用，可加速响应并降低成本，但这些方案本质上容易受到缓存碰撞攻击：攻击者通过注入精心构造的查询来污染缓存，进而破坏后续合法请求的响应。已有方案均未有效解决这一安全漏洞。
AI.method: LaCache的核心洞察是：虽然攻击者完全控制对抗性查询，但对响应的控制力却有限，因为响应必须同时满足多个语义约束。因此LaCache不仅检查查询的缓存命中，还额外检查其前k个（推测性）解码token的缓存命中。这种重设计提供两个好处：(1) 形式上保证对缓存碰撞攻击的韧性——证明了不可能构造出既触发恶意响应又与良性查询碰撞的对抗性查询；(2) 丰富的索引提供额外语义上下文用于缓存检索，提升响应相关性。
AI.result: 在多种LLM和基准上的实证评估验证了LaCache的安全保证与效率增益。
AI.conclusion: LaCache为鲁棒的语义缓存指明了一个有前景的方向，同时实现安全防护与性能提升。

title: Isotonic Bradley-Terry Model for Paired Comparison Data
summary: In this paper, we study prediction problems for paired comparison data, for example, predicting the win probability between two unmatched players and ranking all the players according to the order of their strengths by using win probability data between two matched players. Paired comparison data are typically analyzed using Bradley-Terry and Thurstone-Mosteller models. These models predict the win probability by transforming the difference between learned rate parameters, which represent players'\;strengths, with a pre-specified inverse link function, and employ the order of learned rate parameters for player ranking. However, these models may suffer from model misspecification owing to the selection of a fixed inverse link function. Therefore, in this study, we propose to learn the rate parameters by a (sub-)gradient method and the inverse link function by an isotonic regression technique alternately. The proposed model guarantees monotonic improvement in training error, and is likely to yield an exact tie when the available data is insufficient to establish a strict ranking. We also verified that the proposed model could improve the win probability prediction and ranking performance through numerical experiments with synthetic data and real-world data of football Premier League, baseball MLB, and tennis ATP tour.

AI.tldr: 本文研究成对比较数据的预测问题，提出了一种交替学习方法：用（次）梯度法学习选手强度参数，用保序回归学习逆链接函数，以解决Bradley-Terry和Thurstone-Mosteller等传统模型因固定逆链接函数导致的模型误设问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的Bradley-Terry和Thurstone-Mosteller模型使用预指定的逆链接函数来转换选手强度参数的差异，但固定的逆链接函数可能造成模型误设，影响胜率预测和排名性能。
AI.method: 提出交替优化框架：通过（次）梯度方法学习选手的强度（rate）参数，同时利用保序回归（isotonic regression）技术学习逆链接函数。该模型保证训练误差单调下降，且当数据不足时可能产生精确的并列排名。
AI.result: 通过合成数据以及真实数据（足球英超、棒球MLB、网球ATP巡回赛）的数值实验，验证了所提模型在胜率预测和选手排名性能上的提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出的交替学习方法能够有效克服固定逆链接函数带来的模型误设问题，同时提升胜率预测与排名性能，并且在数据不足时能合理处理并列情况。

title: Asleep at the Wheel: JEPA's Limitations in Evaluating Novel Driving Data
summary: Modern autonomous-driving fleets record far more video than human reviewers can inspect. This motivates the need for an automatic clip triage mechanism, to surface rare and review-worthy clips, so that driving models can be fine-tuned to better handle unideal circumstances. We test a label-free approach that scores clips by the prediction-error "novelty" of a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA); a frozen V-JEPA video encoder is paired with a lightweight predictor head to reconstruct masked clip embeddings, and clips whose embeddings are hard to predict are flagged as interesting. Evaluated under a realistic protocol that trains on one dataset and tests against footage from others, this approach appears highly effective. We show that this apparent success is actually a domain-shift consequence: on a fair benchmark drawn from a single dataset, this mechanism collapses to chance and is on par with simple no-training baselines. A lightly supervised probe on the same frozen embeddings results in almost double the average precision, indicating that the bottleneck is indeed the self-supervised objective, rather than the representation. We present this as a study for evaluating the effectiveness of self-supervised learning, where cross-dataset protocols can silently reward domain separation over novelty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自动驾驶视频自动分诊（clip triage）问题，测试了一种基于自监督JEPA架构的标签无关方法，通过预测误差"新颖性"来标记值得审查的视频片段。在跨数据集协议下该方法看似非常有效，但在同一数据集内的公平基准上表现退化为随机水平。研究揭示：跨数据集协议可能悄然奖励领域分离而非真正的视频新颖性，并证明轻监督探头能在相同嵌入上获得近两倍的精度提升。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车队录制的视频远超人工审查能力，需要自动分诊机制来发现罕见且值得审查的片段，以便针对性微调驾驶模型应对不良场景。然而现有评估方法可能存在方法论缺陷，需要更严谨地检验自监督方法在新颖性检测上的真实效果。
AI.method: 使用冻结的V-JEPA视频编码器搭配轻量级预测头重建被掩码的片段嵌入，以预测难度作为新颖性分数。采用跨数据集训练/测试协议进行评估，并设置同一数据集内的公平基准作为对照。同时训练轻监督线性探头作为性能上限参照。
AI.result: 跨数据集协议下该自监督方法表现出色，但在单数据集公平基准上性能退化为与随机水平相当，仅与简单无训练基线持平。而轻监督探头在同一冻结嵌入上获得近两倍的平均精度，说明瓶颈在于自监督目标函数而非表征质量。
AI.conclusion: 跨数据集评估协议可能误导性地奖励领域分离效应而非真正的新颖性检测能力。该研究为评估自监督学习有效性提供了警示：需要警惕评估协议设计带来的虚假成功，并建议在相同数据分布内进行公平基准测试。

title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy (self) distillation (OPSD) is increasingly adopted for language-model post-training. It strengthens the teacher with privileged information but can induce a privilege illusion: the student learns privilege-dependent behavior it cannot reproduce from its inference-time context, yet behaves as if the training-time privileged information remained available, ultimately degrading performance. In this paper, we identify information asymmetry between the privileged teacher and the student at inference as the root cause of this failure in OPSD. To resolve this asymmetry, we propose Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation (DAPD), a unified framework with two levels of anchoring. Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) introduces a self-conditioned bridge and aligns reference and rollout behavior along two matched-information paths, preventing privilege-dependent behavior from being transferred to the inference-time student. Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) applies these paths in both reference-to-rollout and rollout-to-reference directions, reducing reliance on privileged reference guidance while preserving correctness supervision. Extensive experiments show that DAPD significantly alleviates privilege illusion, outperforming OPSD on Qwen3-4B by +2.00 points on average across tasks. Notably, its gains persist across scales, reaching +2.69 at 4B and +2.78 at 32B.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中教师与学生推理时信息不对称是引发"特权幻觉"的根本原因，并提出双锚定策略蒸馏（DAPD）框架，通过双路径锚定和双源锚定分别对齐参考与rollout行为、双向应用蒸馏路径，从而缓解特权幻觉，在多个规模模型上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: OPSD在强化教师能力的同时会引入"特权幻觉"问题：学生学到依赖训练时特权信息的行为，但推理时无法复现，导致性能下降。作者定位到根本原因是特权教师与推理时学生之间的信息不对称，亟需一种框架来消除这种不对称。
AI.method: 提出DAPD统一框架，包含两个层次锚定：(1) 双路径锚定(DPA)，引入自条件桥接，沿两条信息匹配的路径对齐参考与rollout行为，防止特权依赖行为传递；(2) 双源锚定(DSA)，在参考到rollout和rollout到参考两个方向上应用蒸馏路径，减少对特权参考指导的依赖同时保留正确性监督。
AI.result: DAPD显著缓解特权幻觉，在Qwen3-4B上平均超过OPSD达+2.00分，且在4B规模上提升+2.69，在32B规模上提升+2.78，增益跨规模持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 信息不对称是OPSD中特权幻觉的根源，DAPD通过双重锚定有效消除该不对称，证明该框架具有跨规模的普适性和鲁棒性。

title: A 2-Block Architecture for Real-Time EEG Gait Decoding: A Pilot Study
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026), September 28-October 1, 2026, Atlanta, GA, USA. Camera-ready version
summary: Closed-loop lower-limb exoskeleton control via Electroencephalography (EEG) remains limited by motion artifacts, low signal-to-noise ratio, and binary gait formulations that fail to capture full cortical gait complexity. We propose a 2-block Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) architecture: a trainable session-specific Feature Extraction Block with real-time artifact suppression and multi-domain feature extraction, coupled with a Decoder Block built on a novel Polynomial Time-Varying Layer (PolyTVL)+LSTM for four-state gait classification (Stand, Initiate, Execute, Terminate). Ablation confirmed v01 (PolyTVL+LSTM) outperformed all variants (validation MCC: 0.435, gap: 0.187), with consistent EEG feature discriminability across ROIs and sub-bands (p<0.05). Closed-loop deployment with v01 achieved 55.3% (Rex-assisted) and 52.7% (volitional) gait initiation success, with a mean prediction time of 70.5~ms (+/-41.5), validating real-time feasibility in this pilot study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种2模块脑机接口（BCI）架构，用于下肢外骨骼的闭环控制，包含可训练的会话特定特征提取模块（含实时伪迹抑制和多域特征提取）以及基于新型多项式时变层（PolyTVL）+LSTM的四态步态分类解码模块，在试点研究中实现了55.3%（外骨骼辅助）和52.7%（自主意愿）的步态启动成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有闭环下肢外骨骼脑电控制受限于运动伪迹、低信噪比以及将步态简化为二分类的问题，无法捕捉完整的皮层步态复杂性，需要更精细的多态步态解码方案。
AI.method: 提出2模块架构：1) 可训练会话特定特征提取模块，实现实时伪迹抑制与多域特征提取；2) 解码模块基于新型多项式时变层（PolyTVL）+LSTM，实现四态步态分类（站立、启动、执行、终止）。
AI.result: 消融实验证实v01（PolyTVL+LSTM）优于所有变体（验证MCC: 0.435，间隙: 0.187），EEG特征在不同脑区和子频带间具有一致性可区分性（p<0.05）。闭环部署中达到55.3%（Rex辅助）和52.7%（自主意愿）的步态启动成功率，平均预测时间70.5ms（±41.5）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了基于四态步态分类的闭环脑机接口在下肢外骨骼控制中的实时可行性，为更复杂的皮层步态解码提供了新的技术路线。

title: Driver2Map: Imitating Human Driving for Online High-Definition Map Construction
summary: High-definition (HD) maps are essential for autonomous driving systems. In constructing such maps, onboard multi-view camera images, standard-definition maps and satellite images provide crucial information. However, due to the modality and perspective differences among these data sources, existing methods often struggle to effectively align and fuse them, making online HD map construction still challenging. To address these issues, we propose Driver2Map, an online HD map construction model inspired by human drivers. Unlike existing HD map construction models that utilize only two modalities, our Driver2Map can simultaneously exploit three modalities. Specifically, we propose a "two-stage alignment" strategy to reduce spatial misalignment across different modalities. Additionally, we introduce "Pose-Guided BEV Fusion", a BEV (bird's-eye-view) generation module that leverages camera pose information to adaptively weight multi-view features, thereby effectively suppressing cross-view feature overlap during BEV generation. Also, we design a "Pretrained Prior for Map Refinement" module to refine the initial prediction by learning map structure priors, thus improving the HD map prediction under dynamic occlusions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Driver2Map outperforms existing methods on both IoU and AP metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Driver2Map，一种受人类驾驶员启发的高清地图在线构建模型，能够同时利用多视角相机图像、标准清晰度地图和卫星图像三种模态数据，通过两阶段对齐策略、位姿引导的BEV融合模块和预训练先验优化模块，在IoU和AP指标上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高清地图对自动驾驶至关重要，但现有方法通常仅利用两种模态数据，且难以有效对齐和融合不同模态及视角差异的数据源，导致在线HD地图构建仍具挑战。
AI.method: 1. 提出"two-stage alignment"（两阶段对齐）策略，减少不同模态间的空间错位；2. 提出"Pose-Guided BEV Fusion"模块，利用相机位姿信息自适应加权多视角特征，抑制BEV生成过程中的跨视角特征重叠；3. 设计"Pretrained Prior for Map Refinement"模块，通过学习地图结构先验来优化初始预测，提升动态遮挡下的HD地图预测精度。模型可同时利用三种模态（多视角相机图像、SD地图、卫星图像）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Driver2Map在IoU和AP指标上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 受人类驾驶员驾驶方式启发，通过三模态融合和三个关键创新模块，有效解决了跨模态对齐和视角差异问题，显著提升了在线HD地图构建的性能。

title: CoEvo-Mem: Co-Evolving Retrieval Policy and Memory Bank for LLM Agents
summary: As memories accumulate across tasks and sessions, the performance of long-term LLM agents depends jointly on query-specific retrieval and continual memory refinement. However, existing methods typically optimize either memory access, through iterative query refinement or adaptive retrieval policies, or memory evolution such as structural update. This separation overlooks a fundamental feedback loop: retrieval determines which memories receive usage signals, while updated memory bank reshape future retrieval. We propose \textbf{CoEvo-Mem}, a closed-loop framework for co-evolving the retrieval policy and memory bank. For each query, a frozen LLM generates route-specific query rewrites and a routing prior, which a lightweight residual router corrects online. The retrieved context serves as the coupling interface between the two learning processes: task outcomes assign credit to routing decisions, while trajectory-conditioned feedback updates memory values and graph relations. These updates alter how memories are ranked and selected for subsequent queries, thereby closing the feedback loop. To mitigate coupling induced non-stationarity, CoEvo-Mem alternates between updating the router with the memory bank fixed and evolving the memory bank with the retrieval policy fixed. Across seven diverse benchmarks, \textbf{CoEvo-Mem} achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the importance of retrieval-memory coevolution.

AI.tldr: CoEvo-Mem是一个闭环框架，通过联合优化检索策略和记忆库来实现长期LLM智能体的记忆演化。它利用冻结的LLM生成查询改写和路由先验，由轻量残差路由器在线校正，并将检索上下文作为两个学习过程的耦合接口，通过交替更新路由器（固定记忆库）和演化记忆库（固定检索策略）来缓解耦合导致的非平稳性，在七个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将检索（查询细化或自适应检索策略）和记忆演化（结构更新）分开优化，忽视了二者之间的关键反馈循环：检索决定哪些记忆获得使用信号，而更新的记忆库又重塑未来的检索。这种分离阻碍了长期LLM智能体在跨任务、跨会话场景下的性能提升。
AI.method: 提出CoEvo-Mem闭环框架：(1) 冻结LLM生成特定路由的查询改写和路由先验，轻量残差路由器在线校正路由决策；(2) 检索上下文作为检索策略与记忆学习的耦合接口，任务结果对路由决策分配信用，轨迹条件反馈更新记忆值和图关系；(3) 交替优化策略——固定记忆库更新路由器，固定检索策略演化记忆库，以缓解耦合导致的非平稳性。
AI.result: 在七个多样化的基准数据集上，CoEvo-Mem达到了最先进的性能，验证了检索-记忆协同演化的重要性。
AI.conclusion: CoEvo-Mem证明了将检索策略与记忆库作为闭环系统协同演化的有效性，揭示了检索-记忆共同演化对长期LLM智能体性能的关键作用，为未来长期记忆智能体设计提供了新方向。

title: An AI-Based Decision-Support Pipeline for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the UK AI Conference (UK-AI 2026)
summary: Reliable photovoltaic (PV) forecasts are needed for low-carbon energy systems, but newly deployed sites often have short, imperfect records. This makes standard day-ahead forecasting difficult: persistence and physical baselines can be sensitive to calibration and timestamp alignment, while single machine-learning models may capture only one structure in the data and overstate skill under non-temporal validation. We study this problem at a United Kingdom charging-station site, where PV forecast errors affect charging availability, storage scheduling, and downstream control. Using measured inverter output and publicly available meteorological inputs, we develop a deployment-oriented environmental-AI pipeline for day-ahead hourly PV forecasting. The pipeline corrects timestamp conventions, constructs leakage-safe solar-geometry and clearness-index features, adds short-term atmospheric context, and combines complementary predictors through validation-learned stacking. Against smart persistence, a clear-sky baseline that adjusts recent PV output using expected clear-sky irradiance, the best ensemble reduces daylight normalised RMSE by about 32% under random day-blocked evaluation and 9% under the stricter rolling-origin protocol. It also reduces daylight RMSE relative to the strongest individual machine-learning baseline by 6.6% and 6.4%, respectively. The results show that physics-aware stacking can support PV forecasts from limited site data, but its value depends on model class, evaluation protocol, and deployment context.

AI.tldr: 本文针对新部署光伏站点数据记录短且不完善的问题，提出了一种面向部署的环境AI日前瞻小时级光伏预测流程。该流程包含时间戳校正、防泄漏的太阳几何和晴空指数特征构建、短期大气上下文添加以及基于验证学习的堆叠集成方法。在英国充电站点的实验中，最佳集成模型在随机日块评估下将日光归一化RMSE降低约32%，在更严格的滚动起点协议下降低9%，相对于最强单一机器学习基线分别降低6.6%和6.4%。
AI.motivation: 可靠的光伏预测对低碳能源系统至关重要，但新建站点往往只有短暂且不完整的数据记录，导致标准日前预测困难：持久性和物理基线对校准和时间戳对齐敏感，单一机器学习模型可能只捕捉数据中的一种结构并在非时序验证下夸大技能。
AI.method: 开发了一个面向部署的环境AI预测流程，包括：1）校正时间戳约定；2）构建防泄漏的太阳几何与晴空指数特征；3）加入短期大气上下文；4）通过验证学习的堆叠（stacking）方式组合互补的预测器。评估采用随机日块和滚动起点两种协议，并与智能持久性基线和最强单一机器学习基线对比。
AI.result: 最佳集成模型在随机日块评估下比智能持久性基线减少日光归一化RMSE约32%，在滚动起点协议下减少9%；相对最强单一机器学习基线在两个协议下分别减少6.6%和6.4%。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知的堆叠集成可以在有限站点数据下支持光伏预测，但其价值取决于模型类别、评估协议和部署环境。该方法为数据受限的新建光伏站点提供了可靠的日前预测方案。

title: DeVIT: Low-Power Vision Transformer Acceleration Using Delta Computation
summary: The emergence of transformer-based deep learning models has brought unprecedented performance across various domains, particularly in natural language processing and computer vision. However, deploying these models, especially on resource-constrained devices, poses significant challenges due to their high computational complexity and large memory size and bandwidth requirements. This complexity has led researchers to use low-bit model weights to reduce memory usage and improve efficiency. In addition to reducing processing and memory demands, quantization introduces another useful property: value locality, where the extremely large number of parameters are restricted to a limited range of values. To fully take advantage of this locality, this paper presents DeVIT, an acceleration method for vision transformers that leverages differential computation to enable multiplier-less matrix multiplication.

AI.tldr: DeVIT是一种针对视觉Transformer的加速方法，通过利用低比特量化引入的"值局部性"（value locality），采用差分计算实现无乘法器的矩阵乘法，从而在资源受限设备上高效部署视觉Transformer模型。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在NLP和CV领域表现出色，但在资源受限设备上部署面临计算复杂度和内存需求高的挑战。低比特量化虽能减少内存占用，但研究者希望进一步利用量化后参数受限值域的特性来优化计算效率。
AI.method: DeVIT利用量化后的权重值局部性，通过差分计算（differential computation）实现无乘法器的矩阵乘法（multiplier-less matrix multiplication），从而加速视觉Transformer的推理过程。
AI.result: DeVIT在视觉Transformer上实现了加速效果，通过消除乘法运算来降低计算复杂度，具体性能数据需要参考完整论文。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了利用量化模型的数值分布特性来设计专用加速方法的潜力，为资源受限场景下的Transformer部署提供了新思路。

title: MemSIF: From Structured Interactions to Dual-Track Fact Memory for LLM Agents
comment: Submitted to AAAI 2027. 19 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables
summary: Long-term memory is critical for LLM agents operating over long-horizon interactions. However, several persistent limitations of existing memory systems can be traced to two recurring misalignment patterns in long-term interaction settings: Temporal-Structural Misalignment (TSM) and Delayed Utility Manifestation (DUM). TSM arises when temporal proximity does not reliably align with topical or event-level relatedness, whereas DUM arises when write-time salience does not reliably predict future query utility. To mitigate these misalignment patterns, we propose MemSIF (Memory with Structured Interactions and Facts), a structured interaction-to-fact memory framework. Structured Interaction Memory organizes raw interactions into Topical Segments that preserve local topical coherence and Event Trajectories that maintain cross-time event continuity. Dual-Track Fact Memory uses two complementary tracks: CoreFact memory consolidates stable, schema-guided information at write time, whereas ActiveFact memory forms facts on demand and promotes those supported by multiple historical sources and recurring query demand for reuse. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across five backbone LLMs show that MemSIF achieves the highest Total ACC in all settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.29%-8.79% on LoCoMo and 2.87%-6.15% on LongMemEval-S. These results support the effectiveness of combining Structured Interaction Memory with Dual-Track Fact Memory to mitigate TSM and DUM. Code is available at https://github.com/luoyufeihaha/MemSIF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemSIF（带有结构化交互与事实的记忆框架），通过结构化交互记忆和双轨事实记忆来缓解长期交互场景中LLM智能体的两种记忆错位问题（时间-结构错位TSM和延迟效用显现DUM），在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的长期记忆系统存在两个反复出现的错位问题：一是时间-结构错位（TSM），即时间上的接近性与主题或事件相关性并不总是对齐；二是延迟效用显现（DUM），即写入时的重要性并不能可靠预测未来的查询效用。这两类问题限制了长期记忆系统在长时交互任务中的表现。
AI.method: MemSIF包含两个核心组件：1）结构化交互记忆（Structured Interaction Memory），将原始交互组织为主题片段（Topical Segments），保留局部主题连贯性，以及事件轨迹（Event Trajectories），维持跨时间的事件连续性；2）双轨事实记忆（Dual-Track Fact Memory），包含CoreFact记忆（写入时整合稳定、模式引导的信息）和ActiveFact记忆（按需形成事实，并推广那些被多个历史来源和反复查询需求支持的事实以复用）。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上，跨越五种骨干LLM，MemSIF在所有设置中均取得最高Total ACC，相比最强基线在LoCoMo上提升2.29%-8.79%，在LongMemEval-S上提升2.87%-6.15%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持将结构化交互记忆与双轨事实记忆相结合，能够有效缓解TSM和DUM问题，提升LLM智能体的长期记忆能力。

title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models often show users a final response and a short reasoning summary while the full reasoning trace stays hidden. We introduce an observability ladder that holds each completed run fixed and varies only what a reader inspects to judge whether the answer is correct: the response, a self-summary the model writes from the trace, the trace itself, and internal signals, each with and without the prompt. Across three benchmarks and five open-weight Qwen3 and gpt-oss models, we train matched linear correctness predictors on each access level. Without the prompt, summaries carry most of the trace's ranking signal (mean AUROC 0.774 versus 0.813) and add +0.156 over the response alone. With the prompt visible, the summary's gain collapses to +0.019, while the trace still adds +0.041. Even at equal length, the trace's last words predict correctness as well as summaries, or slightly better, and carry denser and more discriminative uncertainty and self-correction cues. On MMLU-Pro questions with both correct and incorrect runs, linear summary readers are near chance and trace readers retain only modest signal, both with and without the prompt (prompt-withheld AUROC 0.503-0.545 versus 0.544-0.590). With the prompt withheld, a GPT-5-mini reader recovers substantially more signal from both summaries and traces on gpt-oss-20b, and even then the trace keeps a small +0.034 advantage. Much of the linear readers' trace signal is associated with length. In the common case where users already hold the prompt, summaries are less helpful than the full trace for monitoring correctness. Monitorability is thus a joint property of the display and the reader, so any monitorability claim, including for faithfulness, should specify both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可观测性阶梯"框架，将完整推理轨迹、摘要、最终响应和内部信号分层比较，研究不同显示层面（有无提示词）对模型答案正确性判断能力的影响。研究发现摘要能捕捉大部分轨迹信号但需隐藏提示词；当提示词可见时摘要优势消失，完整轨迹仍保持优势；可观测性取决于显示层和阅读器的联合属性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通常只向用户展示最终响应和简短推理摘要，而完整推理轨迹保持隐藏。现有研究缺乏系统性比较不同观测层面（响应、摘要、轨迹、内部信号）对答案正确性判断能力的量化分析，也未能析显示层面与阅读器能力之间的交互效应。
AI.method: 引入"可观测性阶梯"框架，固定每次完成的运行，仅变化读者检查的内容：响应、模型自写摘要、完整轨迹、内部信号，每种情况分别在有提示词和无提示词条件下测试。在三个基准和五个开源模型（Qwen3和gpt-oss）上训练匹配的线性正确性预测器。
AI.result: 无提示词时，摘要携带了轨迹的大部分排序信号（平均AUROC 0.774对比0.813），比单独响应提升+0.156；提示词可见时摘要优势降至+0.019，而轨迹仍增加+0.041。等长条件下轨迹最后词预测能力不差于摘要。在MMLU-Pro的正确/错误配对问题上，摘要阅读器接近随机水平，轨迹阅读器信号也很弱（无提示词AUROC 0.503-0.545对比0.544-0.590）。线性阅读器的大部分轨迹信号与长度相关。
AI.conclusion: 可观测性是显示层与阅读器的联合属性，任何可观测性声明（包括忠实性）都应同时指明两者。在用户已持有提示词的常见场景中，摘要对监控正确性的帮助不如完整轨迹。
