title: From Simple QA to Deep Research: A Verifiable Benchmark Constructed through Iterative Task Evolution
comment: 6 figures. Includes supplementary material. Code and data are publicly available
summary: Deep research benchmarks require expert-level tasks and reliable evaluation grounded in task-specific knowledge. Existing benchmarks rely heavily on expert authoring or pre-existing human-authored materials, while fully automatic construction struggles to ensure consistent and traceable verification. To address this gap, we introduce a verifiable benchmark of 500 deep research tasks spanning 31 topics and 10 major categories, with three query forms designed to probe complementary capabilities required for deep research. The benchmark is constructed automatically using an iterative Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger pipeline that progressively transforms simple questions into deep research tasks. Each task is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of atomic steps and associated checkpoints, enabling the query, DAG, and rubrics to evolve together in a controlled manner. Experiments demonstrate that the benchmark clearly discriminates among models and query types, while its fact-grounded pointwise rubrics enable fine-grained, human-aligned, and stable evaluation. Our data, implementation, and results are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含500个深度研究任务的验证基准，覆盖31个主题和10个主要类别，采用三种查询形式。通过迭代的Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger流水线自动构建，每个任务表示为原子步骤和检查点的有向无环图（DAG），确保可验证、可追踪和细粒度的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究基准要么依赖专家手工编写，要么依赖预先存在的人工材料，而完全自动化的构建难以保证一致且可追踪的验证。需要一种既能自动构建又具备可靠验证能力的基准。
AI.method: 提出一个自动构建管线：使用迭代的Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger流程，逐步将简单问题转化为深度研究任务。每个任务以原子步骤和检查点的DAG表示，使查询、DAG和评分标准能够协同演化。支持三种查询形式以探测深度研究所需的不同互补能力。
AI.result: 实验表明该基准能够清晰区分不同模型和查询类型，基于事实的逐点评分标准支持细粒度、人类对齐且稳定的评估。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供了自动构建且可验证的深度研究评估方案，填补了现有基准在自动构建与可靠验证之间的空白，数据、实现和结果均已公开。

title: Entity-Aware Sequence Transduction for Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting
summary: Player-centric ball action spotting requires temporally precise event detection together with actor attribution in crowded, partially observed multi-agent sports videos. Existing Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) baselines treat the player-role dimension as part of a flattened frame-level representation, which weakens the inductive bias for modeling player-specific temporal evolution and inter-player interactions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Entity Denoising Sequence Transduction (ME-DST). ME-DST keeps the role-slot dimension throughout encoding. It uses temporal attention to model the history of each role slot, and spatial attention to exchange information across role slots at each frame. This factorized design gives the model a direct structure for separating within-player evolution from inter-player context. We also add learnable role embeddings, tracking-derived tactical features, and fused visual predictions from X3D-L and Swin3D-S. Experiments on the FOOTPASS dataset show that ME-DST reaches a Micro F1 of 0.778. This improves the strongest official TAAD+DST baseline by 10.3 percentage points. Controlled ablations show that preserving the entity axis and encoding role identity are central to this gain. These results suggest that explicit entity modeling is an effective inductive bias for player-centric sports event understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ME-DST（多实体去噪序列转导）方法，用于足球比赛中的球员中心球动作定位。ME-DST在编码过程中保留角色槽位维度，通过时间注意力建模每个角色槽位的历史，通过空间注意力在帧内各角色槽位间交换信息，实现了球员内演化与球员间上下文的分离建模。
AI.motivation: 现有DST基线将球员角色维度展平为帧级表示，削弱了对球员特定时间演化和球员间交互的归纳偏置。在拥挤、部分遮挡的多智能体体育视频中，需要同时实现时间精确的事件检测和球员归属，现有方法对此建模不足。
AI.method: ME-DST在编码过程中保留角色槽位维度，采用分解式设计：时间注意力建模每个角色槽位的历史演化，空间注意力在每帧各角色槽位间交换信息。此外加入可学习的角色嵌入、基于跟踪的战术特征，以及来自X3D-L和Swin3D-S的融合视觉预测。
AI.result: 在FOOTPASS数据集上，ME-DST达到0.778的Micro F1分数，比最强的官方TAAD+DST基线提升了10.3个百分点。消融实验表明，保留实体轴和编码角色身份是性能提升的关键。
AI.conclusion: 显式实体建模是球员中心体育事件理解的有效归纳偏置，分解的时间-空间注意力设计能够更好地区分球员自身演化与球员间交互，为多智能体视频事件检测提供了新的建模思路。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Method: Shortcut Hacking Misleads the Evaluation of LLM Reasoning on Frontier Science Benchmarks
summary: Scientific reasoning benchmarks typically evaluate large language models (LLMs) using final-answer accuracy. However, a correct answer does not necessarily demonstrate the reasoning capability targeted by the problem. We identify Solution Hacking, a failure mode in which an LLM reaches the correct answer through invalid shortcuts, such as numerical search, enumeration, guessing, or answer-first verification, without providing a valid task-targeted derivation. We systematically analyze this phenomenon across difficulty levels, scientific domains, and frontier models. Solution hacking increases sharply with benchmark difficulty, from 2.2\% on common problems to 28.3\% on Olympiad-level problems and 37.4\% on HLE. Moreover, 8.2\%-44.1\% of answers credited as correct across frontier models are identified as hacked solutions. We further develop expert-inspired anti-hacking strategies, including an automatic judge and a test-time instruction. The results show that suppressing shortcut behavior substantially reduces reported accuracy while having a smaller effect on correct and non-hacked accuracy. These findings reveal that answer-only evaluation can overestimate the scientific reasoning capabilities of frontier LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了LLM在科学推理基准测试中的"Solution Hacking"（方案破解）失败模式——模型通过数值搜索、枚举、猜测等捷径而非有效的任务推导来获得正确答案。研究发现，随着基准难度增加，破解率从常见问题的2.2%飙升至奥林匹克级问题的28.3%和HLE的37.4%，且前沿模型中被判定正确的答案有8.2%-44.1%实为破解方案。作者提出了专家启发的反破解策略（自动裁判器和测试时指令），有效抑制了捷径行为。
AI.motivation: 现有科学推理基准仅用最终答案正确率评估LLM，但正确答案并不一定反映问题所针对的推理能力。这种评估方式可能严重高估前沿模型的科学推理能力，因此需要识别和量化这种"破解"现象。
AI.method: 1) 系统性地识别并定义了Solution Hacking这一失败模式（包括数值搜索、枚举、猜测、答案优先验证等无效捷径）；2) 跨难度等级、科学领域和前沿模型进行系统分析；3) 开发专家启发的反破解策略，包括自动裁判器（automatic judge）和测试时指令（test-time instruction）来检测和抑制捷径行为。
AI.result: Solution hacking随基准难度急剧增加：从常见问题的2.2%上升到奥林匹克级问题的28.3%和HLE的37.4%。前沿模型中被记为正确的答案有8.2%-44.1%被识别为破解方案。抑制捷径行为后，报告的准确率显著下降，而正确且非破解的准确率受影响较小，表明仅基于答案的评估确实高估了前沿LLM的科学推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠最终答案准确率来评估LLM的科学推理能力是不充分的，会显著高估模型能力。研究呼吁开发更严格的评估方法，反破解策略提供了一种可行的改善方向。

title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as the knowledge-to-action gap. To address this challenge, we introduce IBA-Bench, a benchmark for implicit behavioral alignment constructed from longitudinal interaction histories that contain noise, implicit cues, and temporal inconsistencies. Unlike prior work, IBA-Bench evaluates whether an agent can execute tasks while satisfying implicit user constraints inferred from historical interactions. We further propose IBA-Agent, an agent framework that reconciles conflicting priorities through broad retrieval and trajectory-level alignment. Experiment results on IBA-Bench show that effective personalization remains a significant challenge for state-of-the-art LLM agents, and the proposed IBA-Agent substantially improves behavioral alignment in complex scenarios across nine application domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IBA-Bench基准和IBA-Agent框架，解决LLM智能体个性化中的"知识-行动差距"问题。与现有依赖静态偏好快照的基准不同，IBA-Bench基于含噪声、隐式线索和时间不一致性的纵向交互历史，评估智能体在执行任务时能否满足从历史交互中推断出的隐式用户约束。实验表明现有SOTA LLM智能体在个性化任务上仍有显著挑战，而IBA-Agent通过广泛检索和轨迹级对齐大幅提升了跨九个应用领域的行为对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化agent基准依赖静态偏好快照、固定交互日志或预定义用户档案的问答，无法捕捉用户偏好随时间演化的复杂性，且忽视了偏好条件化任务执行——即"知识到行动的差距"（knowledge-to-action gap）。
AI.method: 1) 提出IBA-Bench基准，从纵向交互历史（含噪声、隐式线索、时间不一致性）构建，评估智能体执行任务时是否满足从历史交互推断出的隐式用户约束；2) 提出IBA-Agent框架，通过广泛检索（broad retrieval）和轨迹级对齐（trajectory-level alignment）来调和冲突的优先级。
AI.result: 实验显示SOTA LLM智能体在IBA-Bench上的有效个性化仍是重大挑战，而IBA-Agent在九个应用领域的复杂场景中显著提升了行为对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: 个性化智能体需要超越静态偏好建模，转向从动态、含噪的交互历史中推断隐式约束并据此执行任务。IBA-Bench和IBA-Agent为该方向提供了评估基准和解决方案。

title: UniSim-SLAM: Feed-Forward SLAM with Unified Sim(3) Optimization
summary: Recent geometric foundation models enable feed-forward inference for SLAM, but their predictions are strongly dependent on the input view set, which leads to geometric inconsistencies and trajectory drift when results are chained over long sequences. Online deployment further exposes a trade-off between the low latency of two-view tracking and the constraint richness of multi-view inference. We introduce UniSim-SLAM, an integrated system that runs lightweight two-view keyframe tracking in the frontend and performs periodic multi-view submap refinement in the backend. To combine predictions defined in heterogeneous local coordinates with inconsistent scales, we formulate a unified multi-level factor graph on $Sim(3)$ that jointly optimizes global keyframe poses and submap poses. The graph integrates temporal view-to-view odometry edges, view-to-submap bridge edges with depth-statistics scale anchoring, and submap-to-submap tie and scale constraints to enforce consistent similarity relations across submaps. Experiments on TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes show that UniSim-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in the uncalibrated setting, reducing trajectory error by $38.5\% $ on TUM RGB-D and $45.9\%$ on 7-Scenes compared to prior best results. Project page: https://vision3d-lab.github.io/unisim-slam/

AI.tldr: UniSim-SLAM 是一个集成的SLAM系统，前端使用轻量级两视角关键帧跟踪，后端进行周期性多视角子图精化，通过统一的Sim(3)多层次因子图联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿，解决几何基金会模型在长序列中因输入视角集依赖导致的几何不一致和轨迹漂移问题。在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes数据集上分别将轨迹误差降低了38.5%和45.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有的几何基础模型虽能实现SLAM的前馈推理，但其预测结果强烈依赖输入视角集合，导致长序列下出现几何不一致和轨迹漂移。同时在线部署面临两视角跟踪低延迟与多视角推理约束丰富性之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 提出UniSim-SLAM集成系统：前端运行轻量级两视角关键帧跟踪，后端执行周期性多视角子图精化。构建统一的Sim(3)多层次因子图，联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿，包含时间维度视角到视角里程计边、视角到子图桥接边（带深度统计尺度锚定）、子图到子图连接边和尺度约束，以强制跨子图相似的相似性关系。
AI.result: 在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes数据集上，UniSim-SLAM在未标定设置下达到最先进精度，相比先前最佳结果，在TUM RGB-D上轨迹误差降低38.5%，在7-Scenes上降低45.9%。
AI.conclusion: UniSim-SLAM通过结合两视角跟踪的低延迟与多视角精化的约束丰富性，有效解决了几何基础模型在SLAM中因视角依赖导致的几何不一致和漂移问题，在未标定场景下显著提升了轨迹精度。

title: PAC Approximation and DIRECT Optimization for Parametric Markov Models
summary: In this paper, we consider the parameter synthesis and optimization problem for parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs), the extension of classical MDPs where exact probability values are replaced by parametric expressions. Computing the rational function $f_{\lsf}$ that maps parameter valuations to the satisfaction value of a PRCTL property $\lsf$ is a computationally expensive task, particularly for pMDPs where the optimal policy may vary across the parameter space. We adopt the \emph{scenario approach} to efficiently synthesize a probably approximately correct (PAC) approximation $\ApproxFunOfProperty{f}$ of $f_{\lsf}$: by sampling parameter configurations and solving a linear program, we obtain a polynomial approximation whose error margin $\margin$ is guaranteed, with prescribed confidence, for all but an $\errorRate$-fraction of the parameter domain under the sampling distribution. We further show how this PAC framework can be combined with statistical model checking (SMC), enabling the analysis of black-box parametric models. Building on the PAC approximation, we integrate the DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles) algorithm for derivative-free global optimization over the parameter space. We establish conditional optimality-gap guarantees: under explicit Lipschitz and PAC-good-set assumptions, the difference between the true optimum $f_{\lsf}(\parameters^{*})$ and the value found by DIRECT is bounded by a partition-diameter term and, in the PAC case, an additional approximation-error term. An empirical evaluation on 2997 benchmarks focuses on the new DIRECT-based optimization component. The results show that DIRECT variants solve fewer instances than the scenario optimizer, but on their common successful instances they often return slightly better objective values and usually run faster, while remaining close to the scenario values within the PAC margin.

AI.tldr: 本文针对参数化马尔可夫决策过程（pMDPs）的参数综合与优化问题，采用场景方法采样参数配置并求解线性规划，获得满足PAC保证的多项式近似；进一步结合统计模型检验（SMC）处理黑盒参数模型，并集成DIRECT全局优化算法，在Lipschitz和PAC假设下给出条件最优间隙保证。在2997个基准上的实验表明DIRECT变体在公共成功实例上通常返回略优的目标值且运行更快。
AI.motivation: 对pMDPs计算精确理性函数f(λ)（将参数估值映射到PRCTL属性的满足值）计算代价极高，尤其是最优策略可能随参数空间变化的情况，因此需要高效的近似与优化方法。
AI.method: 1) 采用场景方法（scenario approach）：采样参数配置并求解线性规划，得到具有误差界保证的PAC多项式近似；2) 与统计模型检验（SMC）结合以处理黑盒参数模型；3) 集成DIRECT（划分矩形）算法进行无导数全局优化，在显式Lipschitz和PAC好集假设下给出条件最优间隙保证。
AI.result: 在2997个基准上的实证评估显示：DIRECT变体解决的实例数量少于场景优化器，但在共同成功求解的实例上，DIRECT通常返回略优的目标值且运行速度更快，且结果保持在PAC误差界内。
AI.conclusion: 场景方法结合DIRECT优化为pMDPs的参数综合提供了一条高效且具有理论保证的路径，在多数成功实例上DIRECT在目标质量和运行效率方面具有优势。

title: SpatialQuery: Benchmarking Geometry-Grounded Multi-Instance Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong semantic understanding but remain unreliable in metric spatial reasoning, particularly when queries require comparing multiple instances of the same object category. We study this problem through the Closest-Instance Distance Query (CIDQ), where a model must identify the nearest visible candidate to a unique reference object and estimate their gravity-aligned floor-plane distance. We introduce SPATIALQUERY, a training- free framework for CIDQ reasoning from a single RGB image, together with SPATIALQUERY-1M, a benchmark containing over one million RGB-only question-answer pairs from 200 indoor scenes. SPATIALQUERY recovers instance-level metric geometry and transforms it into a canonical Bird's-Eye View through Scene Cubifying, which represents objects as uniformly sized, category-coded blocks to emphasize their relative floor- plane locations. We further propose Uncertainty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (UA-CoT) prompting, which incorporates geometry- derived per-instance uncertainty into the VLM reasoning process. Without task-specific fine-tuning or architectural modification, SPATIALQUERY with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves a Floor-MAE of 0.259 m, an Unc-Acc@0.3 m of 90.5%, and a proximity-decision accuracy of 84.18%, outperforming fine-tuned spatial specialists, general-purpose VLMs, and closed-source frontier models. Code, benchmark resources, and an interactive demo are available at https://namhai1810.github.io/SpatialQuery/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPATIALQUERY，一个无需训练的空间度量推理框架，用于解决视觉-语言模型在物体间度量距离比较上的不足。通过将单张RGB图像转换为规范的鸟瞰图，并结合不确定性感知的链式思考（UA-CoT）提示，该方法在最近实例距离查询（CIDQ）任务上显著超越了微调的空间专用模型和闭源前沿模型。同时引入包含100万+问答对的SPATIALQUERY-1M基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型在语义理解上表现优异，但在度量空间推理方面不可靠，尤其是需要比较同一物体类别多个实例的场景。现有模型缺乏对实例级度量几何的精确恢复能力，需要对单张RGB图像中的物体距离进行准确的数值推理。
AI.method: SPATIALQUERY框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 从单张RGB图像恢复实例级度量几何；(2) 通过Scene Cubifying将场景转换为规范的鸟瞰图（BEV），将物体表示为统一尺寸、类别编码的方块以强调相对平面位置；(3) 提出不确定性感知链式思考（UA-CoT）提示，将几何推导的逐实例不确定性融入VLM推理过程。整个框架无需任务特定微调或架构修改。
AI.result: SPATIALQUERY结合Qwen3-VL-8B在CIDQ任务上取得Floor-MAE为0.259米，Unc-Acc@0.3米达90.5%，邻近决策准确率达84.18%，超越了微调的空间专用模型、通用VLM和闭源前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将实例级度量几何转化为结构化鸟瞰图表示并将不确定性融入提示推理，可以实现无需训练的高效空间度量推理，显著缩小了VLM在空间度量任务上与专用方法之间的差距。

title: UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation. Existing work has introduced Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) to push beyond exact lexical matching toward richer semantics. Yet LSR has so far remained tied to encoder-style bidirectional architectures, and its extension to multimodal settings still relies heavily on auxiliary cross-modal modules. To address these limitations, we introduce UEmbed (Unified Embedding), a decoder-only multimodal embedding model that produces both sparse lexical and dense representations in one causal forward pass. UEmbed appends N learnable special tokens to the input and partitions the vocabulary into N disjoint subsets. Each token's causal hidden state predicts sparse weights over its assigned subset, and the N subsets are concatenated into the full sparse vector. Trained on public data, we release UEmbed at 2B, 4B, and 9B scales. UEmbed-9B reaches 71.8 (dense) and 71.0 (sparse) on MMEB-v2, outperforming multimodal embedding models trained on publicly available data (e.g., RzenEmbed). On BEIR, UEmbed also remains competitive with strong dense and sparse baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate the practical utility of UEmbed across three dimensions: effectiveness, efficiency, and agentic applications. Overall, UEmbed offers a new paradigm: it unifies dense and sparse embeddings in one model, while further extending sparse retrieval to unify text and multimodal inputs.

AI.tldr: UEmbed是一个基于解码器架构的多模态统一嵌入模型，通过单个因果前向传播同时生成稀疏词级表示和稠密表示，将词汇表划分为N个不相交子集，并使用N个可学习的特殊token各自预测对应子集上的稀疏权重。模型在2B、4B和9B三个规模上训练并开源，在MMEB-v2和BEIR基准上展示了与强基线相当甚至更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型稀疏检索（LSR）仍局限于编码器风格的双向架构，且扩展到多模态场景时依赖辅助跨模态模块，缺乏统一的端到端解决方案。
AI.method: UEmbed采用解码器-only架构，在输入中附加N个可学习的特殊token，并将词汇表分为N个不相交子集。每个token的因果隐藏状态预测其分配子集的稀疏权重，最终将N个子集拼接为完整的稀疏向量，同时在同一前向过程中生成稠密表示。
AI.result: UEmbed-9B在MMEB-v2上达到71.8（稠密）和71.0（稀疏），优于使用公开数据训练的多模态嵌入模型（如RzenEmbed）；在BEIR上与强稠密/稀疏基线保持竞争力。论文还从有效性、效率和智能体应用三个维度展示了其实际效用。
AI.conclusion: UEmbed提出了一种新范式：在单一模型中统一稠密和稀疏嵌入，同时将稀疏检索扩展到融合文本与多模态输入的场景，克服了传统LSR的架构限制。

title: MEGRAG: Multi-Granular Evidence Graphs for Answer-Aware Multi-Hop RAG
summary: Multi-hop question answering is a fundamental challenge in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), because deriving an answer requires integrating dispersed evidence. Iterative RAG (iRAG) is widely used for this challenge, but existing methods have two limitations. First, most methods still support each reasoning step with single-granularity evidence, making it difficult to balance information density and contextual noise. Second, existing methods often answer the original question only after aggregating evidence retrieved across intermediate steps, so redundant evidence and intermediate retrieval errors may accumulate and degrade the final answer. To address these limitations, we propose MEGRAG, an answer-aware framework that represents multi-hop reasoning as a path-structured multi-granular evidence graph. Offline, MEGRAG links passages to their sentences and extracted triples through a cross-granularity index. Online, it retrieves passages for the current query and selects aligned evidence, starting with compact triples and adding sentence or passage context as needed. MEGRAG uses the resulting intermediate answer and prior reasoning to decide whether the Initial Query has been resolved. If not, it identifies the missing information and formulates a focused next query; otherwise, it stops retrieval and returns the answer. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains over a diverse set of RAG baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MEGRAG框架，通过路径结构的多粒度证据图谱来表示多跳推理，解决现有迭代RAG方法中单粒度证据支持和中间错误累积的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代RAG方法有两个局限：一是每个推理步骤仅支持单粒度证据，难以平衡信息密度与上下文噪声；二是通常在所有中间步骤聚合完证据后才回答原始问题，导致冗余证据和中间检索错误累积，降低最终答案质量。
AI.method: MEGRAG采用答案感知框架：离线阶段构建跨粒度索引，将段落与其句子和提取的三元组关联；在线阶段检索段落并选择对齐证据，从紧凑三元组开始，按需补充句子或段落上下文。利用中间答案和先前推理判断初始查询是否已解决，若未解决则识别缺失信息并生成聚焦的下一查询，否则停止检索并返回答案。
AI.result: 在多种RAG基线的广泛实验对比中持续取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MEGRAG通过多粒度证据选择和答案感知的停止/继续决策机制，有效提升了多跳问答在RAG场景下的性能。

title: STC-Net: Electroluminescence-Based Solar Cell Crack Segmentation for Power Loss Estimation
summary: Accurate crack assessment in electroluminescence (EL) images is important for photovoltaic (PV) reliability analysis, yet existing segmentation methods often fail to capture the thin, elongated, and structurally constrained nature of crack defects. This paper proposes a Solar Topology Crack Network (STC-Net) that incorporates edge priors, spectral priors, and a boundary-topology refinement module to improve crack continuity and boundary preservation. The framework further extends segmentation to power-loss estimation by deriving a crack-associated inactive-area proxy from the predicted masks. Experiments on the PVEL-S dataset show that STC-Net achieves 95.98 MIoU, 98.01 MDice, and 98.00 MAcc during training, and 72.52 MIoU and 80.16 MDice on unseen test samples. These results demonstrate that STC-Net provides accurate crack localization while offering a practical link between EL-based defect segmentation and PV degradation assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STC-Net，一种融合边缘先验、光谱先验和边界-拓扑细化模块的太阳能电池裂纹分割网络，并在分割基础上扩展至功率损失估计，在PVEL-S数据集上取得了良好的分割和泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 光伏EL图像中的裂纹缺陷具有细长、拉长和结构受限的特点，现有分割方法难以准确捕获这些裂纹。准确的裂纹评估对光伏可靠性分析至关重要，因此需要一种能更好地保持裂纹连续性和边界完整性的分割方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出Solar Topology Crack Network (STC-Net)，融合三种先验信息：边缘先验（edge priors）和光谱先验（spectral priors）；2) 设计边界-拓扑细化模块（boundary-topology refinement module）以改善裂纹连续性和边界保留；3) 在分割基础上，从预测掩码中推导裂纹相关的非活性面积代理（inactive-area proxy），将分割任务扩展到功率损失估计。
AI.result: 在PVEL-S数据集上，STC-Net在训练阶段达到95.98 MIoU、98.01 MDice和98.00 MAcc；在未见测试样本上达到72.52 MIoU和80.16 MDice。
AI.conclusion: STC-Net能够提供准确的裂纹定位，同时为基于EL图像的分割与光伏退化评估之间建立了实用的联系，展现出良好的泛化能力。

title: PosterMELD: Multi-Agent Paper-to-Poster Generation for Controllable Design Diversity with Editable Print-Ready Outputs
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Shannon4Science/PosterMELD
summary: Scientific poster construction compresses a long multimodal paper into a readable, editable canvas. Existing systems hide request-level failures by scoring only completed outputs; direct image generation is not element-editable, while coding-agent workflows are costly. PosterMELD is a template-conditioned multi-agent pipeline: capacity-aware slots guide writing before rendering, and deterministic gates plus vision-language model (VLM) review route failures to bounded repair. Each accepted request exports editable PowerPoint (PPTX) and Portable Network Graphics (PNG) artifacts; explicit design controls yield same-paper variants. Across 621 papers, Print-Ready Rate (PRR) counts requests passing geometric, readability, asset-integrity, and obvious-factual-error checks, with native editability reported separately. A frozen VLM assigns conditional Craftsmanship-Harmony-Expressiveness (CHE) scores to print-ready outputs. PosterMELD attains 81.3% PRR, 3.4 times P2P's rate and 5.2 times PosterGen's, and the highest conditional CHE among generated methods with multiple print-ready outputs. Native editability and explicit design controls are retained at a mean cost of USD 0.38 per request, 3.5% of Codex+Skill's. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Shannon4Science/PosterMELD.

AI.tldr: PosterMELD是一个模板条件驱动的多智能体流水线，用于将多模态论文压缩为可读、可编辑的学术海报。通过容量感知槽位引导写作、确定性门控和VLM审查实现失败修复，生成可编辑的PPTX和PNG，在621篇论文上达到81.3%的Print-Ready Rate，成本仅为每请求0.38美元。
AI.motivation: 现有学术海报生成系统存在三大缺陷：1）仅评分完成输出，隐藏了请求级失败；2）直接图像生成不具备元素级可编辑性；3）编码智能体工作流成本高昂。需要一种既能保证输出质量、又具备可编辑性且成本可控的海报生成方案。
AI.method: PosterMELD采用模板条件驱动的多智能体流水线：1）容量感知槽位在渲染前引导内容写作；2）确定性门控加VLM审查将失败路由到有界修复循环；3）每个成功请求导出可编辑的PPTX和PNG产物；4）显式设计控制支持同论文的多版本变体；5）使用冻结的VLM为可打印输出分配条件性CHE（工艺-和谐-表现力）评分。
AI.result: 在621篇论文上，PosterMELD达到81.3%的PRR（Print-Ready Rate），是P2P的3.4倍、PosterGen的5.2倍；在生成方法中条件性CHE评分最高；保留原生可编辑性和显式设计控制，平均每请求成本仅0.38美元，为Codex+Skill方法的3.5%。
AI.conclusion: PosterMELD在印刷就绪率、可编辑性、设计控制和成本效率之间取得了最优平衡，为学术海报自动生成提供了一种实用且经济的解决方案。

title: When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration
summary: Extremely low-light RAW enhancement aims to recover severely attenuated sensor signals, yet existing methods often focus on illumination and noise while overlooking the motion-induced degradations inherent in practical low-light imaging. We present a framework for robust extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic acquisition degradations. First, we introduce See in the Degraded Extremely Dark (SIDED), a new dataset that applies controlled motion degradation to extremely low-light RAW pairs while retaining their original sensor noise. Second, we propose a unified RAW tokenizer equipped with explicit domain-conditioned representation calibration to align extremely low-light and well-exposed RAW data, followed by a MeanFlow that performs enhancement in a single function evaluation. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic motion-degraded acquisition and address it with MeanFlow. We further introduce a physics-guided refinement model to strengthen illumination--reflectance consistency, pixel fidelity, and color preservation without incurring additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in extremely low-light RAW enhancement, and robustly handles coupled motion and noise degradations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于极端低光照RAW图像增强的框架，该框架首次考虑了实际采集过程中运动退化与传感器噪声耦合的问题。作者构建了SIDED数据集（对极端低光RAW对施加受控运动退化并保留原始传感器噪声），并提出了统一RAW分词器（伴有领域条件表示校准）配合MeanFlow实现单次函数评估的增强，同时引入物理引导的精炼模型在不增加推理成本的情况下强化光照-反射一致性、像素保真度和色彩保持。实验表明该方法达到了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有极端低光RAW增强方法主要关注光照和噪声问题，忽视了实际低光成像中固有的运动退化（如手持相机抖动、物体运动导致的模糊），导致在真实场景下性能退化。目前缺乏同时包含运动退化与原始传感器噪声的极端低光数据集。
AI.method: 1) 构建SIDED数据集：在极端低光RAW配对数据上施加受控运动退化，保留原始传感器噪声；2) 提出统一RAW分词器，通过显式领域条件表示校准对齐极端低光和充分曝光RAW数据；3) 采用MeanFlow（匹配平均流）进行单次函数评估实现高效增强；4) 引入物理引导的精炼模型，在不增加推理开销的情况下强化光照-反射一致性、像素保真度和色彩保持。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在极端低光RAW增强任务上达到了最先进的性能，并且能够稳健地处理运动退化与噪声耦合的复杂退化场景。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个将极端低光RAW增强建模为现实运动退化获取场景并使用MeanFlow解决的方案，为实际低光成像系统中同时处理运动模糊和噪声问题提供了有效框架。

title: Trustworthy AI in Digital Health: A Comprehensive Review of Robustness and Explainability
comment: Preprint of the paper published in Progress in Biomedical Engineering. 26 pages, 5 figures
summary: Ensuring trust in AI systems is essential for the safe and ethical integration of machine learning systems into high-stakes domains such as digital health. Key dimensions, including robustness, explainability, fairness, accountability, and privacy, need to be addressed throughout the AI lifecycle, from problem formulation and data collection to model deployment and human interaction. While various contributions address different aspects of trustworthy AI, a focused synthesis on robustness and explainability, especially tailored to the healthcare context, remains limited. This review addresses that need by organizing recent advancements into an accessible framework, highlighting both technical and practical considerations. We present a structured overview of methods, challenges, and solutions, aiming to support researchers and practitioners in developing reliable and explainable AI solutions for digital health. This review article is organized into three main parts. First, we introduce the pillars of trustworthy AI and discuss the technical and ethical challenges, particularly in the context of digital health. Second, we explore application-specific trust considerations across domains such as intensive care, neonatal health, and metabolic health, highlighting how robustness and explainability support trust. Lastly, we present recent advancements in techniques aimed at improving robustness under data scarcity and distributional shifts, as well as explainable AI methods ranging from feature attribution to gradient-based interpretations and counterfactual explanations. This paper is further enriched with detailed discussions of the contributions toward robustness and explainability in digital health, the development of trustworthy AI systems in the era of LLMs, and various evaluation metrics for measuring trust and related parameters such as validity, fidelity, and diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于数字健康领域可信AI的综述，聚焦于鲁棒性和可解释性两大维度，提出了一个结构化框架，涵盖可信AI的支柱、特定医学领域的信任考量、以及提升鲁棒性和可解释性的最新技术进展。
AI.motivation: 在高风险的数字健康领域，确保AI系统的可信度（包括鲁棒性、可解释性、公平性、问责制和隐私）至关重要。虽然已有研究涉及可信AI的不同方面，但针对医疗健康背景下鲁棒性和可解释性的系统性综述仍然缺乏，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 该综述采用三部分结构：(1) 介绍可信AI的支柱及数字健康中的技术和伦理挑战；(2) 探讨重症监护、新生儿健康、代谢健康等特定应用领域的信任考量；(3) 展示提升鲁棒性（针对数据稀缺和分布偏移）和可解释性（特征归因、基于梯度的方法、反事实解释）的最新进展。此外还讨论了LLM时代的可信AI系统及信任评估指标（有效性、保真度、多样性）。
AI.result: 文章提供了数字健康领域鲁棒性和可解释性方法的系统化组织和总结，提出了一个可访问的框架，并涵盖了从技术方法到评估指标的全面内容，包括LLM时代的新考量。
AI.conclusion: 作者旨在通过该综述支持研究人员和实践者在数字健康中开发可靠且可解释的AI解决方案，强调在AI全生命周期中贯穿信任考量，并指出了当前该领域综述文献的不足及未来发展方向。

title: G-Skin: Learning to Bind 3D Gaussians with Generative Visual Priors
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved remarkable success in photorealistic and efficient rendering, leading to a rapid increase in 3D assets represented by 3D Gaussian primitives. Directly rigging these assets with arbitrary skeleton topologies is highly desirable. However, training a feed-forward skinning framework is infeasible due to the lack of high-quality 3D Gaussian rigging datasets. An alternative solution is to transfer mesh-based techniques to 3D Gaussian-based representation, but 3D Gaussian primitives are not restricted to the surface and lack explicit topological connectivity. Moreover, this kind of method suffers from poor generalization to unseen data due to its strong dependence on training data, while acquiring high-quality rigging data is prohibitively expensive. To address this challenging problem, we propose G-Skin, a novel generative skinning framework designed for expressive and high-fidelity animation with 3D Gaussian representation. To overcome this 3D data scarcity, we introduce a skeleton-controllable image generation model leveraging 2D vision foundation models to distill powerful motion priors into pseudo-guidance. Guided by these priors, we formulate an optimization pipeline incorporating geometry-aware regularizations, which stabilizes the learning process and ensures smooth, structurally coherent skinning weights. G-Skin also generalizes flexibly to the augmented variants of 3D Gaussian representation designed to mitigate animation-induced rendering artifacts. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating clear advantages over state-of-the-art methods. Project page: https://yaoyx689.github.io/GSkin.html.

AI.tldr: G-Skin是一个面向3D高斯表示的生成式蒙皮（skinning）框架，通过引入基于骨架可控的图像生成模型来蒸馏2D运动先验，克服3D高斯蒙皮数据稀缺的问题，实现高保真、富有表现力的动画生成。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅在真实感和高效渲染方面取得了显著成功，但直接为任意骨架拓扑的3D高斯资产进行蒙皮非常困难。由于缺乏高质量3D高斯蒙皮数据集，前馈式蒙皮框架无法训练；而迁移基于网格的技术到3D高斯表示又面临3D高斯不限于表面、缺乏显式拓扑连接的问题，且这类方法依赖训练数据、泛化能力差，获取高质量蒙皮数据成本高昂。
AI.method: G-Skin提出一个生成式蒙皮框架：1) 引入骨架可控的图像生成模型，利用2D视觉基础模型将强大的运动先验蒸馏为伪引导（pseudo-guidance）；2) 在这些先验的指导下，构建包含几何感知正则化的优化管线，以稳定学习过程并确保平滑、结构一致的蒙皮权重；3) 框架可灵活泛化到3D高斯表示的增强变体，以缓解动画引起的渲染伪影。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了G-Skin方法的有效性，在多个指标上明显优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: G-Skin成功解决了3D高斯蒙皮中数据稀缺和泛化性差的问题，为3D高斯资产的任意骨架绑定与高质量动画生成提供了有效方案。

title: Homebot: A Personal AI Agent for Conversational Home Assistance and Automation
summary: \texttt{Homebot} is a locally deployable AI agent for conversational household assistance and automation. It accepts voice and instant-messaging requests through a shared runtime that combines language-model responses with registered tools and task-specific skills. The design separates common request processing from session ownership: messaging history remains scoped to a channel and chat, whereas voice interaction is bounded by wake-word activation. For hands-free use, \texttt{Homebot} combines local wake-word detection, streaming speech recognition and synthesis, and an explicit dialogue-state protocol for ending, following up, or continuing a conversation. Clear channel, tool, and skill contracts support practical customization for household use.

AI.tldr: Homebot是一个本地部署的AI家庭助手代理，支持语音和即时消息两种交互方式，通过共享运行时结合语言模型响应与注册工具和任务技能，并采用清晰的对话状态协议来管理语音交互的结束、跟进或继续。
AI.motivation: 为了在家庭环境中提供实用的对话式助手，需要解决本地可部署、多模态交互（语音和消息）以及可定制化的需求。设计目标是让请求处理与会话所有权分离，以支持不同交互模式下的自然使用。
AI.method: 采用共享运行时架构，将语言模型响应与工具注册和任务技能结合。消息历史按频道和聊天范围管理，语音交互受唤醒词激活限制。语音交互集成本地唤醒词检测、流式语音识别与合成，并通过显式对话状态协议（结束、跟进、继续）管理对话流程。提供清晰的频道、工具和技能契约以支持家庭场景的定制。
AI.result: 论文提出了Homebot系统设计，实现了本地部署的对话式家庭助手，支持语音和即时消息双模态交互，并通过共享运行时和明确的对话状态协议实现灵活的会话管理。
AI.conclusion: Homebot通过分离请求处理与会话所有权、定义清晰的交互契约和对话状态协议，为家庭环境提供了实用且可定制的本地AI助手解决方案。

title: Learning Where to Look and How to Judge: Resolution-agnostic Image Quality Assessment with Quality-aware Saliency
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: No-reference image quality assessment (NR IQA) has recently benefited from deep and multimodal models, yet many SOTA systems still violate at least one basic requirement: they either discard critical quality cues via aggressive resizing, fail to generalize across resolutions, cannot be jointly trained on heterogeneous IQA datasets with mismatched MOS scales, or require prohibitive computation. We present \textbf{ReLIQS}, a model for \textbf{Re}solution-agnostic \textbf{L}earning for \textbf{I}mage \textbf{Q}uality with \textbf{S}aliency, which is resolution-agnostic, preserves original-resolution quality cues, learns from multiple subjective studies, and remains computationally efficient and budget-adaptive. ReLIQS is a CLIP-based multiscale patch-driven architecture that learns both \emph{where to look} and \emph{how to judge} quality. Fixed-size patches are sampled across multiple resolutions, including the original resolution, and encoded with a CLIP vision backbone. A lightweight Perceptual Importance Estimator then predicts IQA-specific importance maps to select a small set of informative patches, and a Latent Quality Axis Module aggregates their embeddings into a single image-level score. Across authentic, synthetic, and AIGC benchmarks spanning diverse resolutions and distortions, ReLIQS generalizes better than strong CNN-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based baselines with matching or reduced computational cost.

AI.tldr: ReLIQS是一个基于CLIP的多尺度块驱动无参考图像质量评估模型，它通过自适应采样原始分辨率下的信息块来学习质量判断，在多分辨率、多数据集和多种失真类型上优于CNN、CLIP和MLLM基线，同时保持计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有NR IQA系统存在四个基本问题：激进缩放过早丢弃关键质量线索、跨分辨率泛化能力差、无法在具有不匹配MOS尺度的异构数据集上联合训练、以及计算开销过高。这些缺陷限制了SOTA模型在实际场景中的应用。
AI.method: ReLIQS采用CLIP视觉骨干对多种分辨率（包括原始分辨率）下的固定大小块进行编码；Perceptual Importance Estimator预测IQA特定重要性图，选择少量信息丰富的块；Latent Quality Axis Module聚合这些块的嵌入生成图像级分数。模型同时学习"看哪里"（空间注意力）和"如何评判"（质量映射）。
AI.result: 在真实、合成和AIGC基准测试中，涵盖多种分辨率和失真类型，ReLIQS相比强CNN、CLIP和MLLM基线具有更好的泛化能力，同时计算成本相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: ReLIQS通过解决分辨率敏感性和多数据集联合训练问题，在保持计算效率和预算自适应性的同时，实现了跨分辨率、跨失真类型的鲁棒图像质量评估。

title: Self-Certification of Representation Adequacy: Sequential Certification at Minimum Task Loss
comment: 108 pages, 3 figures. Full proofs and appendices included. Independent researcher
summary: Agents that act on a compressed representation of their history face a structural risk: if the representation aliases histories with different optimal actions, no rule measurable with respect to the representation can avoid an irreducible per-round loss, and the agent may be unable to detect this from its own transcript. This paper develops a four-layer theory of self-certification of representation adequacy. The static layer defines decision-theoretic adequacy through a Bayes-risk grouping identity and prices a one-shot external verification by an exact total-variation threshold. The sequential layer poses certification as an optimal-stopping problem in the currency of task loss: we define an environment-wise certification complexity constant through a covering linear program, prove an information-task-loss lower bound for every delta-correct strategy, and give a Certification Track-and-Stop policy whose cost matches the bound asymptotically. A final boundary layer gives an explicit kernel-switching example and identifies the open theorem needed to cover policy switching or representation repair; it does not claim that the fixed-kernel guarantees extend to representation revision. The proofs of the two main theorems are given in full in the appendices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种四层理论框架，用于解决智能体在压缩历史表征下可能产生的不可约损失问题，即"自证表征充分性"。通过静态层、序列层和边界层三个层次，分别从决策理论充分性、最优停止问题（以任务损失为货币）以及核切换边界三个角度展开分析，并给出了认证复杂度的下界和匹配的渐近最优策略。
AI.motivation: 智能体在压缩表征上行动时面临结构性风险：若表征将具有不同最优行动的历史混为一谈（别名化），则任何基于该表征的规则都无法避免每轮不可约损失，且智能体可能无法从自身转录中检测到这一问题。因此需要一套系统的自我认证理论来保证表征充分性。
AI.method: 论文构建四层理论：(1) 静态层：通过贝叶斯风险分群恒等式定义决策理论充分性，并用精确全变差阈值定价一次性外部验证；(2) 序列层：将认证建模为以任务损失为货币的最优停止问题，通过覆盖线性规划定义环境级认证复杂度常数，证明每个delta-正确策略的信息-任务损失下界，并提出认证跟踪与停止（Certification Track-and-Stop）策略，其成本渐近匹配下界；(3) 边界层：给出显式的核切换示例，识别覆盖策略切换或表征修复所需的关键定理（作为开放问题），但不声称固定核保证可扩展至表征修订。
AI.result: 主要成果包括：(1) 建立了贝叶斯风险分群恒等式，用于判定决策理论层面的表征充分性；(2) 通过覆盖线性规划定义了环境级认证复杂度常数；(3) 证明了每个delta-正确策略的信息-任务损失下界；(4) 提出了认证跟踪与停止策略，其成本渐近匹配理论下界；(5) 两个主要定理的完整证明收录于附录中。
AI.conclusion: 论文为压缩历史表征的自证充分性提供了系统性的理论框架，明确了静态验证、序列认证和边界情况的适用边界。研究承认固定核设置的保证不能直接扩展到表征修订场景，并指出了需要进一步证明的开放定理，为该领域的后续研究指明了方向。

title: IDraw: Artist Verification from Digital Drawing Images
summary: As digital drawings are increasingly shared online, reliable authorship verification has become important for protecting artists and resolving disputes. Yet when authorship is questioned, verification may have to rely only on the disputed drawing and reference drawings known to be created by the claimed artist. This setting is challenging for two reasons. First, artist-specific drawing behavior, such as pen pressure and movement speed, is informative but is not available from a completed drawing. Second, similarities in the depicted object or scene can obscure similarities arising from the artist. We propose IDraw, a framework that learns from drawings paired with tablet-pen sensor signals collected from separate training artists. This allows IDraw to infer drawing behavior from completed images during a later authorship dispute, without requiring sensor data from the artist being verified. IDraw also reduces the influence of drawing content by identifying information shared by drawings of the same object across different artists and suppressing it before comparing drawings. To support this approach, we construct the first multimodal dataset for digital drawing authorship verification, containing 1,110 drawings from 37 artists and 14 types of tablet-pen sensor signals. Evaluated on previously unseen artists across nine image-encoder backbones, IDraw consistently outperforms standard image-based verification and reduces verification error by up to 40%. These results demonstrate that inferring drawing behavior from completed images and suppressing drawing content improve digital drawing authorship verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDraw框架，用于数字绘画作者身份验证。该框架通过从训练艺术家的平板笔传感器信号中学习绘画行为，并将其推断到完成的图像上，同时抑制绘画内容（物体/场景相似性）的干扰。作者构建了首个包含1,110幅绘画、37位艺术家和14种传感器信号的多模态数据集，实验表明IDraw在未见过的艺术家上持续优于标准图像验证方法，验证错误率最高降低40%。
AI.motivation: 数字绘画在线分享日益增多，作者身份验证对保护艺术家和解决纠纷至关重要。但实际场景中，验证只能依赖争议绘画和参考绘画，面临两大挑战：(1) 绘画行为信息（如笔压、移动速度）在完成图像中不可直接获得；(2) 描绘对象或场景的相似性会掩盖艺术家风格的相似性。
AI.method: IDraw框架包含两个关键组件：(1) 从配对训练数据（绘画图像+平板笔传感器信号）学习，使模型能从完成的图像中推断出绘画行为，无需验证艺术家的传感器数据；(2) 通过识别并抑制不同艺术家绘制同一物体时共享的内容信息，减少绘画内容对身份验证的干扰。作者还构建了首个数字绘画作者验证多模态数据集（37位艺术家、1,110幅画、14种传感器信号）。
AI.result: 在9种图像编码器骨干网络上、对未见过的艺术家进行评估，IDraw持续优于基于标准图像的验证方法，验证错误率降低最高达40%。
AI.conclusion: 从完成图像中推断绘画行为并抑制绘画内容可以有效提升数字绘画作者身份验证的性能，证明了该方法在数字绘画作者验证领域的有效性。

title: Harness-R1: Learning to Edit Executable Runtime Harnesses from Agent Failure Trajectories
summary: Agents built around large language models continually accumulate interaction trajectories during deployment, yet their behavior typically remains fixed. Beyond updating model weights, these trajectories can improve the agent harness that constructs context, mediates tools, validates actions, and recovers execution. We introduce Harness-R1, the first method, to our knowledge, that makes failure-conditioned, lifecycle-wide editing of an existing executable runtime a learned capability. It post-trains a dedicated harness engineer with online reinforcement learning so that its edits are optimized for the realized task success they produce, rather than proposed by a fixed editor. A separate 9B engineer converts batches of target-agent failures into validated executable patches; fresh same-batch reruns of the frozen target provide outcome rewards, so training updates only the engineer. Cold-start supervised fine-tuning initializes this editing policy, which is then trained online with group-relative policy optimization. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and DBBench, Harness-R1 raises vanilla Qwen3.5-9B success from 44.3% to 53.6% (+9.3 percentage points). After direct target-agent fine-tuning, a target-specific engineer raises the average further from 59.2% to 64.2% (+5.0 points); because these gains hold both before and after fine-tuning the target, Harness-R1 points toward co-evolving the harness engineer and the target agent.

AI.tldr: Harness-R1提出了一种新方法，通过在线强化学习训练一个专用的"harness工程师"智能体，使其能够对现有可执行运行时进行失败条件驱动的、全生命周期编辑，从而改进大语言模型智能体的运行框架（包括上下文构建、工具中介、动作验证和错误恢复）。该方法在WebShop、ALFWorld和DBBench三个基准上，将基础模型的成功率从44.3%提升至53.6%（+9.3个百分点），在目标智能体微调后，进一步将平均成功率从59.2%提升至64.2%（+5.0个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在部署过程中积累了大量交互轨迹，但行为却保持固定。除了更新模型权重，这些轨迹还可以用于改进智能体的harness（即构建上下文、中介工具、验证行动和恢复执行的框架）。现有方法通常使用固定的编辑器，无法根据目标任务结果的反馈进行优化，因此需要一种能够学习性地编辑harness的方法。
AI.method: Harness-R1采用双智能体架构：一个9B的专用harness工程师智能体，将目标智能体的失败批次转换为验证过的可执行补丁；冻结目标智能体在相同批次上重新运行以提供结果奖励，训练更新仅作用于工程师。方法包括两个阶段：(1) 冷启动监督微调初始化编辑策略；(2) 使用在线强化学习（群组相对策略优化，GRPO）进行在线训练，使编辑策略针对实际任务成功率进行优化。
AI.result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和DBBench三个基准上，Harness-R1将vanilla Qwen3.5-9B的成功率从44.3%提升至53.6%（+9.3个百分点）；在直接对目标智能体进行微调后，目标特定的工程师将平均成功率从59.2%进一步提升至64.2%（+5.0个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: Harness-R1证明了将harness编辑作为可学习能力是可行的，且收益在目标智能体微调前后均能保持。这表明可以协同进化harness工程师和目标智能体，为智能体系统的持续改进提供了新方向。

title: SPECTRA: Band-Routed Embedding and Stage-Wise LoRA for Cross-Sensor Fine-Tuning of Geospatial Foundation Models
summary: Geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs), pretrained on large-scale geospatial data such as Earth observation (EO), climate, and weather data, have shown promising performance when fine-tuned on diverse downstream tasks. However, there are two challenges of adapting EO-pretrained GeoFMs to practical downstream datasets. The first challenge is how to handle spectral mismatch: pretrained patch embeddings expect a fixed set of input bands, whereas downstream sensors may provide different channels. The second challenge is how to reduce fine-tuning cost and make it efficient. While existing work has made efforts on these challenges individually, jointly improving fine-tuning performance under spectral mismatch while reducing adaptation cost remains underexplored. We propose SPECTRA, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework that addresses both spectral mismatch and adaptation cost. To handle spectral mismatch, SPECTRA introduces Band-Routed Embedding (BRE), which maps all available downstream bands into the band space expected by the pretrained GeoFM. By using BRE, all available bands in the downstream dataset are utilized to improve the selected-band input without changing the pretrained patch embedding interface. To reduce adaptation cost, SPECTRA further introduces a Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA (ST-LoRA) fine-tuning. ST-LoRA estimates stage-wise transferability before fine-tuning and assigns stage-specific LoRA ranks, concentrating trainable parameters on the stages with high transferability for the target task. Across three EO-pretrained GeoFMs and four downstream segmentation datasets, experiments show that BRE improves performance by utilizing all spectral bands, while ST-LoRA reduces trainable parameters compared with full fine-tuning and standard LoRA. Code is available at https://github.com/big-data-lab-umbc/SPECTRA.

AI.tldr: SPECTRA是一个参数高效微调框架，同时解决地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）在应用于下游任务时面临的两个挑战：光谱不匹配问题和微调成本过高问题。它通过Band-Routed Embedding (BRE)将下游所有可用波段映射到预训练模型的波段空间，并通过Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA (ST-LoRA)根据各阶段的迁移性分配不同的LoRA秩，在保持性能的同时减少可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型在微调下游任务时面临两个关键挑战：(1)光谱不匹配问题——预训练模型期望固定波段输入，而下游传感器可能提供不同波段；(2)微调成本过高问题。现有工作虽然各自解决了其中某一个问题，但联合优化两者（即在光谱不匹配下提升微调性能同时降低成本）仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: SPECTRA包含两个核心组件：(1) Band-Routed Embedding (BRE)：将下游数据集中的所有可用波段映射到预训练GeoFM期望的波段空间中，充分利用所有波段信息，同时不改变预训练patch embedding的接口；(2) Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA (ST-LoRA)：在微调前估计各阶段的迁移性，为不同阶段分配特定的LoRA秩，将可训练参数集中在目标任务迁移性高的阶段。
AI.result: 在三个EO预训练GeoFM和四个下游分割数据集上的实验表明：(1) BRE通过利用所有光谱波段提升了模型性能；(2) 相比全量微调和标准LoRA，ST-LoRA减少了可训练参数的数量。
AI.conclusion: SPECTRA成功地在处理光谱不匹配问题的同时降低了参数高效微调的成本，为地理空间基础模型在实际下游数据集上的高效适配提供了一种统一解决方案。

title: SKT: Skill-Use Training at Scale via Verified Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Agent skills have become an important mechanism for equipping language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge. However, providing skills alone does not guarantee that current models can effectively identify, apply, and coordinate them. To improve skill-use capabilities, we introduce SKT, a verified data synthesis pipeline that constructs skill-grounded tasks and executable trajectories from large collections of agent skills. SKT selects suitable single-skill and multi-skill configurations, synthesizes tasks through rule-based and agent-based verification with feedback-guided repair, and retains only successful trajectories that substantially use every required skill. Using 2,000 public skills, SKT produces 4,000 task packages and 27,164 verified trajectories. Based on the same pipeline and a disjoint test pool, we further construct SkillEval, a held-out executable benchmark for evaluating skill use. Experiments across diverse models, benchmarks, and agent harnesses show that supervised fine-tuning on SKT-generated trajectories consistently improves skill-use performance. Verification ablations, cross-harness evaluation, and scaling experiments further demonstrate that these gains depend on high-quality supervision, extend beyond a single agent interface, and increase with broader skill coverage. Together, these results establish verified data synthesis as an effective and scalable approach for skill-use training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SKT，一个经过验证的数据合成流水线，用于从大量Agent技能中构建技能导向的任务和可执行轨迹，并基于此构建了SkillEval基准测试。实验表明，在SKT生成的轨迹上进行监督微调能持续提升模型的技能使用能力。
AI.motivation: 虽然Agent技能已成为赋予语言模型Agent可复用程序性知识的重要机制，但仅提供技能本身并不能保证当前模型能够有效地识别、应用和协调这些技能。因此需要一个系统性的方法来改善模型的技能使用能力。
AI.method: SKT流水线包含三个核心步骤：(1) 从大量Agent技能中选取合适的单技能和多技能配置；(2) 通过基于规则和基于Agent的验证（辅以反馈驱动的修复）合成任务；(3) 仅保留那些充分使用所有必需技能的成功轨迹。此外，基于相同流水线和不相交的测试池构建了SkillEval基准测试。
AI.result: 使用2,000个公开技能，SKT生成了4,000个任务包和27,164条经过验证的轨迹。跨多种模型、基准和Agent框架的实验表明，在SKT生成的轨迹上进行监督微调能持续提升技能使用性能。验证消融实验、跨框架评估和规模实验进一步证明这些增益依赖于高质量监督、能超越单一Agent接口并随技能覆盖率增加而增长。
AI.conclusion: 验证数据合成被证明是一种有效且可扩展的技能使用训练方法。

title: Can Urban Blight Be Accessed with Vision-language Models: A Case Study in Detroit
summary: Addressing urban blight has seen increased focus in the past 15 years. Assessing urban blight is essential for guiding urban planning, targeting rehabilitation, and safeguarding public health, yet traditional residential blight surveys are difficult to maintain at scale due to the labor-intensive cost and long-term cycle. This study introduced a scalable framework for estimating residential blight using open-source large vision-language models on multiple views. Structured prompts guided models to evaluate housing attributes, including roof integrity, wall damage, and broken or boarded openings, producing both binary assessments and probabilistic estimates of disrepair. To evaluate the performance of these visual assessments, we compared professional human annotations of these features across several models, including an ensemble stacking approach based on XGBoost and a weighted scoring system. Results showed that (i) multiple street views can contribute to the improvement of accuracy, (ii) large vision-language models have different strengths of inference, (iii) the ensemble learner outperforms individual base models, enhancing robustness across all residential conditions and blight assessment. The practical application of the method allows low-cost tracking and management of housing stock conditions, providing a regularly updatable complement to traditional blight surveys.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种利用开源大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）从多视角街景图像评估住宅破败状况的可扩展框架。通过结构化提示引导模型评估屋顶完整性、墙体损坏、门窗破损等属性，并采用XGBoost集成堆叠与加权评分方法融合多个模型的优势。结果表明多视角能提升精度、不同模型推理优势互补，集成学习优于单一基模型，为传统破败调查提供低成本、可定期更新的补充手段。
AI.motivation: 城市破败评估对城市规划和公共卫生至关重要，但传统住宅破败调查依赖人工，成本高昂且周期长，难以大规模持续维护。因此需要一种可扩展、低成本的自动化评估框架。
AI.method: 利用开源大视觉语言模型对多视角街景图像进行住宅破败评估。通过结构化提示引导模型评估屋顶完整性、墙体损坏、破损或封闭的开口等房屋属性，输出二元判断和破损概率估计。采用基于XGBoost的集成堆叠方法和加权评分系统融合多个模型的输出，并与专业人工标注进行比较评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(i) 多视角街景图像可提升评估精度；(ii) 不同大视觉语言模型在推理上具有不同的优势；(iii) 集成学习器的性能优于所有单一基模型，在所有住宅条件和破败评估中表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为城市破败调查提供了低成本、可大规模应用的解决方案，能够定期更新住房存量状况并作为传统破败调查的有效补充，具有实际应用价值。

title: Shared Prefixes, Better Credit: Adaptive Routing for Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent reasoning (MAR) improves reasoning reliability through iterative solution exchange and refinement. Existing adaptive MAR methods typically learn routing decisions from query-level labels or trajectory-level returns, but such coarse supervision cannot accurately estimate the state-conditioned utility of individual operators in multi-step collaboration. We propose TreeCredit, a shared-prefix credit assignment framework for efficient adaptive MAR. Its core insight is to estimate operator utility through state-matched downstream comparisons, rather than directly attributing trajectory-level outcomes to preceding decisions. TreeCredit constructs shared-prefix collaboration trees by expanding candidate operators from the same intermediate state and assigns each state--operator pair a correctness-prioritized suffix credit based on the terminal correctness and cumulative additional cost of its complete continuation. These structured credits are converted into state-local operator preferences to train a lightweight pairwise state router, which dynamically selects the next admissible operator during inference. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that TreeCredit modestly improves accuracy while substantially reducing inference cost, achieving a better accuracy--cost trade-off than representative MAR methods.

AI.tldr: TreeCredit提出了一种基于共享前缀信用分配的高效自适应多智能体推理（MAR）框架。其核心思想是通过状态匹配的下游比较来估计操作符效用，而非直接将轨迹级结果归因于先前的决策。该方法构建共享前缀协作树，为每个状态-操作符对分配正确性优先的后缀信用，训练轻量级成对状态路由器以动态选择下一个操作符。在六个推理基准上，TreeCredit在精度略有提升的同时大幅降低推理成本，实现了优于代表性MAR方法的精度-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的自适应MAR方法通常从查询级标签或轨迹级回报学习路由决策，但这种粗粒度的监督信号无法准确估计多步协作中单个操作符的状态条件效用，导致路由决策不够精准。
AI.method: TreeCredit通过构建共享前缀协作树，从同一中间状态扩展候选操作符，并为每个状态-操作符对基于最终正确性和累计额外成本分配正确性优先的后缀信用。这些结构化信用被转换为状态局部的操作符偏好，用于训练轻量级成对状态路由器，在推理时动态选择下一个可接受的操作符。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准上的实验表明，TreeCredit在精度上略有提升的同时大幅降低推理成本，实现了比代表性MAR方法更好的精度-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: TreeCredit通过更细粒度的信用分配机制有效改善了自适应MAR的路由决策质量，验证了基于状态匹配比较来估计操作符效用的有效性。

title: Pixel Ignores, Superpixel Sees: Adverse Weather Image Restoration via Semantic-Center SSM
summary:
Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover clear visibility from degraded images in complex weather conditions.
  Existing works attempt to address this problem by modeling relationships between pixels, however, this paradigm defies the spatially non-uniformity fact of degradations and learns non-discriminative features from semantic-conflict regions.
  In this paper, we propose SSR, a \textbf{S}emantic-center guilded \textbf{S}tate space model for image \textbf{R}estoration.
  The key idea of SSR is to shift the conventional scanning strategy of pixel-serial to semantic-guilded one.
  Specifically, we introduce a Superpixel-guided Selective Scan Mechanism ($\text{S}^3$M), which first partitions the image into perceptually coherent regions via superpixel clustering and then performs relations modeling within the semantic-related regions.
  Moreover, a Region-level Gating Mechanism (RGM) is developed to perform intra-region calibration by modulating degradation outliers within each semantic superpixel unit along the channel dimension.
  Extensive experiments on \textbf{6} well-established benchmarks demonstrate that SSR performs favorably against state-of-the-art models with competitive computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSR，一个语义中心引导的状态空间模型用于恶劣天气图像恢复。通过超像素聚类将图像划分为感知一致的区域，并在语义相关区域内进行关系建模，同时设计区域级门控机制沿通道维度对退化异常进行校准，在6个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有恶劣天气图像恢复方法通常建模像素间关系，但这种范式违背了退化在空间上非均匀的特性，且容易从语义冲突区域学习到非判别性特征。因此需要一种语义引导的建模方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出超像素引导的选择性扫描机制（S3M）：通过超像素聚类将图像划分为感知一致区域，然后在语义相关区域内进行关系建模，将传统的像素序列扫描策略转变为语义引导的扫描策略。2) 设计区域级门控机制（RGM）：沿通道维度对每个语义超像素单元内的退化异常进行调制，实现区域内校准。
AI.result: 在6个公认的基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，SSR在恢复效果上优于现有最先进的模型，同时保持了具有竞争力的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过将状态空间模型的扫描策略从像素序列升级为语义引导的方式，有效解决了天气退化非均匀性问题，提升了语义判别特征的提取能力，在性能和效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: MechGeo: Autoformalizing and Proving Euclidean Geometry in Lean 4
summary: We present MechGeo, a Mathlib native agentic framework that jointly addresses faithful autoformalization and certified proof construction for Euclidean geometry. In this framework, GeoFormalizer represents informal problems in GeoIR, deterministically translates them into Lean 4, and iteratively repairs candidate statements using structural diagnostics and semantic evaluation. GeoProver constructs geometric proof plans, derives intermediate lemmas, and selectively algebraizes suitable subgoals through a library verified in Lean. Singular or SymPy may generate algebraic certificates, but all resulting proofs and counterexamples are checked by Lean's kernel. Experiments across seven LLM backbones show substantial improvements in autoformalization, particularly for models with weaker direct translation performance. On 43 historical IMO geometry problems, GeoFormalizer generates formal statements that GeoProver proves in 29 cases; for the remaining 14, it constructs counterexamples verified in Lean and proves all repaired statements after expert correction. Together with IMO 2026 Problem 2, this yields, to the best of our knowledge, the largest reported collection of automated, kernel-checked Lean proofs for IMO geometry problems. On the 14 geometry statements in LEAP's Lean-IMO-Bench, MechGeo proves 12 for the first time, formally refutes the remaining two, and proves both repaired statements. These results establish counterexample guided diagnosis, geometric reasoning, and certified symbolic computation as a practical foundation for trustworthy formal geometry.

AI.tldr: MechGeo是一个Mathlib原生的智能体框架，联合解决欧几里得几何的忠实自动形式化与认证证明构建问题。在43道IMO几何题中证明29道，对其余14道构建Lean验证的反例；在LEAP基准上首次证明12道、正式反驳2道并证明所有修复后的命题。
AI.motivation: 当前几何问题的形式化验证面临两大挑战：一是自动形式化（autoformalization）不够忠实，难以准确将非正式几何问题转化为形式化表述；二是缺乏认证的证明构建机制，无法保证几何推理的可靠性。作者希望建立一个能够同时解决这两个问题的统一框架。
AI.method: MechGeo包含两个核心组件：1) GeoFormalizer——将非正式问题表示为GeoIR，确定性翻译为Lean 4，并通过结构诊断和语义评估迭代修复候选陈述；2) GeoProver——构建几何证明计划，推导中间引理，并通过Lean中验证的库选择性地对合适的子目标进行代数化。Singular或SymPy可生成代数证书，但所有证明和反例均由Lean内核检查。
AI.result: 在7个LLM骨干上实验显示自动形式化显著提升。43道IMO几何题中GeoFormalizer生成的形式化陈述有29道被GeoProver证明；剩余14道构建了Lean验证的反例，经专家修正后全部证明。在LEAP的14道几何题中首次证明12道、反驳2道，并证明两个修复后的命题。连同IMO 2026 Problem 2，这是目前已知最大的自动化、内核检查的IMO几何题Lean证明集合。
AI.conclusion: 反例引导的诊断、几何推理和认证符号计算的结合，为可信赖的正式几何学建立了实用基础，验证了该框架在自动形式化和认证证明方面的有效性。

title: DecoupleGS: Interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Testing
summary: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving algorithms require rigorous closed-loop validation in simulation environments offering high visual fidelity, strong interactivity, and real-time performance. Existing approaches, from game engines to static neural rendering, inherently trade off these requirements and struggle with the dynamic scene composition essential for E2E testing. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel decoupled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework tailored for large-scale E2E evaluation. We fundamentally decompose scenes into a high-fidelity static background and manipulable dynamic agents using an object-centric canonical representation. To resolve resulting representational conflicts, we introduce three targeted modules: (1) asset compression via perceptual pruning and vector quantization for real-time traffic rendering; (2) map-guided geometric registration leveraging semantic topology to strictly align trajectories; and (3) proxy-based relighting transferring ambient illumination for seamless photometric integration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoupleGS achieves a balanced fidelity-efficiency trade-off, improves metric and photometric consistency, and provides a practical closed-loop sensor simulation platform for E2E autonomous driving evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DecoupleGS，一个解耦的3D高斯泼溅框架，用于端到端自动驾驶的闭环仿真验证。该框架将场景分解为高保真静态背景和可操控的动态智能体，并引入三个模块（感知剪枝与向量量化的资产压缩、基于语义拓扑的地图引导几何配准、基于代理的重光照）来解决表示冲突，实现了保真度与效率的平衡，为E2E驾驶评估提供了实用的闭环传感器仿真平台。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶算法需要在仿真环境中进行严格的闭环验证，但现有方法（从游戏引擎到静态神经渲染）在高视觉保真度、强交互性和实时性能之间存在固有取舍，难以支持E2E测试所需的动态场景组合。这一瓶颈促使研究者探索更优的仿真方案。
AI.method: 采用解耦的3DGS框架：1）将场景分解为高保真静态背景和可操控的动态智能体，使用对象中心规范表示；2）通过感知剪枝和向量量化实现资产压缩以支持实时交通渲染；3）利用语义拓扑实现地图引导的几何配准来严格对齐轨迹；4）通过代理重光照传递环境光照以实现无缝光度集成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DecoupleGS在保真度与效率之间取得了平衡，改善了度量和光度一致性，并为E2E自动驾驶评估提供了实用的闭环传感器仿真平台。
AI.conclusion: DecoupleGS为端到端自动驾驶的闭环仿真验证提供了一种平衡的、实用的解决方案，通过解耦静态背景与动态智能体，解决了传统渲染方法在动态场景组合上的不足，具有广泛的应用价值。

title: Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Includes appendices with full controls and ablations
summary: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive adoptions expose variable-length semantic phases, and no milestone vocabulary, gold patch, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenter places a boundary. Because the agent names its conjecture, a reviewer can negate it by name, which lets our protocol manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions that recorded work rarely contains; one collection then yields four supervised targets, including audit supervision from exactly the failed regions an episode label discards. We then ask what survives deleting the declaration. Given the cut points but not the hypothesis, a model attributes action blocks to their governing hypothesis at over twice chance, beating equal-length blocks over the same trajectories (paired sign test $p = 0.0002$), surviving a lexical control and collapsing under label permutation. Asked instead to place boundaries, a code-blind annotator matches 24 of 40 where random placement matches 11.5, while a mechanical test-event rule beats chance at neither end of a strict-to-permissive sweep. The segments are therefore coherent and not cheaply reproducible. Downstream, DPO on 2,551 phase-boundary pairs changes no decision on 91 adversarial held-out items, while four of 60 change on matched-construction items, all wrong to right, where two controls change none: with 1,825 pairs from one generator, the variable to vary next is corpus diversity, not the boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"采集时语义自切分"协议：在轨迹生成过程中，由智能体通过可证伪的因果假设自我暴露边界，形成可变长度的语义阶段。该协议无需里程碑词汇、黄金补丁或回顾式切分器，能制造"错误原因-修正"转换以提供四种监督目标。实验表明发现的分段具有连贯性且不易廉价复现，下游DPO训练在匹配构造样本上有效，但对抗样本上无效。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体的轨迹与现有的训练信用单元（如单动作、回合标签、固定窗口）不匹配：单动作无稳定价值、回合标签混淆生产性探索与放弃方向、固定窗口随意截断。需要一种与轨迹语义结构对齐的信用分配/监督信号采集方法。
AI.method: 在数据采集时让智能体通过声明式契约自我暴露轨迹边界（语义自切分）。具体而言，智能体以可证伪的因果假设形式命名其推断，评审者可否定该假设，从而产生"错误原因-纠正"转换。一次采集可生成四种监督目标，包括对失败区域进行审计监督。同时还设计了消融研究：给定切分点但去除假设标签，测试模型是否可将动作块归属到对应假设；以及仅凭切分点让注释者放置边界。
AI.result: 1）模型将动作块归属到主导假设的准确率超过随机两倍，且优于等长块，在词汇控制和标签置换下均表现鲁棒。2）代码盲注释者匹配40个边界中的24个（随机11.5个），机械测试事件规则无法超越随机。3）DPO在2,551对阶段边界对上：91个对抗保留项无决策变化，但60个匹配构造项中4个从错误变为正确，两个对照组均无变化。结论：需要增加语料多样性，而非改变边界定义。
AI.conclusion: 采集时语义自切分产生的分段在语义上是连贯的、不可廉价复制的，并能转化为有效的下游训练信号。当前瓶颈已从"边界质量"转移为"语料多样性"。

title: LiveLight: Real-time Streaming Video Relighting with Interactive Control
comment: Accepted by TOG 2026. Project page: https://living-lighting.github.io
summary: We present LiveLight, the first diffusion-based framework for real-time streaming video relighting with interactive 3D lighting control. Achieving this is non-trivial, as it requires overcoming three critical challenges: effectively injecting dynamic 3D lighting into a diffusion model, maintaining high-fidelity generation under an extremely low NFE (Number of Function Evaluations) budget for real-time speed, and facilitating continuous streaming for interactive control. To address these pain points, we propose three key designs. First, for accurate lighting injection, we propose a lightweight adapter that feeds Multi-Plane Light Irradiance (MPLI) conditions-depth-aware irradiance maps encoding 3D lighting geometry-directly into the diffusion backbone. Second, to prevent rendering quality degradation at low NFEs towards real-time distillation, we introduce a geometry-guided feedback branch. This training-time constraint leverages a frozen geometry estimator to enforce depth- and normal-consistent relighting, ensuring geometrically plausible shading without adding inference overhead. Finally, to enable streaming interaction, we develop a progressive rolling-window strategy that maintains a denoising ladder of latent chunks at varying noise levels. By propagating intermediate states, this strategy guarantees temporal coherence and supports arbitrarily long video relighting with per-frame reference refresh. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that LiveLight achieves state-of-the-art relighting quality while running at real-time speed, significantly outperforming offline baselines in temporal stability, lighting controllability, and user preference. To foster real-time interactive relighting research, we will publicly release our models, training data, and synthetic data generator.

AI.tldr: LiveLight是首个用于实时流式视频重光照的扩散模型框架，支持交互式3D光照控制。它通过轻量适配器注入多平面光照辐照度条件、几何引导反馈分支在低NFE下保持渲染质量、以及渐进滚动窗口策略实现流式交互，在实现实时速度的同时达到最先进的重新照明质量。
AI.motivation: 实现实时视频重光照与交互式3D光照控制面临三大挑战：将动态3D光照有效注入扩散模型、在极低NFE预算下保持高保真生成以实现实时速度、以及支持交互控制的连续流式处理。现有方法难以同时兼顾这三者。
AI.method: 三个关键设计：1) 轻量适配器将MPLI条件（深度感知辐照度图）直接注入扩散主干进行光照注入；2) 几何引导反馈分支，利用冻结的几何估计器在训练时强制深度和法线一致的重新照明，不增加推理开销；3) 渐进滚动窗口策略维持不同噪声水平下潜变量块的去噪阶梯，通过传播中间状态保证时间连贯性并支持任意长度的视频重照明。
AI.result: 在真实世界和合成基准上的大量实验表明，LiveLight在实现实时速度的同时达到最先进的重新照明质量，在时间稳定性、光照可控性和用户偏好方面显著优于离线基线。
AI.conclusion: LiveLight通过三个针对性设计成功解决了扩散模型用于实时视频重照明的关键挑战，并计划公开发布模型、训练数据和合成数据生成器，以推动实时交互式重照明领域的研究。

title: Hard Constraints, Smooth Gradients: Learning Feasible Inventory Policies via Differentiable Projection
summary: Many operational problems are constrained sequential decision processes with large, combinatorial action spaces and interdependent feasibility constraints. Mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) handle such constraints flexibly but scale poorly in stochastic environments. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) promises scalable decision rules, but existing methods either penalize constraints rather than enforce them, or rely on feasibility mechanisms that break down once constraints interact. We bridge this gap by embedding a differentiable convex optimization module inside the policy: a neural network proposes continuous action targets, a quadratic program projects them onto the relaxed feasible set, and a dual-informed integer mapping restores integrality while preserving feasibility. Given a differentiable simulator, the policy trains end to end from sampled trajectories using pathwise gradients, while handling hard constraints with similar flexibility to MILPs. We show that our feasibility enforcement has bounded error relative to an exact integer projection and ensures the entire feasible action space is reachable. We apply the method to multi-echelon production-inventory planning under shared resource and material constraints. Our policy attains an average optimality gap below 1% on small instances. It further outperforms state-of-the-art echelon base-stock policies by up to 9.75% and a rolling-horizon multi-stage stochastic program by at least 7.7% in larger networks. On an industry-scale case study from ASML, it reduces average cost by up to 3.22% relative to the best-known benchmark policy. The savings are largest where planning is hardest: in tightly capacitated systems with high demand variability. More broadly, our work shows that DRL can deliver economically significant savings in sequential decision problems with interdependent hard constraints, which are widespread in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将可微凸优化模块嵌入深度强化学习策略的方法，用于解决具有组合动作空间和相互依赖可行性约束的顺序决策问题。策略通过神经网络提出连续动作目标，二次规划将其投影到松弛可行集，再通过对偶信息的整数映射恢复整数性并保持可行性，可实现端到端训练且优于现有基准方法。
AI.motivation: 运营问题常涉及约束顺序决策，动作空间大且约束相互依赖。MILP灵活但可扩展性差，DRL可扩展但要么惩罚约束而非强制执行，要么依赖在约束交互时失效的可行性机制。需要一种既能灵活处理硬约束又具备可扩展性的方法。
AI.method: 将可微凸优化模块嵌入策略网络内部：1) 神经网络提出连续动作目标；2) 二次规划将这些目标投影到松弛可行集；3) 基于对偶信息的整数映射恢复整数性并保持可行性。在可微模拟器下，利用路径梯度从采样轨迹进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 可行性保证方法的误差相对于精确整数投影有界，且确保整个可行动作空间可达。在多级生产库存规划中：小规模实例平均最优性差距低于1%；比最先进echelon base-stock策略高9.75%；比滚动时域多阶段随机规划至少高7.7%。在ASML工业规模案例中，相对最佳基准策略平均成本降低3.22%，在紧约束和高需求变动的系统中节省最大。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明DRL能够在具有相互依赖硬约束的顺序决策问题中带来显著的经济效益，弥补了MILP灵活性与DRL可扩展性之间的差距，对实际运营问题具有广泛适用性。

title: Investigating Social Bias in Narrative Image Generation
comment: Accepted to GenAI4World Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) generation models are increasingly embedded in applications such as media content creation and education, raising concerns about how their outputs may reproduce social biases. Prior work has shown that T2I models exhibit social biases, yet existing evaluations largely focus on a photo generation task. As a result, it remains unclear whether and how such biases manifest in more narrative visual formats, such as storyboards and comics, where characters and events are presented across multiple panels. In this work, we compare bias expression across photo, storyboard, and comic generation in six T2I models by adapting BBG, a text-based bias evaluation framework, to image generation. Our results show that proprietary models generate 25.9% biased outputs in photo generation on average, with biased outputs increasing by 9.6pp in storyboard generation and 18.2pp in comic generation. We also find that photos mainly encode biases through subtle visual cues, while storyboards and comics reveal them more explicitly through event sequencing, character positioning, narrative resolution, and textual elements. These findings show that biases that remain less visible in photo generation may surface in narrative visual formats, highlighting the importance of evaluating T2I systems with diverse visual formats beyond photo generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了文本到图像（T2I）生成模型在照片、故事板和漫画三种视觉格式中的社会偏见表现。通过改编BBG框架，作者对六个T2I模型进行系统评估，发现偏见表现在不同格式中差异显著：专有模型在照片生成中平均有25.9%的偏见输出，故事板中增加9.6个百分点，漫画中增加18.2个百分点。照片主要通过微妙的视觉线索编码偏见，而故事板和漫画则通过事件序列、角色定位、叙事结局和文字元素更明确地暴露偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型的偏见评估主要聚焦于照片生成任务，忽略了故事板和漫画等多面板叙事视觉格式。随着这些模型被广泛应用于媒体内容创作和教育领域，需要理解偏见在不同视觉叙事格式中的表现方式和程度差异。
AI.method: 作者将BBG（一种基于文本的偏见评估框架）改编应用于图像生成领域，系统比较了六个T2I模型在照片、故事板和漫画三种格式中的偏见表现。通过分析偏见在视觉线索、事件序列、角色定位、叙事结局和文字元素等多个维度上的编码方式来进行评估。
AI.result: 专有模型在照片生成中平均产生25.9%的偏见输出，故事板生成中偏见增加9.6个百分点，漫画生成中增加18.2个百分点。照片主要通过微妙视觉线索编码偏见，而故事板和漫画通过事件序列、角色定位、叙事结局和文字元素更明确地展示偏见。
AI.conclusion: 在照片生成中不太明显的偏见可能在叙事视觉格式中浮现，这强调了T2I系统评估应超越照片生成，纳入更多样化的视觉格式，以确保全面理解模型的社会偏见问题。

title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
summary: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval. The hierarchical processing of semantic information overcomes the representation bottleneck of RLAs and endows HMM cross-task generalization through parametric learning, which is not observed in other long-context enhanced Mamba variants. Evaluations on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E tasks demonstrate that HMM improves retrieval success by 34.3--37.1% and reasoning accuracy by 1.6--14.2% over strong Mamba-based models, while adding only 2% extra parameters and with minimal training overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次记忆Mamba（HMM），通过模拟人类记忆的分层机制，在预训练Mamba骨干上集成轻量级工作记忆（提取段落级语义）与持久长期记忆（用于任务相关检索），克服了循环线性注意力模型固定容量状态导致的表示瓶颈，在Passkey Retrieval上提升检索成功率34.3-37.1%，在LongBench-E上提升推理准确率1.6-14.2%，仅增加2%参数。
AI.motivation: 循环线性注意力模型（如Mamba）虽提供高效线性时间序列建模，但其固定容量的循环状态限制了长序列建模能力，类似于人类记忆需要分层组织来扩展容量。
AI.method: 基于预训练的Mamba骨干，HMM集成轻量级工作记忆模块，从骨干隐藏状态（快速感官记忆）中提取慢速段落级语义（PLS），再将PLS压缩为持久长期记忆用于任务相关检索，实现层次化语义处理。
AI.result: 在Passkey Retrieval上检索成功率提升34.3-37.1%，在LongBench-E上推理准确率提升1.6-14.2%，且仅增加2%额外参数，训练开销极小。
AI.conclusion: HMM通过层次化记忆处理克服了RLAs的表示瓶颈，并通过参数化学习实现跨任务泛化，这是其他长上下文增强Mamba变体所不具备的。

title: KC-Agent: A Dual-Process Cognitive Architecture for Efficient ML Model Improvement
summary: Data drift poses significant challenges for machine learning systems in production, requiring continuous model updates to maintain performance. We present KC-Agent, a dual-process cognitive architecture for automated ML model improvement that combines fast pattern recognition (System 1) with deliberate incremental updates (System 2). Our approach implements structured memory systems enabling System 1 to leverage successful solutions previously discovered by System 2, achieving efficient pattern-based responses without costly re-computation. KC-Agent incorporates atomic change principles and rollback capabilities to ensure reliable, verifiable updates in production environments. We evaluate our method on five datasets including real-world NASA turbofan data with authentic temporal degradation and synthetic datasets with controlled drift scenarios. KC-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance (76.8% accuracy) while maintaining optimal efficiency (13.2s execution time), outperforming established cognitive architectures: CodeAct (+2.4%), Tree of Thoughts (+3.6%), ReAct (+8.0%), and Reflexion (+8.9%). Consensus evaluation by a panel of state-of-the-art LLMs confirms superior strategic efficacy (8.33/10 Smartness score), significantly outperforming baseline agents. The knowledge consolidation mechanism delivers 91% speedup over the slow variant while maintaining higher accuracy. Our approach demonstrates both theoretical foundations and practical viability for cognitive-inspired automated ML improvement systems capable of handling complex real-world data drift scenarios.

AI.tldr: KC-Agent是一个双过程认知架构的自动化ML模型改进系统，结合System 1（快速模式识别）和System 2（刻意增量更新），通过结构化记忆系统和原子变更原则在数据漂移场景下实现高效、可靠的模型更新，在五个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的机器学习系统面临数据漂移挑战，需要持续更新模型以维持性能。现有认知架构（如ReAct、Reflexion等）在应对数据漂移时效率低下且缺少可靠性和可验证性保障。
AI.method: 提出KC-Agent双过程认知架构：System 1利用结构化记忆系统快速匹配先前成功方案，避免重复计算；System 2执行刻意增量更新。引入原子变更原则和回滚能力确保生产环境下的可靠更新，并设计了知识整合机制加速决策。
AI.result: 在五个数据集（包括NASA涡扇真实时序退化数据和受控漂移合成数据）上达到76.8%准确率、13.2秒执行时间，优于CodeAct(+2.4%)、ToT(+3.6%)、ReAct(+8.0%)和Reflexion(+8.9%)；LLM专家组共识评分8.33/10；知识整合机制带来91%速度提升。
AI.conclusion: KC-Agent证明认知启发式自动化ML改进系统在实际数据漂移场景中兼具理论基础和实用可行性，在性能、效率和可靠性方面均有显著优势。

title: Parameter-Dynamic Adaptive Fusion and Calibration Network for RGBT Tracking
summary: Existing RGBT trackers typically employ fusion functions with fixed parameters across different targets and scenarios. Although dynamic-architecture methods improve fusion flexibility by selecting among predefined operations, they still cannot adapt the fusion parameters to the evolving target state. To address these issues, we propose a Parameter-Dynamic Adaptive Fusion and Calibration Network (PAFCNet) for RGBT tracking. PAFCNet dynamically generates target-conditioned parameters for multimodal fusion and temporal calibration, enabling the tracking process to adapt to target appearance variations and modality quality fluctuations. Specifically, we introduce a Target-Adaptive Hypernetwork (TA-HyperNet) that leverages template representations, which preserve stable target identity and recent appearance changes with less background interference, to generate target-conditioned parameters for subsequent fusion and calibration. Based on TA-HyperNet, we design a target-aware parameter-dynamic fusion module that uses the generated parameters to modulate the fusion process. This enables the fusion module to adapt to changes in target appearance and complex scene conditions. Furthermore, since spatio-temporal information propagation may accumulate tracking noise, we propose a dynamic spatio-temporal calibration module that employs TA-HyperNet to generate calibration parameters for spatio-temporal tokens. By dynamically calibrating historical information before propagation, the module improves the reliability of temporal representations. Experimental results demonstrate that PAFCNet achieves competitive performance on multiple RGBT tracking benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出参数动态自适应融合与校准网络（PAFCNet）用于RGBT跟踪。通过目标自适应超网络（TA-HyperNet）动态生成目标条件参数，用于多模态融合和时空校准，使融合参数能够随目标外观变化和模态质量波动而自适应调整。
AI.motivation: 现有RGBT跟踪器通常使用固定参数的融合函数，无法适应不同目标和场景的变化。虽然动态架构方法通过预定义操作的选择提高了融合灵活性，但仍无法将融合参数自适应于不断变化的目标状态。
AI.method: 1) 提出目标自适应超网络（TA-HyperNet），利用模板表征（包含稳定目标身份和近期外观变化，且背景干扰少）生成目标条件参数；2) 设计目标感知参数动态融合模块，用生成参数调制融合过程；3) 提出动态时空校准模块，为时空令牌生成校准参数，在传播前动态校准历史信息以减少噪声累积。
AI.result: 在多个RGBT跟踪基准上取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: PAFCNet通过动态生成目标条件参数，实现了融合过程对目标外观变化和场景复杂度的自适应，并通过时空校准提高了时序表征的可靠性，验证了参数动态化策略在RGBT跟踪中的有效性。

title: SkillTrace: Traversing a Query-Skill Graph for Composable LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by composing reusable skills from a library. To address this, the key challenge is not merely to retrieve individually relevant skills, but to identify a complete and executable skill composition. In this paper, we argue that this problem can be solved in a graph with three levels: compositional relations among skill queries, similarity between queries and candidates in the skill library, and the dependencies among the selected candidates. We introduce SkillTrace, which organizes the user query into a semantic hierarchy, matches skill queries and candidates, and propagates over the skill dependencies. Experiments on SkillsBench and ALFWorld demonstrate that SkillTrace achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a success rate of 53.17% on SkillsBench and 91.43% on ALFWorld. SkillTrace also delivers consistent improvements across different backbone language models, demonstrating the generality and robustness of graph-based skill retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillTrace，一种基于图的技能检索方法，通过三层图结构（组合关系、相似度、依赖关系）来识别完整且可执行的技能组合，在SkillsBench和ALFWorld上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体通常通过组合技能库中的可复用技能来解决复杂任务，但关键挑战不仅是检索单独相关的技能，而是要识别完整且可执行的技能组合。现有方法忽视了技能之间的组合关系和依赖关系。
AI.method: SkillTrace构建三层图结构：第一层建模技能查询之间的组合关系，将用户查询组织成语义层次；第二层计算查询与技能库中候选的相似度进行匹配；第三层建模所选候选技能之间的依赖关系，并通过图传播来整合信息，最终识别出可执行的技能组合。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench上达到53.17%的成功率，在ALFWorld上达到91.43%的成功率，均达到SOTA性能；在不同骨干语言模型上均有一致的改进，验证了方法的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的技能检索方法（SkillTrace）能够有效解决完整性和可执行性的技能组合检索问题，相比仅检索单个技能的方法有显著优势，并具有良好的模型泛化能力。

title: SecondOpinion: Anatomy-Aware Gated Reasoning for Efficient Medical Image Analysis
summary: Deep learning models for medical image analysis typically apply a fixed amount of computation to every input, regardless of case difficulty. Anatomy-guided dual-stream architectures have been shown to improve diagnostic performance, but they evaluate both streams unconditionally, even on cases a single stream could already resolve confidently. We propose SecondOpinion, a framework in which a fast primary stream processes every case, while a second, anatomy-guided stream is invoked only when GateKeeper, a gating mechanism trained explicitly as a binary correctness classifier, judges that the primary stream's prediction needs additional scrutiny, much as a clinician might seek a second opinion on a difficult case. When activated, the two streams are combined through a lightweight cross-attention fusion module. We evaluate SecondOpinion on a unified five-class chest X-ray dataset and a pelvic fracture dataset, the latter including a held-out, harder subset of fractures that are invisible on X-ray but confirmed via CT. SecondOpinion matches or exceeds prior state-of-the-art performance on both tasks, while activating its anatomy-guided stream on only 9.23% of chest X-ray cases, rising to 24.12% on visible fractures and 45.71% on invisible fractures, an activation rate that tracks task difficulty directly. These results suggest that supervising a gating signal toward correctness, rather than relying on unsupervised confidence, allows a model to allocate anatomical reasoning where it is actually needed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SecondOpinion框架，通过一个快速主流处理所有病例，仅当GateKeeper（一个专门训练的二元正确性分类器）判断需要额外审查时才激活第二道解剖引导流。在胸部和骨盆骨折数据集上，SecondOpinion达到或超过最先进性能，同时仅在9.23%胸部X光、24.12%可见骨折和45.71%不可见骨折病例上激活解剖流，激活率直接反映任务难度。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分析的深度学习模型通常对每个输入施加固定计算量，不考虑病例难度。虽然解剖引导的双流架构能提升诊断性能，但它们无条件地评估两个流，即使单个流已经可以自信解决病例。作者希望像临床医生寻求第二意见一样，仅在困难病例上才调用第二个解剖引导流，以节省计算资源并合理分配解剖推理。
AI.method: 1) 设计一个快速主流处理所有病例；2) 训练一个GateKeeper作为显式二元正确性分类器，判断主流预测是否需要额外审查；3) 仅当GateKeeper判定需要时，才激活第二个解剖引导流；4) 通过轻量级交叉注意力融合模块将两个流的输出进行组合。
AI.result: 在统一五类胸部X光数据集和骨盆骨折数据集（包括CT确认但X光不可见的困难子集）上，SecondOpinion达到或超过先前最先进性能。解剖引导流激活率：胸部X光9.23%、可见骨折24.12%、不可见骨折45.71%，激活率直接与任务难度挂钩。
AI.conclusion: 监督门控信号朝向正确性（而非依赖无监督置信度）允许模型将解剖推理分配到真正需要的地方，实现性能与计算效率的平衡，并且激活率能够直接反映病例难度。

title: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple robot action prediction with video world models. Existing WAMs with shared-backbone and Mixture-of-Transformers designs generally tie the depth of the action module to that of the video backbone, resulting in substantial computational overhead and high inference latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Dock of Transformer (DoT), a video-centric design principle that treats a pretrained video Transformer as a representation hub and connects lightweight output-heads through docking interfaces. This enables flexible output-head design while providing direct access to representations from all layers of the backbone. We then introduce \textbf{Faster-WAM}, an instantiation of DoT for WAMs, which docks a single-layer action head onto a 30-layer video backbone. The docking interface fuses keys and values from all video layers and applies RoPE realignment. Without additional embodied pretraining, Faster-WAM achieves competitive performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 while demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus. Faster-WAM also achieves the lowest end-to-end latency in our controlled comparison, requiring only 66.5 ms per inference --- a \(3.2\times\) speedup over Fast-WAM. Overall, these results demonstrate that the video-centric DoT architecture supports flexible task-specific head design while delivering low inference latency, strong action-prediction performance, and robust generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DoT（Dock of Transformer）架构设计原则，将预训练视频Transformer作为表征中枢，通过对接接口连接轻量级输出头，并基于此构建了Faster-WAM模型。Faster-WAM将单层动作头对接至30层视频骨干，在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上取得竞争性性能，端到端推理延迟仅66.5ms（比Fast-WAM快3.2倍），且具有较强的分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）采用共享骨干或MoE设计，动作模块深度与视频骨干深度绑定，导致大量计算开销和高推理延迟。作者希望解耦动作模块与视频骨干的深度约束，实现低延迟的同时不牺牲性能。
AI.method: 提出DoT（Dock of Transformer）设计原则：将预训练视频Transformer视为表征中枢，通过对接接口（docking interface）连接轻量级输出头，使输出头能直接访问骨干所有层的表征。具体实例化Faster-WAM：单层动作头对接30层视频骨干，对接接口融合所有视频层的k/v并应用RoPE重对齐。
AI.result: Faster-WAM无需额外的具身预训练，在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上取得竞争性性能，在LIBERO-Plus上表现出强分布外泛化能力。端到端推理延迟最低，仅66.5ms/次，比Fast-WAM快3.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 视频中心的DoT架构支持灵活的任务特定输出头设计，同时实现低推理延迟、强动作预测性能和稳健泛化，证明了将视频模型作为表征中枢、轻量输出头对接的设计方向的有效性。

title: DAVET: Denoising-Aware Visual Evidence Trajectory Allocation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
summary: Diffusion vision-language models (dVLMs) iteratively denoise masked responses while conditioning each denoising step on visual evidence, making visual conditioning a substantial recurring inference cost. Unlike autoregressive decoding, diffusion generation repeatedly revisits the entire response as uncertainty evolves.
