Our analysis reveals that visual evidence demand is strongly step-dependent, motivating adaptive allocation across denoising steps. Existing inference acceleration methods operate through decoding-side strategies or visual token compression via pruning and merging, but do not explicitly treat visual evidence as a resource whose demand evolves across the diffusion process. Therefore, we present Denoising-Aware Visual Evidence Trajectory Allocation (DAVET), a training-free framework that allocates visual evidence according to the evolving generation state. Starting from a phase-conditioned evidence trajectory, the proposed allocation policy uses operation demand to set an evidence reserve whose allocation at each denoising step is modulated by trajectory risk. DAVET realizes the resulting budgets through a hierarchy of evidence views constructed from a single visual encoding, separating when and how much evidence is needed from how the evidence views are constructed. Evaluated on two representative dVLMs, LLaDA-V and LaViDa, across multiple visual-understanding benchmarks, DAVET achieves an average speedup of 1.55$\times$ with an average relative performance drop of 1.86\%, showing that denoising-aware visual evidence allocation can reduce visual conditioning cost while largely preserving generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAVET框架，针对扩散视觉语言模型（dVLMs）中视觉条件在每个去噪步骤重复计算的高昂推理成本问题，通过动态分配视觉证据来加速推理。DAVET是无需训练的框架，基于阶段条件证据轨迹和操作需求来设定证据储备，并通过轨迹风险调节每步的证据分配。在LLaDA-V和LaViDa两个模型上，平均加速1.55倍，性能平均仅下降1.86%。
AI.motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型在每一步去噪时都基于视觉证据进行条件化，导致视觉条件成为重复且高昂的推理开销。与自回归解码不同，扩散生成会反复遍历整个响应，且视觉证据需求随去噪步骤而变化。现有加速方法（解码侧策略或视觉token剪枝/合并）均未将视觉证据视为随扩散过程需求动态演化的资源。
AI.method: DAVET是一个无需训练的框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 从阶段条件证据轨迹出发，基于操作需求设定证据储备，并通过轨迹风险调制每个去噪步骤的证据分配；(2) 从单一视觉编码构建分层证据视图，将"何时需要多少证据"与"如何构建证据视图"解耦，从而高效实现预算分配。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-V和LaViDa两个代表性dVLMs上，跨多个视觉理解基准评估，DAVET实现了平均1.55倍加速，平均相对性能下降仅为1.86%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，去噪感知的视觉证据分配能显著降低视觉条件化的推理成本，同时大体上保持生成质量，验证了将视觉证据作为随扩散动态演化的资源进行自适应分配的有效性。

title: Chess on Ice: Curling Tactical Decision-Making via Backward Induction and Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Curling is often referred to as "Chess on Ice", owing to the tactical complexity of its decision-making process. Yet unlike chess, curling remains largely underexplored from a machine learning perspective, with prior work confined mainly to statistical approaches. We propose a reinforcement learning framework capable of quantitatively evaluating and comparing tactical options in curling. The game poses several modeling challenges: continuous state and action spaces, stochastic action outcomes reflecting player skill variability, and state transitions that are highly sensitive to small perturbations in the executed action. To address them, we employ the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient actor-critic algorithm, adapted to exploit the finite-horizon structure of the game. Our experiments show that effective curling strategies can be acquired in a fully self-supervised manner, without any human-annotated data: on a reduced four-rock variant, the learned agent matches a hand-crafted expert heuristic in a regime where that heuristic is close to optimal, a parity we quantify against the intrinsic hammer advantage of the variant. Beyond the resulting policy, the learned critic provides a dense value estimate over the entire continuous action space, enabling the quantitative comparison of tactical alternatives for applications such as post-game performance analysis and decision support during athlete preparation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于深度强化学习的冰壶决策框架，采用DDPG算法（针对有限时间结构进行适配），在缩减版四石变体中实现了无需人工标注数据的自监督策略学习，其表现可与手工专家启发式相当，并通过学习到的critic提供连续动作空间的稠密价值估计，用于战术量化比较。
AI.motivation: 冰壶被称为"冰上国际象棋"，战术决策复杂度高，但与围棋等棋类不同，冰壶在机器学习领域研究甚少。以往工作主要局限于统计方法，缺乏能够定量评估和比较战术选项的学习框架。
AI.method: 采用深度确定性策略梯度（Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient, DDPG）actor-critic算法，并针对冰壶游戏的有限时域（finite-horizon）结构进行适配。框架需应对三个建模挑战：连续状态与动作空间、反映玩家技能差异的随机动作结果、以及状态转移对动作微小扰动的极度敏感性。
AI.result: 在缩减的四石变体中，完全自监督（无人工标注数据）训练得到的智能体表现可与手工专家启发式策略相媲美（在该启发式接近最优的区间内），这一对等性通过对变体固有后手优势（hammer advantage）的定量分析得到验证。此外，学习到的critic能对整个连续动作空间提供密集的价值估计，支持战术替代方案的定量比较。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明有效冰壶策略可以通过纯自监督强化学习获取，无需人类专家数据。学习到的价值函数同时具备实用价值，可应用于赛后表现分析和运动员备战决策支持等场景，为冰壶这项"冰上国际象棋"开辟了机器学习研究的新方向。

title: Detail Continuation over a Trustworthy Coarse Scale for Autoregressive Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026. 10 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/K2NSR
summary: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge in generative super-resolution (GSR), where reconstructed results may contain visually plausible yet weakly supported content, structural deviations, or unnatural textures with respect to the low-resolution (LR) input. Existing GSR methods have extensively explored the trade-off between perceptual realism and reconstruction fidelity, but the division between preserving reliable coarse-scale information and restoring more uncertain fine details is often handled implicitly within the overall restoration process. Visual autoregressive (VAR) modeling provides a natural opportunity to revisit this issue, as its coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction offers an explicit scale-wise generation interface. However, existing VAR-based SR methods still inherit the original full 1-to-$N$ autoregressive generation path, even though, for super-resolution, coarse-scale information in LR is often relatively more reliable, while long autoregressive chains may accumulate prediction errors. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textbf{K2N}, which reformulates VAR-based SR from full-path generation into a $k$-to-$N$ detail continuation process. Specifically, early coarse-scale states are established directly from LR, while only the remaining finer scales are restored autoregressively. Experimental results show that K2N remains competitive with the VARSR baseline on standard SR metrics, while exhibiting clearer advantages on hallucination-focused evaluation. These findings suggest that explicitly rethinking the generation path in a scale-wise manner can be a promising direction for improving the reliability of generative super-resolution. Our code will be released soon at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/K2NSR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出K2N方法，将基于视觉自回归（VAR）的超分辨率重建从完整1-to-N的自回归生成路径重构为k-to-N的细节延续过程。粗尺度信息直接从低分辨率图像建立，仅对其余更精细尺度进行自回归恢复，从而减少长自回归链的误差累积，在保持标准SR指标竞争力的同时，在幻觉聚焦评估上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 生成式超分辨率（GSR）中幻觉问题持续存在，重建结果可能包含视觉上合理但缺乏依据的内容。现有方法在感知真实性与重建保真度之间权衡时，往往隐式地处理可靠粗尺度信息与不确定细细节的划分。VAR模型的粗到细逐尺度预测提供了显式的尺度级生成接口，但现有VAR-based SR方法仍沿用完整1-to-N自回归路径，而粗尺度信息相对可靠，长自回归链可能累积预测误差。
AI.method: K2N将VAR-based SR从全路径生成重构为k-to-N细节延续过程。具体而言，早期粗尺度状态直接从LR输入建立，仅剩余更精细的尺度通过自回归方式恢复，减少不必要的自回归步骤和误差累积。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，K2N在标准SR指标上与VARSR基线保持竞争力，同时在幻觉聚焦评估上展现出更明显的优势。
AI.conclusion: 以尺度级方式显式重新思考生成路径，是提升生成式超分辨率可靠性的有前景方向。代码将开源。

title: Cooperative Coevolution for Resource-Constrained Agentic LLM Post-Training
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents produce long, multi-turn trajectories, making gradient-based post-training memory-intensive. Evolution strategies (ES) enable memory-efficient full-parameter post-training without backpropagation and can eventually match the performance of gradient-based reinforcement learning (RL). However, resource-constrained settings typically offer only a few GPUs, so the high GPU-hour requirements of ES translate into prohibitively long training times. To address this, we introduce Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy (CoPES), a cooperative coevolutionary method that decomposes the full parameter space into lower-dimensional subspaces and searches over them cooperatively to improve optimization efficiency. We post-train a Qwen3.5-4B tool-using agent for the math task and evaluate it on five benchmarks of varying difficulty. Under the GPU-hour budget of full-parameter GRPO's best validation checkpoint, CoPES recovers 92% of GRPO's validation-accuracy gain, versus 67% for standard ES, while its theoretical GPU memory requirement is less than one-eighth that of full-parameter GRPO. It consistently outperforms standard ES and LoRA-based GRPO on all evaluated pass@k metrics across the five benchmarks. Additional experiments further show the advantage of CoPES on the question-answering task. These results demonstrate an improved trade-off between memory requirements and training time for agentic LLM post-training under resource constraints. The code is open-sourced in https://github.com/MetaronWang/CoPES

AI.tldr: CoPES是一种合作协同进化方法，通过将完整参数空间分解为低维子空间进行合作搜索，在资源受限（仅少数GPU）条件下显著提升工具使用LLM智能体的后训练效率，以远低于完整参数GRPO的训练时间和不到八分之一的GPU内存，恢复了GRPO验证精度增益的92%。
AI.motivation: 工具使用LLM智能体产生长多轮轨迹，基于梯度的后训练内存消耗大。虽然进化策略（ES）无需反向传播即可实现内存高效的全参数后训练，并最终能达到与梯度RL相当的性能，但在资源受限环境下（仅少数GPU），ES的高GPU小时需求会导致训练时间过长，亟需提升优化效率。
AI.method: 提出Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy（CoPES），一种合作协同进化方法。它将完整参数空间分解为较低维度的子空间，并在这些子空间上进行合作搜索，以提高优化效率，在降低内存需求的同时加速训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B工具使用智能体的数学任务后训练中，在五个不同难度基准上评估：在完整参数GRPO最佳验证检查点的相同GPU时长预算下，CoPES恢复了GRPO验证精度增益的92%（标准ES仅为67%），理论GPU内存需求不到完整参数GRPO的八分之一；在所有五个基准的pass@k指标上一致优于标准ES和基于LoRA的GRPO；额外的问答任务实验也显示了CoPES的优势。
AI.conclusion: CoPES实现了内存需求和训练时间之间更好的权衡，为资源受限环境下的智能体LLM后训练提供了一种高效的解决方案。

title: PartMat: Material-Aware 3D Part Decomposition with a Single Global Latent
summary: Part-level 3D generation has recently attracted increasing attention for producing structured and editable 3D assets. However, existing methods typically decompose objects according to functional semantics rather than the editable material boundaries (e.g., fabric, wood, metal) required in practical 3D applications such as interior design. Additionally, current methods often generate parts independently, causing computational costs to scale linearly with the part count. To address these limitations, we present PartMat, an efficient material-aware 3D part decomposition pipeline that represents multi-part geometry with a single global latent. Given a reference image and a single whole-object geometry, PartMat decomposes the object into parts that follow material boundaries. First, we propose PartVAE to learn such a unified representation and decode all material parts in a single forward pass, thereby decoupling inference cost from the number of parts. Second, with this representation, a diffusion model is trained for part generation and refined via reinforcement learning for accurate material assignment and overlap suppression. Finally, to recover fine-grained geometric details, we introduce a sparse-voxel flow-matching model with part attention for geometry post-processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PartMat significantly outperforms existing baselines in material-aware decomposition accuracy and achieves comparable geometric quality, while maintaining efficient inference.

AI.tldr: PartMat是一个高效的材质感知3D部件分解与生成管线，通过单一全局潜变量表示多部件几何，实现推理成本与部件数量解耦，同时支持材质边界感知的部件分解。
AI.motivation: 现有3D部件级生成方法通常按功能语义而非可编辑材质边界（如布料、木材、金属）进行分解，且部件独立生成导致计算成本随部件数量线性增长，不满足实际3D应用（如室内设计）需求。
AI.method: 1) 提出PartVAE学习统一潜表示，单次前向解码所有材质部件，解耦推理成本与部件数；2) 基于该表示训练扩散模型生成部件，并通过强化学习优化材质分配和重叠抑制；3) 引入带部件注意力的稀疏体素流匹配模型进行几何后处理以恢复细粒度细节。
AI.result: 实验表明PartMat在材质感知分解准确性上显著优于现有基线方法，几何质量相当，且推理效率更高。
AI.conclusion: PartMat证明了通过全局潜表示统一表示多部件几何，可以在保持高质量生成的同时实现高效的材质感知3D部件分解，为面向实际应用的3D资产编辑提供了可行方案。

title: MonitrLLM: A Community-Centered Evaluation Infrastructure for Large Language Models
summary:
Benchmark suites assess model capability on controlled tasks; large-scale conversation corpora capture naturalistic use without user feedback; and in-interface feedback mechanisms record satisfaction without task purpose. Together, they leave a critical gap in LLM evaluation: no existing infrastructure routinely links interaction trajectories to user-defined outcomes. We introduce MonitrLLM, open-source infrastructure for community-centered LLM evaluations that links full conversation transcripts to user-reported task intent and outcome assessments, treating all three as primary evaluative signals rather than optional metadata.
  To demonstrate the value of this approach, we conducted a two-week feasibility pilot with 26 college students using ChatGPT, collecting 206 evaluation reports with full conversation transcripts. The findings from our pilot demonstrate the value of connecting conversation trajectories with user-reported outcomes. For instance, despite reporting high average satisfaction (4.19/5) with their LLM interactions, participants also experience a substantial 23.1% failure rate on their goal tasks. We also find that multi-turn conversations are reported as failing at 2.5 times the rate of single-turn exchanges, a pattern that reframes extended interaction as a signal of difficulty rather than engagement. We conclude by discussing the value of incorporating direct user feedback with observational data for robust LLM evaluations, and the possibilities for infrastructure that enables this goal.

AI.tldr: MonitrLLM是一个开源基础设施，将完整对话记录与用户报告的任务意图和结果评估相连接，填补了现有LLM评估框架中缺乏"交互轨迹-用户定义结果"关联的空白。通过26名大学生为期两周的试点研究（206份评估报告），发现高满意度（4.19/5）与23.1%目标任务失败率并存，且多轮对话失败率是单轮的2.5倍，挑战了将多轮交互简单视为"参与度"的传统理解。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估存在三类割裂的信号：基准测试衡量受控任务能力、大规模对话语料捕捉自然使用但缺乏用户反馈、界面内反馈机制记录满意度但不含任务目的。三者之间存在关键空白——缺乏将完整交互轨迹与用户自定义结果相连接的基础设施，导致无法全面理解LLM在实际使用中的真实表现。
AI.method: 作者构建MonitrLLM开源基础设施，将三种信号（对话全文、用户报告的任务意图、结果评估）作为主要评估信号。通过26名大学生使用ChatGPT的为期两周可行性试点，收集206份包含完整对话记录的评估报告，并比较满意度评分与实际任务成功率的差异，同时分析单轮与多轮对话的结果差异。
AI.result: 试点发现：用户平均满意度为4.19/5（较高），但实际目标任务失败率高达23.1%；多轮对话的报告失败率是单轮对话的2.5倍，表明多轮交互更多反映任务困难而非用户参与度。
AI.conclusion: 将直接用户反馈与观察性数据相结合对稳健的LLM评估具有重要价值，MonitrLLM展示了实现这一目标的基础设施可能性，并为社区中心的LLM评估提供了新范式。

title: DeepVoyager-VL: Incentivizing Vision-in-the-Loop Search for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced visual understanding and reasoning, yet their static parametric knowledge limits their ability to address knowledge-intensive and dynamically evolving open-world problems. To move beyond this limitation, multimodal deep search has emerged as a key direction for open-world information access, evolving from single-turn factual retrieval toward long-horizon, multi-turn search guided by visual evidence. However, existing methods typically confine vision to the input or answer stage, overlooking its role in intermediate reasoning, and lack designs tailored to long-horizon interaction. Consequently, visual evidence rarely drives continued retrieval, constraining both interaction depth and reasoning span. To address these limitations, we propose DeepVoyager-VL, a long-horizon multimodal deep-search framework for vision-in-the-loop search. Specifically, we construct a multimodal event graph to drive data synthesis, yielding problems with intermediate visual dependencies and long reasoning chains. We then design an agent framework for active visual acquisition and on-demand image loading. Finally, we fine-tune models on the synthesized data without reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across ten multimodal search benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepVoyager-VL，一个长时程多模态深度搜索框架，通过构建多模态事件图驱动数据合成，设计主动视觉获取与按需图像加载的智能体框架，使视觉证据真正参与中间推理环节，并仅通过微调（无需强化学习）即在十个多模态搜索基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs依赖静态参数知识，难以应对知识密集和动态演化的开放世界问题。多模态深度搜索虽有发展，但现有方法通常将视觉仅限制在输入或答案阶段，忽视了其在中间推理中的作用，且缺乏针对长时程交互的设计，导致视觉证据难以驱动持续检索，限制了交互深度和推理跨度。
AI.method: 1）构建多模态事件图驱动数据合成，生成具有中间视觉依赖性和长推理链的问题；2）设计智能体框架，支持主动视觉获取（actively acquire visual information）和按需图像加载（on-demand image loading）；3）在合成数据上直接进行微调训练，不采用强化学习。
AI.result: 在十个多模态搜索基准上的广泛实验验证了DeepVoyager-VL方法的有效性，表明其能显著提升长时程、多轮视觉引导搜索的性能。
AI.conclusion: DeepVoyager-VL通过将视觉置于搜索循环中间环节（vision-in-the-loop），并借助事件图驱动的数据合成与无需强化学习的微调策略，有效解决了现有方法中视觉证据难以驱动持续检索的问题，为多模态深度搜索提供了新的框架思路。

title: xPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding
summary: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its predecessors. Such independently sampled marginals tend to produce sequences with tokens that are individually likely, but jointly improbable under the target model's distribution, which verifies each token conditionally. This can cause early rejection and limits acceptance length. To address this, we propose xPress as a means to restore the missing causality in diffusion drafters. xPress is a lightweight causal refiner that reconciles the whole diffusion block at once through parallel refinement, restoring and propagating causal dependencies across the draft without a token-by-token loop. On Qwen3-8B, across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks, xPress raises acceptance length by about 30% on average (up to +56%) and its end-to-end decoding throughput by about 1.3 on average (up to 1.7) compared to the original dFlash diffusion drafter.

AI.tldr: xPress是一种轻量级因果精炼器，用于恢复扩散草稿生成器（如dFlash）中缺失的因果依赖关系。通过并行精炼方式一次性协调整个扩散块，无需逐token循环，从而提升推测解码的接受长度和端到端吞吐量。在Qwen3-8B上，七个基准测试中平均接受长度提升约30%，吞吐量提升约1.3倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散草稿生成器（如dFlash）虽能以单次前向传播生成整块草稿token，大幅减少多token草稿的开销，但其单次离散去噪过程在每个位置采样条件独立的token，产生的是逐位置边际分布而非联合分布。这导致草稿token间缺乏因果依赖，序列虽个体概率高但联合概率低，容易在目标模型的逐token条件验证中被提前拒绝，限制了接受长度。
AI.method: 提出xPress，一种轻量级因果精炼器。它通过并行精炼一次性协调整个扩散块，在草稿中恢复并传播因果依赖关系，同时避免逐token循环带来的开销。具体做法是在扩散草稿生成后，对整块token进行并行因果精炼，使每个token重新依赖于其前驱token，从而将边际分布修正为更接近目标模型的联合分布。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B模型上，涵盖数学、代码和聊天任务的七个基准测试中，与原始dFlash扩散草稿生成器相比，xPress平均将接受长度提高约30%（最高达+56%），端到端解码吞吐量平均提升约1.3倍（最高达1.7倍）。
AI.conclusion: xPress有效解决了一类扩散式草稿生成器因缺乏因果依赖而导致接受率低的问题，在不引入逐token循环开销的前提下显著提升推测解码性能，展示了轻量级并行精炼在恢复草稿因果关系方面的有效性。

title: MoCRA: Mixture of Compositional Rank-1 Atoms for 4K All-in-One Video Restoration
summary: Real-world video arrives hazy, rainy, dark, or noisy, and a deployable restorer faces three demands at once: no degradation label, native 4K output, and stability in playback. Existing methods answer them separately and break on the joint problem, because per-frame degradation readings flip between frames, downsampled proxies erase the rain and noise they are meant to remove, and dense temporal alignment does not fit 4K memory. No paired benchmark even poses that problem, so we build one. UHV-4K-AIO renders physically modeled haze, rain, sensor noise, and low light over the same 100 clean 4K clips with shared depth and motion, and its construction exposes the split MoCRA is built on: haze and low light survive aggressive downsampling, while rain and noise exist only at native scale. Band-matched compositional conditioning follows, spending conditioning capacity, computation, and supervision in the band where each degradation lives. One dictionary of rank-1 atoms, recomposed sparsely per frame, conditions both a once-per-clip coarse branch and a shallow native-resolution refiner, in 3.6M parameters and with no optical flow. Trained once for all four tasks, MoCRA takes the best task-mean PSNR of eleven retrained image and video baselines, holds warping error at the level of the flow-based video models while never estimating motion, and restores native 4K in under half a second, against 1.7 seconds for the fastest baseline.

AI.tldr: MoCRA 是一个统一的 4K 视频修复模型，通过频带匹配的组合条件化机制，同时处理雾、雨、噪声和低光四种退化，无需标签和光流估计，在3.6M参数下实现半秒内原生4K修复，并超越了11个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 真实世界视频同时面临雾、雨、暗光和噪声等多种退化，而现有方法各自解决单一问题，无法应对三者联合挑战：逐帧退化估计不稳定、降采样丢失雨和噪声细节、密集时序对齐不适合4K内存。且缺乏同时覆盖这些退化的配对基准数据集。
AI.method: 1) 构建 UHV-4K-AIO 基准：在100个干净4K视频上物理建模雾、雨、传感器噪声和低光，共享深度和运动；2) 频带匹配的组合条件化：利用"雾和低光在降采样后存活，雨和噪声仅在原生尺度存在"的观察，将条件化能力、计算和监督分配到退化所在的频带；3) 稀疏低秩字典：一个秩1原子字典按帧稀疏重组，驱动一次每片段粗分支和浅层原生分辨率细化器，共3.6M参数，无需光流。
AI.result: 在四个任务的联合训练下，MoCRA 取得了11个重新训练的图像和视频基线中最佳的任务平均PSNR；扭曲误差与基于光流的视频模型持平但从不估计运动；在不到半秒内恢复原生4K，而最快基线需要1.7秒。
AI.conclusion: MoCRA 证明通过理解不同退化在频带上的分布特性，可以用极轻量级、无光流的架构同时解决多种退化，实现高效稳定的原生4K视频修复，为该联合任务设定了新基准。

title: Agentic Commerce World: An Auditable and Verifiable Environment for Vibe Commerce
summary: In vibe coding, people describe software in natural language and delegate implementation to AI agents. By analogy, vibe commerce allows people to express buying or selling goals in natural language and delegate the corresponding tasks to agents. Commerce, however, requires independently controlled Buyer and Merchant agents to interact in a shared market while preserving their private objectives and distinct authority. We introduce Agentic Commerce World (ACWorld), an environment for evaluating such agents across ongoing transactions. Through its Vibe Commerce Protocol (VCP), ACWorld validates agent actions before updating shared transaction state and records the resulting interactions, making agent behavior auditable and evaluation reproducible. The ACWorld Benchmark contains a 200-task capability-coverage track and a 60-task large-catalog track that searches 785,022 transactable listings. Across ten models, mean scores range from 65.9% to 85.6% and from 56.1% to 91.4%, respectively. Our analysis shows that process-level evidence is necessary: final state alone can miss evaluated errors, incomplete trajectories still retain useful process signals, and large-catalog tasks expose bottlenecks across stages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACWorld（Agentic Commerce World），一个用于评估AI代理在商业交易场景中表现的基准环境。通过Vibe Commerce Protocol（VCP）协议验证代理行为并记录交互过程，包含200个任务的能力覆盖测试和60个任务的大型目录测试（搜索785,022条可交易列表）。实验表明不同模型得分范围从65.9%到91.4%，并证明了过程级证据评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 随着vibe coding的成功，人们开始将类似的自然语言委托模式应用到商业领域（vibe commerce）。但商业场景比编码更复杂，需要独立控制的买方和卖方代理在共享市场中交互，同时保持各自的私有目标和不同权限。现有的评估环境无法满足这种需求，因此需要一个能够评估此类代理在持续交易中表现的标准化环境。
AI.method: 作者引入ACWorld（Agentic Commerce World），这是一个用于评估买方和卖方代理在持续交易中表现的环境。其核心是Vibe Commerce Protocol（VCP），该协议在更新共享交易状态之前验证代理的操作，并记录所有交互结果，使代理行为可审计、评估可复现。基准包含两个测试轨道：200个任务的能力覆盖轨道和60个任务的大型目录轨道（搜索785,022条可交易列表）。
AI.result: 在十个模型上，能力覆盖轨道平均得分范围为65.9%到85.6%，大型目录轨道平均得分范围为56.1%到91.4%。分析表明：仅依赖最终状态评估会遗漏已评估的错误；不完整的轨迹仍然保留有用的过程信号；大型目录任务暴露了各阶段的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 过程级证据对于商业代理评估至关重要，仅检查最终状态不足以准确评估代理行为。ACWorld为vibe commerce代理的标准化评估提供了基础设施，且大型目录测试揭示了代理在各交易阶段面临的挑战。

title: Decoupling semantics from vision: A framework for faithful visual-text compression evaluation
summary: Recent visual-text compression (VTC) methods, typified by DeepSeek-OCR, report impressive high token compression ratios for long-context modeling tasks by leveraging text-to-image rendering. However, existing evaluation protocols heavily rely on downstream task performance. Such evaluation metrics fail to accurately measure text preservation due to the strong inherent linguistic priors of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). In this work, we introduce a new evaluation framework that decouples MLLMs' capabilities to faithfully assess VTC quality. Within this framework, we further introduce the ZeroSense Benchmark to ensure low semantic correlation of testing samples. By eliminating textual dependencies, our benchmark guarantees that the evaluation results are purely reflective of VTC quality, unaffected by the semantic inference capabilities of downstream models. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that VTC quality and downstream task accuracy diverge significantly, highlighting the necessity of our decoupled evaluation framework.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有视觉文本压缩（VTC）评估协议过度依赖下游任务性能，无法准确衡量文本保留质量。为此，作者提出一种解耦MLLM能力的评估框架，并引入ZeroSense基准测试，确保测试样本具有低语义相关性，使评估结果纯粹反映VTC质量。
AI.motivation: 现有VTC方法（如DeepSeek-OCR）的评估协议严重依赖下游任务性能，但由于MLLM具有强大的语言先验，这些指标无法准确衡量文本保留的真实质量。需要一种能够解耦MLLM语义推理能力、纯粹评估VTC压缩质量的评估框架。
AI.method: 1. 提出一种新的评估框架，将MLLM的能力从VTC质量评估中解耦；2. 在该框架内引入ZeroSense基准测试，通过确保测试样本具有低语义相关性来消除文本依赖，保证评估结果不受下游模型语义推理能力影响。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，VTC质量与下游任务准确率之间存在显著分歧，证明了所提出的解耦评估框架的必要性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 现有基于下游任务性能的评估方式会因MLLM语言先验而高估或掩盖VTC的真实质量，所提出的解耦评估框架和ZeroSense基准能够更可靠、更纯粹地衡量VTC的文本保留能力。

title: Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-III: Semantic Geometry Observatory
summary: With the widespread adoption of Vision Transformers in modern AI, the need to analyze their inherent representational behavior has become increasingly important. While most existing studies emphasize token geometries and training dynamics, the evolution of representational covariance structures and class-level geometric organization remains comparatively underexplored. In this work, we investigate semantic geometry and class separability as representations evolve across the layers of ViT-Small/16 through TGO-III: Semantic Geometry Observatory. It is a framework designed to analyze the emergence of semantic organization, feature evolution, and class-wise representation geometry throughout training. The framework employs multiple complementary observatories, including Linear Probe Accuracy, Fisher Ratio, Class Centroid Distances, Local Intrinsic Dimension, and Local PCA Rank, to quantify the progressive evolution of discriminative representations. Our analysis reveals that class representations become progressively more linearly separable, Fisher discriminability increases, class centroids move farther apart, and local representation manifolds exhibit structured class-dependent geometric complexity. These observations provide empirical evidence supporting the Semantic Expansion Hypothesis, suggesting that the manifold expansion observed in previous observatories is accompanied by the progressive organization of representations into increasingly discriminative semantic structures. Collectively, TGO-III extends the Transformer Geometry Observatory framework by establishing a direct connection between manifold geometry, covariance evolution, and semantic organization during Transformer training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TGO-III（Semantic Geometry Observatory）框架，用于分析Vision Transformer（ViT-Small/16）在训练过程中表征的语义几何和类可分性演化。通过多种互补观测工具（线性探针精度、Fisher比率、类质心距离、局部内在维度和局部PCA秩），揭示了类的表征逐步变得更加线性可分、Fisher判别性增强、类质心距离增大，以及局部表征流形呈现类依赖的几何复杂度。这些发现支持语义扩展假说。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多关注ViT的token几何和训练动态，而表征协方差结构的演化和类级几何组织尚未得到充分探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，深入理解ViT内部表征如何随网络层次演化并形成语义组织。
AI.method: 提出TGO-III框架，集成多种互补的"观测站"（Linear Probe Accuracy、Fisher Ratio、Class Centroid Distances、Local Intrinsic Dimension、Local PCA Rank），系统地量化ViT-Small/16各层表征在训练过程中的语义组织、特征演化和类级几何结构。
AI.result: 实验发现：1）类表征随层数增加逐步变得更线性可分；2）Fisher判别性持续增强；3）类质心间距离不断增大；4）局部表征流形呈现结构化、类依赖的几何复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为语义扩展假说提供了经验证据，表明先前观测到的流形扩展伴随着表征向越来越具判别性的语义结构逐步组织的过程。TGO-III将流形几何、协方差演化与语义组织建立了直接联系，扩展了Transformer Geometry Observatory框架。

title: ParEvalLayer: When Partial LLM-Agent Evaluations Support a Decision
comment: Accepted at the 2026 ACM International Conference on AI-ML Systems (AIMLSystems)
summary: LLM-agent evaluations often produce task outcomes long before the full benchmark run is complete. A partial score is tempting to report, but it does not show whether the observed tasks support the same conclusion as the completed evaluation. Early tasks can omit important parts of a benchmark, running cheaper tasks first can distort the observed sample, and a rule that decides only easy pairs can appear accurate while leaving many comparisons unresolved. We introduce ParEvalLayer, a decision layer that reads paired outcomes for two agent systems and a comparison policy chosen in advance. For each partial run, it records whether the tested agent system is better by the required amount, is not better by that amount, needs more evidence, or should abstain. We evaluate ParEvalLayer by replaying completed public benchmark data as if each evaluation had stopped earlier. At each point, ParEvalLayer applies the policy using only the outcomes observed so far; if it reaches one of the two comparison judgments, we check whether that judgment matches the completed data for the same system pair. With the main comparison rule, three of the public benchmarks reach the same decision as the completed evaluation after observing only 15% to 25% of task outcomes. Other benchmarks require more task outcomes. This variation shows why a partial score alone is not enough: reports should also state the decision rule and how many comparisons remain without a decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ParEvalLayer，一个用于LLM智能体评估的决策层，通过预定义的比较策略在部分评估结果上判断两个智能体系统的优劣，避免过早报告部分分数带来的误导性结论。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体评估通常在完整基准运行结束前就产生任务结果，部分分数具有诱惑力但无法证明观察到的任务是否支持与完整评估相同的结论。早期任务可能遗漏重要部分，先运行廉价任务会扭曲样本，仅对简单任务对做决策的规则可能看似准确但留下大量未解决的比较。
AI.method: ParEvalLayer作为一个决策层，读取两个智能体系统的配对结果和预先选择的比较策略。对于每个部分运行，它记录被测系统是否优于所需量、是否未优于该量、需要更多证据或应弃权。通过重放已完成的公共基准数据来评估——仿佛每次评估提前停止，在每个时间点仅使用已观察到的结果应用策略。
AI.result: 使用主要比较规则时，三个公共基准在仅观察15%到25%的任务结果后就得出与完整评估相同的结论，其他基准则需要更多任务结果。
AI.conclusion: 仅报告部分分数是不够的，报告还应说明决策规则以及有多少比较尚未作出决定。基准间的差异凸显了系统化决策框架的必要性。

title: Beyond Illumination: A Conditional Mutual Information-Guided Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) seeks to restore structural fidelity, natural color rendition, and proper exposure from images captured under inadequate lighting conditions. Recent state-of-the-art approaches, such as CIDNet, adopt a dual-branch architecture comprising a chrominance (HV) branch and an intensity (I) branch to separately model decoupled chromatic and luminance information within the HVI color space. However, these methods overlook the mutual interaction between intensity and chrominance components, which inherently limits their representational capacity and leads to suboptimal enhancement performance. To address this limitation, we propose the Conditional Mutual Information-Guided Network (CMIG-Net), which leverages conditional mutual information as a principled metric to quantitatively assess the contribution of chrominance features conditioned on the available intensity information. In particular, we design a Conditional Mutual Information Calibration (CMIC) module that generates a conditional information map, enabling region-adaptive recalibration of chrominance representations according to local illumination statistics. Furthermore, we introduce a Dynamic Dual-branch Information Restoration (D2IR) module, which adaptively governs bidirectional information flow between the intensity and chrominance branches, guided by both the conditional prior and the instantaneous restoration state. Extensive experiments on paired LLIE benchmarks demonstrate that CMIG-Net consistently outperforms CIDNet, achieving up to a 0.619 dB gain in PSNR, with a 0.382 dB improvement specifically on the challenging Sony-Total-Dark dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CMIG-Net，通过条件互信息度量来建模低光图像增强中亮度与色度分支的交互关系，设计了条件互信息校准模块和动态双分支信息恢复模块，在多个基准上超越CIDNet，PSNR最高提升0.619dB。
AI.motivation: 现有双分支LLIE方法（如CIDNet）在HVI颜色空间中分别建模色度和亮度信息，但忽略了亮度与色度分量之间的相互交互，这限制了模型的表征能力，导致增强性能次优。
AI.method: 提出CMIG-Net，包含两个关键模块：(1) 条件互信息校准（CMIC）模块，利用条件互信息作为度量生成条件信息图，根据局部光照统计对色度表征进行区域自适应重校准；(2) 动态双分支信息恢复（D2IR）模块，在条件先验和瞬时恢复状态引导下，自适应控制亮度与色度分支间的双向信息流。
AI.result: 在配对LLIE基准上，CMIG-Net一致优于CIDNet，PSNR最高提升0.619dB，在具有挑战性的Sony-Total-Dark数据集上提升0.382dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过条件互信息量化亮度-色度交互并引导双分支信息流通，CMIG-Net有效改善了低光图像增强的结构保真度、色彩还原和曝光准确性。

title: Infinite Trace Objectives with Finite Trace Techniques: Translating LTL to LTLf+
summary: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) is one of the most widely adopted languages for specifying temporal extended objectives in AI, with applications ranging from reactive synthesis to stochastic planning in Markov decision processes and reinforcement learning. Traditionally, solving any of these problems requires translating the LTL specification to a nondeterministic automata on infinite words and then determinizing it, a step that is notoriously difficult in theory and in practice. Recent work has introduced LTLf+, which lifts the finite-trace logic LTLf to infinite traces. LTLf+ has the same expressive power as LTL, yet it retains most of the crucial advantages of its base logic LTLf. Most reasoning in LTLf+ rests on finite automata on finite words, for which we have not only a canonical minimal representation but also an efficient determinization procedure. In this work we present the first translation from LTL to LTLf+. We first normalize an LTL formula into the syntactic reactivity fragment of the Manna-Pnueli hierarchy, to create the general fragment-based shape of LTLf+. We then present linear translations for each individual component of that fragment. As a consequence of this translation, the expanding body of techniques developed for LTLf+ now becomes available to many AI problems currently formulated in LTL. We further show that this comes at no asymptotic cost, as the pipeline from LTL to automaton via LTLf+ remains doubly exponential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个从LTL到LTLf+的翻译方法，通过将LTL公式规范化为Manna-Pnueli层级中的语法反应性片段，再对每个组件进行线性翻译，使LTLf+的推理技术可以应用于LTL问题，且时间复杂度保持为双重指数级。
AI.motivation: 传统上解决LTL相关AI问题（如反应式综合、MDP随机规划、强化学习）需要通过非确定性无限词自动机来转化LTL规格，而这一确定化步骤在理论和实践中都极为困难。近年提出的LTLf+与LTL具有相同的表达能力，但保留了LTLf的大部分优势（基于有限词上的有限自动机，具有规范最小表示和高效确定化过程）。因此，将LTL翻译为LTLf+可以解锁这些高效技术。
AI.method: 首先将LTL公式规范化到Manna-Pnueli层级中的语法反应性（reactivity）片段，以构建LTLf+的基于片段的形式。然后为该片段的每个独立组件提供线性时间的翻译。整个翻译管线从LTL到LTLf+再到自动机，仍保持双重指数复杂度。
AI.result: 成功实现了首个从LTL到LTLf+的翻译，每个片段组件的翻译均为线性时间，且整个管线保持双重指数级的时间复杂度，没有引入额外的渐进成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过这一翻译，原本为LTLf+开发的大量技术（包括有限自动机上的推理方法）现在可以应用于以LTL表述的各类AI问题，为AI领域提供了更高效、更实用的LTL推理途径。

title: GeoCore-9B: Towards Geo-Aware Generative Foundation Models in Earth Observation
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/GeoCore-9B_site/
summary: Existing generative models for earth observation (EO) predominantly rely on fine-tuning natural image priors, which limits their scalability and introduces perspective biases that conflict with geospatial constraints. To address this, we introduce GeoCore-9B, a 9-billion-parameter generative foundation model, which is the first of its scale to be trained from scratch exclusively on EO data. Unlike previous EO foundation models, GeoCore-9B is built upon a Flow Matching-based Diffusion Transformer (DiT) and natively conditions generation on text descriptions and continuous geospatial metadata, including ground sample distances, latitudes, and longitudes. To overcome the convergence and spatial disorientation challenges of training at this scale, we propose a Geospatial Semantic Alignment loss. This objective distills structural Earth surface priors (e.g., terrain and urban areas) from a frozen specialist teacher network, constraining the diffusion latent trajectory during training without adding inference overhead. Pre-trained on the global-scale Git-10M dataset, GeoCore-9B demonstrates strong downstream versatility. Beyond standard proxy generative tasks, we show that GeoCore-9B can be effectively adapted for practical EO applications, including highly challenging tasks such as cloud removal and SAR-to-optical cross-modal translation. Extensive evaluations confirm that GeoCore-9B establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both visual fidelity and geographic structural accuracy.

AI.tldr: GeoCore-9B是一个90亿参数的地球观测生成式基础模型，首次完全从零开始在纯EO数据上训练，采用Flow Matching-based DiT架构，原生支持文本描述和连续地理空间元数据条件生成，并提出了地理空间语义对齐损失来解决大规模训练中的收敛和空间定向挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有EO生成模型大多依赖微调自然图像先验，这限制了的可扩展性，并引入与地理空间约束相冲突的视角偏差。研究者希望通过完全从EO数据训练的地基模型来克服这些限制。
AI.method: 1）构建90亿参数的Flow Matching-based Diffusion Transformer（DiT）架构；2）原生支持文本描述和连续地理元数据（地面采样距离、经纬度）条件生成；3）提出Geospatial Semantic Alignment loss，从冻结的专业教师网络中蒸馏地表结构先验（地形、城市区域等），约束扩散潜空间轨迹；4）在Git-10M全球规模数据集上预训练。
AI.result: 在视觉保真度和地理结构准确性方面均达到新SOTA性能；不仅在标准代理生成任务上表现优异，还可有效适配实际EO应用，包括去云和SAR到光学跨模态翻译等极具挑战性的任务。
AI.conclusion: GeoCore-9B证明了大规模从零训练EO专用生成模型是可行的，且相比微调自然图像先验的方法，在生成质量和地理结构准确性上更具优势，为EO领域生成式基础模型指明了一条可扩展的发展路径。

title: Real-Time Detection and Repair of LLM Agent Failures
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Code, data and demo: github.com/sunnydubey1111/agent-trajectory-sentinel Walkthrough: youtu.be/a05n_000klE
summary:
LLM agents fail mid-episode -- they loop, cascade tool errors, drift off goal, fabricate results, or silently absorb corrupted content -- and the standard remedy, judging every step with a second LLM, costs more than the agent itself. We ask how much detection is achievable from observable step telemetry alone, using monitors costing microseconds per step and trained only on healthy runs.
  On 2,823 committed agent episodes across three frameworks, three local models (qwen2.5 7b/3b, llama3.1 8b) and a commercial API (gemini-2.5-flash), a one-class echo-state-network ensemble with CUSUM alarms detects 0.71 of failures at a 5% false-alarm budget (AUROC 0.872). Its advantage over a memoryless baseline is a monotone function of post-onset horizon (+0.09 at <=3 steps, +0.40 at >=9), predicting its own failure region out of sample on AFTraj-2K. Ranking transfers with no retraining to two corpora from other groups (AFTraj-2K 0.745, ATBench 0.779).
  Monitors carry two burdens: a per-deployment healthy null (they do not transfer -- AUROC 0.527 cold against 0.885 recalibrated) and a residual false-alarm rate. We add a layer carrying neither: deterministic verification, which recomputes a run's stated total from the tool results it actually received and confirms every required call was made. Head-to-head it catches 60% of failures (96% with the coverage check) at 0 of 63 false positives against the monitor's 54% at 17%, transfers unchanged to llama3.1:8b (110 of 110 at 0 of 10), and trips on 0 of 1825 healthy episodes.
  Detection is then closed into repair: each flagged run is rolled back and re-run live, recovering 45% of failures against a 16% resampling control (p=0.0005) and lifting task success from 52% to 73% for about one extra model call per run. The system runs at ~200 microseconds per step, three orders of magnitude below a judge call. Code, traces and results are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级LLM智能体故障监测框架，仅利用步骤级遥测数据，通过单类回声状态网络集成加上CUSUM警报，在微秒级成本下实现0.71的故障检测率（5%误报预算，AUROC 0.872）。该系统结合确定性验证层（零误报）和回滚重放修复机制，可将任务成功率从52%提升至73%，且每步检测成本约为200微秒，比调用法官模型便宜三个数量级。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在运行中途经常失败（循环、级联工具错误、偏离目标、伪造结果或吸收损坏内容），而标准解决方案（用第二个LLM评判每一步）成本过高，超过智能体本身。作者希望探究仅从可观测的步骤遥测数据中能实现多大程度的故障检测。
AI.method: 1）使用单类回声状态网络集成+ CUSUM警报作为监测器，仅在健康运行上训练，每步成本微秒级；2）添加确定性验证层：重新计算运行声明的总结果与实际工具返回结果对比，确认所有必需调用是否完成；3）将检测闭环到修复：对被标记的运行进行回滚并实时重放。
AI.result: 在2,823个智能体episode和多种模型上，监测器实现0.71故障检测率（5%误报预算，AUROC 0.872），比无误报基线的优势随故障后视野单调递增。排名可跨语料库迁移（AFTraj-2K 0.745，ATBench 0.779），但监测器需部署时重新校准。确定性验证以0/63误报捕获60%故障（含覆盖检查为96%），在健康episode上0/1825误报。修复环节恢复45%故障（对照16%，p=0.0005），成功率从52%升至73%，每步约200微秒，比法官调用便宜三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明轻量级遥测监测结合确定性验证可以在无需昂贵的LLM法官前提下有效检测和修复智能体故障，且修复闭环能显著提升任务成功率，为LLM智能体的可靠运行提供了经济高效的解决方案。

title: Long-term Measurements: Towards a Longitudinal Understanding of Human-AI Interactions
summary: Language models have taken on the role of a very new type of technology, by virtue of their "human-ness" and rapid integration into users' daily lives. This combination of features can introduce longitudinal risks---cognitive, developmental and socio-affective changes in humans---that might not surface in short-term interactions, but can have lasting long-term effects on users. This forms the basis of a critical new mission for NLP: to pivot from static, short-term evaluations of text generations to long-term measurements of behavioral changes, towards a diachronic understanding of human-model interactions. In this work, we draw from measurements used in social science fields that are crucial to understand emergent phenomena in longitudinal data. We discuss how computational methods in the field of NLP need to be combined with such measurements, not only to understand long-term safety risks of human-model interactions, but to help steer model development towards positive rather than negative outcomes for users. This ability to model human behavioral shifts as a function of model interactions can facilitate online rather than post-hoc detection of problematic behaviors, and should be leveraged in alignment frameworks to mitigate long-term risks in users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NLP领域需要从静态、短期的文本评估转向对人与语言模型长期交互行为变化的纵向测量，借鉴社会科学方法以理解并缓解模型使用对用户认知、发展和社会情感方面的长期风险。
AI.motivation: 语言模型因其"人性化"特质和快速融入日常生活，可能引入纵向风险——即对用户认知、发展及社会情感层面的长期改变。这些风险在短期交互中不易显现，但可能产生持久影响。现有NLP评估范式局限于静态、短期的文本生成评估，无法捕捉这些长期效应。
AI.method: 论文提出将社会科学领域的纵向数据测量方法（用于理解突发现象的测量工具）与NLP计算方法相结合，建立对人与模型交互的历时（diachronic）理解框架。该方法强调在线而非事后检测问题行为，并将此类能力纳入对齐（alignment）框架中。
AI.result: 论文提出了一种新的研究范式转变方向：NLP应从静态评估转向长期行为变化的纵向测量，通过跨学科方法整合实现。该框架不仅有助于理解长期安全风险，还能引导模型开发朝向对用户有益的方向发展。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张将人类行为变化建模为模型交互的函数，以此实现问题行为的在线检测，并将其纳入对齐框架以缓解用户的长期风险，这将构成NLP领域一个新的关键使命。

title: PhotoHOI: Synthesizing 3D Hand-Object Interactions from a Single RGB Photograph
summary: Hand-object interaction (HOI) is a fundamental human behavior with broad applications in AR/VR, digital humans, and embodied interaction. Existing methods typically require predefined object geometry, object trajectories, or task-specific conditions, limiting their use with natural real-world inputs. To address this, we study a more practical problem of synthesizing 3D hand-object interaction sequences from a single RGB photograph and an open-vocabulary language instruction, and introduce PhotoHOI. PhotoHOI first uses a vision-language model to parse the input image and instruction into a structured task specification, including the interaction object, target region, and spatial relation. It then recovers a compact task-relevant 3D scene and plans a smooth collision-aware object trajectory based on the recovered object states, support relations, and surrounding scene geometry. To synthesize hand motion that generalizes to real-world photographs and unseen objects, it learns transferable task-conditioned contact and contact-conditioned grasp priors from large-scale affordance and HOI data. The grasp is further refined in a learned latent space, constraining the optimization to a plausible hand-pose manifold. Experiments on GRAB and H2O demonstrate improved contact quality and reduced penetration over representative baselines. Results on real-world photographs further demonstrate higher task success and scene consistency, together with generalization to unseen objects and open-vocabulary instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhotoHOI，一个从单张RGB照片和开放词汇语言指令合成3D手物交互序列的新框架，无需预定义物体几何或轨迹，通过视觉语言模型解析任务、恢复3D场景、规划碰撞感知轨迹，并利用可迁移的先验实现真实世界泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有手物交互（HOI）合成方法通常需要预定义物体几何、物体轨迹或任务特定条件，限制了其在自然真实世界输入场景中的实用性。作者希望研究更实际的问题：从单张RGB照片和开放词汇语言指令直接合成3D手物交互序列。
AI.method: PhotoHOI包含三个关键步骤：(1) 使用视觉语言模型将输入图像和指令解析为结构化任务规范（包括交互物体、目标区域和空间关系）；(2) 恢复紧凑的任务相关3D场景，基于物体状态、支撑关系和周围场景几何规划平滑的碰撞感知物体轨迹；(3) 从大规模affordance和HOI数据中学习可迁移的任务条件接触先验和接触条件抓取先验，并在学习的潜在空间中细化抓取姿态，将优化约束在合理的hand-pose流形上。
AI.result: 在GRAB和H2O数据集上的实验表明，相比代表性基线方法，PhotoHOI在接触质量和穿透减少方面均有提升。在真实世界照片上的结果展示了更高的任务成功率和场景一致性，并验证了对未见物体和开放词汇指令的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PhotoHOI成功实现了从真实世界单张照片和自然语言指令到3D手物交互序列合成的全流程，克服了传统方法对预定义几何和轨迹的依赖，展示了良好的泛化性和实用价值。

title: CMuon: Accelerating and Stabilizing Diffusion Transformer Training via Chunked Momentum Orthogonalization
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in visual generative modeling, yet their training remains computationally prohibitive. While the recently proposed Momentum Orthogonalization (Muon) optimizer offers a promising alternative to AdamW, its direct application to DiTs yields suboptimal late-stage convergence. In this paper, we identify the root cause of this bottleneck: standard DiT architectures fuse functionally distinct weights (e.g., within AdaLN and QKV layers) into unified tensors for computational efficiency. Applying Muon to these fused tensors inadvertently induces implicit subspace coupling, which distorts update directions and degrades global optimization. To address this, we introduce Chunked Muon (CMuon), a simple yet highly effective strategy that partitions these matrices into independent sub-components prior to orthogonalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that a 675M-parameter DiT trained with CMuon achieves a FID of 1.18 on ImageNet 256 in just 200 epochs. This represents more than a 2x training speedup over AdamW, while effectively overcoming the late-stage convergence plateaus of vanilla Muon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chunked Muon (CMuon)优化器，通过将DiT中融合的张量（如AdaLN和QKV层）按功能划分为独立子块后再进行正交化，解决了vanilla Muon在DiT训练后期收敛不佳的问题。675M参数DiT在ImageNet 256上仅用200 epochs即达到FID 1.18，比AdamW快2倍以上。
AI.motivation: DiT训练计算成本高昂，Muon优化器虽为AdamW的有力替代方案，但直接应用于DiT时后期收敛效果不佳。作者发现根因在于标准DiT架构为了计算效率将功能不同的权重（如AdaLN和QKV层）融合为统一张量，Muon对融合张量的正交化操作会引入隐式子空间耦合，扭曲更新方向并损害全局优化。
AI.method: 提出Chunked Muon (CMuon)策略：在正交化之前，将融合矩阵按功能划分为独立的子组件（chunk），对每个子组件分别进行正交化更新，从而避免不同功能权重之间的隐式耦合。该方法简单高效，不改变架构本身，仅修改优化流程。
AI.result: 675M参数的DiT使用CMuon在ImageNet 256上仅200 epochs即达到FID 1.18，相比AdamW实现了超过2倍的训练加速，同时有效克服了vanilla Muon的后期收敛平台期问题。
AI.conclusion: CMuon通过解耦融合张量中不同功能子空间的更新，成功将Muon优化器的优势扩展到DiT训练中，在显著加速训练的同时保持了生成质量，是一种简单且可广泛推广的优化策略。

title: Assessing the Benefits of Combining Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment from UAV Imagery
comment: Accepted at ECMLPKDD 2026, 31 pages (including appendix), 18 figures
summary: Rapid and accurate post-disaster building damage assessment is essential, yet remains a challenging task. Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery offers a timely and high-resolution view of affected areas, but existing Computer Vision (CV) models often demand large annotated datasets, generalize poorly across geographic regions and their assessment policies, and are confined to the specific tasks they were trained for. Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) offer a promising alternative through their strong reasoning and generalization capabilities, but fall short on precise, low-level perception tasks such as object detection and accurate bounding box generation. Furthermore, they often require a substantial amount of data for effective fine-tuning on domain-specific tasks. In this paper, we propose a hybrid framework that decouples detection from damage assessment, combining the precision of CV models with the reasoning power of LVLMs. A CV model first detects buildings and generates bounding boxes on the image that are then passed to an LVLM for damage classification and contextual interpretation. We evaluated our framework on two real-world benchmarks: RescueNet and FloodNet. In particular, the best combination under this framework accurately counts intact, partially damaged and completely destroyed buildings, surpassing isolated baselines by up to 2.1 R^2 points, while requiring only limited annotated data for the detection stage. Beyond reporting aggregate gains, we provide a detailed analysis of failure scenarios and edge cases, offering practical insights for practitioners and concrete directions for future work. Our source code and data are publicly available to the research community via the following repository: https://github.com/ungquanghuy-kddi/VLM_GDINO.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个混合框架，将CV模型的精确检测能力与LVLM的推理能力相结合，用于灾后建筑损伤评估。CV模型先检测建筑并生成边界框，LVLM再进行损伤分类和语义解释，在RescueNet和FloodNet基准上超越了孤立基线模型。
AI.motivation: 灾后建筑损伤评估至关重要但具有挑战性。UAV图像提供高分辨率视角，但现有CV模型需要大量标注数据、跨区域泛化能力差且局限于特定任务；LVLM虽有强推理和泛化能力，但在精确感知任务（如目标检测和边界框生成）上表现不足，且领域微调需要大量数据。因此需要一种结合两者优势的方案。
AI.method: 提出一个解耦检测与损伤评估的混合框架：1) 使用CV模型检测建筑并生成边界框；2) 将裁剪的图像区域传递给LVLM进行损伤分类和上下文解释。该框架在检测阶段仅需有限的标注数据。
AI.result: 在RescueNet和FloodNet两个真实世界基准上评估，最佳组合准确计数完好、部分损坏和完全摧毁的建筑，比孤立基线模型高出最多2.1个R²分数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在损伤评估任务上优于单一模型，并提供了失败场景和边缘案例的详细分析，为实践者和未来研究提供了有用见解。代码和数据已公开。

title: Abduction Without a Body? Representational Grounding and the Abduction Loop for Scientific Hypothesis Generation
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. DAB-30 execution reported in companion paper
summary: Can scientific abduction occur without continuous sensorimotor embodiment? Recent arguments in AI and philosophy of science hold that genuine hypothesis generation requires an agent continuously coupled to the physical world. We defend a narrower claim: online embodiment is not necessary for every abductive scientific act. Our focus is identity abduction: the inference that two independently developed structures are one object under an explicit correspondence, reached through representational grounding rather than bodily interaction. An agent may acquire new inferential affordances not through physical interaction but through transformations into representations that expose latent invariants. Scientific diagrams are a practical substrate because they embody independently evolved conventions that partially canonicalize symmetry, topology, and operator structure across disciplines - a property we develop as convention space, which answers a hard retrieval problem: finding mathematically related work when two fields share no discriminating vocabulary. We operationalize the mechanism as an architecture, the Abduction Loop: representation generation, motif extraction, convention-space canonicalization, cross-domain retrieval, identity-hypothesis generation, and adversarial verification, with abstention as the designed default. A documented episode, in which a multimodal model given a figure of a gravitational-memory transport model generated and then verified the hypothesis that its central differential complex is equivalent to the spherical Kaiser-Squires mass-mapping complex of weak-lensing cosmology, serves as a motivating possibility witness from which the architecture is abstracted, not as evidence of general capability. We close with a falsifiable evaluation program, the DAB-30 benchmark. The contribution is a mechanistic proposal, an architecture, and a test program.

AI.tldr: 本文提出即使在缺乏连续感知运动具身（online embodiment）的情况下，科学溯因（abduction）中的"身份溯因"仍可发生。作者提出"约定空间"（convention space）概念，并构建"溯因循环"（Abduction Loop）架构，通过表示生成、基元提取、约定空间规范化、跨域检索、身份假说生成与对抗验证等步骤，使智能体能够在不依赖物理交互的前提下发现跨领域数学结构间的等价性。文章基于一个具体案例（引力-记忆输运模型与弱引力透镜的球形Kaiser-Squires质量映射复形等价）作为可能性证据，并提出了DAB-30基准用于可证伪的评估。
AI.motivation: 近期AI与科学哲学领域的论点认为，真正的假说生成需要智能体与物理世界持续耦合。作者对此提出更窄的辩护：并非所有溯因科学行为都需要在线具身。特别是"身份溯因"——即在显式对应关系下推断两个独立发展结构为同一对象——可以通过表征接地（representational grounding）而非身体交互实现。核心动机在于反驳"具身性绝对必要"的立场，并为非具身智能体的科学发现能力提供理论机制与架构支持。
AI.method: 作者提出"Abduction Loop"架构，包含六个环节：（1）表示生成（representation generation）、（2）基元提取（motif extraction）、（3）约定空间规范化（convention-space canonicalization）、（4）跨域检索（cross-domain retrieval）、（5）身份假说生成（identity-hypothesis generation）、（6）对抗验证（adversarial verification），并以弃权（abstention）为设计默认行为。核心机制是"约定空间"——不同学科中独立演化的图示约定部分规范化了对称性、拓扑与算子结构，使得跨域检索成为可能，回答了当两个领域缺乏共享词汇时如何找到数学相关工作的难题。
AI.result: 论文提供了一个具体的"可能性见证"（possibility witness）：多模态模型在给定引力-记忆输运模型的图示后，生成并验证了其中心微分复形与弱引力透镜领域中的球形Kaiser-Squires质量映射复形等价的假说。作者明确指出该案例仅用于抽象架构的动机，而非作为通用能力的证据。此外，论文提出了DAB-30基准作为可证伪的评估程序。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献在于三重：一个机制性提议（非具身身份溯因的可行性论证）、一个架构（Abduction Loop）以及一个测试程序（DAB-30基准）。作者审慎地将工作定位为理论建构与架构设计，而非通用能力的实证声明，并为未来研究提供了可检验的评估路径。

title: PNEC-Mamba: Prototype-Guided Positive-Negative Evidence Calibration for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: In real-world hyperspectral scenes, pixel representations are often ambiguous due to factors such as spectral similarity, mixed pixels, and local context interference, which may simultaneously encode discriminative evidence and interfering information. Existing methods mainly focus on learning more powerful representations or modeling broader contexts, but rarely investigate whether the learned representations provide reliable evidence or introduce interference into classification decisions. To address this issue, we view hyperspectral image classification from the perspective of pixel-level evidence reliability modeling and propose PNEC-Mamba, a prototype-guided positive-negative evidence calibration framework. The framework progressively establishes semantic references, separates class-related evidence from interference, estimates pixel-level reliability, and performs selective calibration. First, a full-image state-space encoder extracts pixel representations, while dynamic class prototypes provide semantic references that evolve jointly with the feature space. Subsequently, positive and negative evidence is derived from pixel-prototype competition, explicitly separating discriminative cues that support classification from confusing signals associated with competing classes. Based on these evidence relationships, a multi-source uncertainty estimation strategy is introduced to assess pixel-level reliability, enabling stronger evidence calibration for uncertain regions. Finally, a full-resolution consistency refinement step is applied to recover local spatial details and improve boundary coherence in the final predictions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that PNEC-Mamba achieves superior classification performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PNEC-Mamba，一种基于原型引导的正负证据校准框架用于高光谱图像分类。该框架通过动态类原型建立语义参考，将类别相关证据与干扰分离，估计像素级可靠性并进行选择性校准，最终在全分辨率下进行一致性细化以恢复空间细节。在三个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现实高光谱场景中，像素表征常因光谱相似性、混合像元和局部上下文干扰而模糊，现有方法主要关注学习更强表征或建模更广上下文，却很少研究学习到的表征是否提供可靠证据或引入干扰。作者旨在从像素级证据可靠性建模角度解决这一问题。
AI.method: PNEC-Mamba框架包含四个核心步骤：(1) 全图像状态空间编码器提取像素表征，动态类原型与特征空间联合演化提供语义参考；(2) 通过像素-原型竞争推导正负证据，显式分离支持分类的判别线索与关联竞争类别的混淆信号；(3) 基于证据关系引入多源不确定性估计策略评估像素级可靠性，对不确定区域进行更强证据校准；(4) 采用全分辨率一致性细化步骤恢复局部空间细节并改善边界一致性。
AI.result: 在三个基准高光谱数据集上的大量实验表明，PNEC-Mamba相比现有最先进方法取得了更优的分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 从证据可靠性建模的角度出发，通过正负证据分离与不确定性引导的可选择性校准，有效缓解了高光谱图像中像素级表征模糊问题，验证了可靠的证据建模对提升分类性能的重要性。

title: Optimizing Minimax Regret in Uncertain MDPs with Small Sets of Policies
summary: Sequential decision-making in real-world applications often involves uncertainty about the environment's model. Uncertain Markov decision processes (UMDPs) represent the possible environments as a set of MDPs with shared states and actions but potentially different transition probabilities and rewards. Optimizing a single policy across all possible MDPs may sacrifice performance, while preparing an individually optimized policy for every MDP may violate operational, regulatory, or interpretability constraints on the number of policies that can be prepared and deployed. We consider settings in which model uncertainty is resolved shortly before execution, allowing the most suitable policy to be selected from a limited set prepared in advance. We introduce $k$-adaptable policy synthesis, which optimizes such a set of $k$ policies under a minimax-regret objective. We prove that the problem is NP-hard and develop KAPS, an exact nested branch-and-bound algorithm with problem-specific bounds and heuristics. KAPS jointly optimizes which MDPs share a policy and the policies themselves. Experiments across various UMDP benchmarks show that the largest reduction in regret consistently occurs when increasing from one to two policies. In the single-policy setting, KAPS is competitive with existing methods in solution quality and proves optimality substantially more often.

AI.tldr: 本文提出k-可适应策略合成（k-adaptable policy synthesis）问题，用于在不确定马尔可夫决策过程（UMDPs）中预先准备一组k个策略，在模型不确定性在执行前被解决时选择最优策略，以最小化最大遗憾（minimax-regret）。作者证明该问题为NP-hard，并开发了KAPS算法——一种精确的嵌套分支定界算法，配备问题特定的界限和启发式方法，在多个UMDP基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的序贯决策常面临环境模型不确定性。UMDPs用一组共享状态和动作但转移概率和奖励可能不同的MDP来表示可能的环境。单策略优化可能牺牲性能，而为每个MDP分别优化策略可能违反运营、监管或解释性约束（策略数量受限）。需要在有限策略数和性能之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为k-可适应策略合成，即在minimax-regret目标下优化一组k个策略。证明问题为NP-hard后，提出KAPS算法——精确的嵌套分支定界算法，包含问题特定的界限和启发式方法。KAPS联合优化哪些MDP共享策略以及策略本身。
AI.result: 在多个UMDP基准上的实验表明，从1个策略增加到2个策略时遗憾减少幅度最大。在单策略设置下，KAPS在解的质量上与现有方法具有竞争力，并且显著更频繁地证明最优性。
AI.conclusion: KAPS为k-可适应策略合成提供了有效的精确求解方法，验证了少量策略（特别是2个）即可大幅降低遗憾，为在策略数量约束下的不确定环境决策提供了实用解决方案。

title: CHOW-SLAM: Compact Hybrid Representation with Complementary Overlap Window Optimization for RGB-D SLAM
summary: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) based on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) enables dense, continuous scene reconstruction. However, existing systems operating with limited online resources struggle to simultaneously construct two types of constraints, namely, compact yet discriminative spatial constraints derived from scene representations and persistent temporal constraints derived from historical observations. To address this challenge, we propose CHOW-SLAM, a dense RGB-D SLAM framework that explicitly constructs these complementary spatial and temporal constraints. Spatially, we propose a compact parametric-hash (P-H) hybrid representation that organizes components based on planes and grids across scales in P and H branches. A unified multi-output decoder further aligns the ray termination distributions induced by TSDF and density, preserving geometry and appearance under a compact parameter budget. Temporally, we propose a complementary overlap-window strategy to prevent optimization from being dominated by short-term overlap or weakly related historical observations. Within a fixed budget, the strategy retains recent frames, selects high-overlap local frames, and introduces temporally distributed historical keyframes. Loss-aware keyframe insertion and bundle adjustment scheduling further adapt optimization to tracking quality. In addition, ORB-based tracking and geometric pose estimation are used for pose initialization, followed by neural rendering optimization to improve tracking stability. Extensive evaluations on multiple datasets demonstrate that CHOW-SLAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both scene reconstruction quality and camera tracking accuracy. The source code is available at https://github.com/jinjidexiaohuoban/CHOW-SLAM.

AI.tldr: CHOW-SLAM是一个基于NeRF的密集RGB-D SLAM框架，通过显式构建互补的空间约束（紧凑参数哈希混合表示）和时间约束（重叠窗口策略），在有限在线资源下实现了高质量场景重建和精准相机追踪。
AI.motivation: 现有基于NeRF的SLAM系统在有限在线资源下，难以同时构建两类约束：来自场景表示的紧凑且具判别性的空间约束，以及来自历史观测的持久时间约束。这限制了重建质量和追踪精度。
AI.method: 1) 提出紧凑参数哈希（P-H）混合表示，基于平面和网格跨尺度组织组件；2) 设计统一多输出解码器，对齐TSDF和密度引起的射线终止分布；3) 提出互补重叠窗口策略，在固定预算内保留近期帧、选择高重叠局部帧并引入时间分布的历史关键帧；4) 使用损失感知的关键帧插入和束调整调度，结合ORB追踪和几何位姿估计进行位姿初始化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的广泛评估表明，CHOW-SLAM在场景重建质量和相机追踪精度两方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式构建互补的空间和时间约束，CHOW-SLAM在紧凑参数预算下同时实现了高质量稠密重建和稳定的相机追踪，验证了空间-时间约束互补设计的有效性。

title: Magnet: Detecting Cross-Session AI Misuse Through Capability Accumulation
summary: The most capable AI deployments are not single models but ensembles of specialized agents that delegate and act in coordination. This architecture unlocks powerful new capabilities, and it also introduces risks that existing frameworks for monitoring, detection, and mitigation were not designed to address. Most state-of-the-art AI abuse detection literature focuses on single-turn or multi-turn (single-session) threat models. This leaves a critical gap: an attacker can decompose a harmful goal into innocuous-looking units and execute each in isolated agentic sessions. The agent is stateless between conversations, but the attacker is not. This asymmetry allows for cross-session trajectories that are effective at evading detection. Our contributions are twofold. First, we demonstrate cross-session goal decomposition as an evasion technique, showing it may elicit more harmful capability than equivalent single-session or multi-turn attacks. By capability we mean an artifact produced at one step of an objective, evidenced by what an interaction produced (model responses and tool-call results), and composable with capabilities accrued elsewhere into a harmful whole. Second, we propose Magnet: an efficient and robust detection approach that models relevant capabilities accrued over time and across agentic conversations, aggregated at a higher-level correlator (in this case, a user ID) rather than per-conversation state. The main challenge is assembling the evidence bundle Magnet reasons over. The incriminating artifacts may be needles scattered through a haystack of benign sessions that are individually harmless, dangerous only once collected. Rather than searching the haystack straw-by-straw (i.e. per-session inspection), Magnet does what its name implies: it attracts the relevant needles out of the hay, across sessions and across time, into a compact evidence bundle a detector can act on.

AI.tldr: 本文指出最强大的AI部署是智能体协作系统，但现有滥用检测框架只针对单会话威胁模型。攻击者可将有害目标分解为看似无害的单元，跨会话执行以规避检测。作者提出跨会话目标分解作为规避技术，并提出Magnet检测方法，通过在用户ID级别聚合跨会话积累的相关能力，将散落的证据"磁吸"成紧凑证据包供检测器使用。
AI.motivation: 现有AI滥用检测文献主要聚焦于单轮或多轮（单会话）威胁模型，存在关键空白：攻击者可将有害目标分解为无害单元，在隔离的智能体会话中分别执行。智能体在会话间无状态，但攻击者有状态，这种不对称性使得跨会话轨迹能够有效规避检测。
AI.method: 提出Magnet检测方法：跨会话、跨时间聚合用户在多个智能体对话中积累的相关能力，在更高级别的关联层（如用户ID）而非每会话状态上进行检测。核心挑战是组装证据包——Magnet将散布在大量良性会话中的"针"（潜在有害产物）吸引出来，聚合成紧凑的证据包供检测器处理。
AI.result: 展示了跨会话目标分解作为规避技术的有效性，表明其可能比等效的单会话或多轮攻击引发更强的有害能力。Magnet作为检测方法，通过聚合跨会话能力来实现高效且鲁棒的检测。
AI.conclusion: 跨会话攻击是现有检测框架未覆盖的重要威胁面，需要在用户级别而非会话级别进行能力聚合与检测，Magnet提供了一种高效的证据聚合方案来应对这一挑战。

title: Recompute or Reuse? Diagnosing and Mitigating Textual Shortcuts in VLM Self-Reflection
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to revise their reasoning when visual evidence changes. Failures to do so are often attributed to insufficient visual attention or contextual inertia, leaving unclear what models reuse instead of recomputing from the current image. We show that evidence-bearing reasoning in a prior chain of thought (CoT) can form a textual shortcut that competes behaviorally with visual recomputation. Across 16 VLMs, a matched counterfactual analysis identifies evidence-bearing content as the most robust carrier of prior-CoT influence. Removing this evidence-bearing content shifts answer preference more than removing length-matched non-evidence context or the final-answer span, with prior control weakening progressively as more stale evidence is removed. Reordering this evidence also weakens prior control, showing that its organization modulates shortcut strength. Beyond the immediate answer, the shortcut can retain residual influence after answer correction: weakening current-image support shifts preference back toward the prior answer, while repeated prior answers and reused premises arise mainly when the shortcut remains active. To limit this influence, we introduce Fresh-State Attention Firewall (FSAF), a training-free intervention that isolates fresh computation from the prior CoT. Across five VLMs, FSAF raises visual update rate from 35.28% to 53.61% and reduces prior-answer rate from 39.22% to 3.67%. Reliable VLM self-reflection therefore requires more than looking again: fresh visual recomputation must be protected from stale textual reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLMs）在面对视觉证据变化时，先前思维链（CoT）中的证据性内容会形成一种文本捷径，与视觉重计算行为上竞争。作者提出训练无关的干预方法FSAF（Fresh-State Attention Firewall），将新鲜计算与旧CoT隔离，将视觉更新率从35.28%提升至53.61%，并将先验答案率从39.22%降至3.67%。
AI.motivation: VLM在视觉证据变化时未能修订推理，常被归因于视觉注意力不足或上下文惯性，但模型究竟复用了什么而非基于当前图像重计算，这一问题尚未明确。理解这种"文本捷径"的形成机制对提升VLM的可靠自省能力至关重要。
AI.method: 1）对16个VLM进行匹配的反事实分析，识别先验CoT中影响最强的证据性内容载体；2）通过移除证据内容、移除长度匹配的非证据上下文、移除最终答案跨度来比较对答案偏好的影响；3）通过重排证据内容检验其组织方式对捷径强度的影响；4）引入FSAF（Fresh-State Attention Firewall），一种训练无关的注意力干预方法，隔离新鲜计算与先验CoT。
AI.result: 证据性内容是先验CoT影响的最强载体；移除它比移除其他内容更能改变答案偏好。重排证据内容也会削弱先验控制。捷径在答案修正后仍保留残留影响。FSAF在5个VLM上将视觉更新率从35.28%提升至53.61%，将先验答案率从39.22%降至3.67%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的VLM自省需要的不只是重新查看图像——新鲜视觉重计算必须受到保护，免受陈旧文本复用的干扰。这揭示了视觉-语言推理中旧推理链对视觉更新的隐性约束机制。

title: A Taxonomy of Cognitive Capability Gaps in Generative and Agentic AI
summary: Cognitive AI seeks to move beyond language generation and autonomous task execution toward systems capable of sustained reasoning, adaptive behavior, persistent memory, and self-regulation. While generative and agentic AI have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a wide range of tasks, many fundamental cognitive functions remain fragmented or weakly developed, limiting reliable operation over extended time horizons. This paper presents a taxonomy-driven survey of the major cognitive capability gaps that continue to constrain the development of Cognitive AI. The literature is organized around five dimensions: persistent state modeling, goal-directed autonomy, self-monitoring and control, environment interaction, and learning and adaptation. For each dimension, we review recent advances, identify recurring limitations, and discuss open research challenges. Building on these insights, we outline a conceptual Adaptive Cognitive Intelligence Architecture (ACIA) and examine emerging directions in cognition-centric evaluation. The proposed taxonomy provides a unified framework for organizing existing research, identifying unresolved challenges, and guiding the design of future cognitively capable systems. Together, the taxonomy, architectural perspective, and evaluation framework offer a roadmap for advancing AI systems that exhibit more reliable long-term reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and continual learning. The survey highlights key research opportunities toward more adaptive, reliable, and cognitively capable AI systems, providing a foundation for future progress toward Cognitive AI and, ultimately, Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇以分类法驱动的综述，系统梳理了认知AI（Cognitive AI）领域的关键能力缺口，围绕五个维度（持久状态建模、目标导向自主性、自我监控与控制、环境交互、学习与适应）组织文献，并提出了自适应性认知智能架构（ACIA）和以认知为中心的评估框架，为通向AGI提供了路线图。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成式和智能体AI已在广泛任务中展现出惊人能力，但许多基础的认知功能仍然碎片化或发展薄弱，导致系统在长时间尺度上的可靠运行受限。作者旨在通过统一分类法来识别、组织并解决这些关键认知能力缺口。
AI.method: 采用分类法驱动的综述方法，将相关文献组织在五个认知维度下：持久状态建模、目标导向自主性、自我监控与控制、环境交互、学习与适应。对每个维度回顾近期进展、识别共性局限并讨论开放研究挑战，进而提出概念性的自适应认知智能架构（ACIA）。
AI.result: 提出了统一的分类法框架用于组织现有研究、识别未解决的挑战；构建了ACIA架构视角和认知中心的评估框架，形成了从分类学到架构再到评估的完整体系。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为构建更自适应、可靠且具备认知能力的AI系统提供了研究路线图，其分类法、架构视角和评估框架共同为迈向认知AI乃至AGI奠定基础。

title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
summary: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI promises to automate this search. Off the shelf, however, it falls short on three fronts. It is not formal: with no structured, searchable statement of the problem, the search has little structure to exploit and hard constraints are not guaranteed. It is not transferable: each task is solved from scratch, so nothing learned on one task carries to the next. Finally, it is not systematic: relying on the LLM as the sole source of candidates, it explores a narrow slice of the design space and settles into local optima. We introduce AtumAI, a framework that generates datacenter control-plane policies with agentic AI, making the process formal, transferable, and systematic. From a goal stated in plain language, AtumAI autonomously proposes, tests, and refines candidate policies until one satisfies the request. It does so through two components. The Datacenter Task Compiler automates problem formulation: it compiles the request into a formal, machine-checkable, and searchable specification of the task's objectives, constraints, decision variables, and evaluation methodology. The Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop then searches this specification, expanding the search beyond the LLM itself via a diffusion model, an evolutionary algorithm, and a surrogate model. Together, they reduce onboarding a new task from months of engineering to writing its description. We evaluate AtumAI on three control-plane tasks with distinct problem scopes, design spaces, and trade-offs: workload placement, resource scaling, and power management. Across all tasks, the policies generated by AtumAI consistently outperform expert-engineered baselines.

AI.tldr: AtumAI是一个利用智能体AI自动生成数据中心控制平面策略的框架，通过Datacenter Task Compiler将自然语言目标编译为形式化、可搜索的规范，再通过Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop（融合扩散模型、进化算法和代理模型）进行搜索，使策略生成过程具备形式化、可迁移性和系统性，在三个控制平面任务上均优于专家设计的基线。
AI.motivation: 数据中心控制平面策略设计日益困难：硬件软件栈快速演进、设计空间庞大且相互依赖、单个策略原型开发需数月时间。现成的智能体AI在三个维度存在不足：非形式化（缺乏结构化可搜索的问题表述）、不可迁移（每个任务从头解决）、非系统性（仅依赖LLM生成候选，探索设计空间狭窄且易陷入局部最优）。
AI.method: AtumAI由两个核心组件构成：1) Datacenter Task Compiler——将自然语言请求自动编译为形式化、机器可验证、可搜索的任务规范（包括目标、约束、决策变量和评估方法）；2) Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop——在规范空间中进行搜索，通过扩散模型、进化算法和代理模型扩展搜索范围，超越LLM本身的候选生成能力。两者结合将新任务的上线时间从数月工程缩短为写一段描述。
AI.result: 在三个具有不同问题范围、设计空间和权衡的控制平面任务（工作负载放置、资源伸缩、功耗管理）上进行评估，AtumAI生成的策略在所有任务中均一致地优于专家设计的基线。
AI.conclusion: AtumAI展示了智能体AI在数据中心控制平面策略自动化设计中的可行性和有效性，通过形式化编译和进化式搜索三个关键设计原则，解决了现成智能体AI在形式化、可迁移性和系统性方面的不足，实现了从数月工程到自然语言描述的上线流程变革。

title: UniMoCa: Unifying Motion and Camera Controls as Visual Proxies for Faithful Human Video Generation
summary: Controlling human motion and camera movement is essential for faithful human-oriented video generation, yet remains challenging in multi-person scenes with large body motions, occlusions, and dynamic cameras. Existing pipelines typically rely on visual motion sequences, such as skeleton maps, pose maps, or rendered body representations, for motion control, while using camera embeddings for camera control. Such heterogeneous control interfaces force video generation models to reconcile pixel-aligned visual cues with non-visual geometric embeddings, making motion-camera attribution difficult and sensitive to camera estimation errors. We propose \textbf{UniMoCa}, a representation-driven framework that unifies motion and camera controls in visual space. At the core of UniMoCa is \textbf{Motion-Camera Visual Proxy} (\textbf{MCVP}), a mutually-sharable novel representation that converts 3D human motion and camera trajectories extracted from driving videos into an identity-neutral visual proxy. MCVP renders temporally aligned human geometry under the recovered camera trajectory and augments it with explicit camera trajectory markers, replacing heterogeneous visual-parametric controls with distinguishable visual cues. As both control factors are represented in the same visual space, they become mutually compatible rather than heterogeneous, enabling consistent joint reasoning and editing during video generation. We further curate a \textbf{MCVP-Video} dataset covering complex actions, multi-person interactions, and diverse camera trajectories. Experiments based on the Wan2.2 I2V show that UniMoCa achieves substantial gains in human motion control, camera control, temporal consistency, and camera-aware robustness with minimal additional complexity. More details are shown in our Project page: https://tanliming-daniel.github.io/UniMoCa/.

AI.tldr: UniMoCa是一个表示驱动的框架，通过引入Motion-Camera Visual Proxy (MCVP)将3D人体运动和相机轨迹统一转化为视觉空间的视觉代理，解决了多人物场景中异构控制接口导致的动作-相机归属困难问题。基于Wan2.2 I2V的实验表明其在人体运动控制、相机控制、时间一致性和相机感知鲁棒性方面均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成管线中运动控制依赖视觉运动序列（骨架图、姿态图等），而相机控制依赖非视觉的几何嵌入（相机参数），这种异构控制接口迫使生成模型在像素对齐的视觉线索与非视觉几何嵌入之间进行调和，使得动作-相机的联合推理和编辑变得困难，且对相机估计误差高度敏感，尤其是在多人场景、大动作和动态相机条件下问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出UniMoCa框架，核心是Motion-Camera Visual Proxy (MCVP)——一种可相互共享的新型表示，它将从驱动视频中提取的3D人体运动和相机轨迹转换为身份中性的视觉代理。MCVP在恢复的相机轨迹下渲染时间对齐的人体几何，并附加显式的相机轨迹标记，从而用可区分的视觉线索替代异构的视觉-参数化控制。由于两种控制因素处于同一视觉空间，它们从异构变为互兼容，支持一致的联合推理和编辑。同时构建了MCVP-Video数据集，涵盖复杂动作、多人交互和多样化相机轨迹。
AI.result: 基于Wan2.2 I2V的实验表明，UniMoCa在人体运动控制、相机控制、时间一致性以及相机感知鲁棒性方面均取得了显著的性能提升，且只需极小的额外复杂度。
AI.conclusion: UniMoCa通过将运动和相机控制统一到视觉空间，有效解决了多人物视频生成中异构控制接口带来的挑战，验证了视觉代理表示在联合控制运动与相机方面的有效性，为视频生成模型的控制接口设计提供了新思路。

title: Event ActivityNet: A Large-Scale Simulated-Event Benchmark for Untrimmed Action Understanding
summary: Long-horizon event-based action understanding remains underexplored because existing datasets largely comprise short, trimmed clips, while collecting native event streams with dense temporal annotations is costly. We introduce Event ActivityNet, a large-scale simulated-event benchmark derived from human-annotated, untrimmed ActivityNet videos. It comprises 3,263 videos, 200 action classes, and 106.94 hours, with matched 5-bin and 9-bin event-voxel representations, temporal action annotations, and timestamped captions. The benchmark supports annotated-segment action recognition, auxiliary event-language alignment, and causal online temporal action localization. We generate event voxels directly from non-interpolated source videos in decoded frame order, retain per-video rational nominal or average frame-rate metadata for approximate time mapping, and use action-center reconstruction LPIPS as a soft diagnostic of retained reconstructable content. We establish baselines for adaptive event framing, prompt-caption alignment, and event-only, RGB-only, and RGB-event localization. Under a progressive nested-scale training protocol, recognition Top-1 accuracy increases from 52.25 to 66.42, while online temporal localization average mAP improves from 21.7 to 29.0. Moreover, staged Event ActivityNet pretraining followed by native-event fine-tuning consistently outperforms target-only and joint-from-scratch training across multiple supervision budgets. Event ActivityNet provides a scalable benchmark for long-horizon event modeling, although native-camera evaluation remains essential for deployment-oriented conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Event ActivityNet，一个大规模模拟事件基准，基于人类标注的未裁剪ActivityNet视频生成，包含3,263个视频、200个动作类别和106.94小时数据，支持长时段事件动作识别、事件-语言对齐和在线时序定位等任务，并通过渐进式嵌套尺度训练显著提升了识别和定位性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程基于事件的动作理解研究不足，原因在于现有数据集多为短小裁剪片段，且采集带密集时间标注的原生事件流成本高昂。需要一个大规模、可扩展的长时程事件基准来推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 从人类标注的未裁剪ActivityNet视频直接生成事件体素（5-bin和9-bin两种），保留帧率元数据用于时间映射，采用动作中心重建LPIPS作为内容保留的诊断指标。建立自适应事件帧化、提示-字幕对齐、事件-only/RGB-only/RGB-event定位等基线，并提出渐进式嵌套尺度训练协议及分阶段预训练+微调策略。
AI.result: 在渐进式嵌套尺度训练协议下，识别Top-1准确率从52.25提升至66.42，在线时序定位平均mAP从21.7提升至29.0。分阶段Event ActivityNet预训练后接原生事件微调，在多种监督预算下持续优于仅目标域和从头联合训练。
AI.conclusion: Event ActivityNet为长时程事件建模提供了可扩展的基准，并在多项任务上验证了有效性；但原生相机评估对于部署导向的结论仍然必要。

title: StyleForge: Indoor Furniture Styling by Counterfactual Reasoning in a Hypergraph Field
summary: Fixed-layout indoor furniture styling requires selecting assets that form a coherent room without changing the prescribed furniture categories, positions, orientations, or scales. Existing approaches typically retrieve each asset independently or rely on static local relations, making them prone to shape, material, and color conflicts after scene composition. We introduce StyleForge, a scene-level structured selection framework built on a dynamic hypergraph style field. A frozen multimodal large language model extracts structured style priors from an open-ended style request and the fixed layout, while StyleForge maintains a learnable candidate distribution for each furniture slot. Conditioned on the target style, the dynamic hypergraph style field adaptively activates and weights layout-induced hyperedges to capture higher-order dependencies among furniture. Counterfactual style preference learning then treats each candidate as a local substitution in the current style field and evaluates its contextual compatibility using Mahalanobis energies. Training alternates between optimizing the style field and the candidate logits. At inference, the model remains frozen and test-time training updates only room-specific candidate logits, progressively correcting cross-slot style conflicts as the global scene context evolves. Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate state-of-the-art furniture retrieval and scene-level style coherence, producing more coherent fixed-layout furniture arrangements than object- and scene-level retrieval baselines.

AI.tldr: StyleForge是一个场景级结构化选择框架，用于固定布局室内家具风格搭配。它利用冻结的多模态大语言模型提取风格先验，并通过动态超图风格场捕捉家具间的高阶依赖关系，结合反事实风格偏好学习和测试时训练，实现了比现有方法更优的场景级风格一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的家具风格搭配方法要么独立检索每个家具，要么依赖静态的局部关系，导致场景组合后出现形状、材质和颜色冲突。固定布局下需要在不改变家具类别、位置、朝向和尺度的前提下选择能形成协调房间的家具，这需要场景级的高阶依赖建模。
AI.method: StyleForge包含三个核心组件：(1) 冻结的多模态大语言模型从开放式风格请求和固定布局中提取结构化风格先验；(2) 动态超图风格场，根据目标风格自适应激活和加权布局诱导的超边，捕捉家具间高阶依赖；(3) 反事实风格偏好学习，将每个候选视为当前风格场中的局部替换，用马氏能量评估上下文兼容性。训练时交替优化风格场和候选logits，推理时冻结模型，仅通过测试时训练更新房间特定的候选logits。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT数据集上的实验表明，StyleForge在家具检索和场景级风格一致性方面达到了最先进的性能，相比物体级和场景级检索基线，能产生更协调的固定布局家具摆放。
AI.conclusion: StyleForge证明了通过动态超图建模高阶家具依赖关系、结合反事实偏好学习和测试时训练，能够有效解决固定布局场景下家具风格搭配的一致性挑战。

title: FAST-GS: Frequency Aware Space-time Gaussian Splatting for Photorealistic Dynamic Novel View Synthesis
summary: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) excels in dynamic 3D reconstruction and real-time novel view synthesis via efficient 4D Gaussian representations and parallelizable rendering. However, existing 4DGS approaches rely on a single polynomial to model motion, which limits performance in complex dynamic scenes where high-frequency motion components are prevalent, and fails to ensure long-term stability due to cumulative trajectory drift. To address these issues, we propose a Fourier Motion Modeling module: this paradigm decomposes motion into frequency-based sinusoidal components, capturing both low-frequency global trajectories and high-frequency local details to model complex motion patterns accurately. It retains the real-time rendering capability of 4DGS while improving complex motion fitting and long-term coherence. Additionally, we integrate a motion-aware regularization strategy into the loss function: it uses frequency-dependent weights to suppress high-frequency jitter while preserving low-frequency motion coherence. Extensive experiments on N3V and Google Immersive datasets from multiple scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于傅里叶运动建模的4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）方法，将运动分解为不同频率的正弦分量，同时捕捉低频全局轨迹和高频局部细节，并引入运动感知正则化策略抑制高频抖动，从而提升复杂动态场景的重建精度和长期稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有4DGS方法使用单一多项式建模运动，难以处理包含高频运动分量的复杂动态场景，且因轨迹累积漂移无法保证长期稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 提出傅里叶运动建模模块，将运动分解为基于频率的正弦分量，同时捕捉低频全局轨迹与高频局部细节；2) 在损失函数中集成运动感知正则化策略，使用频率相关权重抑制高频抖动并保持低频运动一致性。
AI.result: 在N3V和Google Immersive数据集上的多个场景实验中验证了方法的有效性，在保持实时渲染能力的同时改善了复杂运动拟合和长期相干性。
AI.conclusion: 通过频域分解运动建模的思想，有效弥补了传统多项式建模在复杂动态场景中的不足，为4DGS在动态场景中的应用提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: OSSDD - a New Open Dataset for Sentinel-1 Ship Detection
summary: Ship detection in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images plays an important role for maritime situational awareness, especially with respect to different illegal activities at sea such as illegal fishing, smuggling or border violations. Modern ship detection methods using neural networks usually require large training datasets, which are considerably scarcer in the SAR domain than in the electro-optical domain. While several free datasets exist for this task, their availability and usability vary. In this paper, OpenSARShip-Ship Detection Dataset (OSSDD), a new dataset based on the well-known OpenSARShip 1.0 dataset is proposed for training neural networks for SAR ship detection. OSSDD is freely available and contains 15,197 Sentinel-1 amplitude patches in VV and VH polarization, binary ship masks, axis-aligned bounding box and rotated bounding box annotations for a total of 55,759 ships. The construction of the dataset, the contents and structure of the downloadable data and experiments with three common detector models (Faster R-CNN, FCOS, DETR) are shown and discussed. The results serve as benchmarks for future experiments. The dataset is available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sylviaHoch/OpenSARShip-Ship-Detection-Dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OSSDD，一个基于OpenSARShip 1.0构建的自由可用的SAR船舶检测数据集，包含15,197个Sentinel-1幅度图像块（VV和VH极化）、二值船舰掩码以及轴对齐和旋转边界框标注，总计55,759艘船舶，并在Faster R-CNN、FCOS和DETR三种检测器上提供了基准实验结果。
AI.motivation: SAR图像中的船舶检测对海上态势感知非常重要（如打击非法捕捞、走私和边境违规）。然而，基于神经网络的现代检测方法需要大量训练数据，而SAR领域的训练数据集比光电领域更为稀缺，现有数据集在可用性和实用性方面参差不齐。
AI.method: 基于著名的OpenSARShip 1.0数据集构建了OSSDD数据集，包含Sentinel-1图像的VV和VH极化幅度图像块，提供二值船舰掩码、轴对齐边界框和旋转边界框三种标注形式。作者展示了数据集的构建过程、内容结构，并使用三种常见检测模型（Faster R-CNN、FCOS、DETR）进行实验。
AI.result: 生成了包含15,197个图像块、55,759艘船舶标注的OSSDD数据集，并在Faster R-CNN、FCOS和DETR三种检测器上完成了基准实验，结果可作为未来实验的参考基准。
AI.conclusion: OSSDD作为自由可用的SAR船舶检测数据集，弥补了该领域训练数据稀缺的不足，其多极化、多标注格式的设计和基准实验结果将为后续SAR船舶检测研究提供重要支撑。

title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake long-horizon tasks that require sustained reasoning, tool use, and revision across many interdependent steps. However, existing agent harnesses maintain task execution, task state, and completion assessment within a growing context, making the state difficult to track and allowing incorrect self-assessments to propagate into later decisions. We reformulate long-horizon execution as a task-state management problem and propose LongHorizon-Harness, which maintains the task state explicitly outside execution and updates it only with facts independently verified from the environment. Its Manage-Execute-Audit(MEA) loop uses a manager to maintain the task state and determine the next subtask, a fresh-context executor to perform it, and a read-only auditor to verify the resulting environment state before the next round.
