A lightweight AgentAdapter supports interchangeable model and harness backends without modifying their native agent loops. LongHorizon-Harness improves Qwen~3.7-Plus from 51.8% to 80.7% on WeaveBench, from 69.7% to 77.2% on Terminal-Bench~2.1, and from 2.8% to 8.3% on OSWorld~2.0. It also raises Claude Opus~4.7 from 20.0% to 34.3% on an OSWorld2.0 subset, demonstrating consistent gains across models, harnesses, and interaction domains.

AI.tldr: 提出了LongHorizon-Harness框架，将长时程智能体任务重新定义为任务状态管理问题。通过Manage-Execute-Audit（MEA）循环，将任务状态显式维护在执行之外，并仅用环境独立验证的事实更新状态，在WeaveBench、Terminal-Bench 2.1和OSWorld 2.0等多个基准上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架在长时程任务中将执行、状态维护和完成评估全部放在不断增长的上下文中，导致状态难以追踪，且错误的自我评估会传播到后续决策中。这暴露了现有方法在长时程任务中的根本性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出LongHorizon-Harness框架，核心是Manage-Execute-Audit（MEA）循环：Manager负责维护任务状态并决定下一个子任务，Executor使用全新上下文执行子任务，Auditor以只读方式验证执行后的环境状态。同时设计了轻量级AgentAdapter，支持无需修改原生智能体循环即可更换模型和harness后端。
AI.result: 在WeaveBench上将Qwen 3.7-Plus从51.8%提升至80.7%，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上从69.7%提升至77.2%，在OSWorld 2.0上从2.8%提升至8.3%。同时将Claude Opus 4.7在OSWorld 2.0子集上从20.0%提升至34.3%，展示了跨模型、跨harness和跨交互域的稳定收益。
AI.conclusion: 将长时程任务执行重新定义为任务状态管理问题是一种有效方法。通过外部化显式状态维护，并用环境验证的事实取代智能体自我评估，可以显著提升长时程任务的性能和可靠性，且该方法具有良好的通用性和模型无关性。

title: SVGEval: A Vision-Grounded Framework for Perceptual-Quality Benchmarking and Evaluation in Text-to-SVG Generation
summary: Multimodal large models are increasingly used to generate scalable vector graphics (SVG), but reliable evaluation remains underexplored. Existing protocols are often code-centric or borrow raster-image metrics after rendering SVGs, which fail to reflect human perception and overlook SVG-specific qualities such as geometry and spatial composition. We introduce SVGEval, a vision-grounded multimodal benchmark for human-aligned SVG quality assessment. SVGEval explicitly incorporates visual renderings to evaluate whether models can judge the rendered outcome rather than only inspect SVG code, and provides high-quality annotations obtained via multi-round human labeling with expert refinement. Systematic evaluations across representative multimodal models reveal a clear gap: models perform relatively well on semantic alignment and aesthetics, yet struggle on geometry- and layout-related judgments. Building on SVGEval, we train an explainable SVG quality scorer that outputs multi-aspect scores with textual rationales. Ablations show that explicit visual grounding and reasoning supervision are crucial, especially for spatial and geometric assessment. SVGEval offers a reliable testbed and practical scorer for evaluating and improving SVG generation in the era of multimodal models.

AI.tldr: SVGEval是一个基于视觉的多模态基准测试，用于评估人类对齐的SVG质量。它结合视觉渲染和高质量人工标注，系统评估多模态模型在SVG质量判断上的表现，并训练了一个可解释的SVG质量评分器。
AI.motivation: 现有SVG评估协议要么过于代码导向，要么借用光栅图像指标，无法反映人类感知，且忽视了SVG特有的几何和空间构图质量。需要一个能评估模型对渲染结果感知能力的基准测试。
AI.method: SVGEval通过三个核心设计实现：(1)显式融入视觉渲染，评估模型判断渲染结果而非仅检查SVG代码；(2)采用多轮人工标注与专家精炼相结合的方式提供高质量标注；(3)基于该基准训练一个可解释的SVG质量评分器，输出多维度评分并附带文本理由。
AI.result: 系统评估显示多模态模型在语义对齐和美学方面表现较好，但在几何和布局相关判断上存在明显不足。消融实验证明显式视觉基础和推理监督对空间与几何评估至关重要。
AI.conclusion: SVGEval为多模态时代SVG生成提供了可靠的测试平台和实用评分器，揭示了现有模型在SVG几何与空间判断上的关键短板，并为改进SVG生成指明了方向。

title: Proxy Avatar Meets Low-Rank Caching: Real-Time One-Shot Emotion-Controllable Portrait Animation
summary: Audio-driven portrait animation has advanced rapidly with diffusion-based generative models, yet real-time one-shot generation with expressive emotion control remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from insufficient emotion-aware motion priors and expensive appearance computation during multi-step denoising. To address these issues, we propose Proxy Avatar Meets Low-Rank Caching, a cascaded framework for real-time one-shot emotion-controllable portrait animation. Instead of directly generating the target portrait from audio, our method uses a Gaussian-based emotion proxy avatar as a reusable motion generator, which is trained once on a single identity to produce expressive driving videos from audio and emotion labels. Since the proxy avatar only provides motion rather than target appearance or geometry, a large-scale one-shot retargeting model further extracts identity-independent motion from the proxy performance and adapts it to arbitrary target portraits. To improve inference efficiency, we introduce zero-shot appearance reuse with low-rank caching, which caches reference appearance features at the initial denoising step and models subsequent feature variations using lightweight low-rank adapters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves stronger emotional expressiveness, better identity-preserving animation, and substantially reduced inference cost, enabling real-time one-shot portrait animation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Proxy Avatar Meets Low-Rank Caching框架，通过高斯情绪代理化身作为可复用运动生成器，配合低秩缓存实现实时的一次性、情绪可控的肖像动画生成。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的音频驱动肖像动画方法在实时一次性生成和情绪控制方面存在不足，主要体现在缺乏足够的情感知觉运动先验，以及多步去噪过程中的外观计算开销过大。
AI.method: 提出级联框架：1）高斯情绪代理化身作为可复用运动生成器，基于单一身份训练，从音频和情绪标签生成表达性驱动视频；2）大规模一次性重定向模型从代理表演中提取与身份无关的运动并适配到任意目标肖像；3）零样本外观复用与低秩缓存，在初始去噪步骤缓存参考外观特征，用轻量级低秩适配器建模后续特征变化。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在情绪表达力、身份保持动画质量和推理成本方面均优于现有方法，实现了实时的一次性肖像动画生成。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦运动生成与外观计算，并利用低秩缓存大幅降低推理开销，该方法在保持强情绪表达力的同时实现了实时高性能的肖像动画。

title: AdaThinkV: Adaptive Thinking for Token-Efficient Video Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve performance on difficult video questions but often wastes decoding tokens on simple ones. We study whether a video multimodal large language model can adapt its reasoning effort to each question. We propose AdaThinkV, an adaptive framework for video reasoning that learns whether to reason explicitly without offline difficulty labels, manually tuned confidence thresholds, or an external router. During reinforcement learning, AdaThinkV samples matched rollouts in explicit reasoning and direct answering modes for each prompt. ThinkGain estimates the prompt-level utility of explicit reasoning by balancing its accuracy gain against additional response length, providing supervision for both conditional response generation and autonomous mode selection. For difficult prompts, limited rollout exploration can yield groups in which every response is unsuccessful and accuracy rewards show little variation, providing insufficient signal for learning. We therefore introduce Variance Recovery Policy Optimization (VRPO), which retains and progressively expands these groups to recover informative signals from prompts that are difficult yet solvable. At inference, AdaThinkV selects a response mode and generates the response in a single autoregressive sequence. Across a unified suite of video reasoning evaluations, AdaThinkV achieves a mean accuracy of 40.79 with an average of 257.20 output tokens, outperforming the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline by 2.98 points while using 22.7% fewer tokens. Project page: https://trilarflagz.github.io/AdaThinkV/

AI.tldr: AdaThinkV是一个用于视频推理的自适应推理框架，通过强化学习让视频多模态大语言模型自主决定是否需要显式推理（即思维链），无需离线难度标签、人工置信度阈值或外部路由器。该方法在推理时能自动选择响应模式，在保持高准确率的同时大幅减少输出token数。
AI.motivation: 链式思维推理虽然能提升困难视频问题的性能，但对简单问题会浪费大量解码token。现有方法要么依赖离线难度标签，要么需要手动调节置信度阈值或外部路由器，缺乏让模型自适应推理努力程度的能力。
AI.method: AdaThinkV包含三个核心组件：(1) 在强化学习阶段对每个提示采样显式推理和直接回答两种模式的匹配rollout；(2) ThinkGain评估显式推理的提示级效用，权衡准确率提升与额外响应长度，为条件响应生成和自主模式选择提供监督信号；(3) Variance Recovery Policy Optimization (VRPO)处理困难但可解的提示，当有限的rollout探索导致所有响应都失败、准确率奖励变化不足时，保留并逐步扩展这些组以恢复有效学习信号。推理时模型在单次自回归序列中选择响应模式并生成响应。
AI.result: 在统一的视频推理评估套件上，AdaThinkV达到40.79的平均准确率，平均仅使用257.20个输出token，相比最强自适应基线准确率提升2.98个百分点，同时节省22.7%的token。
AI.conclusion: AdaThinkV证明了视频多模态大语言模型能够通过学习自适应地调整推理努力，在复杂问题上显式推理、在简单问题上直接回答，从而实现准确率与效率的更好平衡。

title: DiffPrune: differentiable information throttling for token pruning in vision-language models
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the computational cost of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens. The key is to learn a score that measures whether a token is useful. Existing methods typically rely on Gumbel-Softmax to approximate discrete selection during training. Such selectors make the score depend on the behavior of a relaxed pruning operator, not directly on the consequence of information loss. In this paper, we propose DiffPrune, which gives token scores a direct meaning. During training, DiffPrune keeps all tokens and weakens each token's information according to its score. If weakening a token hurts the task, the scorer is pushed to protect it; if not, the token can receive a lower score. Because the loss is differentiated through this actual information-throttling path, the scorer avoids the unstable surrogate path of relaxed token selection. DiffPrune implements this idea with an Information Throttler, which injects variance-preserving noise into visual tokens, where high-score tokens remain close to their original representations, while low-score tokens carry less original information. At inference, the throttler is removed, and hard top-K pruning is applied using the learned scores. Across ten VLM benchmarks, DiffPrune retains 96.5% of full-model accuracy while accelerating LLM prefill by 2.85x, with only 0.69 ms inference overhead. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: DiffPrune提出了一种新的视觉token剪枝方法，通过信息节流器（Information Throttler）为每个token的得分赋予直接含义：训练时保留所有token但按分数削弱其信息量，推理时移除节流器并应用硬top-K剪枝。在10个VLM基准上，保留96.5%的完整模型准确率，同时将LLM预填充速度提升2.85倍。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法依赖于Gumbel-Softmax近似离散选择，其打分器依赖于松弛后的剪枝算子行为，而非直接反映信息损失的真实后果，导致训练不稳定且得分语义不明确。
AI.method: 训练时保留所有token，通过Information Throttler向视觉token注入方差保持噪声，高得分token保持接近原始表示而低得分token携带更少原始信息。损失通过这条实际信息节流路径反向传播，避免不稳定松弛路径。推理时移除节流器，直接应用学习到的得分进行硬top-K剪枝。
AI.result: 在10个VLM基准上，DiffPrune保持96.5%的完整模型准确率，LLM预填充加速2.85倍，推理额外开销仅0.69毫秒。
AI.conclusion: DiffPrune通过将token得分与信息损失直接关联，避免了Gumbel-Softmax的代理训练路径，实现了更稳定有效的token剪枝，在精度和效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Grounding and Explaining Visual Evidence for AI-Generated Image Detection in Human-Centric Scenes
summary: Rapid advances in image generation models call for interpretable AI-generated image detection methods that not only determine authenticity but also provide supporting visual evidence. Existing approaches may produce inconsistencies between generated explanations and localized evidence regions, undermining the reliability of explanations for authenticity decisions. Meanwhile, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of the diverse human-centric scenes prevalent in generated imagery. To address these limitations, we investigate authenticity detection with grounded and explainable visual evidence in human-centric scenes. We present HAVE (Human-centric AI-generated Visual Evidence), a diverse human-centric dataset comprising 40K real and 39K AI-generated images from 10 recent generators, with 106K localized evidence instances across 8 evidence categories, each annotated with a bounding box and a region-aligned explanation. We further propose PAVE, a Perception-Aware Visual Evidence framework that jointly performs authenticity prediction, visual evidence grounding, and region-aligned explanation generation. PAVE employs a judge-guided alignment reward to assess region--explanation consistency and evidence validity, together with perception-aware regularization that contrasts token-level predictions between original and randomly masked images to promote reliance on visual input. Experiments on HAVE and external datasets demonstrate strong performance in authenticity detection, visual evidence grounding, and explanation quality. Code and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAVE数据集（包含40K真实和39K AI生成的人像图像，含106K带边界框和区域对齐解释的定位证据实例）以及PAVE框架，该框架联合执行真实性检测、视觉证据定位和区域对齐解释生成，通过审判者引导的对齐奖励和感知感知正则化提升检测与解释的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法在生成解释与定位证据区域之间存在不一致，削弱了真实性判断的可信度；同时现有基准对生成图像中常见的人像场景覆盖有限。
AI.method: 提出PAVE框架，包含三个联合任务：真实性预测、视觉证据定位和区域对齐解释生成。采用审判者引导的对齐奖励机制评估区域-解释一致性和证据有效性，并引入感知感知正则化，通过对比原始图像与随机掩码图像间的token级预测差异，促使模型更多依赖视觉输入。
AI.result: 在HAVE和外部数据集上的实验表明，PAVE在真实性检测、视觉证据定位和解释质量方面均表现出强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 构建了大规模人像中心场景的AI生成图像证据数据集HAVE，并提出PAVE框架有效解决了解释与证据区域不一致的问题，提升了可解释的AI生成图像检测能力。

title: SPARE: Structural Parameter-Free Affinity Regularization for Flow Matching
summary: Denoising diffusion transformers achieve strong generation quality but converge slowly during training. Regularizing their internal representations has emerged as an effective accelerator, yet existing methods split into two families with complementary costs. Target-based methods strengthen representations by aligning them to external features, which requires an external encoder and a learnable projection head to bridge feature spaces. Target-free methods hold no reference at all, and can only repel the model's own features across samples or layers, discarding whatever structure the data contains. Prior work suggests that spatial structure, rather than global semantics, drives the gains of alignment. We therefore ask whether such structure can serve as a target directly, and whether it exists not only within an image but across images. Our key insight is that the clean data latent already carries this structure in the relations among its tokens, where a relation is the similarity between two tokens, a single scalar comparable across feature spaces without a projection head. We propose Structural Parameter-free Affinity Regularization (SPARE), a regularizer that matches the pairwise affinities of intermediate tokens to those of the clean latents. To exploit this structure fully, SPARE extends the matching to token pairs across images, precisely the pairs that prior target-free methods repel by default, and calibrates both relation types with a single learning objective. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$ with SiT backbones under matched 400K-iteration budgets, SPARE adds no encoder, head, or parameters and only 0.08 GB of training memory, yet attains the lowest FID among parameter-free regularizers in every tested setting, recovers 37 to 54\% of REPA's FID reduction, and improves over REPA when combined with it, reaching FID 1.90 under classifier-free guidance at 1M iterations.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARE正则化方法，通过匹配中间token与干净隐空间token之间的成对亲和度（pairwise affinities）来加速扩散Transformer的训练收敛。该方法无需外部编码器、投影头或额外参数，仅增加0.08GB训练内存，在ImageNet 256×256上达到参数无关正则化器中的最优FID。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer生成质量高但训练收敛慢。现有基于目标（target-based）的方法需外部编码器和可学习投影头来对齐外部特征，而无需目标（target-free）的方法没有参考，只能排斥自身特征，丢弃了数据中的结构信息。先前工作表明空间结构比全局语义更重要，因此希望直接利用空间结构作为训练目标。
AI.method: 核心洞察：干净数据隐空间在token间的关系（两个token的相似度）中已包含空间结构，且这种关系是单个标量，可在不同特征空间直接比较而无需投影头。SPARE通过匹配中间token与干净隐空间token的成对亲和度来实现正则化，不仅匹配图像内token对，还扩展至跨图像的token对（这些正是target-free方法默认排斥的），并通过单一学习目标校准两类关系。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上用SiT骨干在400K迭代下测试：SPARE不增加编码器、投影头或参数，仅增加0.08GB训练内存，在每种测试设置中均达到参数无关正则化器中最低FID，恢复了REPA的37-54%的FID降低，且与REPA结合时表现更好，在1M迭代配合无分类器引导下达到FID 1.90。
AI.conclusion: 空间结构可以跨图像直接作为训练目标，成对token亲和度提供了一种无需投影头即可比较不同特征空间的简洁接口。SPARE证明了一种轻量级、参数无关的正则化方法能够有效加速扩散Transformer训练，且能与现有方法互补。

title: ASTRA: Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction via Trajectory Alignment
summary: Dynamic 3D scene reconstruction has achieved remarkable success under the assumption of strictly synchronized multi-camera inputs. However, in real-world scenarios, temporal asynchrony among capturing devices remains a critical challenge, leading to severe motion blur and geometric artifacts. Existing asynchronous reconstruction methods typically estimate temporal offsets through photometric supervision, but appearance matching provides weak temporal cues under large offsets and complex motions. We attribute this limitation to two major bottlenecks: texture-induced collapse, where low-texture regions provide nearly vanishing alignment signals, and deformation-induced coupling, where temporal errors are absorbed into distorted geometry or motion rather than being explicitly corrected. To address these issues, we propose ASTRA (Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction via Trajectory Alignment), a framework that introduces 2D motion trajectories as explicit, texture-agnostic supervision for asynchronous dynamic reconstruction. Instead of synchronizing cameras solely through rendered color residuals, ASTRA jointly optimizes temporal offsets and dynamic 3D representations by aligning the projected motion of reconstructed 3D points with observed 2D trajectories, while using dynamic and certainty masking to suppress unreliable trajectory constraints. Extensive experiments on different dynamic Gaussian Splatting backbones show that ASTRA preserves high-frequency spatial details and sustains strong robustness even under severe asynchrony with up to 25-frame offsets, achieving approximately 1.4 dB PSNR improvement, reducing temporal-offset MAE by 54.0\%, and nearly quadrupling the synchronization success rate.

AI.tldr: ASTRA是一种异步动态3D场景重建框架，通过引入2D运动轨迹作为显式的、与纹理无关的监督信号，取代传统的基于光度匹配的时间偏移估计方法，从而解决大偏移和复杂运动下异步相机重建中的运动模糊和几何伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 现有异步重建方法依赖光度监督来估计时间偏移，但在大偏移和复杂运动场景下，外观匹配提供的时间线索非常微弱。主要瓶颈包括：低纹理区域产生近似消失的配准信号（纹理诱导塌缩），以及时间误差被吸收到扭曲的几何或运动表示中而非被显式修正（变形诱导耦合）。
AI.method: ASTRA框架以2D运动轨迹作为显式监督信号。核心思想是：不通过渲染颜色残差来同步相机，而是将重建3D点的投影运动与观测到的2D轨迹进行对齐，联合优化时间偏移和动态3D表示。同时使用动态掩码和确定性掩码来抑制不可靠的轨迹约束。
AI.result: 在不同动态Gaussian Splatting骨干网络上验证，ASTRA在高达25帧偏移的严重异步条件下仍保持高保真空间细节和强鲁棒性，PSNR提升约1.4 dB，时间偏移MAE降低54.0%，同步成功率提升近4倍。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA证明了运动轨迹相比颜色外观是更可靠的时间同步线索，为异步动态重建提供了新的监督范式，有效解决了纹理依赖和形变耦合两大核心瓶颈。

title: Beyond Global Latents: Chunk-Based Sparse Grid VAE for Scalable 3D Modeling
summary: Sparse voxel grids preserve the spatial structure needed for detailed 3D reconstruction, but their memory still grows rapidly with resolution as active surface cells increase. We introduce ChunkVAE, a sparse grid variational autoencoder organized around local chunks rather than a global latent volume. Local learned operators permit independently chosen encoder and decoder partitions and allow inference chunk sizes to differ from training. Two complementary data operators make this flexibility practical: Balanced Binary Object Partitioning distributes active cells while limiting replicated overlap, while S-Curve weighted stitching attenuates unreliable boundary features when assembling a global latent or reconstruction. Across three object benchmarks, ChunkVAE is competitive with or better than strong baselines from $512^3$ to $1536^3$; smaller chunks lower peak allocated memory and shorten per-chunk compute, enabling faster parallel inference. Stable stitched latents and improved image to 3D metrics indicate that local compression can scale geometry while retaining the global interface required downstream.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChunkVAE，一种基于局部块（chunk）的稀疏网格变分自编码器。通过局部学习算子与两种数据操作（平衡二分对象划分和S曲线加权拼接），支持训练与推理块大小解耦，在512³到1536³分辨率下与强基线竞争或更优，降低峰值内存并加速并行推理。
AI.motivation: 稀疏体素网格虽能保留3D重建所需的空间结构，但其内存随分辨率增长过快（活跃表面单元增加）。现有全局隐空间的VAE方法难以扩展至高分辨率，需要一种局部压缩方案来平衡内存效率与全局一致性。
AI.method: 1) 提出ChunkVAE，围绕局部块而非全局潜在体积组织稀疏网格VAE；2) 使用局部学习算子，允许编码器与解码器采用独立且不同的分块划分，推理块大小可与训练不同；3) 引入Balanced Binary Object Partitioning均匀分布活跃单元并限制复制重叠；4) 设计S-Curve加权拼接，在组装全局潜在或重建时衰减不可靠边界特征。
AI.result: 在三个物体基准上，ChunkVAE在512³到1536³分辨率下与强基线竞争或更好；更小块降低峰值内存分配并缩短每块计算时间，实现更快并行推理；拼接后的隐变量更稳定，图像到3D的指标得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 局部压缩可以在扩展几何分辨率的同时保留下游所需的全局接口，证明了分块式稀疏VAE在高分辨率3D重建中的可行性与优势。

title: Invisible Ink Threats: Adversarial Goals Behind Legitimate Tasks in Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs), which empower large language models to autonomously operate operating systems and the web, are increasingly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection attacks. A widely adopted defense is the human-in-the-loop paradigm, in which the agent pauses for explicit user confirmation before executing sensitive operations. While effective against conspicuously high-harm attacks, this defense offers little protection against what we term Invisible Ink Threats: low-harm injected goals, such as starring a repository or installing a package, that are behaviorally indistinguishable from legitimate task execution and thus evade both model safety mechanisms and human oversight. To systematically investigate this blind spot, we present II-Bench, a collection of seemingly harmless adversarial tasks. II-Bench comprises 444 examples targeting confidentiality and integrity attacks across three platforms, spanning three attack categories: page navigation and interaction, sensitive information exfiltration, and code download and execution. Each category is instantiated in both natural language and code forms under two levels of instruction specificity. Furthermore, we construct HITLCUA, a comprehensive adversarial testing framework that integrates a real virtual machine operating system environment with isolated Docker-based web platforms, and simulates human participation by allowing CUAs to consult an API-simulated user before proceeding with suspicious operations. Extensive evaluations of leading CUAs reveal that low-harm injections frequently bypass both agent defenses and simulated user review, exposing severe and previously underexplored security risks in current CUAs.

AI.tldr: 本文发现计算机使用智能体（CUA）在面对"隐形墨水威胁"（低危害注入目标）时，现有的人类参与防御机制会失效。为此提出了II-Bench基准（444个对抗性示例）和HITLCUA对抗测试框架，实验表明低危害注入能够同时绕过智能体防御和模拟人类审查。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类参与式防御主要针对高危害的提示注入攻击有效，但对于低危害的注入目标（如star仓库、安装包等），这些操作与正常任务执行在行为上难以区分，既无法触发模型安全机制，也难以被人类监督发现，构成了当前防御体系中的盲区。
AI.method: 构建II-Bench基准，包含444个示例，覆盖三个平台（网页操作等）上的三类攻击（页面导航交互、敏感信息外泄、代码下载执行），每种攻击以自然语言和代码两种形式呈现，并设置两种指令具体化程度。同时构建HITLCUA测试框架，集成真实虚拟机操作系统环境和基于Docker的隔离Web平台，通过API模拟人类用户参与审查。
AI.result: 对主流CUA的广泛评估表明，低危害注入频繁地同时绕过智能体自身防御机制和模拟用户审查，揭示了当前CUA中严重且此前未被充分探索的安全风险。
AI.conclusion: 现有的安全防御范式对低危害注入攻击存在系统性盲区，需要新的防御策略来应对这类"隐形墨水威胁"。

title: RSVideo: Are Your Vision-Language Models Ready for Remote Sensing Videos?
summary: Remote-sensing videos enable real-time observation of changes in target attributes, short-term activities, and scene evolution. They record motion, actions, interactions, and scene changes that cannot be captured by isolated images. Existing models primarily target single images or discrete temporal observations spanning a long time range. However, a unified evaluation setting for assessing vision-language models on continuous remote-sensing video understanding remains lacking. We introduce RSVideo-10K, a remote-sensing video dataset comprising 10,773 instances, 1.47 million frames, and 17.02 hours of footage, containing both unmanned aerial vehicles and satellite platforms. Its fixed evaluation benchmark, RSVideo-Bench, contains 2,731 test instances and evaluates two complementary aspects of remote-sensing video understanding: L1 Perception and L2 Reasoning, spanning seven capability groups and 17 tasks. Evaluations show that current vision-language models still struggle to recover small local evidence, track short-lived states, and use scene-constrained spatial relations. Based on this analysis, we further propose RSVideo, a reinforcement learning framework for small-target spatiotemporal focusing that selects question-relevant regions across frames and suppresses redundant background tokens. RSVideo achieves a maximum absolute improvement of 9.01% with InternVL3.5-14B and attains the highest accuracy of 40.63% with Qwen3.6-27B across 26 open-source vision-language backbones.Codes will be available at https://github.com/HongjieZhou0329/RSVideo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSVideo-10K，一个包含10,773个实例、147万帧、17.02小时视频的遥感视频数据集，以及RSVideo-Bench基准测试（2,731个测试实例，7个能力组、17个任务），用于统一评估视觉语言模型在连续遥感视频理解上的能力。同时提出RSVideo强化学习框架，通过跨帧选择与问题相关的区域并抑制冗余背景token，在26个开源视觉语言骨干上取得最佳效果，InternVL3.5-14B上最高提升9.01%，Qwen3.6-27B上取得40.63%的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感视觉语言模型主要针对单张图像或长时间范围的离散时间观测，缺乏一个统一的评估框架来衡量模型在连续遥感视频理解上的能力。遥感视频能捕捉到单张图像无法记录的运动、行为、交互和场景变化，而现有评估设置无法覆盖这一关键维度。
AI.method: 1）构建RSVideo-10K数据集（含无人机和卫星平台数据）及固定的RSVideo-Bench评估基准，分为L1感知和L2推理两个互补层面，覆盖7个能力组和17个任务。2）提出RSVideo强化学习框架，该框架在帧间选择与问题相关的区域，同时抑制冗余的背景token，实现小目标时空聚焦。
AI.result: 评估发现当前视觉语言模型在恢复小局部证据、跟踪短暂状态和使用场景约束的空间关系方面仍有困难。RSVideo框架在InternVL3.5-14B上取得最高9.01%的绝对提升，在Qwen3.6-27B上取得40.63%的最高准确率，并验证了其在26个开源视觉语言骨干上的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 遥感视频理解对当前视觉语言模型仍是一大挑战，尤其是小目标检测、时序跟踪与场景约束推理。RSVideo-10K数据集、RSVideo-Bench基准和RSVideo强化学习框架为这一领域提供了统一评估基准和有效的解决方案。

title: Déjà Cue: Localizing States in Object Histories via Vocabulary-Relative Coordinates
summary: Tracking links observations of the same object through visual change, yet cannot by itself determine when the object is empty or filled, intact or cut. We formulate identity-conditioned state-moment retrieval: given a tracked-object history and alternative state descriptions, localize an interval in which each described state holds. Absolute image-text similarity scores descriptions independently; because every visible frame depicts the same target, shared object compatibility can obscure the state evidence needed to identify the target interval. The alternatives provide the missing reference: evidence for one state should be measured against the others. We introduce Déjà Cue, a training-free framework that turns these alternatives into a vocabulary-relative coordinate system. It subtracts their state-balanced centroid from each description, calibrates frame scores, and scans multiple durations within contiguous visible runs using a frozen encoder. On 78 VOST histories, holding the temporal scan fixed and changing only the query reference nearly doubles R@1 at tIoU 0.5 from 10.3\% to 20.5\% and raises Top-1 tIoU from 16.0\% to 21.5\%. Candidate-rank analyses show that vocabulary-relative queries rank useful intervals higher within the same candidate set. Related state descriptions can therefore serve as an object-specific, query-time coordinate system for reading frozen visual representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Déjà Cue，一种无需训练的视频状态检索框架，通过将替代状态描述转化为词汇相对坐标系来定位目标对象在特定状态（如空/满、完整/切割）出现的视频片段。在VOST数据集上，仅改变查询参照就将R@1从10.3%提升至20.5%。
AI.motivation: 跟踪链接同一物体在不同视觉变化中的观测，但仅凭跟踪无法判断物体何时处于特定状态（如空或满）。现有的绝对图像-文本相似度方法独立评分每个描述，由于所有可见帧都描绘同一目标，共享的对象兼容性会掩盖区分状态所需的关键证据。需要一种利用替代状态描述作为参照的方法来精确定位状态发生的区间。
AI.method: 提出训练自由的Déjà Cue框架：将替代状态描述转化为词汇相对坐标系。具体步骤包括：1）从每个描述中减去状态平衡质心；2）校准帧评分；3）使用冻结编码器在连续可见片段内扫描多个持续时间。通过参考坐标系而非绝对相似度来定位目标状态区间。
AI.result: 在78个VOST历史序列上，保持时间扫描固定仅改变查询参照，R@1@tIoU0.5从10.3%提升至20.5%（接近翻倍），Top-1 tIoU从16.0%提升至21.5%。候选排名分析显示词汇相对查询能在相同候选集中将有用区间排名更高。
AI.conclusion: 相关状态描述可以作为对象特定的、查询时的坐标系来读取冻结的视觉表示，显著提升状态时刻检索性能，且无需任何训练或微调。

title: TBSG-Net: Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network for Fine-Grained Video Moment Retrieval
summary: Recent advances in proposal-free Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) have highlighted the effectiveness of Static Scene Graphs (SSGs). By modeling objects and their relations at the frame level, SSGs enrich retrieval-oriented video representations. However, integrating SSGs into VMR remains constrained by two inherent limitations: (1) Lack of Temporal Dynamics. SSGs fail to model how objects and their relationships evolve over time, leading to the loss of essential temporal dependencies in video representation; and (2) Lack of Explicit Temporal Span Encoding. SSGs do not explicitly encode the duration of relationships, making precise localization challenging. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network (TBSG-Net)---to the best of our knowledge, the first Dynamic Scene Graph (DSG) based proposal-free VMR model. Specifically, TBSG-Net leverages DSGs to extract event-centric graph representations of the input video, enabling the modeling of object interactions over time and thus addressing limitation (1). These DSGs are then processed by a novel Dynamic Scene Graph Embedding (DSG-E) module to capture both Temporal Span and spatio-temporal information. First, DSG-E utilizes a TBSG Constructor to transform DSGs into TBSGs, explicitly encoding objects, relationships, and time spans to tackle limitation (2). Second, the resultant TBSGs are passed into a hybrid TBSG Encoder that integrates a Transformer variant for global event modeling and a Graph Convolutional Network for detailed relational reasoning, ultimately producing a more comprehensive spatio-temporal representation. Our experiments demonstrate substantial improvements of TBSG-Net over all baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TBSG-Net，这是首个基于动态场景图（DSG）的无提案视频时刻检索（VMR）模型。它通过DSG建模物体关系随时间演变，并设计DSG-E模块将DSG转化为时间二分场景图（TBSG），显式编码对象、关系和时间跨度，再通过混合TBSG编码器（Transformer + GCN）生成全面的时空表示，实验证明其显著优于所有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有无提案VMR方法依赖静态场景图（SSG），但SSG存在两个固有局限：(1)缺乏时间动态性，无法建模物体及关系随时间的演变；(2)缺乏显式时间跨度编码，难以精确进行时间定位。这些局限严重制约了检索性能。
AI.method: 提出TBSG-Net框架：首先利用动态场景图（DSG）提取事件中心的图表示以建模物体随时间交互；然后通过动态场景图嵌入模块（DSG-E）处理DSG——其中TBSG构造器将DSG转换为时间二分场景图（TBSG），显式编码对象、关系和时间跨度；最后混合TBSG编码器结合Transformer变体进行全局事件建模和GCN进行细粒度关系推理，生成全面的时空表示。
AI.result: 实验表明TBSG-Net在所有基线方法上均取得了显著的性能提升，验证了动态场景图及时间跨度显式编码在VMR任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TBSG-Net通过引入动态场景图克服了静态场景图的时序局限性，显式建模时间跨度并融合全局与局部事件推理，为无提案VMR提供了更优的时空视频表征方案。

title: MIEScore: Human-Aligned Evaluation for Multi-Source Image Editing
summary: Recent advances in unified multimodal models have significantly improved text-guided image editing abilities. In particular, models such as Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 demonstrate emerging capabilities in multi-source image editing (MIE), including tasks such as object synthesis, person-background composition, and cross-image style fusion. However, existing benchmarks and image editing assessment (IEQA) methods remain primarily focused on single-image editing tasks and largely overlook the more challenging setting of MIE. This highlights the urgent need for a comprehensive and human-aligned benchmark for MIE. To this end, we introduce MIE-Bench, the first large-scale multiple image editing benchmark with fine-grained human preference annotations. Specifically, MIE-Bench includes 3,000 editing instances across 16 tasks, each involving more than two source images and an editing prompt, together with 36K edited images produced by 12 state-of-the-art editing models and over 108K mean opinion scores (MOSs) covering visual quality, instruction following, and attribute preservation. Based on MIE-Bench, we propose MIEScore, a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based evaluation model enhanced with skill optimization and multi-dimensional supervised fine-tuning, to provide human-aligned feedback for MIE. Extensive experiments show that MIEScore achieves state-of-the-art performance in aligning with human preferences and generalizes well across other IEQA datasets. Both the dataset and the model are available at https://github.com/IntMeGroup/MIEScore.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MIE-Bench，这是首个大规模多图像编辑基准，包含3,000个编辑实例、16个任务、36K张编辑图像及108K个人类偏好评分；同时提出MIEScore，一个基于多模态大语言模型的编辑评估模型，通过技能优化和多维监督微调实现与人类偏好高度对齐的自动评估。
AI.motivation: 尽管统一多模态模型在多源图像编辑（MIE）方面展现出强大能力，但现有基准和图像编辑评估方法仍主要聚焦于单图像编辑任务，缺乏针对MIE的全面、与人类偏好对齐的基准和评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建MIE-Bench基准：包含3,000个编辑实例、16个任务（每个涉及两张以上源图像和一个编辑提示），由12个先进编辑模型生成36K张编辑图像，并收集超过108K个平均意见分数，覆盖视觉质量、指令遵循和属性保持三个维度。2) 提出MIEScore评估模型：基于多模态大语言模型，结合技能优化和多维监督微调技术，提供与人类偏好对齐的MIE反馈。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MIEScore在与人类偏好对齐方面达到最先进性能，并能很好地泛化到其他图像编辑评估数据集。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了多图像编辑评估领域的空白，提供了首个大规模基准和人类对齐的自动评估模型，数据集和模型均已开源。

title: STEAM:ASpatio-TEmporal Alignment Mixture-of-Experts Model with Hierarchical Pre-training for EEG Decoding
summary: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have been widely used in motor rehabilitation, disease diagnosis, and other neural engineering scenarios. However, conventional neural signal decoding algorithms often suffer from limited generalizability and high adaptation costs, motivating recent interest in BCI foundation models. Existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve general transferability, accurate decoding, and efficient downstream adaptation. We present STEAM, a hierarchical transfer framework that reconciles general-purpose representation learning with paradigm-specific specialization in EEG foundation models. The framework is instantiated as a dual-branch spatio-temporal encoder in which a shared soft mixture-of-experts (SSMoE) module aligns the spatial and temporal branches, allowing complementary representations to exchange information through a compact set of soft slots. Across seven downstream datasets and fourteen evaluation settings, STEAM attains the best average rank among the compared methods at a competitive inference cost measured in FLOPs. Building upon the Stage-I general initialization, the hierarchical pre-training strategy further specializes the model to a target paradigm without retraining from scratch, yielding consistent gains in paradigm-specific decoding accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEAM，一个用于EEG基础模型的分层迁移框架，通过双分支时空编码器和共享软混合专家（SSMoE）模块实现通用表示学习与范式特定专门化的统一。在七个下游数据集和十四个评估设置中取得最佳平均排名，且推理成本具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 传统神经信号解码算法泛化能力有限且适应成本高，现有BCI基础模型难以同时实现通用可迁移性、准确解码和高效下游适配。作者旨在解决这一三难问题。
AI.method: 提出STEAM分层迁移框架，包含双分支时空编码器（空间和时间分支），其中共享软混合专家（SSMoE）模块通过一组紧凑的软槽（soft slots）对齐并促进两个分支间的互补信息交换。采用分层预训练策略：Stage-I进行通用初始化，在此基础上进一步对目标范式进行专门化微调，无需从头重训。
AI.result: 在七个下游数据集和十四种评估设置中，STEAM取得对比方法中的最佳平均排名，同时保持有竞争力的FLOPs推理成本。分层预训练策略在范式特定解码精度上带来一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: STEAM成功调和了通用表示学习与范式特定专门化之间的矛盾，在跨数据集泛化、解码精度和推理效率之间取得了良好的平衡，为BCI基础模型提供了一种有效的分层迁移范式。

title: GIFT: Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning for Non-Lambertian Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth foundation models, benefiting from large-scale synthetic training data, have demonstrated strong generalization. However, they often hallucinate depth on non-Lambertian surfaces, estimating reflected content in mirrors or transmitted content behind glass rather than the physical surface itself. Adapting these models with real-world data is challenging because conventional depth sensors are also unreliable in such regions. We observe that while the appearance of a non-Lambertian surface varies with its reflected or transmitted environment, its underlying geometry remains unchanged. Based on this observation, we propose GIFT (Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning), a parameter-efficient post-training framework that requires no measured depth labels. We collect groups of RGB images under controlled appearance changes while keeping the camera and target geometry fixed. GIFT exploits geometric invariance across these observations to suppress non-Lambertian depth hallucinations while retaining general depth estimation capability. We further construct a controlled benchmark that evaluates non-Lambertian depth recovery, robustness to appearance changes, and performance retention in other regions. Experiments on our benchmark and an independent real-world dataset demonstrate that GIFT improves depth prediction for mirrors and transparent objects while largely preserving the base model's performance, providing a practical and low-cost approach for adapting monocular depth foundation models to non-Lambertian scenes.

AI.tldr: GIFT是一个无需真实深度标签的参数高效微调框架，利用非朗伯表面（如镜子、玻璃）在不同外观下几何不变的特性，抑制单目深度基础模型的深度幻觉，同时保留其通用深度估计能力。
AI.motivation: 单目深度基础模型在大规模合成数据上训练后泛化能力强，但在非朗伯表面（镜面反射、玻璃透射）上会产生深度幻觉，估计的是反射或透射内容而非物理表面本身。而传统深度传感器在这些区域同样不可靠，导致难以用真实数据适配模型。
AI.method: GIFT利用非朗伯表面外观随环境变化但底层几何不变的观察，收集在受控外观变化下、相机和目标几何固定的RGB图像组，通过几何不变性约束进行参数高效的后训练微调，无需测量深度标签，从而抑制非朗伯深度幻觉。
AI.result: 在自建基准和独立真实世界数据集上，GIFT显著改善了镜子与透明物体的深度预测，同时基本保留基础模型的性能，展示了在非朗伯场景中适配单目深度基础模型的实用性和低成本。
AI.conclusion: GIFT提供了一种无需深度标签的实用方案，通过几何不变性将单目深度基础模型适配到非朗伯场景，有效解决深度幻觉问题而不损失泛化能力。

title: Deep Multimodal Fusion Detection through Spatial Mask and Channel Fusion
summary: Deep multimodal fusion for object detection has demonstrated good performance through mining modal characteristics. However, existing feature-level fusion methods mainly weigh between two modalities and unify them in a unified representation space. This can lead to overfitting or over-specialization of the statistical properties of a single modality within a dual-backbone architecture. This paper proposes an Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling framework for robust improvement of cross-modality object detection. Based on a shared channel spatial attention mechanism, we first introduce the semantic mask exchange to actively mix the boundaries of the modalities during the training phase, forcing the backbone network to learn generalized features without relying on fixed modal labels. Then we propose a learnable channel competition to sample and aggregate features in a channel-wise and learnable way. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that the proposed method is effective and yields competitive results among existing state-of-the-art approaches. The source code is provided in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种注意力驱动的互补重采样框架（Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling），用于提升跨模态目标检测的鲁棒性。该方法通过语义掩码交换和可学习的通道竞争机制，解决了双骨干架构中特征级融合容易对单一模态过拟合或过度特化的问题，在多个数据集上取得了有竞争力的SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有特征级融合方法主要在两个模态之间加权并统一到同一表示空间中，在双骨干架构下容易导致对单一模态统计特性的过拟合或过度特化，缺乏对模态边界和互补信息的充分利用。
AI.method: 1. 基于共享通道空间注意力机制，引入语义掩码交换（semantic mask exchange），在训练阶段主动混合模态边界，迫使骨干网络学习不依赖固定模态标签的广义特征。2. 提出可学习的通道竞争（learnable channel competition）机制，以通道维度、可学习的方式对特征进行采样和聚合。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法有效，并且在现有最先进方法中取得了有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过主动混合模态边界和通道级可学习竞争聚合，有效缓解了跨模态融合中的过拟合问题，为实现鲁棒的跨模态目标检测提供了新的解决思路。

title: Same Semantics, Different Paths: Self-Improving Alignment for Vision-Text Compression
summary: Vision-Text Compression (VTC) renders long texts into images and encodes them through the vision encoder (ViT), compressing thousands of text tokens into far fewer visual tokens. However, since the ViT is pretrained predominantly on natural images, it captures visual attributes (glyphs, font sizes, layout) rather than linguistic semantics, causing rendered-image representations to diverge from native-text representations. We term this cross-path inconsistency and show, via rendering perturbation experiments, that it is a critical yet overlooked bottleneck of VTC. We propose SPIRAL (Self-improving Path Integration and Realignment), a self-supervised alignment framework that closes this gap using only the model's own text-path behavior as supervision, requiring no external teachers or additional annotations. SPIRAL operates at two complementary granularities: token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) for local faithfulness, and sequence-level preference optimization (DPO) for global coherence. On VTCBench, SPIRAL improves the overall score of Qwen3-VL-8B from 35.10 to 54.02, approaching the native text-input performance (55.60) and outperforming models up to 30x larger. The two granularities exhibit complementary strengths: OPD excels at retrieval and is sample-efficient, while DPO is stronger on reasoning and memory and scales better with data. SPIRAL's benefits also generalize to out-of-domain benchmarks, confirming that effective VTC hinges on aligning rendered-image representations back to native-text semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIRAL框架，通过自监督对齐解决Vision-Text Compression（VTC）中渲染图像表征与原生文本表征之间的跨路径不一致问题，将Qwen3-VL-8B在VTCBench上的得分从35.10提升至54.02，接近原生文本输入性能（55.60），且优于30倍规模更大的模型。
AI.motivation: VTC将长文本渲染为图像并通过视觉编码器压缩，但这种压缩方式存在根本性问题：由于ViT预训练于自然图像，其捕获的是视觉属性（字形、字号、布局）而非语言语义，导致渲染图像的表示与原生文本表示产生偏离（即跨路径不一致）。作者通过渲染扰动实验证明这是一个关键但被忽视的瓶颈。
AI.method: SPIRAL采用自监督对齐框架，仅利用模型自身的文本路径行为作为监督信号，无需外部教师或额外标注。框架包含两个互补粒度的对齐模块：（1）token级在线策略蒸馏（OPD）用于局部保真；（2）序列级偏好优化（DPO）用于全局连贯性。
AI.result: 在VTCBench上，SPIRAL将Qwen3-VL-8B的总体得分从35.10提升至54.02，接近原生文本输入性能（55.60），并优于最大30倍规模的模型。OPD在检索任务上表现优异且样本高效，DPO在推理和记忆任务上更强且数据扩展性更好。该方法在领域外基准上也展现了泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实有效的VTC关键在于将渲染图像的表征重新对齐到原生文本语义。SPIRAL通过两种互补粒度的自监督对齐成功弥合了这一差距，为VTC领域提供了一种无需外部监督的高效对齐方案。

title: PromptPath: Prompt-Adaptive Computational Pathways for In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) has attracted increasing attention for enabling models to perform new tasks using only a few ``input--output'' prompt examples. However, existing approaches suffer from \textbf{shallow task adaptation}, where prompts are primarily used as contextual cues to implicitly infer task intent through semantic representations, while the underlying computational process remains unchanged. This limitation restricts task-specific adaptation and compromises inference interpretability. We argue that prompts should not only condition feature representations but also dynamically regulate the model's computation pathways. To this end, we propose \textbf{PromptPath}, an adaptive ICL framework that enables computation-level adaptation through prompt-conditioned dynamic pathways. Specifically, PromptPath introduces a prompt-driven routing mechanism to selectively activate and compose lightweight low-rank experts, forming task-specific computational pathways tailored to different prompts. By integrating prompt information directly into the inference process, PromptPath dynamically reconfigures model computation to enhance task specialization and interpretability. Extensive experiments on 3D point cloud and 2D visual recognition benchmarks demonstrate that PromptPath consistently outperforms state-of-the-art ICL baselines while exhibiting strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出PromptPath框架，通过提示驱动的动态路由机制激活和组合轻量级低秩专家，形成任务特定的计算路径，实现上下文学习中的计算级自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有ICL方法存在浅层任务适应问题，提示仅作为上下文线索隐式影响特征表示，底层计算过程未改变，限制了任务特定适应性和推理可解释性。
AI.method: PromptPath通过提示驱动的路由机制选择性激活并组合轻量级低秩专家，形成针对不同提示的任务特定计算路径，将提示信息直接集成到推理过程中。
AI.result: 在3D点云和2D视觉识别基准上，PromptPath一致优于最先进的ICL基线，并展现出强大的跨领域和跨任务泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 提示不应仅调节特征表示，还应动态调控模型的计算路径，PromptPath验证了这种计算级自适应方法的有效性与可解释性。

title: Extended Field of View Analysis for VideoGAN-based Trajectory Generation
summary: Realistic and diverse trajectory generation is central to enabling higher levels of vehicle automation. While rule-based and classical learning-based methods may struggle to capture the complexity of traffic behavior, generative models have already demonstrated in other fields that they can handle a comparable level of complexity. In this paper, we build upon previous work on generative adversarial network (GAN)-based semantic bird's-eye-view traffic generation and extend the proposed framework in several key aspects. We improve the semantic representation, replace the trajectory extraction procedure with a graph-based association method, and systematically investigate increasingly larger fields of view. In addition, we introduce a quantitative evaluation framework to assess hallucinations and object permanence in generated videos. Our experiments demonstrate that the framework generalizes to larger and more complex traffic scenes while maintaining statistically realistic trajectories and coherent spatial relationships between traffic participants. Within 150GPU hours of training and with inference times below 20ms for scenes of up to 20s, our results demonstrate that video-based GANs remain an efficient and scalable approach for realistic trajectory generation, even in substantially larger traffic scenes, making them well suited for downstream tasks such as prediction, planning, and simulation in automated driving.

AI.tldr: 本文基于GAN的语义鸟瞰图交通生成框架，通过改进语义表示、引入基于图的轨迹关联方法，并系统研究更大的视野范围，实现了在更大、更复杂的交通场景中生成统计上真实且空间关系一致的车辆轨迹。训练仅需150 GPU小时，推理时间低于20ms，适用于自动驾驶的预测、规划和仿真等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 规则驱动和传统学习方法难以捕捉复杂交通行为的复杂性，而生成模型在其他领域已展现出处理同等复杂度的能力。本文旨在扩展基于GAN的语义鸟瞰图轨迹生成框架，使其能够处理更大、更复杂的交通场景，从而支持更高水平的车辆自动化。
AI.method: 1) 改进语义表示以增强场景表达；2) 用基于图的关联方法替代原有轨迹提取流程；3) 系统性地研究递增的更大视野范围；4) 引入定量评估框架来评估生成视频中的幻觉现象和对象持久性。
AI.result: 框架成功泛化到更大更复杂的交通场景，生成轨迹在统计上真实且参与者之间保持空间关系一致性。训练仅需150 GPU小时，20秒场景推理时间低于20ms。
AI.conclusion: 基于视频的GAN仍然是现实轨迹生成的高效、可扩展方法，即使面对更大的交通场景也表现良好，非常适合自动驾驶中的预测、规划和仿真等下游任务。

title: Messages, Not Tokens: Grounded Coresets for Faithful VLM Compression
summary: Modern vision language models (VLMs) turn high-resolution images into long sequences of visual tokens. Every token traverses the language decoder and persists in its prompt KV cache, inflating inference cost and motivating aggressive visual compression. Existing score-based methods assign each token an independent importance score and retain the Top-K. However, text queries consume collective, signed attention messages from the visual population, not isolated patches. Consequently, equally sized Top-K sets can repeatedly cover one salient region, omit sparse but complementary evidence and discard information carried by the removed population. We therefore formulate faithful visual compression as constructing a compact coreset for decoder messages, and introduce our training-free Grounded Message Coreset Pruning (GMC) which jointly allocates support across query-grounded, appearance, and coordinate-aware evidence, then transports discarded states into selected representatives at their original multimodal positions before physical compaction and native attention resume. This decomposes faithful compression into two coupled components, including selecting carriers that cover the required message modes and realizing the signed population message on those carriers. We further derive bounds connecting their errors to signed-message distortion, visual innovation, and candidate-margin stability. Experiments across multiple VLM families and diverse benchmarks demonstrate strong performance, with GMC-H2 retaining 97.78% Full-relative mean capability on Qwen2.5-VL-7B using 80.2% fewer visual tokens, while GMC-L16 reaches 100.36%. Controlled interventions verify that collective support and population realization jointly drive these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grounded Message Coreset Pruning (GMC)，一种免训练的视觉token压缩方法，通过构建"消息核集"而非简单的Top-K剪枝，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上保留97.78%性能的同时减少80.2%的视觉token。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的视觉token压缩方法（如Top-K）存在根本缺陷：它们为每个token分配独立的重要性分数并保留Top-K，但文本查询实际消耗的是来自视觉群体（population）的集体性、带符号的注意力消息，而非孤立补丁。这导致等大小的Top-K集合可能反复覆盖同一显著区域，遗漏稀疏但互补的证据，并丢弃被移除群体所携带的信息。
AI.method: GMC将忠实视觉压缩形式化为为decoder消息构建紧凑核集（coreset），包含两个耦合组件：(1) 选择"载体"（carriers），覆盖查询引导（query-grounded）、外观（appearance）和坐标感知（coordinate-aware）三种证据模式的联合支持；(2) 将这些被丢弃状态的消息传输（transport）到选定的代表token上，保持在原始多模态位置，之后进行物理压缩并恢复原生注意力。同时推导了连接这些误差与带符号消息失真、视觉创新和候选边际稳定性的理论界限。
AI.result: 在多个VLM家族和多样化基准上表现强劲：GMC-H2在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上保留97.78%的Full-relative平均能力（相对完整模型），同时减少80.2%的视觉token；GMC-L16达到100.36%。控制实验验证了集体支持和群体实现共同推动了这些增益。
AI.conclusion: GMC证明了视觉token压缩不应只关注个体的重要性，而应关注视觉群体对文本查询所传达的集体消息。通过联合支持分配和群体消息实现，可以在大幅减少视觉token的同时保持甚至超过原始模型的性能，为高效VLM推理提供了新的范式。

title: Two Sides of the Same Coin: Co-Evolving Search for Cross-Task Attacks on Vision-Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, and 8 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong generalization across multimodal tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing attacks typically follow single-trajectory gradient optimization or task-specific objectives, limiting search-space exploration and cross-task transferability. We propose an evolutionary-computation-guided cross-modal attack framework for unified VLMs. The framework adaptively searches both textual and visual spaces. On the textual side, it evolves hard negative semantic embeddings around the source-category representation to provide diverse cross-modal repulsion. On the visual side, it maintains a population of object-region perturbations and combines momentum-based gradient updates with evolutionary selection, mutation, and crossover to more reliably explore multiple feasible trajectories. Jointly optimizing semantic negative guidance and localized perturbations generates adversarial examples that consistently shift source-object semantics toward target categories across vision-language tasks. Theoretical analyses show that the co-evolutionary search preserves perturbation feasibility, prevents degradation of the best observed fitness, and increases the probability of reaching high-margin adversarial regions compared with single-trajectory optimization. Experiments on Florence-2, OFA, and UnifiedIO-2 demonstrate strong overall attack performance across image captioning, object detection, region categorization, and object localization. Ablation studies further verify the complementary effectiveness of text-side semantic evolution and image-side perturbation evolution, as well as the framework's efficiency and cross-task transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架，用于统一视觉-语言模型（VLMs）。该框架在文本侧进化硬负语义嵌入，在视觉侧结合动量梯度更新与进化选择、变异和交叉操作，联合优化以生成跨任务可迁移的对抗样本。实验在Florence-2、OFA和UnifiedIO-2上验证了其在图像描述、目标检测、区域分类和目标定位等任务上的攻击性能。
AI.motivation: 现有针对VLMs的攻击方法通常采用单轨迹梯度优化或任务特定目标，存在两大局限：一是搜索空间探索不足，容易陷入局部最优；二是跨任务可迁移性差。因此需要一种能同时探索文本和视觉两个模态搜索空间、并产生跨任务一致攻击效果的新框架。
AI.method: 提出进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架：（1）文本侧：围绕源类别表示进化硬负语义嵌入，产生多样的跨模态排斥；（2）视觉侧：维护目标区域扰动种群，结合动量梯度更新与进化选择、变异、交叉操作，探索多条可行轨迹；（3）联合优化语义负向引导与局部扰动，使源物体语义在跨视觉-语言任务中一致地向目标类别偏移。理论分析证明共进化搜索保持扰动可行性、防止最优适应度退化，并提高达到高余量对抗区域的概率。
AI.result: 在Florence-2、OFA和UnifiedIO-2三个统一VLM上，该方法在图像描述、目标检测、区域分类和目标定位四个任务中均表现出强的攻击性能。消融实验验证了文本侧语义进化与图像侧扰动进化的互补有效性，同时证明了框架的高效率和跨任务可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架能够有效突破单轨迹优化的局限，通过文本和视觉双空间的协同进化探索，实现统一VLM上跨任务的强攻击能力，为研究VLM的鲁棒性提供了新的视角和方法。

title: The Push-Forward Transform for Continuous and Robust Comparison of Dynamic Shapes
summary: We introduce a mathematical framework for shape comparison based on mapping functions from the shape domain to a common reference domain. This Push-Forward Transform enables invariant and robust comparison of shapes, preserving intrinsic geometric information. Quantitatively comparing shapes and their temporal evolution is a fundamental challenge in image analysis. Meaningful shape comparison requires representations that are invariant to transformations that do not alter shape itself, such as translation, rotation, reflection, re-parametrization, and uniform scaling, while remaining sensitive to intrinsic geometric variation. Existing approaches often rely on sensitive parameterizations, landmark correspondence, or learned representations that are difficult to interpret and reproduce. We show that the Push-Forward Transform (PF-T) applied to Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) yields a continuous representation that captures both boundary and interior geometry. We derive an interpretable morphometric that quantifies shape similarity and reveals features such as skeletal topology and rotational symmetries. The push-forward transform applies consistently to two- and three-dimensional shapes, extends to time-evolving geometries, and supports the joint analysis of shape and additional scalar fields defined over shapes, such as intensity or molecular signals. We present the mathematical formulation, describe an efficient algorithm, and benchmark the approach on 2D, 3D, and temporal data sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Push-Forward Transform (PF-T)的数学框架，用于形状比较。该方法将形状域映射到共同参考域，应用于Signed Distance Functions (SDFs)后，能够生成连续表示，捕捉边界和内部几何信息，实现不变且鲁棒（对平移、旋转、反射、重参数化和均匀缩放不敏感）的形状比较，并支持2D/3D/时变几何以及附加标量场的联合分析。
AI.motivation: 形状比较是图像分析中的基础挑战，但现有方法往往依赖敏感的参数化、地标对应或难以解释和复现的学习表示。需要一种能对不影响形状本身的变换（平移、旋转、反射、重参数化、均匀缩放）保持不变，同时保持对内在几何变化敏感的形状表示方法。
AI.method: 提出Push-Forward Transform (PF-T)应用于Signed Distance Functions (SDFs)。该方法将形状域映射到共同参考域，产生连续表示，可捕捉边界与内部几何信息。推导出可解释的形态测量指标，用于量化形状相似性，并揭示骨骼拓扑和旋转对称性等特征。
AI.result: 该方法一致适用于2D和3D形状，扩展到时间演化几何，支持形状与附加标量场（如强度或分子信号）的联合分析。在2D、3D和时间序列数据集上进行了基准测试验证。
AI.conclusion: Push-Forward Transform为形状比较提供了一种不变、鲁棒且可解释的数学框架，能够捕捉内在几何信息，并且具有广泛的适用性（2D/3D/时变/附加标量场），为形状分析提供了优于现有方法的新工具。

title: HiResNets: Native Full-HD Video Recognition with Foveal Residual Streams
summary: Much of the recent progress in image and video recognition has come at the cost of memory: larger models, increased resolution, and longer temporal contexts. An inevitable component is the quadratic (or larger) growth of memory and compute based on image resolution, which is a property of the grid sampling used in convolutional networks and vision transformers. In this work we study residual networks whose convolutional blocks have logarithmic-square growth instead, enabling them to process very high-resolution video quickly. The key insight is to use a residual architecture's residual stream as a high-resolution buffer, to which convolutional blocks only read and write via log-polar image warp operations. Layers adaptively focus on different parts of each frame, with very high resolution only near the focus point. A complete high-resolution representation is built up in the residual stream, analogous to eye saccades creating a complete picture in biological vision, and a theoretical construction is presented that eliminates the quadratic dependency of the residual stream resolution. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed HiResNets learn to foveate around scenes similarly to human vision, and have superior performance in difficult egocentric video recognition tasks, especially egocentric video with small objects and fine-grained recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiResNets，一种利用残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区的残差网络，通过log-polar图像扭曲操作实现对数平方级的内存和计算增长，能够快速处理超高分辨率视频，并在第一人称视频识别任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 图像和视频识别领域的内存/计算成本随分辨率呈二次方（或更高）增长，这对高分辨率视频处理构成严重瓶颈，需要一种更高效的方法来突破这一限制。
AI.method: 利用残差架构中的残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区，卷积块通过log-polar图像扭曲操作仅读写缓冲区中的局部区域。借鉴生物视觉中的眼跳（saccade）机制，各层自适应聚焦于帧的不同部分，焦点附近保持高分辨率，远处降低分辨率，在残差流中逐步构建完整的高分辨率表征。同时提供了理论构造来消除残差流分辨率的二次依赖。
AI.result: 实验表明HiResNets能够像人类视觉一样学习对场景进行焦点注视（foveate），在困难的第一人称（egocentric）视频识别任务中表现优越，尤其是在小目标和细粒度识别场景下。
AI.conclusion: 通过将计算和内存成本从二次方降至对数平方级别，HiResNets为高分辨率视频识别提供了一种高效且仿生的解决方案，验证了残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区的可行性。

title: Quaternion Tensor Modeling for Joint Color-Polarization Demosaicking
summary: Division-of-focal-plane (DoFP) color polarization cameras enable snapshot acquisition of color polarization mosaic images, but the inherently sparse sampling pattern makes color polarization demosaicking severely ill-posed. Existing methods often fail to jointly exploit the correlations among polarization channels and the physical constraints inherent in polarization imaging, resulting in noticeable demosaicking artifacts. To address this issue, a quaternion-tensor-based color polarization demosaicking (CPDM) method incorporating Stokes-domain total variation (TV) regularization is proposed. Correlation analysis shows that the correlations among polarization channels are stronger than those among color channels. Accordingly, the color polarization images acquired at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ are encoded into the four components of a third-order quaternion tensor, with the color channels organized along its third mode. A low-rank prior is then imposed on the quaternion tensor to exploit the global structural redundancy in the color polarization data. Moreover, spatial gradients are mapped to the Stokes domain through an orthogonal transformation to separate intensity, polarization and residual variations, with adaptive quaternion weights enabling component-specific regularization and preserving the energy consistency of the reconstructed Stokes vectors. An efficient optimization algorithm is derived for the resulting model. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior demosaicking performance of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于四元数张量和Stokes域全变分（TV）正则化的彩色偏振去马赛克（CPDM）方法。将0°、45°、90°、135°四方向偏振图像编码为三阶四元数张量的四个分量，利用低秩先验挖掘全局结构冗余，并通过正交变换将空间梯度映射至Stokes域实现分量自适应正则化，有效解决了DoFP彩色偏振相机的稀疏采样导致的病态去马赛克问题。
AI.motivation: DoFP彩色偏振相机可快拍获取彩色偏振马赛克图像，但其固有的稀疏采样模式使彩色偏振去马赛克问题严重病态。现有方法未能联合利用偏振通道间的相关性以及偏振成像固有的物理约束，导致明显的去马赛克伪影。
AI.method: 1）通过相关性分析发现偏振通道间相关性高于颜色通道间相关性，据此将四个偏振方向的图像编码为四元数张量的四个分量，颜色通道沿第三模式排列；2）对四元数张量施加低秩先验以利用全局结构冗余；3）通过正交变换将空间梯度映射到Stokes域，分离强度、偏振和残差变化，并使用自适应四元数权重实现分量特定正则化，保持Stokes向量能量一致性；4）推导高效优化算法求解该模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的方法在彩色偏振去马赛克性能上优于现有方法，能够有效减少伪影并保持重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将四元数低秩张量建模与Stokes域TV正则化相结合，该方法充分利用了偏振通道间强相关性以及偏振成像的物理约束，为彩色偏振去马赛克提供了一种更优的解决方案。

title: UniqueSplat: View-conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
summary: In this paper, we propose UniqueSplat, a view-conditioned feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting model to reconstruct customized 3D radiance fields for each view query. Existing feed-forward methods such as pixelSplat and MVSplat aim to generate fixed Gaussians across all views of each scene by minimizing the error between rendered views and ground-truth images. However, such fixed Gaussians generally render images from all views and lack the ability to adapt to specific viewpoints, as they do not incorporate target view information when predicting Gaussians. To address this, our UniqueSplat learns the view-conditioned information as a prior and incorporates this knowledge into network parameters, so that Gaussians are dynamically adjusted in accordance with different views. Specifically, we propose a two-branch view-conditioned hyperNetwork to simultaneously learn view-agnostic embeddings and view-specific knowledge, which not only explores the shareable knowledge from various views, but also adapts the model to specific views at test time. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including RealEstate10K, ACID and DTU demonstrate the superiority of UniqueSplat over the state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, UniqueSplat encouragingly outperforms existing methods in cross-dataset evaluation, showing its notable generalization ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniqueSplat，一种视图条件化的前馈3D高斯泼溅模型，通过双分支视图条件超网络同时学习视图无关嵌入和视图特定知识，使高斯分布能够根据目标视图动态调整，在RealEstate10K、ACID和DTU数据集上超越现有方法，并展现出优异的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的前馈方法（如pixelSplat和MVSplat）生成对所有视图固定的高斯分布，缺乏适应特定视角的能力，因为预测高斯时没有纳入目标视图信息，导致渲染效果无法针对具体视角进行优化。
AI.method: 提出双分支视图条件超网络（two-branch view-conditioned hyperNetwork），将视图条件信息作为先验学习并融入网络参数中，同时学习视图无关的共享嵌入和视图特定的知识，使高斯在测试时能根据不同视图动态调整。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K、ACID和DTU数据集上的大量实验表明UniqueSplat优于最先进的方法，且在跨数据集评估中表现突出，展示了显著的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 视图条件化建模能够有效提升3D高斯泼溅的重建质量，通过将视图信息编码进网络参数而非仅依赖固定高斯，可以在保持共享知识的同时实现针对特定视图的自适应优化，并具备良好的跨数据集泛化性。

title: PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs
summary: Embodied intelligence and world models require video understanding systems to go beyond recognizing objects and actions and develop an understanding of physical regularities. However, despite their strong performance on general video understanding tasks, current video-language models still struggle to reliably determine whether an observed event conforms to specific physical laws. Existing benchmarks primarily assess the physical quality of generated videos, providing limited support for systematically evaluating and improving the physical-law understanding of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs). To address this gap, we introduce PhyCheck, a video question answering dataset organized at two complementary levels of granularity. The coarse-grained subset asks models to determine whether the phenomenon shown in a video conforms to or violates physical laws, while the fine-grained subset further examines whether models can capture physical details responsible for the violation or compliance. We use these subsets as structured supervision to improve physical understanding. In addition, the dataset contains a diagnostic subset with external causal context that reveal hidden factors affecting physical plausibility, assessing whether models can recalibrate their judgments accordingly. Experiments with Fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL show that training with the proposed data substantially improves the understanding of physical-consistency, while evaluations in the diagnostic subset reveal that current models still have difficulty incorporating additional causal conditions into their decisions. These findings highlight the gap between recognizing surface-level inconsistencies and understanding underlying physical mechanisms, and provide a foundation for evaluating and improving physical understanding in Video-LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhyCheck，一个用于评估和提升视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）物理规律理解能力的视频问答数据集。数据集包含粗粒度（判断是否符合物理规律）、细粒度（识别具体物理细节）和诊断性子集（引入外部因果上下文），并通过微调Qwen2.5-VL验证了训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现存的视频语言模型虽然在通用视频理解任务上表现优异，但在判断事件是否符合物理规律方面仍然困难。现有基准主要评估生成视频的物理质量，缺乏系统评估和提升VideoLLMs物理规律理解的工具，这是研究空白。
AI.method: 构建PhyCheck数据集，包含三个层次的子集：(1)粗粒度子集，判断视频现象符合还是违反物理规律；(2)细粒度子集，识别导致违反或符合物理规律的具体细节；(3)诊断性子集，提供外部因果上下文，测试模型能否据此重新校准判断。使用该数据集对Qwen2.5-VL进行微调训练。
AI.result: 使用PhyCheck数据微调的Qwen2.5-VL在物理一致性理解上显著提升；但在诊断性子集上，现有模型仍难以将额外因果条件融入决策，暴露了表面层不一致识别与深层物理机制理解之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当前VideoLLMs在识别表面物理不一致性方面可通过训练提升，但在理解底层物理机制和整合外部因果信息方面仍有明显不足，PhyCheck为后续评估和提升物理理解能力奠定了基础。

title: AdaForensics: Learning A Characteristic-aware Adaptive Deepfake Detector
summary: In this paper, we propose a characteristic-aware adaptive network named AdaForensics for deepfake detection. Most existing methods learn a fixed network to detect deepfakes based on carefully-designed network architectures. However, these methods employ the same deepfake detector for all the images despite of various facial characteristic, which fail to provide customized forgery detection for different individuals. To address this, our AdaForensics simultaneously learns characteristic-agnostic and characteristic-specific embeddings, where the detector dynamically adapts to varying faces with our designed hypernetwork on the fly. More specifically, our AdaForensics not only explores the shareable abstractions from various deepfake images, but also adapts the detector to the given characteristic at test time. To achieve this, we propose a two-branch HyperNetwork to learn an adaptive deepfake detector, which automatically adjusts the parameters based on characteristic of the input. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including FaceForensics, Celeb-DF and DFDC demonstrate our AdaForensics outperforms the state-of-the-art works.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaForensics，一种基于特征感知的自适应深度伪造检测网络。它通过双分支超网络同时学习特征无关和特征相关的嵌入，在测试时根据输入人脸的特征动态调整检测器参数，实现个性化伪造检测，在FaceForensics、Celeb-DF和DFDC数据集上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法对所有图像使用同一个固定检测器，忽视了不同个体的面部特征差异，无法为不同人提供定制化的伪造检测服务，导致检测性能受限。
AI.method: 提出AdaForensics网络，包含两个关键组件：(1)同时学习特征无关（characteristic-agnostic）和特征相关（characteristic-specific）的嵌入表示；(2)设计双分支超网络（two-branch HyperNetwork），根据输入图像的面部特征在测试时自动调整检测器参数，实现动态自适应检测。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics、Celeb-DF和DFDC三个广泛使用的数据集上的大量实验表明，AdaForensics的性能优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将检测器参数与个体面部特征动态关联，AdaForensics实现了真正个性化的深度伪造检测，证明了特征感知自适应策略的有效性，为该领域提供了新的研究思路。

title: GSRAIN: Physically Calibrated High-/Low-Frequency Rainfall Synthesis for 3D Gaussian Driving Scenes
summary: Existing rainfall simulation methods for autonomous driving remain limited in physical controllability and multi-view consistency. This paper presents GSRAIN, a high-/low-frequency rainfall synthesis method for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) driving scenes. GSRAIN constructs a high-frequency raindrop model from measured rainfall data and generates low-frequency rainy appearance using a geometry-aware single-step diffusion model. The two effects are then fused in a unified 3DGS scene, enabling rainfall-intensity control over the range of 0--13~mm/h. The proposed method achieves a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 149.09, outperforming CycleGAN-Turbo (155.71) and WeatherEdit (157.94). Object-detection and closed-loop driving experiments further show that the generated scenes expose scene-dependent performance changes of the evaluated algorithms under controllable rainfall. These results indicate that GSRAIN provides an effective approach for constructing physically controllable, repeatable, and closed-loop-compatible rainy-weather test scenes for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: GSRAIN是一种面向3D Gaussian Splatting驾驶场景的高/低频降雨合成方法，通过融合高频雨滴模型和低频雨天外观扩散模型，在统一3DGS场景中实现0-13 mm/h可调控降雨强度，FID达149.09，优于CycleGAN-Turbo和WeatherEdit，并支持目标检测与闭环驾驶测试。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶降雨仿真方法在物理可控性和多视角一致性方面存在局限，需要一种既能精确控制降雨强度又保持多视角一致的仿真方法，以支持自动驾驶算法在雨天场景下的可靠测试。
AI.method: GSRAIN构建高频雨滴模型（基于实测降雨数据）和低频雨天外观生成（使用几何感知的单步扩散模型），然后将两种效果在统一3DGS场景中融合，实现0-13 mm/h范围内降雨强度可控。
AI.result: FID达到149.09，优于CycleGAN-Turbo（155.71）和WeatherEdit（157.94）。目标检测和闭环驾驶实验表明生成场景能揭示不同算法在可控降雨下的场景依赖性能变化。
AI.conclusion: GSRAIN为自动驾驶提供了物理可控、可重复且闭环兼容的雨天测试场景构建方法，验证了高频/低频降雨合成框架在3DGS场景中的有效性和实用性。

title: SWINSleepNet: A Hierarchical Context-Aware Framework for Sleep Staging (v2)
comment: Report-no: SDUST-SLEEP-202608-V2; 10 pages, 7 figures, revised updated version of arXiv submit/7867870, conference submission draft
summary: Automatic sleep staging is a critical role in sleep disorder diagnosis, sleep quality assessment, and long-term health monitoring; however, existing approaches suffer poor performance on ambiguous and transition-related sleep stages, caused by inadequate modeling of fine-grained intra-epoch structures and complex cross-region spectral dependencies. Traditional epoch-level encoders commonly fail to extract subtle temporal microstructures and intra-epoch cross-region interactions, resulting in unsatisfactory recognition accuracy for hard categories such as the N1 stage. To tackle these drawbacks, we propose SwinSleepNet, a hierarchical context-aware dual-stream framework that separately optimizes intra-epoch representation learning and inter-epoch contextual modeling. Concretely, we characterize each sleep epoch from two complementary perspectives: raw time-domain EEG signal and its time-frequency transformation. The time-domain branch adopts convolutional encoders to capture fine waveform temporal details, and the time-frequency branch uses Swin Transformer to extract local spectro-temporal features, hierarchical multi-scale information and long-range spatial dependencies. The multi-branch extracted features are fused into integrated embeddings, which are optimized by a bidirectional context module to capture cross-epoch temporal dependencies for final sleep stage classification. Comprehensive experiments on Sleep-EDF-20, Sleep-EDF-78 and SHHS datasets verify that our method achieves competitive overall performance, and exhibits stronger robustness and stability on difficult N1 stages and transitional epochs. The results prove that optimized intra-epoch representation learning based on hierarchical architecture greatly benefits automatic sleep staging tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwinSleepNet，一个层次化的上下文感知双流框架，分别优化epoch内表征学习和epoch间上下文建模，在睡眠分期任务中（尤其在困难的N1阶段和过渡期）取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自动睡眠分期方法在模糊和过渡相关的睡眠阶段（如N1期）表现不佳，原因是缺乏对epoch内细粒度结构和跨区域频谱依赖关系的充分建模。传统epoch级编码器难以提取微妙的时间微观结构和epoch内跨区域交互。
AI.method: 提出双流框架SwinSleepNet：1）时间域分支使用卷积编码器捕获精细波形时间细节；2）时间-频率分支使用Swin Transformer提取局部频谱-时间特征、层次多尺度信息和长距离空间依赖；3）多分支特征融合后通过双向上下文模块建模跨epoch时间依赖以进行分类。
AI.result: 在Sleep-EDF-20、Sleep-EDF-78和SHHS三个数据集上的综合实验验证了方法的竞争性整体性能，并在困难的N1阶段和过渡epoch上表现出更强的鲁棒性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 优化的基于层次架构的epoch内表征学习对自动睡眠分期任务有显著帮助。

title: SPIRIT: Spatio-temporal Pairwise Relational Modeling of Instrument-Tissue Interactions for Surgical Action Triplet Recognition
summary: Fine-grained understanding of surgical activity is essential for context-aware assistance in the operating room, including safety monitoring, adverse event identification, and skill assessment. Surgical action triplets, defined as tuples of the form <instrument, verb, target>, provide a structured description of instrument-tissue interactions. A key open problem, however, is how to learn triplet representations that remain reliable across institutions, where surgical video varies in acquisition conditions, surgeon style, tool usage, and tissue handling, while existing triplet datasets do not support explicit evaluation of center-wise transfer. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{SPIRIT}, a structured framework for surgical action triplet recognition designed to learn interaction representations that transfer more reliably across centers. Instead of treating each triplet as a flat class label, SPIRIT first learns spatio-temporal representations for instruments, verbs, and targets, then models their pairwise relations, and finally composes them into coherent triplet predictions, with multi-head distillation used to stabilize learning. To evaluate this setting, we establish \textbf{MultiBypass-4C-T40}, a multi-centric dataset for dense surgical action triplet recognition in Roux-en-Y gastric bypass across four geographically distinct centers, with auxiliary phase and step annotations. Across multiple evaluation protocols, SPIRIT consistently outperforms strong recent baselines, highlighting the value of explicit relational reasoning for multi-centric triplet recognition. Code will be available at https://github.com/CAMMA-public/multibypass-4c-t40.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIRIT框架，通过结构化建模手术动作三元组（<器械，动词，目标>）的组成部分及其两两关系，实现跨中心可迁移的手术动作识别，并构建了多中心数据集MultiBypass-4C-T40用于评估该设置。
AI.motivation: 手术动作三元组识别需要跨机构泛化，但现有数据集不支持中心间迁移的显式评估；直接将有无数组合的三元组视为扁平类别标签难以学习可靠的跨中心表征。
AI.method: SPIRIT框架先分别学习器械、动词和目标的时空表示，再建模它们的两两关系，最后组合成连贯的三元组预测；使用多头蒸馏稳定学习过程。同时构建了包含四个地理分布中心、带阶段和步骤标注的多中心数据集MultiBypass-4C-T40。
AI.result: 在多种评估协议下，SPIRIT在跨中心迁移任务中持续优于近期强基线方法，验证了显式关系推理对多中心三元组识别的价值。
AI.conclusion: 显式的结构化关系建模比扁平类别标签更能学习跨中心可靠的手术动作三元组表征，多中心数据集为未来研究提供了基准。

title: DerainSplat: Feed-Forward Clean 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Rainy Views
summary: Although image deraining has advanced substantially, existing methods mainly focus on 2D image restoration. As spatial intelligence applications such as embodied AI and autonomous driving continue to emerge, reconstructing clean 3D scenes from sparse rainy views in a feed-forward manner becomes increasingly important. Existing feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods often assume clean inputs and collapse under rainy conditions. To this end, we present \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}}, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs clean 3D scenes from only a few rainy views. To support this task, we build a large-scale multi-view derain dataset through a four-stage synthesis pipeline that sequentially models overcast illumination, depth-dependent haze, rain streaks, and lens raindrops, producing privileged weather factors. We introduce a weather net that predicts the weather factors from rainy context and yields two support maps. Scene support modulates cross-view cost-volume matching, while radiance support drives depth-aligned appearance fusion to fill corrupted pixels. The derived geometry evidence further attenuates Gaussian opacity to reduce spurious structures. A rainy cycle consistency re-renders clean views using the predicted factors and aligns them with rainy inputs. Extensive experiments show that \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}} outperforms existing methods on various datasets, including RealEstate10K, ACID, Mip-NeRF360, and real-world rainy scenes, with strong cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DerainSplat，一个前馈式框架，能够从少量雨天视角重建干净的3D场景。通过构建大规模多视角去雨数据集（四阶段合成管线生成天气因素），并引入天气网络预测天气因素生成两种支持图来调制跨视角代价体匹配和外观融合，同时结合雨循环一致性约束，在多个数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像去雨方法主要聚焦于2D图像复原，而空间智能应用（如具身AI、自动驾驶）需要从稀疏雨天视角前馈式重建干净3D场景。现有前馈3DGS方法假设干净输入，在雨天条件下性能崩溃。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模多视角去雨数据集，通过四阶段合成管线（阴天光照、深度相关雾霾、雨条纹、镜头雨滴）生成并输出特权天气因素；2) 引入天气网络预测天气因素并生成场景支持和辐射支持两种图；3) 场景支持调制跨视角代价体匹配，辐射支持驱动深度对齐的外观融合修复被污染像素；4) 推导的几何证据衰减高斯不透明度以减少虚假结构；5) 雨循环一致性将预测因素重渲染干净视图并与雨天输入对齐。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K、ACID、Mip-NeRF360以及真实世界雨天场景等数据集上均优于现有方法，且具有强跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DerainSplat成功实现从稀疏雨天视图前馈重建干净3D场景，验证了天气因素感知方法在雨天3D重建中的有效性，为雨天条件下的空间智能应用提供了可行方案。

title: T$^2$exture: Sparsely Perturbed Thermal-to-Texture Imaging
summary: Thermal imaging remains effective under adverse illumination, yet passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) measurements often lack fine texture. Existing thermal texture imaging approaches commonly rely on spectral sensing or registered auxiliary modalities, incurring substantial data throughput or vulnerability to cross-modal degradation. We introduce T$^2$exture, a sparsely perturbed thermal texture imaging framework that aims to reconstruct temporally dense thermal texture sequences from densely sampled passive frames and a few actively perturbed keyframes. We define thermal texture as the residual between a source-on observation and its corresponding source-off passive state. Under sparse LWIR illumination and rapid quasi-steady paired acquisition, this residual attenuates the passive-emission background and approximates a source-induced reflected response, exposing localized material- and geometry-dependent texture. T$^2$exture reconstructs a dense sequence of this source-conditioned response through two stages. Stage 1 estimates the unobserved source-off passive state at each active instant from neighboring passive frames to obtain reliable differential texture anchors. Stage 2 combines sparse anchors with passive structural context near each target time to reconstruct the dense sequence. On the simulated benchmark, T$^2$exture adds only 0.20M parameters to AMT-L while improving PSNR by 6.66 dB. Extensive evaluations on simulated and real acquisitions further show clearer texture recovery and stronger structural preservation than representative VFI baselines. These results establish T$^2$exture as a practical framework for thermal texture imaging under sparse active acquisition.

AI.tldr: T²exture是一个稀疏扰动热纹理成像框架，通过少量主动照明关键帧和密集被动帧，重建时间密集的热纹理序列。该方法在AMT-L基础上仅增加0.20M参数，PSNR提升6.66 dB，在模拟和真实采集上均优于代表性VFI基线。
AI.motivation: 被动长波红外（LWIR）测量虽然在不同光照条件下有效，但往往缺乏精细纹理。现有热纹理成像方法依赖光谱传感或配准的辅助模态，存在数据吞吐量大或跨模态退化脆弱性的问题。
AI.method: T²exture采用两阶段框架：第1阶段从相邻被动帧估计每个主动时刻未观测的源关被动状态，获得可靠的差分纹理锚点；第2阶段结合稀疏锚点与目标时刻附近的被动结构上下文，重建密集的热纹理序列。热纹理被定义为源开观测与其对应源关被动状态的残差。
AI.result: 在模拟基准上，T²exture仅增加0.20M参数至AMT-L，PSNR提升6.66 dB。在模拟和真实采集上的广泛评估显示，其纹理恢复更清晰、结构保留更强，优于代表性VFI基线。
AI.conclusion: T²exture被确立为一种在稀疏主动采集下进行热纹理成像的实用框架，能够在少量主动扰动下有效恢复热纹理细节。

title: RSC-GestureNet: Reliability-Aware Selective Causal Recognition of Chinese Traffic Police Gestures
summary: Traffic police gestures are safety-critical perception cues for autonomous driving. A deployable recognizer must infer commands causally from continuous full-frame video, remain stable around transitional arm motion, and avoid over-trusting corrupted pose measurements. This study presents RSC-GestureNet, a reliability-aware selective causal recognizer, for Chinese traffic police gestures. The model treats pose confidence as a first-class signal: unreliable joints are down weighted during graph reasoning, temporal evidence is aggregated causally, and calibrated predictions are selectively emitted through a reliability-aware inference rule. We further introduce CTPGesture-C, a reproducible feature-level corruption benchmark with seven pose/RGB degradation families, and an RGB-level diagnostic in which corrupted frames are reprocessed by MediaPipe before recognition. On the complete official CTPGesture v1 split (134,424 labeled frames and 33,451 causal windows), RSC-GestureNet achieves 93.33+-0.24% accuracy, 91.71+-0.27% macro-F1, 91.69+-0.29% online macro-F1, 98.80+-0.07% Early@10, 0.153+-0.013 s TTC, and the best robust macro-F1 among evaluated methods. Under the same split and causal protocol, it exceeds reproduced traffic-specific MD-GCN and HLP-GCN baselines by 3.23-4.11 macro-F1 points and 2.15-3.07 online-F1 points. These results, together with calibration, selective-risk, statistical, adaptive-branching, and image-level re-extraction analyses, indicate that explicit pose-reliability modeling improves early, stable, and robust traffic-command recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSC-GestureNet，一种面向中国交通警察手势的可靠性感知选择性因果识别器，通过将姿态置信度作为一等信号、因果时序聚合和可靠性感知推理规则，在完整官方CTPGesture v1分割上实现93.33%准确率，并优于多个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 交通警察手势是自动驾驶中安全关键的感知线索。可部署的识别器必须从连续全帧视频中有因果关系地推断指令，在过渡性手臂动作中保持稳定，并避免过度信任被损坏的姿态测量。现有方法未显式建模姿态可靠性，导致在姿态退化场景下识别不稳定。
AI.method: RSC-GestureNet将姿态置信度作为一等信号：在图上推理中对不可靠关节点降低权重；因果地聚合时序证据；通过可靠性感知推理规则选择性发射校准后的预测。同时引入CTPGesture-C，一个可复现的特征级损坏基准，包含七种姿态/RGB退化族，以及RGB级诊断（损坏帧经MediaPipe重新处理后再识别）。
AI.result: 在完整官方CTPGesture v1分割（134,424标注帧和33,451个因果窗口）上，RSC-GestureNet达到93.33±0.24%准确率、91.71±0.27%宏F1、91.69±0.29%在线宏F1、98.80±0.07% Early@10、0.153±0.013秒TTC，以及最优鲁棒宏F1。相比复现的MD-GCN和HLP-GCN基线，宏F1提升3.23-4.11点，在线F1提升2.15-3.07点。
AI.conclusion: 校准、选择性风险、统计、自适应分支和图像级重提取分析表明，显式姿态可靠性建模改善了早期、稳定且鲁棒的交通指令识别，证明可靠性感知方法对安全关键手势识别任务具有显著价值。

title: CLEAR: Conflict-aware Learning via Evidence-guided Adaptive Routing for Unified Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Super-Resolution
summary: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Super-resolution is highly challenging since the sparse and low-resolution (LR) inputs lack sufficient geometric and high-frequency information for accurate reconstruction. To achieve high-quality reconstruction, existing sparse-view super-resolution methods adhere to two-stage pipeline that performs LR Gaussian reconstruction and then high-resolution (HR) Gaussian refinement, which directly results in stage-wise Gaussian transfer and reconstruction error accumulation. To this end, we propose CLEAR, a Conflict-aware Learning via Evidence-guided Adaptive Routing, as the first unified single-stage framework for Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Super-resolution. Specifically, CLEAR performs joint the optimization of authentic LR observations and external HR priors within a unified Gaussian representation. To mitigate the gradient conflicts introduced by sparse supervision during training, we propose a Gaussian-wise conflict-aware optimization strategy that regards the LR gradient as a reliable anchor and applies evidence-conditioned soft correction only to severe HR conflicts. Moreover, to recover high-frequency details, we introduce an evidence-guided Patch-to-Gaussian routing mechanism which estimates patch reliability and detail demand, lifts them into Gaussian space, and selectively routes high-frequency gradients and densification. Finally, we employ shared Gaussian dropout and a detached mid-training anchoring to enhance the robustness of training framework. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world $4\times$ super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that CLEAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and superior geometric fidelity.

AI.tldr: CLEAR是一个统一的单阶段框架，用于稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅超分辨率重建，通过证据引导的自适应路由和冲突感知优化策略，联合优化真实LR观测和外部HR先验，在合成与真实基准上实现了最先进的渲染质量和几何保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏视角超分辨率方法采用两阶段流程（先LR高斯重建，再HR高斯细化），导致阶段间高斯传递和误差累积。稀疏的低分辨率输入缺乏足够的几何和高频信息，需要更统一高效的框架来解决。
AI.method: 1) 提出统一的单阶段框架，在统一的高斯表示中联合优化真实LR观测和外部HR先验；2) 高斯级冲突感知优化策略，以LR梯度为可靠锚点，仅对严重HR冲突应用证据条件软校正；3) 证据引导的Patch-to-Gaussian路由机制，估计patch可靠性和细节需求，选择性地路由高频梯度和致密化；4) 共享高斯dropout和分离的中期训练锚定增强训练鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界的4倍超分辨率基准上，CLEAR始终达到最先进的渲染质量和优越的几何保真度。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR通过单阶段统一框架有效解决了稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅超分辨率中的误差累积和梯度冲突问题，验证了证据引导路由和冲突感知优化的有效性。

title: Self-supervised DXA representations encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability
summary: Whole-body dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) scans are routinely acquired to measure bone density and regional body composition, leaving their spatial structure largely unused. Here, we show that self-supervised learning (SSL) can convert raw DXA images into representations of systemic health. We introduce LeDXA, a vision model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns by predicting latent representations rather than reconstructing pixels. Trained from scratch on 11,540 unlabeled Human Phenotype Project scans, LeDXA was evaluated internally and on 47,400 external UK Biobank (UKBB) scans. It improved cross-cohort prediction of prevalent diseases and biomarkers beyond scanner-derived DXA measurements and DINOv3, a state-of-the-art general-purpose model, despite approximately 150,000-fold fewer training images and nearly 40-fold fewer parameters. Over a median 4.3-year UKBB follow-up, LeDXA improved incident disease prediction over tabular DXA measures, with the largest gains for hip and knee arthrosis and type 2 diabetes. For hip arthrosis, 66% of incident cases occurred in the highest-risk quartile versus 41% for tabular measures. Its representations predicted chronological age externally (r = 0.88; mean absolute error = 2.90 years), and the biological-age gap tracked broader disease burden and a 45% higher mortality hazard in the oldest-appearing quartile. The gap also decreased in women after starting hormone-replacement therapy, suggesting it may be modifiable. Genome-wide associations recovered mostly known body-composition and bone-density loci, and LeDXA embeddings were more heritable than DINOv3's. These findings reveal prognostic information in DXA images that conventional readouts discard, learnable with relatively little data and modest compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LeDXA，一种基于JEPA架构的自监督视觉模型，仅用11,540张无标注全身DXA扫描图像训练，即可将DXA图像转化为系统性健康表征。LeDXA在47,400张外部UK Biobank扫描上超越了传统DXA表格测量和DINOv3（尽管训练数据少约15万倍、参数少约40倍），在疾病预测、生物年龄估计、全基因组关联分析等多个任务中表现优异，揭示了DXA图像中以往被忽视的丰富预后信息。
AI.motivation: 全身DXA扫描常规用于测量骨密度和区域身体成分，但其空间结构信息基本未被利用。作者希望证明自监督学习能够从这些大规模、低成本、常规获取但未被充分利用的医学影像中提取系统性健康信息。
AI.method: LeDXA采用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），通过预测潜在表示而非重建像素进行学习。模型在11,540张来自Human Phenotype Project的无标注DXA图像上从头训练，并在47,400张外部UK Biobank扫描上进行评估。
AI.result: LeDXA在跨队列疾病和生物标志物预测中优于DXA表格测量和DINOv3（尽管训练数据少约15万倍、参数少近40倍）。在4.3年中位随访期内显著改善突发事件预测（髋/膝骨关节炎和2型糖尿病增益最大）。年龄预测r=0.88，MAE=2.90年；生物学年龄差距与疾病负担和45%更高的死亡风险相关；HRT后差距减小。GWAS恢复已知位点，嵌入遗传力高于DINOv3。
