AI.conclusion: DXA图像中包含传统测量指标丢弃的丰富预后信息，通过自监督学习仅需相对少量数据和适度计算即可提取。LeDXA表征可能具有可干预性（如HRT可减小生物学年龄差距），为个性化健康监测和疾病风险预测提供了新途径。

title: VARPose: Flexible 2D Pose Densification via Visual Autoregressive Modeling for Enhanced 3D Lifting
summary: Visual AutoRegressive Modeling (VAR) has excelled in natural image generation via next-scale prediction, but its use on topology-structured data like human skeletons is still unexplored. VARPose is proposed to adaptively densify 2D sparse poses, thereby enriching the anatomical information available for 3D lifting models. Our core contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a Granularity-agnostic Pose Tokenizer (GPT), which employs a single hybrid codebook and a residual quantization strategy to encode poses of varying densities into a unified, multi-scale discrete representation. Our results demonstrate the strong generalizability of this representation. By decoupling the representation from the projection, we can successfully decode novel pose granularities using a frozen codebook with a retrained decoder. Second, we propose UniSkelar, a unified autoregressive model that treats "joint density" as "scale". UniSkelar learns to predict the token sequence for the next density level in a coarse-to-fine manner, conditioned on the sparsest pose. VARPose not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods and generalizes to unseen granularities, but also confers tangible performance gains on downstream tasks, such as 3D Pose Estimation and Human Mesh Recovery, through 2D pose densification. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/VARPose.git.

AI.tldr: VARPose将视觉自回归建模（VAR）的"下一尺度预测"思想扩展到人体骨架这类拓扑结构数据上，通过自适应稠化稀疏2D姿态来增强3D提升模型可用的解剖信息。
AI.motivation: VAR在自然图像生成中表现优异，但尚未被探索用于人体骨架等拓扑结构数据；同时稀疏2D姿态缺少解剖信息，限制了3D姿态估计等下游任务的性能。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) Granularity-agnostic Pose Tokenizer (GPT)，采用单一混合码本结合残差量化策略，将不同密度的姿态编码为统一的多尺度离散表示；(2) UniSkelar，一个统一的自回归模型，将"关节密度"视为"尺度"，以粗到细的方式学习预测下一密度级别的token序列，以最稀疏的姿态为条件。
AI.result: VARPose在2D姿态稠密化任务上优于现有SOTA方法，能泛化到未见过的姿态粒度，并在下游任务（3D姿态估计、人体网格恢复）中通过2D姿态稠密化带来实质性性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将表示（codebook）与投影（解码器）解耦，VARPose展示了强泛化能力，即使用冻结码本也能解码新的姿态粒度；该工作为离散表示与自回归建模在结构数据上的应用开辟了新方向。

title: Local Margin Restoration for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities, yet their performance frequently degrades sharply under unexpected test-time distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising solution, continuously adapting VLMs over an unlabeled test stream presents fundamental challenges. Conventional top-1-centric updates often reinforce errors by corrupting the local semantic geometry among related classes, while iterative adaptation exacerbates progressive bias accumulation, ultimately driving the model toward mode collapse. To overcome these coupled vulnerabilities, we propose Local Margin Restoration (LMR), a lightweight, one-step TTA framework. At the sample level, our Protected Margin Restoration (PMR) objective recovers local semantic geometry by shielding plausible near-top candidates from external hard negatives. Concurrently, to combat stream-level degradation, we introduce a dual-stage stabilization mechanism, featuring an Adaptive Margin (AM) controller and Bias Correction (BC), to dynamically disrupt progressive bias accumulation and prevent mode collapse. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-C, ImageNet-C, and ImageNet variants demonstrate that LMR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA baselines, proving exceptionally robust and efficient even in challenging low-batch test-time regimes. Our code is available at https://github.com/DennisHuangYan/LMR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LMR（Local Margin Restoration），一种轻量级单步测试时自适应（TTA）框架，用于解决视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在测试时分布偏移下的性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言模型在零样本场景表现优异，但面对意外的测试时分布偏移时性能急剧下降。虽然TTA是解决方案，但现有方法存在两大耦合问题：1）top-1为中心的更新会因强化错误而破坏相关类别间的局部语义几何结构；2）迭代自适应会加剧渐进性偏差积累，最终导致模式坍缩。
AI.method: LMR框架包含两个核心组件：1）样本级别：Protected Margin Restoration (PMR)目标函数，通过保护可能接近top-k的候选类别免受外部硬负样本干扰，恢复局部语义几何结构；2）流级别：双阶段稳定机制，包括自适应边际（AM）控制器和偏差修正（BC），动态打破渐进性偏差积累并防止模式坍缩。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-C、ImageNet-C和ImageNet变体上的大量实验表明，LMR在多个基准上持续优于最先进的TTA基线，即使在小批次（low-batch）测试时场景下也展现出极强的鲁棒性和高效性。
AI.conclusion: LMR通过同时解决样本级别的局部语义几何破坏和流级别的渐进偏差积累问题，为VLM在测试时分布偏移下提供了一种高效、鲁棒的自适应方案，代码已开源。

title: VC-Tooler: Learning Compositional and Adaptive Visual Tool Use
summary: Agentic multimodal reasoning extends passive image understanding by allowing VLMs to actively acquire and refine visual evidence through visual tool interactions. Effective visual tool use requires three capabilities: grounding tool calls in visual context, composing tools across multiple steps, and adapting reasoning to tool-returned observations. However, existing approaches largely focus on grounding within fixed tool spaces and rigid invocation patterns, leaving composition and adaptation insufficiently addressed. We present VC-Tooler, which learns visual tool use as a compositional and adaptive capability. To this end, we first build a trajectory bank through a hierarchical synthesis pipeline covering three capability levels: single-tool grounding, multi-tool composition, and diverse tool contexts and interfaces. We then train the model in two stages: a supervised cold start that establishes these capabilities, followed by reinforcement learning that encourages accurate, efficient, and context-aware visual tool use. VC-Tooler achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on both general-purpose and agentic benchmarks, including $95.8\%$ on V* and $35.3\%$ on VTC-Bench, and shows promising transfer under richer tool settings at inference time. Project page: https://w1zheng.github.io/VC-Tooler

AI.tldr: VC-Tooler是一个将视觉工具使用学习为组合式和自适应能力的框架，通过分层合成管道构建轨迹库，并采用监督冷启动加强化学习的两阶段训练，使VLM能够进行多步骤的工具组合和上下文感知推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体多模态推理方法主要局限于固定工具空间和刚性调用模式，未能充分解决工具组合使用和根据工具返回结果进行自适应推理的问题。作者认为有效的视觉工具使用需要三种能力：在视觉上下文中进行工具调用接地、跨多步骤组合工具、以及根据工具返回的观察调整推理策略，但现有方法对此覆盖不足。
AI.method: VC-Tooler的训练分为两个关键部分：(1) 通过分层合成管道构建轨迹库，覆盖三个能力层级：单一工具接地、多工具组合、多样化工具上下文和接口；(2) 两阶段训练：先进行监督冷启动以建立基础能力，再通过强化学习鼓励准确、高效且上下文感知的视觉工具使用。
AI.result: VC-Tooler在通用和智能体基准上均取得了开源模型中的最优性能，包括V*基准上95.8%和VTC-Bench上35.3%的准确率，并在推理时更丰富的工具设置下展现出良好的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉工具使用建模为组合且自适应能力的方法（结合分层轨迹合成与两阶段训练）能显著提升VLM的智能体多模态推理性能，并具备在更复杂工具环境下泛化的潜力。

title: GenPrior: Unleashing Text-to-Motion Generative Priors for Zero-Shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition
summary: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition (ZSAR) aims to recognize unseen action categories by aligning skeleton features with textual semantics. However, existing methods rely on text-derived prototypes that inherently lack geometric structure and physical constraints, resulting in a pronounced \textit{semantic-kinematic gap}. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{GenPrior}, the first framework to exploit generative priors from pre-trained Text-to-Motion (T2M) models for ZSAR. Specifically, we introduce Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion, which distills kinematic prototypes and intra-class dispersion from generative motion sequences and employs a learned gating network to adaptively inject reliable structural cues into textual embeddings while suppressing synthetic artifacts. Furthermore, we propose Generative Prototype Refinement, which leverages these generation-enhanced prototypes as anchors to mine high-confidence unseen samples, calibrating class prototypes toward the true distribution and thereby unleashing strong performance gains. Extensive experiments on NTU-60, NTU-120, and PKU-MMD demonstrate that GenPrior achieves state-of-the-art performance under both zero-shot and generalized zero-shot settings. Code is available at https://github.com/jidongkuang/GenPrior.

AI.tldr: GenPrior 是首个利用预训练文本到运动（T2M）模型的生成先验来解决零样本骨架动作识别（ZSAR）中"语义-运动学鸿沟"问题的框架。通过 Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion 蒸馏运动学原型与类内离散度，并用门控网络自适应注入结构线索；再通过 Generative Prototype Refinement 利用生成增强原型作为锚点挖掘高置信度未见样本，校准类别原型。在 NTU-60、NTU-120 和 PKU-MMD 上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 ZSAR 方法依赖文本派生原型，这些原型本质上缺乏几何结构和物理约束，导致明显的"语义-运动学鸿沟"，限制了识别未见动作类别的能力。
AI.method: 1) Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion：从生成运动序列中蒸馏运动学原型和类内离散度，通过可学习的门控网络将可靠结构线索自适应注入文本嵌入，同时抑制合成伪影。2) Generative Prototype Refinement：以生成增强原型为锚点，挖掘高置信度的未见样本，校准类别原型使其逼近真实分布。
AI.result: 在 NTU-60、NTU-120 和 PKU-MMD 三个数据集上，GenPrior 在零样本和广义零样本设置下均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用 T2M 模型的生成先验能有效弥合语义与运动学之间的鸿沟，为 ZSAR 提供了一条利用生成模型中嵌入的结构化运动知识的新路径。

title: HarMoE: Multi-Source Chest Radiograph Pretraining with Dataset-Disentangled Experts
summary: Recent vision-language models for chest X-ray understanding are largely built on image-report alignment and therefore rely heavily on MIMIC-CXR as the dominant pretraining source. While effective at scale, this paradigm underexplores an important alternative source of supervision: a range of existing multi-label classification datasets, which provide cleaner and more explicit disease signals than free-text reports, and can offer broader pathology coverage when combined across sources. However, learning from such heterogeneous datasets is nontrivial, as differences in label ontologies, annotation protocols, acquisition pipelines, and report styles can cause models to entangle clinical semantics with dataset identity, leading to poor transfer despite increased scale. In this work, we revisit radiology VLM construction from the perspective of harmonized multi-source learning. We propose HarMoE, a dataset-aware mixture-of-experts framework that learns shared cross-dataset medical semantics while confining source-specific variation to lightweight residual experts in deeper decoder layers. To further exploit clean supervision from labeled datasets, we train in a unified disease vocabulary with masked multi-dataset supervision, enabling the model to leverage complementary annotations without introducing false negatives. Experiments on large-scale chest X-ray benchmarks show that HarMoE consistently improves zero-shot classification, out-of-distribution transfer, and grounding over strong baselines. Our results suggest that building robust radiology VLMs requires moving beyond single-source image-report alignment toward structured knowledge construction from heterogeneous datasets with cleaner supervision and broader coverage. Code and the 873k harmonized dataset will be released at https://github.com/Roypic/harmoe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HarMoE，一个数据集感知的混合专家框架，用于从异构多标签分类数据集中学习统一的放射学视觉语言模型。该方法通过将共享医学语义与数据集特定的残留专家分离，并采用统一疾病词表的掩码多数据集监督训练，在胸部X射线基准上显著提升了零样本分类、分布外迁移和定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的胸部X射线视觉语言模型主要依赖 MIMIC-CXR 的图像-报告对齐进行预训练，忽略了多标签分类数据集这一更清洁、更明确且覆盖更广的监督信号来源。然而，异构数据集之间的标签本体、标注协议和采集流程差异会导致模型将临床语义与数据集身份纠缠，损害迁移能力。因此需要一种能够从异构数据源中学习共享医学语义的方法。
AI.method: 提出 HarMoE（Harmonized Mixture-of-Experts）框架：1）采用数据集感知的混合专家架构，在较深的解码器层中学习共享的跨数据集医学语义，同时将数据集特定的变异限制在轻量级残差专家中；2）在统一的疾病词表下进行掩码多数据集监督训练，使模型能够利用互补的标注信息而不引入假阴性。
AI.result: 在大规模胸部X射线基准上的实验表明，HarMoE 在零样本分类、分布外迁移和定位任务上均一致优于强基线方法。此外，作者发布了 873k 的协调化数据集。
AI.conclusion: 构建稳健的放射学视觉语言模型需要超越单一来源的图像-报告对齐范式，转向从异构数据集中进行结构化知识构建，以利用更清洁的监督信号和更广泛的病理覆盖。

title: Open-Set Visual Text Forensics via Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow
summary: Rapidly evolving Generative AI enables sophisticated visual text manipulations that increasingly evade current forensic detectors. Existing discriminative models often overfit specific forgery patterns, limiting their generalization to unseen, open-set attacks. To address this challenge, we propose a generative detector that localizes tampering by estimating the local restoration cost required to align a query image with authentic visual-text statistics, rather than by learning forgery-specific decision boundaries. Specifically, we introduce Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow (SC-RF), a detector-oriented adaptation of Flow Matching for spatially sparse anomaly localization. We further mitigate data scarcity via self-supervised Artifact Injection and preserve high-frequency forensic traces using a pixel-space Forensic-DiT. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing the runner-up by 3.2 and 4.8 percentage points in F1 and IoU, respectively. In particular, the proposed detector demonstrates strong zero-shot performance on challenging unseen text editing patterns. We further provide an auxiliary stress-test analysis showing that local harmonization produced by our model can weaken the statistical cues relied upon by existing detectors, offering a complementary vulnerability-analysis perspective.

AI.tldr: 提出SC-RF（Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow）生成式检测器，通过估计局部修复成本而非学习伪造特定决策边界，实现对视觉文本篡改的定位检测，在F1和IoU上分别超越第二名3.2和4.8个百分点，并对未见过的编辑模式展现出强大的零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 现有判别式取证检测器容易过拟合特定伪造模式，难以泛化到未知的开集攻击。随着生成式AI驱动的视觉文本篡改日益复杂，需要一种不依赖特定伪造模式学习的通用检测方法。
AI.method: 提出生成式检测框架：(1) 引入SC-RF（Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow），一种面向检测任务的Flow Matching适配，用于空间稀疏异常定位；(2) 通过自监督Artifact Injection缓解数据稀缺问题；(3) 使用像素空间的Forensic-DiT保留高频取证痕迹。核心思想是估计将查询图像与真实视觉文本统计对齐所需的局部修复成本来定位篡改区域。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的实验达到SOTA，F1和IoU分别超过第二名3.2和4.8个百分点。在未见过的文本编辑模式上展现出强零样本性能。额外压力测试表明模型生成的局部协调可以削弱现有检测器依赖的统计线索。
AI.conclusion: 生成式检测方法凭借修复成本估计，在泛化性和零样本能力上优于传统判别式方法，同时提供了互补的脆弱性分析视角，有助于理解现有检测器的局限。

title: EOVSAM: Efficient Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with SAM 3 in One Pass
summary: Open-vocabulary segmentation identifies and segments objects from arbitrary textual descriptions. SAM 3 supports noun-phrase-guided segmentation and achieves competitive open-vocabulary performance through exhaustive vocabulary traversal, yet suffers from prohibitive computational overhead as target categories scale. In this paper, we propose an Efficient Open-Vocabulary segmentation framework with SAM 3 (EOVSAM), which adapts SAM 3 for single-pass prediction. EOVSAM removes prompt conditioning to turn SAM 3 into an efficient mask generator and introduces a new Attentional Aggregation strategy to optimize open-vocabulary classification end-to-end. This formulation avoids the multi-stage pipelines and post-processing heuristics commonly used by existing methods, while mitigating the closed-set collapse that can arise when classification is optimized directly. EOVSAM consistently improves segmentation accuracy over vanilla SAM 3 on all evaluated datasets and accelerates inference by up to 338$\times$. Furthermore, EOVSAM maintains high accuracy at lower resolutions while achieving even more remarkable inference speeds. Experiments on standard semantic and panoptic segmentation benchmarks show that EOVSAM combines competitive or state-of-the-art accuracy with a substantial speed advantage over existing open-vocabulary segmentation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/EOVSAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EOVSAM框架，将SAM 3改造为高效的开集分割模型。通过去除提示条件使其成为高效的掩码生成器，并引入注意力聚合策略端到端优化开集分类，避免了多阶段流程和后处理启发式方法。EOVSAM在所有评估数据集上一致提升分割精度，推理速度最高提升338倍，并在低分辨率下保持高精度同时获得更快的推理速度。
AI.motivation: SAM 3支持名词短语引导分割并具有竞争力的开集性能，但依赖穷举词汇遍历，随着目标类别数量增加，计算开销巨大且难以承受。现有方法通常需要多阶段流程和后处理启发式方法，效率低下且缺乏端到端优化。
AI.method: 1) 去除SAM 3中的提示条件（prompt conditioning），将其改造为高效的单次前向掩码生成器；2) 提出新的注意力聚合（Attentional Aggregation）策略，端到端优化开集分类，缓解直接优化分类时可能出现的闭集坍缩问题。
AI.result: EOVSAM在所有评估数据集上较原始SAM 3一致提升分割精度，推理速度最高提升338倍；在低分辨率下仍保持高精度并实现更快的推理速度；在标准语义和全景分割基准上达到竞争力或最先进的精度，同时具备显著的推理速度优势。
AI.conclusion: EOVSAM通过重新设计SAM 3的架构和训练策略，在保持或提升开集分割精度的同时，大幅提升了推理效率，为开集分割提供了兼顾精度与速度的有效方案。

title: Sen-Cap: Sensor-Flexible and Noise-Resilient Human Motion Capture via LiDAR-Camera Integration
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ECCV 2026. Aoru Xue and Yujing Sun contributed equally. Yuexin Ma is the corresponding author
summary: We propose Sen-Cap, a Sensor-Flexible and Noise-Resilient 3D human motion Capture framework that integrates multi-modal data from LiDAR and camera. While multi-modal sensors provide richer information than single-modal sensors, existing approaches still suffer from two core challenges. First, multi-modal alignment/matching across arbitrarily deployed sensors is typically handled by explicit calibration, which propagates errors under changing viewpoints and in turn constrains deployment to fixed, highly overlapped layouts. Second, prior methods degrade under severe noise or partial sensor failures, which are common in real-world environments. To address these challenges, Sen-Cap introduces a Unified Across-Sensor Motion Estimator that reconstructs local pose and shape in a human-centric space without calibrations between sensors, supporting a flexible number of sensors, as well as a Noise-Resistant Trajectory Tracker that maintains robustness under severe point cloud noise through iterative refinement. These sensor-flexible and noise-resilient features make Sen-Cap more practical in real-world deployment. Notably, operating in real time, Sen-Cap achieves state-of-the-art performance on major metrics on Human-M3 and FreeMotion, as well as strong cross-domain performance on LiDARHuman26M and RELI11D. This combination of flexibility and robustness opens new opportunities for motion capture in real-world scenarios, e.g. sports analytics, field robotics, and large-scale immersive environments.

AI.tldr: Sen-Cap是一个传感器灵活且抗噪声的3D人体运动捕捉框架，融合LiDAR和摄像头多模态数据。它通过统一跨传感器运动估计器在无标定情况下重建人体姿态和形状，并通过抗噪声轨迹追踪器在严重点云噪声下保持鲁棒性。在Human-M3和FreeMotion上达到SOTA性能，在LiDARHuman26M和RELI11D上表现强跨域性能，且支持实时运行。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态传感器融合方法面临两大核心挑战：1）跨传感器对齐/匹配通常依赖显式标定，在视点变化时传播误差，且只能部署在固定、高度重叠的布局中；2）现有方法在严重噪声或部分传感器故障（现实环境常见）下性能显著退化。这些问题严重限制了多模态运动捕捉在真实场景中的实用性和部署灵活性。
AI.method: Sen-Cap包含两个核心组件：1）Unified Across-Sensor Motion Estimator——在人居中空间中重建局部姿态和形状，无需传感器间标定，支持灵活数量的传感器；2）Noise-Resistant Trajectory Tracker——通过迭代精化在严重点云噪声下保持鲁棒性。
AI.result: Sen-Cap在Human-M3和FreeMotion数据集的主要指标上达到最先进水平，在LiDARHuman26M和RELI11D上表现出强大的跨域性能，且支持实时运行。
AI.conclusion: Sen-Cap通过传感器灵活性和抗噪声能力相结合，为现实场景（如体育分析、野外机器人、大规模沉浸式环境）中的运动捕捉开辟了新机遇，使多模态运动捕捉在实际部署中更加实用。

title: SpikeRestormer: Towards Energy-Efficient All-in-One Image Restoration via Unified Event Reasoning
summary: ANN-based All-in-One image restoration (AiOIR) unifies diverse degradation handling but incurs high computational costs, limiting its real-time deployment. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a low-power alternative, applying them to static images remains challenging. This difficulty arises because explicit event signals are absent, and degradation cues are heavily entangled with scene structures, hindering the learning of reliable restoration-oriented spike events. To address these issues, we propose SpikeRestormer, an energy-efficient SNN for AiOIR that performs event reasoning over internally generated spike cues. Specifically, we propose a degradation-event perception process to extract spike-based degradation events through Subtractive Degradation Event Attention (SDEA). Moreover, we introduce Hierarchical Bayesian Skip Masking (HBSM) and Additive Restoration Event Attention (AREA) processes for event-reliability inference and restoration-event construction, respectively. By integrating these complementary processes, SpikeRestormer formulates restoration as a unified process of degradation-event perception, degradation-event reliability inference, and restoration-event construction, liberating the potential of SNNs for energy-efficient AiOIR. Extensive experiments show that SpikeRestormer delivers competitive performance against ANN-based methods and establishes new state-of-the-art results among SNN-based methods with significantly lower energy consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpikeRestormer，一种基于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的节能型全合一图像复原（AiOIR）方法。通过内部生成退化事件线索进行事件推理，解决了SNN在静态图像上应用时缺乏显式事件信号和退化线索与场景结构纠缠的难题，在保持低功耗的同时取得了与ANN方法相竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于ANN的全合一图像复原方法统一处理多种退化但计算成本高，难以实时部署。SNN作为低功耗替代方案，在静态图像上应用面临两大挑战：缺乏显式事件信号，以及退化线索与场景结构高度纠缠，导致难以学习可靠的复原导向脉冲事件。
AI.method: 提出三种关键机制：(1) 退化事件感知过程（SDEA：减法退化事件注意力）用于提取基于脉冲的退化事件；(2) 层次贝叶斯跳跃掩蔽（HBSM）用于事件可靠性推断；(3) 加法复原事件注意力（AREA）用于复原事件构建。通过整合这些互补过程，将复原形式化为退化事件感知、退化事件可靠性推断和复原事件构建的统一流程。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SpikeRestormer在性能上与基于ANN的方法相当，并在基于SNN的方法中建立了新的最先进结果，同时能耗显著更低。
AI.conclusion: SpikeRestormer成功释放了SNN在节能型全合一图像复原中的潜力，为低功耗实时图像复原提供了可行路径。

title: A General-Purpose VLM Can Teach an Astronomy Foundation Model to Better Recognize Galaxy Morphology
summary: Existing astronomy foundation models provide strong galaxy representations, but adapting them to new survey conditions and survey-specific morphology recognition tasks still requires substantial human supervision. We show that VLM-based VQA systems contain meaningful visual-semantic priors that can serve as weak supervision for downstream morphology classifiers and improve morphology classification under limited human-label budgets. We first introduce a survey-oriented VQA benchmark spanning two representative imaging regimes and evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs on galaxy morphology questions. The results show that these models capture useful morphology signals and informative uncertainty, but are not sufficiently reliable to replace human annotators. Motivated by this finding, we use a general-purpose VLM as a morphology teacher for Zoobot, an astronomy foundation model pretrained on large-scale Galaxy Zoo annotations. Across two survey domains and multiple annotation budgets, the VLM teacher consistently improves Zoobot's downstream morphology classification. These results demonstrate that a general-purpose VLM provides knowledge complementary to an astronomy foundation model and can teach it to better recognize galaxy morphology under limited human supervision. The resulting pipeline is designed for label-efficient adaptation to forthcoming large-scale surveys, including the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) and the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. The benchmark and code are publicly available at https://github.com/fw-ic/VLM-morphology-teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用通用视觉语言模型(VLM)作为弱监督教师，为天文基础模型(Zoobot)提供形态学知识，在有限的标注预算下显著提升星系形态分类性能，并配套发布了面向巡天任务的VQA基准数据集和代码。
AI.motivation: 现有的天文学基础模型虽然能提供强大的星系表征，但将其适配到新的巡天条件和特定形态学识别任务时，仍然需要大量人工标注监督。作者希望探索VLM中蕴含的视觉-语义先验知识，以在有限人工标注预算下提升形态学分类性能，降低对昂贵人工标注的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 构建了一个覆盖两种成像体制的巡天导向VQA基准，评估SOTA VLM在星系形态学问题上的表现；2) 将通用VLM作为形态学"教师"，采用知识蒸馏的方式为Zoobot（基于大规模Galaxy Zoo标注预训练的天文基础模型）提供弱监督信号；3) 在两个巡天领域和多种标注预算设置下系统评估该教师-学生管道。
AI.result: 实验表明VLM能够捕获有用的形态学信号和有效的不确定性信息，但尚不足以完全替代人工标注。然而，将VLM作为教师教授Zoobot后，在两个巡天领域和多种标注预算下均一致性地提升了Zoobot的下游形态学分类性能，证明VLM提供的知识与天文基础模型互补。
AI.conclusion: 通用VLM可以为天文学基础模型提供补充性的形态学知识，使得在有限人工监督下更好地识别星系形态。该管道专为即将到来的大规模巡天项目（如LSST和Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope）设计，具备良好的标签效率拓展性。

title: CalibBEV: LiDAR-Camera Calibration via BEV Alignment
summary: We present CalibBEV, a novel Bird's Eye View (BEV) alignment approach for LiDAR-camera calibration. Our method unifies LiDAR and camera data into a shared 3D spatial representation, enabling accurate and robust cross-modal calibration. CalibBEV extracts sensor-wise BEV features from each modality using domain-specific architectures and estimates the calibration matrix through a two-step alignment process. First, we perform an implicit alignment by regressing a coarse calibration matrix directly from the BEV features. To ease this alignment, we enforce semantic consistency between BEV representations across modalities using a contrastive loss inspired by CLIP, guiding both networks toward a unified feature space. In the second step, we leverage our BEV formulation to explicitly align the features of one modality with the other, refining the initial coarse estimate into a final, more accurate calibration matrix. CalibBEV significantly outperforms prior point-to-pixel matching methods, achieving state-of-the-art calibration accuracy. On the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks, our method reduces the Relative Rotation Error (RRE) by 51% and 68%, and the Relative Translation Error (RTE) by 80% and 91%, respectively, compared to previous methods.

AI.tldr: CalibBEV是一种新颖的鸟瞰图（BEV）对齐方法，用于LiDAR-相机标定。该方法将LiDAR和相机数据统一到共享的3D空间表示中，通过两阶段对齐过程（粗回归+精调优）估计标定矩阵，并在KITTI和nuScenes基准上大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: LiDAR-相机标定是自动驾驶系统中的关键任务，但现有基于点对像素匹配的方法在跨模态对齐上存在精度不足和鲁棒性差的问题，需要更有效的标定方案。
AI.method: CalibBEV包含两个步骤：1）隐式对齐——通过对比损失（受CLIP启发）强制两个模态的BEV特征在语义上一致，直接从BEV特征回归粗标定矩阵；2）显式对齐——利用BEV公式将一个模态的特征与另一个模态对齐，将粗估计细化为更精确的标定矩阵。
AI.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，相比先前方法，相对旋转误差（RRE）分别降低了51%和68%，相对平移误差（RTE）分别降低了80%和91%，达到最先进的标定精度。
AI.conclusion: CalibBEV通过统一的BEV空间表示和两阶段对齐策略，显著提升了LiDAR-相机标定的精度和鲁棒性，验证了BEV表示在跨模态对齐任务中的有效性。

title: GEOID-Flood: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Benchmark Dataset for Flood Segmentation
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 - Terrabytes II Workshop, 23 pages
summary: Geospatial foundation models aim to learn representations that transfer across regions and sensors, yet evaluating them on specific tasks requires large, high-quality, multi-modal benchmarks that measure how well such models extract value from data. Concerning flood mapping, existing datasets rarely combine bi-temporal SAR and co-registered optical imagery at scale, leaving the value of foundation models for this downstream task largely untested. We introduce GEOID-Flood, a large-scale multi-modal flood segmentation benchmark, derived from Copernicus Emergency Management Service activations, spanning 219 events across 65 countries over ten years. The dataset provides more than 14,000 tiles with co-registered pre- and post-event Sentinel-1, in GRD and RTC format, pre-event Sentinel-2 composite, and DEM, including manually validated labels that separate background from permanent water and flooded water. Using this benchmark, we evaluate foundation models against conventional encoders across single-image, multi-temporal, and multi-modal protocols. We report three main findings: foundation models offer a consistent but modest advantage; optical-SAR fusion with finetuning best resolves transient flooding; and models trained on GEOID-Flood transfer to unseen events better than those trained on existing datasets. Dataset and code available at https://github.com/links-ads/geoid-flood.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEOID-Flood，一个大规模多模态洪水分割基准数据集，基于Copernicus应急管理服务数据，涵盖65个国家219个事件、超14000个瓦片，包含双时相SAR（GRD和RTC格式）、灾前光学影像、DEM及人工验证标签。评估显示基础模型优势有限但稳定，光学-SAR融合微调最佳，且在该数据集上训练的模型迁移能力更强。
AI.motivation: 现有的洪水制图数据集很少在规模上将双时相SAR与配准的光学影像结合起来，导致地理空间基础模型在该下游任务上的价值未被充分测试。缺乏大规模、高质量、多模态的基准来衡量基础模型提取数据价值的能力。
AI.method: 构建GEOID-Flood基准数据集，包含灾前灾后Sentinel-1（GRD和RTC格式）、灾前Sentinel-2合成影像、DEM，以及区分背景/永久水体/洪水的标注。在该基准上，对基础模型与传统编码器在单图、多时相、多模态协议下进行比较评估。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：1）基础模型相比传统编码器有一致但适度的优势；2）光学-SAR融合加微调最能解决瞬时洪水识别问题；3）在GEOID-Flood上训练的模型在未见事件上的迁移效果优于在现有数据集上训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: GEOID-Flood填补了洪水制图领域大规模多模态基准的空白，表明基础模型在洪水分割中提供了稳定但有限的增益，且多模态融合策略和高质量数据集对提升迁移能力至关重要。数据集和代码已开源。

title: Global-Scale Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Learning for NDVI Time-Series Reconstruction
summary: Accurate and efficient reconstruction of cloud-contaminated and noise-corrupted NDVI time series remains a challenge in remote sensing. Deep learning provides a promising solution for modeling complex spatiotemporal dependencies; however, its application is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining paired clear-sky and degraded NDVI data for identical spatiotemporal locations. To address this issue, we propose GloSSR, a Global-scale Self-supervised Spatiotemporal framework for NDVI Reconstruction. The framework constructs supervisory signals by artificially degrading relatively clean NDVI observations with realistic cloud contamination patterns, producing self-supervised training pairs that closely mimic real-world degradation. It further introduces an end-to-end spatiotemporal learning network that jointly captures long-range temporal dependencies and short-term spatiotemporal correlation through a bidirectional Transformer with a ConvLSTM architecture. A temporal-channel attention-based reconstruction module is incorporated to enhance informative features, while a spatiotemporal prior constraint is designed to preserve both fine-scale structures and long-term phenological trends during optimization. Extensive evaluations on MODIS NDVI data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework across both artificial and real-world scenarios. In artificial degraded-pixel reconstruction experiments, GloSSR consistently outperforms the comparison methods. Time-series analyses based on real observations further demonstrate that the proposed framework can accurately characterize vegetation dynamics and capture the key phenological states. Long-term vegetation trend analysis and the transferability analysis to AVHRR data validate the scalability of the framework and illustrate its broad applicability for large-scale environmental monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出GloSSR，一个全球尺度的自监督时空框架，用于NDVI时间序列重建。通过人为降解干净的NDVI观测数据并配合真实云污染模式构造自监督训练对，结合双向Transformer与ConvLSTM的端到端时空学习网络，以及时间-通道注意力和时空先验约束，在MODIS和AVHRR数据上验证了其有效性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 云污染和噪声导致的NDVI时间序列不完整是遥感领域的长期挑战。虽然深度学习能建模复杂的时空依赖，但训练需要同一时空位置上成对的"清晰天空"与"退化"NDVI数据，这种配对数据在实际中极难获取，限制了深度学习方法的应用。
AI.method: 提出GloSSR框架：(1)通过人为降解相对干净的NDVI观测数据，并引入真实云污染模式来构造自监督训练对，模拟真实退化过程；(2)设计端到端时空学习网络，结合双向Transformer捕获长程时间依赖和ConvLSTM捕获短期时空相关性；(3)引入基于时间-通道注意力的重建模块增强信息特征；(4)设计时空先验约束在优化过程中保持细粒度结构和长期物候趋势。
AI.result: 在MODIS NDVI数据上的人工退化像素重建实验中，GloSSR一致优于对比方法。基于真实观测的时间序列分析表明其能准确刻画植被动态并捕获关键物候状态。长期植被趋势分析和向AVHRR数据的迁移性分析验证了框架的可扩展性和大规模环境监测的广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: GloSSR通过自监督学习策略有效解决了配对数据难以获取的问题，在NDVI重建任务中表现出优越性能，且具备良好的跨传感器迁移能力，为大规模环境监测提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Implicit Neural Representations for Multimodal Longitudinal Image Imputation and Interpolation
summary: Longitudinal multiparametric MRI is central to follow-up imaging in oncology, yet real-world clinical data are characterised by missing sequences, heterogeneous acquisition protocols, and varying spatial resolutions across time points. We propose a patient-specific conditional implicit neural representation (INR) that models multimodal longitudinal MRI as a continuous function of world coordinates, time, and modality conditioning. The model is trained with stochastic modality dropout to handle incomplete data, and its continuous coordinate-space formulation enables both spatial and temporal interpolation without resampling to a fixed voxel grid. A self-consistency-based confidence estimator is derived from cross-modal reconstruction performance at inference time. We evaluate the framework on longitudinal MRI from paediatric brain tumour patients, demonstrating statistically significant improvements over linear interpolation for T1CE and FLAIR (p < 0.05), with mean MS-SSIM of 0.95 $\pm$ 0.02 for T1CE. Predicted confidence correlates strongly with true reconstruction quality (Pearson r up to 0.996), suggesting reliable deployment potential in heterogeneous clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种患者特定的条件隐式神经表示（INR）模型，将纵向多参数MRI建模为世界坐标、时间和模态条件的连续函数，通过随机模态dropout处理不完整数据，实现空间和时间插值，并基于交叉模态重建性能推导自一致性置信度估计器。在儿童脑肿瘤患者的纵向MRI上验证，优于线性插值方法。
AI.motivation: 真实临床场景中的纵向多参数MRI常面临序列缺失、采集协议异构和时间点空间分辨率不一致等问题，现有方法需要重采样到固定体素网格，难以有效处理这些异质性数据。
AI.method: 1) 构建患者特定的条件隐式神经表示（INR），将MRI建模为世界坐标、时间和模态的函数；2) 采用随机模态dropout训练处理不完整数据；3) 连续坐标空间公式支持空间和时间插值，无需重采样；4) 推导基于交叉模态重建性能的自一致性置信度估计器。
AI.result: 在儿童脑肿瘤患者纵向MRI上，T1CE和FLAIR显著优于线性插值（p<0.05），T1CE平均MS-SSIM达0.95±0.02；预测置信度与真实重建质量强相关（Pearson r最高0.996）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在异质性临床环境中具有可靠的部署潜力，能有效处理不完整的纵向多参数MRI数据。

title: Context-Aware Mixture of Domain Experts for Bodily Expression of Emotion in the Wild
comment: Submitted to "IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing"; 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. To facilitate reproducibility, the PyTorch implementation of CA-MoDE is publicly available at https://github.com/dehshibi/CA-MoDE
summary: The same body posture can convey entirely different emotions depending on its surrounding context, yet most methods for recognising bodily emotions treat scene and object cues as auxiliary feature augmentations rather than as structured priors over the plausibility of emotions. We introduce the Context-Aware Mixture of Domain Experts (CA-MoDE) for bodily emotion recognition. CA-MoDE incorporates dedicated scene and object experts to generate soft distributions over emotion categories conditioned on their respective domains. These domain-conditioned soft predictions serve as structured contextual priors that modulate the body expert's predictions at the distributional level rather than at the feature level. To fuse these multi-domain signals, we propose a task-tailored max-endorsement gating strategy that selects the strongest contextual signal across experts for each emotion dimension. Our gating strategy mitigates the signal dilution that typically occurs when conflicting or uninformative context distributions are averaged. CA-MoDE achieves an Emotion Recognition Score of 0.3269 on the Body Language Database. By outperforming existing temporal models using only single still images, our framework demonstrates that explicitly modelling structured spatial context can serve as a complementary discriminative proxy for the behavioural dynamics typically captured by video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CA-MoDE（Context-Aware Mixture of Domain Experts）框架用于肢体情绪识别。该方法通过专门的场景专家和物体专家生成基于各自领域的情绪类别软分布，作为结构化的上下文先验，在分布层面而非特征层面调节身体专家的预测。采用任务定制的最大背书门控策略融合多领域信号，避免无关或冲突上下文分布平均化导致的信号稀释。在Body Language Database上取得0.3269的情绪识别分数，仅用单张静态图像就超过了现有的时序模型。
AI.motivation: 相同的身体姿态在不同场景下可以传达完全不同的情绪，但现有方法仅将场景和物体线索视为辅助特征增强，而非对情绪合理性的结构化先验。这忽略了上下文对情绪判断的根本性约束作用。
AI.method: 提出CA-MoDE框架：1) 专门的场景专家和物体专家分别生成基于各自领域条件的情绪类别软分布；2) 这些领域条件的软预测作为结构化上下文先验，在分布层面调制身体专家的预测；3) 提出最大背书门控（max-endorsement gating）策略，为每个情绪维度选择最强的上下文信号，避免平均化造成的信号稀释。
AI.result: 在Body Language Database上实现0.3269的Emotion Recognition Score，且仅使用单张静态图像就超越了现有的时序模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模结构化空间上下文可以作为一种互补的判别性代理，替代视频中通常捕获的行为动态信息，表明静态图像中的上下文建模对肢体情绪识别具有重要价值。

title: Loop-Mamba: A Loop Mamba with Degradation-Aware and Shared Memory for Old Photo Restoration
summary: Old photographs often suffer from multiple coupled degradations, including scratches, cracks, fading, blur, noise, and missing regions, severely degrading both visual quality and semantic content. We propose Loop-Mamba, a lightweight loop-based state-space framework that formulates old photo restoration as progressive state evolution, where a persis- tent restoration state is continuously propagated and refined through iterative computation. Specifically, we introduce a Semantic-Guided Degradation Estimator (SGDE) to explicitly model heterogeneous degradations by jointly predicting local degradation maps and global degradation scores, providing degradation-aware guidance for state evolution. We further develop a Shared Structural Memory Mamba (S$^2$M- Mamba), which maintains a persistent restoration state across iterations, enabling persistent state evolution through shared structural memory for robust long-range structural reconstruction. Benefiting from first-order state recursion, Loop-Mamba propagates latent restoration states through recurrent tran- sitions instead of repeatedly stacking deep feature transformations, thereby alleviating gradient dilution while avoiding the computational overhead inherent in iterative CNN- and Transformer-based restoration frameworks. A lightweight multi-directional scanning strategy further enhances direc- tional information aggregation and preserves structural continuity. To better evaluate restoration quality, we introduce the task-oriented Old Photo Damage Recovery Score (ODRS), which jointly measures degradation recovery and structural reconstruction fidelity. Experimental results on the public SynOld benchmark demonstrate that Loop-Mamba consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across both conventional restoration metrics and the proposed ODRS.

AI.tldr: Loop-Mamba是一个轻量级基于状态空间模型的旧照片修复框架，通过持续状态传播和迭代计算来渐进式修复老照片中的多重耦合退化（划痕、裂纹、褪色、模糊、噪声和缺失区域）。它引入语义引导退化估计器和共享结构记忆Mamba模块，并提出了新的评估指标ODRS。
AI.motivation: 旧照片往往同时遭受多种耦合退化（划痕、裂纹、褪色、模糊、噪声、缺失区域），严重损害视觉质量和语义内容。现有基于CNN和Transformer的迭代修复框架存在计算开销大、梯度稀释等问题，亟需一种更高效且能保持结构连续性的修复方法。
AI.method: 1) 将旧照片修复建模为渐进式状态演化过程，通过循环转换传播潜在修复状态，而非反复堆叠深层特征变换；2) 提出语义引导退化估计器（SGDE），联合预测局部退化图和全局退化分数，提供退化感知的状态演化指导；3) 开发共享结构记忆Mamba（S²M-Mamba），在迭代间维持持久修复状态，利用共享结构记忆实现鲁棒的长距离结构重建；4) 采用轻量级多方向扫描策略增强方向信息聚合；5) 提出面向任务的旧照片损伤恢复评分（ODRS），联合衡量退化恢复和结构重建保真度。
AI.result: 在公共SynOld基准上的实验表明，Loop-Mamba在传统修复指标和提出的ODRS指标上均持续优于此前的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Loop-Mamba通过状态空间模型的递归状态演化机制，在避免迭代框架计算开销的同时有效缓解了梯度稀释问题，为旧照片修复提供了一个轻量且高效的新范式。

title: GROVE: Growing and Reasoning over Temporally Stratified Memory from Streaming Video Experience
comment: 7 pages and 4 figures in the main paper
summary: A wearable assistant should both answer questions about its visual history and recognize when that history is useful to the present situation. Existing video-memory systems primarily support question-conditioned recall, whereas proactive assistants typically use separate memory and control mechanisms. We introduce GROVE, a training-free framework that supports both behaviors with one memory grown causally from a continuous video stream. GROVE retains fine-grained perceptual evidence and incrementally consolidates it into time-stamped moments, coherent episodes, and recurring cross-day patterns. Each stratum is paired with a scale-native retrieval skill for locating an observation, replaying an activity, or traversing long-range regularities. Reactive QA and proactive assistance share this memory and access interface, differing in whether retrieval is initiated by a user query or the current situation. Across multiple benchmarks including the challenging MM-lifelong and EgoServe, GROVE achieves the best results among the compared methods. Controlled ablations show that the temporal strata and their access skills are complementary, with patterns providing the largest benefit when evidence spans multiple days. Code will be available at https://github.com/SitongGong/GROVE.

AI.tldr: GROVE是一个无需训练的可穿戴助手记忆框架，通过从连续视频流中因果式生长记忆，同时支持反应式问答和主动式辅助，在MM-lifelong和EgoServe等基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频记忆系统主要支持问题条件式回忆，而主动式助手通常使用分离的记忆和控制机制。可穿戴助手需要同时具备回答视觉历史问题以及识别历史对当前情境有用性的能力，现有方法未能统一这两种行为。
AI.method: GROVE采用无需训练的框架，从连续视频流中因果式构建单一记忆系统。记忆包含三个层级：细粒度感知证据、带时间戳的时刻（moments）、连贯的情节（episodes）以及跨天的周期模式（patterns）。每个层级配备原生检索技能，分别用于定位观测、回放活动和遍历长期规律。反应式问答和主动式辅助共享同一记忆和访问接口，区别仅在于检索由用户查询还是当前情境触发。
AI.result: 在包括MM-lifelong和EgoServe等多个基准上，GROVE在对比方法中取得最佳结果。受控消融实验表明，时间层级和访问技能具有互补性，其中模式层在证据跨越多天时提供最大增益。
AI.conclusion: GROVE证明了统一的记忆架构可以同时支持反应式问答和主动式辅助，无需训练即可实现优越性能，为可穿戴智能助手的记忆系统设计提供了新的方向。

title: Does Explainability Transfer? A Controlled Benchmark of Attribution Methods on Vision Transformers and CNNs
summary: Most evidence on the effectiveness of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) attribution methods has been established on convolutional neural networks (CNNs), with limited investigation into whether these conclusions generalize to the diverse Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures that now dominate computer vision. This paper presents a controlled benchmark that evaluates attribution quality across five dimensions: faithfulness, localization, robustness, complexity, and computational cost. A standardized framework assesses 13 attribution methods from four algorithmic families on eight representative backbones spanning CNNs, isotropic ViTs, hierarchical transformers, hybrid architectures, and linear-attention transformers. The results show that attribution performance is strongly architecture-dependent and that rankings established on CNNs do not reliably transfer to transformer-based models. CAM-based methods achieve the highest scores under the conventional bounding-box localization metric on CNNs and most ViTs but perform poorly on linear-attention architectures. Pixel-level dense-mask evaluation further reveals that these gains largely reflect metric saturation rather than accurate localization. CAM-based methods also exhibit limited robustness on global-attention transformers, whereas attention rollout provides consistently stable explanations with poor localization. Furthermore, faithfulness correlation offers limited discrimination between attribution methods, highlighting the limitations of single-metric evaluation. These findings challenge prevailing conclusions on attribution performance and demonstrate the need for architecture-aware, multi-dimensional evaluation. The open-source code for the evaluation framework and benchmark results is available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/VIT_XAI_Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个受控基准测试，系统评估13种可解释AI（XAI）归因方法在8种代表性骨干网络（涵盖CNN、各类型ViT等）上的表现，涵盖忠实性、定位、鲁棒性、复杂性和计算成本五个维度。结果表明归因性能强烈依赖架构，基于CNN的结论不能可靠迁移到Transformer模型，CAM方法在传统定位指标上表现好但在线性注意力架构上差，且其优势部分来自指标饱和而非准确定位。
AI.motivation: 现有关于XAI归因方法有效性的证据大多基于CNN模型建立，但计算机视觉领域已被多样的Vision Transformer（ViT）架构所主导。这些基于CNN的结论是否适用于Transformer架构尚未得到充分验证，因此需要系统性地评估归因方法在各种ViT架构上的泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用标准化框架，从四个算法家族中选取13种归因方法，在8种代表性骨干网络（包括CNN、各向同性ViT、层次化Transformer、混合架构和线性注意力Transformer）上进行评估。评估覆盖五个维度：忠实性、定位、鲁棒性、复杂性和计算成本，并同时使用传统边界框定位指标和像素级密集掩膜评估。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）归因性能高度依赖架构，CNN上的排名不能可靠迁移到Transformer；2）CAM方法在CNN和多数ViT的传统边界框定位指标上得分最高，但在线性注意力架构上表现差；3）像素级密集掩膜评估揭示CAM方法的优势部分源于指标饱和而非准确定位；4）CAM方法在全局注意力Transformer上鲁棒性有限，而attention rollout提供稳定的解释但定位差；5）忠实性相关性在区分归因方法方面区分度有限。
AI.conclusion: 现有基于CNN的归因性能结论不能简单推广到ViT架构，研究强调了需要架构感知的、多维度的评估方法来评价XAI归因方法，并公开了评估框架和基准结果的代码。

title: USP-Mamba: Unmixing-Derived Spectral and Structural Prompting for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
summary: Hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to reconstruct high-resolution imagery while preserving dense spectral information. Recently, Mamba-based models have shown promising potential for this task by capturing long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. Nevertheless, their causal sequence modeling requires two-dimensional hyperspectral features to be unfolded along predefined scanning orders, which disrupts spatial adjacency and restricts the effective propagation of contextual information. Moreover, state-space parameterization of existing models is predominantly derived from generic learned representations, without explicit alignment with the intrinsic characteristics of the hyperspectral image. To address this issue, we propose an Unmixing-derived Spectral and Structural Prompting Mamba framework, termed USP-Mamba, which adapts Mamba state evolution through composition-aware spectral priors and image-dependent structural prompts. Specifically, an unmixing-informed spectral prompt captures the global material composition of the input image and provides persistent conditioning throughout reconstruction. Injected into the Mamba sequence and progressively adapted across layers, it steers state evolution toward composition-consistent reconstruction. We introduce feature-level structural prompts comprising spatial and frequency components to provide image-dependent local guidance. The spatial prompt promotes structure-sensitive state encoding for local detail preservation, while the frequency prompt enables region-adaptive transitions between homogeneous regions and high-frequency details. Finally, complementary Hilbert and Semantic-Guided Neighboring scans preserve spatial continuity and strengthen non-local semantic dependency modeling. Extensive experiments on different datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms representative approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出USP-Mamba框架，用于高光谱图像超分辨率。该框架通过解混衍生的光谱提示（捕获全局材料组成）和图像相关的结构提示（包含空间与频率成分），自适应地引导Mamba状态演化，并结合互补的Hilbert和语义引导的邻近扫描策略，在保持空间连续性的同时增强非局部语义依赖建模，实验证明其性能优于现有代表性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Mamba-based高光谱超分模型存在两个关键问题：(1)因式序列建模需将二维高光谱特征沿预定义扫描顺序展开，破坏了空间邻接性，限制了上下文信息的有效传播；(2)状态空间参数化多源于通用学习表示，未与高光谱图像的内在特性（如光谱组成）显式对齐。这两个缺陷制约了重建质量。
AI.method: 提出USP-Mamba框架，包含三个核心模块：(1)解混信息光谱提示：捕获输入图像的全局材料组成，在重建过程中提供持续性条件约束，注入Mamba序列并跨层渐进适应，引导状态演化朝向组成一致的重建。(2)特征级结构提示：包含空间提示（促进结构敏感的状态编码以保留局部细节）和频率提示（实现均匀区域与高频细节之间的区域自适应转换）。(3)互补扫描策略：Hilbert扫描保持空间连续性，语义引导的邻近扫描增强非局部语义依赖建模。
AI.result: 在不同数据集上的大量实验表明，USP-Mamba方法一致性地优于现有代表性高光谱超分辨率方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解混衍生的光谱先验和图像相关的结构提示显式对齐Mamba状态演化与高光谱图像的内在特征，并采用互补扫描策略兼顾空间与语义连续性，有效解决了现有Mamba模型在该任务中的空间破坏和状态参数化缺乏物理意义的问题。

title: Loggia dei Lanzi: AI Thermography Enhancement Comparisons through 3D Photogrammetry
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, to be presented at the 8th International Symposium on Cultural Heritage Conservation by Digitization (CHCD2026) in Beijing
summary: The Loggia dei Lanzi in the Piazza della Signoria is one of Florence's most prominent structures visited by millions every year. Its construction history spans multiple centuries of modification. This paper presents the results of a thermal imaging campaign conducted in December 2025, using a FLIR T1020 HD camera, revealing hidden architectural features including walled-up openings and material transitions beneath the plaster surface. The favorable winter ambient conditions provided a feature-rich benchmark upon which to compare the results of enhancement algorithms and artificial intelligence models. We evaluate the application of AI-based image enhancement to thermal heritage documentation through a comparison of three tiers of image resolution in a photogrammetric Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipeline: native resolution, FLIR's hardware-based pixel-shifted super-resolution (UltraMax), and state of the art AI-upscaled imagery models. We quantify the effect of each resolution tier on feature detection and tie-point generation, assessing whether the additional detail produced by super-resolution, whether hardware or AI-derived, translates into meaningfully denser and more accurate 3D thermal models. Our results contribute to the emerging intersection of artificial intelligence and heritage thermography by providing a direct comparison of hardware microscanning and AI super-resolution within a thermal photogrammetric workflow for cultural heritage. All datasets are made publicly available and accessible within an interactive 3D archival framework, and integrated into a custom citywide extended reality overlay application.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在佛罗伦萨佣兵凉廊（Loggia dei Lanzi）开展的热成像测绘研究，使用FLIR T1020 HD相机在2025年12月采集数据，通过对比原生分辨率、硬件超分辨率（UltraMax）和AI超分辨率三种图像层级在摄影测量SfM管线中的表现，评估了超分辨率技术对3D热模型质量和特征检测的影响。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产建筑的热成像检测是一个重要且不断发展的领域，但热成像图像分辨率有限，如何通过超分辨率技术提升热成像摄影测量的精度和3D模型密度，并评估AI技术与硬件技术在文化遗产热成像中的实际效果，是一个尚未充分研究的问题。
AI.method: 在冬季环境条件良好的12月，使用FLIR T1020 HD热成像相机对佣兵凉廊进行热成像采集，发现墙体隐藏特征。随后在摄影测量SfM（运动恢复结构）管线中对比三种分辨率级别：原生分辨率、FLIR硬件像素移位超分辨率（UltraMax）以及AI图像超分辨率模型，量化每种分辨率对特征检测和连接点生成的影响。
AI.result: 研究量化了不同分辨率层级对特征检测和连接点生成的效应，评估了硬件和AI超分辨率是否能够转化为更密集、更精确的3D热模型。所有数据集已公开，并提供交互式3D档案框架及城市级扩展现实（XR）覆盖应用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为人工智能与文化遗产热成像的交叉领域提供了直接对比硬件微扫描与AI超分辨率在热摄影测量工作流中效果的实证数据，展示了AI增强图像在热遗产文档记录中的应用潜力。

title: DF$^3$: World Modeling via Decoder-Free Feature Forecasting in Autonomous Navigation
summary: Forecasting future states from video sequences is a critical challenge for autonomous robotic systems and a fundamental objective of world modeling. Prior generative methods operating at the pixel level inevitably overemphasize task-irrelevant details, leading to prohibitive computational overhead. While latent-based approaches attempt to mitigate this by predicting features directly, the persistent reliance on heavy decoders for state-to-task mapping remains a computational bottleneck. In this work, we propose Decoder-Free Feature Forecasting (DF$^3$), a novel framework that models world evolution entirely within the latent space and directly derives task outputs, completely eliminating the need for a decoder. Specifically, DF$^3$ injects learnable spatial queries into the terminal blocks of a frozen vision foundation model to extract future state representations directly. By employing a lightweight, unified Motion-Aware Context Fusion (MACF) mechanism that seamlessly integrates coarse flow warping with fine-grained latent cross-correlation, these queries interact with historical token representations to explicitly align and forecast the feature of the next frame. Subsequently, a specialized set of task queries probes these forecasted features for the downstream task. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and zero-shot deployment in a robotic simulator demonstrate that DF$^3$ achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods while offering superior efficiency and flexibility for integrated perception and control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DF³框架，一种完全无解码器的潜在空间世界建模方法，通过冻结视觉基础模型和可学习空间查询直接预测未来特征并完成下游任务，在效率和灵活性上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频预测方法存在两大瓶颈：像素级生成方法过度关注任务无关细节导致计算开销过大；潜在空间方法虽预测特征但仍依赖重解码器进行状态到任务的映射，计算负担依然沉重。
AI.method: DF³框架完全在潜在空间中建模世界演化：1) 向冻结的视觉基础模型末端块注入可学习空间查询以提取未来状态表示；2) 采用轻量级Motion-Aware Context Fusion (MACF)机制，结合粗粒度光流扭曲与细粒度潜在互相关，使查询与历史token交互并对齐预测下一帧特征；3) 使用一组任务查询探测预测特征以完成下游任务，完全消除解码器。
AI.result: 在公开基准和机器人仿真器的零样本部署中，DF³达到与最先进方法相当的性能，同时在集成感知与控制的效率和灵活性方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: DF³验证了完全无解码器的潜在空间世界建模范式的可行性，通过消除解码器瓶颈实现了高效且灵活的感知-控制集成，为自主机器人系统的未来预测提供了新思路。

title: Learning to Tessellate: Point Cloud Generation via Recursive Spectral Partitioning
comment: Accepted by ECCV2026, project page: https://huggingface.co/Mo-nan/PointRSP
summary: Autoregressive models have emerged as an effective paradigm for point cloud generation. However, most existing approaches rely on heuristic tokenization strategies, such as spatial sorting or stochastic downsampling, which often disrupt intrinsic point cloud topology and weaken the structural coherence of the generated shapes. In this paper, we present PointRSP, an autoregressive framework that reformulates point cloud generation as a topology-preserving tessellation process via recursive spectral partitioning. Instead of constructing token sequences heuristically, we introduce a topology-aware partitioning autoencoder that decomposes an unstructured point cloud into a non-balanced binary tree through a hybrid recursive spectral partitioning strategy. This hierarchical representation provides a deterministic geometric blueprint that preserves topological relationships while capturing multiscale structural dependencies within a quantized latent space. To synthesize shapes in this space, we propose a dual-stream cascaded generator that jointly models structural evolution and feature synthesis. In addition, we design a geometry-calibrated positional encoding mechanism that anchors latent embeddings using multi-scale structural centers, which stabilizes cascaded generation during the early stages of structural formation. Extensive experiments show that PointRSP achieves state-of-the-art performance in generation quality and diversity, demonstrating strong generalization across complex 3D topologies.

AI.tldr: PointRSP是一个自回归点云生成框架，通过递归谱划分将点云生成重定义为保拓扑的镶嵌过程。它利用拓扑感知的划分自编码器构建非平衡二叉树层级表示，并采用双流级联生成器联合建模结构演化与特征合成，在生成质量和多样性上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归点云生成方法大多依赖启发式分词策略（如空间排序或随机下采样），这些方法会破坏点云的内在拓扑结构，削弱生成形状的结构连贯性。
AI.method: 1) 提出拓扑感知的划分自编码器，通过混合递归谱划分策略将无序点云分解为非平衡二叉树，保留拓扑关系并捕获多尺度结构依赖；2) 提出双流级联生成器，联合建模结构演化与特征合成；3) 设计几何校准的位置编码机制，利用多尺度结构中心锚定潜在嵌入，稳定早期级联生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PointRSP在生成质量和多样性方面达到最先进水平（SOTA），并在复杂3D拓扑上展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将点云生成重构为拓扑保持的层次化递归过程，PointRSP验证了拓扑感知的分词策略和双流级联生成范式在3D形状生成中的有效性。

title: InfiniSplat: Implicit Gaussian Decoding for Large-Baseline Monocular View Synthesis
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Journal Track). Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat
summary: Single-image feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to directly generate a renderable 3D scene representation from one input image, avoiding the cost of multi-view capture and per-scene optimization. However, existing methods are often constrained by a pixel-aligned representation, where Gaussians are predicted from fixed image-grid locations. Such pixel-aligned primitives can produce promising nearby-view renderings, but they remain weakly coupled to underlying scene surfaces and struggle to preserve coherent structures under large viewpoint shifts. We present InfiniSplat, a feed-forward single-image 3DGS framework that moves from a pixel-aligned representation toward a surface-aligned representation. InfiniSplat constructs this representation by first using geometry-guided sampling to place 2D supports according to depth-induced local surface structure, and then applying a query-conditioned implicit decoder to predict Gaussian attributes from the image features queried at these supports.By grounding support locations in geometry while decoupling Gaussian prediction from fixed pixel centers, InfiniSplat produces Gaussian layouts that better follow scene surfaces and reduce scattered primitives caused by grid discretization.Across multiple cross-dataset NVS evaluations, InfiniSplat achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with single-image feed-forward baselines, and demonstrates zero-shot generalization from Hypersim indoor synthetic training to complex open-world scenes.Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat.

AI.tldr: InfiniSplat 是一个前馈式单图像 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）框架，通过从像素对齐表示转向表面对齐表示来提升渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的单图像前馈 3DGS 方法受限于像素对齐表示，高斯原语从固定图像网格位置预测，与底层场景表面耦合弱，在大视角变化下难以保持连贯结构。
AI.method: 首先使用几何引导采样，根据深度诱导的局部表面结构放置 2D 支撑点；然后应用查询条件隐式解码器，在这些支撑点处从图像特征预测高斯属性。通过将支撑点位置锚定在几何上，同时将高斯预测与固定像素中心解耦。
AI.result: 在多个跨数据集新视角合成（NVS）评估中取得最先进性能，并展示了从 Hypersim 室内合成训练数据到复杂开放世界场景的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 表面对齐的表示比像素对齐表示更能捕捉场景表面结构，减少网格离散化导致的散射原语，从而在视角变化显著时生成更连贯的渲染结果。

title: UAV-Based Environmental Monitoring of Rip-Current Indicators Using Wavelet-Derived Texture Features
summary: Rip currents are recurrent coastal natural hazards that threaten beachgoers and create operational challenges for lifeguards and coastal managers. Reliable monitoring from standard RGB (red-green-blue) imagery acquired by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains difficult because hazardous channels often appear as subtle gaps in breaking waves, foam texture, or sediment patterns, and these signatures are affected by illumination, sea state, and environmental noise. This study presents a physically informed coastal environmental monitoring workflow for detecting visually expressed rip-current indicators that integrates wavelet-derived spatial-frequency texture features with deep learning. We evaluate multiple strategies for incorporating Discrete Wavelet Transform features into convolutional architectures, from computationally efficient channel replacement to dual-stream fusion with attention mechanisms. Performance is assessed against a standard RGB baseline using a task specific convolutional neural network for image-level presence classification and a YOLOv8 model for object-level localization. Under the evaluated dataset conditions, integrating wavelet derived texture features improves performance over RGB-only models. The dual-stream architecture achieves the strongest classification performance, exceeding 95% accuracy with high recall, while channel replacement is most effective for YOLOv8 object detection, reaching 94% mAP@50 for localization. Explainable artificial intelligence analyses provide qualitative evidence that the models attend to visually plausible wave-gap regions associated with rip currents. These results suggest that under the conditions of the evaluated dataset, physically informed wavelet integration may support UAV-based decision-support tools for interpretable beach-safety risk mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种物理信息驱动的海岸环境监测工作流，将小波变换提取的空间频率纹理特征与深度学习相结合，用于从无人机RGB影像中检测离岸流（rip currents）的视觉指示物。实验表明，小波纹理特征的集成优于纯RGB模型，双流注意力架构在图像级分类上达到95%以上准确率，通道替换策略在YOLOv8目标检测上达到94% mAP@50。
AI.motivation: 离岸流是常见的海岸自然灾害，威胁海滩游客安全并给救生员和海岸管理者带来运营挑战。然而，从无人机标准RGB影像中可靠监测离岸流十分困难，因为危险通道通常表现为波浪破碎、泡沫纹理或沉积物模式中的细微间隙，且这些信号易受光照、海况和环境噪声影响。因此需要更有效的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出物理信息驱动的海岸环境监测工作流，核心是将离散小波变换（DWT）衍生的空间频率纹理特征集成到卷积架构中。评估了多种集成策略：计算高效的通道替换法和带注意力机制的双流融合法。使用图像级卷积神经网络进行存在性分类，以及YOLOv8模型进行目标级定位，并与标准RGB基线对比。
AI.result: 在评估数据集条件下，集成小波纹理特征优于纯RGB模型。双流架构在分类任务上表现最佳，准确率超过95%且召回率高；通道替换策略在YOLOv8目标检测中最为有效，达到94% mAP@50的定位性能。可解释AI分析定性证明模型关注与离岸流相关的视觉合理波浪间隙区域。
AI.conclusion: 在评估数据集条件下，物理信息驱动的小波集成方法可能为无人机海岸安全决策支持工具提供可解释的风险缓解方案，有助于海滩安全风险管理。

title: MoRAL: Sensor-Grounded BEV Reasoning for Compact VLMs toward Edge-Oriented Autonomous Driving
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 14th IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Mobile Computing (IEEE IMC 2026), Fukuoka, Japan, July 27-30, 2026
summary: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) for safety-critical spatial reasoning on resource-constrained autonomous driving platforms requires both compact model size and reliable metric grounding. We present MoRAL (Multimodal Reasoning for Autonomous Language Models), a two-stage fine-tuning pipeline that teaches Cosmos-Reason2-2B to first read a physics-encoded Bird's Eye View (BEV) representation and then reason over it for driving decisions. The BEV image encodes LiDAR metric distance as color bands, object class as cluster morphology, and radar Doppler velocity as directional wedge overlays, externalizing spatial perception into the input image so that no learned 3D backbone is required at inference. Stage 1 fine-tunes the vision encoder on 60,000 grounding records; zero-shot baselines produce no parseable BEV outputs, confirming the vocabulary requires explicit training. Stage 2 fine-tunes the full model (52M parameters, 2.4% of total) on 57,696 chain-of-thought records generated by Cosmos-Reason2-8B as teacher, spanning eight driving question types. On 2,304 held-out nuScenes frames evaluated by Gemma 4 (31B) calibrated against human review, MoRAL wins seven of eight question types over a zero-shot 8B baseline despite using four times fewer parameters, with the largest margins on question types requiring structured multi-step physics reasoning. Emergency braking recall improves from 10.8% to 47.8%, output degeneration falls from 94.1% to 20.8%, and the full pipeline fits a consumer 8 GB GPU at 42 tok/s without quantization. These results establish a reproducible foundation for compact, physics-grounded VLM reasoning on mobile edge platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoRAL，一个两阶段微调流水线，用于在资源受限的自动驾驶平台上部署视觉语言模型进行安全关键的空间推理。通过将LiDAR距离、物体类别和雷达多普勒速度编码为BEV图像的物理信息，并用教师模型生成的思维链数据进行微调，MoRAL仅用5200万参数（总参数的2.4%）就超越了零样本80亿参数的基线模型，在8项驾驶问题类型中赢得7项，紧急刹车召回率从10.8%提升至47.8%，且能在消费级8GB GPU上以42 tok/s运行。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的自动驾驶平台上部署VLM进行安全关键的空间推理，需要同时满足模型体积紧凑和度量接地（metric grounding）可靠的要求。现有VLM缺乏物理空间感知能力，且纯零样本方式无法解析BEV图像中的编码信息。
AI.method: MoRAL采用两阶段微调流水线：(1) 第一阶段在60,000条接地记录上微调视觉编码器，教会模型读取物理编码的BEV表示（LiDAR距离用色带编码、物体类别用聚类形态、雷达多普勒速度用方向楔形覆盖层）；(2) 第二阶段使用Cosmos-Reason2-8B作为教师生成的57,696条思维链记录微调完整模型（仅52M参数，占总量2.4%），涵盖八种驾驶问题类型。
AI.result: 在2,304个留出的nuScenes帧上评估，MoRAL在8种问题类型中7种胜过零样本80亿参数基线（Gemma 4 31B校准），参数少4倍。紧急刹车召回率从10.8%提升至47.8%，输出退化从94.1%降至20.8%，完整流程在8GB消费级GPU上以42 tok/s运行且无需量化。
AI.conclusion: MoRAL证明通过将空间感知外部化为BEV图像编码并进行显式两阶段微调，可以在紧凑模型尺寸下实现物理接地的VLM推理，为移动边缘平台上的可复现、物理基础的VLM推理建立了坚实基础。

title: ISRS-DETR: Detection-Guided Click Propagation for Remote Sensing Interactive Segmentation
summary: Interactive segmentation reduces the prohibitive cost of pixel-level annotation by allowing users to delineate objects with a few clicks. However, applying this paradigm directly to remote sensing imagery is non-trivial: ultra-high resolutions, small object sizes, and sparse spatial distributions all degrade segmentation quality. Recent work has addressed the resolution barrier and achieved competitive results in interactive segmentation for remote sensing (ISRS). However, they treat all instances of a class within an image as a single objective target. Consequently, interactions spent on one object contribute nothing to its same-class neighbours, and satisfactory masks may demand up to 40 clicks per image, hindering the practicality of these frameworks. We observe that remote sensing scenes exhibit markedly strong inter-object correlation, meaning a single clicked object is highly informative about the rest of its category. Building on this, we propose ISRS-DETR, a detection-guided interactive segmentation framework that injects object-level evidence into both training and inference. Our ISRS-DETR employs an RF-DETR decoder with the interactive segmentation backbone to localise co-occurring same-class objects, and introduces a Dynamic Top-K Click Selection strategy that retains only reliable proposals and converts each into a simulated click, so one user interaction propagates across an entire class. Experiments on three standard remote sensing benchmarks show that ISRS-DETR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while substantially reducing Number of Clicks per Image (NoC-I). All codes and data splits will be released for reproducibility upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ISRS-DETR，一个检测引导的交互式分割框架，通过注入目标级证据并利用动态Top-K点击选择策略，将单次用户交互传播到整个类别，在三个遥感基准上实现SOTA精度并显著减少每张图像的点击次数。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式遥感分割（ISRS）方法将所有同类实例视为单一目标，导致对某一目标的操作对同类别邻居无贡献，每张图像可能需要多达40次点击，实用性不足。作者观察到遥感场景中目标间存在强相关性，单个点击目标对其同类具有高度信息量，因此希望通过利用这种相关性来减少点击次数。
AI.method: 1）提出ISRS-DETR框架，在训练和推理阶段都注入目标级证据；2）采用RF-DETR解码器结合交互式分割骨干网络，用于定位共现的同类目标；3）提出动态Top-K点击选择策略，仅保留可靠的目标提议并将其转换为模拟点击，使一次用户交互能够传播到整个类别。
AI.result: 在三个标准遥感基准数据集上，ISRS-DETR实现了最先进的精度，同时显著减少了每张图像的点击次数（NoC-I）。
AI.conclusion: ISRS-DETR通过利用遥感场景中同类目标间的强相关性，成功将单次交互传播到整类目标，大幅提升交互式遥感分割的实用性，且代码和数据集将开源发布。

title: Calibrated Similarity and Graph Clustering for Open-Set Animal Re-Identification
summary: AnimalCLEF26 addresses discovery-oriented animal re-identification, where systems must both attach query images to known individuals and discover unseen individuals by clustering them correctly. We present a similarity-to-clustering pipeline for this setting across Eurasian lynx, fire salamander, loggerhead sea turtle, and Texas horned lizard images. The method first isolates the target specimen using segmentation and then applies lightweight species-specific preprocessing for lynx, sea turtle, and salamander images to enhance identity-relevant visual cues, while Texas horned lizard images are used after segmentation only. Pairwise similarities are then estimated with WildFusion by calibrating and combining a MiewID global descriptor with two local matching branches, ALIKED + LightGlue and DISK + LightGlue. The resulting query-query similarities are refined and converted into identity clusters using graph-based clustering, while query-database similarities are used to attach confident samples to known identities. We evaluate training-free and fine-tuned MiewID variants, including Dynamic ArcFace and SphereFace2-Focal adaptations, and combine them in the final ensemble. Our selected ensemble substantially improves on the WildFusion baseline, achieving the best public ARI of 0.72124 and a private ARI of 0.70393, while a simpler preprocessing-before-calibration variant achieves the best private ARI of 0.71087. These results indicate that calibrated global-local fusion with species-aware preprocessing choices is effective for open-set wildlife re-identification under challenging field conditions and visual variation. The implementation code is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于AnimalCLEF26动物再识别挑战的"相似度到聚类"流水线，通过分割、物种特定预处理、全局与局部特征融合（WildFusion）以及图聚类，同时完成已知个体匹配和未知个体发现。该方案在公开ARI上达到0.72124，私有ARI达到0.70393，显著优于WildFusion基线。
AI.motivation: 动物再识别面临开放集问题，系统不仅要将查询图像匹配到已知个体，还需要通过聚类发现未见过的新个体。现有方法在野外条件下面对物种间视觉差异和挑战性环境时性能有限，需要更有效的全球-局部特征融合和物种感知的处理策略。
AI.method: 流水线包括四个关键步骤：(1) 使用分割技术隔离目标标本；(2) 对猞猁、海龟和蝾螈图像进行轻量级物种特定预处理以增强身份相关视觉线索，德克萨斯角蜥仅用分割结果；(3) 使用WildFusion估计成对相似度，将MiewID全局描述符与两个局部匹配分支（ALIKED+LightGlue和DISK+LightGlue）结合并进行校准；(4) 通过基于图的聚类将查询-查询相似度转化为身份聚类，利用查询-数据库相似度将置信样本关联到已知个体。同时评估了无训练和微调MiewID变体（Dynamic ArcFace、SphereFace2-Focal），并在最终集成中组合。
AI.result: 所选集成方案大幅优于WildFusion基线，公开ARI达到0.72124（最佳），私有ARI达到0.70393；一个更简单的先预处理后校准的变体实现了最佳私有ARI 0.71087。
AI.conclusion: 校准的全局-局部融合加上物种感知的预处理策略在开放集野生动物再识别的挑战性野外条件下是有效的，多个描述符变体的集成进一步提升了性能。

title: Grounding Agentic VLMs with Dedicated Segmentation for Fine-Grained Vehicle Damage Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as reasoning agents in real-world visual assessment pipelines, yet their spatial grounding remains unreliable for fine-grained, visually ambiguous targets. We study this gap in the context of automated vehicle damage assessment, where fine-grained defects such as scratches and hairline cracks occupy few pixels, produce weak gradient signal, and are easily confused with reflections and surface texture. We show that a state-of-the-art VLM (Qwen-VL) achieves strong semantic classification accuracy (87.3%) on this task but is systematically ungrounded at the spatial level: it hallucinates damage in reflective regions, misses elongated scratches entirely, and produces spatially inconsistent outputs when prompted for localization. We propose TinyDamage, a hybrid architecture that delegates spatial grounding to a dedicated multi-task segmentation model while reserving the VLM for semantic reasoning and report generation. On the segmentation side, we find that the choice of loss function has an outsized and underexplored effect on tiny-object grounding: focal loss, widely used for class imbalance, collapses tiny-damage detection to zero, while a supervised contrastive objective measurably improves damage/background separability. We integrate the segmentation model into a 7-node LangGraph agent pipeline that grounds every VLM generation step in the segmentation output, and show that this grounding reduces the report hallucination rate from 92% (text-only) and 78% (image-only) to 31% in a controlled evaluation on 100 human-verified reports. We introduce DET_l, a permissive per-category detection metric for evaluating tiny-object grounding under class imbalance, and report latency and reliability characteristics of the deployed pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在细粒度空间定位上的不可靠问题，提出TinyDamage混合架构——将空间定位任务委托给专门的多任务分割模型，VLM只负责语义推理和报告生成。通过监督对比学习损失改善微小损伤分割，并集成到7节点LangGraph智能体管道中，将报告幻觉率从92%（纯文本）和78%（纯图像）降至31%。
AI.motivation: VLM在真实视觉评估任务中日益被用作推理智能体，但其对细粒度、视觉模糊目标的空间定位不可靠。在车辆损伤评估场景中，划痕和发丝裂纹等微小缺陷仅占极少像素、梯度信号弱、易与反光和表面纹理混淆，VLM虽能达到高语义分类精度但系统性缺乏空间定位能力（在反光区域幻觉损伤、漏检细长划痕）。
AI.method: 提出TinyDamage混合架构：(1) 空间定位委托给专用多任务分割模型，VLM仅负责语义推理和报告生成；(2) 对比了focal loss（在微小损伤检测上完全失效）与监督对比学习目标（提升损伤/背景可分性）；(3) 集成到7节点LangGraph智能体管道，每个VLM生成步骤都基于分割输出进行接地；(4) 提出DET_l指标，用于类不平衡下微小目标定位的逐类别宽松检测评估。
AI.result: Qwen-VL在车辆损伤语义分类上达到87.3%准确率但空间定位系统性地不接地。TinyDamage管道将报告幻觉率从纯文本的92%和纯图像的78%降低到31%，在100个人工验证报告上进行受控评估。同时报告了部署管道的延迟和可靠性特征。
AI.conclusion: 在微小目标定位任务中，损失函数的选择对分割效果有被低估的重大影响——focal loss会完全崩溃，而监督对比学习显著改善性能。通过将空间定位与语义推理解耦（VLM+专用分割模型+智能体管道），可以有效降低VLM在细粒度视觉评估中的幻觉率。

title: Action-grounded tissue affordance enables anticipatory auto-framing that lowers surgeon cognitive workload during laparoscopic surgery
comment: Preprint. 54 pages, including supplementary information and 7 main figures
summary: Computational attention models could help surgeons manage the visual demands of laparoscopy, but they require dense spatial labels that are difficult to obtain because surgical intent is highly specialized and tacit. Here, we introduce DiffeoAfford, an action-grounded tissue affordance framework that retrospectively derives visual attention supervision from completed surgical procedures. By combining diffeomorphism-constrained tissue tracking with instrument trajectory analysis, DiffeoAfford generates affordance hotspot labels without manual per-frame annotation. A real-time prediction model trained on these labels anticipates relevant surgical regions and enables AffordView, an assistive auto-framing system for laparoscopic visualization. The proposed framework aligns with expert annotations and intraoperative surgeon gaze, and reduces surgeon cognitive workload during real-world evaluations using subjective, physiological, and behavioral measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffeoAfford，一个基于动作的腹腔镜组织可供性框架，通过微分同胚约束的组织追踪与器械轨迹分析，从已完成手术中回顾性生成视觉注意力监督标签，无需人工逐帧标注。基于此标签训练实时预测模型，并构建AffordView辅助自动取景系统，在真实评估中与专家标注和术者注视一致，并降低术者认知负荷。
AI.motivation: 计算注意力模型有望帮助外科医生管理腹腔镜手术中的视觉需求，但训练这类模型需要密集的空间标签，而这些标签难以获取，因为手术意图高度专业化且具有隐性知识特性。
AI.method: 1) 结合微分同胚约束的组织追踪与器械轨迹分析，从已完成手术中回顾性生成可供性热点标签，无需人工逐帧标注。2) 在这些标签上训练实时预测模型，用于预判相关手术区域。3) 基于该预测模型构建AffordView辅助自动取景系统，用于腹腔镜可视化。
AI.result: 该框架与专家标注和术中外科医生注视方向一致；在真实场景评估中，通过主观问卷、生理指标和行为指标验证，能够降低外科医生的认知工作量。
AI.conclusion: DiffeoAfford展示了一种无需人工密集标注即可学习手术视觉注意力的可行路径，并通过自动取景系统在实际手术评估中有效减轻了外科医生的认知负担。

title: EchoCache: Energy-Guided Cross-Modal Caching for Efficient Audio-Driven Video Generation
comment: EchoCache is honored to be accepted by ACM MM 2026
summary: Audio-driven video generation (A2V) has achieved promising progress in synthesizing temporally coherent and audio-visually aligned videos, yet its inference remains expensive due to the iterative denoising process of diffusion models. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy in visual features while overlooking the cross-modal alignment of A2V, where audio drives visual generation with highly non-uniform temporal importance. In this paper, we identify two levels of misalignment in existing A2V caching methods: temporal-semantic and computation-storage misalignment. To address them, we propose EchoCache, an energy-guided cross-modal caching framework for efficient A2V generation. EchoCache leverages audio time-frequency energy as a saliency anchor to guide latent-level cache updates and further introduces a dynamic timestep-latent caching mechanism with quantized cache management for joint efficiency and memory optimization. Extensive experiments on mainstream A2V models show that EchoCache consistently improves the latency-quality trade-off while preserving generation quality and audio-visual consistency. In particular, on Wan2.2-S2V over the EMTD benchmark, EchoCache achieves a 2.46x speedup with the best overall performance. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/EchoCache.

AI.tldr: EchoCache是一个面向音频驱动视频生成（A2V）的高效缓存框架，通过音频时频能量作为显著性锚点引导潜在空间缓存更新，并引入动态时间步-潜在缓存机制，在保持生成质量和音视频一致性的前提下，实现了2.46倍加速。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动视频生成虽然取得了进展，但由于扩散模型的迭代去噪过程，推理成本高昂。现有缓存方法主要利用视觉特征的时间冗余，却忽视了A2V中音频驱动视觉生成这一跨模态对齐特性，其中音频的时间重要性高度非均匀，导致现有缓存方法存在时间-语义错配和计算-存储错配两个层面的问题。
AI.method: EchoCache提出能量引导的跨模态缓存框架，包含两个核心机制：1）利用音频时频能量作为显著性锚点来指导潜在级别的缓存更新，使缓存策略与音频的时间重要性对齐；2）引入动态时间步-潜在缓存机制，结合量化缓存管理，同时优化计算效率和内存使用。
AI.result: 在主流A2V模型上的大量实验表明，EchoCache持续改善了延迟-质量权衡，同时保持了生成质量和音视频一致性。在Wan2.2-S2V模型的EMTD基准上，EchoCache实现了2.46倍加速并取得了最佳的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: EchoCache通过利用音频能量信息作为跨模态显著性引导，有效解决了A2V缓存中的两层次错配问题，实现了高效的音频驱动视频生成，代码已开源。

title: Fermat Active Laplace Learning for Semi-Supervised Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Two active learning algorithms for hyperspectral image (HSI) classification are proposed that combine density-aware Fermat distances with Poisson-reweighted harmonic label propagation. Our methods actively query points using an uncertainty-based acquisition function, extending Poisson ReWeighted Laplace Learning (PWLL). Our first algorithm, Fermat Active Laplace Learning (FALL), builds an affinity matrix using Fermat distances between all data points. Then, PWLL is run with a diagonal perturbation using the minimum-norm acquisition function. In contrast, Approximate FALL (A-FALL) computes Fermat distances between each data point and landmark pixels selected via farthest-point sampling and constructs the affinity matrix using landmark multidimensional scaling. After several query rounds, A-FALL selects the Fermat exponent $p$ using a leave-one-out cross-validation variant. FALL and A-FALL leverage Fermat distances and subsequent harmonic label propagation to provide a density-aware estimation of the data manifold, improving labeling accuracy. Experiments on Salinas A and Pavia show the effectiveness of FALL and the scalability of A-FALL to large HSI scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种结合密度感知Fermat距离与Poisson重加权调和标签传播的高光谱图像(HSI)分类主动学习算法：FALL和其近似版本A-FALL，通过不确定性驱动的查询函数提升标注精度，并在Salinas A和Pavia数据集上验证了有效性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像分类面临标注样本稀缺的挑战，现有主动学习方法在密度感知和数据流形建模方面存在不足，需要一种能够适应数据几何结构、同时具备可扩展性的分类方法。
AI.method: 方法基于Poisson ReWeighted Laplace Learning (PWLL)框架扩展。FALL算法利用Fermat距离构建亲和矩阵，并使用最小范数采集函数进行对角线扰动；A-FALL通过最远点采样选取地标像素，利用地标多维缩放构建亲和矩阵以降低计算复杂度，并通过留一交叉验证在若干轮查询后选择最优Fermat指数p。
AI.result: 在Salinas A和Pavia数据集上的实验表明，FALL能有效提升标注精度，而A-FALL在保持较好性能的同时可扩展到大规模高光谱图像场景。
AI.conclusion: Fermat距离与调和标签传播的结合为HSI分类提供了密度感知的流形估计方法，A-FALL在地标采样策略下实现了计算效率与分类准确率的良好平衡。

title: DyFrDet: Towards Accurate Small Object Detection via Dynamic Frequency Suppression with Label Disambiguation
summary: Despite the remarkable progress over the past decades, accurately identifying small objects remains challenging because of their insufficient visual cues. Previous works typically attempt to construct discriminative representation of the small objects. However, the wide range frequency domain noises and label ambiguities have been greatly overlooked, which significantly hinders the accurate localization. To address these issues, we propose a novel small object detection (SOD) detector termed DyFrDet, which is able to precisely localize the small object by dynamically suppressing the background distractions in frequency domain. Specifically, we propose a Dynamic Frequency-aware Feature Pyramid Network (DyFrFPN) to adaptively suppress low-frequency redundancy and excessive high-frequency noises. The DyFrFPN transforms the hierarchical features into frequency domain representation, and introduces a Dynamic Band Predictor (DBP) to preserve the discriminative components for small object identification. Afterwards, we present a novel Label Disambiguation Module (LDM), which leverages probabilistic distributions to explicitly model and alleviate the inherent ambiguity of target labels, yielding efficient improvement in localization precision of the small objects with low-resolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DyFrDet achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, indicating its effectiveness and robustness in various challenging scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/ManOfStory/DyFrDet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyFrDet，一种新型小目标检测器，通过动态频率域去噪和标签去歧义两大模块，解决小目标检测中背景干扰和标签模糊问题，在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 小目标检测因视觉线索不足而困难重重，以往方法多聚焦于构建判别性表示，却忽略了频率域噪声（低频冗余和高频噪声）以及标签歧义这两个关键问题，这些问题严重阻碍了精确的目标定位。
AI.method: 提出两个核心模块：(1) DyFrFPN——动态频率感知特征金字塔网络，将层次特征变换到频域，通过动态频带预测器（DBP）自适应抑制低频冗余和高频噪声，保留判别性成分；(2) LDM——标签去歧义模块，利用概率分布显式建模并缓解目标标签的固有歧义，提升低分辨率小目标的定位精度。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，DyFrDet达到最先进的性能，验证了其在各种挑战性场景中的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从频率域视角出发，通过动态抑制背景干扰和建模标签不确定性，为小目标检测提供了新的解决思路，且代码已开源可供后续研究使用。

title: Token Radius Attention for Efficient Video Generation
summary: Video Diffusion Transformers (VDiTs) enable high-fidelity generation but incur quadratic cost from dense 3D self-attention. Existing head- and block-level sparse methods share computation budgets across queries, overlooking token-specific attention demand. We observe that retained density varies across queries yet correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, while dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods with token-dependent radii. Based on these findings, we propose Token Radius Attention (TRA), a training-free framework that maps query entropy to an analytic token budget and converts it into a temporally decayed radius without explicit key ranking. Fused entropy extraction, warm-up reuse, and block-sparse mask construction further reduce overhead. Across seven Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo T2V/I2V configurations, TRA retains only 9-19% of attention interactions and achieves 1.56x-2.05x speedup with competitive generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/Token-Radius-Attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Token Radius Attention (TRA)，一种无需训练的框架，利用注意力熵与保留密度之间的对数线性关系，为不同查询分配动态注意力预算，并转换为时间衰减半径实现块稀疏计算，在视频扩散Transformer中仅保留9-19%注意力交互，实现1.56x-2.05x加速且保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer（VDiTs）具有高质量生成能力，但密集3D自注意力的二次计算成本过高。现有头部级和块级稀疏方法为所有查询共享相同计算预算，忽略了不同查询对注意力计算的差异化需求，导致计算资源分配不优。
AI.method: TRA基于两个关键观察：(1) 保留密度随查询变化，但与注意力熵呈对数线性相关；(2) 主导注意力交互形成以查询为中心的邻域，且邻域半径因token而异。据此，TRA将查询熵映射为解析token预算，并将其转换为时间衰减半径（无需显式key排序），同时通过融合熵提取、预热复用和块稀疏掩码构建来降低额外开销。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1、Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo的七个T2V/I2V配置上，TRA仅保留9-19%的注意力交互，实现1.56x-2.05x推理加速，同时生成质量与稠密注意力相当。
AI.conclusion: TRA验证了查询级自适应稀疏注意力的有效性，通过熵-密度映射和径向邻域近似，在不训练的情况下显著降低视频生成注意力计算开销，为大规模视频扩散模型的高效推理提供了可行方案。

title: ReMiX-MAE: Learning Missing-Channel Cross-Modal Representations from RGB-Only Clinical Facial Videos for Sympathetic-Mediated Pain Assessment
summary: Automated pain assessment in real clinics is limited by scarce clinically grounded facial video data with weak labels (often sequence-level self-report) and by the fact that pain cues can be subtle or near-neutral in RGB, while thermal and depth signals are informative yet impractical to deploy routinely. To address these challenges, we propose ReMiX-MAE (Reconstructing Missing Channel Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoder), a self-supervised multimodal masked pretraining framework that learns transferable facial representations from synchronized RGB, thermal, and depth videos and explicitly trains robustness to missing modalities, enabling RGB-only deployment. To fill the gap of clinically grounded facial pain data with video-level self-report and longitudinal treatment trajectories, we collect the Sympathetic Mediated Pain (SMP) dataset with paired pre- and post-recordings across multiple visits. Under RGB-only deployment, we evaluate ReMiX-MAE using both direct feature extraction and pseudo-multimodal features decoded from RGB. ReMiX-MAE consistently outperforms an RGB-only masked autoencoder baseline on SMP, with pseudo-multimodal features providing additional gains in the challenging five-class setting. Across external datasets, ReMiX-MAE further shows more robust and label-efficient transfer than RGB-only baselines, highlighting its advantage in data-limited clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMiX-MAE，一种自监督多模态掩码预训练框架，利用同步的RGB、热成像和深度视频学习可迁移的面部疼痛表征，并显式训练对缺失模态的鲁棒性，从而支持仅使用RGB的临床部署。作者还收集了SMP数据集（含多次就诊前后配对记录），实验表明ReMiX-MAE在RGB-only部署下优于RGB-only MAE基线，尤其在五分类困难场景中表现突出，且在外部数据集上展现出更强的鲁棒性和标签效率。
AI.motivation: 临床自动化疼痛评估面临两大挑战：一是缺乏临床标注的面部视频数据（通常只有序列级别的自我报告弱标签）；二是疼痛线索在RGB中可能细微或接近中性，热成像和深度信号虽信息丰富但在常规临床环境中难以部署。因此需要一种既能利用多模态信息又能在RGB-only条件下部署的方法。
AI.method: 提出ReMiX-MAE（Reconstructing Missing Channel Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoder），一种自监督多模态掩码预训练框架。核心思路：(1) 从同步的RGB、热成像和深度视频学习可迁移的面部表征；(2) 显式训练对缺失模态的鲁棒性，使模型在仅使用RGB时仍能工作；(3) 在RGB-only部署下，既支持直接特征提取，也支持从RGB解码出伪多模态特征。另外构建了SMP数据集，包含视频级自我报告和纵向治疗轨迹，多次就诊记录配对的术前术后录制。
AI.result: 在SMP数据集上，ReMiX-MAE的RGB-only部署一致优于RGB-only MAE基线，伪多模态特征在五分类困难场景中带来额外增益。在外部数据集上，ReMiX-MAE相比RGB-only基线展现出更强的鲁棒性和标签效率，证明其在数据受限的临床环境中具有优势。
AI.conclusion: ReMiX-MAE通过跨模态掩码自监督预训练，成功地在多模态信息与RGB-only临床部署之间取得了平衡，为数据稀缺的临床疼痛评估场景提供了更鲁棒、更标签高效的解决方案。

title: CAPEval: A Decoupled Caption Evaluation across Understanding and Generation
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Code and dataset will be available at https://liuzhipenggg.github.io/CAPEval/
summary: Captions serve as a primary supervision signal for both multimodal understanding and text-to-image generation. However, previous evaluations treat the caption quality as a single scalar objective, which conflates two distinct properties: (1) how much visual information a caption covers and (2) how reliably the image supports its stated claims. To this end, we design a decoupled caption evaluation benchmark, CAPEval (Coverage And Precision Evaluation), with human-written ground-truth captions and human-verified atomic checklist items. Specifically, CAPEval decomposes caption quality into Coverage and Precision. The former quantifies how thoroughly a caption covers ground-truth factual content, while the latter reflects the factual correctness rate of all claims expressed in the caption. We select 10 captioners and further conduct controlled downstream end-to-end experiments with them from four model families, where the caption source is the only variable. Empirically, we find a consistent task-dependent dissociation: Coverage serves as the stronger correlate for understanding performance, whereas Precision acts as the dominant predictor for generation performance. This decoupled evaluation paradigm not only delivers a more fine-grained diagnosis of caption quality, but also offers actionable guidance for selecting and optimizing captioners tailored to different downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAPEval（覆盖度与精确度评估）基准，将字幕质量解耦为Coverage（视觉信息覆盖程度）和Precision（声明事实正确率）两个独立维度，通过实验发现理解任务更依赖Coverage，而生成任务更依赖Precision。
AI.motivation: 以往的字幕质量评估将质量视为单一标量目标，混淆了两个不同属性：视觉信息的覆盖程度与图像对声明支持的可靠性。这种混淆阻碍了对字幕质量的细粒度诊断，也无法为下游任务提供针对性优化指导。
AI.method: 构建CAPEval基准，包含人类书写的真实字幕和人工验证的原子检查清单条目。将字幕质量解耦为Coverage（覆盖真实事实内容的彻底程度）和Precision（字幕中所有声明的事实正确率）两个维度。选取10个字幕生成器，并在4个模型家族上开展受控下游端到端实验，仅变动字幕来源。
AI.result: 发现一致的任务依赖型分离现象：Coverage是理解性能的更强相关指标，而Precision是生成性能的主导预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的评估范式不仅能提供更细粒度的字幕质量诊断，还能为不同下游任务选择和优化字幕生成器提供可操作的指导。
